Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondiswa kuhulumeni kazwelonke nasezindabeni eziphathelene nenhlonipho noma ekuxosheni kwabo, okungabandakanya imfundo noktraining yamaJaji amasha kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphakathi kwamaJaji amadala, izimo zokusebenza nezimo zesevisi zamaJaji, ukuhlelwa kabusha kwemingcele yeZigaba Eziphezulu, nokunye. Ukuhlanganisa uhlu lwabafakizicelo bokunikezwa izikhundla zamaJaji eNkantolo yeMthethosisekelo, oluthunyelwe ngemigqa emithathu yokukhetha futhi lwethulwa kuMongameli, uma kukhona abafakizicelo abangamukeleki kuMongameli, amagama engeziwe kufanele engezwe. Ukuhamba phambili ekuxoxeni ngezinsolo zokuziphatha kabi noma ukungafaneleki ukuba uJaji, ukuthola umphumela mayelana nocwaningo nokwazisa iNhlangano Yezwe ngempumelelo uma kutholakala ukuthi uJaji unenkinga yokwenza imisebenzi yabo, uyaphumelela emisebenzini yabo noma uxoshwa ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. Ukuhlinzeka iPhalamende ngombiko obhaliwe wonyaka mayelana nemisebenzi eyenziwe ngaleso sikhathi. IKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa liqukethe amaKomishina angama-25 (kuhlanganisa noMongameli noMphakathi) kanye noSekela. Uma udaba oluthinta iZigaba Eziphezulu luphathwa, uJaji Omkhulu waleyo Nkantolo kanye noMphakathi ofanelekile noma abathunyelwe babo bayabandakanywa. Uma inani labantu abafakizicelo besuka ezikhungweni zokwakha umthetho noma emkhakheni wezomthetho ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1 e noma f lingama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli kufanele abakhethe. Uma inani labafakizicelo lidlula ama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli, ngokuxhumana nomkhakha ofanele, uzokhetha inani elifanele lamagama aphakanyiswe ukuze agcwaliswe ama-vacancies ngemuva kokucabangela isimo sokuthi wonke imikhakha ibonakale. Amalungu eKomidi athunywe nguMphakathi Wasezindaweni Zikazwelonke asebenza kuze kube baphathwa ndawonye noma uma kwenzeka enye i-vacancy emkhakheni ophakanyisiwe. Amanye amalungu athunywe noma akhethwe yiKomidi asebenza kuze kube baphathwa yilabo abababekela noma abababekela. Isikhathi sokusebenza kwamanye amalungu eKomidi, uMphakathi, kanye nama-vacancies. Uma ilunga elithile lishiya isikhundla sawo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe sokwazisa ngenyanga eyodwa kuMongameli. Ilunga leKomidi elithunywe ngale ndlela ngaphansi kwesigaba-178 1 e, f, g, h, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo lizoshiywa isikhundla sawo ngokushesha uma iziqu zawo zemfundo zingasasebenzi ukufakazela isikhundla ababeqashwe kuso. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezibekwe esigabeni-178 1 yeMthethosisekelo, noma ilunga eliphelelwe isikhathi singabuyiselwa ukuze siqhubeke nokusebenza. IKomidi izokhetha amalungu ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuhambisana nesigaba-105 1 b, c, e, f, g, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo njengoba uMphakathi engakatholakali, uMphakathi uzothatha indawo kaMongameli. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe kwiGazethi Yombuso [Isaziso SoMnyango R187-15 sikaDisemba 2002] (Ifomu-A). Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise uma isicelo singekho isithombe sedokhumenti noma uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukufaka idokhumenti ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma idokhumenti ingeyona incwadi, ingafundwa ngendlela efunwayo, uma kukhona indlela esigabeni -292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela kuhlobo oluthile lwefomu, umfaki-sicelo uzofinyelela ulwazi ngendlela abacela ngayo. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho imvume ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kahle kwenhlangano yomphakathi ethintwayo, ukonakala kwedokhumenti noma ukuphazamiseka kwezinto ezikhethekile zokuphathwa kwedokhumenti yoMnyango. Uma kukhona izizathu ezinkulu zokungamukeli isicelo ngendlela efunwayo kodwa kukhona enye indlela, izindleko zokuhambisana nesicelo zizobalwa ngokuhambisana nesicelo sokuqala esenziwe ngumuntu ngaphansi kwesigaba -293 kanye 4. Uma kunempendulo ebhaliwe engaphezu kweyodwa esicelweni, umfaki-sicelo ofuna ulwazi mayelana nesinqumo ngenye indlela, isibonelo; ngocingo, kufanele achaze lesi sigaba -182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi bacela egameni lomunye futhi kufanele kube nobufakazi obusekela isicelo esigabeni -182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala noma unokukhubazeka, bangathumela isicelo sedokhumenti ngokuqhubekayo. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele aqedele ifomu egameni lomfaki-sicelo futhi anikeze umfaki-sicelo leyo dokhumenti efanayo/ikhophi esigabeni-183. Umfaki-sicelo ofuna ukufinyelela kudokhumenti equkethe ulwazi lomuntu mayelana nomfaki-sicelo akadingi ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele wazise umfaki-sicelo (ukuhlukanisa umuntu ofuna ulwazi mayelana naye) uma umfaki-sicelo kudingeka akhokhe imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili nesicelo. Imali ethile ye-R35 ikhokhwa ngokuthenga izimpawu zentela ezitholakala ehhovisi leposi. Inani elifanele lezimpawu kufanele lifakwe kufomu lesicelo (Ifomu A). Uma izimpawu zingafakwanga, isicelo ngeke sithathwe kuze kube imali ethile noma ethile yokufaka izimpawu ikhokhwa. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka isicelo enkantolo ephikisana nokuhanjiswa noma ukukhokhwa kwemali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphakathi wezokwazi wenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela efunwayo ngumfaki-sicelo. Isithombe 1: Izimpawu zezitshalo ezithintekayo zikhombisa ukuhamba kwalolu bhubhane. Bheka ama-sclerotia amnyama kanye ne-mycelium emhlophe. Isitshalo esinempilo singase sibe ngakolunye uhlangothi. Isithombe 2: I-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ethishelweni lesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 3: Ama-sclerotia ngaphakathi kwesitho sesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 4: Ukuwa ngaphakathi komqolo. Isithombe 5: Ukuwa kwekhanda - lokhu kubonakala ngaphambi kokuba ikhanda lehle. Isithombe 6: Ukuhamba kwalolu bhubhane - ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo. Ama-sclerotia abuyiselwa emhlabathini ngesikhathi sokuvuna nasekulimeni. Kulesi sithombe, sizogxila kakhulu kulolu bhubhane olubalulekile oluthinta i-canola - Izifo ze-Sclerotinia. Kukhona izifo ezintathu, ukuwa (ukubola) okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia, ukuwa ngaphakathi komqolo, nokubola kwekhanda. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kubangelwa yifungus ehlala emhlabathini ebizwa nge-sclerotia, engena ezimpandeni ze-canola. Lokhu kubola kuhlukile ngoba kuqala ezimpandeni. I-Sclerotinia ebola ikhanda nomqolo ihamba emoyeni ngama-spores. Lezi yizifo ezibeka ingozi phezulu komhlaba kodwa zonke zifana engozini ezidalayo. Zonke ezintathu zibangelwa yisifo esisodwa esibizwa nge-Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, ifungus eliyingozi kakhulu elivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "i-mold emhlophe." Le fungus ifana naleyo ebangela i-mold emhlophe kuma-soybeans, ama-beans omisiwe, i-canola, nezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo ezivame ukuthinteka. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kwenzeka lapho i-canola ifakwe emhlabathini onama-Sclerotinia, kuholela engozini enkulu yokulimala. Kungenzeka ukuthi insimu yonke ithinteke kulolu bhubhane. Ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhambisana nenani lezitshalo ezithintekayo kanye nesikhathi sokufika kololu bhubhane; uma inani lezitshalo ezithintekayo liphezulu futhi lolu bhubhane lungena ngokushesha, ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuzokwandisa. Ngokuvamile, isitshalo esithintekayo sinikeza kuphela u-50% wokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okuqukethwe kwe-oli kwehla uma isitshalo sikhuluma. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi ukuvela kwalolu bhubhane kukhuphula inani le-Sclerotinia emhlabathini. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nzima ukufaka i-canola ezindaweni ezine lolu bhubhane iminyaka eminingi. I-Sclerotinia yehlisa ukukhiqiza futhi ingavimba i-canola ekukhiqizeni esikhathini esizayo, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwemali okujwayelekile okuhlobene ne-canola. Ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo akuvamile ukwenzeka; kuvame ukuvela ngemuva kwemvula enkulu. Lezi zifo azivamile ukwenzeka ngezikhathi zomoya omile. Ukuwa kwekhanda kwehlisa ukuvuthwa kwembewu, inani lembewu, kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-oli. Uma kukhona ama-sclerotia embewini, kwehla isikhwama kanye nokuthengiswa kokukhiqiza. Amakhanda athintekayo avame ukuwa ensimini, futhi imbewu ilahleka emhlabathini. Futhi, uma umshini wokuvuna uthinta ikhanda, imbewu iyahlakazeka futhi ayingeni emshinini. Ukuwa kwekhanda kuyinkinga lapho kukhiqizwa imbewu emisha ezothengwa abalimi ukuze ifakwe ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba azivuthi kahle futhi spread the sclerotia disease, creating new work to clean the seeds before obtaining a certificate stating that the seeds are healthy. Azikho izithako ezikhiqizwa yi-Sclerotinia embewu ye-canola, kodwa uma kukhona ama-sclerotia amaningi, akufanele adliwe ngabantu noma izilwane. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi lolu bhubhane lungangena ezindaweni ezimpilweni futhi kudale ingozi esikhathini esizayo. Ngokuvamile, izimpawu ezivela ngokushesha ziwukubola kwemifanekiso, ukuwa kwezimpande, kanye nesitho somqolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuwa kwezitshalo kuqala kubonakala ezindaweni ngaphambi kokuba izitshalo ziqhakaze, kodwa izitshalo ezine lolu bhubhane zingabonakala uma ziqala ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, isitshalo ngasinye sibonakala ngokuhlukile, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ziyaqhagamshelana. Lolu bhubhane luvame ukuvela ezindaweni ezithile zensimu. Ngoba izitshalo zingabola ngokushesha ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningi zokungena kololu bhubhane, izimpawu zingabonakala ngokushesha. I-lesion ethwele amanzi ikhula ethishelweni (ngaphansi) kwesitshalo. I-lesion inombala ophuzi-oluhlaza bese ibanjwa mnyama ifana nomqolo ophakathi komqolo. Uma ukuwa kuqhubeka, umqolo uba mhlophe futhi ungabonakala ungena. Ukuwa kungabonakala endaweni eyinhloko engaphezu kwezandla ezimbili ubude. Kukho ukuwa ngaphansi komqolo futhi izakhi eziqinile ezibizwa nge-sclerotia (ezilingana nosayizi ukusuka ku-1/8 kuya ku-1/4 inch ububanzi) zitholakala. Ama-sclerotia akhiqizwa yisifo futhi anikeza uphawu balolu bhubhane. Uma kuningi, i-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ikhula ethishelweni somqolo, ngakho ibizwa ngokuthi: "i-mold emhlophe." Ukuwa kwezimpande kubonakala ngokushesha ngoba imvamisa isitshalo siphuma emhlabathini kalula uma pulled. Isikhumba sezimpande sitholakala kalula, sikhombisa i-pith yangaphakathi. Ukuwa kuvame ukwenzeka emiqolweni futhi ama-sclerotia abonakala kuzo zonke izimpande. Ekugcineni, isitshalo esithintekayo sifa. Isitshalo singakhiqiza kuphela ukudla, okuhambisana nesikhathi sokungena kololu bhubhane esitshalo. Amakhanda ezitshalo ezithintekayo ancane kunezempilo. Ukuwa kwehlisa inani lembewu, ikakhulukazi ngoba imbewu ilula. Izitshalo ezithintekayo zehla kalula uma kunomoya omkhulu. Lokhu kuvame ukubonakala lapho izimbali ziqhamuka noma ngemuva kwalolo sikhathi, kubonakala ngaphakathi noma eduze komqolo. Kuqala kubonakala njengombala omnyama noma ophuzi-oluhlaza opholile. Bese umqolo ubamba ikhanda, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba namanzi futhi zibe nsoft. Umqolo uvame ukuphuka uma kukhona ukuwa, futhi konke okungaphezulu komqolo kufa. Imvamisa i-mycelium emhlophe kanye nama-sclerotia azovela ngaphandle nangaphakathi komqolo, ikakhulukazi uma kunemvula. Ekugcineni, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba mhlophe futhi ziyaqala. Ukuwa komqolo kungaqhubeka phansi ethishelweni noma kungakhuphuka phezulu kwekhanda. Ngezinye izikhathi leaf ingathola i-Sclerotinia futhi i-fungus izoqhubeka nokungena nokubola umqolo. Izimpawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo ziwukuthi: i-fungus emhlophe (mycelium) ibonakala ezitshalweni noma izindawo ezithwele amanzi ngaphansi kwekhanda. I-fungus ikhula ngokushesha kulowo mhlaba, ibola ikhanda bese i-mycelium emhlophe kanye nezindawo eziningi ze-sclerotia ezimnyama zivele. Ikhanda livame ukubonakala limhlophe, libonakala ngokushesha. Ikhanda lonke lingabola futhi indawo lapho kukhona imbewu yehla, ishiyela ikhanda elimhlophe elibolile eline-sclerotia. Lezi zikhanda ezim
Amaphoyisa - Umsebenzi Wabo Nendlela Abaphila Ngayo Amaphoyisa, njengezikhungo ezisemthethweni zokugcina ukuphepha emphakathini, adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi babhekelele ukugcina umthetho, ukuvikela impilo, nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde kangcono umsebenzi wabo, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa izinsuku zabo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nomthelela abawenza empilweni yomphakathi. Ekuqaleni, amaphoyisa ahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengezokuphepha, ezokuhlola, nezokuphatha. Umsebenzi wabo uvame ukuqala ekuseni, lapho behamba ezitaladini, bezama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uphephile. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bebonisa ubuhlakani, futhi bakhombise ukuzimisela emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuxhumana nabantu, nokuzama ukuqonda izinkinga ezikhona emphakathini. Amaphoyisa avame ukuxhumana nabantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezibhekene nabo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaphoyisa abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izimo ezinzima, njengez crime, zidinga ukuthi amaphoyisa abe nesibindi, futhi kube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba babe nekhono lokuxazulula izinkinga, futhi bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani abantu abahlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima. Ngokwesibonelo, uma kwenzeka icala lokweba, amaphoyisa kufanele abheke izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ahlole ubufakazi, futhi axhumane nabantu abahlobene. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi busemqoka. Amaphoyisa akhuthazwa ukuba abe nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinhlelo zokubambisana nomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya imicimbi yokwakha ubudlelwano, lapho amaphoyisa ahlangana nabantu, abaxoxe ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi babonise ukuthi bahlonipha izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokwakha ukwethenjwa, okubalulekile ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa abamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekufundiseni umphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya imihlangano yokufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuzivikela, ukuxhumana nabantu abanezinkinga, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule kahle ezimweni ezinzima. Imihlangano yokufundisa ibalulekile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangabathola kanjani usizo, futhi bazi ukuthi amaphoyisa akhona ukuze abavikele. Nokho, akukhona konke okukhanyayo emsebenzini wamaphoyisa. Bahlala bephakathi kwezinselelo ezinzima, ezifana nokucindezelwa, ukungabi nabantu abavumelana nabo, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezibandakanya izigameko eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba amaphoyisa babe nesibindi, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini wabo. Ekugcineni, amaphoyisa adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi babhekelele ukugcina umthetho, ukuvikela impilo, nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde umsebenzi wabo, futhi ubabheke njengabanye abantu ababalulekile empilweni yabo. Amaphoyisa akhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza ngempumelelo, ukuze bakwazi ukuvikela umphakathi, futhi baqhubeke nokwakha izixhumanisi ezinhle phakathi kwabo nabantu. Umsebenzi wabo ungavula amathuba amaningi, futhi ungakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuhle, nokuphepha okungapheli.
Umshini wokutshala udalwe ukuze ubeke imbewu kanye ne-fertilizer emhlabathini ngendlela eqondile ukuze imbewu ikwazi ukuvutha kahle futhi ingabi seduze kakhulu ngesikhathi ithola i-fertilizer efanele. Ububanzi phakathi kwemigqa. Ububanzi phakathi kwemibewu emgqeni. Ubude, inani, nendawo lapho i-fertilizer ibekwe khona. Ubude nendawo lapho imbewu ibekwe khona. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwemibewu nomhlabathi onomswakama. Umshini wokutshala udinga emhlabathini, uvule umhlabathi, ubeke imbewu kulowo mhlaba ovuliwe, uvale imbewu ngomhlabathi, futhi ucindezele kancane umhlabathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwembewu nomhlabathi onomswakama. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zomshini wokutshala, kodwa ekugcineni zenzelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ofanayo - kukhona ingxenye evula umhlabathi, indlela yokubeka i-fertilizer, nendlela yokuthatha imbewu nokuyibeka emhlabathini ngendlela efanele nangokunembile. Ngokuvamile, i-fertilizer ibekwe emhlabathini ngaphambi kwemibewu - lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imbewu ne-fertilizer azithintani ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imbewu ingavuthi kahle. Ngakho-ke, i-fertilizer ibekwe ngaphansi kwemibewu. Ingxenye yokuvula umhlabathi lapho i-fertilizer ibekwe khona imide futhi ikha phezulu. Ingxenye ebeka imbewu ifushane futhi ibekwe ngasohlangothini, futhi imbewu ibekwe kancane ngaphezulu komhlabathi. Ingxenye yomhlabathi ingawa phezu kwembewu ngemuva kokutshala, kodwa kungase kube nezikhala phakathi kwemibewu nezicucu zomhlabathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imbewu nomhlabathi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle (okubalulekile ngoba imbewu idinga ukufaka umswakama ukuze iqale ukuvutha), kuzodingeka ucindezele kancane umhlabathi. Lokhu kucindezelwa kwenziwa ngalezi zinqola ezibizwa ngokuthi izinqola zokucindezela.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Izinyathelo Zokulandela Ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumcimbi obalulekile empilweni kazwelonke, unikeza abantu ithuba lokukhuluma ngemibono, izifiso, nezidingo zabo. Ukuze ukhetho lube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kulandelwe izinyathelo ezithile. Nansi indlela yokuhlela ukhetho lukazwelonke ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Ukuvota Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izakhamizi zibe nolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvota. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zibhale igama lazo ohlelweni lokuvota. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuvakashela emahhovisi kahulumeni endaweni, noma ngokuqhafaza kwi-inthanethi uma kungenzeka. Abavoti kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo ihambisana, futhi uma kudingeka, benze izichibiyelo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukufunda Ngabadayisi Ngaphambi kokuvota, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle abadayisi abavela ezikhundleni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufunda ngamaqembu ezepolitiki, izifiso zawo, nezinhlelo abakhipha uma sebekhethwe. Abavoti bangasebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukahlukene, njengamaphephandaba, iziteshi ze-TV, nezinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze baqonde kahle abadayisi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuvota Uma usuku lokhetho lufika, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle indawo yokuvota. Lokhu kungatholakala kwi-akhawunti yomvoti noma ngezinsiza ezikhona emakhaya. Ngaphambi kokuhamba, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baphathe izinsuku ezifanele zokuphuma, balungise iziqu zabo zokuvota, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi banezinto ezidingekayo, njenge-ID yomvoti. Endaweni yokuvota, abavoti bazodingeka baphendule kumabhalane ukuze baqinisekiswe ukuthi baphuma kokuqala, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Ngemva kokuvota, kuqala inqubo yokuhlonza imiphumela. Lokhu kwenziwa ngababheki bokhetho, abaqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe phansi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku zibalulekile, ukuze kukhuthazwe umoya wokubambisana. Isinyathelo 5: Ukwamukela Imiphumela Lapho imiphumela isitholakele, kubalulekile ukuba ibikwe ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi ubani ophumelele. Lokhu kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba bahloniphe izinqumo ezenziwe, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphatha kahle imiphumela, beqonda ukuthi ukhetho lungukukhetha kwabantu. Lokhu kubambisana phakathi kwabantu kungakhuthaza ukuthula emiphakathini. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubambisana Ngezinye Izinsuku Ngemva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bexhunywe ukuze baphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho abantu bangabakhona khona ukuze bacele imiphumela, futhi bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni ezizayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi kuzokwakha umoya wokuhlanganyela, okuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Isiphetho Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisigameko esibalulekile, esiqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banesikhala sokuzwakalisa izifiso zabo. Ukuze le nqubo ihambe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinyathelo ezichaziwe zilandelwe ngokunembile. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngenkundla efanele yokuvota, sithuthukise isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika. Ukhetho akusikho nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqinile nezwe elikhaliphile.
E-GEMS, silalela lapho amalungu ekhuluma khona. Sijabulela inani lokuxhumana okuhlanzekile futhi sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zethu nezinsizakalo zihlangabezana nezidingo zamalungu ethu. Ngiyajabula ukwethula izinzuzo zika-2010 kini. Kule bhrosha, olunye ulwazi lunikezwa mayelana nok coverage okuthengekayo nokubanzi ongakuthola njengelungu le-GEMS ngo-2010. Siyanxusa ukuthi ukhethe inketho efanele izidingo zakho nezomndeni wakho. Ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuthuthukiseni kuyisibonakaliso sokuzinikela kwethu kuwe, ezidingweni zakho zempilo, kanye ne-CHOICE yakho. Kule mhlahlandlela, sikhombisa izinketho zethu ezinhlanu ezithengekayo - ukusiza ukuthi wenze ukukhetha okunolwazi mayelana nenketho yeziqu ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zomndeni wakho ngo-2010. Izinzuzo eziyisisekelo ezitholakala kumalungu ngo-2009 zigcinwe zikhona ngo-2010. Siphinde sakhulisa imikhawulo yezinzuzo ezitholakalayo futhi sangeza ezintsha, njengezinzuzo ezintsha zeBlock enkethweni ye-Emerald. Sijabulela ukwazi ukuthi noma ngabe isikhathi somnotho sikhulu, siqhubeka nokukunika ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuthengekayo nokwakhiwe kahle. Imali yokufaka ka-2010 iqala ku-R424, futhi siphumelele ukugcina ukukhuphuka kwemali yokufaka kuyo yonke inketho ku-10.8%. Amathebula emali yokufaka ka-2010 afakiwe kulomhlahlandlela, ukuze ubone ukuthi ukukhuphuka kuzothinta kanjani iphakheji yakho. Ngithanda ukubonga ngokuqhubeka kokwesekwa kwakho futhi ngikufisela impilo enhle ngo-2010. Khumbula ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsizwa yakho empilweni enhle. Ekupheleni konyaka ngamunye, sinika amalungu ethu ithuba lokushintsha ukuya kwenye inketho yeziqu. Ukuze ukhethe, kudingeka ucabange ngezidingo zakho zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izinzuzo ezitholakalayo kuyo yonke inketho, kanye nemali yokufaka ngayinye. Sicela uthathe lokhu kubalulekile njengoba uvunyelwe ukushintsha inketho yakho kanye kuphela ngonyaka. Uma ufuna ukushintsha inketho yakho ngo-2010, sicela ulandele lezi zinyathelo ezintathu ezilula ngezansi. Khumbula ukuthi ifomu lakho le-"Khetha" kumele lifike kithi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kosuku lwe-30 Novemba 2009. Lolu mhlahlandlela luhlanganisa izici ezihlukahlukene ze-GEMS. Luhloselwe ukuba kube isikhumbuzo esisheshayo kuphela futhi aluhlanganisi imithetho yeSchem. Uma kwenzeka ukungavumelani, imithetho ebhalwe phansi izothatha indawo.
Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa ukuhlela izikhungo ezinqoba ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi, ukuveza konke, kanye namazinga okwethembeka. Ukwanda nokufakwa kwezinguquko ezakhiweni ezifana nalokhu okusebenzisa izinsiza zobuchwepheshe obukhethekile kufakiwe. Sifuna ukwandisa amazwi okuthokozisa emndenini nasemakhosini akhe asebenze naye eToyota kulandela ukulahleka kwendodana yakhe evela e-Afrika. Lapho sibheka umhlangano wase-Algiers, umhlangano wokugcina weMillennium, sifuna ukuveza izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu kulezi zinsongo ezintsha. Izikhungo ezihlelwe kahle zamabhizinisi, abasebenzi, nomphakathi kufanele ziqinisekiswe ngokusimama kwiKhansela. Iziphakamiso ezichazwe ngenhla zakha indlela ebanzi okufanele izinguquko zilandele. Ibhajethi yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ibheka izimali ezidingeka ukukhokhwa nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusimama kwezezimali. IKhansela ibike uNgqongqoshe ngentuthuko eyenziwe ekwenzeni umsebenzi okhishwe futhi izinguquko zakamuva, igcizelela izinselelo ezidinga ukunakwa. Ukunikezwa komholi omusha ophakeme kuzothathwa ezixhumanisweni ezishiwo ngenhla yiphaneli yabahluleli. Izindlela zokuhlola Umsebenzi Wokubambisana ziqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngenhloso yokwakha engxoxweni yezepolitiki eqhubekayo phakathi kwamazwe amabili ezingeni eliphezulu, esifundeni, nakwezinye izigaba. NgoDisemba, kwaba nokwabiwa kokonakala komhlaba, kubandakanya izinsiza zokumboza ama-robot ashiye izintambo zikagesi zivele. Izinto ezibucayi zezimboni kanye nezixube zezimboni ekwakhiweni, ukuhlanganiswa, ukusabalalisa, ukusetshenziswa, nokulahla zenza ubungozi empilweni yabantu nasemvelweni. Lapho ufaka emkhakheni, imbewu kumele ibe namanzi kodwa ingabi namanzi amaningi. Ababambiqhaza kulolu hlelo bazovunyelwa ukuhola izimali ezingeni elihle eminyakeni emithathu yohlelo. Lokhu bekungenye indlela yokwethula udaba olwenziwe ngamaphephandaba azimele, amaningi awo engamabhizinisi amakhulu, athuthukise imibono yabantu abamhlophe abafika lapha ukuze baphathe leli lizwe. Kubantu basePalestine, lokhu kusho ukusungula izimo zokugcina zokuletha ukuthula ezizobandakanya izindaba ezibalulekile kakhulu. Ukugeleza okuqondile kwamanzi abandayo phansi eziphethweni eziphezulu nezivunguvungwini ezinamandla, zitholakala entshonalanga naseningizimu naseNingizimu Afrika. Ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uqale ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizinkulu ezihlanganyela nezobuciko bendawo. Lokhu kuyisizathu esibalulekile sokuthi amazwe ase-Afrika avumele iSivumelwano. Imakethe yaseTshwane iyindawo ehlukile lapho amanani ebekwe khona futhi lapho imifino nezithelo zithengiswa khona, kuzuza abakhiqizi, abathengi, nabathengisi. Njengoba kuhlale kunjalo, sibhekene nezinselelo zesikhashana, kodwa akukho okuzosivimba ekuthuthumeleni phambili ukuze sibe nekusasa elingcono, futhi simema abaqalayo ukuba basihambise kulolu hambo. Izindawo ezisemngciphekweni ophakeme ohlelweni lwezindawo eziningi zizokhunjuzwa futhi zihlolwe, ukuze kuncishiswe isidingo somsebenzi wezobunjiniyela ukuvikela izakhiwo noma abantu. Ngithanda ukwabelana nabameli ekugubheni bonke ababekhona eMhlanganweni, ikakhulukazi abamele abahlonishwa abavela kwamanye amazwe ababekhona lapha. I-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima zezimali, futhi isu lokubheka isikhathi somsebenzi lalihloselwe ukuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza kube nokuzimela nokukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele. Abantu abasha abaneziphumo zengqondo bangafaka izicelo zokungena ohlelweni lweTraining Workshops Unlimited. Ngaphandle kweqiniso elingaphikiswa lokuba khona kwabo eNingizimu Afrika, kwenziwa uphenyo olukhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zesayensi zibe nendima ebonakalayo ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe obusha nasekuqhamukeni nemibono emisha phakathi kwentsha yethu. Inani labafundi lenyukile phakathi kwabafundi abamnyama, kodwa lokho kukhula kwenani labafundi abamnyama akuhambelani nezikhangiso ezidingekayo kulabo bafundi. IKomidi Lezokuphathelene Nezimali linqume ukuthi noma ngabe kukhona ukwehla okuncane ekubukekeni kwamandla ezimali, ukugcina umgomo wezezimali kusemqoka okwamanje. Izinguquko kumele zicabangele izindaba ezibalulekile kakhulu ezifana nezimiso zokuzimela kwezihlalakuhle, kugcizelelwa izinhlelo zangaphakathi ukuze izihlalakuhle zikwazi ukuphendula kulokho okwenzekile nokwenza kube nokufinyelela kwezobulungiswa kubo bonke. Kumele kube nezindlela ezisunguliwe zokuhlola ukusimama kwabantu besifazane ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha kwezempilo. Amathuba akhona lapha - thina singabantu abasebenza kanzima, ngakho asifuni ukuvuma futhi siqale ukusebenza. Amabhizinisi asika izinkuni ngaphandle kwalezi zwekazi akhulisa ukungabi nemithetho mayelana nemikhawulo yokusika izinkuni. Lapha, izimali zikahulumeni ezabelwe minyaka yonke zokwakha nezokusebenza zirekhodwe. Lo msebenzi usitshela ukuthi, ukuze abantu bethu babe nephephile, abesifazane bethu nezingane kumele zingasetshenziswa ukuthwala izidakamizwa ngalezi zigaba zobugebengu. Sivumelana nesu lokuthuthukiswa elinophiko olubanzi futhi investa izinsiza kubantu bethu bonke. Ukulungiselela umhlaba kube kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukusungulwa kwesistimu nokuzuza izinzuzo ezibalulekile. Futhi yilabo abakhathazekile kakhulu abahluphekile kakhulu. Kucacile ukuthi iTshwane iyidolobha elinikeza amathuba amaningi okuxhumana kwezomnotho, ukuxhumana kwezok education, kanye nezamasiko, ezokuvakasha, nezokuxhumana. Izifunda ezingaphandle kwalesi sifunda zizophoqeleka ukuba zihlolisise izinhlelo zazo zokuthuthukiswa. UMbutho Wezokuphatha Wasekhaya uqeqeshwe ukwenza ukuhlola kwedatha nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Uma ungumthuthukisi wephrojekthi, umema ukuba uthumele ifomu lesicelo ukuze ubonise ukuthi unentshisekelo yokubhalisela iphrojekthi yakho. Lezi zindawo ngokuvamile zikhululwa ngaphansi kwedamu, lapho ikhwalithi yamanzi iphansi futhi ingase ibe yingozi ezidalweni eziphilayo emanzini. Lo mphakathi unabantu abaningi abaxhumene nabo abathatha izinto kalula emhlabeni wonke, kuhlanganise nabapolitiki. Ngithanda ukuqaphela intuthuko eyenziwe wezweni lonke. Ungangiqinisekisa ukuthi kudlule isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuba uvalwe? Ekhulumeni kwakhe kokugcina njengoMongameli ngoSepthemba unyaka odlule, wakhombisa ukuzithoba kwelizwe lakhe futhi wabeka lokho elizweni elifuna phambili kokuthi yena ofuna. Ikhwalithi yokugunda utshani iholela ekutholeni kahle lokho okomile kwezilwane. Kukhona okuthile okulindelwe ukuthi kwenzeke uma iziqondiso zokungcoliswa komoya ziphulwa. Izigaxa zingaba uphawu lwezifo, noma umphumela wokudla okungafanele. Kucacile ukuthi umthetho ohlosiwe ugcizelela ukuthi izindaba zokungcoliswa komoya azikhokhiswa kuphela ngumlomo. Kulokhu, kokubili okuqukethwe kanye nesimo noma indlela esetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa ulwazi kufanele kubhekwane. Namuh
IPhalamende idinga idokhumenti ezovumela imibono yomphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezithile ukuba iphume ezincwadini zikamasipala ezinezikhangiso zomphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinsiza zethulwe ePhalamende ngenhloso yokwenza kube umthetho obophelelayo owamukelwe yiPhalamende. Lokhu kuhambisana nemithetho kahulumeni eqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni angachaza ngemininingwane futhi azibophezele, aphendule ngendlela efanele, futhi abe sobala. Ekwenyukeni kokuqala kukaDisemba 2006, amalungu ePhalamende avumelene ekubhaleni umthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ezincwadini zikamasipala ezinezikhangiso zomphakathi, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. UNgqongqoshe wezokuphila kwemvelo nezokuhamba, uMarthinus Van Schalkwyk, wamemezela ngoDisemba 8, 2006, ukuthi lo mthetho uzobe utholakala ezincwadini zokukhuluma zomphakathi ngoDisemba 15, 2006. UNgqongqoshe wakhuluma ngokucacile ukuthi ngenxa yezakhi ezahlukene ezenza lo mthetho, umphakathi unikezwa izinsuku eziyi-90 zokukhuluma nokukhombisa imibono yabo ngalolu mthetho. Le dokhumenti itholakala kumapublishers wezincwadi zikamasipala (inombolo yocingo 012-334 4511 noma 012-465 7531) noma kuwebhusayithi kahulumeni http://www.deat.gov.za/. Inhloso yalezi zihloko ezitholakala lapha ukusiza umphakathi ekukhulumeni ngezindaba ezidala incazelo futhi zixhomeke kulwazi olwanele mayelana nalokho umphakathi ofuna ukukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esinikeziwe sezi-90. Lezi zihloko zenzelwe ukuchaza umlando owaholela ekushicilelweni kombiko osemthethweni kahulumeni mayelana nokuphathwa nentuthuko yezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika (iWhite Paper on Sustainable Coastal Development in South Africa). Lo mbiko kahulumeni unikeze umgomo kazwelonke wokuphatha izilwandle zethu. Lapha kuqukethwe incazelo emfushane echaza umsebenzi wesigaba ngasinye esitholakala kulomthetho. Uma lo mthetho uba umthetho ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, kuzoba isikhathi sokuqala ukuthi lo mthetho ube nomthetho (Act) ophathelene nokuphathwa nentuthuko yezilwandle. Izilwandle ziyinsiza yezomnotho engakahlukaniswa. Ukushicilelwa komthetho ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukhuluma ngawo kuletha ithuba elibalulekile kulabo abathintekayo ezilwandle, labo abafuna ukuxhumana nabathintekayo mayelana nezilwandle, kanye namalungu omphakathi afuna ukufaka isandla ekwakhiweni kwemithetho eyinhlanganisela yokuphathwa kwezilwandle. Imibuzo ebuzwa kakhulu - kungani kufanele kube nomthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ngqo - ingabe izilwandle azihlanganisiwe nemithetho eyamukelwe yokubheka imvelo? Imibuzo le izotholakala ngezansi. Izilwandle ziyingxenye ehlukile yemvelo. Yindawo lapho umhlaba uhlangana nolwandle, indawo engakhululekile kodwa ixhasa izidingo eziningi zabantu. Izilwandle ziyisistimu enezici eziningi esingazibala, isistimu yesayensi yezinhlanga eziphilayo zezilwandle, ukuvikelwa, ukuhamba, kanye nokuxhumana kwalezi zici okudinga ukubhekwa nokucatshangelwa mayelana nokuphathwa kwezilwandle. Izilwandle kufanele ziphathwe kahle ukuze kukhuphuke izinga lezinzuzo ezivela kuzo zonke amathuba atholakala ezilwandle. Nokho, le ndlela yokuphatha nokubhekwa ayikasebenzi kahle kuze kube manje ngoba izakhi ezahlukene zikahulumeni ziqhuba kuphela izinto eziphathelene nezindawo zabo ezithile ezifana nokusetshenziswa komhlaba, ezolimo, amanzi, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nezinye. Iphromotha indlela ebhekelela zonke izigaba ezithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezilwandle. Le sistimu ibonisa izilwandle njengendawo okufanele ibonakale njengokubalulekile futhi kufanele iphathwe ngokufanele. Phambilini, ukubaluleka kwezilwane nemvelo endaweni yezilwandle njengokudingeka okubalulekile kokuthuthukiswa akukabhekwanga kahle ezinqumweni ezithathwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubona izinzuzo ezivela ezilwandle. Inani lezinsiza ezitholakala ezilwandle, ngonyaka ka-1998, lalilinganiselwa ku-R168 billion ngonyaka, okuyinzuzo elinganiselwa ku-35% yomkhiqizo kazwelonke wezomnotho wezilwandle. Umnotho obalulekile uxhumene nezilwandle futhi uqhubeka usebenzisa ngendlela engafanele, okungabandakanya ukwakhiwa nokuhamba. Amathuba okuthuthukiswa abalulekile noma kukhona inkinga yokuphuma kwawo, futhi ukuvumelana kwamathuba kubantu bonke kuyalahleka, futhi izilwane nemvelo yezilwandle nazo ziyaphazanyiswa. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela futhi ukuphathwa kwemvelo okuzoqinisekisa ukuthi imvelo yezilwandle isetshenziswa ngendlela esheshayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi impilo yemvelo nezitshalo, ukuhamba kwenzeke ngendlela efanele. Ukuze impilo yezilwane nemvelo ibe nephephile ukuze isetshenziswe ngendlela esheshayo, akufanele kuholele ekuphileni kwezilwane nemvelo. Ukuze amathuba okuzijabulisa ezilwandle atholakale kubo bonke ngokulinganayo, umphakathi osebenzisa izilwandle kufanele ufundiswe ukuze ubambisane futhi unakekele, ikakhulukazi ukuvuselela abampofu kanye nemiphakathi abavela kuyo, kubandakanya abesifazane nezingane. Ukuze le sistimu isebenze, umphakathi kufanele ube namathuba angcono, imisebenzi, futhi ube neziqhamo ezizuzisayo. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni awuzange uveze kuphela umbono, imigomo, nezinhloso mayelana nokuphathwa okufanele kwezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mbiko uthathile esinye isinyathelo mayelana nalokho okufanele kulandelwe lapho kuqala le sistimu yokuphatha izilwandle. Enye indlela kwakuwukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo kanye nemithetho ephathelene nalesi sikhungo. Ngemuva kokuba amalungu ePhalamende avumelene ngalombiko, uhlaka lwezomthetho lwahlaziywa. Lokhu kwenziwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi lo mbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ungavulwa ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthetho ezivele zakhululwa. Ngemuva kwalolu hlolo, kwatholakala ukuthi kudingeka imithetho ephathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ukuze kuqale lo mbiko. Inhloso yalombiko kanye nokusebenza kwengqalasizinda yokuphatha izilwandle ephakanyisiwe kuxhomeke kumaphuzu akhulunywe ngemininingwane ngenhla. Lesi sigaba sichaza imigomo nezivumelwano, futhi siphinde sibe umthetho ozosiza ekuhumusheni kwalombiko, sikhanyisa indima kahulumeni ekuphathweni kwezilwandle, futhi sichaze ukuthi lo mbiko uhambelana nani futhi ubathinteka kanjani. Lo mthetho ophumelele kufanele ufundwe kanye nomthetho wezokuphatha imvelo kazwelonke, futhi lo mbiko uphinde uchaze ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani uma kungahambisani nalomthetho nakwezinye. Lo mthetho uhambelana nokusungulwa komthetho ophathelene nokusetshenziswa kwezilwandle ngumphakathi, kanye nemithetho ethinta izilwandle. Indawo yezilwandle ichazwa ngemininingwane ephathelene nendawo yokuqala (isigaba sokuqala), indawo esesigabeni sezilwandle esisetshenziswa umphakathi ukuze azijabulise futhi athole inzuzo ezilwandle (indawo yokuvikela yezilwandle). Umnyango Wezolimo ugcina uhlu lwezinhlobo ezibalulekile zezitshalo ezihlukene nezithelo. Ukubika izinhlobo zezitshalo ngenjongo yokuhambisana nokufakwa kwazo ohlwini lwezinhlobo zezitshalo kwenziwa ngohlelo lokusebenza. Ukugxila kukhulu ekubalulekeni kwezimali kwezinhlobo zezitshalo emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ifomu lokusebenza eliphelele kanye nephuzu lobuchwepheshe mayelana nezimali ezidingekayo kumele kuthunyelwe kanye nokuhlolwa kwezithombo noma izitshalo zokukhulisa, imvume ebhaliwe evela kumnikazi, uma ungumkhulisi, kanye nohlobo olukhethiwe noma olwakhiwe. Sicela uchaze emibuzweni ukuthi le ndlela kufanele iqhathaniswe nanoma yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi izinhlobo ezintsha kufanele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kutholakale umehluko wazo. Uma ukuvikelwa kudingeka ngokulandela amalungelo abakhulisi bezitshalo, abafakizicelo bayelulekwa ukuthi bathumele izicelo ndawonye ukuze kugcinwe isikhathi nemali. Inqubo yokufakwa ohlwini lwezinhlobo izothatha okungenani isikhathi sokutshala nokukhula kwezitshalo.
Akukho ingxenye yale ndatshana engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngabe iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhalwe phansi efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukusebenzisa leli thuluzi kahle nangokwaneliseka, kubalulekile kumuntu ukuba nolwazi ngezisho ezithile ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa njalo ngababhali bezomthetho eMthethweni Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu shwankathelo ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubona nokujwayela lezi zisho ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa eMthethweni Wobufakazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emifushane ebasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene neMthethweni Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhonjiswe phambi kwecala ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi ikomidi lenze isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubalulekile bukhuluma ngawo wonke ulwazi nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimfanelo nokulawulwa kokuthi izimfanelo zethulwa kanjani ngokwethembeka. Izimfanelo zingathulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibonakalayo. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezikhala zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi uhamba kuphi, incazelo yeMthethweni Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyenza ubufakazi obubalulekile nokuthi yini equkethwe. Impikiswano ethulwe ngombuso kanye neqembu lokuvikela ayithathwa njengobufakazi kodwa iyisithako esisiza enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihlosiwe ukugqamisa isimo somthetho noma izimfanelo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze ithonya ukucabangela kwekhamphani lapho ikhipha isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, izinhlangothi zinekhono lokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obukhulunywe ngempela. Izimfanelo zecala yilezo ezethulwe yiphathi ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi ukuze iwine leli cala. Izimfanelo zivame ukulethela ubufakazi noma ziqhubele phambili. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihlobene nobudlelwane bomzali, ubuhlanga bababa kuzoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwane bezocansi nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobudlelwane bomzali. Ubufakazi obuqinile buchaza ubufakazi obunamandla noma ukuthi akukho olunye ubufakazi olungcono kunalokho okukhona. Ubufakazi obungaphikiswa buchaza ukuthi kukhona olunye ubufakazi olungcono noma ukuthi bekukhona. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ithathwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti athathwa njengobufakazi obungaphikiswa. Igama elithi "prima facie" liyisisho sesiLatini esisho "ngokokuqala." Isisho sobufakazi obucacile ezimweni zomthetho sisho ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe phambi kwekhamphani bufanele ukusungula iqiniso noma icala ngaphandle kokuthi kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obucacile luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, ubufakazi bungase bukhombise ukuthi u-A wayenomgomo wokubulala u-B futhi wabonwa eqhuba ephuma endlini ka-B enokhuni olugcwele igazi. U-X uyafakaza ukuthi wezwa ingilazi iphuka futhi waphendukela ukubona u-Y emi phambi kwefasitela eliphukile lika-Z, lapho u-Y ebamba itshe esandleni sakhe. Ubufakazi obuqondile buyilokho okufakazelwe um witness. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, u-C ufakaza ukuthi wayemi phandle kwendlu ka-B ngesikhathi ebona u-A ehlula u-B. Ukuvunyelwa kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi, futhi akukho standard yokulinganisa izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe sincike ekutheni buhambisana yini noma ukuthi ukuvunyelwa kwabo kuzobeka umsolwa engozini. Kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezizokweneliseka ekupheleni kwecala. Uma isimo singanelisi, lelo bufakazi alithathwa njengelungile. Ikhampasi yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzweni komsolwa nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa yiqembu lokuvikela. Ngemuva kokuphela kwecala, umsolwa uzoba nethuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi obuphuma ngemuva kokubuzwa kuzobekwa eceleni yikhamphani. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, ikhamphani izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe buhambisana nezimfanelo zecala. Amandla kuyilungelo noma isibopho esidingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho kuthulwa ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zamandla. Amandla abantu kanye namandla ombuso. Ukungena kwenkantolo kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqinile futhi obungaphikiswa noma bukhishwe ngaphandle kokuthi izimfuneko zomthetho ezithile zifezekiswe. Ukungena kwangaphandle kubhekisela ekungeni okwenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuthintekayo ekuphikisaneni noma empikiswaneni. Ukuvuma kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umsolwa evuma ngokuphelele futhi ngaphandle kokungabaza emsebenzini, okungaba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo kuzothathwa njengokuvuma ukuvuma. Isaziso senkantolo sikhombisa ukuthi ikhamphani yamukela izimfanelo ezaziwa kanye nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa alukwazanga ukufakazelwa ngobufakazi ngesikhathi sokubuzwa. Isinqumo sokukholwa siwukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimfanelweni ezithile ezisunguliwe ngumthetho. Umthwalo wobufakazi ubhekisela emsebenzini noma isibopho sephathi sokwethula ubufakazi obuqinile, emthethweni wobugebengu lo mthwalo ubekwe ezindleleni zabaphenyi. Umthwalo wobufakazi obubalulekile ubhekisela emsebenzini noma isibopho sokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze ikhamphani ibize umsolwa ukuthi aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lelo bufakazi elicacile elikhulunywe yiphathi evula leli cala.
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo: Indaba Yethu Ngaphambi kokuba umnotho wezwe lethu nezenzo zethu ziqhamuke ngaphakathi kwemithombo emisha, sasingakabi nesinqumo esiqinile sokusebenza ndawonye. Izikhathi zazinzima, abantu bezwa ubuhlungu bamazwe asebenzayo, izimo zomphakathi zaziphikisana, kanti imibono yayingafani. Ngaleso sikhathi, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika lalibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, okuyizinto ezaziphoqa abantu ukuba bacabange ngokuhlukile, baphendule izinkinga zabo ngokubambisana, baphokophele impilo engcono. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kwahamba phambili lapho kuvela izwi lezizukulwane ezintsha ezazifuna ushintsho. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMandela wayengakatholanga ithuba lokubusa, kodwa izwi lakhe lalingalalelwayo. Abantu bethula umbono ophakeme wokuthi ubulungisa kufanele bubekezelwe, futhi baveza imicabango ehlukene emihlanganweni yolimi olwakhiwe. Zaziningi izigameko ezithinta ukuhamba phambili kwemizamo yokwakha umthethosisekelo. Umhla omubi, ukufunwa kwezinsiza kwafika phezulu, kanti ukuvota kwakubukeka kuncane. Kodwa ke, uMthethosisekelo wakhiwa ngothando lwezulu, kwathi abantu bahlola izindawo ezinkulu eziboniswa ngezithombe ezimnandi zamathuba amasha. Kwakukhona imibuthano ebhotela, abantu behlanganisa i - ngalo zinyanga, bese bephakamisa amazwi abo njengokukhanyisa ubumnyama. Izinyanga zamanje, abasebenzi bamazwe abavela ezindaweni eziningi baziphakamisa ngendaba yokwakha umthethosisekelo, befuna ukuhlanganisa imicabango yabo. Emhlanganweni obalulekile, ngezinsuku ezithile, beziphatha njengezithunywa zeMali, bephakanyiswa ubuqotho nokubumbanisa izwi. Lokhu kwawa phakathi kwemisebenzi, abafundisi nezinduna besebenzisa imihlangano ukwakha isimo esifanele sobumbano lwabo. Kwavuka izinsuku ezimnandi, nakuba ziningi izinhlelo ezazingatholakali, izwe lathola ubuhlakani obufunwa. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawusondela ndawonye, ulandela ukulawulwa komthetho nokubuyisana komkhathi. Kwathi abantu babona ukuthi ukwakha umthethosisekelo kwakuyithuba lokuthi baveze izincwadi zabo, izifiso zabo, baphinde babalekele emuva ezikhathini ezinzima. Kwakukhona owesilisa owaqala ukwakha iNhlangano Yentando Yabantu, efuna ukuphakamisa ukwakhiwa kwesimanje sokubusa. Ubuqotho bakhe bujoliswe ezindabeni zezenhlalo, ethi umthetho kumele uhlonishwe. Izwe lalihamba phambili, izifunda zenzeka zaziwa, nabantu befundeka gebhude, beze nemibono ehluke-hluke. Kwaqhamuka iziphakamiso zokubuyekezwa, ukuhlela kwesiSekeli, izikhumbuzo zeMali, izinsizwa zafuna ukwenza umehluko. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwaba yingxubevange yokwakha umthethosisekelo. Imithetho ehlukene yayihamba kancane, bese ibhalwa ngendlela ekhangayo ukuze ibheke phakathi kwezinkanyezi. Umthethosisekelo waba uthembiso, i-promise ephakeme yokuthi abantu bangenza umehluko. Kwathi umphakathi, njengoba benezizukulwane ezahlukene, wathola inkanyezi enqamula ubuhlobo. Ngesikhathi isivumelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nezinhlangano sashiwo, abaphathi behlelwa kakhulu. Kwakulimaziswa abantu besebenzisa izindlela nokulandela izinyathelo. Abantu bezindla ngezikhathi ezimbi, kodwa umthethosisekelo waba uphawu lwezithombe ezinhle. Abaphathi baphakamisa izwi elilodwa, benza umphakathi ube nesithakazelo esijulile. Kwathi sekuphela isikhathi sokulindela, iNhlangano Yentando Yabantu yatha ukwakha umthethosisekelo. Abantu bakhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa umoya ophuma kumabandla waba umoya omusha. Kwathi umphakathi wathola amandla okwakha nokukhulisa ezizindeni zawo. Imithetho, izigaba nezinsizakusebenza zathelela isimo esisha sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo ezazithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isivumelwano saziwa njengomthombo wezinto ezintsha, umthethosisekelo ubumba inhlonipho, ukulingana nezinsiza zokwakha. Kwakungekho ukulangazelela, bezithanda izinqubo ezithokozisayo, futhi bakhumbula ukuthi lezi zinguquko zazididiyela ebuhleni bomphakathi. Ubuqotho busizayo, kanti umthethosisekelo waba yisithombe salokho abantu abafisa ukukwenza. Ekugcineni, umthethosisekelo waba umthombo wezimo ezinhle, ukwakha ukuvuma phakathi kwabantu. Kombuso wabantu, kwenza kube sobala ukuthi umphakathi unamandla okwakha. Kwathi sengathi izinkanyezi zikhanya, umthethosisekelo wanikeza izinhlelo ezinkulu zempilo yethu. Kwakungekho ukungabaza, umphakathi uya phambili. Ngaleyo ndlela, umthethosisekelo wakulethela uhlelo oluhlukile lokuphila, lapho wonke umuntu ebamba iqhaza. Ngakho, kufanelekile ukuhamba phambili, sizigcine ukuze siphile, sithande, sihlanganyele, sizithande. Lokhu kwakungukwakha umthethosisekelo, okuyindida yokuhamba kwesikhathi, eyakha izandla zethu, hamba phambili ukuze uNtlama umthethosisekelo. Abantu babebambene, bahamba phambili, kwathi umthethosisekelo waba ukwakha ubumbano — lesi yisandla esihlanganisa izinkanyezi phakathi kwethu sonke.
Ama-Orlando Pirates: Ukuhlola impilo yebhola lezinyawo eNingizimu Afrika Ama-Orlando Pirates, okuyiqembu eliyaqhamuka emadolobheni amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, kubeka izimpawu ezinhle emlandweni wezokugijima. Umsebenzi waleli qembu uqinisekiswe yikhono lawo lokwenza impumelelo emidlalweni eminingi, okuhlanganisa nezinyathelo ezithokozisayo ezifaka phakathi izicoco zePremier Soccer League, iNedbank Cup, kanye neCAF Champions League. Kunokuhamba phambili okungalindelekile kwalesi sikhumbuzo, sithola izinkanyezi ezahlukene ezisebenza ngaphakathi kwayo. Imvelaphi nethonya lezingxenye zomphakathi Ama-Orlando Pirates asetshenziselwa ukunweba umnqopho wezokuphepha phakathi kwenhlalo yebhola. Yasungulwa ngo-1937, leli qembu lihlala likhumbula izimpumelelo zasendulo. Leli qembu libonwa njengenye yezingxenye ezinkulu zomlando wesifunda saseNingizimu Afrika, elihlanganisa umphakathi weziqhingi, abavakashi, nabadlalayo. Izinhlelo zawo zokuthuthukisa ibhola lendawo zikhiqiza abadlali abasha abakhula ukwenza imisebenzi emangalisayo. Ubuhlakani bokuphatha Ukuphathwa kweqembu kudinga umsebenzi omkhulu, futhi amaPirates akwenza lokho kahle. Ubulungiswa bokuphatha buncike emgomeni ohlomiwe, ofaka phakathi ukuqhubeka komphakathi kanye nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwamaqembu. Abaphathi bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe Bama-Orlando Pirates buhlanganisa abaninimabhuku nabafundi, okubandakanya ukufundisa amalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngaso sonke isikhathi ukudala umkhosi ophumelelayo, onikeza abadlali nethimba lonke ithuba lokukhula. Ukusebenza komkhankaso Njengoba singena esikhathini esisha semidlalo, ukuphumelela kwegame yeqembu sekubhekwene kahle. Ekuqaleni konyaka, amaPirates abethe umkhankaso oqine woMqhudelwano, abantu abaningi bejabule futhi bekhuthazekile. Lokhu kwalandela indlela yokuhlola imiphumela yokuqala nezinyathelo zokulungisa isimo somqhudelwano. Unezimpumelelo ezinzima, i- coaching staff isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuyingqayizivele ekwakheni imidlalo ehlakaniphile. AmaPirates abona ukuthi kunenkinga ethile ebuhlotsheni nomhlaba wezemidlalo, okwenza kuphumelele izimbangi ezinzima ezifanele ibhande lemidlalalo. Izinkanyezi nabadlali Ngaphambi kokuthi iPirates ibonakale njengeqembu eliphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuba kuba nezinkanyezi ezikhanzilephathi. Abadlali abanjengoThembinkosi Lorch, Happy Jele, noGabadinho Mhango baveza izimfanelo ezihlukene ezibangela ukubaluleka kwabo emsebenzini. Abadlali abafaka imakhono, ubuchule kanye nokuphikelela izama ukukhombisa izinga eliphezulu lemidlalo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkanyezi futhi nabalandeli bukhulu, kubonisa isitayela sokuqhuba imidlalo esiphumelelayo. Lokhu kudala isiko elihlangene, elijabulisayo nelihloniphekile phakathi kwamaqembu noma izigaba. Isigaba Sokuncintisana Uma sibheka isigaba sokuncintisana, amaPirates aphokophele phezulu kakhulu kuzo zonke izingeniso. Kwezinsuku zakamuva, lokhu kugudluza izithombe ezinkulu zokuheha abalandeli, abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, laba abathanda ibhola. Lokhu kudala uhlobo lwezikanathi phakathi kweqembu nomphakathi, kudalula imiphumela emihle. Ithuba Lokuthola Ukuthola Imiphumela Ekuhlakanipheni AmaOrlando Pirates naye ajabulela ukuthola amalungelo okuthola emiphumeleni ebucayi ngaphakathi kokuhlelekile. Ngokuqhubeka nokucishe kwenziwa kubaluleke kakhulu endaweni yokuhlonipha nezinkanyezi zabafana abasha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi okuhamba phambili kuza kutholakala emakethe yezezimali - ngakho-ke nokuthola impumelelo okukhulu. Isiphetho Kuphinde kube nokubungaza ukunqoba okukhulu okuwufaneleke kakhulu, futhi ama-Orlando Pirates angaba yimfuno yebhola elahlukile eNingizimu Afrika. Kwabaningi, umoya ophakathi kwabo uyazwakala, futhi ubharia eliheha ibhizinisi elikhanya phansi nezinyathelo zenhliziyo. Isiphetho ukuthi la maqembu kumele ahlale eqhubekayo, edlula emkhakheni omkhulu. Abalandeli bazothokozisa okusunguliwe, okungakhetha ukwenza ukuba amaPirates ahlale phambili kumakhono nomphakathi, ngaleyo ndlela kuvuleka amathuba amaningi ezintweni ezingakaze zenzeke phambilini.
Ezokuvakasha: Ukwakha Uxhumano Phakathi Kwezingxenye Zethu Nezizwe ZakwaZulu Ezokuvakasha zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa indlela ezokuvakasha ezishintsha ngayo, njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka unomoya ophakeme. Akukhona nje ukuphuma siye ezindaweni ezinhle, kodwa futhi ukuzama ukuqonda izimpilo, amasiko, nemicabango yabanye. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ovulekile, umoya wokufunda, kanye nesifiso sokuxhumana. INingizimu Afrika inezindawo eziningi ezithakazelisayo ezokuvakasha. Kusukela enhlokodolobha, iPretoria, kuze kufike ezintabeni eziyinqaba zeDrakensberg, nezindawo ezihlekisayo eWestern Cape. IKwaZulu-Natal ikhangwa kakhulu ngemvelaphi yayo, ikhetha impilo yasemaphandleni neyesimanje, ibhizinisi, kanye nemfashini yezenhlalakahle. Ukwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwezingxenye zethu nezizwe kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lokwakha uxhumano lukhombisa ubuciko, ikhono, nempumelelo yomdabu. Abantu abaningi bakha imibukiso, imicimbi, nabahambi bembula izimfihlo zamasiko amasha. Lokhu kudinga ukusizwa ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phezu kwezithiyo ezibhekene nomphakathi. Nokho, izithiyo zikhona. Ezokuvakasha zidinga ukufundwa kwezifundo ezichaza amabhuku akhombisa ubukhona base-Afrika ukuze sifunde amagugu okuvakasha. Kubahloli bezifundo, izazi zenza imfundo esemqoka, futhi lezi zifundo zingase zifake iminyango emisha ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ezokuvakasha ziqhubeka nokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokuxhumanisa zikhombisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile, imicimbi yokuhlangana, kanye nokwakhiwa kwabathandi bokuhamba. Lesi sikhathi sokuhlangana sikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zibe nengxenye ngaphansi komoya wokuhlanganyela, ngaphandle kokweqa izithiyo. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ezokuvakasha kufanele zikhuthaze ukugcinwa kwemvelo. Imikhiqizo efanelekayo, njengokudla, izimpahla ezingcolile, kudinga amasu akhululekile. Kumele siqonde ukuthi izindawo ezaziwa ngempilo kahle zingase zibe yiziteshi zokuthokozisa izivakashi, kodwa futhi zidinga ukwakha umhlaba omuhle. Njengoba sikhuluma ngezinkanyezi, kufanele sibe nemiphumela ehloniphekako yasendaweni. Ezokuvakasha, uma ziqhutshwa kahle, zingaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi oqinile. Kumele sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umkhankaso ovulekile, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Esikhathini esizayo, ubuchwepheshe buzothola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, kodwa kuzodingeka sihloniphe izimiso zendabuko. Okukhethwa kubalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano bethu nabanye. Ekugcineni, ezokuvakasha zingaba nomthelela omuhle, zifake umqondo wokuhlangana, nokwakha uxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okukhona okuhle, futhi okukhuthazayo. Kumele sizame, silethe, futhi sithumele izinkanyezi.
Umnyango wezobulungiswa ungowesigaba sokuphepha lapho indawo yokusebenza kweziteshi zamaphoyisa ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane, ezilawulwayo ezaziwa njengamasektha. I-SAPS izothumela uphoyisa, owaziwa njengomphathi wesigaba, kuzo zonke izigaba. Imiphakathi nabaphathi bezigaba bazoba ngababambiqhaza abenza okuthile ukuze baqinisekise ukuphepha nokuvikeleka endaweni abahlala kuyo. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umphakathi esigabeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulwa nobugebengu bendawo njengokuhlanganyela. Ukuze kube nesixhumanisi phakathi komphakathi wesigaba kanye nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo. Ukuze usebenze njengomphakathi ophumelelayo, ophatha zonke izinhlelo nezinhlelo ezibhekene nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze uxoxe ngezinhlelo zokusebenza nomphathi wesigaba ukuze ubhekane nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze uqinisekise futhi ubambe iqhaza emicimbini yasendaweni ukuze ugcine indawo abahlala kuyo iphephile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nezicebiso zokuvikela ubugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze usekele ngempela umnyango wezobulungiswa wezivolontiya ezindaweni. Ukuze uxhumane nomphathi wesigaba wakho ukuze wenze indawo ophila kuyo iphephile. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, amaqembu omphakathi, izinhlangano zabahlali, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi bencitshwa ukuba babambe iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezinkinga eziholela ebubini esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inengxenye yokweseka umphakathi, ehlinzeka zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo ababuya emiphakathini eyayithintekile ngodlame, ngemininingwane nezidingo. Ngokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo ezikhiqiza amafilimu, le ndawo ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. I-archive kazwelonke egcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nolwazi olurekhodiwe lwezwi ibamba iqhaza emikhankasweni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo zimenyiwe ukuba zibuke amafilimu futhi zixoxe nganoma yimaphi amagatsha abona kufanele abhekwe. Lokhu kwenziwe ngokuxhumana nothisha nabafundisi. Inhloso enkulu yale ngxenye yokweseka umphakathi ukulethela "izindawo zokubuka amafilimu kubantu," okuzoletha inzuzo emiphakathini. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezifana nezikole, imikhakha efanele, amaqembu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasemakhaya engazi ukuthi le archive ingakwenza kanjani njengoba nayo inamalungelo okuthola ulwazi. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zobuciko Bomphakathi, ezisungulwe nguMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, ukuze ifinyelele le njongo. Izikhala zomphakathi, izikole, nezindawo zomphakathi nazo zizosebenza. Siphakamisa umphakathi nanoma ubani ofisa ukwazi ngomlando kanye nomlando waleli zwe ukuthi axhumane nathi uma efisa ukucela ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zalesi sikhungo sokugcina, i-NAFVSA. I-NAFVSA inengxenye egxile ekuqinisekiseni umlando orekhodwe osevele ugcwalise izikhala endabeni yethu yomlando. Kuxoxiswane nabantu abanolwazi ngezihloko ezihlukene ezihlobene namasiko, ubuciko, umlando, kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuqoqwa, ukugcina, nokusabalalisa umculo wendabuko kuyakhuthazwa ngohlelo lwethu olubizwa ngokuthi i-Traditional Musical Instrument Exhibition. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto ezirekhodiwe ze-audio nezibukwayo (zomphakathi nezingezona zomphakathi) nezinye izenzo ezihlobene ezikhiqizwe noma ezihlobene neNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zifinyelela kulezi zirekhodi futhi zikhuthazwe ukuthi zisetshenziswe nguwo wonke umuntu. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina lezi zirekhodi. I-NAFVSA inegumbi lokucwaninga lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwezinhlobo zonke uma befuna ulwazi, futhi bangakwazi futhi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe kumakhompyutha mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela izinto ezishicilelwe kumele kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi. Udinga ukwazisa isikhungo okungenani ezinsukwini ezintathu ngaphambi kokulungiselela lokho ofuna ukukusebenzisa futhi ufake kumishini efanele. Lezi zinto zingasetshenziswa kuphela ezindaweni ze-NAFVSA futhi kuzokwenziwa imali ethile ethathwe nguMnyango Wezezimali. Abafundi nabafundi bangasebenzisa lezi zinto mahhala, kodwa badinga futhi ukuhlela ngaphambi kokulalela nokubuka. Imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kubadali iyadingeka uma othile efuna ukukopisha into ethile. Ibhuku lethu linamabhuku angama-3000 ayinqaba ahlobene nomkhakha wefilimu, oqalwe kudala ngesikhathi seNational Film Board, futhi izinto ezingahlangene azikhiphwayo nhlobo ngenxa yokubaluleka kwazo. Nokho, wonke amabhuku ebhuku angabukwa ku-Archive yeNational Heritage, futhi amakhophi angakhiqizwa ngentengo ephansi. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo lamaphosta amafilimu ahlukaniswe cishe ayizinkulungwane, aqala ngesikhathi sikaDe Voortrekkers, okuyifilimu endala eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi lamaphosta lawo ngempela alingabazekayo futhi ahlobene nawo wonke amakhono amafilimu akhiqizwe ezweni lethu. Inhloso ye-archive ngala maphosta ukuwurekhoda ngokuqondile futhi uwagcine eqoqweni lapho angasetshenziswa khona ngaphandle kokuthathwa. Njengokuqoqwa kwamaphosta, i-Archive ineqoqo lezithombe ezihlobene namafilimu kuleli zwe. Izithombe zezifilimu ezingama-1916 ezikhiqizwe kuleli zwe zingatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqu zezifilimu ezedlule cishe eziyi-1200 ezikhiqizwe kuleli zwe. Iningi leziqu lisesigabeni sokukhiqiza, ngaleyo ndlela lihluke kakhulu kumkhiqizo ophelile olungile ukubukwa. I-NAFVSA iphinde ibe umgcinimafa wezirekhodi zamaphephandaba, okuhlanganisa imibhalo, iziqeshana ezikhethiwe ezivela kumaphephandaba, izithombe, izinhlelo, nezikhumbuzo ezihlobene nezindawo zokusebenza, umculo, ubuciko, nezandla. Iningi lezi zinto kulesi sigaba laqala ngokuqhamuka kwabantu kanye nezikhungo ezizimele ezinomsebenzi wezobuciko nezandla. I-NAFVSA iyingqayizivele ngoba ingesinye sezikhungo ezincane emhlabeni ezigcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nezirekhodi ezilalelwayo ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa. Ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lolwazi olukhombisa umlando wesizwe sethu eNingizimu Afrika ngezithombe kube usizo futhi kuzokwenza kube umthombo omkhulu wezizukulwane ezizayo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Baphinde bakwazi ukubheka kalula emuva kulokho okwenzeka esikhathini esedlule, futhi lokhu kungab placing them in a position to speculate on what the film and tape industry will look like in the future. Ngenxa yokushintsha okusheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe, imishini esetshenziswe eminyakeni engama-20 edlule manje isiphukile, kodwa ingasetshenziswa ukuze ihlinzeke ngolwazi lomlando, kanye nokubonisa ukuthuthuka nezinguquko embonini ye-filimu, ividiyo, kanye ne-tape.
Umculo - Uhlanga Oluhle Lokuhlanganyela Nempilo Umculo ungumkhakha obalulekile empilweni yomuntu, unikeza amandla, uthokozisa, futhi uvuselela imizwa. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zomphakathi, umculo ube yindlela yokuxhumana, ukuxoxa izindaba, nokuhlonipha izinkolo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umculo ungaphezu kokukhuthaza; ungumthombo wokwelapha, ubuchwepheshe bokukhuluma, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umculo Njengendlela Yokuzwakalisa Imizwa Ukuzwakalisa imizwa kuyinto eyinhloko yomculo. Imizwelo ehlukahlukene iboniswa ngezingoma ezithile, ezithinta inhliziyo yomlistener. Umculi, ngokusebenzisa izwi lakhe, amathoni, namazwi, udala umhlaba ophilayo lapho abathandi bomculo bengakwazi ukuzifaka khona. Izinkanyezi zomculo ezifana noMiriam Makeba noHugh Masekela zikhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, njengezinkinga zomphakathi, uthando, nokuphila. Ubuciko Bokuhlanganisa Izinhlobo Zomculo Umculo ungumkhakha ogcwele izinhlobo ezahlukene. Kukhona umculo wesintu, umculo wepop, nezinye izinhlobo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwezinhlobo zenza umculo ube yinkanyezi, uhlanganisa izizinda ezahlukene. Umculo wesintu, ngokwesibonelo, ubonisa ubuciko bendabuko, lapho izinsimbi zesiZulu zisetshenziswa khona ukudala umculo ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umculo wepop uhlanganisa izitayela ezithokozisayo, ezivame ukudlalwa emicimbini nasematheni. Umculo Njengomthombo Wokuxhumana Umculo ungumthombo omkhulu wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ezinye izinkanyezi zomculo zisetshenziswa emicimbini, ezikhumbuzweni, nasemihlanganweni, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlangane, bakhumbule izikhathi ezinhle, futhi bazwakalise imizwa yabo. Umculo uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, ubakhuthaze ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi ubavumele ukuba babonise uthando nemizwa yabo. Umculo Njengomthombo Wokwelapha Ngaphezu kokuba umculo uyinsiza yokuzijabulisa, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi ungumthombo wokwelapha. Umculo ungasiza ekunciphiseni ukukhathazeka, ukunciphisa ubuhlungu, nokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo. Abantu abanezinselelo ezinzima, njengokukhathazeka noma ukucindezeleka, bangathola ukuthula emculweni. Izinhlelo zokwelapha ezisebenzisa umculo zikhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Izinselelo Zomculo Wamanje Noma umculo unamandla amakhulu, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ubulungiswa bokwakha umculo, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwemali, kanye nezinguquko zamasiko zenza kube nzima kubaculi abasha. Umculo wokwakha ungaba nezinselelo eziningi, njengoba abaculi behluleka ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhe umculo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abaculi, ukuze umculo uqhubeke uthokozisa. Isiphetho: Umculo Njengomthombo Wokuphila Ngokuphetha, umculo ungumthombo ophilayo, onamandla okwakha, ukuxhumana, nokwelapha. Uhlanga oluhle lokuhlanganyela nempilo, umculo ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba umculo uqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, kubalulekile ukuthi siwuhloniphe, siwusebenzise, futhi siwufake ezimpilweni zethu nsuku zonke. Umculo awuwona nje umculo; ungumthombo wempilo, uthando, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sonke sibe nomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina umculo uphilile, ube yinsiza yokuhlanganyela, nokuba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni yethu.
Ikhono lokwenza okulungile - ukwenza lokhu ngendlela efanele. Ukukhiqiza okuphumelelayo akuhambisani nomkhiqizo otholakalayo ekugcineni, kodwa kukhombisa ikhono lomlimi lokulinganisa okokufaka (izindleko) nokuthi yini etholwa (futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okokufaka kukhiqiza inzuzo ekugcineni). Lokhu kufanele kukalwa ngokukhula kokutholwayo (ukukhiqiza); kodwa kufanele kubhekelele zonke ezinye izici ezinganciphisa ukukhiqiza: indlela yokusebenza kahle, ukuphatha abasebenzi kahle, ukuthola ulwazi ngembewu, izimo zezulu, futhi ekugcineni: inhlanhla! Uma ubona ukuthi okokufaka (izindleko) ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, nemishini zikhuphukile kakhulu, kufanele usebenze ngokuhlakanipha ukuze ufinyelele inzuzo. Ukwanda kokukhiqiza okuphumelelayo kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphambili futhi ukusebenza ngokuhlakanipha kuqhubeka - lokhu kuholela ezinzuzweni ezinhle kodwa hhayi okokufaka okweqile. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi kufanele usebenze ngokuhlakanipha, hhayi nje ukusebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukulinganisa konke lokhu kuyinselelo ngoba kufanele ubheke zonke okokufaka nezokukhipha (umkhiqizo) bese ulinganisa ukuze ubone ukuthi isimo sakho simele kuphi kulokhu. Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi mangaki umsebenzi owenziwe ukukhiqiza ngonyaka odlule ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi yisiphi isisebenzi esifanele ukuba senzeke ngonyaka ozayo.
Ngakho-ke, igama lebrand liyigama noma ukuhlanganiswa kwamagama. Isiqubulo siyi-phrasi noma umusho omfushane kanye nesithombe esithile se-logo esihlukaniswe nezinye noma uphawu. Lokhu kukhombisa ubunikazi obuhlukile obuhlobene naleyo nkampani emakethe futhi kusebenza nakumikhiqizo nasezinkampanini. Uma uphawu lwasungulwa, akekho omunye ongasebenzisa lelo phawu noma elinye elifana nalo. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kungathathwa izinyathelo zomthetho. Kube nezimo ezidumile ezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika, njengokuthi inkampani yeMcDonald's e-USA yaphosa icala enkampanini yaseNingizimu Afrika eyayisebenzisa uphawu olufana ne "M" yabo. Thola ifomu le-TM1 ulenze ngamasethi amathathu. Amakhophi amabili azosetshenziswa ehhovisi, kanti elinye kufanele uligcine njengobufakazi besicelo sakho. Khokha imali yokubhaliswa ngaphambi noma lapho uthumela isicelo sakho. Bhala phansi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ofuna ukuzenza usebenzisa uphawu emkhakheni 57 wefomu le-TM1. Qaphela kakhulu ungafaki imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezivela kwezinye izigaba ngaphansi komkhiqizo owodwa esicelweni. Uma wenza njalo, uzonconywa ukuba uhlele incazelo ukuze ifake kuphela lezo zimpahla noma izinsizakalo ezichazwe kulowo mkhakha kuphela. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kuzodingeka ukuthi uthumele isicelo esihlukile futhi. Uma isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izimfuneko zokubhaliswa, uzonikezwa usuku lwesicelo sakho nenombolo. Zonke izingxoxo nehhavisi zizobhekisela kulenombolo yesicelo. Nakuba kungathatha kuze kube yizinyanga eziyi-18 ukubhaliswa komkhiqizo, ungakwazi ukuwusebenzisa njengoba uthola inombolo yesicelo sakho. Uma uphawu lwakho lwamukelwa ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, ungakwazi ukukhangisa ngalo kwi-Patent Journal, ephephandabeni elikhishwa ngenyanga nguMphakathi Wezokuphrinta. Abantu emphakathini banikezwa izinyanga ezintathu zokuphikisa isicelo. Ungaxhumana nezikhungo zokuxhumana ze-dti ngenombolo elandelayo:. Khokha ebhange usebenzisa ikhodi yokubhekisela. Kungathatha iminyaka emibili ukuze kubhaliswe uphawu.
Khetha isifunda lapho isikole sakho sitholakala khona, uhlu olungaphansi kokuthi "Isinyathelo 2: Bhala inombolo ye-EMIS noma ukhethe isikole kulolu hlu" luzovuselelwa, lukhombisa izikole ezisifundeni sakho. Phendulela kulolu hlu ukuze uthole isikole sakho ngqo noma inombolo ye-EMIS yesikole ebhokisini elincane elingezansi, lapho ukubhala inombolo kuzokhombisa igama lesikole kahle, cindezela ukhiye [Enter] kukhibhodi futhi imininingwane yesikole kufanele igqame kulolu hlu. Cindezela inkinobho ethi "Isinyathelo 3: Faka ulwazi lwesikole sakho" futhi ibhokisi lokuxoxa lizovela. Ngemva kokuthi uchofoze "OK", ikhasi 1 lefomu lokufaka ulwazi lizovela.
