Umfanekiso 5: Ikhasi 1 lefomu lokufaka Zonke izifomu zibonakala futhi zisebenza ngendlela efanayo futhi zenziwe ukuhambisana ne-hard copy. Hamba uye ekhasini elilandelayo ngokuchofoza inkinobho ethi "ikhasi elilandelayo" kukhasi eliyinhloko. Qhubeka uye ekhasini elilandelayo kuphela uma uqinisekile ukuthi yonke imininingwane eqoqiwe yalelo khasi ethile ifakiwe, njengoba imininingwane kuthebula ngalinye izoqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuthi ukwazi ukuyigcina nokuphrinta. Uma ufuna ukufaka ifomu lokuhlola ngesandla ngaphandle kwefomu elingenalutho, chofoza inkinobho ethi "ifomu elingenalutho" kukhasi eliyinhloko. Le nqubo izoprinta ifomu lokuhlola elingenalutho. Uma usuphelelisa ukuhlola, chofoza inkinobho ethi "Gcina futhi Phrinta ulwazi lwesikole" kukhasi eliyinhloko, uhlelo luzoprinta ifomu lokubala nolwazi olufakile. Uma uphendula "yebo" emcabangweni mayelana nokugcina imininingwane eqoqiwe kwiZikole kwenye ifomu ngendlela engasuswa, isibonelo, i-CD noma i-memory stick, uhlelo luzokhuthaza ukuthi ukhethe indawo. Ikhophi ephephile ingasayinwa kanye nendlela yokugcina ifayela lolwazi oluqoqiwe oluthunyelwe ehhovisi lesifunda. Izikole ezikhethekile: Amathebula 2, 5, 7, no-8 kumele abe nezinombolo eziphelele nolwazi lwezikole olugcwaliswe kuzo zonke izifundo lapho kubhaliswa khona. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo kuthebula ngalinye ziqondile ukuze izinombolo eziphelele zihambisane. Izikole ezijwayelekile: Amathebula 3, 7, no-8 kumele abe nezinombolo eziphelele nolwazi lwezikole olugcwaliswe kuzo zonke izifundo lapho kubhaliswa khona. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo kuthebula ngalinye ziqondile ukuze izinombolo eziphelele zihambisane. Uma udinga noma yiluphi uhlobo losizo noma ukwesekwa, sicela uqondise imibuzo yakho ehhovisi elifanele.
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungelona lutho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, noma sithatha ukunakekela imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana innehla ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho uwakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho, qaphela wena. Uma ungashisi, ngeke ube nezinkinga zempilo. Abantu abaningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bayazi lokho. Ngakho, abashisi izigubhu noma amathuluzi, futhi abakhwabanisi utshwala noma bashise i-snuff (utshwala obungena emathunjini). Le bhukwana innehla amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana nokuphila impilo enempilo. Into engcono kakhulu umuntu angayenza ukuvuma ukuthi angashisi noma ayeke uma eseshisa. Sithemba ukuthi uzokhetha ukuphila kahle ngokungabheki izigubhu noma ukushisa. Funda indaba kaDudu... Um husband wakho uyakhwehlela kakhulu, Gugu. (Pic.1). Kungcono uma engashisi! (Pic.1). Uyazi ukuthi ngishise iminyaka eminingi futhi akukho okwakuhambile kimi! (Pic.2). Uyakubona uDudu, le yimpilo yami ngakho nginamalungelo okushisa ngendlela engiyifisayo! (Pic.3). Kulungile, uyakhumbula ukuthi uDkt. Zondi, udokotela ophakeme, uthi abantu abaningi abafika esibhedlela ukuze bathole ukwelashwa banezifo ezidalwe ukushisa? (Pic.3). Umonakalo odalwe ukushisa utshwala ngaphakathi emzimbeni wakho usuku nosuku ubonisa umonakalo enhliziyweni yakho, emaphashini, emithanjeni yegazi, nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba wakho. Ekugcineni, impilo yakho yonke iyashintsha. Ukushisa utshwala kubulala izigidi zabantu emhlabeni wonke unyaka nonyaka! (Pic.3). Lokhu akusho lutho ngoba sonke sizofela ekugcineni. Angiboni inkinga uma ngibulawa yinto engiyithokozelayo. (Pic.4). Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukushisa utshwala kuphinde kuhlanganyele nabantu abakuzungezile futhi kubenza babe sengozini yezifo ezifanayo ezithinta umshisi. (Pic.5). Futhi njalo khumbula uma ushisa isigubhu ukuthi ungase ungafeli ngokushesha ngenxa yokushisa, kodwa ungase uhlupheke ngesifo esiholela ekuchithweni kweminyaka eminingi ubuhlungu, noma ungase ufe ubuhlungu ngenxa yesifo samaphaphu. Cabanga ngalokhu ngenkathi usenethuba lokuyeka ukushisa okwamanje! (Pic.6). Igama lami nguDudu. Ngifuna sikhulume ngokuqhuba utshwala. Ake siqale ngokubheka amaphuzu ahlobene nokushisa utshwala. Unyaka nonyaka, abantu abangu-12,000 eNingizimu Afrika bafa ngenxa yezifo zenhliziyo, umdlavuza wamaphaphu, nezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza, kanye ne-bronchitis. Ukushisa utshwala kukhuthaza umuntu ukuba abe sengozini yalezi zifo. Ezinye izindawo, ukushisa kubulala abantu abaningi kunezibalo ezihlanganisiwe zabantu abafa ngempela ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS, utshwala, nezidakamizwa ezifana ne-heroin ne-cocaine, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Umshisi angabuya esimweni esijwayelekile sempilo uma eyeka ukushisa, kuye ngempilo yakhe, isisindo somzimba, nezinye izimo zempilo, kanye nesikhathi esithathwe eseshisa. Ngonyaka olandelayo kokuyeka ukushisa, kunezinga eliphansi lokuthola izifo ezifana ne-bronchitis. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyishumi, bafeza okufana nomuntu ongakaze ashise. Izigubhu nezitshalo zinezingxenye ezixubile ezilimazayo ezifana ne-carbon monoxide, i-tar, kanye ne-nicotine. Lezi yizinto ezenza abashisi bahlupheke. Ukushisa utshwala kuphinde kulimaze labo abawuphefumulayo. Uma usondelene nomshisi, qonda ukuthi lowo muntu uyaphula impilo yakho ngendlela efanayo abaphula ngayo impilo yabo. Utshwala buphazamisa impilo yakho ngoba bukhona phezu kwezinto ezingama-200 ezilimazayo. Lezi zinto zilimaza amaphaphu. Uma uqhubeka nokushisa, umonakalo uyanda. Lezi zinto zingadala ukuhamba kwenhliziyo nokuhlupheka. I-nicotine iyidrog. Ungase uzithole ufinyelela emathubeni e-nicotine noma ube nephutha elithinta igazi lakho. Uma ufinyelela ku-nicotine, kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho nomqondo wakho kudinga i-nicotine ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uzizwa udinga lokhu nsuku zonke. Uma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho, kuba nzima ukuyeka. Yingakho abantu abaningi behluleka ukuyeka ukushisa. Kuthiwani nge-snuff (utshwala obungena emathunjini)? I-snuff iqukethe zonke izinto ezilimazayo ezitholakala ezigubhu. Abantu abashisayo i-snuff bangathinteka ngezifo ezithile, ezifana nezifo zomlomo, umphimbo, nezifo ezithinta umoya. Kuthiwani nge-marijuana? Odokotela bathole ukuthi i-marijuana ilimaza umzimba wakho ngendlela efanayo nokushisa utshwala. Uma ufinyelela ekushiseni i-marijuana, uzogcina ungakwazi ukusebenza, ukufunda, ukudlala, noma ukujabulela. Kukhona izinhlobo zembewu ezingalimazi? Cha, azikho. Izigubhu, ama-cigar, amathuluzi, kanye ne-snuff konke kulimaza impilo yakho. Uma umuntu eshisa izigubhu ezimbalwa ngosuku, ingabe lokho kungamphazamisa? Nokho, ukushisa isigubhu esisodwa ngosuku kungalimaza! Ungaqali ukushisa! Umonakalo emzimbeni wakho uqala lapho uqala ukushisa. Ungase ubukeke unempilo iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuthi izimpawu zesifo ziqale ukuvela. Ingabe kubi ukufaka umoya ophuma kubantu abanye? Yebo, ungathola izifo eziningi uma uphila noma usebenza nomshisi. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba uphefumulayo umoya wabo nsuku zonke. Izingane ezizalwa kubazali abashisayo zihlala zihlupheka ngezifo zokuphefumula ezifana ne-bronchitis ne-pneumonia, okungajwayelekile ezinganeni ezingenabazali abashisayo. Kulungile ukuba uphefumulayo umoya ohlanzekile! Abashisi kufanele bahloniphe leli thuba. Abashisi abaningi bayala ukuyeka ngoba abazi ukuthi ukushisa kuphazamisa impilo yabo. Ake sikhulume ngezifo ezithile. Ukushisa kudala izifo eziningi ezahlukene. Eziwubukhali kakhulu yizifo zamaphaphu, umdlavuza, izifo zenhliziyo, nezifo zokuphefumula. Abantu abanezinhliziyo ezilimele bangahlupheka iminyaka eminingi bekhwehlela nokuqina komoya. Izinhlobo eziningi zomdlavuza, ezifana nomdlavuza wamaphaphu, zidalwe ukushisa. Akukho ukwelashwa komdlavuza wamaphaphu. Ukushisa kungadala umdlavuza kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba, ezifana nomlomo, i-bladder, amankonyana, ulimi, nezinye. Igazi emzimbeni wethu lihamba ngeziteshi ezincane esibiza ngokuthi imithambo yegazi. Ukushisa kudala ukuthi lezi zithambo zibe mncane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi igazi alikwazi ukuhamba, okuyingozi enkulu. Uma igazi lingafiki engxenyeni ethile yomzimba, le ngxenye iyafa. Lokhu kwenzeka uma umuntu ehlupheka ngesifo sokuhlaselwa yizitho zenhliziyo noma ukuhamba kwenhliz
### IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika Kudala, emhlabeni ogcwele izinkolelo, amandla, nezifiso, kwavela umqondo omkhulu wokuphatha izwe. Lokhu kwavula umnyango ophambili emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, lapho abantu baziwa njengokuhamba phambili, bephila ngezifiso ezinqunyiwe. IPhalamende, okuyisikhungo sombuso, satholakala njengendawo yokuphikisana, yokuxoxisana, nokwakha ikusasa. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, abantu baqala ukubona ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kwakungakabi namandla. Ngakho-ke, amavukelambuso aqala ukwakha, ahamba ngendlela ethile, efuna ukuba nezwi. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni nemibono ehlukene, abantu behlangana nemihlangano, behlanganyela imibono, bekhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokuphila, waqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangakha izinguquko. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwePhalamende, kwavela izinkanyezi ezinkulu ezazihola izwe. Omakhelwane bahlala behlabelela izinkanyezi zabo, bekhuluma ngemizamo yabo yokubamba iqhaza. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwakha izinyathelo ezinzima, kudaleka izigaba eziningi ezazihilela abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kokuthula, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi imizamo yabo ibalulekile. Phakathi kwalokhu, izinhlelo zokuqala zePhalamende zathuthuka zaya phambili, zikhula nezimiso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlelo lwePhalamende lwaqala ukuveza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Kubalulekile ukuveza ukuthi iPhalamende alikhona nje kuphela njengendawo yokuxoxa, kodwa futhi njengesikhungo sokwakha. Ngalesi sikhathi, abanye abantu baqala ukufuna ukufaka izwi labo emigomeni, ukuze baqhamuke nezixazululo. IPhalamende laqala ukuba yindawo yokuhlanganyela, lapho izinkulumo zikhula zaba izimpendulo, ziqhamuka nemibono emisha. Nokho, akukhona konke okulungile. Izinkinga zaba khona. Abantu bahlala bephikisana, bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezinzima, bezama ukuthola izixazululo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kokuxoxisana okujulile, lapho abantu behlangana bezama ukuqonda izikhala eziphakathi kwabo. IPhalamende lasendaweni yalo waba yindawo yokuxoxa ngaphezulu kwezinkinga, kuhlangana izimvo ezahlukahlukene ezazivela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula abantu ukuba babone ukuthi, nakuba bekhona amanxeba, ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu bokuqala baphinde bukhule. Njengoba izinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokukhanya, abantu baqala ukubona izinzuzo. Izinhlelo ezintsha zaziphuma, imikhankaso yayiqala, abantu bahlala bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukuze iPhalamende iyenze kahle, kwadingeka ubuhlakani, lapho izinsiza ezikhethiwe zenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngenxa yalokho, abaphathi bahlala bephokophele ukwenza okungcono, behlola izindlela zokwakha ukuxhumana okuhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iPhalamende yathola izifundo zempilo. Izinkumbulo ezinhle zathuthukiswa, abantu baziwa ngezigameko ezinjalo. Kwakukhona imizamo yokugcina ubudlelwano, ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kwabaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, kodwa ezidingekayo. Imibono emisha yahlala ikhula, futhi abantu baqonda ukuthi iPhalamende yindawo yokubambisana, yokwakha, nokuphila. Izinsuku zishintsha, izikhathi zishintsha, kodwa iPhalamende lasendaweni yalo luhlale lukhanya njengenkanyezi. Abantu bazi ukuthi akukhona nje ukuveza izikhalazo, kodwa futhi ukujolisa ezixazululweni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwePhalamende njengendawo yokubambisana, yokuxhumana, nezinhlelo ezinhle. Amalungelo abantu aqhubeka nokukhula, izwi labo liyavuma, kwazulu ukuba nemikhankaso yokuphila. Ekugcineni, iPhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika yaba isibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangabambisana kanjani, baphumelele ngezifiso zabo. IPhalamende akusiyo nje indawo yokuxoxa kodwa iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye ungaba neqhaza. Isikhathi siqhubeka, kodwa izifiso zabantu zihlala zikhanya. Le ndaba ihlale ibhalwe emlandweni, iqhubeka, ihamba phambili, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ukwazi kwakhiwa, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela kuyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. IPhalamende iseNingizimu Afrika, le ndawo eqhakazile, iyinsika yokwakheka komphakathi, futhi imbono yokuhlanganyela ibalulekile. Izindaba zaphakanyiswa ezinkulu, umoya wokuphila uqhubeka, futhi iPhalamende iyasikhumbuza ukuthi amandla ethu akhula lapho sixhumana, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazelana. Lokhu kuhlangana kwenza iPhalamende ibaluleke kakhulu emiphakathini yethu, futhi izifiso zethu zihlale ziphila, zikhanya njengezinkanyezi ezisemkhathini.
I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo: Isikhungo Sokuzimela Kwamalungelo Nezibopho Zethu I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, njengoba iyinhlangano eyinhloko eqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yethu iyahambisana nezimiso zomthethosisekelo. Le nkantolo ibhekelele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enobulungiswa, kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umthetho uyaphumelela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indima yayo, izinselelo ezibhekene nayo, kanye nezindlela zokuqinisa le nkantolo ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle. Ukuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ayikona nje kuphela indawo yokuxazulula izingxabano, kodwa iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umthetho awuhambisani nezifiso zomuntu siqu, kodwa uhamba phambili ekukhulumeni ngezinhloso ezinkulu. Isebenza njengomgibeli phakathi kokuphathwa kahle kwezimali zomphakathi nokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, lapho imithetho ingase ingahambisani nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukuthi abantu abaningi basawubona umthetho njengenhlangano ethile, hhayi njengesikhungo sokuvikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle nokungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabantu nemithetho. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngezindlela zokwenza abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iyinsika yokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwale nkantolo. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, bahlushwa ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abo, ukuze bakwazi ukuwasebenzisa lapho kudingeka. Ngaphandle kokwaziswa, abantu bangase bahlupheke, bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale benamathele ezinqubweni ezingalungile. Kodwa-ke, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ayinakho ukufinyelela kuphela; kufanele futhi ibe nezinqubo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Izinqubo ezinzima nezinde zingadala ukuthi abantu baphoxeke, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphumelele emacaleni abo. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokwenza izinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zayo kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo kufanele ibonise ubuholi obuqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahluleli bayo kumele babe neziqu eziphezulu, kodwa futhi babe nekhono lokuphatha izindaba ezinzima. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezithile ezidingekayo, abahluleli kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izimo ezithile, bahlolisise izimo ezihlukene, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo esihambisana nomthethosisekelo. Ekugcineni, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Isebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokuhlonipha amalungelo omunye nomunye. Ukuze le nkantolo iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwayo, sithuthukise izinqubo zayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abahluleli bayo banobuholi obuqinile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa, nolwazi oluqinile ngamalungelo abantu. Ngakho, asiqhubeke sikhuluma, sikhuthaza, futhi sithuthukise iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza njengesikhungo sokuzimela, ukuvikela amalungelo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kudinga imizamo eminingi, kodwa uma sisebenzisana, singakha ikusasa elingcono, elinobulungiswa, nelivumelanayo.
Izenzakalo zokuphepha nemisebenzi ye-ofisi... Ukuhlela kwezimali ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamasiko. I-ofisi ephethe ukudalwa kwezimpawu. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlanganiswa kwesiko, isayensi, nobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni, inhlalakahle yokuxhasa ubunikazi nasekukhuthazeni amanani ahlukahlukene ezwe lethu. Emculweni, ifa lesiko, kanye namavalue, ngokuhlonipha ukuhlukahlukana, nangezinhlelo zokuxhasa umnotho. Ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ezweni lethu njengendlela yokuphakamisa wonke umZulu ukuba athathe ingxenye empilweni yokuxhumana, yezepolitiki, kanye nomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa okulinganiselwe ukuze kugcinwe, kugcinwe, kuvikelwe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando wethu, izimpawu zethu zomhlaba, ifa, namavalue kuyavunywa. Ukubheka emuva konyaka odlule, kube nempumelelo ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe ngomhla we-DACST. Kusukela ekubonakaliseni/ukufinyeleleka kwezinsiza zamasiko okuholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi, kuya ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zocwaningo ezisezingeni lomhlaba. Indlela imiphakathi noma umkhakha wezobuciko ongakhelwa ngayo nokuthi singanikeza kanjani emaphakathini aholelwa uhulumeni ngezinhlelo zokubambisana nezihlanganisiwe, esibiza ngokuthi izinhlelo ze-cluster. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sizibandakanye nazo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhalwe phansi ngama-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole. Isidingo sesithombe esisha sezobuciko, esisekelwe ekuxhumaneni kwezinsiza ezingashintshi. Ukuguqula imicabango ibe izenzo ngokwenza izimboni zamasiko zidalwe amathuba emisebenzi. Mayelana nezilimi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenkomba efanele ngokomthetho yokukala izilimi nokuhlukahluka kwazo, ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ungumuntu owodwa futhi isimo sezimali siba sikhulu. Unyaka odlule wabona izinguquko ezibalulekile ekubukeni kwe-DACST. Iphakathi elisebenzisa okungenani ama-90% wezimali zayo (ama-R1 billion) ezinhlelweni zangaphandle uma kuqhathaniswa nezinhlelo zangaphakathi, nezinsiza zangaphandle ezixhaswe yi-DACST zithola uxhaso kule 90%, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezisebenza ocwaningweni lwesayensi, amabhodi ahlobene nezilimi zesiZulu, iminyango, nemikhakha ehambelana nokuboniswa kobuciko. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezihlangene emikhakheni enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqale ukuthuthukisa inqubo yokuphatha nokuphatha efanayo. E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye nezithombe, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zomnotho ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi. Sekucacile ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko zingadlala indima enkulu emnothweni ophumayo, okufana nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nokumbiwa nokulima. Amazwe ahlukene afana neSweden neMexico anikeza ukuqinisekiswa okungaphikiswa ngalokhu. Ukuthuthukisa imikhakha yocwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Le ndawo idinga ukunakekelwa ngokuphathwa kwayo nokubhekwa, ngokwezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba ekubhekeni nasekuthuthukiseni, ngokwezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba. Ukuze kusizakale le nhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe ukuhlola okufanele nokuhlola (isibonelo, ukubheka phambili) ngokubambisana neNational Advisory Council for Development. Ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi ibhajethi eyinhloko yonyaka ye-R2.5 billion kufanele ibe okungenani kabili eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo. (Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yeziqukathi ezizimele). Okwamanje, sigcina uxhaso lwe-GDP kazwelonke ku-0.7%, okuyingxenye yesithathu se-OECD average futhi encane uma kuqhathaniswa nenani eliphelele lamazwe athuthukile afana neSouth Korea neFinland. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili kunezimpempe ezinkulu zokunciphisa izindleko emnothweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala izindlela ezizinzile zokudlulisa ulwazi nobuchwepheshe ezinkampanini (ikakhulukazi kuma-SMMEs). Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamasiko. Izinhlelo zezimali zomnyango zonyaka ka-2000/2001 zifaka izenzakalo ezahlukene ezindaweni zomphakathi. Singachaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngocwaningo, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokubhekana ne-HIV/AIDS ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe, nokusungulwa kohlelo lweMlando Wokhuluma. Ukugcina nokuthuthukisa ifa. Ifa liyingxenye ebalulekile yobunikazi. Iningi leNingizimu Afrika linemigomo yefa eyathuthukiswa ngokwanele nakuba ingaxhaswanga kahle (njengeminyango, imikhakha yokulawula). Ukuguqulwa kwalezi zinsiza kubalulekile emnothweni nasemasikweni. Ukuhlanganiswa nokwakha izimnyango ezinhlanu zomlando ezimnyangweni ezithile nezithombe ezintathu eKapa: umlando wemvelo, umlando wesiko, kanye nomlando wezempi, kubonise inzuzo enkulu. Kuphakanyiswe futhi kwethulwa kwiCabinet. Le ndlela iphakanyiswa njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi eziyi-11 zesiZulu njengoba kuqinisekiswe ngumthethosisekelo. Le ndlela ihlinzeka ngendlela yokuhamba phakathi kwezilimi. Kule nhlelo, isigaba ngesigaba, kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ukwandisa ukwaneliseka kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi. Ulwazi lwasekhaya/olwakazwelonke ngakolunye uhlangothi lungaba umthombo wokukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona ingozi yokuthi kuzochithwa ngamandla angaphandle angabheki ulwazi lomphakathi njengolwakhe. I-ethnomedicine ne-ethnopharmacology iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo, izilwane, nokuhlukahluka kwamasiko kanye nokuhlonipha izinkampani, imvelo yokudla kwezitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo, nokwakhiwa/ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kukhona ifa lokukhuthaza ucwaningo lwezokwazi imvelo nezimiso ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwe-Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe ulwazi lwasekhaya/olwakazwelonke. Ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba bokuthula nokuvikela iziqoqo. Lezi zicabango zashintsha zaba izenzo ngonyaka odlule? Umnyango usungule indlela eqinile yokuphatha eholelwa ngumenzi, ixhaswe ngumsizi wemenzi kanye noMphakathi-Jikelele. Indlela yokuhlangana kwabaphathi nendlela yokwethula iziphakamiso nokuphatha izinsiza zabantu ithole ukunakwa okukhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi weqembu elisha lokuphatha izinsiza zabantu. Njengoba umbiko wezinsiza zabantu uthi, zonke izinhloso zokwakhiwa kwabaphathi zifeziwe. Sikholelwa ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yezinhlaka zonke ezixhaswe yi-DACST (isayensi, ubuciko, ifa, izilimi) ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokuphatha ezisekelwe kumbono owabelwana ngawo nentshisekelo yokuhloniphana nokwethembeka. Ulwazi nomnyango. Lezi zinsimu kufanele zithuthukise izinqubomgomo ezizokwamukela futhi zithuthuk
Ezocwaningo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yethu Namasiko Ezocwaningo, noma i-research, ibalulekile empilweni yethu nasemasikweni ethu. Izinselelo, izimfuno, nezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngolwazi olunembile nolwakha. Ngakho, ubuchwepheshe bokucwaninga buphakathi kwezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda ukuthi le mikhakha ihlukaniseka kanjani, ibaluleke kanjani, futhi iziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izocwaningo ukuze zibe yinzuzo kulabo ezibhekene nazo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izocwaningo ziqala ngenhloso yokuthola impendulo ezinkingeni ezithile. Lokhu kuphumelela kuphela uma kudalwe izindlela eziphumelelayo. Imibuzo eminingi ibe yinqaba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinta impilo yomphakathi, ezemvelo, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sizama ukuqonda izizathu zokwanda kwezifo ezithile, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izici eziningi – ezempilo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezomnotho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izocwaningo akukhona nje ukwenza ngezinto ezithile, kodwa kudinga ukuqonda okunembile kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngenhloso yokucwaninga. Itholakala emiphakathini eminingi ukuthi abantu bahlale bephikisana nemiphumela ethile yokucwaninga. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle, noma ukunganeliseki ngezinqumo ezithathwayo. Ukuze siphumelele ekutholeni ukwaziswa okunembile, kudingeka ukuba sithuthukise imikhuba yokuxhumana, siphinde siphinde sifundise umphakathi ngokubaluleka kwezocwaningo. Uma abantu behlale beyazi ukuthi izocwaningo ziqhuba kanjani, kuzoba lula ukuvuma imiphumela, noma ngabe ingahambisani nezinkolelo zabo zangaphambili. Kodwa-ke, kunobunzima obukhulu bokwenza izocwaningo ezinhle. Ukuze kudaleke ucwaningo olunembile, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi. Imali, izinsiza zabantu, nezinsiza zempahla zidingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhlelo ezithile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abacwaningi bahlale benza izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi mayelana nezinto abazidingayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela omkhulu ekutholeni imiphumela ethile. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele ziqhubele phambili ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izocwaningo zithola ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izocwaningo akufanele ziqhutshelekile kuphela emkhakheni wezempilo noma wezomnotho. Kukhona umkhakha obaluleke kakhulu - ezokwakha. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ezindaweni zokwakha lungathuthukisa izindlela zokwakha ezilungele imvelo, ezisebenzayo, nezikhumbulekayo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukwakha izakhiwo ezingcono ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo olwenziwa ezindaweni zokwakha lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuhlanganisa izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokwakha. Futhi, ezocwaningo idinga ukuba ibe nobumbano. Ukwenza ucwaningo olunembile, abacwaningi badinga ukusebenzisana nabanye emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Umphakathi uqobo kufanele ubambe iqhaza, ukuze uthole umbono ohlangene. Njengoba sithuthukisa imikhakha yethu, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabacwaningi, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ekutholeni imiphumela eyanelisayo. Ekugcineni, izocwaningo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile. Kuzo zonke izinkinga nezinkumbulo esibhekene nazo, ubuchwepheshe bokucwaninga buzohola ekutholeni izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo yezocwaningo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela ayikhombisi kuphela ubuchwepheshe bethu, kodwa futhi ibonisa ukuthi singabantu abaphumelelayo uma sisebenzisana. Ngakho, asikho isidingo sokubona izocwaningo njengomsebenzi ophathekayo kuphela, kodwa njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onolwazi, nosizo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha izizukulwane ezizayo ezizokwazi ukumelana nezinselelo zomhlaba wethu.
Akukho mkhumbi wangaphandle ozokwenziwa imvume yokudoba eNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokuba ubambisane nomuntu onamalungelo aseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokudoba. Kumele baxhumane ne-ofisi yezokuhlalisana nomnotho yendawo ngaphambi kokuba baqale ukudoba ukuze bazi ukuthi ukusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle kuvunyelwe yini emkhakheni othile wezinyoni nokuthi yimaphi amadokhumenti adingekayo ukuze imvume inikezwe. Uma kukhulunywa ngokuqondile ngokusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle, umfaki-sicelo kumele athole ifomu lokucela ukusetshenziswa komkhumbi wangaphandle ehhovisi le-DEA&T eliseduze. Igama lomkhumbi, igama nemininingwane yomnikazi womkhumbi, amandla omkhumbi, ubude, nenombolo yokubhaliswa yomkhumbi, izwe lapho umkhumbi ubhaliswe khona, kanye necebo lokuphepha elivela kulowo mzwe kumele kuhanjiswe. Bonke omkhumbi bangaphandle kumele babe nomshini osebenzayo obizwa nge-INMARSAT CVMS oxhumana nezinsizakalo zezimali. Kumele uqinisekiswe yilabo abaphatha amanzi olwandle. Ekuhlinzekeni kwakho, chaza ukuthi uzosebenza kuphi emkhakheni wezokudoba nokuthi uzodoba isikhathi esingakanani. Uma umkhumbi ungakhethwanga ngokwezimiso zamalungelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu lokudlulisela umkhumbi kwenye indawo. Ukuze umkhumbi uthole amalungelo okudoba, umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu elihlobene nomkhakha wezokudoba womkhumbi azodoba kuwo. Ekugcineni, uma umfaki-sicelo ekholelwa ukuthi lo mkhumbi uzodoba ezindaweni ezinamaza aphezulu olwandle, kumele aqedele ifomu lokudoba lezo zindawo. Isicelo sokusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle singathatha izinsuku eziyi-14 uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele.
Izimpi Zomlando: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezigameko Eziyinhloko Izimpi zomlando zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umlando wezwe, zikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta abantu, izizwe, nezindawo. Lezi zimpi zihlala zikhumbuleka ngenxa yokuthi zishintsha izimpilo zabantu, zidalela izwe izinselelo ezintsha, futhi zishintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Kulokhu, sizobheka izimpi ezithile ezibalulekile, izizathu zazo, nemiphumela yazo emhlabeni. Impi Yezwe Yokuqala (1914-1918) Impi Yezwe Yokuqala, eyaziwa nangokuthi iGreat War, yenzeka phakathi konyaka ka-1914 no-1918. Le mpi yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezizwe, izinkinga zezimali, kanye nezinkinga zempucuko. Izwe elikhulu elalibandakanyeka kule mpi kwakungamaNgisi, amaJalimane, amaFrentshi, kanye namaRashiya. Imiphumela yale mpi yahlasela kakhulu, yashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi yadalela izwe izinguquko ezinkulu kwezombusazwe, ikakhulukazi ukwakhiwa kwezimpi ezilandelayo. Impi Yezwe Yesibili (1939-1945) Impi Yezwe Yesibili, eyaziwa nangokuthi iWorld War II, yenzeka phakathi konyaka ka-1939 no-1945. Le mpi yaphinde yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, kodwa ikakhulukazi yaphakanyiswa yizinhlelo zika-Adolf Hitler eJalimane. Iziphumo zalesi simo zashintsha umhlaba, zashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi zashiya izwe nezifunda zikhubazekile. Le mpi yaphinde yakhulisa umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweZizwe Ezihlangene, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izimpi zingaholela ezinhlelweni ezinkulu zokuthula. Impi YaseVietnam (1955-1975) Impi yaseVietnam ibonisa indlela izimpi zomlando zingashintsha ngayo izwe. Le mpi yahlasela iVietnam, lapho amaMelika abamba iqhaza elikhulu, efuna ukuvikela iVietnam enhlangothini ye-Communist. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu, hhayi kuphela eVietnam, kodwa naseMelika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Imiphumela yale mpi ibonakala emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni umqondo wokuthula phakathi kwezizwe. Izimpi Zase-Afrika Izimpi eziningi zenzeka e-Afrika, zidalwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukulwela inkululeko, izimpi zempucuko, nezimpi zendawo. Isibonelo, impi yaseNigeria phakathi kuka-1967 no-1970, eyaziwa nangokuthi iBiafran War, ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima ezihlobene nezombusazwe, ubuhlanga, nezomnotho. Le mpi yashiya izigidi zabantu bengenamakhaya, futhi yadalela izwe izinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Imiphumela Nezifundo Izimpi zomlando zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Zikhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezinkulu zingavela uma abantu behluleka ukuvumelana, futhi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukuthula kubalulekile. Imiphumela yalezi zimpi ibonakala emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula, ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Isiphetho Izimpi zomlando zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wethu ngomhlaba. Zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile, zikhombisa izinselelo ezithinta abantu, nezizwe. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlola lezi zimpi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule izifundo ezitholakele, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono, onokuthula, nolwazi. Umhlaba udinga abantu abakhumbula izifundo zomlando, ukuze baphile ngokuhlonipha, bahloniphe izinkolelo zabanye, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe.
UMphathiswa Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, emva kokubonisana noMphathiswa Wezindaba Zasendaweni mayelana nezindaba zikahulumeni ekhaya, wenza lokhu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 19 seMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zamanzi (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1997) ngokukhishwa kwemiyalo equkethwe kulolu hlu. a ukuhlinzeka noma ukwamukela noma iyiphi imali engafanele, ukungena, isipho, noma enye inzuzo engafanele eyenzeka ngoba kufanele noma akufanele uthathe isinyathelo esithile esithinta lesi sivumelwano; b ukufuna, ukuhlinzeka, ukubamba iqhaza, ukudala umjikelezo, nokuzama ukudala izimo ezichazwe kumyalo a. e Umthetho Wokulingana Kwezemployment ungumthetho No. 75 ka-1997 futhi f Umthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ungumthetho No. 97 ka-1998. a ucabangela ulimi abathanda noma olusebenzisa endaweni futhi b ucabangela izidingo ezihlukene zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala nabathintekile esikhathini esedlule. c chaza izimo nemigomo ngaphansi kwazo abanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo ephethwe yikhandidethi yamanzi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ingxenye yephrojekthi yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. d lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ububanzi bomsebenzi nezindinganiso zomsebenzi okufanele zenziwe, futhi sizokhombisa ukuthi uma kuguquka, kuzoguquka ngokuhambisana nezimo zendawo zesivumelwano nezidingo ezithile, kuhlanganise nesikhathi esichaziwe futhi kubalulekile ukuba kube nohlu lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa zezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindinganiso zomsebenzi ezibekwe; futhi e chaza lezi zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezizoba yingxenye yesivumelwano nephrojekthi ukuze umhlinzeki wamanzi akwazi ukufinyelela lezi zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zazo zonke izinhlangothi ekutholeni noma yiziphi izimvume ezidingekayo, ukuze usebenzise amanzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). b Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokubuyekezwa okuphindaphindiwe komsebenzi owenziwayo; kufanele futhi c kuvumele ithuba lokuphinda kuxoxiswane ngezindinganiso zomsebenzi nezinkomba ezihilela labo abangabasebenzisi bamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezimo ezisemqoka okufanele umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ahlangabezane nazo mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlanganise umthetho ozovimbela umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ekudluliseleni amalungelo akhe noma noma yiziphi izibopho zakhe zesivumelwano kumuntu noma ngaphambi kokuba avunyelwe yikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuhlela kwabasebenzi abakule khandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi abahilelekile ekuhlinzekeni ngamanzi nalabo abathintekile ngesivumelwano mayelana nokuthi bazokhokhwa kanjani ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezabasebenzi. i futhi kuzoletha izinguquko ezimamounts ezikhokhwayo, amaholo, noma kuzoletha izinguquko ezindinganisweni noma ezingeni lokusebenza ii lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuveza ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezinguquko nezichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe ku-I ngenhla; futhi h noma yiziphi izijeziso ezingafanele zikhokhwe noma yimuphi umuntu onenhlangano yokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi noma iyiphi uhlelo olubhalwe phansi, incwadi yemiyalo, isizinda solwazi, uhlu olunembile, amarekhodi ezimali, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluqoqwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano kuzohlala kungokwakhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. a ivimbela ukuthengiswa, ukudluliswa kwamalungelo okuphatha, noma ukucindezelwa kwanoma iyiphi impahla eyindawo kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona noma ezizayo futhi engelona impahla yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kuhlanganise noma iyiphi ingxenye yezinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukuthengiswa, noma ukudluliswa kwamalungelo noma ukucindezelwa kuhlelwe ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi noma ii kuvunywe ngesisekelo senhlangano yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. b Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhuba ukucindezelwa kwempahla futhi sichaze amasu okugcina impahla isesimweni esisebenzayo ukuze kukhombise ukuthi umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ugcinwa esimweni esifanele; bese c sichaza inqubo yokuthola impahla, ukuthengisa, ukudlulisa amalungelo okuphatha, nokulahla impahla ecindezelwe. c kumele kuhlangabezane nokubuyekezwa kwezimali ezikhathini ezichaziwe mayelana nendlela esetshenzisiwe; futhi d hlinzeka ngokwabelana ngezinzuzo zezimali ezizotholwa ngokwenza umsebenzi kahle nangaphakathi kwezinga lomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi. banohlelo lokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzisi bamanzi iii chaza ilungelo lomsebenzisi wamanzi lokuthi kube neziphazamiso zilungiswe b qapha ukuhamba kwenqubo ezovumela abasebenzisi bamanzi endaweni lapho lesi sivumelwano sisebenza khona ukuba babambe iqhaza ekubhaleni idokhumenti yamalungelo abasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kufanele kuhlelwe ukuthi i kube nemihlangano nemiphakathi lapho, uma ibanjwe, kubhekwa ulimi abathanda noma olukhuluma abantu bendawo lapho lesi sivumelwano sisebenza khona; bese ii kube nendlela yokwamukela, ukuhlaziya, nokubheka imibono neziphakamiso zabantu abasebenzisa amanzi ezethulwe mayelana nedokhumenti yamalungelo ephakanyisiwe. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi ikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi izokwazi kanjani ukuqapha ukusebenza komhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ukuze ihambisane nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 27 seMthetho. Lesi sivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi uhlinzeka ngolwazi olungase lwenziwe yikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuze uqaphe ukuhambisana nesivumelwano ukuze ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo zokubika kuMphathiswa kanye nohulumeni wesifunda ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi uyahambisana nomthetho kanye nalezi ziqondiso. a lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi ezimali nezitatimende ngokulandela incwadi yemithetho ethathwa njengokufanele kwezindaba zezimali futhi yamukelwe Ngokuvamile Yamukelwe Ukubalwa Kwezimali eNingizimu Afrika noma uma kukhona ezingeni elithile likahulumeni, landela umthetho ofanele wokubalwa kwezimali; futhi b ivumele ikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuthola wonke amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali ezidingekayo ukuze zihlolwe futhi zibhalwe phansi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. a qopha bonke abantu abasebenzisa amanzi nalabo abake bawasebenzisa ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano b uhlu lwezimpahla nezakhiwo zezinsizakalo zamanzi kuhlanganise nezimo zazo nezindawo zazo futhi c qopha imisebenzi, ukugcinwa kwemishini nezinsiza, ukuhlolwa, nokucubungula kwezimo zemishini. Umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi kumele ngaphansi kwesivumelwano uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo ngabantu abasebenzisa amanzi kanye nalabo abangase bawasebenzise
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Ngomhla kaJulayi 2021, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika labhekana nezibhelu ezinkulu ezashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Lezi zibhelu, ezazihambisana nokuphikiswa, ziqale ngemuva kokuboshwa kukaFormer President Jacob Zuma, kodwa zashintsha zaba yizigameko ezinkulu zokuphikiswa ezazihlanganisa izifunda eziningi, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng. Izibhelu zashiya umonakalo omkhulu, hhayi kuphela ezindaweni ezithintekayo, kodwa nasemazweni omhlaba. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zikhombisa ukuthi umnotho wezwe ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ezihlanganisa ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali, ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezokuhamba kwezimpahla. Umthelela emnothweni Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umonakalo omkhulu ezimbonini ezahlukene. Izitolo eziningi zavalwa, izimboni zaphazamiseka, futhi izinsiza eziningi zalahleka. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokuthengiswa kwezimpahla, okwakuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo kumabhizinisi amancane. Abaningi baphinde bahlala bezama ukuvuselela amabhizinisi abo, kodwa imiphumela ibonakala ikhuluma ngokwehla kokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhelu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emsebenzini. Izinkampani eziningi zaphazamiseka, zadinga ukuvala iminyango ngenxa yokungabi namathuba okuthengisa. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokungasebenzi, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka. Abantu abaningi baphinde bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umthelela omkhulu ekutshalweni kwezimali. Abatshalizimali baphendule ngokukhathazeka, bephinde bahlala bephikisana nokutshalwa kwezimali ezweni. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokutshalwa kwezimali okuvela kwamanye amazwe, okwakuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okukhula komnotho. Izinkampani eziningi zathola ukuthi kunzima ukuhamba phambili, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokungabaza phakathi kwabantu. Izinyathelo zokuvuselela umnotho Ngemuva kwezibhelu, uhulumeni weNingizimu Afrika wathatha izinyathelo ezithile zokuvuselela umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Uhulumeni uphinde waphinde wakhuthaza abatshalizimali ukuba babuyisele izimali zabo ezweni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyavuselelwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokusebenza zathuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bangathola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa umnotho, nokwakha izinsiza ezisemqoka ukuze abantu baphile kahle. Isiphetho Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Umnotho ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ezihlanganisa ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali, ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezokuhamba kwezimpahla. Nokho, uhulumeni uthathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuvuselela umnotho, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika basebenzisane ukuze baphinde bakhe umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwe lihlala likhula futhi lihlala lizinzile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izifundo ezitholakele ezivela kulezi zibhelu zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho wezwe uyavuselelwa, futhi abantu baphila kahle. Umnotho ophumelelayo ungatholakala kuphela uma abantu bonke bebandakanyeka ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Isingeniso Ukupheka, njengomsebenzi wokudala, kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Abantu abaningi bakubona njengomsebenzi ojwayelekile, kodwa empeleni, ukupheka kunomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu, ezempilo, nasemiphakathini. Kukhona abavuma ukuthi ukupheka kuyindlela yokukhulisa ubudlelwano, kuyilapho abanye bephikisa ukuthi kudinga isikhathi esiningi, okungaholela ekutheni kube nzima kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme okuphila. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo zokupheka ekhaya, izinselelo ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ukupheka kube lula. Izinzuzo Zokupheka Ekhaya Okokuqala, ukupheka ekhaya kunikeza ithuba lokulawula izithako esizisebenzisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo. Izithako ezitholakala ezitolo zihlala zinezakhamzimba eziphansi, futhi zihlala zinezinye izinto ezingeziwe ezingenza kube nzima emzimbeni. Ngokupheka ekhaya, sikwazi ukukhetha izithako eziphilile, ezinjengemifino, izithelo, nemikhiqizo ye-organic. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ukudla okunempilo, okungasiza ekugcineni isisindo esifanele, kanye nokuvikela izifo ezihlobene nokudla okungafanele. Okwesibili, ukupheka ekhaya kudala ithuba lokuxhumana nomndeni. Lapho sithokozisa umndeni wethu ngezinsuku ezikhethekile, noma ngabe yisiphi isikhathi sokudla, sithuthukisa ubudlelwano bethu. Lokhu kudala imikhuba emihle, lapho izingane zifunda khona ukubaluleka kokupheka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Ukupheka ndawonye kungaba yindlela yokwakha imikhuba emihle, futhi kudala izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izinselelo Zokupheka Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukupheka kungaba yinselelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme okuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yisikhathi esincane, futhi ukupheka kudinga isikhathi, okungaholela ekutheni bakhethe ukudla okusheshayo, okungase kube nezithako ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abantu bephuma bephuza ukudla okungafanele, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase babe nekhono elincane lokupheka, okwenza kube nzima ukuzenzela ukudla. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bephoxekile, futhi bakhethe ukudla okuthengwayo, okungase kube nezithako ezimbi. Ukuze sithuthukise ukupheka, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, izindlela zokupheka ezilula nezisebenzayo. Izindlela Zokwenza Ukupheka Kube Lula Ukuze sithuthukise ukupheka, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, singasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezinhlelo zokupheka eziku-inthanethi, ezisiza abantu ukuba bafunde izindlela ezilula zokupheka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abasha, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe izinkumbulo ezinhle zomndeni. Okwesibili, singasebenzisa izithako ezilula nezitholakalayo. Ukupheka akudingi ukuba kube nzima; singakha izidlo ezimnandi neziphilile ngama-ingredients ambalwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abahlushwa yisikhathi, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe ukudla okunempilo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukupheka kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezihambisana nakho, izinzuzo zokupheka ekhaya zikhulu kakhulu. Ukupheka akusizi kuphela ekwakheni ukudla okunempilo, kodwa futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokupheka, sithole izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi sifundise abantu izindlela zokupheka ezilula. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukupheka kube lula, kube mnandi, futhi kube yindlela yokuphila enempilo. Ukupheka akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sithokozise le msebenzi.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Isingeniso Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathuthukiswa nguHulumeni ukuze sinikeze usizo lwezezimali kubantu abathintekile kakhulu yileli gciwane. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kuhlose ukucacisa indlela lesi sibonelelo esisetshenziswe ngayo, izinzuzo ezitholakele, kanye nezinkinga ezitholakele ekuphathweni kwalesi sikhwama. Uhlaka lwezibonelelo Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant satholakala kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi labo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi yabo, abangenayo imali yokuphila, noma abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima. Uhlelo lwaluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukunciphisa ubumpofu, nokwakha umnotho ophilayo. Izindlela zokufaka izicelo Abantu baye bafaka izicelo nge-inthanethi, ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokuxhumana, noma ngokuqhuba izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela esiboneleleni, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zendabuko. Ukusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nokuhlaziywa kokuthi abantu basebenzisa kanjani lesi sibonelelo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi iningi labathola lesi sibonelelo lalisisebenzisa ukuze lithenge ukudla, izimpahla zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila zabantu abaningi. Izinzuzo ezitholakele Ukwamukelwa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant kube nomthelela omkhulu ekunciphiseni ubumpofu. Abantu abaningi bakwazi ukuthola ukudla okwakudingeka ukuze baphile, futhi lokhu kwandise umuzwa wokuphepha phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba abanye abantu beqale amabhizinisi amancane ukuze basebenzise imali abayitholile. Izinkinga ezitholakele Nokho, kube nezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwesibonelelo. Kukhona abanye abantu abathi bahluleka ukufinyelela esiboneleleni ngenxa yezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokufaka izicelo ezinzima, noma ukungabi khona kolwazi olucacile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu onelungelo lokuthola lesi sibonelelo uyakwazi ukusifinyelela. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olucacile kubantu mayelana nezindlela zokufaka izicelo, izidingo, kanye nezikhathi zokuhlinzeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubaphathi bezinhlelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha lesi sibonelelo. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Nokho, izinkinga ezitholakele zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ukuze sithuthukise lesi sibonelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu.
Le nsizakalo inikeza ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwentela kanye nosizo lwezezimali oluvela kwiMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubuyiselwa kwentela kuyancipha enteleni ekhokhwayo ezimpahleni ezingenisiwe uma uthenga izimpahla. Umfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu, kumele aqedele ifomu lesicelo; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processed. Esiqeshini sezinhlobo zamakhasimende, bhalisela ibhokisi lokubuyiselwa kwentela esigabeni sokubhaliswa. Ikhodi yomgwaqo wesigaba lapho ibhizinisi likhona. Esiqeshini seMvume yokufaka isicelo, kumele sigcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo uma efaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomsebenzisi wokubuyiselwa. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ethengisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube igama elivela kulesi sigaba. Lapho kukhona le uphawu, susa okungafanele. Izimpahla ngaphansi kwezibalo zokubuyiselwa 3, 4. Incazelo yezimpahla ezingenisiwe. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Umfaki-sicelo kumele athumele ifomu lesicelo eliphelele ehhovisi leMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika eliseduze. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento yokubuyiselwa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye no 607.04.10. Abatshalizimali, Izinkampani Ezinqunyiwe, kanye Neziqinisekiso - Bonke Ozakwethu/Abatshalizimali/Abaphathi. Inkampani - Bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise noMphathi Omkhulu kanye noMphathi Wezezimali. Abasebenzi be-SARS banikeza izindinganiso nezikhathi zokulethwa kwesevisi ngokuhambisana neSivumelwano Sezesevisi ezizosebenza ngo-2007. Le nsizakalo iyamahala. Uhlobo lwamakhasimende lokubhaliswa - Umsebenzisi Wokubuyiselwa, DA185.
Ukubhujiswa Kwemvelo Ngenxa Kwezizimayini Ukukhula komnotho emhlabeni jikelele kuholele ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo, okukhombisa izidingo ezinkulu zokumba izinsiza ezinjengamalahle, insimbi, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zinezimpawu ezinzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekubhujisweni kwemvelo. Izimayini, nakuba zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima. Umthelela Wokumba Izinsiza Uma izimayini ziqala ukusebenza, zidinga indawo enkulu yokumba. Lokhu kuholela ekuchithweni kwemvelo, njengoba izihlahla, izilwane, nezindawo zokuhlala zibhujiswa. Ukumba izinsiza kudinga ukwakha izindawo ezinkulu zokugcina, okwenza kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emvelweni. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola ukudla nokuphila. Ukukhishwa Kwezinto Ezingcolisayo Izimayini zikhishwa izinto eziningi ezingcolisayo, ezinjengemfucumfucu, amanzi angcolile, nezinto eziphuma emoyeni. Lezi zinto zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma amanzi angcolile efakwa emifuleni, kungaholela ekubeni izilwane eziphila emanzini zife, futhi abantu abahlala eduze bangase bahlupheke ngezifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukushintsha Kwezimo Zokuphila Ukusebenza kwezizimayini kuholela ekushintsheni kwezimo zokuphila. Izindawo ezazikhona ngaphambi kokumba zingase zishintshe zibe izindawo ezingenakuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo badinge ukuhamba, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemiphakathi nasemiphakathini. Ukushintsha kwezindawo zokuhlala kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola ukudla, amanzi, nezinsiza. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Imvelo Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela omubi wezizimayini, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokumba, obunciphisa umonakalo emvelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimayini kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva, lapho umhlaba obhujiswe ubuyiselwa esimweni esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izindawo ezazibhujiswe zibuye zibe nezitshalo nezilwane. Ukubambisana Nezindawo Zokuhlala Kubantu abahlala eduze kwezizimayini, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlangano ezibambisene nezimayini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyahlangatshezwa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqashwa, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi. Ukuze kube nokubambisana okuhle, izimayini kufanele ziqonde izidingo zomphakathi futhi zisebenze ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uyathuthuka. Isiphetho Ukubhujiswa kwemvelo ngenxa yezimayini kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Nakuba izimayini zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, umthelela wazo emvelweni ungaba mubi kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngokubambisana nemiphakathi. Ngale ndlela, singagcina imvelo yethu futhi siqinisekise ikusasa elihle kubantu nezilwane. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizimayini, iziphathimandla, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile sokuvikela imvelo.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Isingeniso Lo mbhalo uqukethe ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo esithathwe yinkantolo engamaNgesi sokushwele sikaOscar Pistorius, owayengumjaho ophumelelayo, obhekene nezinsolo zokubulala. Ukuhlaziywa kuzogxila ezicini ezihambisana nesinqumo, imiphumela yezomthetho, kanye nemithelela kulezi zenzo emphakathini. Isizathu Sokuhlola Ukubheka isinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kubalulekile ngoba kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu zokubusa, ubulungiswa, kanye nokuhlukumeza kwabantu. U-Pistorius, obemelwe njengomfanekiso olandelwayo, uyisibonelo sokuthi izinqumo zomthetho zingabhekwa ngezindlela ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezinkanyezi zomphakathi. Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Uhlaka lwezomthetho olusemthethweni lukhombisa ukuthi isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngokuhlonipha zonke izinqubo zomthetho. Nokho, ubufakazi obuhlinzekiwe, izimpikiswano zokuqonda, kanye nezimpendulo zezinhlangothi ezahlukene zikhombisa ukuthi kukhona izinkinga ezihlobene nokuqonda kobulungiswa. Ukuhlinzekwa Kobufakazi Ubufakazi obuhlinzekiwe phakathi kophiko lwezomthetho lubonisa ukungabaza okukhulu. Ubufakazi bokuphila bukaPistorius, izimo ezimkhulumayo, kanye nemiphumela yokushaya kukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho aluhambisani nezimfuno ezifunwa umphakathi. Ukubaluleka kokuhlinzekwa kobufakazi obanele, obuqinisekisiwe, kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe umehluko obalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nezombusazwe Isinqumo sikaPistorius sibuye saphakamisa izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe. Imiphumela yesinqumo ibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho lungase luhlangabezane nezinselelo zokubhekelwa kwababusi bezomthetho. Ukwaziswa okuphakanyisiwe kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu zokuthi abantu abacebile noma abathandwayo bangathola izinkanyezi ezinkulu, kuyilapho abanye besolwa bephoqwa ukuba bahlale phansi. Umthelela Emphakathini Umphakathi ubona imiphumela yesinqumo sikaPistorius ngokwehlukana. Abanye bakhombisa ukuthanda, bebonisa ukuthi uPistorius ubengumuntu ophambene nezimo ezinzima, kanti abanye bahlola ubulungiswa obuyisisekelo. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi umphakathi ungase ube nezinkolelo ezahlukene ngokwethulwa kwezomthetho nobulungiswa. Izifundo Ezifunwayo Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi sinqumo kukhombisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala emkhakheni wezomthetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kwenziwe izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuzwe ubulungiswa. Ukuqonda indlela umphakathi uphendula ngayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho zihlala zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kuvula indlela yokuhlola izinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezomthetho, ubulungiswa, kanye nezomnotho. Kudingeka ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zithathwa ngokuqonda, ziqinisa ubulungiswa, futhi zisebenzele wonke umuntu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Isinyathelo sokugcina sokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso ezibekwe kulokhu kuhlaziywa ziqiniswa, kudingeka izinsiza zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, amaqembu ezomthetho, kanye neminyango yezobulungiswa, ukuze kube nesigaba sokuxhumana esiqinile phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezomthetho. Umsebenzi Olandelayo Umsebenzi olandelayo ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngolwazi, ucwaningo, kanye nezifundo ezitholakala kokubili emkhakheni wezomthetho, nasezindaweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokuqonda izinqumo zomthetho, ukwakha isithombe esihle sezinqubomgomo, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubulungiswa emiphakathini yethu. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kuveza ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola izimo, izinqubo zokusebenza, kanye nezimpendulo zomphakathi kumasu wezomthetho. Imiphumela yalezi zifundo iyawuqinisa umqondo wokuthi ubulungiswa kufanele bube yinto efanelekile, eveza izidingo zomphakathi wonke.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Ngonyaka ka-2014, umhlaba waphenduka waba nesithombe esibi kakhulu lapho umgibeli odumile, uOscar Pistorius, ethola isinqumo sokwahlulela ngemva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, intombi yakhe. Lesi senzo saphendula izinkulumo eziningi mayelana nezokuphepha, ubudlelwane, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho ezithinta abantu abadumile. Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kudinga ukuba sihlole izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimo zomthetho, izinkolelo zomphakathi, kanye nemiphumela yalesi senzo. UOscar Pistorius, owaziwa kakhulu njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela emhlabeni wobunzima, njengoba enezinyawo eziphukile. Waba yisithonjana sokuzimisela, futhi wathola udumo emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, impilo yakhe yaguquka ngokuphelele ngemuva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp ngonyaka ka-2013. U-Pistorius wathi wacabanga ukuthi uReeva ungumthakathi, futhi waphosa isibhamu, okwaholela ekufeni kwakhe. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwecala, lapho abameli bakhe bezama ukufakazela ukuthi ubulale uReeva ngokungafanele, ngenxa yokucindezeleka okukhulu. U-Pistorius waphikisa ukuthi wayengazi ukuthi uReeva ubekhona endlini, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokuvikela kwakhe. Nokho, umphakathi wawungavumi lezi zinsolo, futhi izinkulumo zaba ziningi. Abantu abaningi babebona lokhu njengokungafanele, futhi baphikisa ukuthi uPistorius wayenokwazi okukhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uPistorius wathola isijeziso sokuvalelwa emzini, esikhundleni sokuba aboshwe. Lokhu kwavusa ukungabaza okukhulu phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaningi bebebona lokhu njengokungafanele. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abathile bangathola izinzuzo ezikhethekile ngenxa yokudumisa kwabo, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezinga lokuphila kwabantu abajwayelekile uma bephakathi kwezinkantolo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isinqumo sikaPistorius saguqulwa, futhi wathola isijeziso esinzima sokuboshwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola umthetho, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi uPistorius kufanele abhekane nezimo ezinzima, njengoba abanye abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho, njengoba izinkantolo zidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuvikelwa, nokuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zisebenze kanjani. Uhlanga lwezokuphepha lwalubhekwa kakhulu kulolu daba. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abaninzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kokukhathazeka, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezokuphepha. Abantu abaningi babebona ukuthi uPistorius wayengumuntu ophumelelayo, kodwa lokhu akukhombisi ukuthi wayengavikeleki. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zihlale ziqinile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi senzo saphinde savula izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezobudlelwane. U-Pistorius noReeva babephila ebudlelwaneni obunokuphikisana, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezimo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uPistorius wathola ithuba lokuphila impilo entsha, kodwa umphakathi wawungakholwa kalula. Isinqumo sakhe saphinde savusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezobudlelwane, izokuphepha, kanye nezimo zomthetho. Ngokuphetha, ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kudinga ukuba sihlole izici eziningi ezithinta umphakathi, izokuphepha, kanye nezimo zomthetho. Lesi senzo saphinde savula izinkulumo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwane, futhi saphinde sakhumbuza abantu ukuthi izinkantolo zidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuvikelwa. Lo mbhalo kufanele ufundwe njengengxenye yesitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni). Umnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi sitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalesi work akukaze kube umsebenzi olula nhlobo. Izikhathi eziningi, abantu abake basebenza kule msebenzi yokuhumusha baphoqeleka ukuba benze amagama amasha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Lezi zimpapasho zithunyelwe futhi kubachwepheshe kulezi zilimi ukuze zihlolwe. Umnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zimpapasho njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufundisa ukuba asebenzise lezi zimpapasho njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlola umfundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela wezinga lokuhlola lemfundo elisekelwe eziphumeleni, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze izibonelo zemikhuba yokugcina amarekhodi. Uhlu lwezinto okufanele zifundwe lunikeza uhlaka olujwayelekile lwezifundo kanye nohlu lokuhlola noluhlu oluhambisana ngqo nezifundo ezithile. Umzimba walencwadi uhlukaniswe ngezihloko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sithinta izinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, nezinga eliphakeme. Isahluko ngasinye kulezi zinga sihlanganisa ingxenye yokwethula eyamfushane, izindlela zokuhlola zezigaba ngazinye. Izindlela zokuhlola zezigaba ngazinye zethulwa ngendlela yokwenza intuthuko yokufunda ibonakale. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezifanayo zezigaba ngazinye ziqondiswa ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuqhathanisa intuthuko yokufunda eminyakeni. Lokhu kudala izikhala kwezinye izindawo, njengoba hhayi zonke izindlela zokuhlola zifana kuzo zonke izigaba.
