UMsunguli wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) unikeza isisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Futhi ukuze kwakhiwe iNingizimu Afrika ephethwe ngentando yeningi nokuqhubeka, futhi ekwazi ukuthatha indawo yayo efanele njengendawo ezimele phakathi kwezizwe ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo kanye nohlelo lwezifundo kudlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso. Uhlelo lwezifundo luhloselwe ukuthuthukisa amandla omfundi ngamunye ukuba abe yisakhamuzi esigcwele saseNingizimu Afrika esephethwe ngentando yeningi. Imfundo esekelwe eziphumeleni. Imfundo esekelwe eziphumeleni iyisisekelo sohlelo lwezifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngokusemandleni abo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlela iziphumo okufanele umfundi ngamunye azifinyelele kanye nomfundi ekupheleni kwazo zonke lezi zenzo. Futhi ukwazi ukukhombisa ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wakhiwe ngohlelo lwezingxenye ezihlukahlukene ngokukwazi ukubona ukuthi umqondo wokuxazulula izinkinga awukwazi ukuba uzimele. Bakwazi ukuzama izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza njengabantu abaphethe imithwalo yokubhekana nezimpilo zomphakathi abawuthandayo, ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bakwazi ukuba nezinhlonipho futhi bathinteke ngezamasiko nobuhle obukhona ezimweni ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Futhi ukudala amathuba ebhizinisi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nobubha, ukungalingani, ukucwaswa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, ukukhubazeka, nezinkinga ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo zonke zinefuthe ezingeni nasekutheni abafundi bafunda esikoleni. Isitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) sigcizelela indlela ebanzi ngokugqamisa izidingo ezincane zabafundi bonke. Zonke izitatimende zezindawo zezifundo zihlose ukuveza ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kokuphila ngendlela efanele, amalungelo abantu, indawo ephephile nehlanzekile ezibambile, kanye nokufakwa kwabo bonke. Abafundi baphinde bakhuthazwe ukuba bazi futhi baqonde kabanzi ngohlobo lwezinto ezikhona ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo, kanye nezwe, okuyizici ezibalulekile zalezi zihloko. Isitatimende ngasinye sezindawo zezifundo sikhombisa iziphumo zokufunda okufanele umfundi azifinyelele ekupheleni kwesigaba sika-9. Isitatimende ngasinye sezindawo zezifundo sichaza kahle indlela yokuhlola engafinyelela eziphumeleni zokufunda ezilindelekile. Izindlela zokuhlola zichazwa kahle ngesisekelo sezigaba nezinga, kanye nobubanzi nobukhulu bolwazi okufanele abafundi bazi nokuthi kufanele bakwazi ukwenza ini. Izindlela zokuhlola zalokho kanye nezitatimende zezindawo zezifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ulwazi namakhono angathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokuhlola zingahlanganiswa ezigabeni ezifanayo noma zihlanganiswe ezigabeni ezingafani. Ikhono lokwakha ubudlelwano ngokukwazi ukuhlanganisa izigaba kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa ulwazi kusuka kulesi zinga kuya kwenye kuyisisekelo salolu hlelo lwezifundo olusha. Isitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo sihlose ukukhulisa ukuzibophezela nolwazi phakathi kwabafundisi, abazoba yibo abahlanganyela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zabo zezifundo. Ukuze kusekelwe leli hlelo, uMnyango Wezemfundo uzokwethula umhlahlandlela wezokuphatha osetshenziswe kuzo zonke izitatimende zezindawo zezifundo. Izifunda nazo zizoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yazo ukuze zibhekane nezihlukahluka ezikhona ukuze zicabangele ukuhlukahluka kwezifunda. Iziqondiso nezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala esitatimendeni sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo nasemazingeni ezifundo zisisekelo sohlelo lokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufinyelela kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezibalulekile zemfundo ngesisekelo sezigaba nezinga, izinhlelo zezifundo zigcizelela ukwakhiwa kwalokho okuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Izinhlelo zezifundo zifaka futhi uhlu lwezabelo okufanele ziqedwe lapho isivinini sokuthi kufanele ziqedwe kanjani nokuthi kufanele zilandela kanjani unyaka nonyaka kanye nezibonelo zehlelo lwezifundo okufanele zisetshenziswe phakathi nesikhathi esinikeziwe. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kunezinhlelo zezifundo ezintathu: ikhono lokufunda nokubhala, ikhono lokubala (ukusebenza ngezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. Ezingeni eliphakathi, ulwazi lwezilimi kanye nezinombolo ku
Uma ufuna ukuba umphakathi wezolimo, akuzothi kudlule isikhathi eside ukuze ubone ukubaluleka kokusebenzisa imishini - okuhlanganisa yonke imishini yokulima. Ekuqaleni, lapho usalima endaweni encane, ungaphumelela ngokusebenza ngezandla noma usebenzisa amajuba noma amahhashi. Kodwa lapho uqala ukulima amahektha amaningi, kuzodingeka usebenzise imishini ukwenza umsebenzi omningi ngesikhathi esifushane. Sivame ukubona ukuthi abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuqhubeka ngoba abanayo imishini noma imishini yabo ayisebenzi kahle. Itraktori engakwazi ukusebenza ayisizi umbulali nhlobo. Bheka inani lamanzi nomoya. Thola irekhodi lesevisi lelo mshini. Bheka isimo samathayi. Bheka noma yikuphi ukuvuza kwe-oyili - akudingeki. Qala injini futhi ulalele ukuthi ikhuluma kanjani. Sebenzisa i-clutch namagiya - ingabe konke kusebenze kahle noma cha? Xhuma imishini (njenge-plow) futhi uyiphakamishe ukuze uhlole ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenza kahle. Ingabe i-PTO iyasebenza kahle? Ingabe wonke amagiya namaleveli asebenza kahle? Donsa imishini ukuze ubone ukuthi itraktori inamandla. Ingabe le traktori isasebenza kahle? Bheka ukuthi i-planter isebenza kanjani - ingabe inama-plates, ingabe isebenza nge-vacuum (umoya), noma ingabe isebenzisa iminwe? Ingabe i-planter ifaka imigqa emingaki? Xhuma i-planter ku-traktori. Faka imbewu ne-fertilizer kumahopper. Phusha itraktori endaweni eqondile engaba ngamamitha angama-10 bese uhlole ukuthi zonke imigqa zisebenza. Uma imbewu ne-fertilizer zingaphumi kahle, bheka izingxenye ezifanele futhi uthole ukuthi yini inkinga. Bheka uma kunezinye ama-plates (lapho isebenzisa ama-plates). Ngaphambi kokuxhuma imishini ku-traktori, bheka izinga le-oyili kuphampu. Xhuma i-sprayer ku-PTO. Phusha futhi uhlole ukuthi zonke izikhukhula zisebenza. Uma kukhona inkinga, bheka ukuthi ikuphi - kungaba kuphampu, ifilitha, noma izikhukhula. Uma imishini ingasebenzi kahle, ingabe uzokwazi ukuyilungisa noma cha? Bheka umzimba - ingabe ugebhezi noma uphukile (bheka izindawo lapho kubhontshwe khona)? Bheka wonke ama-bolts nezinye izindawo zokubopha. Bheka izingxenye ezingenela emhlabathini - ingabe zidinga ukuba ezintsha? Bheka amapayipi namaphampu - ingabe asebenza kahle futhi avuza? Bheka amavhili - bheka ingcindezi yomoya. Bheka ama-bearings - ingabe agcwele amafutha futhi ahamba kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola kwakho itraktori nemishini kwenziwa kahle, qinisa konke, futhi imishini izokwazi ukusebenza kalula endaweni yakho - akusizi ukuthola imishini encane bese ufuna ukulima izinkundla ezinkulu. Kungcono ukwenza inzuzo endaweni encane kunokulahlekelwa imali endaweni enkulu. Sebenzisa kuphela izinkundla ezikufanele.
Umdanso: Umsebenzi Wokudlulisa Isiko Nezizathu Zokuhlanganyela Umdanso, njengomsebenzi wezokwakha, ubonakala njengengxenye ebalulekile yamasiko amaningi emhlabeni. E-Afrika, umdanso unomlando ocebile, uphinde ube yindlela yokudlulisa izindaba, imizwa, nezifundo ezibalulekile ezizweni ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso akuwona nje umsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi unomthelela omkhulu empilweni yamasiko. Emazweni amaningi, umdanso uhlanganisa abantu, udala ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizukulwane. Izinkolo, imicimbi yokugubha, kanye nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo ziba yizizathu ezibalulekile zokudansa. Ngokwesibonelo, eNingizimu Afrika, umdanso weZulu, owaziwa ngokuthi yi-'Indlamu', ubonisa ubuhlakani bamasiko kanye nemigubho yokuhlonipha. Umdanso weZulu ubalulekile emicimbini efana neziqholo, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze baphinde baqhakambisa izithethe zabo. Ngaphandle kokuba umdanso ubonisa isiko, unikeza nethuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhona emphakathini. Njengoba umdanso uvame ukusebenzisa izincazelo ezithile, abaculi bangasebenzisa le ndlela ukuze baphakamise izwi labo, baveze imizwa yabo, futhi baphendule ezinkingeni ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emidansweni ethinta izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlalisana. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ohlanganisa izindlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukudansa ngokwezinkanyezi, ukudansa kwesiko, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umdanso ungashintsha futhi uthuthuke, uhambisane nezinguquko ezisemphakathini. Izinkampani zomdanso zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abaculi abasha ukuba baveze ubuchwepheshe babo, futhi ziqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Ngokwenyuka komdanso, izigidi zabantu ziya ziqonda ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuphila. Abantu abaningi baphila ngokuqhubeka nokudansa, bejabulisa abanye futhi bephinde bephakamisa imizwa yabo. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuphumula, yokukhulula ingcindezi, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuzithokozisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso unamandla okukhulisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhlanganise izizukulwane ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdanso ungenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwamazwe. Umdanso wezemidlalo, njengokudansa kwezemidlalo, ungathokozisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, udala umoya wokuhlanganyela nokuhloniphana. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso ungathuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, ube yindlela yokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ekuqaleni, umdanso wawusetyenziswa njengendlela yokukhumbula izinkanyezi zempilo, kodwa manje usuphenduke umkhakha ongenamkhawulo. Abaculi baphakathi komdanso bahlala bephokophele ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi beveza izifundo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, ube yindlela yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo eziphilayo. Umdanso, njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, ungaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlanganyela, sokuphila, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ubonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhle, nokuhlakanipha kwezakhamuzi. Njengoba umdanso uqhubeka nokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle, kubalulekile ukuthi siwuhloniphe, siwugubhe, futhi siwuthokozise. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sithokozisa, sithokozise, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi siko esiyigugu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso uzophinde ube yindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlangene, nelinobungane. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithandazela umdanso, siwufake emhlabeni wethu, futhi siwuthokozise. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sithokozisa, sithokozise, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi siko esiyigugu.
Amabhizinisi Amancane - Ingxoxo Nendoda Ethuthukisa Umnotho Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozile ukuba nezingxoxo nomnqobi wempumelelo emkhakheni wamabhizinisi amancane, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu. U-Sipho ungumuntu ophumelele kakhulu, futhi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wakhe. Sizobe sikhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe, izinselelo abhekane nazo, kanye nezifundo azifundile endleleni. Ingxoxo Umbuzo 1: U-Sipho, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi waqala kanjani ibhizinisi lakho? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngathanda ukusungula ibhizinisi lami ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami. Ngibone ukuthi umphakathi wami udinga izinsiza ezithile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokudla. Ngakha umqondo wokuvula isitolo sokudla esinikeza ukudla okuphumelelayo, okwenziwe ngempela ngezithako ezisemqoka. Ngathola uxhaso oluncane oluvela kubangani bami, futhi ngaqala ngenkampani encane. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo obhekane nazo ekuqaleni? U-Sipho: Kunezinto eziningi ezinzima. Okokuqala, kwakunzima ukuthola imali yokwakha ibhizinisi. Ngabe ngidinga ukuhamba ngokuqhubekayo, ngikhuluma nabantu abahlukene ukuze ngithole uxhaso. Okwesibili, kwakunzima ukuheha amakhasimende. Ngafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yami iyathandwa, ngakho ngasebenzisa izindlela zokumaketha ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezincane emiphakathini. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba nebhizinisi elincane? U-Sipho: Izinzuzo ziningi. Okokuqala, ungakwazi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho ngendlela oyithandayo, okuvumela ukuba ube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Okwesibili, ungakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende akho. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngithanda amakhasimende ami, bayazizwa bekhululekile futhi baphinde babuyisele. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onempilo. Umbuzo 4: Uthola kanjani izixazululo ezinzima? U-Sipho: Ngithanda ukufunda. Ngihlala ngifunda izincwadi, ngibuka izifundo eziku-inthanethi, futhi ngihlanganyela nabanye osomabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi akekho owazi konke, ngakho ngiyazama ukufunda kwabanye. Ngithola izixazululo ezinzima ngokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene, futhi ngiyazama ukusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izifundo ezibalulekile ozifundile? U-Sipho: Okwokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile. Ngithole ukuthi uma ungenalo uhlelo, ungase ungaphumeleli. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana kubalulekile. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye osomabhizinisi, amakhasimende, kanye nabahlinzeki bangeza impumelelo. Okwesithathu, kufanele uhlale uvumelana nezinguquko. Umhlaba ushintsha njalo, futhi kufanele ube nesimo sokuzivumelanisa. Umbuzo 6: Uthanda kanjani ukusiza abanye osomabhizinisi? U-Sipho: Ngiyakholelwa ekutheni umphakathi kufanele usebenze ndawonye. Ngihlanganyela izifundo zamahhala nabantu abasha abathanda ukuqala amabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sabelana ngolwazi, siphumelela sonke. Ngithanda ukusiza abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani, futhi ngiyabavumela ukuba babuze noma yini. Umbuzo 7: Yini oyibona njengomgomo wakho wokugcina? U-Sipho: Umgomo wami wokugcina ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emiphakathini. Ngifuna ukusungula ibhizinisi elizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo, futhi ngithanda ukusiza abanye ukuba bathole amathuba. Ngifuna ukuba isibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Isiphetho U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhombisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukufunda, nokuxhumana nabanye kuyizinto ezibalulekile empumelelweni yakhe. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze amabhizinisi amancane, ngoba ayisisekelo somphakathi. U-Sipho ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi, uma sinesifiso, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.
IShoprite - Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Zayo IShoprite iyindawo yokuthenga ehlonishwayo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibhekwa njengomunye wezitolo ezinkulu kakhulu kuleli. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinselelo ezihambisana nale ndawo yokuthenga, futhi sizohlola ukuthi iziphi izindlela ezithinta impilo yabathengi. Izinzuzo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Okokuqala, iShoprite inikeza izintengo eziphansi, ezilungele umphakathi ophakathi nendawo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abathengi bamaNingizimu Afrika, njengoba kudingeka izimakethe ezingabizi. Izintengo ezikhangayo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bavakashele iShoprite, okwenza kube nezithombe ezinhle ngezinsizakalo zayo. Okwesibili, iShoprite inikela ngempahla ebanzi, okuvumela abathengi ukuba bathenge izinto ezidingekayo emakhaya. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla, iziphuzo, nezimpahla zansuku zonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola konke abakudingayo endaweni eyodwa, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphise isikhathi sokushiya emsebenzini. Okokugcina, iShoprite ihlinzeka ngocingo olwenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezimakethe ezahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ukuhlanganyela ukuze kutholakale imininingwane ethile, njengeminyango yezezimali nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola izipesheli nemikhankaso ethokozisayo, okwandisa ulwazi lwabathengi. Izinselelo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Nokho, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nabathengi. Okokuqala, izindleko zomsebenzi ezihambisana nezokuthenga ziya zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima kubathengi abathile. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abathengi kufanele baqaphele izindleko ezithile ezikhuphukayo, okwenza kube necala. Okwesibili, kukhona impikiswano mayelana nephalethi yeShoprite nezimpahla ezibizayo ezithengiswa. I-Shoprite ikhuluma kakhulu ngalesi sihloko, kodwa abanye bahlongoza ukuthi izimpahla zikhuphuka kanjani eminyakeni ethile, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imikhiqizo engabizi. Okokugcina, ubukho beShoprite emiphakathini yezezimali bunomthelela omubi ezitolo ezincane. Njengoba iShoprite iqhubeka nokwethula imikhiqizo emisha, izitolo ezincane ziba sengozini yokuntuleka. Lokhu kuholela empikiswaneni emiphakathini yethu, njengoba izitolo ezincane zikhuthaza ukuhweba okuhlukahlukene. Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, iShoprite iyindawo ebalulekile yokuthenga, kodwa iphakamisa imibuzo eminingi. Yize inezinzuzo ezinkulu, njengezintengo eziphansi nezimpahla eziningi, ubukhona bayo buveza isidingo sokuxazulula izinselelo ezithile, njengezindleko eziphakeme nezinqwaba ezithile. Lokhu kuqonda kubalulekile ukuze sithole indlela eziteshi ezinkulu ezithinta ngayo izitolo emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, sizoba nekhono lokuhola imikhankaso ehlukanisayo ekuphileni kweShoprite.
Lo msebenzi uhlose abantu noma izinhlangano ezithakazelayo ukubhalisela ikhaya labadala. Gcwalisa ifomu phambi kwabasebenzi bebhange. Thola i-receipt uma uthumela ifomu futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanselwa, uzothola incwadi echaza izizathu zokukhanselwa kwesicelo sakho. Uma ungavumelani nesinqumo, thumela isicelo sokuphikisa kwiNgqongqoshe yoThuthukiswa Komphakathi noma kumuntu oyiMenenja ehhovisi lesigaba noma lesifunda echaza ukuthi kungani ungavumelani nesinqumo. Thumela isicelo sokuphikisa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 ukuze uthole impendulo yakho. Kungathatha izinsuku ezingu-4 ukuze processing yesicelo sakho iphumelele. Umsebenzi wezokwelapha uzomema abanye abantu abafana nezisebenzi zempilo nezikhulu zikamasipala ukuze bahlolisise le ndawo. Umuntu ngamunye owamukelwe uzobhala umbiko wakhe ngezinto abatholile ngesikhathi sokuhlola. Le mibiko izothunyelwa ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo sokugcina. Ukubhaliswa kuncike ekutheni isifunda sinamandla kangakanani futhi kuyahluka ngesifunda. Ukuhlolwa kwekhaya lokubhaliswa akukhokhiswa. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze.
Abalimi BaseNingizimu Afrika: Umgogodla Wokuphila Kwethu Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika bangabantu ababalulekile empilweni yethu. Bahlala bephakathi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo zomnotho wethu, benza umsebenzi onzima ukuze sihlale sithola ukudla okwakhiwe ngothando, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemizamo yabo. Abalimi bethu, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokweqiniso, abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ezimeni ezinzima. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwemithombo, kanye nezinkinga zokuthola izinsiza, konke lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu. Nokho, abanye bethu basakhumbula izinsuku ezinhle lapho umhlaba wawugcwele izithelo nezitshalo, lapho imifino yayikhula kahle, futhi lapho umoya wawugcwele iphunga lempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nokuqonda okujulile nokuhlonipha imizamo yabo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa bahlala bephikelela. Ukusebenza kwabo akugcini nje ngokukhiqiza ukudla, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukugcina amasiko ethu, imikhuba, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Ukusebenza kwabo akugcini nje ngokukhiqiza ukudla, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukugcina amasiko ethu, imikhuba, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Abalimi bethu bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo
Izilwane EziFuywayo: Injongo Yokuthanda Nokuphila Njengobungane Izilwane ezifuywayo, ezaziwa ngokuthi izilwane zokuzijabulisa, zibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke yomuntu. Namuhla, abantu abaningi bavame ukuzithanda lezi zilwane, njengezinja, amakati, nezilwane ezahlukene, futhi zithathwa njengengxenye yomndeni. Nokho, ingabe izinzuzo zokuba nezilwane ezifuywayo zidlula izinkinga ezihambisana nazo? Izinzuzo Zokufuywa Kwezilwane: Okokuqala, izilwane ezifuywayo zicebisa impilo yethu ngezindlela eziningi. Zisiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu, zikhuthaza ukuhamba, futhi zinciphisa ukucindezeleka. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abantu abanezilwane ezifuywayo bahlala bejabule futhi banempilo engcono. Umphenyi uJohn C. T. Mackenzie ubonisa ukuthi abantu abanezinyoni bahlala bejabule kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abangafuywanga. Okwesibili, ukufuywa kwezilwane kukhuthaza umoya wokunakekela. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ukudla, nokuvikela izilwane kudinga umzamo omkhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthenga ukudla okufanele, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, nokuzijabulisa. Le mikhankaso inika abantu umqondo wokuphila, ibanikeza isizotha ngezinzwa zabo. Izinkinga Ezivela Ekufuyweni Kwezilwane: Nokho, akukhona konke okukhanya. Ukufuywa kwezilwane kudinga izinsiza eziningi, ezifana nesikhathi, imali, nezinsizakusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufuywa kwezilwane akulula, futhi lokho kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithile empilweni yomuntu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele kubalulekile ukuze izilwane zihlale zikhona futhi ziphila kahle. Okwesithathu, kunezinkinga zokubuyiselwa. Ezinye izilwane zidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu, futhi lokhu kudinga isikhathi esiningi. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni uma izilwane zingakwenzi okwakulindelwe, okungadala ubandlululo kwabanye. Ukukhuluma Ngemiphumela Yemvelo: Okokugcina, abafuphi nezilwane abathembekile bahlala benomthelela omubi emvelweni. Izilwane ezifuywayo zingadala izinkinga zemvelo, kuhlanganise nokwanda kwezimboni ezishaya izilwane. Noma izilwane zinelungelo lokuphila, izenzo zethu zingaba nemiphumela emibi. Ushowe umhlangano wezinsiza eziluhlaza uthe “ukuthanda okuphumelelayo kuncike ekufundeni izinto ezinhle, ngezikhathi zokwelapha.” Lokhu kusho ukuthi abanikazi bezilwane kufanele baziqhenye futhi baphathe kahle izilwane zabo. Isiphetho: Ekugcineni, izilwane ezifuywayo zinezinzuzo ezinkulu, zikhuthaza ubungane, kodwa zinezinkinga ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Njengomphakathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukufuywa kwezilwane kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuncishiswe imiphumela emibi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila okuhle kwabantu nezilwane. Ngakho, imali, umqondo, nesikhathi kudinga ukwakhiwa ukuze kube nobudlelwano obuphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, sizoba nomthelela omuhle emvelweni, sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nezinye izilwane, futhi sakhe izimpilo ezingenza impilo ibe ngcono kubo bonke.
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemazweni abo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhosi noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nabaholi bendawo, futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulu ngokuqhuba imikhuba yendabuko. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 211 soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba kwenzeka ngaphambi kokwethulwa komthethosisekelo omusha, kepha lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nomthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhangwa ngaphansi kwento 16 yeSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo, enikeza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neNkantolo Yendabuko eyayikhona ngesikhathi umthethosisekelo uqala iyaqhubeka nokusebenza futhi izisebenze amandla ayo omthetho njengoba anikeziwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ihlanganiswe nezinye ezazishiwoyo ngaphambi komthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazizimele. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yomlando eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokuqinisekiswa komthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana nento 14 yeSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko obizwa ngokuthi "Umbiko NgamaKhosi Wendabuko & Imisebenzi Yezomthetho Yabaholi Bendabuko" owadalwa ngomhla ziyi-21 kuJanuwari, 2003: iKomidi Lomthetho laseNingizimu Afrika ekhasini 1. Ukuvinjelwa kwamandla kungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwenkantolo yokulalela icala nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho, ukuvinjelwa kwamandla kusitshela ngamandla nemingcele enikezwe inkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe kulolu daba lapho inkantolo ingenawo amandla sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Lapho sihlola umthetho okhona, imibono yokuvinjelwa kwamandla ivela kokubili emikhubeni yendabuko nasemithethweni eminingi. Le mithetho ivela kumthetho ojwayelekile kepha ingase ibhalwe njengomthetho. Isibonelo sokubhalwa kwale mithetho nguMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ehlobene nokuvinjelwa kwamandla. Ngokuhambisana nalomthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe namandla, kufanele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kufanele ibe namandla phezu komuntu ophathwayo kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wokuvinjelwa uhambisana nomgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Ukuvinjelwa kwamandla kuhambisana nomngcele wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Ukuvinjelwa kwamandla enkantolo kuhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echaziwe. Le misho ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphakeli ulandela indawo lapho umphikisi ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphakeli kufanele avule icala enkantolo enegunya phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Ngokuvamile, inkantolo yendawo lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphakeli ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezahlukene ngaphansi kwalomthetho: ngokwesibonelo; inkantolo inegunya ngoba umthombo wenkohlakalo uvele endaweni elawulwa yinkantolo leyo. Mayelana nesigaba 28(d) soMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sithi ukuze le nkantolo ibe namandla okusebenza, umthombo wenkohlakalo kufanele uvele ngokuphelele endaweni elawulwa yinkantolo leyo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana kwamandla, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe namandla phezu kwendaba efanayo. Ngoba umphakeli unelungelo lokulawula icala, angakhetha inkantolo ezolalela udaba lwakhe. Ngokuvamile, umphakeli ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana naye ngaphandle kokucabangela ukuthi isimo sifanele kangakanani kumphikisi. Amandla okulawula akhonjiswa ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha imiyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula amandla ayo, ingase iphume icala ngokuphelele. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ekhasini 819. Uma inkantolo yayinevinjelwa kwamandla ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho lwesimo ngeke luguqule ukuvinjelwa kwamandla enkantolo. Ngokwesibonelo: inkantolo inegunya lokulawula ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, wayehlala ngaphakathi kwendawo yayo, iyaqhubeka nokuba namandla phezu kwendaba noma ngabe ngemuva kokukhipha imiyalo, umphikisi akasekho endaweni yenkantolo leyo. Indawo ehlobene nokuvinjelwa kwamandla. Inkantolo inegunya lokulalela udaba olukhulunywa phambi kwayo. Lokhu kuqondene kakhulu nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwendaba kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kufanele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezakhamuzi zendabuko, kusekhona umgomo othile ophatha inani lemali. Noma ngabe akukho mgomo ophathelene nenani lemali, iKomidi Lomthetho ephathelene noMthetho Wendabuko yenze izincomo zokuqala zomgomo ozosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo soMthetho Wendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo ngaphandle kwamandla okukhuluma udaba lwakhe futhi engakwenzi ukwenqaba ukuba abhekane nenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okulalela udaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) soMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kuguqulwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, igunya eliphethe linomsebenzi wokubuza ngakho (mero mutu) mayelana namandla okukhuluma udaba kulenkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, igunya eliphethe lenkantolo ngeke libuze ngakho ngempela mayelana namandla enkantolo okukhuluma icala. Uma kwenzeka kudaleke udaba lokuthi inkantolo ingenawo amandla okukhuluma icala, umuntu owafakile kufanele alethe ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukukhuluma icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lomthetho ngamaKhosi Wendabuko, ekhasini 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okukhuluma icala ingamphoqelela ukuba alethe ubufakazi bokuthi kungani esho kanjalo. Umqondo wokuvinjelwa kwamandla uhambisana nokuhlelwa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa ngamandla nemithetho yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lamandla okulawula nokuvinjelwa, inkantolo yombuso ihlala njengenkantolo eyinhloko elalela udaba noma njengenk
Udlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane: Izinyathelo Zokuzivikela Nokuphuma Emathubeni Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga enkulu emphakathini wethu. Lokhu kudlame kungaba ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, noma ngokocansi, futhi kubangela ubuhlungu obukhulu ezimpilweni zabesifazane. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuzivikela, siqonde izimpawu zodlame, futhi sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile ezizosisiza ekuphumeleleni ekulweni nodlame. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Udlame Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane lungatholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Udlame lwezocansi: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yokocansi ngaphandle kwemvume. - Udlame lwemizwa: Lokhu kubonakala ngokuhlukumeza, ukugxekwa, noma ukwehliswa kwenhlonipho. - Udlame lwemizimba: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlaselwa ngokomzimba, njengokushaywa noma ukuhlinzekwa ngodlame. Ukuqonda lezi zindlela zodlame kuzosisiza ukuba sibe nekhono lokuzivikela. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubona Izimpawu Zodlame Izimpawu zodlame zingahluka, kodwa kunezinto ezithile okufanele sizibheke. Uma ubona noma uzwa: - Ukukhathazeka okungapheli, ukungabi nankinga, noma ukungazethembi. - Ukuphazamiseka emsebenzini, ezikoleni, noma emiphakathini. - Ukuphazamiseka kokuxhumana nabanye, noma ukugwema abantu abathile. Lezi zimpawu zingaba uphawu lokuthi umuntu ubhekene nodlame. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubona lezi zimpawu, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhuluma Ngodlame Uma ubona izimpawu zodlame, kubalulekile ukukhuluma. Lokhu kungaba nzima, kodwa kubalulekile. Ungakhuluma nomngane, umndeni, noma umuntu omethembayo. Uma ungakakwazi ukukhuluma, ungabhalela phansi imicabango yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuveza imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukufuna Usizo Uma udlame lukhona, kubalulekile ukufuna usizo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuvakashela udokotela ukuze uthole usizo lwezempilo. - Ukuxhumana nezikhungo zokwelashwa kwengqondo. - Ukuxhumana nezikhungo ezikhethekile ezisiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo. Ukufuna usizo akusho ukuthi uyaphoxeka, kodwa kusho ukuthi uyazithanda futhi ufuna ukuphila impilo engcono. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuzivikela Ukuzivikela kubalulekile. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukufunda izindlela zokuzivikela, njengezokulwa. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphepha, njengokwazi ukuthi ungaphi uma uzizwa ungaphephile. - Ukuxhumana nabangane noma umndeni ukuze uthole ukwesekwa. Ukuzivikela akukhona kuphela ukuvikela umzimba, kodwa futhi nokuvikela imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokwesekwa Kunezikhungo eziningi ezitholakalayo ezisiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo. Lezi zikhungo zinganikeza: - Ukusekela ngokomzimba. - Ukusekela ngokwengqondo. - Ulwazi ngezindlela zokuphuma ezimeni ezinzima. Ukuxhumana nalezi zikhungo kungaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphuma emathubeni. Isinyathelo 7: Ukukhuthaza Abanye Ngemuva kokuthola usizo, ungaba yisibonelo kwabanye. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukwabelana ngempilo yakho nabanye. - Ukukhuthaza abesifazane abanye ukuba baphume emathubeni. - Ukuxhasa imikhankaso yokulwa nodlame. Ukukhuthaza abanye kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuphila Impilo Engcono Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuzivocavoca ukuze uthole amandla. - Ukudla kahle ukuze ugcine impilo. - Ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula nokuzijabulisa. Impilo engcono izokwenza kube lula ukuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba udlame. Isiphetho Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga enkulu, kodwa sinesibopho sokuzivikela nokuphuma emathubeni. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, singakwazi ukusiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo, sikhuthaze abanye, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Khumbula, akuwona umthwalo wakho kuphela, kodwa umphakathi wonke unomsebenzi wokulwa nodlame. Sihlanganyele ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabesifazane, sikhulise umphakathi onobudlelwano, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa elingcono.
Kunokwehluka phakathi kokwahlulela uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye nokusiza amaqembu athintekayo ekuxazululeni. Ekwahluleleni, umuntu ongengxenye yokungaboni ngaso linye uthatha isinqumo mayelana nokungaboni ngaso linye, futhi leso sinqumo kumele sibe sihlose amaqembu athintekayo. Uma umuntu ongengxenye yokungaboni ngaso linye esiza la maqembu ekuxazululeni, sithi lokho kuyisixazululo noma ukuvuselela. Uma amaqembu athintekayo exazulula izinkinga zawo ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu wesithathu, lokhu kuyisiphumo senqubo yokuxoxisana phakathi kwamaqarhu amabili. Abaphathi bezomthetho ezinkantolo bathola amandla abo okwahlulela ngokuba baqokwe ngokwezimiso zomthetho. Kuphinde kube nokwenzeka ukuthi amaqembu athintekayo alethe izinkinga zawo ukuze zihlulelwe ngumuntu abavuma ukuba kube umlandeli. Ezivumelwaneni eziningi, amaqembu afaka isigaba esivuma ukuthi noma iyiphi ingxabano ephuma phakathi kwabo ezivumelwaneni zawo izodluliselwa kumxhumanisi. Umxhumanisi angabizwa noma isigaba singachaza ukuthi umxhumanisi uzokhethwa kanjani, njengomthetho okhethwe yiBar Association. Isivumelwano sokuhamba kumxhumanisi asidingi ukuba sibhale. Emiphakathini ethile noma emindenini, kungase kube nesivumelwano sokuthi ingxabano izodluliselwa kumholi womphakathi noma kumholi wemindeni ngoba lokho kuyisiko elalandelwa isikhathi eside. Ingxabano ithathwa njengokwenziwa ngumuntu ophathiswe nguhulumeni. Amaqembu athintekayo awakwazi ukukhetha ukuthi ubani umuntu ophathiswe. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngemicimbi, imithetho, noma izivumelwano zenkantolo. Kungaba nzima kumaqembu athintekayo ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokwethulwa komthetho. Isinqumo kumele sibe sihambisana nesibonelo esisebenzayo. Isinqumo siqinisekiswa ngenqubo esemthethweni noma engasebenzi. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo ephezulu. Izinqumo ezinkantolo eziphansi zingathathwa ngokucubungula. Kuyejwayelekile ukuba kube nesiphumo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezithintekayo zokusebenzisa abameli. Azikho izindleko zenkantolo ezikhokhwa ngaphambi kokuba kube nezimpawu. Qaphela: inkantolo ephansi ihluke ngoba inqubo iyahlola futhi amaqembu athintekayo awadingi ukuba amelelwe ngabameli. Amaqembu athintekayo akhetha umxhumanisi (umxhumanisi). Umxhumanisi angaba ngumuntu onolwazi olunzulu kulolo mkhakha. Amaqembu athintekayo anenkululeko yokukhetha inqubo yabo. Isidingo sokwethulwa komthetho sizoncika kulokho okhethwe. Isinqumo kumele sithathwe njengomyalo wenkantolo ukuze sisebenze kahle. Akukho sicelo esizofakwa enkantolo—kungavunyelwana ukuthi isicelo sithathwe ngababonisi abanye. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokucubungula yiNkantolo Ephakeme. Kuyejwayelekile ukuba kube nesiphumo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezithintekayo zokusebenzisa abameli. Ukukhokhwa kwabaxhumanisi kuzokwenziwa ngamaqembu athintekayo. Amaqembu athintekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Akukho ukusiza ekuxazululeni udaba oluvela kumuntu wesithathu. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngamaqembu athintekayo. Iqembu ngalinye elithintekayo lingasebenzisa abeluleki bezomthetho, kodwa lokho akudingekile. Umphumela uncike kumandla nobuchule bamaqembu athintekayo. Azikho izindleko zomthetho ngaphandle kwezindleko zomeluleki wezomthetho uma zisetshenziswe. Amaqembu athintekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Umuntu wesithathu angasiza ekuxazululeni udaba. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngumxhumanisi ophendula kumqondisi. Abeluleki bezomthetho bamaqembu athintekayo abadingeki uma le nqubo yenziwa. Umphumela ungaba yifiso yomxhumanisi kodwa abenzi izinqumo. Umphumela uvame ukuba yisimo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Amaqembu athintekayo akhokha izindleko zomxhumanisi uma zikhona. Le ndlela ibonisa ukuthi umuntu wesithathu, umxhumanisi/umuntu olethe ukuthula, udingeka ukusiza amaqembu athintekayo axazulule izinkinga zawo. Kungachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusekelayo. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi ukulethela udaba kumxhumanisi ngamaqembu athintekayo kwenziwa ngenhloso, kodwa ngokomthetho, isiko noma isivumelwano kungadinga ukuthi amaqembu athintekayo alethe udaba lwabo kumxhumanisi. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi umxhumanisi abe ngumuntu owamukelekayo kumqondisi womabili amaqembu athintekayo, umuntu ongaxhunywanga nganoma iyiphi indlela kumqondisi noma udaba. Umxhumanisi akumele athathe izinkanyezi. Umxhumanisi akwenzi izinqumo kumqondisi athintekayo. Indima yomxhumanisi ukusiza amaqembu athintekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo. Umxhumanisi kumele azame ukwenza amaqembu womabili athintekayo awine ukuze kungabi khona iqembu elishiywe lihlulelwe. Lokhu kubalulekile uma amaqembu athintekayo enobudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngoba ubuhlungu obungazwanga iqembu elihlulelwe bungaholela ekuphukeni kobudlelwano obuhle. Akukho mthetho ophatha umxhumanisi, kodwa ezinye izinhlobo zomxhumanisi ziyaqhubeka zikhishwa umthetho, njengokuthi izinkinga zabasebenzi zikhishwa nguMthetho Wokubambisana Kwezamabhizinisi, kuyilapho izinkinga phakathi kwezikhungo zikahulumeni zikhishwa nguMthetho Wamasipala Wokusebenza ka-1998. Uma kungekho umthetho othile ophatha, inqubo nokukhethwa komxhumanisi kusezandleni zamaqembu athintekayo. Isivumelwano sokuxhumana singakhethwa uma kukhona ingxabano, noma amaqembu athintekayo uma ebona ukuthi kungase kube nengxabano phakathi kwabo esikhathini esizayo, angavuma ukuthi le ngxabano kumele ixazululwe ngokufuna umxhumanisi. Isivumelwano sokudlulisela udaba kumxhumanisi asidingi ukuba sibhale, kodwa isivumelwano esibhaliwe singasiza njengoba sisiza ukuhlela inqubo yonke elandelwayo ngababonisi. Umxhumanisi unomthwalo wokugcina ubumfihlo bamaqembu athintekayo. Ngaphandle kokuthi, umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika awunikezi abaxhumanisi ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi enkantolo ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutholwe ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Uma izindaba zomphakathi ziqhutshwa, ilungelo elisebenzayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziselwa ukuxazulula izinkinga lingasetshenziswa. Amaqembu athintekayo angasebenzisa lokhu ngokuvuma ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezihlanganisiwe nenqubo yokuxhumana zingasetshenziswa. Uma kubhekwa ubumfihlo, ilungelo elinjalo alizokwenziwa uma umxhumanisi ebizwa ukuveza ubufakazi. Ngokuvamile, ngokomthetho, umxhumanisi akadingeki ukuba neziqu ezithile zemfundo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umxhumanisi aqonde izimiso ezihlobene nomxhumanisi kanye nemithetho ephatha ukuziphatha njengomthetho owaziwa ngokuthi 'audi alterem partem'.
Ibhola Lombhoxo: Umcimbi Ohloniphekayo Nobuchwepheshe Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokulinda, umcimbi omkhulu wehlukile ubuyela emhlabeni: ibhola lombhoxo. Lo mcimbi uheha imiphakathi eminingi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi abantu baphuma ezindlini zabo ukuze bajabulele le midlalwa emangalisayo. Umcimbi uhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene, uthokozisa abalandeli, abadlali, kanye nezingane, ubukhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, nokuhlangana kwabantu. Ibhola lombhoxo, elaziwa ngokuthi "rugby" ngesiNgisi, liphakamisa umoya weqhawe, ubuholi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Abadlali baveza amakhono abo, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokuphosa, ukushaya, nokuhamba, bahlula izithiyo ezinzima. Umphakathi uthokoziswa ngemizamo yabo, njengoba behlangana nezinselele ezinkulu, futhi bebonisa ukuthi imidlalo emikhulu iyakwazi ukuhlanganisa abantu. Umcimbi uqala ngenkulumo efushane ethokozisayo, lapho abashayi bejabulisa izilaleli. Kulapho kuqala umoya omusha, nokukhuthaza ukuthi wonke umuntu azithokozise emsebenzini. Umphakathi uqala ukujabulisa, kunomoya omuhle kanye nezipho eziphephuliwe. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, abadlali bahlala benezinga eliphezulu, behlola izindlela zabo zokuphosa nezokugijima. Izinkanyezi zomdlalo ziqhakaza ezinkundleni zodumo, abadlali baphumelela, besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe nobuhlakani babo ukuze bahlasele izitha zabo. Akukhona nje ngobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi nekukhuthazayo okuvela emindenini, abangani, nabalandeli, kuphakamisa umoya wokuwina, okwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Ukuphumelela komdlalo akukhathalekile kuphela kumphakathi, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni ubuhlobo. Uhlanga lwempumelelo luhlanganisa imiphakathi ehlukene, kuthi ubudlelwano obwakhiwe phakathi kwabalandeli, abaphathi, kanye nabathandi bempilo yeqembu bube yimpumelelo ezihlukahlukene. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi eziphakanyiswe ngama-‘try’ nezinhliziyo ezikhanya, kuthokozisa ubuhlobo obukhulu phakathi kwabantu bonke. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, imizwelo iyagqugquzela, ubuhlakani, kanye nesibindi. Abadlali banikezwa ukuzethemba, belethe izindaba ezizothokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Umphakathi uyaqhubeka ukujabulisa, ubuhlobo bukhula, kanti umoya wokusebenza ubonakala njengesigaba somfekethwani wezikhathi ezizayo. Umcimbi ubonisa ukuqhubeka kwamasiko, njengoba ibhola lombhoxo liqhubeka likhuluma ngempumelelo yezinhlelo eziqinile. Ukudlalwa kwale midlalwa kudala ukushaya umoya phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zabantu, bonke bejabulela imiphakathi ethokozisayo. Kumele sihloniphe le midlalwa, ukuze sibe nesithakazelo esiqinile sokubambisana. Ekupheleni komcimbi, imiphakathi ikhethe umqeqeshi ohloniphekayo, uthokozisa izindlela ezizondekayo zokwenziwa nezenzo ezenza abalandeli bahlale benelisekile. Umonakalo wokudlalwa kweqembu uyashona, umoya ophakathi komphakathi ubonisa ukuzihlanganisa ngempela. Umcimbi we-rugby uhloswe kahle ukuba umphakathi uthokozise, uhambisane nemiphakathi ehlukahlukene, futhi ube nesithakazelo sokuthi ibhola lombhoxo luhlale lungumoya ohlelekile nokuqhubeka. Ngakho, uma uhamba phakathi komcimbi wesimanje sebhola lombhoxo, okukhombisa lesi sikhumbuzo sokubambisana, umoya obonakalayo ubangela ubuhlobo obukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali, abalandeli, nabaphathi behlangana ngezinkumbulo ezithokozisayo, izinjabulo ezivela ezinkundleni, nezingqophamlando ezinquma isikhathi sabo sokuhlala behlezi, bese lokhu kube umphakathi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe. Ngalesi sikhathi, ibhola lombhoxo lihlala luhlaza amakhono, lukhumbuza abanye bonke ukuthi umphakathi omuhle uhlanganisa abantu abahlanganyela izinjongo ezifanayo, okwenza izikhathi zibe zezinhloso eziphakeme. Emva kokuphumelela, kumnandi ukuvuma ukufinyelela empumelelweni, umphakathi uqhubeka phambili. Umbono wempumelelo ubonisa kahle umoya wendawo eyaziwayo, futhi ugcwalisa umoya wezilimi ezihlekisayo ezivumelanayo. Iqhaza lokuqopha le midlali liveza ubuncane bokuhlonishwa, okwenza izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Lo mcimbi, ibhola lombhoxo, uyinkumbulo enkulu yokubambisana, ukukhulumisana, nokuhlanganyela, uthokozisa imiphakathi ngezinsuku ezinhle ezizayo, ugxile emphakathini, nasezahleni. Umhlaba ubhalwa, izinselele zibhakabhaka, futhi ibhola lombhoxo lihlala libonisa umoya obalulekile wokubambisana.
Izifundo Zokuphumelela KwezamaBhizinisi: Ukuhamba Phambili Ngobuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokwakha Ezamabhizinisi zihlala zibhekwa njengenhloso yokwakha izinkampani eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Nokho, empilweni yansuku zonke, abhizinisayo abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene bahlala bephikisana nezinselele eziningi. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo ezihamba phambili, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zokwakha zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhambela phambili. Kulezi zinsuku, ubuchwepheshe buphendule indlela esisebenza ngayo, futhi lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezamabhizinisi. Amabhizinisi amancane athola ithuba lokukhula ngokusebenzisa amaphakheji e-software avumela ukuhlela kahle, ukuthengisa, nokuxhumana namakhasimende. Ngendlela efanele, ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi ahlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Ngezizathu ezinjalo, izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa ama-plathifomu e-inthanethi ukuze zikhulise ukuthengisa kwazo. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kubekhona ukwanda kwezinkampani ezisebenzisa amakhasi e-web, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokukhangisa ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukufinyelela komkhiqizo, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa isithombe sendawo yebhizinisi. Ngakho, njengabathandi bezamabhizinisi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlale buthuthuka. Uma sithanda ukuba phambili, kumele sihlale sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana namakhasimende. Ukuze sithuthukise imikhiqizo nemisebenzi, lokho kudinga ukuba siqhubeke sifunda, sibe nokuzimisela, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezikhuthazayo. Kodwa akukhona nje ubuchwepheshe obuyisihluthulelo. Izinselelo ezihlobene nezinsizakusebenza, izindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezikhwama zezimali zidinga ukuba siqaphele. Kumele sibuye siphendule izinselelo zokuphatha ezithinta izinkampani, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zethu zisebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezilungile zokuphatha abantu, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kumayelana nokunika indawo yokusebenza ekhuthazayo, lapho abasebenzi bezwakala benesithakazelo emsebenzini wabo. Izinqubomgomo ezinhle zokusebenza zingaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, kube nezinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kubasebenzi. Ngaleso sikhathi, lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Ngemuva kokwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile, kufanele sihlole indlela yokubambisana. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, amabhizinisi kufanele axhumane nabanye ukuze athole ukufinyelela ezinsizeni nezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kungaholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha, kuhlanganyele izinsiza, futhi kulethe izinzuzo kubo bobabili. Ukubambisana kungenza kube lula ukuncintisana emakethe futhi kudale amathuba amasha. Kodwa futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ezamabhizinisi akupheli ekwakheni kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukusiza umphakathi. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezihlobene nokubaluleka kokuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo kubantu. Amabhizinisi kufanele abheke ukuthi angawathuthukisa kanjani amathuba emisebenzi, anikeze imiholo efanele, futhi abe nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimfundiso ezivela ezamabhizinisi ziqinisekisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuba siyiqonde impilo yomphakathi. Ibhizinisi elinobuhlakani alikhulisi kuphela inzuzo, kodwa futhi linikela ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuphila sabantu. Lokhu kuyindlela engcono yokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, nokwakha ikusasa eliqinile. Ekugcineni, ezamabhizinisi zinhle kakhulu uma zisebenza kahle, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ziqinisekise abasebenzi, zisebenzisana, futhi zikhathalela umphakathi. Ngamafuphi, izifundo zokuphumelela ezivela ezamabhizinisi zikhombisa ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona nje ngenkulu yokuthengisa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili ngendlela efanele, enobuntu, futhi eqondile. Lokhu kuzoholela emiphumeleni emihle, hhayi kuphela kubanikazi bamabhizinisi, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabantu abahlala emiphakathini yethu.
Kwake kwaba nomuzi omncane obizwa ngeMkhumbane, lapho abantu babephila impilo ejabulisayo, begcwele imidlalo nezinsuku ezimnandi. Kule ndawo, kwakukhona umgibeli ophumelelayo odlalela abanye iCheckers. Igama lakhe linguSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nane. U-Sipho wayeyintokozo emzaneni, enobungane, futhi wayaziwa kakhulu ngezinsuku azichitha edlalela abanye. Njalo ngempelasonto, uSipho wayehamba ehlathini eliseduze nomuzi, elandela umphakathi wabelusi nabantwana ababejabulile. Uhlanga lwemithi lwalufana nendawo yokudlala, imithi emikhulu ihlukaniswe izindawo zokudlala ezahlukene. Abantwana babedlala iCheckers, behlukanisa amaphakethe amancane abewathola ezitolo, besebenzisa izinto ezitholakala endaweni, njengamapulangwe noma amathoyizi. U-Sipho wayehamba phambili, ethokozisa abanye ngekhono lakhe lokudlala. Lokhu kwenza abanye bezwa umdlandla wokuhlangana ukuze babone umdlalo, njengoba bekhumbula ukuthi uSipho uhlala edlala ukuze enze ubungani, hhayi ukuze anqobe. Ngempela, umdlalo wawungaphezu kokuphumelela; wawukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wahlangana noThandi, intombazane ethokozisayo enothando lokudlala. UThandi wayenobuchule bokuhlola amasu amasha, okwakuholela ekwakheni umphakathi omusha, lapho bonke bahlala beyindlalifa. U-Sipho noThandi badlala imidlalo ethokozisayo, behlakanipha ngendlela evelele. Bafuna izinkanyezi eziphuma phezulu, bezama ukufaka izinhlelo ezahlukene ukuze baphumelele. Njengoba bedlala, bahlola izinkambo ezintsha, benza izinqumo ezinzima, bezama ukuqonda izindlela zokuqeda izitha zabo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uSipho uthola ukuthi ukudlala iCheckers akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda. Ubuqotho, ubuhlobo, nokubambisana kwenzeka ngenhliziyo, okwenza umdlalo ube mnandi kakhulu. Izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga. Umphakathi wabe unokukhanya okukhulu, njengoba abantwana baphokophela phambili, befunda futhi begcina ubudlelwano obubanzi. U-Sipho noThandi baqala ukuhlela umjaho omkhulu weCheckers wendawo, bahlola ukuthi abantu bayakuthokozela yini. Umjaho wawuhloswe ukuxhumanisa wonke umphakathi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obukhudlwana phakathi kwabantu. Ngesikhathi sokubamba umjaho, uSipho noThandi babebonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma ubambisana. Abantu behlangana, behlukanisa iziphuzo nezitsha, bejabulisa imindeni eminingi. U-Sipho wanikela ngeziqhamo, uThandi wanikela ngezinsuku ezimnandi ezithokozisayo. Umjaho wabe ubuyisa imizwa emihle, ukuncintisana kwaba yinto eyenzeka, kodwa umphakathi wawumkhumbula, ubudlelwano bukhula bese kudlula imidlalo. Ngemuva komjaho, uSipho noThandi bahlala phansi, behlangana nabantu abavela kwaMkhumbane. Babebonisa ubufakazi bokuthi iCheckers ingaba umphakathi owodwa. U-Sipho waphakamisa ingxenye ethakazelisayo - "Umdlalo akukhona nje ukuwina, kodwa ukuhamba ndawonye. Lokhu kudlula impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abavuma ukusiza." Izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga. U-Sipho noThandi baqhubeka bedlala, bezikhandla nezinye izizukulwane. ICheckers yabe isiyinsiza yokubambisana, yokuhlanganyela, nokuqonda ukuthi ubuhlobo bukhulu kakhulu kunokuthola amaphuzu. USipho waqala ukufaka izifundo ezithile kumfundo, asho ukuthi umdlalo ufundisa umqondo wokuhlanganyela, ukweseka, nezinto ezinhle ezidlalwayo. Njengoba uSipho noThandi bephumelela, umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula. Umdlalo wawubalulekile, kanti abantu baqala ukucabanga ngamasu amasha. U-Sipho wafunda indlela yokubambisana, nokuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma wonke umuntu enza isinyathelo. Ngakho-ke, umuzi waqhubeka nokukhanya, ubuhlobo bukhulisa izinsuku ezinhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waqonda ukuthi ubuhlakani buvela ebudlelwaneni. ICheckers yabe isikhalazo sokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho noThandi baphokophela phambili, bekhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophelele, besebenzisa umdlalo ukuze bakhe izixhumanisi ezinzima. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esiyingqayizivele sokuthi umphakathi ungakha umhlaba ophumelelayo uma wonke umuntu edlala ndawonye. Ngakho-ke, izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga, kodwa umgibeli owayethanda iCheckers wahamba phambili. U-Sipho noThandi bahlala bejabule, bephokophela phambili, bathe izinkanyezi zihamba, bezama ukuhamba ndawonye, ukuze umphakathi ube ngcono. Futhi, bahlala bejabulile emzaneni, baqhubeka bedlala, bezindla izikhathi ezinhle, bejabulisa abanye ngothando lwabo lokukhuthaza. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo seCheckers esikhulu - lapho ukudlalela, ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganyela kuhlonishwa, umphakathi ubuyisela umphakathi. ICheckers yabe isibonelo sokuthi ukuxhumana kwethu kwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.
Izikhungo ezingekho phansi kwezomnotho ziyizinkampani eziqoshwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo noma ukuthuthukisa izidingo zomphakathi futhi azihlosile ukwenza inzuzo noma ukwenza imisebenzi yokwenza inzuzo. Izikhungo eziningi ezingaphansi kukahulumeni, ezifana nezinhlangano ezizimele, izikhungo zezinsizakalo, nezikhungo zokupha noma zokwelapha, zifaka kuleli qembu. Ngokuvamile, izikhungo ezingekho phansi kwezomnotho zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukene emiphakathini, njengezinhlelo zokudla zezingane, izikhungo ezibhekelela abantwana abanogogo ngenxa ye-AIDS, izikhungo zokholo, nezinye. Nakuba zingase zibe nemali ethile futhi zibe nezimali ngemva kokuhlanza izindleko zazo zokusebenza, lezi zisetshenziselwa ukwandisa nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo. Lezi zikhungo ngokuvamile zithola uxhaso oluvela eziphandleni nasezikhungweni zezimali zangaphandle futhi ziqoshwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 seMthetho Wokwakha, 1973. Inkampani ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 inamalungu angaphansi kwezimbili futhi okungenani abaphathi ababili (kuhlanganise nomgibeli). Qedela amafomu ahlukene atholakala eMnyangweni Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Uhlu lwamafomu adingekayo ukuthi aqedwe lunikezwa ngezansi. Kungathatha izinsuku ezinhlanu ukuze processing yesicelo sakho.
UMartin Luther King Jr.: Umholi Wokulwa Nezobulungiswa UMartin Luther King Jr. ungomunye wabaholi abavelele emlandweni waseMelika, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe ekulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo. Impilo yakhe yayigcwele ukuzinikela ekufuneni ubulungiswa, ukuthula, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Wazalwa ngoJanuwari 15, 1929, eAtlanta, eGeorgia, wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo yokholo. Uthole imfundo ephakeme, waphothula izifundo eMorehouse College, eCrozer Theological Seminary, naseBoston University, lapho athola khona iPhD. UKing waba yisithonjana sokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo phakathi kweminyaka yama-1950 kuya kwama-1960. Ngonyaka we-1955, waqala ukukhombisa amandla akhe njengomholi kwezombusazwe ngesikhathi sokubhikisha eMontgomery, eAlabama, ngemva kokuthi uRosa Parks engavuma ukuhamba esikhwameni somphakathi. Le bhikisho, eyaziwa njengeMontgomery Bus Boycott, yaphumelela futhi yakhuthaza abaningi ukuba balwe nezinhlelo zobandlululo. UMartin Luther King Jr. wayenombono wokuthi ukulwa kwezenhlalakahle kufanele kube nokuthula. Wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphatheke kahle, baphendule ngokuthula, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuhlonipha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemibhikisho emikhulu, efana neMarch on Washington for Jobs and Freedom ngo-1963, lapho uKing ethula khona isikhumbuzo sakhe esidumile, "I Have a Dream." Kuleli zinga, waphakamisa umbono wokuthi wonke umuntu kufanele athole amathuba alinganayo. Umlando kaKing awukhona nje kuphela wokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo, kodwa ubonisa ubuholi obuqinile bokuhlanganyela nezinkinga ezinzima. Waba yisithonjana sokuthula emhlabeni wonke, futhi imiyalezo yakhe yathinta izizukulwane eziningi. Waphinde wathola iNobel Peace Prize ngo-1964, okuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuhlonishwa komsebenzi wakhe. Nokho, impilo kaMartin Luther King Jr. ayizange iphelele ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Ngonyaka we-1968, uKing wabulawa eMemphis, eTennessee, ngesikhathi esebenza ekulwisaneni nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kwashiya umhlaba ubuhlungu, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphinde bacabange kabusha ngempilo kaKing, nokuqonda ukuthi imizamo yakhe ayizange iphelelwe isikhathi. Umlando kaMartin Luther King Jr. usafundisa izifundo ezibalulekile namuhla. Ubonisa ukuthi ukulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo akuyona impi yokuhlukumeza, kodwa kungumzamo wokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. UKing usikhumbuza ukuthi ubulungiswa buyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokulwela amalungelo ethu, njengoba yena waba nesibindi sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Ngamafuphi, uMartin Luther King Jr. ungumholi ophawulekayo, owashiya umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Imigomo yakhe yokuthula, ubulungiswa, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu izoqhubeka iphila ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. UKing ungumfanekiso wokukhuthazela, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba balwe nezinhlelo zobandlululo, baphinde bakhe umhlaba ongcono. UMartin Luther King Jr. ungumfanekiso wezinto ezinhle, futhi umbono wakhe wokuthi "sonke singabantu" usaqhubeka nokukhanya njengophawu lokuphila okuhle.
Ukakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (Reconstruction and Development Programme) kube yinsakavukela ezweni lethu, njengoba izinsuku zikhula zihlala zihlaba umxhwele. I-RDP yenzelwe ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemadolobheni amancane. Ngicela ukwazi, ngabe ungabala izinselele ezitholakala ekwakhiweni kwezi zindlu, nokuthi lokhu kudlula kanjani umqondo wempilo yabantu? Ingxenye 2: Ukuqala Kwesikhala Sichaza Uhlanga Sizisho njalo ukuthi umqondo wokwakha izindlu ezithuthukisiwe uqala kuleli zinga eliyinkimbinkimbi, lapho kudingeka ukuthi kubhekwe izidingo zomphakathi. Yini eyenza lezi zindlu zafaneleka kubantu, ikakhulukazi lezi ezibhalwe ku-RDP? Njengoba sixoxa, kufanele sikhumbule amandla nemikhawulo yalesi sikhala. Abantu abasha nabadala bahlala benelungelo lokuphila kahle, kodwa izinselele eziningi zikhona. Ingxenye 3: Inqubo Yokwakha Uma sithinta inqubo yokwakha, sigxila ezintweni ezibalulekile ezifana nemigomo, izithiyo, nokwakheka kwalesi sikhala. Uhlelo lwe-RDP lusebenza ngendlela ethile, kuhilela ukuthi izindlu zikhishwe kusukela ekuhloleni indawo, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, nokuhlinzeka ngemali. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uma ubuhlobo phakathi kwezakhamuzi nosomabhizinisi buhle, akukwazi ukungabikho kwezinto ezixhasayo. Ingxenye 4: Ukubambisana Komphakathi Abantu basebenzisa kanjani amakhono abo ukuze basebenze ndawonye? Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi kanjani ukubambisana ukuze ibuyisele amandla kulesi sikhala. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza nezinsizakusebenza kusiza ekwakheni udumo nolwazi, okwenza ukuba kube neqhaza elikhulu. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuphi, usizo lokubambisana lungakhuphula izinga lokuphila. Ingxenye 5: Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu akupheli nje ekwakheni izakhiwo, kubalulekile futhi ukuphatha kahle izinhlelo uma zikhona. Kuze kube manje, izinkinga ezidlangile ziletha ukusindwa kumaphrojekthi. I-RDP kudinga ukubhekwa ngendlela ebanzi, kungebanga lokuthi abantu badinga izindlu ezigungeni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi kubhekelwe izinsiza ezifanele. Ingxenye 6: Izikhumbuzo Nezixazululo Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi izikhumbuzo zohlelo lwe-RDP zibaluleke kangakanani. Iziphumo ezitholakalayo zikhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezijwayelekile zikhona, kodwa futhi zikhona nezixazululo. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisa umphakathi kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke phambili. Kodwa-ke, asikwazi ukweqa izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezihambisanayo. Ingxenye 7: Izifinyezo Zokugcina Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akukhulumi nje ngokwakha izindlu, kodwa kuyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwabantu. Ukuhlanganyela kwethu kumaphrojekthi akwemukelekanga kuzodingeka. Asiphambukeli kulokhu, sibheka phambili, sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza, ukuze kube nezinto ezizokwenziwa ngeqiniso. Ingxenye 8: Ukuphetha Siyavuma ukuthi lezi zindlu ze-RDP zingasiza ukuvuselela umphakathi, kodwa kudinga ukuba nesivumelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Le ngxoxo inikwe amandla ukuhlinzeka ngedlanzela elikahle lempilo yetu. Ukubambisana, ukuziqhenya, nokwenza izinqumo ezinhle kuzo zonke izigaba kuwufanele, ukuze sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ngabe ungakhetha izindlela ezitholakalayo zokwenza ngcono i-RDP? Njengoba sisondele ekugcineni, ngabe unganikeza isithombe sesikhathi esizayo sokwakhiwa kwezindlu?
Isingeniso Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ukuthi ukufunda akukhona nje ukuthola ulwazi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umqondo, ukwazi ukuqonda izwe esiphila فيه. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga lokufunda lihlala liwumgogodla wobuchwepheshe, inhlalakahle, kanye nezinga lempilo elihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukucabangela izimbangela zokuhluleka noma zempumelelo kwabafundi, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizothuthukisa izinga lokufunda. Izici ezithinta izinga lokufunda Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lidinga ukubhekwa kumqondo obanzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici eziningi, njengokufundiswa, ukuphathwa kwezikole, kanye nezimo zomndeni. Uma sifunda, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abafundi bangabantu abahlukene, abanezimo ezihlukile, izifiso, nemikhuba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, indlela abafundi abaqondiswa ngayo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kudinga ukuba zihluke ukuze zifanele wonke umuntu. Ngokwesibonelo, izikhungo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, njengezincwadi, amakhompyutha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukufunda. Lokhu kuyabakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bazibandakanye, bahlakulele amakhono okucabanga, nokufunda ngendlela ethokozisayo. Nokho, uma lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abafundi bangasala bejwayele ukungafundi kahle. Indima yomfundisi Ngakho-ke, indima yomfundisi ibalulekile. Umfundisi onekhono akavuli nje umnyango wokufunda, kodwa futhi udala isimo esikhuthazayo. Umfundisi kufanele abe khona ukuze akhuthaze, ahlolisise, futhi abheke ukusebenza kwabafundi. Lokhu kudinga ukuphawula okusezingeni eliphezulu, ngoba abafundi bahlala bephendula kahle uma bezwa ukuthi umfundisi uyabakhathalela. Umfundisi odlala indima efanele uyavula amathuba okuphumelela, futhi uthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabafundi. Izimo zomndeni Ngaphandle kokufundiswa, izimo zomndeni nazo zinemphumela omkhulu. Abafundi abaphuma emindenini enezinkinga, njengokushoda kwemali, ukungalali kahle, noma ukungabi khona kokusekela, bavame ukuba nemiphumela emibi ekufundeni. Ubulili, ubuhlanga, kanye nezimo zokuhlala nazo zingaba nomthelela. Uma umndeni udinga ukuxhasa, kufanele kubekhona uhla lwezindlela ezihlukene zokweseka, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufeza amaphupho abo. Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi uthola ithuba elifanele lokufunda. Ubuchwepheshe bokufunda Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bube nomthelela omkhulu ekufundeni. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, izifundo ezikwi-intanethi, nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ziye zathuthukisa indlela abafundi abafunda ngayo. Lokhu kudale ukuthi ukufunda kube lula, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle. Kodwa-ke, kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona njengokuphela kwendlela yokufunda. Kubalulekile ukubhekisisa ukuthi kungani abafundi behluleka ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kuthiwani uma umphakathi ungakabi nesiqiniseko sokuthi ukuthola ubuchwepheshe kuyatholakala kubo bonke. Ukubambisana komphakathi Uhlanga olukhulu lokuthuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lutholakala ekubambisaneni phakathi kwemiphakathi. Uma imiphakathi ibambisana nezikole, kudala izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthiwe kulula ukuvuselela izinga lokufunda. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ziwusizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu, sihlinzeke ngezinsiza, futhi siphendule ezidingweni zabafundi. Isiphetho Njengoba sithanda ukufunda, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi izinga lokufunda kwabafundi alikona nje ukushaya amaphuzu ezivivinyweni, kodwa kuyindlela yempilo. Kuhle ukuqonda ukuthi abafundi bahluka, banelungelo lokufunda ngendlela ehlukile. Umphakathi, izikole, nabafundisi badinga ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze kube nempumelelo. Ngakho, kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokufunda, siqinisekise ukuthi sonke sithola ithuba elifanele lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokuqhamuka nezinqumo ezithembekile. Lokhu akusizi nje abafundi, kodwa kuthuthukisa umphakathi wonke.
Izimpande Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Kwathi emzaneni omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwaba nesimo esihle. Le ndawo yayisemaphandleni, izindawo ezinhle nezithokozisayo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwalukhanya phezulu, luthokozisa abahlali. Nokho, uMkhumbane wawubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokuntuleka kwemithombo yokuphila, izikole eziphumelelayo, nezinsiza zempilo. Abantu bezama ukuziphilisa, kodwa impilo yaba nzima. Ngakho, emini ethile, umphakathi wahlangana ukuze wenze isinqumo. Bahlangana emzaneni, behlanganyela izinkumbulo, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu njengophawu lokubambisana. UMama Nandi, omama bendawo, waphakamisa ukuthi, “Sidinga ukuvuselela uMkhumbane, sithuthukise izindawo zethu. Asihlanganyeleni!” Abantu bavuma, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhanya. Ngaleso sikhathi, uBaba Thulani, owayaziwa ngolwazi lwakhe, wathatha isinyathelo. “Masithathe izinyathelo ezincane,” kusho yena, “sifune izinsiza, sikhuthaze abasebenzi bendawo, sithuthukise imfundo.” Umkhankaso omusha wezokuthuthukiswa waqala, abantu baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo, bejolise ekubambisaneni, befuna izinsiza ezivela kuhulumeni, ezizimele, noma kumaphrojekthi. Umnumzana Jabu, owayedlala indima enkulu ekugqugquzeleni abantu, wathi, “Sizokwakha izikhungo zemfundo. Sizokwakha iziteshi zamanzi, ukuze wonke umuntu athole amanzi ahlanzekile. Sizobambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ukudla, sikhuthaze ukuzimela.” Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baqala ukukholelwa emandleni abo, bazi ukuthi bangazuza uma behlanganyela. Izinhlelo zathuthuka, izikhungo zemfundo zakhuliswa, futhi izingane zakhuluma ngokuthokozisa ngemfundo abayitholayo. U-Phumzile, uthisha, wathola ukuba neqhaza elikhulu. “Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ngalezi zinsuku,” esho. “Abafundi bethu bahlala bejabulile, bazi ukuthi balindelele ikusasa elihle.” Ngemva kwesikhathi, uMkhumbane wahamba phambili, izinhlelo zathuthuka, abantu bahlala bezithokozisa. Iziteshi zamanzi zenzeka, zikhanyisa izimpilo zabantu. Abantwana babedla umhlaba, begijima bezijabulisa. Izinsiza zempilo zazitholakala kalula, abantu banikezwa ithuba lokuba neqhaza, bahlala bejabulile. Nokho, ukuphila akuhambanga kahle njalo. Kwakukhona izinselelo, nezinkinga ezazivela. Uhlelo olusha lwakha izinxenye eziningi, kodwa abanye abantu babengathandi. “Kungani kufanele sishintshe?” abanye babuza. “Uhlanga lwasekuqaleni lungakha izinkinga.” Kodwa uMama Nandi waphendula ngothando, “Ukukhula kudinga ushintsho. Sihamba phambili, asibuyele emuva.” Umoya wokubambisana waba yikhono elikhulu. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izinselelo zikhona, kodwa zikhona nezixazululo. Baphakamisa amaphuzu, bahlanganyela, benza imihlangano, bekhuluma ngempumelelo. Umoya wabo wawufana nemvula ebusika, ulethela uMkhumbane isivuno esikahle. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, imikhuba yendawo yathuthukiswa. Izikhungo zempilo zikhula, imfundo yayigqugquzela. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa lwaluphumelele, lwandisa impilo yezakhamuzi. Izinsuku zanyamalala, kodwa ukwakha umphakathi ongcono kwaba yinkumbulo engapheli. UMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bahlala bejolise empumelelweni, bangashintsha noma iyiphi indawo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwalukhanya phezulu, lukhuluma ngezindaba zempilo, uthando, nokubambisana. Umoya wokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya wawukhanya, futhi abahlali baqhubeka nokuthokozisa, bejabulile ngempilo yabo entsha. Ngalolu hambo, uMkhumbane waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma bephikelela, bahlala bejolise, bangathola impumelelo. Iminyaka yathuthuka, kodwa indaba yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya yaqhubeka, isingatha izimpande zesikhathi eside. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhanya, umphakathi unqoba, uthokozisa impilo.
I-Fund ye-Competitiveness (CF) iyigxathu yokwabelana ngezindleko ehlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali ukuze kusekelwe osomabhizinisi abasungula amabhizinisi ukufinyelela ku-50% wezindleko zabo. Osomabhizinisi abafanelekile kumele bakhiqize imikhiqizo noma banikeze izinsizakalo kumabhizinisi anezici ezithile noma iziqu. Ukukhuthaza ngokwezimali amabhizinisi ukuba athuthukise amazinga awo okusebenza, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwazi zangaphandle nezifundo. Ukuthuthukisa izinkampani (ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphatha noma lokuphathwa, ukuthola amazinga ajwayelekile), ukuqeqesha ukuze kwakhiwe amazinga okuncintisana. Ukwandisa izinsizakalo ze-NGOs, izinhlangano zamabhizinisi, nezimboni ezizama ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zezigaba/izimboni ezithile. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-grant ukuze kufinyelelwe ezingeni eliphezulu le-R600,000 emkhakheni nasemkhakheni ofanele. Ukusiza izimboni ukuthi zifeze amazinga aphezulu okuncintisana emakethe zangaphandle emkhakheni wemakethe yasekhaya nasemakethe yokuthumela ngaphandle.

Lapho ubunikazi bezimpahla bushintshwe kuhulumeni, abakwazi ukuthengiswa, kushintshwe, noma kuthengiswe nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphambi kokuvunywa okubhalwe phansi nguNgqongqoshe Wezolimo noma ummeleli wakhe/noma, futhi noma yikuphi ukulahleka okuhlobene nalokhu, ukujola noma ukufa kwezinkomo noma nganoma iyiphi indlela kufanele kubikwe ngokushesha kwiMiphakathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezibopho Nokukhokha kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nokujola kufanele kubikwe ngokushesha kwiSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwasemphakathini saseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma kwenzeka ukulahleka noma ukungatholakali, imali ebolekiwe kufanele ibuyiswe noma ibekwe esikhundleni salokhu kulahleka noma ukungatholakali ngeminye impahla engakhokhelwa enenani elifanayo, isimo, nobudala noma ngenye indlela, uzodingeka ukukhokhela uHulumeni ngemali ukulahleka noma ukungatholakali. Noma ubani, ngaphandle kwemvume, ophatha, noma obulala noma osebenzisa noma iyiphi impahla kaHulumeni uzobhekana nezibopho futhi angaboshwa. Uma kudingeka, ubufakazi kufanele buhlinzekwe njengomfanekiso wombiko wokujola kwiSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwasemphakathini saseNingizimu Afrika futhi incwadi yobufakazi (i-affidavit) kufanele ixhunywe kulombiko. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olukhona kulolu documet, ngokwazi kwami nangokukholwa, lugcwele, lweqiniso, nolunembile. Ngiyavuma ukuthi umphakathi uqinisekisile ukuthi uvuma futhi uqonda okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo. Kuqinisekiswe futhi kusayinwe phambi kwami kulolu suku lwe...
A.1 Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kahle nokusebenza kwezinhlinzeko kanye nemigomo yeMthethosisekelo mayelana nokusebenza kukahulumeni, bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi bahloniphe futhi balandele le Khodi Yokuziphatha. A.2 Le Khodi izoba umhlahlandlela kubasebenzi mayelana nezilindelo zokuziphatha kwabo ngokwethembeka kanye nezixhumanisi abanezona nabanye abasebenzi. Ukuhlonipha le Khodi kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise izinga lobuchwepheshe endaweni yokusebenza futhi kusize ekuqinisekiseni ukwethembana nokuqhakambisa uMnyango Wezokuthutha. A.3 Umsebenzi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuzilawula nokulandela imithetho ebekwe le Khodi. Ngokufanayo, abaphathi nabaphathiswa banomsebenzi wokwenza ukuthi le Khodi ilandelwe, futhi lokhu kufanele kwenzeke ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. A.4 Le Khodi Yokuziphatha ayihlosile ukuvimba intuthuko yomsebenzi kodwa ukuvikela amalungelo kaMnyango kanye nomsebenzi. B.1 Le Khodi iyengezo kuKhodi Yokuziphatha ebhekiswe esigabeni 2 seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, ehlanganisa bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kuhlanganiswa ukuthi ibhekisela ngqo ezidingweni zikaMnyango Wezokuthutha. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kweKhodi Yokuziphatha YamaHhovisi Kahulumeni, njengale etholakala kuMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, neKhodi Yokuziphatha kaMnyango, le yokugcina izolandela. B.2 Kunomneed wokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nezixhumanisi zabo nomthetho, kanye nabaphethe amandla ezepolitiki nabaphathiswa, abanye abasebenzi, kanye nomphakathi, futhi kufanele bafundiswe nomoya okumele abasebenzi basebenze ngawo, nokuthi yini okufanele bayenze ukuze bagweme ukungqubuzana nezithakazelo, nokuthi yini elindelekile kubo mayelana neziziphatha zomphakathi nasempilweni yabo yangasese nasekusebenzeni. B.3 Nakuba le Khodi Yokuziphatha ibhalwe ukuhlanganisa konke, ayiyona iqoqo eliphelele lemigomo elawula izinga lokuziphatha. Nokho, uMphathi-Jikelele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 (b) seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-1994, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle koMnyango kanye nokugcina umthetho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ukuthi ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakhe kuhambisane nokwethembeka nezimiso ezilawula amahhovisi kahulumeni kanye nemigomo efanele kanye nezinqubo njengoba kushiwo kulo Mthetho. B.4 Inhloso enkulu yale Khodi ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzi angatholakala enecala lokuziphatha okungafanele futhi abhekane nenqubo yokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokudinga uma izenzo zabo zingahambisani neKhodi Yokuziphatha noma uma kutholakala ukuthi baphule ezinye zezidingo zale Khodi. C.1.7 akuphuli noma iyiphi ingxenye yeKhodi Yokuziphatha ebekwe kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. C.2.11 ingaxhumana namalungu omphakathi nganoma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni uma nje kukhethwe umphakathi. C.2.14 akumele ibeke impilo yabanye noma eyayo engcupheni ngokungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha noma ngokuyigwema. C3.17 akumele ithathe ingxenye emibuthanweni ephikisana nezinga lokusebenza futhi engemthethweni. C.4.6 ingacela ukuthi ingathathi ingxenye ezinqumweni noma ezinyathelweni emsebenzini ezisemthethweni uma lokhu kungaholela ekutholeni inzuzo engafanele ngendlela engalungile, engakhethi, futhi ebandlululayo. C 4.16 ezimeni eziphuthumayo ingacelwa nguMphathi woMnyango ukuba enze imisebenzi ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi, noma uma kungesikhathi esijwayelekile sokusebenza kodwa kuyisimo esingaphansi kokulawulwa koMphathi woMnyango futhi sinesidingo esidinga isinyathelo esisheshayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni. C.4.31 akumele iphule umthetho ezindaweni zomphakathi. C.5.3 akumele isebenzise isikhundla sayo emsebenzini ukuze ithole imiklomelo nokukhwabanisa umphakathi nezinye izinzuzo futhi ayikwazi ukwamukela noma yini uma kubonakala sengathi iyikhwabaniso. Yonke imiklomelo kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi ifakwe kwi-rejista yemiklomelo. C.6.1 ngezizathu zokuxhumana ngaphakathi, kufanele usebenzise isiNgisi njengolimi lokuxhumana futhi lokhu kufanele kube sobala kuzo zonke izenzo zomsebenzi zangaphakathi (okungukuthi, imibhalo, imihlangano, njll.). C 6.5 kufanele ihambisane nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ngekhompyutha njengoba kushiwo. C.7.11 kufanele ikhuthaze isiko lokwethembana ngokwazisa njalo nokuqinisa. D.1. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi kahle uMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, Isahluko II, Umthetho 108 ka-1994, mayelana nemigomo nezinqubo zokuthatha izinyathelo zokudinga emahhovisi kahulumeni. Umkhakha Wokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi uzosiza abaphathi nabasebenzi ngezinhlelo zokwazisa kanye nezinto ezisakazwa kubasebenzi. E.1 Abaphathi kufanele bahlale bezama ukuvimbela ukuvela kokunganeliseki nezikhalazo mayelana nokuphathwa nezinqubo zokuhola ezilungile. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhona inkinga edinga ukuxazululwa. Iph platform yokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi izodlala indima ekusekeleni ngokwazisa abaphathi nabasebenzi ngamalungelo nezibopho zabo. F.1 Zonke imibhalo ehlobene nezinyathelo zokudinga kufanele ibekwe endaweni ephethe ukuphathwa kwabantu, ezokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwazo ngokuphepha. F.2 Iph platform yokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi izobheka ukugcinwa kwemibiko yezibalo kanye nokubhaliswa kwemibiko ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni. F.3 UMnyango, abasebenzi bawo, kanye nezinyunyana kufanele bazibophezele ekugcineni nasekukhulumeni okuqukethwe kule Khodi Yokuziphatha.
