Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan Ingxoxo noMnumzane Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Wezomnotho Umxoxi: Mnumzane Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukungihlangabeza namuhla. Singaqala ngenkulumo engajulile mayelana nohlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan? Yini leli phrojekthi elikhulu? Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngale ndaba. Uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan luhloselwe ukusiza umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi uvuselelwe ngemva kwemiphumela emibi ye-COVID-19. Lolu hlelo luthinta zonke izigaba zomnotho, ikakhulukazi ezokwakha, ezemfundo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izigaba ezahlukene zomnotho kufanele zisebenze ndawonye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kunamathuba, yini izinselelo ezibhekene nalolu hlelo? Mthembu: Impela, izinselelo ziningi. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngezinsiza. Uhlelo lufuna izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa kunobunzima ekutholeni lezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ziningi izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi kudinga ukuhlela kahle kwazo ukuze zifinyelele empumelelweni. Umxoxi: Yiqiniso, futhi umphakathi uthanda ukubona ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhuluma kanjani nezinye izinqubomgomo. Ingabe uhlelo luhlelekile kahle ukuze luhambisane nezinqubomgomo ezikhona? Mthembu: Yebo, uhlelo lwenziwe ngokucophelela ukuze luhambisane nezinye izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, zikazwelonke, kanye nezomhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezihlangene ukuze sithole impumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokufunda, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, kanye nokuphucula imisebenzi. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlobene kakhulu nezidingo zomphakathi. Ingabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abampofu bayathola usizo? Mthembu: Ngempela, umphakathi ophila ngaphansi kwemithwalo yokuqashwa kancane udinga ukunakwa okukhethekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa amaphrojekthi akhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kumasifundisane. Kulolu hlelo, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo efanele iyatholakala kubantu abampofu, kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokufundisa amakhono. Umxoxi: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu. Ngabe uhlelo luhlelwe kanjani ukuze luqinisekise ukuthi lusebenza kahle, futhi lubuyekezwa njalo? Mthembu: Uhlelo luzobuyekezwa njalo, futhi kukhona izigaba ezithile zokuhlola. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinkomba ezicacile zokusebenza ukuze sithole ukuthi imiphumela iyafinyelelwa yini. Izinhlaka ezahlukene zizosiza ekubuyekezweni nasekusebenzeni kahle komqondo. Umxoxi: Lolu hlelo lungaba namathuba amakhulu emiphakathini. Kukhona yini izinhlelo ezithile eziqondene nezokwakha? Mthembu: Yebo, izinhlelo zokwakha zibalulekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, izikole, nezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukufunda, nokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okuyizinto eziyisisekelo kubantu. Umxoxi: Ngabe zikhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana nomphakathi ukuze abantu bazi ngemiphumela yalo hlelo? Mthembu: Impela, sizobe sikhuluma nomphakathi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi bazi ngalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzofaka izifundo, imihlangano, nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza kanjani, futhi bazise ngempumelelo ezitholakala. Umxoxi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubumbano luyisihluthulelo. Ngabe ukhona umbono owodwa ofuna ukusho kubafundi? Mthembu: Yebo, ngifuna ukuveza ukuthi ukuvuselela umnotho akukhona nje umsebenzi wombuso kuphela; udinga ubambiswano phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Sidinga ukufaka izandla zethu ndawonye ukuze uthole impumelelo. Uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan lungaba yimpumelelo uma sisenza ngokubambisana. Umxoxi: Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane Mthembu, ngempela le ngxoxo ibe yinsiza enkulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela nathi! Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan luhloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho, kugqugquzela imisebenzi, futhi kukhethiwe ukuthi kubhekwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi uhlelo lube yimpumelelo, futhi umphakathi uzothola izinzuzo ezinkulu.
Umlando WaseNingizimu Afrika: Iphrofayela Yomlando Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumlando ocebile, ogcwele izigigaba eziningi ezithinta abantu, izizwe, namasiko ahlukahlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezahlukene zomlando, kusukela ezikhathini zokuqala zempucuko, kuze kube yizinsuku zethu zanamuhla. Izinsuku Zokuqala: Izizwe Nezimpucuko Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho izizwe ezahlukene zihlala kuleli. Izizwe ezifana namaKhoisan, amaNguni, namaSotho zaziwa ngokuphila kwazo okwakuhambisana nemvelo, zisebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala endaweni. AmaKhoisan, ngokukhethekile, ayaziwa ngamasiko awo ahlukile, okuhlanganisa nezinkanyezi, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo. Ukufika Kwamanye Amazwe: Abantu Abavela Kude Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izigigaba zashintsha kakhulu. Ngonyaka we-1652, uJan van Riebeeck, umphakathi wamaDashi, wafika eKapa, kwathi lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuhlangana phakathi kwabantu bendawo nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezindawo zokuhlala ezazihlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene, kodwa futhi kwadala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwamasiko ahlukene. Ukufika kwabantu abavela eYurophu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini yaseNingizimu Afrika. UbuSuthu Nezinguquko Zamasiko Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokuqala zashintsha zaba yizinkinga ezinzima. UbuSuthu, obuhlanganisa izizwe eziningi, bahlaselwa yizinhlekelele ezivela ngaphandle. Ubugebengu, ukungabi nabulungiswa, nezinhlekelele zempilo zaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu abantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibono emisha, lapho abantu beqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila ezihlukile, ezazihambisana nezidingo zabo. UbuMthetho Nezinguquko Zombusazwe Ngonyaka we-1910, uNingizimu Afrika waba yizwe elizimele, kodwa lokhu akuzange kube yisixazululo. Uhlelo lwe-apartheid lwavela, lwaholela ekwahlukanisweni kwabantu ngokobuhlanga. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, lapho abantu abamnyama babekhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, bezama ukufuna amalungelo. UNelson Mandela, umholi ophakeme, waba yisibonelo sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Uhlelo lwe-apartheid lwagcina luphukile ngonyaka we-1994, lapho uMandela ewina ukhetho lokuqala olukhululekile. Ukwakha Isizwe Esisha: Izinsuku Zamanje Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-apartheid, uNingizimu Afrika waba yizwe elisha, elizama ukwakha ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona. Ukungabi nabulungiswa, ubuphofu, nezinkinga zomnotho zihlala zikhona. Kodwa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlala bephokophele ekwakheni ikusasa el better, elihlanganisa wonke umuntu. Isiphetho: Umoya Wokubumbana Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumlando ogcwele izifundo. Ubonisa ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa amandla abo ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umoya wokubumbana, uthando, nokuhlonipha izimpilo zabanye, kuyisisekelo sokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukufunda emlandweni, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbule izifundo ezitholakele, futhi sakhe umphakathi onobumbano. Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika uyisifundo esibalulekile, esifundisa ukuthi ubumbano, uthando, nokuhlonipha izimpilo zabanye kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile esizokwenza sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nezinselelo ezikhona, sikhulise umphakathi wethu, futhi sithuthukise izimpilo zethu.
Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ngokomthetho kuyisibopho somthetho esidinga bonke abashicileli (nabakhiqizi) eNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izinhlobo zemibhalo, kuhlanganise naleyo eshicilelwe ngokuqondile, ukuthi bathumele inani elithile lemikhono yalokho abakushicilelile ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ezibekwe ukuze kugcinwe ngokuphepha. Kuyisiko emhlabeni jikelele ukuthi uhulumeni badinge abakhiqizi bezinhlobo zonke zemibhalo, kuhlanganise namavidiyo nezinsiza ezirekhodiwe, ukuthi bahlinzeke ngenani elithile lemikhiqizo yabo kulezi zindawo ezisemthethweni ezibekwe. Okwamanje, amazwe emhlabeni jikelele ayabuyekeza futhi aguqule imithetho yawo ephathelene nokuthunyelwa kwemibhalo ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze kuhambisane nokwanda kwemibhalo eshicilelwe ngokuqondile efana namavidiyo, ama-CD, nama-DVD. Inhloso yokugcinwa kolwazi endaweni esemthethweni ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokuhlinzeka abasebenzisi balo msebenzi, kokubili ngesikhathi samanje nakusasa, ngolwazi nemibhalo equkethe imisebenzi nesiko elibalulekile kulomphakathi. Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kwaqala ngo-1842 ngokwethulwa kokuqala kweMithetho ye-Copyright yaseBrithani, evikela ilungelo lombhali lokuba ngumthombo wemibhalo kuyo yonke iMpumalanga yaseBrithani. Kwakukhona futhi izichibiyelo emthethweni phakathi kweMithetho ye-Copyright ka-1965 kanye neMithetho ye-Legal Deposit of Published Documents ka-1982. Okwamanje, iMithetho ye-Legal Deposit of Documents (Umthetho 54 ka-1997) yamenyezelwa ngoJulayi 1, 1998. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwemibhalo, izincwadi, neminye imithombo equkethe ulwazi olufana namafilimu, amavidiyo, ama-CD omculo, nama-DVD, wonke ashicilelwe noma akhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo esibanzi somthetho mayelana nenani lemikhono okumele igcinwe, isimo sokufika kwayo, ulwazi oludingekayo kubashicileli nabakhiqizi, isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwemikhono, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo uma abashicileli nabakhiqizi behluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho. Imibhalo iyinto ethile ehlelelwe ukugcinwa noma ukudluliswa njengolwazi olubhalwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi luyimibhalo, izithombe, noma irekhodi elenzelwe ukulalelwa, futhi kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi eqondakalayo nangemithombo ethile. Lokhu kubhekisela kwimibhalo eyakhiwe ukuze isetshenziswe emphakathini, ehlelelwe ukukhiqizwa nokusabalalisa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, egcina noma idlulisa ulwazi olubhalwe, ulwazi lwezithombe, ulwazi olurekhodiwe lokulalela, olufundwa ngama-mishini, noma lwethulwa kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi ehlolwe noma esanda kushicilelwa ehlukile kakhulu kulokho okwakukhona ngaphambili ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi luhlukile noma indlela nesimo sokuthi luthunyelwe kulolu shicilelo eNingizimu Afrika noma ehlelelwe ukusetyenziswa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcinwa kwemfihlo ebhalwe phansi kanye nemvelaphi ye-rekhodi kusiza ukufinyelela kwabantu emisebenzini yonke eshicilelwe eyakhiqizwa ezweni labo. Ngakho-ke, ukugcinwa kolwazi ngokomthetho kuyisici esisodwa semigqa yokukhululeka kolwazi. Kusiza izwe lethu ukuba ligcine izibopho zayo ezimbili zokwethembeka kubantu bonke, kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wombhali awulahleki futhi uyatholakala ukuze uphenywe esikhathini esizayo, kuvumela indawo yokugcina ukuba ikhulise ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu bonke balo msebenzi mayelana nalokho okukhishwe nokushicilelwe njengesisekelo sokwakhiwa kwemibhalo kazwelonke nezinye iziqoqo zolwazi ezazisa abasebenzisi-bokugcina nalabo abazozisebenzisa ezwenikazi nasemhlabeni jikelele ngezincwadi ezikhona neminye imibhalo, ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukusabalala kwayo nokuthengwa, kuba isisekelo sokuhlanganiswa kwezibalo ezikhiqizwa yi-UNESCO emhlabeni jikelele, okuyinsiza ewusizo yolwazi emsebenzini wezincwadi nezohwebo. Lokhu kungase kube nenzuzo nakwezinye izindlela.

UDokotela Kobus Laubscher uqokwe njengomphakathi omusha weGrain SA oqala ngoJanuwari 1, 2008. Okwamanje, uDokotela Laubscher usebenza eNyuvesi yaseFree State. Unolwazi lwezinkambu ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho wezolimo, futhi unolwazi olunzulu oluhambelana nezindawo zasemakhaya, izifundazwe, kanye nezwe ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zebhizinisi lezolimo; ungumhloli futhi uphinde afundise. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, uphinde usebenze namabhizinisi ezolimo eNamibia naseBotswana. UDokotela Laubscher ungum member we-International Food and Agriculture Management Association (IAMA). Unolwazi lokuphatha amabhizinisi omnotho. Muva nje, uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ukuphatha iNational Productivity Institute (NPI) yaseNingizimu Afrika, lapho engumsekeli wezolimo. Phambilini, ubeyilungu lebhodi yeNyuvesi yaseFree State njengommeleli okhethwe ngabaxhasi bokusiza. UDokotela Laubscher ushade noAnnemarie, futhi banamadodana amabili nendodana eyodwa.
Ubumfihlo Bolwazi Lwabancikile (GEMS Dependent Information Confidentiality) eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi nolwazi lwabancikile kudlala indima enkulu empilweni yomuntu. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwabancikile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathola izinzuzo zokwelapha kanye nezimali, kubalulekile ukuze kudalwe isisekelo sokwethembeka nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile, njengoba izimo zokuphila zidinga ukwenziwa ngokucophelela. Abancikile, nabanye abavela ezigabeni ezifana nababhalisile, bathola ithuba lokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zeGEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme), kodwa lokhu kudinga ukugcina ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuvikela le mininingwane kubalulekile ekwakheni umuzwa wokuqinisekiswa nokuphepha kumuntu. Umcimbi wethu uhlose ukuxoxa ngemicabango nezinqubomgomo ezithinta ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izindlela zokuvikela idatha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo igcinwa iyimfihlo, nokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo aluphumi ngaphandle kokuhlola. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zifundise abathola izinsizakalo mayelana nezici zobalo nokubaluleka kokuba nemininingwane efanele yokuphila kwabo. Umthetho kanye nezinqubomgomo zenkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi ubumnyama bemininingwane busebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa osomabhizinisi, othisha, nabaphathi bezempilo. Ukuze siphumelele kulokhu, kudingeka uhlelo oluqinile lokufundisa abanicikile nabakhiqiza ulwazi. Ukuqonda izikhathi ezinzima kudinga ukuphendulwa ngobuchule, futhi imfundo ngosizo lweGEMS izoba nomthelela omkhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abancikile ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo zezinsizakalo, ukubhalisa kahle, nokuzicabangela ngokucophelela empilweni yabo. Izinselelo zokuthi ubani ofanele ukufinyelela kulwazi nokuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo, kudinga ukuqashelwa. Izinhlangano kufanele zihlale zibheke izinqubo zokuphakela, uqobo lwabazali, nokuqonda phakathi kwabafuna imisebenzi. Kubalulekile ukugxila ezimweni zamanje ezinzima, njengoba sinesimo esinzima esihlobene nezempilo nezokwelapha. Ukuze abantu balwe nezehlakalo eziphuthumayo, izinhlelo zokubhalisela izinzuzo zempilo, okubalwa kuzo neGEMS, zidinga ukuhlonishwa, okuhlanganisa nokuqinisekisa ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuphepha kwezimali nabanganikazi bezempilo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa ukuze kuzuze impumelelo. Uma ubumnyama bolwazi lungalandelwa kahle, imiphumela engalindelekile ingase ibekhona, okudinga ukuqapha ngokucophelela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iphephile, izinkampani zidinga ukuvuma ukufundisa abancikile ngokuqondile mayelana nokuphatha ubumfihlo, ukuze babe nemithetho yokuvikela. Ukuze baphumelele, izixazululo eziningi zidinga ukufakwa, nezindlela zokuxhamazela zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhanya. Ubumfihlo bolwazi abuqhamuki kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuqhubeka, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekelwa izinguquko zesimanjemanje. Ekugcineni, uma singazisa abancikile ngezidingo zokuqonda ubumnyama bolwazi lwabancikile, sizosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Ukuphathwa kahle kolwazi lwabancikile kuyisici esiyinhloko sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umcwaningi kufanele aqhubeke ukuhlaziya imithetho, ahlaziye izinguquko, futhi abheke phambili ekwakheni isikhala esihlonishwayo senhlangano, okuhlanganisa ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Inhloso yethu iwukwakha umphumela osiza abantu bonke, kusetshenziswa ubumfihlo ukuze kutholakale ushintsho nokuphila okungcono.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Ngokwezimo zomnotho emhlabeni, iCOVID-19 ibangele ukuhamba phambili kokungasebenzi, ukwanda kwezindleko zokuphila, kanye nezimo ezinzima kubantu abaningi. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zibhekwane, uhulumeni wakwaZulu-Natali kanye nohulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika, baphakamise isibonelelo seSocial Relief Grant. Lo mbhalo uzobheka indlela lesi sikhwama esisetshenziswa ngayo, imiphumela yaso, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezindleko zokuphila. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda umgomo waleli sikhwama. Isibonelelo seSocial Relief Grant siphakanyiswa ukusiza abantu abathintekayo ngqo yiCOVID-19, kanye nezindawo zempilo zomphakathi. Lezi zibonelelo zafaneleka kumaphesheya aphansi, kubantu abahola kancane, kanye nabathintekile kakhulu ezimeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kube nomphumela omuhle, njengoba kuvele kwanda abantu abahola kahle. Naphezu kokuba isibonelelo sikhona, abanye abantu basenobunzima ekukufinyeleleni. Lokhu kubonisa izinkinga ezivela ekutholeni lesi sikhwama. Imingcele Yokufinyeleleka: Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukuthola lesi sikhwama, umphakathi kufanele uhambisane nemigomo ethile, efaka phakathi izidingo zokubhaliswa, ezivame ukuba nzima kubantu abangenazo izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu kuveza inkinga yokuthi abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela lesi sikhwama ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi noma izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwesibonelelo kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi amafomu ahlanzekile, ukuhamba kwezimali kuhamba kahle, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyaziswa kahle. Ubululelwe bokuphatha buvame ukuba yinkinga, lapho imiphakathi ethile ibonwa ingatholi kahle ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuwa kokuthola imiphumela engafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi nesabelo sesikhwama seSocial Relief Grant kuveza umbuzo, "Ngabe sikhona isidingo sokuphinde sihlolisise le mibandela?" Le ngxoxo ibalulekile ngoba umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uhlinzeka ngensizakalo ehambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke kabusha imigomo yokufaneleka, futhi abheke izindlela zokuphathwa okungcono ukuze avumele abantu abaningi ukufinyelela kulezi zibonelelo. Nokho, kufanele sazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoba nezindleko ezihambisana nakho. Umphakathi uzodinga ukufaka imali eningi kuzo zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenzisa. Nakuba ithonsi leSocial Relief Grant likhona, alikwazi ukwenziwa kabusha. Lesi sikhwama siphumelelayo emphakathini, njengoba singasebenza njengensizakalo esheshayo yokuhlinzeka ngosizo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokugxila ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizosiza lesi sikhwama, njengoba sizokwenza izinqumo ezibeka izidingo zabantu phambili. Futhi, ukugxila kwethu emiphumeleni yeSocial Relief Grant kubalulekile. Ubuwena bubalulekile, njengoba kuvele kudinga ukukhumbula ukuthi iGrant ithuthukisa izimo zabantu abathintekayo ngqo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile ezinhlelweni zomnotho. Abantu abathintekayo bakhombisa ukuhlela kabusha izimpilo zabo, ukuphuma ekuthatheni kwezindlela ezimbi, futhi balwela ukuthuthukisa izikhala zabo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo seCOVID-19 Social Relief Grant kutshengisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezinqubomgomo zikahulumeni. Nanoma izinkinga ziyavela ekufinyeleleni, uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kumavolontiya, umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezisekelayo. Ukuze iGrant ibe nomthelela omuhle, kudingeka sishintshe izindlela zethu zokuphatha, sihlolisise izidingo zabantu, futhi sithuthukise imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokudlulisela imiyalezo ebalulekile emphakathini, okwenza isibonelelo sijabulise izimpilo zezakhamuzi. Ngakho-ke, ukuba siqhathanise nemiphumela yasendaweni nezinzuzo ezinkulu zomnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe izidingo zabantu. Njengempela, kuphela lapho umuntu efunda ukuhamba komnotho kahle, sizokwazi ukuphumelela ekuphileni kwethu. Ukuba nohlelo oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi kubalulekile uma sifuna ukuqinisa imiphakathi yethu futhi sisize ukubuyisela umphakathi ngokuphelele ngemuva kweCovid-19.
Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Indaba Yomlando Imidlalo yeshashalazi, noma i-theatre, ingenye yezindlela ezidumile zokudlulisa izindaba, imizwa, nezifundo emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle imvelaphi yalesi siko, kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi iqale kanjani, yakhula kanjani, futhi yaba yinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imidlalo yeshashalazi inezimpande ezijulile emlandweni, ikakhulukazi eGreece lasendulo. Ngonyaka ka-534 BCE, uThespis, umqambi wezinkanyezi, waba ngumuntu wokuqala ophakamisa umqondo wokudlala, lapho abelaphi bezinkanyezi bahlala phansi besebenzisa izinkulumo ezibhalwe phansi, benza izigcawu ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokudalwa kwemidlalo yeshashalazi, okwakuhlanganisa izinkanyezi, ababhali, nababukeli. Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yayihlanganisa izinkulumo ezinzulu ezikhuluma ngezinto ezifana nobuhlungu, uthando, nezimfihlo zempilo. Ngemuva kwalokho, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka yaba yinsiza ebalulekile yokuxhumana. E-Greece, imidlalo yayidayiswa ezindaweni ezinkulu, ezaziwa ngama-theatre, lapho ababhali abanjengoSophocles, Euripides, noAristophanes bezama ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zomphakathi, imithetho, nobuhlakani. Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yayihlanganisa izigcawu ezinjengokuhlola izimo zomphakathi, izinkinga zempilo, nezifundo ezithile ezazithinta abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yafika eRoma, lapho izinkanyezi zashintsha izindlela zokudlala. E-Roma, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola umoya omusha, yahluka ngokwengeziwe, futhi yathokozisa izithameli ngezinto ezihambisana nezokuzijabulisa. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu, futhi izinkanyezi zafaka phakathi izigigaba ezinjengokulwa, ukugijima, nezinkanyezi ezikhangayo. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka futhi yahluka kakhulu. Ngesikhathi seMaphakathi neNkathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola indlela yokwakha izigcawu ezihlekisayo, ezinjengama-morality plays, lapho izifundo zempilo zafundiswa ngendlela ehlekisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemidlalo yeshashalazi eyaziwa kakhulu eNgilandi, njengezinkanyezi zikaWilliam Shakespeare, owaba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni wemidlalo yeshashalazi. UShakespeare, ngezingoma zakhe ezithokozisayo, izinkulumo ezijulile, kanye nezimo ezithakazelisayo, waphendula izinkinga zomphakathi, uthando, nobuhlungu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Ngesikhathi seMhlabeni Wokugcina, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola ukufinyelela okukhulu ezingeni lempucuko. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka yaba yinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo, behlangana ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izithameli ngezigcawu ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezinkulu, ezinjengeBroadway eNyakatho Melika, neWest End eNgilandi, lapho imidlalo yeshashalazi ithokozisa abantu abaningi. Namuhla, imidlalo yeshashalazi isikhona ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini ezihlukahlukene, ezikhangisa izigcawu ezithokozisayo, ezihlekisayo, nezifundisayo. Imidlalo yeshashalazi isengumthombo obalulekile wokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokuhlekisa, futhi isiza abantu ukuba bahlale behlakaniphile. Izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene, njengezinkanyezi ezihlekisayo, izinkanyezi ezinzima, nezinkanyezi zezenzakalo zempilo, zikhona ukuze ziqhube imizwa yabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ayigcini nje ngokuba yinsiza yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi iyinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane. Iphinde ibaluleke ekwakheni umphakathi, lapho abantu behlangana khona, bejabulela izigcawu ezithokozisayo, futhi behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezizohlala zikhumbuleka. Imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsiza engapheli, ehlangene nezidingo zomuntu, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni izimo ezinhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsiza ebalulekile emlandweni, futhi iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaphezu kokuba yinsiza yokuzijabulisa, iyindlela yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka sikhumbula umthelela omuhle wemidlalo yeshashalazi empilweni yethu.

Ososayensi baseNingizimu Afrika bakwi phambili kuzo zonke izinhlelo zocwaningo eziphathelene nemvelo futhi izwe lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuguqulweni. Ingxenye enkulu yalolu shintsho igxile eCape Town. Umongameli, yonke le misebenzi ingxenye yesu elikhulu lokwenza uMbuso wethu uphephe ezinkampanini, abathengisi bezidakamizwa, kanye nezono. Sibe nezinkulumo eziphumelelayo futhi sijabule ngomsebenzi owenziwayo kulolu hlangano. Izimo ezinzima zamahhovisi abaphathi abakhulu esakhiweni esivunyiwe ehhovisi elikhulu ziyadingeka. Uthe imboni yezokuvakasha idinga ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani emphakathini ezinqubweni zayo zebhizinisi njengoba izivakashi zamazwe omhlaba ziqaphela okwenzekayo. Ukuze sithole imiphumela enengqondo esikhathini esiphakathi naphakathi nesikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo zezentengiselwano ngendlela edala umzamo ohlelekile phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabalingani bawo emphakathini. Umnyango Wokuhlola weDolobha laseCape Town usuqalile ukulungiselela isigaba sesithathu sokuhlola okukhomba ukukala. Umnyango awunikezi igunya kokuqukethwe kwanoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi engase ihlanganiswe nale. Uhlu lwemali okumele ikhokhwe kwiwebhusayithi yeElsenburg noma lungatholakala elabhorethri. Abaphathi bamaphoyisa abane babulawa kule ndawo kanti ababili bafa endleleni beya esibhedlela. Khetha isifunda ukuze ubheke ulwazi olubalulekile ngaleso sifunda. Umphakathi wezokutshalwa kwezimali emhlabeni jikelele usicelile thina njengezizukulwane zesiAfrika ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi izimo zivumela izinqumo zokutshalwa kwezimali ezihlakaniphile zesikhathi eside e-Afrika. Sibheka isixazululo, sendawo, esifundazweni, kanye nokubamba iqhaza esifundeni njengendlela yokubhekana nesimo. Idolobha elikhulu elingu-9 eNingizimu Afrika lakhe amanethiwekhi okuxhumana ukuze wabelane ngemininingwane futhi uthole izixazululo ezintsha zokushintsha ezindaweni. Ezingxoxweni ezandulele, kwacaca ukuthi ukuphathwa kanye nokukwazi ukuphatha kubalulekile ekwenzeni inzuzo emikhiqizweni yobisi. Sizibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokugxila ezokuphepha, ukuthuthukisa ukuthuthwa kwezimoto nezinye izinsiza, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuhamba komoya, okuhlangenwe nakho kwezamasiko, kanye nokuhlukahluka kwemikhiqizo. Abasolwa baphathe ithuba lokudubula umphathi uma engakhiphi umfundi. Ngithumele isicelo sokukhokha ngesikhathi esithile futhi saphakanyiswa, kwathi ngemuva kwalokho ngakhipha imali. Abamnyama nabamhlophe bakhethwe kulokho, kangangokuthi izilwane ezibomvu zakhishwa ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa. Ngokufanayo, kuphela iNkantolo Ephakeme engavimba ingane ukuba ibhekwane nomgibeli wayo. Waphuma ngemuva kwesango elikhulu, wama okwesikhashana, wabe esangena ngaphakathi. Kodwa ekugcineni, kwakhuluma ngokuthi ukuhamba kwephutha kuhlehliswe kusuka eTaipei. Ngesikhathi semisebenzi elawulwayo yamalungu ePhokeng Organized Crime Unit kulezi ngesonto, abasolwa abane baboshwa futhi kutholakala ipulathini, igolide, kanye nemali. Ukuvakashela iCape Town Tourism Information Center emahhovisi eBurg Street kuyisiqalo esihle. Ukukhula okubonakalayo ekuchithweni komphakathi kokuqeqeshwa kanye nezifundo zomsebenzi, kulabo abaqashwe nabangaqashwanga, kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile emnothweni omkhulu. Uyabona lokho uma ubheka isikhungo semali esisetshenziselwa ukuhamba komnotho nezinsiza ukuze zisebenze ezingeni eliphezulu. Ishadi leMvume yokukhuluma komphakathi lihlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokukhuluma zomphakathi isikhathi esingamashumi amane. Lingavuselelwa, uma ufaka isicelo sokuvuselelwa kwemvume okungaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha futhi okungaphezulu kwezinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokuphela kwemvume ekhona. Lingavuselelwa kuphela uma abanikazi bemvume behlonipha imiqathango ebekwe yiziphathimandla zemvume. Imvume inikezwa emiphakathini efuna ukusungula inkampani yeSigaba 21, iTrust, inhlangano yokuzithandela, noma yimuphi omunye umzimba ovunyelwe umthetho ongasebenzi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo. Iphromotha ilungelo lokuxhumana kanye nenkululeko yokukhuluma imibono ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imikhakha ehlukahlukene yokukhuluma embonini, kubandakanya imiphakathi njengababproduci, abakhulumeli, nabalaleli ekwakheni ukuxhumana nokuxhumana ukuze kube nevoce yemiphakathi ekukhiqizeni izinhlelo ezikhombisa izintshisekelo ezikhethekile nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, kuhlanganise namasiko, ulimi, inkolo, nezidingo zokuhlela imikhakha ehlukene yomphakathi. Imvume iyasebenza isikhathi esingamashumi amane. Umnyango wezokuxhumana uxhasa abanikazi bemvume iminyaka emine ngezinsiza zokukhuluma nokukhiqiza, kodwa kuphela uma behlonipha izidingo zomnyango. I-ICASA izokhipha isikhumbuzo sokufaka izicelo zezinsizakalo zokukhuluma komphakathi futhi ihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene. Susa iqembu elisebenzayo elizophatha inqubo yokufaka izicelo futhi lisebenze njengomfaki-sicelo egameni lomphakathi. Qoqani izimpawu zomphakathi ukuze nibhale uhlelo lwebhizinisi lokuphromotha ukhetho lwamalungu eBhodi ngenqubo yokhetho olukhululekile ukuze kubhekwane nendawo yesiteshi sokukhuluma ezokwenziwa khona. Qedela ifomu lesicelo ngocingo, usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu. Thumela ifomu lesicelo sokuqala kanye nezincwadi eziyi-16 ezivunyiwe ku-ICASA kanye nemali yesicelo. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfaki-sicelo, futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Kungathatha ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuya kwezi-4. Kuzokwenziwa imali engu-R250 yokukhipha imvume ngemva kokuvunywa kwayo. Ifomu lesicelo lizoba yingxenye yesikhawu seGovt Gazette.
Imfashini: Umhlaba Wokugqoka Nobuciko Imfashini iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yokwakha ubuqotho komuntu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini yanamuhla. Ihlanganisa izindlela zokugqoka, izitayela, nemikhuba ethinta ukuziveza kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde ngempela imfashini, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iyini, izakhi zayo, nezizathu ezenza abantu bakhethe izitayela ezithile. Ukwakhiwa KweMfashini Imfashini ibonisa indlela abantu abaziveza ngayo, futhi ihlale ibonisa izimo zomphakathi, izinkolo, nezinkolelo. Isiko, ubuciko, kanye nezimo zempilo zidlala indima enkulu ekwakhiweni kwemfashini. Isibonelo, imfashini yesikhumbuzo ibonisa izikhathi zomlando, njengokugqokwa kwezimpahla ezithile ezazisetshenziswa ezikhathini ezedlule. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imfashini akukhona nje okugqokwayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nemvelo, izinkolelo, kanye nezinkumbulo. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokugqoka Ngokuvamile, imfashini ibandakanya izinto ezahlukene zokugqoka, okuhlanganisa izingubo, izicathulo, nezinsiza zokuhlobisa. Izingubo zingahluka kakhulu, zisukela ezikhethelwe imicimbi emikhulu, njengezihlahla zomshado, kuya ezimeni ezijwayelekile, ezifana nezikhumbuzo zansuku zonke. Izicathulo nazo zibalulekile, njengoba zikhombisa isitayela somuntu, futhi ziba nesithakazelo kumphakathi. Ukuze umuntu akhethe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi ahloniphe izimo zomphakathi, izimo zezulu, kanye nezidingo zakhe. Izitayela Nemikhuba Izitayela zihlala zishintsha, ziqhamuka nezinto ezintsha, futhi ziqhubeka nokuhlangana nezinto ezedlule. Izitayela ezidumile zihlala ziqhamuka ezinkampanini ezinkulu, ezifana nezinkanyezi, abaculi, kanye nabaklami bemfashini. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezithile, njengoba bejolisa kulokho abakubona emithonjeni yezokuxhumana, ezikhangisweni, nakwezinye izindawo. Ngakho, imfashini iyindlela yokukhombisa ubuciko, nokukhuluma ngezimvo zomuntu. Imfashini Nezinkanyezi Izinkanyezi zidlala indima enkulu ekwakhiweni kwemfashini. Lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zokwakha imfashini, lapho abaculi bembula khona izitayela ezintsha. Izinkanyezi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bazame izinto ezintsha, futhi zenza kube lula ukuba abantu bakhethe izitayela ezihambisana nezinto abazithandayo. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlanganyela, njengoba abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlala behlanganyela nezinkanyezi ezithile. Ubuciko BeMfashini Ubuciko buhlobene kakhulu nemfashini. Abaklami bemfashini bahlala bephusha imikhawulo, befuna izindlela ezintsha zokwakha izingubo ezihlukile. Lokhu kudala imfashini ehlukahlukene, ethokozisayo, futhi ethinta imizwa. Ukuze imfashini ibonakale, kudingeka ukuba kube nokucabanga okukhulu, kanye nezindlela eziningi zokwakha. Lokhu kudala umhlaba ogcwele ubuciko, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukuziveza ngendlela abathanda ngayo. Imfashini Nezimo Zokuphila Imfashini ayigcini nje ngokuba yindlela yokugqoka, kodwa ibonisa futhi izimo zokuphila. Abantu bahlala bekhetha izitayela ezihambisana nezimo zabo, kanye nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba imfashini ingaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubuntu bomuntu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bahlala bejolisa emigomeni ethile, njengezokuhlala, izomnotho, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana. Isiphetho Imfashini iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi ibonisa indlela abantu abaziveza ngayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imfashini akukhona nje okugqokwayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhombisa ubuciko, izinkolelo, nezimo zempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bahlala bejolisa ezitayeleni ezintsha, futhi imfashini iqhubeka nokuhlangana nezimo zomphakathi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe imfashini, siqonde izizathu eziholela ekwakhiweni kwayo, futhi sihlole indlela esiyithanda ngayo. Imfashini iyindlela yokukhombisa ubuntu bethu, futhi kufanele siyijabulele, siyihloniphe, futhi sithokozise.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Umhlahlandlela Wokwakha Okuqukethwe Okuphumelelayo Isingeniso Namuhla, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bejolise ekwakheni nasekwabelaneni ngolwazi, izindaba, nezinto ezithokozisayo. Okuqukethwe okukhuluma ngakho kungaba yizithombe, amavidiyo, izindatshana, noma amabhulogi. Ukuze ube ngumkhiqizi ophumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinyathelo ezithile ezizokwenza umsebenzi wakho ube nomthelela omkhulu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka zokwakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuhlelekile, nokuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Isinyathelo 1: Thola Isihloko Esifanele Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukukhetha isihloko esizokhuthaza abantu ukuba bafunde. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokucwaninga izitayela ezithandwa kakhulu, izihloko eziphathelene nempilo, ubuchwepheshe, noma izindaba zomphakathi. Qiniseka ukuthi isihloko sakho sikhanga futhi sinentshisekelo, ukuze sikwazi ukuheha ababukeli. Thola ulwazi olutholakalayo ngokusebenzisa amathuluzi afana ne-Google Trends noma izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze uthole ukuthi yini ethokozisa abantu. Isinyathelo 2: Qonda Ababukeli Bakho Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukubhala, kubalulekile ukuba uqonde kahle ababukeli bakho. Bafuna ini? Yiziphi izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo? Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuklama okuqukethwe okuthinta inhliziyo yabo. Thola izimpendulo ezivela kubabukeli, bese usebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abantu nokubavusa ukuba baphendule. Isinyathelo 3: Hlela Okuqukethwe Ngemuva kokuba usunokwazi ngalesi sihloko kanye nababukeli, hlela okuqukethwe kwakho. Lokhu kungafaka izigaba ezihlukene, izihloko ezincane, nezithombe ezizokwenza kube lula ukufunda. Hlela kahle izigaba zakho ukuze kube nokuhleleka, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umqondo wakho uhamba kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubabukeli ukuba baqonde kahle lokho okukhuluma ngakho. Isinyathelo 4: Bhala Okuqukethwe Manje sekuvele isikhathi sokubhala. Qala ngokubhala isingeniso esikhangayo, esizokwenza abantu bafune ukufunda okwengeziwe. Bese uqhubeka nezihloko ezihlukene, uqinisekisa ukuthi ubhala ngendlela ecacile, enembile, futhi ethokozisayo. Sebenzisa izibonelo, izithombe, noma amavidiyo ukuze uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi ugcina umoya wokuxhumana, ukuze ababukeli bakwazi ukuzizwa behlanganyela. Isinyathelo 5: Hlela Futhi Uhlola Ngemuva kokubhala, kubalulekile ukuhlola nokuhlela okuqukethwe kwakho. Bheka amaphutha okubhala, iziphazamiso, noma izinkinga zokuhleleka. Ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhlela, noma ucele omunye umuntu ukuba abuke umsebenzi wakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amaphutha ongawazi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kuhlelekile futhi kulungile. Isinyathelo 6: Yabelana Ngokuqukethwe Uma usuhlele futhi uhlolile okuqukethwe kwakho, sekuvele isikhathi sokwabelana. Sebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, amabhulogi, noma amawebhusayithi ukuze ufinyelele ababukeli abaningi. Qiniseka ukuthi uthumela izixhumanisi ezithokozisayo, izithombe ezikhangayo, nezincazelo ezikhuthazayo ukuze uthole ukunakwa. Ungasebenzisa izikhangiso noma izikhangiso ezikhokhelwayo ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okukhulu. Isinyathelo 7: Thola Impendulo Ngemuva kokwabelana, thola impendulo kubabukeli bakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kuthokozisa kangakanani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zakho zokwakha okuqukethwe esikhathini esizayo. Ungasebenzisa izibalo, izimpendulo, noma izibuyekezo ukuze uthole umbono wokuthi abantu bacabangani ngakho. Isiphetho Ukuba abadali bokuqukethwe akulula, kodwa uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuhlelekile, nokuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Khumbula, umgomo wakho uwukuhlanganyela nabantu, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwakha umphakathi. Qhubeka ufunde, uthuthukise, futhi ube nesibindi sokwabelana ngemicabango yakho. Ngale ndlela, ungaba umdali ophumelelayo, futhi uthuthukise impilo yabanye.
Umphakathi ungaxhumana nalesi sikhungo ukuze uthole usizo ngokushayela inombolo engenamkhawulo: 0800 005 133. Lesi sikhungo sokuxhumana kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphezulu sinezisebenzi ezinganikeza umphakathi izeluleko nolwazi mayelana nezempilo nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi nemininingwane edingekayo kumshayeli. Njengoba kuhlobene nezempilo, uzothola usizo. Lesi sikhungo, esitholakala ebhizinisini iNatalia, okuyiHhovisi Elikhulu leMnyango Wezempilo e-uMgungundlovu, sinezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezilungele ukusiza noma ubani oxhumana nazo. Inhloso yokwakha lesi sikhungo ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wonke ngosizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngensiza zokuxhumana ezifana neradiyo, ithelevishini, i-imeyili, i-SMS, kanye nezinsizakalo zocingo. Uqhubekile wathi, "Lesi sikhungo sisiza kakhulu kithi ekusizeni uma kukhona okuphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uvusa isixwayiso, singafika ngokushesha lapho kudingeka khona njengoba lesi sikhungo sinezixhumanisi ezisiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuba baqondiswe lapho usizo ludingeka khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna lelo ndawo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sikhungo singathumela imiyalezo yokwazisa uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi mayelana nemithi. "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo singasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, okusho ukuthi siphinde sibe nesandla ekufundiseni umphakathi. Lokhu esikubonile ukuthi abantu abaningi bafuna ukwazi ngesimo sezempilo kulesi sifunda ngoba befisa ukuvakashela futhi bathi sinesandla ezivakashi," kuchaza uNtsobi. Izinhlobo zezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo zifaka phakathi lezo ezivela kubantu abafuna ukuveza izinkinga ezifana nokukhwabanisa, amacala okuhlukumeza, udlame lwasekhaya, abantu abalahlekile, imibiko yokwenzeka kwezehlakalo, izikhalazo ngezisebenzi, nokho nakuba abanye befaka izikhalazo. Zonke izikhalazo zilandelwa futhi zihlolwa. Njengoba sisondele isikhathi seholide, kubonakala ukuthi lesi sikhungo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhlinzekeni ngosizo lwezempilo kumphakathi nasekuletheni usizo lokuxhumana uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma ngalesi sikhathi. Khuluma nathi. Lalela nathi. Amahora angama-24 ngosuku. UKhuzwayo akazange abambezele njengoba athatha ithuba lokuba phakathi kwabokuqala kulesi sikhungo ukuthola imithi ye-antiretroviral ye-HIV. Nakuba impilo kaKhuzwayo kanye naleyo yabanye abavakashi abayi-506 kulesi sikhungo ibonisa umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo kusukela baqala ukuthola imithi, ub faced with great difficulties at home as his husband does not want to hear anything about HIV. Ukephuleka ukuxoxa ngakho ngemva kokuthola ukuthi ungena, kodwa umyeni wakhe wenqaba ukulalela le ndaba. Indlela amadoda abheka ngayo amadoda. Ingabe lokhu kuyinkinga? Ngokusho kukaNzuza, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nendlela amadoda abheka ngayo wona ezimpilweni. UNzuza uthi kukhona izikhathi lapho iziphepho, ikakhulukazi amadoda, engafuni ukubonakala ethola imithi kuze kube sezingeni lokuthi banqume ukufihla imithi enikezwe abalingani babo. Omunye wabaguli bethu weza kithi ekhala ukuthi imithi yakhe ilahlekile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola kwethu, sathola ukuthi umyeni wakhe ubebamba amaphilisi akhe. Sabe sesichaza kuye ukuthi kuyingozi kangakanani ukungalandeli imiyalelo uma usebenzisa imithi njengoba kungaholela ekutheni ingasebenzi, kuchaza uNksz. Nzuza. UMnyango Wezempilo ucele amadoda ukuthi asebenzise uhlelo lukamasipala lokuthola imithi yamahhala. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona ohlelweni lokuthola imithi mayelana nokuhlonipha ukusetshenziswa kwemithi efanele, uhlelo lusebenza kahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala kuzo zonke izifunda eziyi-11 zalesi sifunda. Lezi zikhungo zinezimiso ezihlinzeka abantu abadala, izingane, kanye nabesifazane abakhululiwe. UNzuza uthi abantu abathola imithi ngabantu abanokuhlola kwe-CD4 okungaphansi kuka-200. Inani le-virus ye-HIV emzimbeni womuntu libizwa ngokuthi i-viral load. Odokotela bahlola i-viral load emzimbeni uma bephatha isiguli ngoba ukwehla kwayo kusho ukuthi imithi iyasebenza. Ukwanda kwe-viral load emuntwini osebenzisa imithi kungase kubonise ukuthi isiguli sinezinkinga lapho imithi ingasebenzi kahle noma ukuthi imithi ayithathwa kahle. Imithi isebenza kahle uma ithathwa njengoba kuyalwa udokotela noma um nurse. Ukushiya izikhathi zemithi kungaholela ekwandeni kwe-virus futhi kungase kubangele ukuthi ingasebenzi emzimbeni. Ngaqala ukusebenza eMnyangweni Wezempilo ngoJanuwari walonyaka ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami eStellenbosch University eWestern Cape. Okwamanje, ngisebenza e-Osindisweni hospital, lapho ngenza khona unyaka wami wezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ngalokho engikwenza. UDr. Suraya Naidoo weza ukuzongazisa ngenhloso eyinhloko yalolu hlelo futhi wakhombisa isifiso sokuthi ngibe yingxenye yalo njengoba sengiyisazi sokudla. Njengengxenye yomsebenzi wami, kufanele ngikwazi ukusiza labo abadinga ukudla nokusiza imindeni ekulweni nendlala ekhaya. Ngemuva kwalokho, njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, saqala uhlelo kulesi sikhungo ngoJulayi walonyaka, futhi ngiyena ophatha ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Abaguli engibabona bangabantu abathunyelwe kimi udokotela, um nurse, noma abanye abasebenzi bezempilo uma bebona isiguli sidinga usizo. Ngikwazile ukubona ubumpofu nokuhlupheka okukhona kulabo abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kuyadabukisa. Ngihlangane nezingane ezinomzimba ophansi ngoba kungekho ukudla ekhaya. Ngibona omama nabababa bephokophele ekuphatheni abantwana babo ababa yizintandane. Uma ngingasiza noma ngabe umuntu oyedwa, ngiyazi ukuthi ngizokwazi ukuqhubeka nalesi sikhungo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu uma ngibona othile owayengaphansi kokudla eqala ukuthola isisindo futhi ehleka ngoba uthole ukudla futhi ubeke okuthile esiswini sakhe. Yebo, kwesinye isikhathi kunzima ukubona ukuthi ubani odinga usizo ngempela nobani ongeyena. Kukhona labo abafikile nekhaya elinokudla kodwa beze bacele ukudla ngoba befuna ukuthola mahhala. Nokho, sizama konke okusemandleni ethu ukufinyelela kulabo abadinga usizo ngempela. Njengoba lolu hlelo luqhubeka, ngithemba ukuthi sizoletha usizo nempilo engcono kubaningi. Ngithanda ukuvakashela olwandle nokukhuluma nabangane bami. Isitifiketi sokufa siyidokhumenti esemthethweni ekhishwa kumndeni wom deceased uma ukufa komuntu kubhaliswa. Uma umuntu ongaphandle efela eNingizimu Afrika, irekhodi liyagcwaliswa bese isitifiketi sokufa sikhishwa kumndeni. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo senziwa phesheya. Bhala incwadi enemininingwane yom deceased bese uyithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi eliseduze uma kungekho ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi endaweni yakho. Akukho ukungcwaba okuzokwenzeka ngaphandle kwe-oda yokungcwaba. I-oda yokungcwaba iyisitifiketi esivumela ukungcwaba nokuhanjiswa komzimba endaweni lapho umuntu efile khona ukuya endaweni lapho bezokungcwaba khona, ngabasebenzi beMnyango Wezangaphakathi, amalungu eNhlangano Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika, noma abaphathiswa abavunyelwe abakhiqiza i-oda yokungcwaba. Isitifiketi sokufingqa: Sikhishwa uma ukufa kubhaliswa. Isitifiketi esigcwele: Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezingu-12 ukuze ziqedwe. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi leMnyango eliseduze.
Ukudla Kwesintu: Ukuvuselela Isiko Nokuqinisa Ubudlelwano Ezimweni zansuku zonke, ukudla kwesintu kubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukudla akusikho kuphela ukudla; kuyisiko, indlela yokuphila, futhi kuyindlela yokuxhumana. Ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, ukudla kwesintu kuhlanganisa izithako ezivela emvelweni, izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokupheka, kanye nemikhuba ethile ethinta izikhathi ezithile zonyaka. Izithako Zokudla Kwasendulo Izithako ezisetshenziswa ekudleni kwesintu zihluke kakhulu, zixhomeke endaweni, isimo sezulu, kanye namasiko abantu. Ezinye zezithako ezivamile zifaka ufulawa, imifino, inyama, nezithelo. Ngokwesibonelo, eNingizimu Afrika, amafutha e-olive, u-anyanisi, ne-garlic zisetshenziswa kakhulu, kanti imifino efana ne-spinach, u-cabbage, kanye ne-butternut ibalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Izindlela Zokupheka Izindlela zokupheka zihluke kakhulu phakathi kwezizwe nezindawo. Abantu abaningi basakaza izindlela zokupheka ezivela kumagugu abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezizukulwane. Ukupheka okuthandwayo kufaka phakathi ukujova, ukuvuthela, nokupheka emlilweni. Lokhu kudala ukudla okunempilo, okuthokozisayo, futhi okukhumbulekayo. Isibonelo, ukujova inyama, okwaziwa ngokuthi "braai," akusizi nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa futhi kudala ithuba lokuhlangana, ukuhlekisa, nokuxoxa. Ukudla Njengomgogodla Wesiko Ukudla kwesintu akugcini nje ngokuba ukudla; kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isiko. Izikhathi ezithile zonyaka, njengezinkanyezi, imishado, kanye nemikhosi, zihlala zixhumene nokudla. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuhlangana, lapho imindeni ihlanganyela khona ukudla, izinkumbulo, kanye nezindaba. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkumbulo zihlala zikhona. Ukudla Kwasendulo Nezinguquko Zamanje Nokho, ukudla kwesintu kuhamba phambili nezinguquko zamanje. Njengoba abantu behamba phambili, izindlela zokupheka nezithako ziyaqhubeka nokuguquka. Abantu abaningi baphendukela ekudleni okunempilo, okwenziwe ngezithako ezivela emvelweni, okukhuthaza impilo enhle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izitolo zokudla ziqhakambise izithako ezivela ezindaweni zasendulo, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ekudleni kwesintu. Ukubaluleka Kokugcina Isiko Kubantu abaningi, ukudla kwesintu kubalulekile ekugcineni isiko. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo ziyaqhubeka nokuhlonipha imikhuba yethu, kubalulekile ukufundisa izingane zethu ngezindlela zokupheka, izithako, kanye nezikhathi ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, kanti futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina izinkumbulo zethu zihlala zikhona. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukudla kwesintu kuqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, isiko, kanye nendlela yokuxhumana. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlangana, sabelana ngezinkumbulo, futhi sikhumbula izimpilo zethu, kudinga ukuthi sihloniphe futhi sigcine ukudla kwesintu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbule, futhi sibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yethu. Ukudla kwesintu akusizi nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi.
Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA Izinhlelo ze-SITA (State Information Technology Agency) zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinhlaka zikamasipala, izikhungo zikahulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluphumelelayo, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Nokho, lapho lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle, umthelela ungaba mubi kakhulu. Kulokhu, sizobheka umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphathwa kwemithombo. Okokuqala, umthelela wezomnotho ungaba mkhulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo ezinjengokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izinhlelo zokukhokha, nezokuphathwa kwemali zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi ihamba kahle. Uma lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kahle, zinciphisa izindleko, zandisa ukuhweba, futhi zenza kube lula ukuphathwa kwemali. Kodwa uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, izindleko zikhula, izinkampani ziba nezinkinga zokuhamba, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinkampani zinciphe imisebenzi, zinciphise abasebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omubi emnothweni jikelele. Okwesibili, ezokuxhumana ziba yinkinga enkulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo ezithinta ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase bangatholi ulwazi oludingekayo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuphathwa kwezinhlelo, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhalazo, nokwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu. Okwesithathu, ukuphathwa kwemithombo kuyinkinga enkulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuphatha imithombo, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo, zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo iyasetshenziswa kahle. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, imithombo ingase ingasetshenziswanga kahle, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni, njengoba imithombo ingase ingafinyeleli ezindaweni ezidinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokungathembeki. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase baphendule ngokungathembeki, okungaholela ekwandeni kokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka emiphakathini, uma abantu bengakholwa ekutheni izinhlelo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo, njengoba abantu bangase baphendule ngokungafuni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, izinsizakalo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana, zingase zingatholakali. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokunganeliseki kwabantu, okungaholela ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka emiphakathini. Izinsizakalo ezibalulekile zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ngokuphetha, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphathwa kwemithombo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi ihamba kahle, abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi umnotho uthuthuke. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza, ukuhlela, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA, okuzoholela ekwenzeni ngcono impilo yabantu kanye nomnotho jikelele.
Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 ophathelene nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi ufake incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo okusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo nguMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izinhlelo zomgwaqo nezemizila; lungisa inqubo ephathelene nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umphakathi ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela ezinsizeni zomgwaqo ezisetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kwasungulwa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambuka kwawo okwesikhashana. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okushicilelwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda osevele ukhona, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwa, ngokuhambisana nebhukwana elibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kufake iziphakamiso eziphathelene nomgwaqo, bese uMEC emva kwalokho kumele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba. Ngaphambi kokuthi athathe umgwaqo noma umgwaqo ophumelele, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umphakathi owazi ngemisebenzi esigabeni 22 ye-ECA, noma umphakathi obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, angakwazi ukuhlela. kanye nokumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 11. UMEC kumele axhumane nazo zonke izifunda lapho umgwaqo uzobe khona futhi acela, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, ukuthi zithumele imibono ebhaliwe ngombiko wokuqala womgwaqo nendawo ekhombisa umthelela ozoba khona umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe kunoma iyiphi isikhala noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi oluhlelekile lwezinhlelo zomphakathi ezithintekayo. a ibhekisela kumgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela; noma b ngokusebenzisa izigaba 6 kuya ku-9, thumela udaba noma izinkinga ezivela kumabhuku okukhuluma noma imibono kwi-commission ukuze kwenziwe ukuxhumana komphakathi okukhuthaza lezi zindaba ngqo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe nguMEC futhi, ngemva kokubheka lezi ziphakamiso, kumemezele umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela. h umuntu angaba ngumholi onemfundo efanele ongaba omunye walabo abakhuluma ezigabeni a kuya ku-g; futhi i umholi kanye namalungu amane kufanele benze i-quorum ngenhloso yokusebenza kwe-commission. e usuku nendawo yokuxhumana komphakathi; futhi f ukumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 12. futhi b phatha ukuxhumana ngokuhambisana nenqubo echaziwe. Ngemuva kokwenza ukuxhumana, i-commission kumele ihlanganise umbiko obhaliwe wokuxhumana, ibheke, uma kudingeka, ezinqubweni zezinqubomgomo ezibekwe esigabeni 3 se-Development Facilitation Act, 1995 Act No. 67 ka-1995 nasemthethweni wokuhlela wesifunda. UMEC, ngokuxhumana nom member we-Executive Council ophathelene nokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa, kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukumemezela komgwaqo ngaphansi kwesigaba 5a noma b kuhambisana kakhulu nanoma iyiphi isikhala noma enye uhlelo lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kwesifunda olwenziwe ngaphansi komthetho wokuhlela wesifunda. ukun Notice ukuthi izizathu zesenzo sikaMEC mayelana nokuthathwa komgwaqo zingacelwa ezindabeni ezithintekayo nezithintekayo ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwesaziso. Ngokusho kwesigaba 82, umgwaqo noma isigaba singashintshwa kuphela nguMEC ngemuva kokuhlanganisa izinqubo ezibekwe ezigabeni 81 kuya ku-8 futhi izinguquko zomgwaqo kufanele zishicilelwe esigabeni 11. Isigaba 7 soMthetho oyinhloko silungiswa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". a ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 1 noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 611". b ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 2 noma kuphi lapho amagama "isigaba 611" futhi ukufaka amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "61 kuya ku-11". a umbiko wendawo obhekiswe esigabeni 4b noma isigaba 63a, uma kudingeka; futhi f ngokufaka esigabeni 8 amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "isigaba 611." Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko silungiswa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". f ukuhlanganiswa kohlelo lwezitimela, umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo zezikhumulo zezindiza, kanye nendawo ezungezile yedolobha nezinye izinsiza zokuhamba. UMEC unamandla okuthi, ngaphandle kokuthinta eminye imithetho, adlulisele noma ahlinzeke ngokuqashwa, lokho akwenza egameni lesinye isigaba noma abaningi balabo abahileleke esivumelwaneni esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1, noma noma ilungelo lokuhamba emhlabeni womunye noma elinye ilungelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi libhalisiwe noma alibhalisiwe, kodwa ezandleni zikaMEC noma zePhondo, ngenhloso noma mayelana nanoma yisiphi isivumelwano njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 nangokuhambisana nesikhathi salo sivumelwano.
Izithombe ozibona lapha zikhombisa okungase kwenzeke uma umlimi engakuvuni ngesikhathi. Lezi zithombe zithathwe ngoFebhuwari kulo nyaka eMpumalanga Kapa - umkhiqizo awuvunwanga, futhi ekugcineni izinkambu zashiswa! Kuyiphithizela ukubona umsebenzi owenziwe unyaka wonke ungakhiphi umkhiqizo - kumele sivimbe lokhu ukuba kwenzeke futhi. Kuyinkinga, kodwa kuyiqiniso ukuthi imikhiqizo ingavunwa kuphela ngemishini ukuze kutholakale umkhiqizo omuhle, futhi imishini yokuvuna ihamba ngokushesha, okwenza ukuvuna kube lula. Ibhande lempahla libalulekile uma uthengisa ngoba imikhiqizo ingalahlekelwa ibhande layo ngokushesha futhi kalula uma ingavunwanga ngesikhathi. Uma imikhiqizo isivuthiwe, kumele ivunwe ngokushesha ngoba noma imvula encane inganciphisa ibhande, futhi inzuzo ingase ingatholakali. Abalimi abasha abanokulima izindawo ezincane bethemba kubaphakeli abanemishini yokuvuna. Bavame ukungena ezivumelwaneni nabalimi ekuqaleni konyaka wokutshala. Bafuna ukungena ezivumelwaneni eziningi ukuze bakwazi ukuvuna amahektare amaningi ukuze bathole imali eningi. Abakwazi ukukhipha ukubikezela ukuthi kuzoshaya imvula nini noma ukuthi izimo zizovela ezizobangela ukuthi balahlekelwe isikhathi sokuvuna. Bathanda ukuvuna ezinkambini ezinkulu ngaphandle kwabaphakeli ngoba imishini yabo ingavuna amahektare amaningi ngosuku olulodwa ngaphandle kokudinga ukujika kaningi. Abafuni ukulinda amatekisi ukuze athwale imikhiqizo evunyiwe. Bakhokhelwa ngokuya ngamahektare abavunile, hhayi ngokuya ngebhande umlimi ozokwamukela. Bahlala bephakathi kwengozi yokuphuka kwemishini yabo - okuchitha isikhathi sabo sokusebenza - abazi ukuthi imishini izophuka nini. Konke lokhu kukhombisa isithombe esinzima, kodwa kumele sazi ukuthi kukhona izinkinga ezizovela, futhi kufanele sibheke phambili ezindleleni zokuzinqoba ngempumelelo. Kumele bazilungiselele ngokungena ezivumelwaneni nabaphakeli kusenesikhathi ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umphakeli akathathi umsebenzi ongaphezu kwamandla akhe. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi awekho amahlanga amaningi enkambini yabo angalimaza imishini yokuvuna. Kumele balungiselele amatekisi anele ukuze athwale umkhiqizo ukuze umsebenzi ungabambezeli isikhathi eside. Kumele balungiselele indawo lapho imikhiqizo izogcinwa uma bengakwazi ukufika ezilondolozweni ngesikhathi ngemuva kokushiya inkambu. Kumele bahlangane nabaphathi bezilondolozo ukuvumelana ngesikhathi imikhiqizo kufanele igcinwe uma kudingeka. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezithokozisa inhliziyo ngesikhathi sokuvuna - umsebenzi wokukhiqiza walo nyaka uphelile, futhi sesicabanga ngonyaka ozayo. Abalimi abakhiqiza imikhiqizo eFree State, konke okuhlobene nokugcina umswakama womhlabathi, kubalulekile uma ufuna ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ehlobo. Ukubaluleka kokugcina umswakama womhlabathi kuyinto esizokhuluma ngayo njalo. Lo msebenzi kufanele uqale ngokushesha ngemva kokuvuna. Okwesibili ukuvuka kwamanzi emhlabathini nokuphuma komoya - lokhu kwenzeka uma umhlabathi uba hard futhi umanzi. Kumele uphathe izinkambu zakho kusukela ngesikhathi uphothula ukuvuna kuze kube ngesikhathi sokutshala kabusha izimpande ezintsha. Ukuvuna okuhle kusezandleni zakho kuphela!
Kubhalwe kahle ukukhokha izindleko zakho zikagesi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ungaphuthelwa. Njalo, amakhasimende akhokha ingxenye yebhili elizokhokhwa ngoba acabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzovimbela ugesi wabo ekuphunyukeni. Uma ingxenye oyiphuthumayo ingakhokhwa ngenyanga ezayo, uzokhula kakhulu futhi ungase ungakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Qaphela ukuthi ukukhokha njalo kuphela izingxenye zenani okufanele ukhokhe kungaholela ekuphunyukeni kukagesi wakho. Uma ubona ukuthi uphuthumile kakhulu emathubeni akho, xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uxoxe ngendlela yokulungisa lesi simo. Kuzokwenziwa izintshisakalo ngenani olikhokhayo uma ikhasimende lingakhokhi ngokuphelele noma likhokha ngamanani amancane noma likhokha ngemuva kosuku lokugcina. Le simo sokungakhokhi kahle kuholela ekwandeni kwenani lokukhokha njalo ngenyanga. Uma usayine isivumelwano sokukhokha nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi, gcina leso sivumelwano. Uma uphumelela, ugesi wakho uzophunyukiswa. Kodwa uma isimo sakho siba sibi kakhulu ngemuva kokusayina isivumelwano, kufanele uqinisekise umhlinzeki wakho kagesi ngokushesha. Ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi besimo sakho esishintshile. Uma unemitha kagesi yokukhokha ngaphambi, qaphela ngenani likagesi olisebenzisayo. Kuwo wonke amabhili, kufanele kube nenani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga kanye nenani lokuvala ekupheleni kwenyanga. Lokhu kukunika ithuba lokwazi inani eliphelele olisebenzisile kule nyanga. Kufanele uhlole ukuthi inani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga lihambisana nenani lokuvala elivela enyangeni edlule. Uma lezi zilinganiso zingahambisani, funa ukucaciselwa kumhlinzeki wakho kagesi. Ngezinye izikhathi, labo abafunda imitha kagesi benza amaphutha. Qaphela ngenani leyunithi ngayinye. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho kagesi kufanele akukhokhise malini ngeyunithi (Kwh) kagesi oyisebenzisayo. Uma ungazi, kufanele ubuze umhlinzeki wakho kagesi noma iNational Energy Regulator. Ukuze uqonde ukuthi ukhokhisiwe kanjani kule nyanga, udinga ukuthatha inani eliphelele okufanele ukhokhe (ngama-rand) bese ulibamba ngenani likagesi olisebenzisile kule nyanga. Umphumela uzoba yintengo ngeyunithi (I-unit). Uma unenketho yokukhetha, ungashintsha uhlelo olusebenzisa ikhadi lapho uthenga inani elithile likagesi. Khumbula ukuthi uzokhokhwa imali yokusetha leli hlelo. Intengo yalezi zinguquko iyahluka ngokusekelwe kukagesi owawusebenzisile. Ulwazi lokulawula inani likagesi olisetshenzisile. Uma udinga ukukhokha, ungase udinge ukukhokha le ngxenye ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokushintsha kuhlelo lwekhadi. Izinzuzo zohlelo oluchazwe ngenhla zihlula izinselelo zokuqala okufanele ubhekane nazo ngaphambi kokushintsha (njengemali yokuqala okufanele uyikhokhe). Thola kumhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuthi yiziphi izimo nemigomo abahamba ngaphansi kwayo. Ngokuvamile, abanye abahlinzeki bagesi badinga amakhasimende ukuthi asayine isivumelwano sokukhokha isikweletu sabo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngokucophelela kuzokusiza unciphise ukusetshenziswa kwakho nezindleko zanyanga zonke. Ungakwenza kanjani lokhu? Amashubhu, izifudumezi zamanzi (ama-gizmos), kanye nezifudumezi (ama-radiators) ziwabathengi bagesi abakhulu futhi zandisa ibhili lakho likagesi. Uma unesi fudu seziwasha, qiniseka ukuthi i-thermostat ayibekwe phezulu. Ungabeka i-thermostat cishe kuma-60 degrees. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uthole izeluleko ngalokhu. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi esifudumezini zamanzi: uma unamandla, unganciphisa izinga likagesi eliya esifudumezini zamanzi, futhi lokhu kungaphinde kwenziwe kumapayipi ahambisa amanzi. Le ndlela inciphisa izindleko zikagesi kakhulu kodwa kuza nemali ethile uma ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Isitofu: qiniseka ukuthi awuvuli wonke amaplethi esitofu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izeluleko zithi unciphise ukushisa ephethe uma iphunga lakho liphume. Ungasebenzisi i-oven njengendlela yokufudumeza ngoba i-oven isebenzisa ugesi omningi. Izifudumezi: izifudumezi zikagesi zisebenzisa ugesi omningi. Uma unesi fudu sikagesi, kunconywa ukuthi uvule kuphela isifudumezi esisodwa. Kodwa uzokwazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwandisa isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba indlu yakho ifudumale. Ukuvala amawindi: enye indlela yokunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa ukuvala amawindi endlini yakho. Ukukhanya: ilambu elivaliwe ngengilazi linika ukukhanya okuningi kanti lisetshenziswa kagesi okuncane. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Yini umthetho oyisho ngokuphunyukiswa kukagesi? Umthetho ohlongozwayo wegesi ka-1987 unika umhlinzeki kagesi igunya lokuphunyukisa uma ibhili lingakhokhiwe noma uma ikhasimende lingahambisani nemigomo yokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Nokho, umthetho ufunela umhlinzeki kagesi ukuba unikeze ikhasimende isixwayiso semihla engu-14 ngaphambi kokuphunyukiswa kukagesi kwabo. Le nkathi iqala ngosuku olubhalwe encwadini. Isixwayiso embhalweni wanyanga zonke sikwamukelekile. Amakhasimende acelwa ukuthi ahlole umbhalo embhalweni. Khumbula ukuthi umuntu wokuqala okufanele ukhalaze kuye umhlinzeki wakho wendawo. Ikhasimende linelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo mayelana nezinga lenkonzo elihlinzekwa umhlinzeki wendawo. Umhlinzeki wendawo kagesi unomsebenzi wokulalela nokuxazulula isikhalazo. Uma wena njengomthengi unganelisekile ngemiphumela noma ngendlela isikhalazo sakho esiphathwe ngayo, udaba lungathunyelwa kuNational Energy Regulator (NER) ukuze luxazululwe.
Izinhlelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, eyaziwa kakhulu, kodwa engathathwa kalula – izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela. Kulabo abangakaze babe nesipiliyoni sokuhlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo, kungaba nzima ukuqonda ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe. Kukhona izindlela ezithile ezilungiselelwe ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo ngokushesha. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini ezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinto ezifana nokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, ukushaywa, ukulimala okukhulu, noma izimo ezinjalo. Uma umuntu efika esibhedlela enezimo ezinjalo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezilungiselelwe ukuze kuncishiswe isikhathi sokulinda, futhi usizo lufike ngokushesha. Uma uhamba esibhedlela, kumele uqaphele ukuthi iziguli zihlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlukaniswa kwezimo" noma "triage." Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bazobheka isimo somuntu ngokushesha, bahlukanise iziguli ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo kulabo abangenalo. Lokhu kusiza ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi abantu abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo bahlala bephuthumekile. Ngemuva kokuhlukaniswa, iziguli ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo ziya phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma unokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, ungase ube phezulu ohlwini, ngenkathi abanye abantu, abangekho engcupheni enkulu, bahlala belindile. Lokhu kusebenza kahle, ngoba kusiza ukunciphisa amathuba okuthi kube nezinkinga ezengeziwe. Ngemuva kokuthi iziguli zihlukaniswe, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukwazi ukusiza iziguli ngokushesha. Abahlengikazi bahlala beqeqeshwe ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benzeni, futhi bangasebenzisa imishanguzo ethile ukuze basize iziguli ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Kodwa, akukhona konke okukhona, ngoba izimo eziphuthumayo zingaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi kufanele bahlale bephuthumekile futhi bazi ukuthi bangabiza kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benzeni uma behlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya izithuthi ezisheshayo, imishanguzo, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Uma izibhedlela zinganikeza lezi zinsiza, kuzoba nzima ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Kukhona futhi udaba lokuxhumana. Uma umuntu efika esibhedlela, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zesibhedlela neziguli. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi iziguli ziyaqonda ukuthi yini eyenzekayo, futhi zazi ukuthi zikhona izinqubo ezithile ezilandelwayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuqonda ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela ziye zashintsha. Imikhuba emisha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuphatha iziguli ziye zafika. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kusiza ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi iziguli zithola usizo oluphuthumayo ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Ngokuphetha, izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezimo, ukuphatha iziguli, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezanele, konke kubalulekile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo kulolu daba, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abanye uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngiyabonga!
