Lapho efile, sazi ukuthi uMama Adelaide Tambo usanda kukhishwa esibhedlela. Nokho, saphinda sagcizelela ukuthi wayenomphefumulo wokubekezela nokufuna okuqinile ukuqhubeka nokuphila phakathi kwethu. Sihlose ukumamukela yena kanye namalungu omndeni wakhe njengababukeli emcimbini ngenyanga kaFebhuwari, kodwa lokho akuphumelelanga. Kusasa sizokwenza ukuhlonipha okokugcina njengoba simfaka emathuneni. Ngakho, uzobe ekhona nathi emoyeni ngenyanga ka-Okthoba kulo nyaka njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lokuzalwa kukayise, owayezobe eshaya iminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye, ubaba bezingane zakhe, umngane wakhe, umlingani wakhe, kanye nezingane ezidumile zethu, u-Oliver Reginald Tambo. Sizophinde sikhulumele umndeni wakwaTambo. Ngiyajabula futhi ukumukela uMama ophakanyisiwe u-Albertina Luthuli, okhona phakathi kwethu namuhla ekuseni. Ung daughter kaChief Albert Luthuli, owawuqala ukuthola iNobel Peace Prize emhlabeni. Ukufa okudabukisayo kukaChief Luthuli, eminyakeni engamashumi amane edlule, kukhunjulwa kulo nyaka, futhi usizi lwaleso sikhathi lwazwakala lapho sathola ukuthi ushaye umshini ophumayo emapulazini esukari eKwaDukuza. Ukufa kwakhe bekuyimfihlo futhi kwashaqisa nomzimba, kodwa impilo yakhe bekuyisibonelo esikhulu esasisiholela enkululekweni esibhiyozela namuhla. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ekhululekile inombono ocacile wokubonga ngalokho uAlbert Luthuli noOliver Tambo abakwenze ezweni lethu ngokusungula izimiso ezimbili zendawo ukuze kuhlonishwe amaqhawe - isimiso sikaLuthuli kanye nesimiso sabangane bakaO.R. Tambo. Ngiyaziqhenya futhi kulabo abamukelwe kulezi zimiso ezihloniphekile zendawo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukumukela ezindlini zephalamende labo ababe nomsebenzi ngonyaka ka-1956 lapho omama bephikisana nemithetho yokuphasa, nalabo ababe khona ngesikhathi uhlelo lwe-apartheid luphikiswa ngonyaka ka-1976, behlezi endaweni elungiselelwe umongameli. Angikhohlwa izindaba eziphonsa inhliziyo ezivela ezweni lethu ezivela kuzo zonke izifunda, ezikhethwe ngabakhulumeli bezifunda ukuze zabelane nezivakashi ezibalulekile phakathi kwethu. Uhulumeni wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika engikhuluma nawo lapha namuhla, njengoba ngibe nenhlanhla yokwenza kanjalo eminyakeni edlule, wasungulwa ngo-2004 ngemuva kokhetho olwenziwa ngalolo nyaka. Emhlanganweni wonyaka, ngenyanga kaJanuwari, umkhandlu wombuso kazwelonke, ophakeme kakhulu esifundazweni, uthole isikhathi sokucabanga ukuthi imihlangano yawo ibonisa ukuthi manje isendimeni yombuso okhethwe ngo-2004. Angithi ngithi kini ukuthi sithole inhlanhla yokuhola lo mkhandlu. Ekuzwiseni lokhu, kubonakala kufanelekile ukuthi sibuze lo mbuzo - ingabe kukhona intuthuko esiyenzile ekutshaliseni ukuze sifeze izinhloso esakhuluma ngazo emphakathini ukuthi sizofezani ngezithembiso esizenzile, ukuthi abantu bethu basinikeze amandla okuphatha izwe lethu kusukela ngo-2004 kuze kube sekukhethweni okulandelayo ngo-2009? Ngemvume yenu, ngithanda ukubuyela emuva futhi ngikhumbuze lokho esakukhuluma ngo-2004, njengabaholi benhlangano, phambi kwabokufika bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, sabuthana endaweni yokuhlangana kukahulumeni e-Union Building eTshwane ngosuku lokukhululeka, usuku esikhumbula ngalo inkululeko yethu eminyakeni eyishumi, futhi saphinde sajoyina isizwe ekubekeni umongameli wokuqala wombuso wentando yeningi, owakhethwe yiphalamende lethu, ukuze kuhlonishwe iz interests zesizwe ezikhonjiswe kokhetho luka-2004. Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibe nekhaya elinokuphila, futhi iphinde yakhombisa kahle futhi ibhujiswe emphakathini. Iphakathi lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uthwala ukwesaba nokucasuka okufihlekile... Iphakathi lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phansi futhi ifaka ubuhle komunye umhlaba onemigwaqo ehlanganayo, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo opholile nothando. Iphakathi lapho ukuphila endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuze bakuphathise, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezophathwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi ukuphila kwabo ngeke kube kuhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuhlinzwa nokulwa okungenasizathu phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iphakathi lapho kukhombisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingadi eziphakeme, imigoqo kagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amaphoyisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo abawubaba bethu ngezikhali, nezikhali ezifihliwe ezihlahleni, kanye namahhelikopta azoshaya ukufa kulabo abaphazamisa ubaba... Kusikhuthaza ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ngesizathu, nendlela yomuntu yokubambisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafanayo. Izinkinga eziphuthumayo zokuphila kwabantu ngeke zixazululwe uma singakhethi amathuba emisebenzi, nokunciphisa noma ukususa ubuphofu phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, ukunciphisa izinga lobugebengu, ukufundisa abantu ukufunda nokubhala, nokuvula amathuba okufunda nezindlela zamasiko... sithi kuzo zonke iziqhawe zethu nezifazane ezithobekile ezazinikele ekufezeni inkululeko, kanye nawe bangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke sikhokhele ithemba elibekwe kithi ngenkathi nisekela ukusiguqula iNingizimu Afrika ibe yintando yeningi, umhlaba wokuthula, lapho kungabikho ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, noma ngohlobo, umhlaba ophumelelayo, ozinikele ezithakazelweni zokuhlanganiswa kwabantu. "Umsebenzi wokwakha le Ningizimu Afrika uqale. Lo msebenzi uzoqhubeka kulesi sikhathi sesibili sokukhululeka kwethu." Emashumini eminyaka adlule, ngenkathi silungiselela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owawamukela i-charter yokukhululeka, izindaba eziphonsa inhliziyo zalolo suku zathi Masikhulume sonke, ama-Afrika, labo abavela eYurophu, amaNdiya kanye nabantu abamnyama, bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, masikhulume sonke ngokukhululeka, masikhulume ngenjabulo evela kubantu abaphila ezweni elikhululekile. Namuhla kufanele sibuye sithumele isithembiso sethu, kufanele sikhulume sonke ngokukhululeka, kufanele sisebenze ezikhulumweni ukuze
Ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezentengiselwano Kwamazwe Ngamazwe, uMthetho 71 ka-2002, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni angase, uma kubhekwa ukuthi kuyadingeka noma kuyinzuzo kulomphakathi, ngesenzo esithunyelwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, akhombise ukuthi akukho goods ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuluma ngohlobo oluthile noma uhlobo oluthile olungangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika; noma lungangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika kuphela ngenkululeko yakhe noma ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe kumvume onikezwe yena noma ngumuntu onikezwe igunya nguye. Izicelo zemvume zokungenisa goods, goods eziphethwe ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwezimpahla kufanele zithunyelwe kufomu elibekiwe. Inhloso yalesi sevisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezisetshenzisiwe ezingenisiwe aziphuli umkhakha weSouthern African Customs Union. Le nqubo iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukulawulwa kwezempilo kwemvelo kanye nezizathu zokuphepha, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nezindinganiso, kanye nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokuhambisana nezizathu zemvelo. Amafomu wezicelo kufanele agcwaliswe futhi athunyelwe. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Kungani kukhona izinsuku zabafuyi nezifundo zokubonisa? Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabafuyi luhloselwe ukuvuselela nokuphatha abafuyi abancane ukuze babe izibonelo neziboniso lapho abafuyi bengabona usizo olukhona uma umhlabathi ulungisiwe kahle, uma umanyolo ofanele ufakwa, uma uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nomhlabathi nesimo sezulu saleyo ndawo kukhethwa, uma izilokazane nezifo ziphathwa kahle, futhi uma ukuvuna kwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Uma izindawo zokubonisa zisungulwa, kubalulekile ukuthi abakhiqizi abasha abasondelene naleyo ndawo bakwazi ukubona konke okukhona mayelana nokutshala nokubheka izitshalo ezizotshalwa kulezo zindawo. Izinsuku zabafuyi zinikeza abafuyi ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abafuyi, nezinkampani ezinikeza izinto zokutshala, kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza embonini - abafuyi bathola ulwazi oluningi kulezi zinsuku zabafuyi. ULawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa wayenazo izinsuku ezine zabafuyi abancane. Phakathi nalezi zinsuku zabafuyi, izihloko ezahlukene zaxoxwa. Umshuwalense wokuqala wokufuya. Kulolu hlelo, sizama ukubringela abantu abaningi abahlukene abasebenza ebhizinisini lezolimo ukuze basekele abakhiqizi - banezindawo zabo ezithile futhi banikeza ulwazi olunenzuzo. Kumele kube nokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke lezi zenzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe intuthuko phambili kokwakha ikusasa elizinzile.
Ama-Orlando Pirates: Uhambo Lwenjabulo Nezinkanyezi Zomhlaba Ekhaya lemidlalweni, lapho umoya wezemidlalo uthokozisa khona, khona lapho sithola khona ama-Orlando Pirates, iqembu elidume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinkanyezi zikaMhlaba ziqale uhambo lwazo eminyakeni engama-1937, lapho abalandeli bejabulisa khona izinkanyezi ezazizokwakha umlando omkhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, abalandeli baziwa ngokuthi "amaBuccaneers," igama elihambisana nesibindi, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokulwa. Uhambo lwamaPirates lwalugcwele izinselelo, kodwa futhi lwalugcwele nezinselelo ezinkulu. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho iqembu lalahlekelwa yizicoco, kodwa abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, amaPirates akhombisa amandla awo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaleso sikhathi, aqhuba umjaho ophakeme, abamba iCAF Champions League, okuyinto eyayiyinsakavukela. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlonishwa, lapho abalandeli behlabelela, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Kwakungesikhathi lapho umoya wokuhlanganyela wawubhalwe phansi emlandweni, futhi abalandeli baziwa ngokuthi "iPirates Family," umndeni owawuhlangene ngothando lweqembu. Ngesikhathi amaPirates edlula eminyakeni, kwavela izinkanyezi eziningi ezazizokhumbuleka. UBenni McCarthy, uTico Tico, noThabo Matlaba, bonke babengabalingisi abakhulu abashaya izinkanyezi emkhakheni wezokudlala. UBenni, ikakhulukazi, waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungakha kanjani izinkanyezi ezinkulu. Uthando lwakhe lweqembu lwakha umoya ophilayo, futhi abalandeli bahlala bemkhumbula. Kodwa, njengokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaPirates abhekana nezinselelo ezinzima. Ukuncintisana okukhulayo phakathi kwamanye amaqembu, kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wezokudlala, kwaholela ekutheni iqembu libe nezinselelo zokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Nokho, abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Ngonyaka ka-2020, amaPirates abuyela emuva, ethola umphumela omuhle emqhudelwaneni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubuyisela ithemba, lapho abalandeli bahlabelela, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Uthando lweqembu lwakha umoya ophilayo, futhi abalandeli baziwa ngokuthi "amaBuccaneers," umndeni owawuhlanganyela ngothando lweqembu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaPirates aqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Uhambo lwama-Orlando Pirates luhlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili. Abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, ama-Orlando Pirates awaqhubeki nje kuphela njengamaqembu, kodwa njengomndeni, umndeni owawuhlanganyela ngothando lweqembu. Uhambo lwabo luhlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili, futhi abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kuyisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona amaPirates edlala, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyisiko, kuyisiko elihlanganyela abantu, elihlanganyela umphakathi, elihlanganyela uthando. Ama-Orlando Pirates, iqembu elidume kakhulu, lihlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili, futhi abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo.
Ezentela: Izigaba Eziyinhloko Zokuhleleka Kwezentela Isingeniso Ezwenikazi lethu, ezentela zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukukhokha intela ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zomthetho ezihambisana nalezi zinyathelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizosisiza bonke abantu, kanye nezinkampani, ukuba bazi kahle izidingo zabo zokuhlinzeka ngezentela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izinhlobo Nezincazelo Zezentela Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinhlobo ezahlukene zezintela. Zikhona izintela eziningi ezifana ne-intela yemihla-nemihla, intela yezimpahla, kanye ne-intela yokudluliswa. Umuntu ngamunye nesikhungo sakhe kufanele aqonde ukuthi iyiphi intela efanele kumkhiqizo wabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekubhaleni nasekukhokheni intela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Izikhumbuzo Zokukhokha Ngemva kokuthi umuntu eqonde kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izikhumbuzo zokukhokha intela. Lokhu kungaba ukufaka izikhumbuzo ezibhaliwe, ukuze umuntu abe nesibopho sokukhokha ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezithile. Lokhu kuzovikela izinkinga ezingase zivele ngenxa yokuhoxiswa kwemali. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlela Imibiko Ngomthetho Ngemuva kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlela imibiko yezintela. Umuntu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi imibiko ibonisa kahle zonke izimali ezitholakele nezindleko ezikhokhelwe, futhi ibhalwe kahle. Ukubhalwa kwamadokhumenti kufanele kuhambisane nemithetho yokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi, ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubala Intela Yakho Manje sekuvele isikhathi sokubala intela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubala umholo, imithombo yezimali, nezindleko ezihambisana nomsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukufuna usizo kwezocwaningo uma ungazi kahle ukuthi ungabala kanjani intela yakho. Ungabuza abeluleki bezentela ukuze uthole izeluleko ezithile. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlinzekwa Kwedokhumenti Yokukhokha Ngemuva kokubala intela, umsebenzisi kufanele alungise uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti yokukhokha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuvele ukuthi ulandele imigomo efanele. Kubalulekile futhi ukugcina ikhophi yezenzo zokukhokha ukuze uqinisekise uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuhlola Izindleko Zokukhokha Ngemva kokukhokha, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi izindleko zokukhokha ziqhubekile ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi awuzange ungeze izindleko ezingekho emthethweni. Ukuze uqhubeke uthola okuhle, hlola izinqubo ezitholakalayo noma ushintshe amasu. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubika Ngemva Kokukhokha Ngemva kokukhokha, kubalulekile ukuthumela umbiko wezintela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga ezinkulu zingavikelwa esikhathini esizayo. Ukubika akubalulekile kuphela ukuze kuhlonishwe umthetho, kodwa futhi kunika ithuba lokubuyekeza izinqumo. Isiphetho Ezentela ziwusizo olukhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ukwazi izinyathelo ezihambisanayo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazicabangele ngokuqondile. Ngalezi zinyathelo ezichazwe kahle, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uthola okwakhe, futhi unika isandla ekwakheni umnotho wenhlalakahle. Ngakho, qhubeka uzibophele ukuze ube qotho ekubhalisweni nasekukhokheni ezentela, ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela empumelelweni enkulu.
Ukufuduka Kwezakhamuzi Emakhaya Baya Emadolobheni Isingeniso UThandiwe Mthembu ungumama osehlale emzaneni omncane eMpumalanga. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi ezintsha selwandile emakhaya, njengoba abanye bezama ukuthola amathuba angcono ezimpilweni zabo. Ukufuduka kwabantu emakhaya baye emadolobheni, njengokwenziwa nguThandiwe, sekuyinto evamile, kubonisa ushintsho olukhulu kwindlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Impilo Yasekhaya UTandiwe wazalelwa ezweni elinokuthula, ehlathini lamadolo, lapho umoya uphumelelisa khona izinyoni nezinkanyezi. Uthando lwezinkuni ezithokozisayo, imifino emnandi, nemifula ecwebile, kuhlotshaniswa nezinkumbulo ezinhle zokukhula. Nokho, impilo emakhaya ibinobunzima. Izinsiza zikhona kodwa zidinga ukuba kusebenze kanzima ukuze zifezekiswe. Abantu bahlala bencintisana nezinye izindawo ukuze bathole imali eyengeziwe, kodwa imiphumela ayihlali ibonakala. Isinqumo Sokufuduka Ngemva kokuhlala emakhaya iminyaka engu-30, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi uhlelo lokuphila lwayo lwenza kube nzima ukuthola okuthile okuhlobene nezidingo zansuku zonke. Imindeni eminingi ibiyathola isikhala sokuhlala, isikhungo sokuthengisa, nezinsiza zokunakekela izingane. Kodwa-ke, ukufuduka emadolobheni akusiyona indlela elula. UThandiwe wanquma ukuthatha leli qhaza, ehamba nabantwana bakhe ababili, uSihle noThando, ukuze baphile kahle. Uhambo Lwakhe Ukuhamba kwabo kwaba nezinselelo. UThandiwe, oneminyaka engama-38, wajoyina abanye abahambi bephuma emakhaya baye emadolobheni. Bahamba ngezinyawo, baphuma emzansi eMpumalanga, baye eThekwini. Ubuya nezinkumbulo ezinhle nezinsizi ezinzima. Uhambo lwabo lwalunezikhathi zokukhathazeka, kodwa futhi nemizwelo yokuthokozisa. Ukufuduka akusiyo nje impilo, kodwa kuyingxenye yesiko lokuphila kwabantu. Izifundo Ezitholakele E-Joburg, uThandiwe wathola izifundo eziningi. Wenza imisebenzi emincane yokuhlanza nezinsiza zokudla, kodwa wahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Abantu bejolise kumsebenzi ophakeme, kodwa uThandiwe wahamba phambili. Wafunda ukuthi ukuhamba emadolobheni kudinga ukuthembela emandleni akho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona — impilo ayilula, kodwa iyasebenza. Imiphumela Yokufuduka Njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka, uThandiwe wathola umsebenzi osezingeni eliphezulu. Noma kunjalo, ukuphila emadolobheni kwaba nezinkinga. Abantwana bakhe bahlala bezama ukufunda ezikoleni, kodwa uThandiwe ubona ukuthi kunezinkinga eziningi abavela emakhaya abahlangabezana nazo. Ubuye azwe ubuhlungu bokuphila ngaphandle kwendlu yabo, kudinga isinyathelo sokwakha imiphakathi. Izindlela Zokuphila Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe waba nephupho lokwakha umphakathi wezakhamizi ezivela emakhaya. Waqala ukuhlanganyela nezinye izimuli, benza imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu abavela emakhaya bangenza umehluko kumphakathi. Bazokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, bahlale besekela omunye nomunye, baphinde bahlanganyele. Isiphetho UThandiwe Mthembu uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangakwenza kanjani ukufuduka emakhaya baye emadolobheni. Ubuye athole izifundo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuphila, ubudlelwano, nomnotho. Ukufuduka akusiyona nje ukukhipha umuntu endaweni ethile, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo engcono. UThandiwe ubona ukuzithoba njengendlela yempumelelo, ethokozisa, futhi evuma ukuthi ukufuduka kuyinselelo, kodwa kudinga isibindi nokuhlakanipha. Uthando lwakhe lwazaleka emakhaya, futhi luhlala lukhona, kubonisa ukuthi noma naphakathi kwezinkinga, abantu banamandla okuphila, baphila, futhi bakha.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS Ekuqaleni kweminyaka ye-2000, izinhlelo zokwelashwa zashintsha ngokukhulu. Umphakathi wawudinga izixazululo ezithile ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavulwa i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS), uhlelo lokwelashwa olwakhelwe ngempela ukuze lusebenze kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezithuthukile, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu ngenxa yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kodwa lokhu kwaholela ekubeni nemibuzo eminingi mayelana nokufaneleka kwabantu kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni babefuna ukuqonda kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezithile, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemigomo ethile yokunquma ukufaneleka. Ukwenziwa kwemigomo yokunquma ukufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile. Kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nezindlela ezicacile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu ukuthi baqonde kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwamadokhumenti ahlukanisayo, aphakamisa izimfuno ezithile okufanele zifezekiswe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujabulisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kwahlanganisa izinga lemfundo, iminyaka yokusebenza, kanye nezinye izimo ezithinta ukufaneleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yahlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola ukufaneleka. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kubo yini. Umphakathi wawudinga ukwazi ukuthi izinzuzo ezifana nezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa zikhona yini kubo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola, ezazisiza abasebenzi ukuthi baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe zafaka phakathi ama-workshops, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kwathuthukisa ukwazi kwabantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ze-GEMS, futhi kwavumela abantu ukuba bakwazi ukusebenzisa izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Nokho, nakuba i-GEMS yayihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, kwavela izinselelo ezithile. Abanye abantu babebhekene nezithiyo ezithile zokufaneleka, okuholela ekutheni bangakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezazifunwa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethile yokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene banethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, i-GEMS yahlala ihlola izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izinzuzo zifinyeleleka kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo zayo kwavumela i-GEMS ukuba ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokufaneleka ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuhlola, ezazisiza abantu ukuthi baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS yaziwa kakhulu ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezithile, i-GEMS yahlala ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ekugcineni, ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile emlandweni wezokwelapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. I-GEMS ibonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha izixazululo ezinhle ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ukukhula kwe-GEMS kubonisa ukuthi umphakathi unethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezithuthukile, futhi lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi umsebenzi omuhle ungakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Iyini iWater Users Association (WUA)? I-WUA iyinhlangano esemthethweni eyasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. I-WUA iyiqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi ngabanye abahlanganyela ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi ukuze benze kahle. Ikhompiyutha yokuphatha inezibopho ze-WUA. Inhloso ye-WUA ukuvumela abantu emiphakathini ukuba bahlele izinsiza zabo (imali, abantu, kanye nobuchwepheshe) ukuze benze kahle imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi. Ngaphakathi kwe-WUA, amalungu angabhekana nezidingo zendawo futhi abeke phambili kulolu hlu. I-WUA isebenza ezingeni lendawo enomkhawulo ochaziwe. I-WUA ingahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuphatha izinsiza zomfula ezingeni lendawo. Ama-WUA adlala indima ebalulekile ekunciphiseni indlala nasekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla. I-WUA iyisikhungo esisemthethweni esinokwakhiwa okuphelele, futhi lezo zikhono zinganikezwa kuphela kumuntu noma isikhungo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-WUA ingenza zonke izenzo umuntu angazenza, njengokuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange, ukungena ezivumelwaneni nabahlinzeki nababolekisi. I-WUA ingabamba icala noma ibanjwe icala yinhlangano ethile. UMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke kanye nomthethosivivinywa we-WUA kulawula ukuphathwa nokusebenza kwale nhlangano. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokusungulwa kwe-WUA kunoma yisiphi isimo sokusetshenziswa kwamanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho. Nokho, kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-WUA ezingasungulwa, i-WUA yomsebenzisi oyedwa kanye ne-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi. I-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi ihlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu abahlukene abasebenzisa amanzi, njengokulima, ukuhweba, ukukhiqiza, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya. I-WUA isungulwa nguNgqongqoshe kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kuMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe angafuna ukuhlinzeka ngezisebenzi, ukuphatha, nokubhekelela uhlelo lukamasipala emphakathini wendawo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma uhlelo luhlelwe ukusiza leyo miphakathi futhi lungaphathwa kahle yi-WUA efanele. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukweseka imizamo yezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngokuzinzisa abalimi abasha noma ngokuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi okutshala ukudla. Lapho kukhona ukuthuthukiswa okungahambisani, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi i-WUA isebenze njengendlela yokuphatha engcono futhi igweme izingxabano ezingase zibe khona. I-WUA isungulwa ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi. Uma uNgqongqoshe exhumana nomphakathi, izindleko zokuxhumana zingabuyiselwa uma i-WUA isunguliwe. I-WUA eyasungulwa ngenhloso ethile ivamise ukusungulwa ngemva kokuthi kube nephakamiso elenziwe kuNgqongqoshe ngababhekene nakho. UNgqongqoshe angase afune umuntu noma inhlangano ukuthi ithumele iphakamiso lokuhlinzeka ngezindleko zokuxhumana nomphakathi ngaphambi. Noma iyiphi uhlobo noma iqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi lingathumela iphakamiso kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kusungulwe i-WUA. UMsunguli-Jikelele weMnyango Wezamanzi Nezihlahla angasiza abasebenzisi bamanzi ekubhaleni iphakamiso. Yini okufanele ifakwe ephakamisweni? Incazelo yokuthi yisiphi isixhumanisi esithathwe ukuze kudalwe iphakamiso kanye nemiphumela yalokho. Yisiphi isixhumanisi esitholakele? Yini eyatholakala? Nini uNgqongqoshe azovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA? UNgqongqoshe uzovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA uma ikhulisa izinhloso ezibekiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. Futhi ukuvikela indawo yokuhlala kwezilwane zasemanzini. Iphakamiso yokusungula i-WUA kufanele ihambisane neMisebenzi Yokuphatha Izinsiza Zomfula ye-CMA. Enye indaba okufanele ifakwe yisivumelwano esiphakanyisiwe se-WUA. UMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke uchaza zonke izindaba okufanele zixazululwe esivumelwaneni se-WUA. Lo Mthetho (Isheduli 5) uphinde uhlanganise imodeli yesivumelwano esingasetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa isisekelo somthetho. Nakuba isisekelo somthetho se-WUA singabandakanya imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, lokhu akusho ukuthi i-WUA izoba nazo zonke lezi zisebenzi uma isunguliwe. Abafaka isicelo sokusungula i-WUA kufanele, njengengxenye yenqubo yokusungula, bacela ngokusemthethweni ukuba bathunyelwe ku-WUA. Lokhu kungafakwa emqulwini ohambisana nephakamiso uma ithunyelwa. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukuthi izindaba ezengeziwe zibe khona esivumelwaneni se-WUA. Lezi zindaba kufanele zamukelwe ngamalungu enhlangano futhi ziqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphambi kokuthi i-WUA ikwazi ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izikhono noma ukwenza noma yiziphi izisebenzi. ngokuchaza indawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngesimo nenani lamanzi okufanele aphathwe, kanye nezikhono nemisebenzi ezodingeka ukuthi zidluliselwe ku-WUA. Emiphakathini engekho namandla okuhlela nokwenza amalungiselelo adingekayo enhlangano. Ikakhulukazi, usizo lungahlinzekwa lapho ukuthuthukiswa kudingeka ukukhuthazwa ngokusungula i-WUA (njengoba kwenzelwa abalimi abasha). Zonke izikhungo zokulima namabhodi amanzi abekade ekhona ngaphambi kokuqala komthetho kufanele aguqulwe zibe yi-WUA. Amabhodi amanzi athile asunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi ukuze akwazi ukulima nawo azoguqulwa abe yi-WUA. Ukuhunyushwa kwamabhodi amanzi kusho ukuthi kufanele baphinde basungule izindawo zabo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze bamele kahle ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kuleyo ndawo, ngokwezizinda nezobulili. INingizimu Afrika inembali yokufinyelela ezinsizeni ngokungafani. Ukuguqulwa kuyindlela eyodwa yokufeza ubulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uphumelele imihlahlandlela yokusungula ikomidi lokuphatha le bhodi yokulima eguquliwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-WUA ibe nezezimali ezizimele ukuze iphumelele. Ukusungulwa kwe-WUA kungenzeka kuphela uma amalungu ekwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokusungula i-WUA kanye nezindleko zokusebenza nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi emikhulu ephathelene ne-WUA. Ngakho-ke, i-WUA ivamise ukuxhaswa ngezimali ezikhokhwa kumalungu ezaziwa ngokuthi "izindleko zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi." Ezinye izinsiza ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zosizo nokuxhaswa kwezimali okuvela kubaxhasi. I-WUA ingabuyekeza izindleko ezikhokhwa minyaka yonke kumalungu ayo uma isivumelwano sayo sinikeza lokhu. Lezi zindleko kufanele zihambisane nesu lokubiza lokusetshenziswa kwamanzi elibekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angahlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ku-WUA ukuze afinyelele izinhloso zomthetho wezamanzi kazwelonke (ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthetho ezibekwe ngaphansi komthetho). Umnyango uthuthukise inqubomgomo yokuhlinzeka ngosizo ezinhlelweni ezikhona noma ezintsha zezigaba ezithintekayo zomlando ezilungiselelwe abanye abahlali be-WUA. Isidingo sokuv
Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi: Ukuhlola Uhlelo Olusha Lokufunda Kulezi zinsuku, imali yokufunda ihamba phambili ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene. Enye yezi zindlela ezithandwayo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabafundi, iwukufunda nge-inthanethi. Le ndlela yokufunda iyakhanga futhi iyahambisana nezidingo zesikhathi sethu samanje, ikakhulukazi njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Kulokhu, sizobheka ukufunda nge-inthanethi ngokubona okwehlukeneyo, izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenzisa le ndlela. Ukwethula Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungenye yezindlela eziphawulekayo emakolishi nasezikoleni. Lolu hlelo lwakha ithuba lokufunda ngemfundo ngokusebenzisa amahlelo e-inthanethi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba abafundi bangenza izifundo zabo bahlala bezazi ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuhlonzwe kahle, kulungile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akuhambisani nekhono lokufunda kuphela, kodwa futhi kushayelela abafundi ukuba basebenzise izinsiza eziphathelene nezimfundo ezikhona ku-inthanethi. Izinzuzo Zokufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokufunda nge-inthanethi ukukwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza eziningi. Abafundi bangakwazi ukufundiswa ithuluzi elisha lesimanje – i-inthanethi – ngokusebenzisa imithombo ethile efana nezifundo ezikwividiyo, izincwadi ze-elektroniki, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda. Lokhu kukhulisa umngani abangawutholi uma befunda ngendlela yephephabhuku noma ezikhungweni zomfundo. Ngokwengeziwe, okufundwayo ku-inthanethi kudinga ukuzikhandla kakhulu. Abafundi banikwe ithuba lokuphendukela emithonjeni engcono ukuzibonela. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhuphule izinga labo lokufunda ngoba bangakhetha lokho abakuthandayo. Njengoba abafundi besebenzisa imeyili, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemicimbi yeziqu, bangafunda babe nezifundo ezikhethekile kalula, bheka uhlelo lwabo futhi bathole izimpendulo ezithile. Izinkinga Ezingavela Ngokufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Noma kunjalo, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunezinselelo zayo. Enye yezi zinkinga ezidumile ukuthi abafundi bangenza ukungasebenzi kahle njengoba bekhuthazwa ukwazi ukusebenza ngebhodi yokuxhumana. Ukungabi khona komphakathi wesikole, okuyikhulu elikhulu, kungabanga khona ukuthi abanye abafundi bazizwe begqokile kakhulu. Ukusetshenziswa koshintsho lwezinhlelo zokusebenza nazokuxhumana kungenza kube nzima bacacise imiqondo ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithunzi yamakhono ephezulu iyadingeka ukuze ufunde kahle kulezi zimo. Abafundi badinga amandla okuphatha isikhathi, ukugxila, nokuphendula imibuzo ezothusayo ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela cishe okungaphezulu kunokufunda okwenzeka endaweni yebhodi. Ukwengeza: Izingxenye Zokwenza Imfundo Ye-Inthanethi Ikhule Ukuze uthole impendulo efanele kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bakhuthazwe ukuba badlule imikhawulo, bakhulise amazinga abantu abahlinzeki, futhi benze izivumelwano ezihambelana nezinhloso. Ukuze kube nezifundo eziphumelelayo, kuhloko ezimeni ezikhethekile, kuyasiza ukuhlela izinhlelo ezinqunyiweyo, kugcizelelwe abaphathi bezemfundo. Uhlaka olusebenza kahle kumele luhlanganise zokugcina uhlanga lwezimo ezahlukene nabafundi. Njengoba imfundo ye-inthanethi ikhulisa amathuba, kumele kube kube nesikhathi sokuxhumana nokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, ukuze kudaleke indawo yokufunda eqinile. Umqondo Wokugcina: Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Njengemfundo Ephuhlisayo Ekugcineni, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungaphathwa njengendlela ethokozisayo yokufunda, eyandulelayo ekufundeni kwabafundi namuhla. Njengoba sivele besithole izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, kufanele sihloniphe ukukhetha ubuchwepheshe esibutholayo. Kumele silungise izifundo zethu ukuze sikhulise ukukhula kwethu siqhubeke nobunjalo obuphumelelayo. Ngalo mkhuba, le ndlela yokufunda uzokhulisa umfundi, imfundo yethu namuhla iyinsika yokuhlela impilo yazo zokuyivuma emiphumeleni engokwenziwa. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyithuba elimangalisayo, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle ngayo yonke imikhakha yempilo.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery 1. Isingeniso Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery uqala ngonyaka ka-2015, lapho kwavulwa khona ithuba lokwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela eMthombeni, eNingizimu Afrika. Le phrojekthi yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokucubungula uwoyela, ukunciphisa ukuncika emithonjeni yangaphandle, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi endaweni. 2. Ukuhlaziywa Kwezidingo Ngaphambi kokuqala iphrojekthi, kwenziwa ukuhlaziywa kwezidingo ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi, izimfuneko zokuphepha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izinsiza zomhlaba, izinsiza zezimali, kanye nezinsiza zabasebenzi. Ukuhlaziywa kwaphinde kwagxila ekutheni izinga lokucubungula uwoyela elidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zendawo. 3. Ukuthola Imvume Ngemuva kokuhlaziywa kwezidingo, kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthola imvume yokwakha. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana nezikhungo zikamasipala, iziphathimandla zezokuphepha, kanye nezinhlangano eziphathelene nezokuhlala. Imibiko yokuhlola imvelo (EIA) yathuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi izohambisana nemithetho yokuvikela imvelo. 4. Ukukhetha Indawo Indawo yokwakha yeMthombo Oil Refinery yakhethwa ngokucophelela, ibhekwa izici ezifana nokufinyeleleka, izinsiza zamanzi, kanye nokuphuma kwemikhiqizo. Iphrojekthi yakhetha indawo ethile eMthombeni, eyayihlangabezana nezidingo ezibekiwe. 5. Ukuhlela Iphrojekthi Ngemuva kokukhetha indawo, kwenziwa ukuhlela kwephrojekthi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha uhlelo lwezindleko, isikhathi sokwakha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Izinkampani ezahlukene zatholakala ukuze zibe yingxenye yephrojekthi, kuhlanganise nabakhi, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nezinkampani zokuhlola. 6. Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhiwo Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo kuqala ngonyaka ka-2018, lapho kwavulwa khona izikhungo zokwakha. Izinsiza eziningi zatholakala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukwakhiwa kuhamba kahle. Izinyathelo zokuphepha zazibhekwa ngokuqinile, futhi abaqashi bahlola izinga lokusebenza. 7. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi Ngaphambi kokusebenza kweMthombo Oil Refinery, kwenziwa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kuhilela ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokusebenza, izinqubo zokuphepha, kanye nezidingo zokusebenza. Ukuqeqeshwa kwaba yimpumelelo, futhi abasebenzi baziswa ngokuqhubekayo ngezinguquko ezithinta umsebenzi. 8. Ukuqala Kokusebenza Ngonyaka ka-2020, iMthombo Oil Refinery yaqala ukusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umkhiqizo wokuqala uwoyela ube uphume. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusebenza kuhamba kahle, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kwezinga lokusebenza, izinga lokuphepha, kanye nezinga lokukhiqiza. 9. Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi Uphathwa kwephrojekthi kwenziwa ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziyaqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izindleko, kanye nezikhathi zokusebenza zaphathwa ngokuqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iphrojekthi ibhekelele izinjongo zayo. 10. Ukubuyekezwa Nokuhlola Ngemuva kokusebenza kweminyaka emibili, kwenziwa ukubuyekezwa kwephrojekthi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola ukusebenza kweMthombo Oil Refinery, izinga lokukhiqiza, kanye nezindleko. Imiphumela yokubuyekezwa yatholakala, futhi izinyathelo zathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza. 11. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yathuthukiswa ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezintsha, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokusebenza, kanye nokwandisa ukukhiqiza. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa zathuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iMthombo Oil Refinery ihlala ibalulekile emnothweni. 12. Isiphetho Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa indlela yokwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela esiphumelelayo. Ngokuqhubeka kokusebenza, le phrojekthi ibonisa ukuthi ingaba yisibonelo sokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yephrojekthi.
Noma ngabe ukudla kuphisiwe, izivakashi kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi kuphisiwe kahle futhi kusemisha. Ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, izinhlanzi ezahlukene nezilwane zasemanzini zingaba ne-toxins eziyingozi ezingathinta impilo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziphisiwe kahle. Kumele kufunwe iseluleko ezikhungweni zezempilo zendawo mayelana nalezi zilwane eziyingozi. Ngaphandle kokuthi, ukubukeka kokudla akukhombisi ukuphepha kwako, futhi ukudla okune-toxin kungaba mnandi. Uma kukhona indlela yokugwema ukudla okungaphephile, izinga elincane lokudla linganciphisa ingozi yokuphefumula. Izivakashi zingakhetha ukuphuthelwa ukudla. ENingizimu Afrika, amanzi e-tap ngokuvamile aphephile ukuphuza. Nokho, uma othile evakashela ezindaweni zasemaphandleni isikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuthwala amanzi abotshiwe ezitsheni ezivaliwe. Amathablethi okucwenga amanzi atholakala ezitolo zokwelapha futhi kumele asetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo. Uma amanzi engase abe nezinhlayiya, izivakashi kufanele zixwayiswe ukuthi noma amanzi abotshiwe kumele abhekwane njengokungcolile futhi angasetshenziswanga ukuphuza. Gwema ukuxhumana kwezocansi nabanye abangabalingani abajwayelekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. I-virus ye-HIV iyinkinga enkulu njengamanje ngenxa yesikhathi esihlala egazini, okuholela ekudlulisweni okungathandeki nemiphumela yayo eyingozi. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezikhwama zokuvikela ngaphambi kokuhamba uma kudingeka. Uma ukuvaccine kudingeka, izivakashi kufanele zizamile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-vaccine nemithi kuvela ezipakisheni ezivaliwe zemithi ezihlanzekile. Abanokukhuluphala kufanele bathwale izikhali ezihlanzekile (ezihlanzekile) ngesikhathi sokuhamba futhi babe ne-authorization kadokotela yokuzisebenzisa. Ukuhlanzwa kwegazi kwenziwa ngokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika futhi akubeki ingozi ezivakashi. Akudingeki ukugcizelela izinguquko zokuziphatha nezinyathelo zokuphepha. Ukusebenzisa isikhwama sokuvikela kuyindlela enye yokuzivikela. I-malaria ingenye yezifo ezivamile ezibangelwa yiphilisi edluliselwa kumuntu ngomuntu ngokugwaza kwesikhukhukazi sohlobo lwe-Aedes Aegypti, oluhamba ne-malaria. Nakuba kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukudluliswa kwe-malaria kwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, isikhukhukazi esithwala lesi sifo sitholakala lapha. I-malaria ibonakala e-Afrika eningizimu-ntshonalanga, emaphakathi, nasempumalanga naseNingizimu Melika. I-ngozi yokuthola lesi sifo ingancishiswa ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezijwayelekile zokuvikela noma zokunciphisa ukugwazwa kwesikhukhukazi. Ukuvaccine: Ngokwemigomo yeMnyango Wezempilo Womhlaba, i-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyisicoco esisodwa esidingekayo sokuhamba emhlabeni jikelele. I-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyasebenza iminyaka eyishumi, iqala ezinsukwini eziyishumi ngemuva kokuvaccine. Ifunwa kubo bonke abahambi abaphezulu kweminyaka eyodwa. Umuntu ophuma endaweni lapho lesi sifo sikhona futhi engakavaccine angavinjwa ekungeneni ezweni noma agcinwe ngaphansi kokubhekwa okuncane kwezinsuku eziyisithupha uma eshintshela kungase kube nezithiyo. Izikhungo zokuhamba zizohlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe mayelana nalesi sifo nokuvaccine ngokumelene naso. Lesi sifo esibulalayo sitholwa ngamagciwane esiswini. Ukutheleleka ngalolu sifo kubangelwa ukuphuza amanzi nokudla okungcolile. Ukulawula kwalo kuhlala kuyinkinga yezempilo. Ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokutheleleka ngalolu sifo, izivakashi kufanele zibe nenhlonipho kakhulu ngalokho abakudlayo nakokho abakuphuza. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba zigweme ukuphuza amanzi angalungiswanga. Amanzi agcinwe ezitsha abotshiwe ayanconywa. I-blood flukes itholakala emhlabeni wonke futhi ibangelwa yizinyoka ezidla igazi labantu, impilo yazo iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ihlanganisa ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane zasemanzini ezibamba. Lezi zikhumbuzo zithola ukutheleleka ngalolu parasite ngenkathi umchamo nezinkanyezi zabantu abatholekile kulezi zinyoka zenza amanzi ahlanzekile angcoliswe. Lezi zikhumbuzo ezithintekile ngalolu parasite zenza ama-larvae amancane ahamba kalula futhi angangena emzimbeni ongekho evikelekile (ovulekile) womuntu emanzini angashisayo. Ukubhukuda emanzini angcolile kufanele kugwenywe. Ukubhukuda emanzini alungisiwe ngokuvamile kuphephile ngezikhathi zonke.
Ngokuvamile nangokwemvelo, intengo yomhlaba ihambisana nekhono lalomhlaba lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, abalimi basagcina umqondo wokuthi uma umhlabathi unokukhiqiza futhi ukhiqiza ukudla okuningi, sizokhokha intengo ethile. Ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwezinga lenzalo nakho kunomthelela ngoba abalimi abaningi balima ngemali ebolekiwe. Ukungena kwemali yokwakha izindlu nezinye izinto epulazini nakho kubangela intengo yamapulazi ukuthi ishintshe. Ungangena ezivumelwaneni nabanye abalimi ukuze wabelane ngempahla. Inzuzo izotholakala ngemuva kwesikhathi eside ngoba ihambisana nokukhuphuka kwentengo yomhlaba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Inzuzo ezotholakala ngemuva kwesikhathi eside ihambisana nenani lempahla engatholakala epulazini ethile, kodwa lokhu nakho kube nokushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokuvamile, intengo yamapulazi ikhuphukile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi manje sekucacile ukuthi umhlaba onokukhiqiza kahle usendleleni yabantu abambalwa. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena kwezolimo ukuthola umhlaba wokulima ngokushesha futhi bakhokhe ngenzuzo engatholakala. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka uma umhlaba ungatholakala ngezinhlawulo (LRAD), noma ifakwe, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngenzalo ephansi (njengoba kwenzeka njengamanje ngehlelo elisha elethulwe uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba elibizwa ngokuthi iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba sekushintshile; kwakuwayindlela yokungena kwezolimo kubalimi abasafufusa, kodwa manje sekuphenduke indlela yokuthi abalimi bezomnotho bathole umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo. Sidinga ukucabanga kahle ngalokhu ngoba kukhona umhlaba owanele ezandleni zomphakathi wonke ongasebenzisa, futhi kukhona abalimi abaningi abanobuchwepheshe abadinga umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze balime ngendlela ezokhiqiza inzuzo. Ukuqashwa kunikeza abalimi ithuba lokwandisa umsebenzi wabo kodwa akudingi imali eningi ehambisana nokuthenga nokuba nomhlaba. Khumbula: Kukhona izindlela zokungena kwezolimo ngaphandle kokuba umnikazi wombuso; ungakwazi ukuqasha ipulazi, usebenzise umhlaba womphakathi, noma wabelane ngalowo mhlaba nabanye abalimi.
Isingeniso Ama-drone, noma ama-quadcopters, ayizindiza ezincane ezilawulwa kude, ezithokozisa abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Zisetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela ezithombeni, ezokuphepha, kuze kube ezokuthutha. Kulokhu, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa ama-drone, izinyathelo zokuwathenga, nokuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukukhetha i-Drone Okokuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zama-drone ezikhona. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene, ezifana neziqondisi ezilula, ama-drone okuthwebula izithombe, kanye nama-drone anemisebenzi ethuthukile. Uma ungumqondisi, ungakhetha i-drone elula, kodwa uma uhlose ukuthwebula izithombe, khetha i-drone enekhamera esezingeni eliphezulu. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlole izibuyekezo nezilinganiso ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola umkhiqizo ofanele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuze Uthole Imvume Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-drone yakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda imithetho nemigomo yokusebenzisa ama-drone endaweni yakho. Ezinye izindawo zidinga imvume yokusebenzisa ama-drone, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zomphakathi noma eziseduze nezikhumulo zezindiza. Qiniseka ukuthi ufunda imithetho yendawo yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga zomthetho. Isinyathelo 3: Ukulungiselela Ukuhamba Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi i-drone yakho ilungile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Ukuhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri igcwele futhi ilungile. 2. Ukuhlola Izimpahla: Bheka ukuthi zonke izingxenye zisebenza kahle, kuhlanganise nezimpahla ezihambayo. 3. Ukubhalisela Uhlelo Lokusebenza: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-drone lukhona futhi luthuthukisiwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuphatha i-Drone Uma usulungele, ungakwazi ukuqala ukuhamba. Landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Thola Indawo Efanele: Khetha indawo enokuthula, ngaphandle kwabantu abaningi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha. 2. Qala i-Drone: Vula i-drone yakho futhi ulungise izilawuli. 3. Thola Isikhala Sokuhamba: Qiniseka ukuthi awuphumi emkhawulweni wezindiza noma ezindaweni ezivulekile. 4. Qala Ukuhamba: Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uqale ukuhamba. Qaphela izimo zomoya, njengoba umoya onamandla ungathinta ukuhamba kwe-drone. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuthwebula Izithombe Uma uhlose ukuthwebula izithombe, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Lungisa Ikhamera: Qiniseka ukuthi ikhamera isethwe kahle. 2. Thola Isikhala Esifanele: Khetha indawo enezindawo ezinhle zokuthwebula. 3. Thwebula Izithombe: Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uthwebule izithombe ezinhle. Ungasebenzisa izilungiselelo ezahlukene ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubuyisela i-Drone Ngemva kokuphothula ukuhamba, kubalulekile ukubuyisela i-drone yakho ngendlela efanele: 1. Phinda Uhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri isebenza kahle futhi uyayigcina. 2. Hlanza i-Drone: Susa uthuli noma amanzi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-drone yakho ihlanzekile. 3. Beka Indawo Ephephile: Gcina i-drone endaweni ephephile ukuze ivikeleke. Isiphetho Ama-drone ayithuluzi elinamandla elingasetshenziswa ngezindlela eziningi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukujabulela ukuhamba nge-drone yakho ngendlela ephephile futhi enempumelelo. Khumbula njalo ukuhlonipha imithetho nemigomo yokusebenzisa ama-drone, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyawasebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, ungathola ulwazi olujabulisayo nolwakha, futhi ube neziqephu ezinhle nezikhumbuzo ezinhle.
Indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu ifaka indawo ezungezile kanye nendawo uqobo, futhi ingaqhubeka ibe nendawo enkulu. Kulendawo engcwele, abacwaningi baqoqe ubufakazi ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuthi ubugebengu bukhona, befuna imikhondo futhi bayihlanganise nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Uma ubugebengu benzeka, ababulali bleave imikhondo endaweni ngokungena noma ukuphuma ngendlela ethile. Le ndlela iba ingxenye yendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu futhi iyindlela eqondile yokuxhuma nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Lapho amaphoyisa efika endaweni, awanalo uqiniseko oluphelele ngalokho okwenzekile. Ungasiza ekutholeni le ndawo engcwele ngokubheka zonke izindlela ezisetshenziswa ababulali. Ukuhlola ubugebengu kuhilela ukuqoqa ubufakazi bokwazi kanye nezimpawu ezibonakalayo. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo bungaba impahla noma izinto ezithile ezingasetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa ukuze axazulule icala. Amaphoyisa asebenzisa isibonelo sokuthi uma izinto ezimbili zihlangana, kukhona imiphumela engajwayelekile efana nezinwele, ushokoledi, ukuhamba komlomo, uthuli, nezimpawu zokuthinta. Lezi yizinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa ngamaphoyisa. Ubufakazi bungaba obubonakalayo, njengephuzu lesikhwama, noma bungabonakala kahle ngaphansi kwemicroscope, njengezintambo noma imikhondo yegazi. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje buwenza kube lula kumaphoyisa ukuhlanganisa abantu nendawo kanye nezinto. Ukuze kusebenze ubuchwepheshe, izindawo zokwenziwa kobugebengu kumele zigcinwe futhi zivikelwe ekungeneleleni okungadingekile okungaphazamisa ubufakazi. Ngokugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuqoqa ubufakazi obuqondile. Ukuphazamiseka endaweni yokwenziwa kobugebengu kudala isimo lapho ubufakazi obungatholakala futhi obuwusizo buncipha. Ukugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, "indawo engcwele," kuyinto ebalulekile ozoyenza. Ungawuthinti noma ukhiphe izinto endaweni, njengezinto zokuhlala, izingubo, noma ukudla. Ungasebenzisi nefonini yakho; okungenani cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane wakho. Sebenzisa enye indlela, hhayi leyo esetshenziswa ababulali. Uma kungenzeka, buyela ekhaya. Cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane noma enye indawo ukuze ubike lesi sehlakalo. Linda amaphoyisa. Lapho ubika ubugebengu, nikeza ulwazi oluphelele lokuthi ungatholakala kuphi, uma amaphoyisa edinga olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokufika endaweni. Khombisa indlela noma indlela oyisebenzisile. Bonke abakwi ndawo noma eduze bangaba ngofakazi. Tshela amaphoyisa konke owazi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukubona kwakho kubonakala kungabalulekile. Bhala konke phambi kokuxoxa nabanye ngoba ungakhohlwa noma uphazamiswe.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni: Ukuhlola Izenzakalo Ezikhathazayo Ngokwesimo sezwelonke nezinselelo ezibhekene neNingizimu Afrika, inkohlakalo kuhulumeni sekuyinkinga eqhubekayo engathola ukusola okukhulu. Le ndaba ingelula kuphela emakhaleni, kodwa ibanga nemiphumela emikhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abaningi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izimbangela, izimpawu, nezizathu zokwandiswa kwale nkinga. Ekuqaleni, kumele kucace ukuba inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iwububi obukhulu obangela ukungathembeki phakathi kwababusi. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka obala, izindlela zokukhwabanisa zikhula zikhula. Kuze kube namuhla, emazweni amaningi, kubonakale ukungathembeki ezintweni ezinzima ezifana nezokuphathwa kwemali, izinsiza noma iphrojekthi yomphakathi. Lokhu kudala ukwehla kokwethenjwa phakathi komphakathi. Okusobala ukuthi abaholi bangakha izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokulwa nalesi sifo esinzima. Kodwa-ke, izenzo eziphikisayo nezenzo ezingekho emthethweni zisadlala indima enkulu. Isibonelo, eminyakeni edlule, omasipala abaninzi bathole izinkinga ezinkulu ngenxa yokungabi nezinqumo ezinhle, okwaholela ekulahlekeni kwemali eningi. Uhlanga lwemali lugubha izinsiza ezincane, kanti izinjongo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi azifinyeleli. Isazi senhlalo, uMnu. Sipho Mkhize, uchaze ukuthi inkohlakalo ayigcini nje ngokuqothula imithombo yezimali, kodwa ibeka ingcuphe empilweni yomphakathi. “Umphakathi ongenayo imali uyanda, kanye nokushoda kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezinjengemfundo, ezempilo nezokuthutha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siphendule ngokoqobo,” kuphakamisa uMkhize. Ukwelashwa kwezinkinga ezihlobene nenkohlakalo kuhulumeni akuphumeleli ngaphandle kokubambisana. Uhlelo olwakhiwa ngeminyaka edlule, i-‘Integrity Management Framework’, lubonakale lungasebenzi kahle, futhi ubufakazi bukaMnyango wezobulungiswa ubonisa ukuthi namanje kunokungqubuzana kumaphuzu athile. Uhlanga lwangaphandle lwoMnyango wezokuvikela luboniswe ngokuqinile, kodwa abantu abahola lezi zinhlelo ngokuvama bahlala befana namakha amnyama. Ukuze nakanjani kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga, kumele kubanjwe umphakathi ngokwazisa izinhlelo, ukuze abantu babe neqhaza, fantasanda uma ibamba. Lokhu kudinga ukukhulumisana ngempela nokufundisa umphakathi mayelana namalungelo nemisebenzi yawo. Isibonelo esihle, ukusungulwa kwemithombo ehlukahlukene yokwazisa komphakathi mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo singaba semqoka ekulweleni lezi zinkinga. Izikhungo zokulanda impendulo nemibono ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, kodwa kumele zihlale zenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngokuqhamuka nokukhathazeka komphakathi, abaholi bamele baphendule ngokuziqhenya, bahlale beqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yezezimali iyaphathwa ngokucophelela. Lokhu kungabonwa kahle ezinhlelweni zabo ezisemthethweni, izinqubomgomo, nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo, kuze kube isimo seNingizimu Afrika sithola ubulungiswa. Abantu baphinde bakhumbuze ukuthi uMnyango wezokuhlalisana udinga ukusiza ukukhipha izikhalazo kumphakathi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi ukufinyelela ezintweni ezibalulekile. Ngokwenza lokhu, kuba nokwethenjwa okwandayo phakathi komphakathi, okwandisa umoya wokuxhumana nokubambisana. Kuphinde kwaphumela isimo sokuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa imiphakathi ibamba iqhaza ekunqandeni inkohlakalo. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngale ndaba, imiphakathi iyakhumbuza ukuthi izithiyo zingazinqamukela uma zinemigomo ecacile nezinhloso ezifanele. Ekugcineni, kumele kukhumbulelwe ukuthi inkohlakalo kuhulumeni akudingi ukuthengiswa, kodwa kufanele kube ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kwezimanga zombuso nezinhlangothi zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekukhuleni kokwethembeka, okuthuthukisa umphakathi ngokubaluleka kwakho konke. Kodwa, akuphumelelanga ngaphandle kokubambisana nezinhlangano zikamasipala, izinyunyana, nezinyathelo ezisemthethweni. Kubalulekile ukukholwa ukuthi umphakathi unawo amandla okwenza umehluko, noma kunjalo, udinga izinsiza nokwesekwa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga ezikhathazayo. Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni ingalawulwa, kodwa udinga ukuguqulwa okukhulu nokuqhubekayo kweshintsho emiphumeleni.
Ezokuvikeleka Kwemininingwane (Cybersecurity) - Isingeniso Ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-cybersecurity, kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni obumbene nobuchwepheshe. Njengoba sikhula futhi sithuthuka kwezehlakalo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile sithole izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu. Esifundweni sethu, sizobe sihlola incazelo ye-cybersecurity, izinselelo ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze sivikele ulwazi lwethu. Yini i-Cybersecurity? I-cybersecurity iwumkhakha ophathelene nezindlela, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuvikela amasistimu, amanethiwekhi, nemininingwane ethinta i-intanethi. Umgomo omkhulu we-cybersecurity ukuvikela ulwazi kanye nokusebenza kwemishini esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ulwazi olunzulu ngezingozi ezahlukene, ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwama-hacker, ukuvuza kwem秘密, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasebenzi kahle. Izinhlobo Zokuhlasela Kunezinhlobo eziningi zokuhlasela ezithinta ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane. Omunye ovame ukubonwa ngu-kephula iphephabhuku, lapho umuntu engena kokungemthetho kulwazi lwemfihlo. Kukhona futhi i-malware, efaka phakathi ama-virus, ransomware, neminye imishayo emibi ethinta ulwazi lwethu. Lezi zingozi zingaholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu nasekuphazamisekeni kwezinkampani kanye nemibuso. Izingozi Eziyinhloko Izingozi zihlala zikhona emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi ziyaqhubeka zikhula njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula. Izinkampani ezithola uxhumano nabangani be-inthanethi, njengokuthenga nge-inthanethi, zikhona engozini yokuhlaselwa. Futhi, izingozi ezihlobene nemisebenzi yokuvula ubuchwepheshe, njengokungena ezinkampanini, ziyaqhubeka zikhukhuma. Ukuzwisisa lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokuvikela. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukuvikela ulwazi lwethu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zihlala zisesikhathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezibuyekezo ezikhona nokugwema izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingathandeki. Okwesibili, amagama anamandla kufanele asetshenziswe ukuvimbela abantu abangagunyaziwe ekufinyeleleni kulwazi lwethu. Amagama aqinile avikela okokusebenza nemininingwane yethu. Ukwengeza, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela i-cyberspace, njenge-firewalls nemisebenzi yokuhlonza izingozi, kubalulekile ukuze kube lula ukubona nokuvimbela ukuhlasela ngaphambi kokwenza umonakalo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufundisa abasebenzi noma amalungu omphakathi ukuze baqonde izingozi nezindlela zokuphatha imininingwane yabo ngendlela ephephile. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Ubuchwepheshe bukhula njalo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandiseni kwezinselelo ezivela kumasistimu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sigcine ulwazi lwethu luqinile ngokuhlala silungisa izinqubo zethu zokuvikela. Izinhlelo ezintsha ziyaqhubeka zithola izisebenzi ezijulile ezizothola izixazululo ezenzakalayo ezithinta izingozi ezikhulayo. Ngakho, ukuqapha izinguquko ezintsha eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu. Umqondo Wokuba Nombono Ngaphandle kokwaziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile futhi ukuba nemibono ethile. Akufanele sikhulume kuphela ngokuvikela, kodwa futhi kufanele sikhathalele impilo yethu ye-inthanethi nendlela esiphatha ngayo ulwazi lwethu. Kudingeka ukuthi sakhe imibono eqhubekayo ezosiza ekukhuleni kokuhlakanipha kwethu, okuhlanganisa ukufundisa abafundi namalungu omphakathi ngezimfanelo zokuthatha izinqumo ezinhle eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane ibalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe namuhla. Ukuze sibe nenhloso yokuvikela ulwazi lwethu, kudinga umdlandla wokubona izingozi, ukwakha izinyathelo ezisebenzayo, nokubuyekeza izinhlelo zokusebenza zethu. Umsebenzi wethu wokuvikela awupheli, uhamba phambili njengoba ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Ngaleso sikhathi, akufanele silibalise ukufundisa nokwazisa abanye ngalolu hlobo lwezokuphepha. Ubuchwepheshe buyashintsha, kodwa ulwazi lwethu lungagcinwa luphephile uma sikwazi ukuphatha kahle.
Ngaphansi kwehlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo, uhulumeni uzohlinzeka ngosizo ezixukwini ezithintekayo ezingakwazi ukufinyelela ukudla okwanele nokunempilo ngenxa yobuphofu nokwenyuka kwamanani okudla. Uhulumeni ubeke imali engu-R1.2 billion eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Imali engu-R400 million isivele yabelwe unyaka wezezimali ka-2002/3, lapho u-R170 million usetshenzisiwe ukusiza abadinga usizo ezweni elizungezile. U-R230 million ubekwe eceleni ukuze kusebenze imindeni engama-200,000 ethintekayo ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo. Izikhwama zokudla zizophakanyiswa emakhaya angenayo imali nokuthi lawo angakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okungafika ku-R200 ngenyanga. Le mikhankaso eqhubekayo ibonwa ngokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlangano zenkolo, amaqembu emisebenzi, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni, kanye nohulumeni uqobo. Inhloso enkulu yale hlelo ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu bonke ngokwandisa amakhono angaphakathi emindenini ethintekayo ukuze ibhekane nobumpofu nokungabi nokudla, ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo, nokuthola ukuvikelwa ezindleleni eziphakeme zokudla. Usizo lokudla luzohlinzekwa ngokusabalalisa izikhwama zokudla emakhaya athintekayo phakathi nezinyanga ezintathu. Ukwabelana kwezimpande kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza le mideni ikhulise ukudla kwabo futhi ithuthukise izimpilo zayo. Kuzohlinzekwa ukwesekwa kwemisebenzi yokwenza imali. Ukuqinisa umnikelo weHlelo Lokudla Esikoleni. Ukuze ubhalise ukuze uthole usizo lokudla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ukudla okunempilo okunothile ngamavithamini nezimayini. Izingane, ikakhulukazi ezikhokhelayo emakhaya: amajazi nezinsizwa ezithintekayo yi-HIV/AIDS nemindeni yazo zizothola kakhulu. Kwamanye amazwe, ezindaweni nasemakhaya, lezi zinsiza zisebenzisana; uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnyango Wezempilo, uMnyango Wezolimo, uMnyango Wezemfundo, iKhansela Lokucwaninga Ngezobuchwepheshe Nezimboni (CSIR), uMnyango Wezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, iNational Development Agency (NDA), kanye ne-Independent Development Trust (IDT). Izinhlangano ezahlukene zenkolo, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izinhlangano zomsebenzi, nezinkampani zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuphepha kokudla. Imisebenzi eminingi ihlelwe ukuze kwandiswe ukuqwashisa ngehlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo kuzo zonke izifunda. Ubuphofu buyisitha esiyinhloko sabantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sisebenze ndawonye njengabaholi bezepolitiki, abaholi bendabuko, izinhlangano zenkolo, amaqembu emisebenzi, imiphakathi, nezinkampani uma sifuna ukuphumelela. Ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwezimboni ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze siphumelele. Le hlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo lwenziwa nguHULUMENI.
Izidingo Zemibhalo Yabasebenzi Abasha: Ukuhlonipha Isiko Nezidingo Zamanje Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho izinguquko zenzeka ngokushesha, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi ziqinisekisa izidingo ezithile zokubhaliswa kwabasebenzi abasha. Ngikubona lokhu njengomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezinsiza zabantu, futhi ngifisa ukwabelana ngombono wami mayelana nezidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, ukuhlela, kanye nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Abasebenzi abasha badinga ukufaka imibhalo ethile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephila ngaphakathi kwemigomo nemibandela yeGEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudala isithombe esicacile sokuthi ubani, yisiphi isimo sabo, nokuthi bangaba kanjani ingxenye yalesi simo esikhulu. Ngokwesibonelo, imibhalo efana nezitifiketi zokuqashwa, izincwadi zokuhlonza, kanye nezitifiketi zezemfundo kufanele zibe khona. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuhlonipha izinqubo, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwabantu abasha emsebenzini. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zidingo zingase zibonakale njengokuphazamiseka, kodwa ziwusizo ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha abasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobulungiswa, lapho bonke abantu behlonishwa futhi bejabuliswa. Uma izinqubo zikhona, izinkampani zikwazi ukuvikela izithombe zabo, ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngokuqonda ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zingase zibe nzima kwabanye abantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Kunezimo lapho abantu bangase babe nezithiyo ezithile, njengokungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngale mibhalo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zibe nesineke futhi ziqonde izimo zabo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuxhasa abasebenzi abasha ukuze bakwazi ukufaka le mibhalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Uma izinkampani ziqonda izidingo nezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abasha, zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobungane, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa futhi bahlonishwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zifaneleka ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zihlala zikhona, kodwa futhi zihlala zikhanga kubantu abasha. Ekugcineni, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS, zibalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha abasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba izinkampani ziqonde izidingo zazo, zibe nesineke, futhi ziqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Njengomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezinsiza zabantu, ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi uyahlonishwa futhi uzwakala. Ngakho-ke, ngikhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhona, zikhanga, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza engcono, enobungane, futhi enempilo, lapho bonke abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa.
Amalungelo Abasebenzi: Ukubaluleka Nokuhlola Namuhla, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engasafunwa; kunalokho, ayisisimangalo esidinga ukugxilwa. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi, olwakha umnotho, luthinteka kakhulu uma amalungelo abasebenzi engavikeleki. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ubucayi balokhu, kanye nezizathu ezithile zokuhlonishwa nokuvuselelwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi aqukethe izinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okusebenza ngezimo ezifanele, amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okwakha izinhlangano, nokuvikelwa ekuphathekeni kabi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bezizwe beyingxenye yomphakathi. Uma lokhu kungafinyelelwa, abasebenzi bangase baphatheke kabi, baphume emsebenzini, noma bazizwe bengabalulekile. Isibonelo, uma sithatha izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, njengezindawo eziphakeme, kudinga ukuqashelwa izimo ezithile. Abasebenzi badinga indawo yokusebenza ephephile, amathuluzi adingekayo, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha uma kudingeka. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuvikelwa kwabantu, kodwa kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle, okugcina kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukungahlonishwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwa, lokhu kunganciphisa umoya wokusebenza, okungaholela ekunciphiseni umkhiqizo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi awazwakali kuphela ezindaweni zokusebenza, kodwa ahambisana nomnotho jikelele. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bazokwenza ngokuzikhandla, okwandisa imiphumela emihle. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo zokuba nezinhlangano zabasebenzi. Lezi zinhlangano zenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa izwi labantu, ziqinisa amalungelo abo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala ziqinisekisa izimo ezinhle zokusebenza. Ngokuhlanganyela, abasebenzi bangakwazi ukulwa nezimo ezingezinhle, futhi bahlanganyele emizamweni yokuthuthukisa izimo zabo. Nokho, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona konke okulungile. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zibe nezinhloso ezithile zokuvikela izinzuzo zazo, zishaye indiva amalungelo abasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nesixazululo sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, ukuze kube nesithunzi esihle sokusebenza. Abasebenzi kumele babe nezinqumo ezithile, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabo. Kubuye kube nesidingo sokucabangela izimo zomhlaba wonke. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izimo zabasebenzi zihlala zishintsha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi aqhubeke nokuvuselelwa, ukuze ahambisane nezidingo zamanje. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziqonda izinguquko, futhi ziqhubele phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhlanganisa, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engathathwa kalula. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ahlanganisa izici eziningi ezithinta impilo yomuntu, umphakathi, kanye nomnotho. Amalungelo abasebenzi kufanele ahlonishwe, aqiniswe, futhi avuselelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle, hhayi kuphela kubasebenzi, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nomoya ophumelelayo, owamukelekayo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi ahlonishwa, futhi abavikelekile. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungumqashi noma ungumsebenzi, aqonde ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi ayisona isithiyo, kodwa yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni isizukulwane esisha esizokwazi ukuphila kahle, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni. Amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engathathwa kalula, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuwagcina, ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa.

Ngalesi, ngifaka isicelo sesikhundla esikhulunywe ngenhla kwiMasipala futhi ngiqinisekisa ukuthi izimpendulo zami ezibuzwe ngenhla ziqinile ngokuphelele.
