Ukuqinisekisa inombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) KwaZulu-Natal, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi kahle le nqubo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlose ukuthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nokusebenza kwabo. Uhlelo lwezempilo lukahulumeni, oluhlanganisa izinsiza ezifana noGEMS, lunikeza ulwazi olubalulekile kubasebenzi, okukhuthaza ukuthola impesheni. Ukuze umphakathi uqonde kahle, sizobheka ngokuqondile ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, futhi sihlole imithetho nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo zempesheni zifinyelelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa kahle izinsizakalo zempesheni, ikakhulukazi uma beqinisekisa izimali ezithile. Uma uhlose ukuqinisekisa inombolo yakho yempesheni, kudinga ukuthi ulandele izinyathelo ezithile. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi unayo ikhadi leGEMS, noma ubhalise online. Izikhangiso ezithile zingasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngalezi zinyathelo. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu abasha baqonde imithetho edingekayo ukuze baqedele le nqubo. U-GEMS uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile kubasebenzi, futhi uthola ukufinyelela kumalungelo nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhlela kahle izimali zawo, futhi uhulumeni uqinisekile ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala kalula. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, futhi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi umphakathi uhlanganise izixazululo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ukukhokha izindleko zemishwalense nezempilo kudinga ukuqonda ukuthi inombolo yempesheni iyaphuthuma, futhi abantu badinga ukukhuthazwa ukuze bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo ziyatholakala. U-GEMS unendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuqinisekisa inombolo yempesheni akuyona nje inqubo, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani, ukuzimisela, kanye nemithombo efanele ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomphakathi. Ekugcineni, qinisekisa inombolo yakho yempesheni ukuze uthole umbono omuhle empilweni yakho, futhi usebenzise izinsizakalo zeGEMS ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho. Ngiyabonga.
UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi oluphathwa nguhulumeni nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi ukuthi umthetho kazwelonke kumele usungulwe ukuze ufeze leli lungelo. Ngokwezinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela unqunyelwe njengomphathi wolwazi (IO), kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli ophakathi (RA) weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Abaphathi Bezesekeli Nabantu Bahlonishwa Njengabaphathi Bezimali (DIOs). Lezi zikhala zizohlinzeka ngosizo olwamukelekayo kumalunga omphakathi ekufinyeleleni kulwazi uma kudingeka amarekhodi avela eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. IKomidi Lezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAAC) lisunguliwe ukuze linikeze izeluleko kumphathi wolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi nokusiza umphathi wolwazi kanye nomgibeli ophakathi mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaKomidi Amancane Ezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAASC) nawo asunguliwe ukuze anikeze izeluleko kubaphathi bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. I-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela isunguliwe njengendawo yokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. I-Centre Yemininingwane izosiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalunga omphakathi ukuba babone uhlobo noma uhlobo lwezikhumbuzo eziphathwa yiMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi kufaka phakathi izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezikhumbuzo nokuthi bangazithola kanjani ngqo noma ngokuqondile. Ulwazi ngokweSahluko 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000). Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwezwe, futhi ikhuthaza ukuphepha ezingeni lesizwe, lesifunda, kanye nezwe jikelele ngokulandela amandla avikelekile, anamuhla, anokufinyelela kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inikezwa ukuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule futhi ethuthukayo kubo bonke. Iphinde ibheke noma iyiphi iminyango kahulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela ihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli onamandla, uNobhala Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophathisa ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nomphathi weMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti umphathi weMpi unomsebenzi wokuyala nokulawula iMpi. Ukuba yi-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ezophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali lukamasipala kuMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha Izimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), Izimiso Zesikhwama, nezikhangiso ezithunyelwe kubo bonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba zezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwazwelonke nokuhola indlela yepholisi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, nokubhekelela izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, isu, kanye nesakhiwo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zikazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okucophelela, nokuphumelelayo komsebenzi wokuvikela. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungisa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Umdidiyeli ungumphathi Wethuba Elilinganayo Nokwesekwa Kwabantu Abandile. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ahlobene nokuvikela umhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa kwezokuphepha komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwempi ngosizo oluhlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ahlobene nokwesekwa nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula isikhungo sezinqubomgomo zokwesekwa kwezempilo ezimisweni zempi nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kwezempilo okubalulekile kubalungu beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincike zabo noma labo abaxhaswe ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokwesekwa nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobuhlakani ekuphathweni nasekuphathweni kolwazi lwezokuphepha ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina uxhaso lwezobuhlakani kwiMpi, ukusiza ekusekeleni, nakwezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuhlela umsebenzi wezisebenzi zeNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubo bonke amalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela kanye nezincike zabo nokukhuthaza ukukhula komoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuqondisa okuvela enhlanganweni yempi. Ukusungula inqubomgomo yokuxhumana kwezokuphepha, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nepolitiki yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nenqubomgomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi ibe yindawo yokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okucophelela, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela nezithakazelo zayo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olukhethekile, usizo olugunyaziwe nolusekela ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukusiza iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono mayelana nezokuxhumana kwangaphandle nezinsiza ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo yezenhlalakahle kuMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe ukuvimbela nokwakha amathuba okufunda ngokuqashwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo olungahlangene nokulwa kumalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kuMnyango Wezokuvikela nokweseka lokho okwenziwa yiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Inhloso yale Mthetho ukuveza ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi oluphathwa uMbuso noma olunye ulwazi oluphathwa nganoma yimuphi umuntu oludingekayo ukuze lusetshenziswe noma luvikelwe nganoma yiluphi ilungelo. Inhloso ukuhlela isiko lokukhanya nokubopheleka ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezizimele futhi ukukhuthaza umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinye
Izinguquko Zenqubomgomo Yemfundo Yezingane Ezisencane 1. Isingeniso Izinguquko zenqubomgomo yemfundo yezingane ezisencane zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola imfundo efanele, esezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ethuthukisa amathuba azo empilweni. Le doko ibonisa izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi, izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisayo. 2. Umgomo Wethu Umgomo wethu uwukwakha uhlelo lwezemfundo oluqinile nolubhekene nezidingo zezingane ezisencane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zengane. - Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwemfundo kubo bonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. - Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nomphakathi. 3. Izinguquko Ezidingekayo 3.1. Ukuvuselelwa Kwezinhlelo Zokufundisa Izinhlelo zokufundisa kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa: - Ukufundisa ngemicabango evulekile, ukwakha amakhono okucabanga. - Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ezifundweni. - Ukugxila ekufundeni okusebenzisanayo, okukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwezingane. 3.2. Ukuqeqeshwa Kothisha Uthisha uyisihluthulelo empumelelweni yemfundo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi othisha banamakhono adingekayo, kudingeka: - Ukuhlinzekwa kwezifundo ezithuthukayo. - Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwezobuchwepheshe bokufundisa. - Ukugqugquzela ubuholi phakathi kothisha ukuze baphumelele. 3.3. Ukufinyelela Kwezemfundo Ukuze kube nokufinyelela kwemfundo kubo bonke, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zidingeka: - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo zemfundo ezikude. - Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zemfundo ezidingekayo, njengezincwadi nezinsiza zokufunda. - Ukusebenzisana nohulumeni bendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane ezisencane zithola imfundo. 4. Ukuxhumana Nabazali Ukubandakanywa kwabazali empilweni yemfundo yengane kubalulekile. Izinyathelo eziphakanyisiwe zifaka: - Ukuhlela imihlangano evulekile phakathi kwabazali nothisha. - Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikhuthaza abazali ukuba babe yingxenye yokufunda kwengane yabo. - Ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabazali. 5. Ukubheka Nokuhlola Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinguquko zenqubomgomo zisebenza, kubalulekile: - Ukuhlela izivivinyo ezivamile zokuhlola impumelelo yezinhlelo. - Ukuqoqa impendulo evela kubazali, othisha, kanye nezingane. - Ukuhlola futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ngokuhambisana nemiphumela etholelwe. 6. Isiphetho Izinguquko zenqubomgomo yemfundo yezingane ezisencane zidinga ukubhekwa njengomsebenzi oqhubekayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kubandakanya uhulumeni, othisha, abazali, kanye nomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuze sifinyelele imigomo yethu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yezingane ezisencane kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. 7. Izinyathelo Ezilandelayo - Ukuphakanyiswa kokwakhiwa kweqembu elihlanganisa bonke abathintekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle. - Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokusebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinguquko zenqubomgomo zisebenza. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ngalezi zinguquko. Ngalezi zinguquko, sizobe sihlose ukwakha uhlelo lwezemfundo oluqinile noluhambisana nezidingo zezingane ezisencane, ukuze zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi.
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Empofu Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukhuluma ngendaba ethinta abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi emindenini empofu. Kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nalezi zindawo, futhi kudinga ukuthi sihlole lezi zinkinga ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithile. Kukhona umbono ophawulekayo phakathi kwabantu, ukuthi ukudla kufanele kube yinto elula, kodwa empeleni, akunjalo. Emindenini empofu, izinkinga zokudla zenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngempilo. Uma umndeni ungakwazi ukuthola ukudla okunempilo, lokho kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi. Abantu abaningi bazi ukuthi ukudla okunempilo kubaluleke kakhulu, kodwa uma izinsiza zikhona kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abanokudla, abakwazi ukuphila kahle. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngaphezu kwemali. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma umndeni ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyenele yokuthenga ukudla, lokhu kudala izinkinga ezintsha. Abantu abaningi baphila ezindaweni ezinzima, lapho kungase kube nzima ukuthola umsebenzi, futhi uma umndeni ungatholi imali eyenele, lokho kusho ukuthi bazokwazi ukwanelisa izidingo zabo zokudla. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwemali nezinselelo zokudla bukhona, futhi kufanele sithole izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ukuze umndeni ungabi nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngendlela yokudla. Abantu abavame ukwazi ukuzenzela ukudla okunempilo ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemithombo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqaphele izinkinga ezithinta izinsiza zokudla emiphakathini ethile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana futhi ubambisane ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezithile, okungaba kuhle uma kukhona izinhlelo zomphakathi ezisiza emindenini empofu. Kukhona futhi impatho yokudla. Inhlalakahle iyasiza, kodwa uma izinsiza zingekho, abantu baphuma ezindaweni ezinzima. Udaba lwezindawo zokudla, ezinjengezikhungo zokudla, luhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umndeni ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokudla, noma uma lezi zindawo zikhona, kudinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza eziwusizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokudla emiphakathini. Ngokubambisana, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zokudla zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezingekho, kanye nezindlela zokuphila, konke lokhu kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu. Kudingeka ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile ezisiza ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Ngasolwazi, sikhuluma nangokubaluleka kokufundisa. Abantu kufanele bafundiswe ngokudla okunempilo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi yini okufanele bayidlayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma abantu bazi kahle, bazokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Ngempela, uma umphakathi jukujabulela ukufunda, lokho kuzokwenza kube nokuthula. Kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithinta ukudla, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, sikhuluma ngempilo, kodwa ekugcineni, sikhuluma ngothando. Umndeni ophilayo uthanda ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla, futhi lokhu kubalulekile. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umndeni unenkinga, kufanele kube nesithakazelo sokuthola izixazululo. Izinkinga zokudla azikhuluma kuphela ngempilo, kodwa zikhuluma futhi ngothando olukhona emindenini. Ukugcina umndeni uphilile, kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umndeni ube neqhaza ekwakheni isikhala esihle. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nokuthula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ukudla okunempilo. Ngokwazisa, lokhu kuhlangene, izinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu kudinga ukunakwa. Kudingeka ukuba sihlale sizama ukuthola izixazululo ezithile, ukuze umphakathi uphile impilo engcono. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezithile, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi lokho kuzokwenza kube nezinguquko ezinhle. Lokhu kuyadingeka, futhi kumele kuqale manje!
uMfula iNile Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela yokuphila. Emhlabeni ophakeme, lapho izintaba zikhuphuka khona, uMfula iNile waqala khona, uhlezi njengomgudu ophilayo. Ubuya emithonjeni emikhulu, uhambe ngezinyawo ezithambile, udlula ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, ulethe impilo, ubuhle, nezindaba eziningi. Ngaphambi kokuba uMfula iNile ube yindawo yokuphila, kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, ezazikhumbuza abantu ukuthi izimpilo zabo zixhumene. Abantu bahlala eduze komfula, bejabulile, bephila impilo enothile. Ubuye ube yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngezindaba, baphinde baphumule emanzini anothile. Ubumfihlo Nokuvikelwa Kolwazi lwe-GEMS Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi sekuba yizinto ezibalulekile kakhulu. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS, okuyinsiza yokunakekela impilo ehloswe ngokuqinile ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngemininingwane ethinta abantu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuvikelwa okukhulu. Ubumfihlo bukhona ezindabeni eziningi, kodwa uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nsiza ibhekene nemininingwane eyimfihlo kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane yokwelashwa, izimo zezempilo, kanye nemininingwane yomuntu siqu. Ngakho-ke, ukuvikela le mininingwane akusikho kuphela isibopho, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu abathola izinsiza zayo. Ngokubheka izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS, kubonakala ukuthi le nsiza ibeka phambili ukuvikelwa kolwazi. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuvikela imininingwane, kanye nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuphatha ulwazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayitholakali kalula, futhi ivikelwe ezinsongweni eziningi ezikhona emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu abaphatha le mininingwane badinga ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwayo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyingxenye yokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuziphatha okuhle, ukucophelela, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kumele iqhubeke nokuxhumana nabantu, ibanikeze ulwazi olucacile nolunembile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela imininingwane yabo. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukwethembana, futhi abantu bazozizwa bekhululekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yabo, bazi ukuthi ivikelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Izinsongo ezivela kwi-cybercrime zikhula, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke ibuyekeza izinqubomgomo zayo zokuvikela imininingwane. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zihlala zisebenza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlaziya, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuvikela imininingwane ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS kumele ibheke phambili, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-blockchain, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane ayishintshiwe futhi ivikelekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abangenamvume ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi baphila emhlabeni lapho ubumfihlo bukhulu. Ukuze i-GEMS iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwe-GEMS akusikho nje isibopho, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Ukuze le nsiza iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi ibheke phambili, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi abantu bazozizwa bekhululekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yabo, bazi ukuthi ivikelekile. Ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi akusikho nje okubalulekile, kodwa kuyisidingo esiyinhloko sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokwethembana, nolwazi. I-GEMS, njengensiza yokunakekela impilo, kufanele iqhubeke nokubeka phambili lezi zinto, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle, futhi bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile.
Ezokwakha: Indaba Yezithombe Zokwakha Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho umoya uphuphuma kancane, uvusa imimoya emisha. Kwakukhona umphakathi ophakathi kokwakha, lapho abantu bejabulile futhi benomdlandla. UThandi, umakhi ophumelele, wayehamba phambili kule ndaba. UThandi wayengumuntu onothando, owayekwazi ukwakha izindlu ezinhle, izikhumbuzo ezizohlala zikhumbuleka. Ngenkathi uThandi eqala ukwakha, wayenelungelo lokukhetha indawo efanele. Wathola indawo ethokomele, eduze komfula, lapho izinyoni zithokozisa khona. Lapho, uThandi waqala khona ukwakha indlu yakhe yokuqala. UThandi wayenolwazi olukhulu, kodwa wayazi ukuthi akekho umuntu ongakwenza yedwa. Waqasha abanye abakhi, ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke benolwazi olunzulu. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, imisebenzi yokuqhuba ibhizinisi yanda. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukwakha akukhona nje kuphela ukwenza izindlu, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Abantu babefika, behlanganyela, behlabelela, futhi bejabulisa. Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthembu, umphakathi omkhulu, owayebamba izifundo zokwakha eziphumelelayo. UThandi wathola ithuba lokufunda kuye, waphinde wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye. Noma kunjalo, izinsuku zazingahlala zikhanya. Kwakukhona izinselelo. Ngenxa yokungabikhona kwemali, uThandi wayebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Izinsiza zazivame ukungabi khona, futhi abanye abakhi babengasebenzi kahle. Kodwa uThandi akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, efuna izixazululo. Waqasha abanye abakhangisi, wathola izinsiza ezithile, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningi zokusebenza, indlu kaThandi yabe isiqediwe. Kwakuyindlu emnandi, enezinto ezinhle nezithombe ezihle. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, ukungapheli kwethemba kungaholela empumelelweni. Abantu bejabulile, behlanganyela emcimbini wokuvula indlu. UThandi wakhumbula ukuthi akekho owakha yedwa; wonke umuntu wayenendima. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqala ukucabanga ngezinto ezinkulu. Wayefuna ukwakha izindlu eziningi, ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Waqala ukuhlela amaphrojekthi amasha, ahlanganisa izinsiza, abantu, nezifundo ezitholakele. Wazi kahle ukuthi ukwakha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu, kodwa futhi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokwakha, kwazulu abantu bejabulile. Umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu, futhi izinhlelo zikaThandi zaba yimpumelelo. Waba umholi, futhi abantu bamlandela. UThandi wayenohlonze, futhi wayebona ukuthi ukwakha akupheli kuphela emakhaya, kodwa kudinga umoya wokubambisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wakhula. Izindlu zanda, izikole zavulwa, nezindawo zokudlela zakhula. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani, uthando, nokubambisana kungaholela empumelelweni. Kwakukhona izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa uThandi wayenokholo. Wazi ukuthi ukwakha akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano, umphakathi, nempilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima. Uthando lwakhe lokwakha lwasiza abantu abaningi, futhi umphakathi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, ukwakha kungenza umehluko. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, banganqoba noma yini. Ukukhanya kwelanga kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, izinsuku ezinhle ziza kulabo abakholelwa. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokwakha, umphakathi, nempilo engcono. Umsebenzi wakhe wawuhamba phambili, futhi izinsuku zaba zinhle. UThandi wayephupha, futhi wayazi ukuthi, uma ubambisene, ungakha okukhulu. Lokhu kwakuyindaba yokwakha, indaba yokubambisana, nempilo engcono. UThandi, umakhi, waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sikhona umoya, konke kungenzeka.

Kubandakanya ukuphathwa kukamasipala ngokuphumeza ukuqoqa intela yezindlu; ukuhlela umthetho weMiphakathi: Umthetho Wamasipala ka-2000, ukuze kuqhubeke nokwakha izigaba zokuthi amamasipala athumele izaziso; ukuhlela noma ukususa eminye imithetho; nokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene. Isihloko esifingqiwe kanye nokuqala komthetho. Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphakathi wendawo ungakha intela yezindlu ezindaweni ezibekwe yibo. Umphakathi wesifunda awukwazi ukuklama intela yezindlu ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ibe ngaphakathi kwesifunda esibekwe kulowo maphakathi. Ezinye izigaba zomthetho; kanye nenqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu okufanele amamasipala ayamukele ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 3. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele yamukele inqubomgomo ehambisana nomthetho mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu ezindaweni noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu kumamasipala. Ivumela amamasipala ukuba akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo; futhi kulandela ukuhlaziywa okujulile mayelana nezindleko nezinhlelo zokubuyisela, zonke izakhiwo noma izimpahla ezingase zingafakwa ngaphansi kwesistimu yokuhlola ngenhloso yokwakha intela yezindlu. Noma iyiphi imali yokubuyiselwa, yokubuyiselwa, noma yokunciphisa okukhulunywe ngesigaba 2 futhi kubhekwa enhlanganweni yenqubomgomo eyamukelwe ngumasipala kufanele ihambisane nezinga likazwelonke elingase lilawulwe ukuze lisetshenziswe. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele lihlole zonke iziphakamiso ezamukelwe nezibhalwe ezithunyelwe kulo ngesikhathi sokucubungula isikhala senqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele ibuyekeze unyaka nonyaka, futhi uma kudingeka, ihlele inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Umphakathi wendawo kufanele wamukele ukuthi imithetho yamasipala ibamba iqhaza ekusebenzeni nasekuphumezeni inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. a ngezizinda ezahlukene zezakhiwo nezindawo; futhi b ngezizinda ezahlukene zabaphathi abaphethekile ukukhokha intela yezindlu. Inani lentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela endaweni eyodwa kufanele iklanywe ngendlela ehlukile ngokuya ngosayizi waleyo ndawo okufanele ibophelelwe yalesi sistimu futhi hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo. a kufanele kube inani elisekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenani lentela yezindlu yaleyo mpahla njengoba kuboniswe ephepheni lokuhlola lezakhamuzi ngaleso sikhathi; noma b intela efanayo empahleni noma endaweni esigabeni esithile esibekwe, kuye ngokuthi leyo ndawo ingaphansi kwenani lokuhlola elisemthethweni. Xhumana futhi uthumele izaziso kubo bonke abathintekayo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku lokwaziswa. UMphathi wesifunda uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngokubhalwe phansi uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe, okusho ukuthi isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo, okuzokwenziwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuthola isicelo futhi ukulungele ukuxhumana nomnikazi womhlaba, ophatha lowo mhlaba ngokomthetho, nabanye abathintekayo. Uma ungeniswa isicelo sokumba izinto ezisemhlabeni, kumele bakwazise ngokubhalwe phansi, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30, bechaza izizathu zokwenqaba. Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala luhamba phambili emizamweni yokuthuthukisa impilo nekhwalithi yokufunda kwabafundi. Nokho, uma sihlola lokhu kuhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impumelelo yalo ayikhawulelwanga ekunikezeni ukudla kuphela, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni izimo zokuphila zabafundi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalolu hlelo. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngezizathu ezinhle zokuthi kungani uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyadingeka. Abafundi abanokudla okunempilo bathola amandla okusebenza kahle, okwandisa ukukwazi kwabo ukufunda. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo kuthuthukisa igazi, okwenza kube lula ukufunda nokugxila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lokondla lunciphisa izinga lokungondleki phakathi kwabafundi, okungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwabo esikoleni. Nokho, izinselelo azikhi kuphela. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lidinga izinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izindawo zokupheka, kanye nabantu abaqeqeshiwe. Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu, futhi ezikhathini ezinzima zomnotho, izikole eziningi ziba nezinselelo zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izikole zidinga ukusiza ngemali ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokudla, kubalulekile ukuthi kudliwe ukudla okunempilo, futhi izikole zidinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nokuhlukahluka kokudla okukhona, ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zokudla ezahlukene, njengezidingo zabantu abane-allergies noma abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ukungabi nalokhu kuhlukahluka kungaholela ekudleni okungafanele, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabafundi. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni kufanele luhambisane nezifundo eziphathelene nokudla. Abafundi kufanele bafundiswe ngokuqonda okuhle kokudla okunempilo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi kungani kudingeka ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kuzokwandisa ukuqonda kwabo ngezingozi zokudla okungafanele. Uhlelo lokondla kufanele luhlanganiswe nezifundo zokuphila, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngempilo enempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zibe nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokupheka ezihambisana nezidingo zokupheka, nezinsiza zokugcina ukudla. Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, ngaphandle kokubangela izinkinga ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlelo lokondla luhambisane nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Izikole zingasebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthola ukudla okunempilo. Ekugcineni, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyinselelo, kodwa futhi luyithuba. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ukudla okunempilo, futhi lokho kudinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngokuphumelela, singathuthukisa impilo yabafundi, sithuthukise ikhwalithi yokufunda, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lungaba yinsika yempumelelo, uma luphathwa kahle futhi luhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni olunempilo, olukhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi luhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokufunda. Lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyinsika eqinile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni lesi sikhathi sokondla.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom Ngolunye usuku, uSipho, ohlala eGauteng, wathola incwadi ethunyelwe kwa-Eskom. Le ncwadi yayikhuluma ngokuqhamuka kwezinsiza ezintsha ezibizwa ngokuthi "smart meters." USipho waba nolaka, ngoba wayesevele eqaphela ukuthi izindleko zikagesi zikhuphuka njalo, futhi wayengazi ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizomnika usizo yini. Ngemuva kokufunda incwadi, uSipho wanquma ukuya ehhovisi le-Eskom eliseduzane ukuze abuze kabanzi. Lapho efika, wathola uNandi, umphathi wezokuxhumana. UNandi wamamukela ngenjabulo, wathi: “Sawubona, Sipho! Ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ngabe ufuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-smart meter?” USipho wavuma, wathi: “Ngiyabonga, Nandi. Ngicela ungichazele ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani.” UNandi waqala: “I-smart meter iyithuluzi elihlakaniphile elikuvumela ukuthi ubone kahle ukuthi ugesi wakho usebenza kanjani. Ibonisa ukuthi ungakanani ugesi osebenzisa, futhi ikwazisa uma izindleko zikhuphuka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhokha izikweletu zakho.” USipho wathokoza, kodwa wabuza: “Kodwa, kuzodingeka ngikhiphe imali eningi ukuze ngifake le meter?” UNandi wamchazela: “Cha, Sipho. Ukuze ufake i-smart meter, kuzodingeka ukuthi ube ne-application, kodwa akudingeki ukuthi ukhokhe imali eningi. Futhi, uma usuyifakile, uzothola izinzuzo eziningi.” Ngemuva kokukhuluma noNandi, uSipho wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame le smart meter. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umakhelwane wakhe, uThandi, wamsiza ukuthi afake i-smart meter. UThandi wayekwazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani, futhi wamchazela ukuthi kuzomnika ithuba lokulawula izindleko zikagesi. Ngemuva kokufaka i-smart meter, uSipho waqala ukubona umehluko. Wathola ukuthi usebenzisa ugesi omningi ngesikhathi esithile sosuku, ikakhulukazi ekuseni nasebusuku. Lokhu kwamnika ithuba lokwenza izinguquko, waphuma ezindaweni ezithile ezazidla ugesi kakhulu. Waqala ukusebenzisa izibani ezincane, waphinde wacisha imishini engasasebenzi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uSipho wathola ukuthi izindleko zakhe zikagesi zinciphile. Wayejabule kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi le smart meter yamsiza kakhulu ekulawuleni izindleko zakhe. Waqala ukwabelana ngalesi sihloko nomphakathi wakhe, wathi: “Ningakhethi, niyazithokozisa. I-smart meter iyasiza!” Abanye abantu emzaneni babenokungabaza, kodwa uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuthi bafake lezi zinsiza, wathi: “Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane, sizokwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zethu.” Ngemuva kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waqala ukwamukela i-smart meter. Abantu baqala ukujabulisa izindleko zabo, futhi kwavela umoya omusha wokubambisana. U-Eskom naye wathola ukuthi izindleko zawo zinciphile, njengoba abantu beqala ukukhokha izikweletu zabo ngesikhathi. USipho, owakha umphakathi wakhe, waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphela izindleko zabo, futhi wathola ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi be-Eskom bukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba nesithakazelo esikhulu emisebenzini ye-Eskom. Waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo yebhizinisi, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana noNandi, futhi baqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwazisa umphakathi ngalezi zinsiza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingashintsha impilo yabantu. USipho waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-smart meter ayisiyona nje indlela yokulawula izindleko, kodwa iyithuluzi elihlanganisa abantu, elikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye, wathi: “Siyakwazi ukwenza umehluko, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yindawo lapho abantu bejabulile, bephila kahle, futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. I-smart meter yaba yinsiza ebalulekile, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma sithatha izinyathelo ezihlakaniphile, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Kuyajwayeleka ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwemishini namathuluzi akhishwe kuhlelo lwezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zenziwe. Njengoba isikhashana sesidlule, thola isikhathi sokunakekela amathuluzi akho. Ukuphila Emadolobheni Ngiyavuma, ukuphila emadolobheni kuyajabulisa, kodwa futhi kunobunzima obukhulu. Ucabanga kanjani ngalokho? Ngithanda ukubona abantu behamba ezitaladini eziphithizelayo, behlabelela, izimoto ziqhubeka, kanye nezinkulungwane zabantu. Nokho, uyazi ukuthi kulapho kuphila khona imizwa ehlukahlukene? Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngempilo yomphakathi. Emadolobheni, ungahlangana nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okwenza kube mnandi ngoba ungafunda izinto ezintsha, ubone izindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Ucabanga ukuthi umphakathi ungaba umthombo omuhle wokuxhumana? Impela, ungathola abangane abasha, ungaxoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi, abantu bangabhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, njengoba umphakathi ungase ube nezinkinga zawo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, amadolobha anikeza okuningi. Izindawo zokudlela, izitolo, nezikhungo zokuzijabulisa zikhona, okwenza ukuphila kube lula. Uma udinga okuthile, ungakuthola kalula. Kodwa-ke, khumbula, konke lokhu kudinga imali, futhi lokho kungaba yinkinga. Ucabanga kanjani ngalokho uma uzama ukuthola ibhajethi yokuphila? Futhi, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukuphila emadolobheni kuza nezinkinga zempilo. Uthola izinga eliphezulu lokukhathazeka, ngoba abantu bahlala bejolise emsebenzini, ezindleleni, nasezindabeni, okungaholela ekwandeni kokucindezela. Uzwa kanjani uma ubona abantu behluleka ukujabulisa? Lokhu akukukhathazi? Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yokuhlala, amadolobha anokuhlukahluka kwezindawo zokuhlala. Kukhona izindlu ezinkulu, ezincane, nezindawo ezibizayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala kanjani ezindaweni ezinjengalezi? Ngabe kuba nezinselelo zokuhlala emakhaya amakhulu noma ezincane? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kukhona izinzuzo zokuphila emadolobheni. Izindawo eziningi zinezinsizakalo ezithuthukile, njengezokuthutha. Uthola izitimela, amabhasi, nezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisheshayo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emsebenzini nasemakethe. Kodwa, kufanele uqaphele, ngoba izithuthi zingaba yinkinga, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokuhamba. Ucabanga ukuthi kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhamba emadolobheni? Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha anikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Uma ungumuntu ofuna ukwakha umsebenzi, ungathola amathuba amaningi, kodwa lokho kudinga ukuzikhandla. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala benza kanjani ukuze bathole imisebenzi? Ngabe lokho akuyinkinga? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amadolobha anikeza izinto eziningi. Uthola imicimbi, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo. Futhi, uma ungumuntu othanda ubuciko, ungathola izindawo eziningi ezihlobene nobuciko, njengemibukiso, amaholo, nezinkanyezi zomculo. Ucabanga ukuthi ubuciko busebenza kanjani emadolobheni? Ekugcineni, ukuphila emadolobheni kunezinselelo nezinsiza. Uthola imizwa eminingi, futhi kufanele uqaphele. Kodwa, uma ungumuntu onomoya ophilayo, ungathola ukujabulisa nokufunda. Ngabe uthanda ukuphila emadolobheni? Ucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo zikhona noma izinkinga? Lokhu kuyinkinga engaphendulwa, futhi ngithanda ukwazi ukuthi ubona kanjani. Ngiyabonga ngokuba nathi kulolu hambo lokuphila emadolobheni. Ngiyethemba ukuthi sithole izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu, futhi sithole indlela yokuphila kahle. Ngabe ukhona omunye umbono ofuna ukwabelana ngawo? Ngiyabonga!
Kungani amahlamvu ommbila engaluhlaza? Kulokhu, izitshalo zommbila zikhule kakhulu kangangokuthi singabona uma kunokushoda kokudla emhlabathini noma cha. Le nkathi ikunika ithuba elihle lokuhamba emapulazini akho ukuze ubone uma kungase kube nezinkinga futhi ucabange ukuthi ungazivimbela kanjani lezi zinkinga (njengokushoda kwe-nitrogen okungalungiswa ngokufaka i-LAN phezulu) nezinye izindaba ezingalungiswa ngaphambi kokufika konyaka omusha. Lapho sibheka izitshalo, kuzoba sobala ngokushesha uma kunenani elanele le-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba zizoba namahlamvu aluhlaza kakhulu. Ukushoda kwe-nitrogen kuyabonakala uma uthola izitshalo ezincane ezinomhlamvu omncane oluhlaza noma ophuzi. Lokhu kuphuzile kuvame ukwenzeka ekugcineni kwamahlamvu (lapho kukhulu) bese kuncipha phakathi kwamahlamvu. Uma lokhu kushoda kubi, lezo zindawo eziphuzile ziba mnyama futhi ihlamvu iyafa. Amahlamvu amadala avame ukukhombisa lokhu kushoda kuqala. Ukushoda kwalokhu kubonakala ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezinye zikhombisa ngamaqhwa amasha amhlophe. Ukuphuzile kuboniswa nasezindaweni ez sides phakathi kwamahlamvu. Lokhu kushoda kuyabonakala futhi uma amahlamvu aphezulu ephuza. Iz sides, maphakathi, nezikhala ngokuvamile zihlala ziluhlaza. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo azikhuli kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwe-amino acids kanye ne-proteins. Ngoba kudingeka ekukhuleni kwesitshalo, kuba ingxenye yesakhiwo sesitshalo. Ukushoda kwalokhu kuyabonakala uma amaqhwa amasha emhlophe, ngokuvamile wonke amahlamvu esitshalo avame ukuba nombala ophuzi oluhlaza - akukho mehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamahlamvu amasha namadala. Lokhu kungakwenza ukushoda kwe-sulfur (S) kube kufana kakhulu nokushoda kwe-nitrogen (N). Kodwa ukushoda kwe-nitrogen kubonakala kuqala kumahlamvu amadala. Ukushoda kwe-sulfur kungavela uma umanyolo ongena i-sulfur, njengalowo onophosphorus ophakeme, ufakwa isikhathi eside. Ukushoda kwe-potassium kuyabonakala uma izitshalo zingakhuli kahle futhi amahlamvu anemikhawulo ebonakala sengathi ashisiwe. Ngoba i-potassium ihamba ngaphakathi kwesitshalo, ukushiswa kuqala kubonakala kumahlamvu amadala. Enye indlela yokukhombisa ukushoda lokhu: izimpande ezithambile ziwela ngokushesha, izifo zifaka kalula izitshalo, futhi zikhula zibe namandla ngaphansi kokubanda ebusika. Ukuhlola inani le-potassium emhlabathini akuvamile ukuba kuqinisekiswe, ikakhulukazi emhlabathini ongena, ngoba ivame ukuhamba phansi futhi ifake emhlabathini ophansi. Umbala ophuzi ophuzi. Umbala ophuzi kwezinye izindawo zesitshalo. Ukuncipha kokwakhiwa kwezimbali nezithelo. Ukuthatha isikhathi sokuphuma.
Izindiza: Ukukhula Kwezokuhamba Ngemoya eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindiza zibe yindlela ebalulekile yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zindiza zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni kwabantu, ezomnotho, nakwezokuthutha. Ukuze sithole umqondo ocacile ngalokhu, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezindiza, ukuqala ngokukhula kwemakethe, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nezinguquko ezithinta abahambi. Ukukhula Kwezindiza eNingizimu Afrika Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe yiSikhungo Sokucwaninga Ngemoya, imakethe yezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukukhula okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kukhula kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwanda kwabantu abavakasha, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuhamba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izikhumulo zezindiza. Ngokweqiniso, izikhumulo zezindiza ezifana neO.R. Tambo International Airport eGoli, zikhula zibe yizikhungo ezibalulekile zokuhamba, zikhokhela ekwenzeni kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwamazwe. Izinkampani Zokuhamba Ngemoya Izinkampani ezihamba phambili ezifana neSouth African Airways, kulandela iBritish Airways neKulula.com, zikhona ukuletha izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili kubahambi. Lezi zinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, okukhona phakathi kwazo izikhumbuzo ezithokozisayo, izikhumbuzo zokuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhankaso wokuhamba ophumelelayo, zifaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zabo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphepha nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Izinguquko Ezinzima Naphezu kokukhula, umkhakha wezindiza ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukwehla kwemali yokuhamba, izindleko eziphezulu zokuphepha, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima, konke lokhu kuthinta ukusebenza kwezindiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhakha uyaphumelela, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela izindlela zokubhekana nalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezindiza. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe buye babaluleka kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindiza. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuhamba, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphatha izindiza, izinhlelo zokuqapha izimo zezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezindiza nezikhumulo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izindiza zisebenza kahle, ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabahambi, futhi zinciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. Umthelela Kwezomnotho Izindiza zineqhaza elikhulu emnothweni wezwe. Zikhuthaza ukuvakashelwa kwezivakashi, okukhuthaza imboni yezokuvakasha. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ukuphucula izinga lokuphila kwabantu, kanye nokwandisa umnotho. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezibandakanya uhulumeni, zisebenzisana nezinkampani zokuhamba ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha wezindiza uthuthuka futhi ufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuxhumaneni kwabantu, ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, nasekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zokuhamba. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, ukukhula komkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani zokuhamba, kanye nezikhumulo zezindiza, kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo, okuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi nasemnothweni. Izindiza zihlala ziwumgogodla wokuxhumana, futhi umkhakha wezindiza uzoba nendima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika.
Sithatha isinyathelo endleleni eya esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nasemkhakheni wokuzimela. 1. Sigxila empilweni yethu futhi siphila ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, umgomo wethu ukuveza izimanga kubalingani bethu. 2. Sifaka isandla ekunakekeleni nasekuvikeleni imvelo nendawo esikuyo, okungavela ekubhekeni phambili ngokuqonda. 3. Sihlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli nabapheki ngokuphelele. Siphikisa ukuphila kahle ngoba sigcizelela ukuthi amathuluzi okusebenza awaphelele. Ukufisa ngaphakathi kwethu ukuhamba phambili. 4. Sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza zempilo ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuchitha noma ukungabaza ukuze siphumelele ngaphezu kokulinganiswa, njengamaphiko asenza sibhakabhake njengenkanyezi. Ukufisa kwethu ukuthuthukisa. 5. Siqinisekisa ukuthi siyazi ngezinhlelo zempilo eziseduze nempilo, ngolwazi, nangokufundisa umphakathi esikuyo, futhi ukuthi banakekela thina ngendlela ephelele, lokhu kuhambisana. 6. Sinikeza abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi olufanele kanye nokwesekwa komzimba, kokomoya, nakokwengqondo. Sizibophezele ekusizeni ocwaningweni, ekwelapheni, nasekuthuthukiseni umuntu ngamunye ngendlela eqotho, ekuhloleni, ekwelapheni, ekubuyiseleni, nasezingeni eliphezulu lokwazi. 7. Sazisa abapheki bezempilo ngenkani yethu yokwenza okudingekayo kumuntu ngamunye, sigxila esimweni sabo nasekufeni komuntu ngamunye, ubulili babo, ubudala, kanye nokukholwa kwabo. Ukukholwa okujwayelekile ukuthi. 8. Sihambisana nemithetho yokwelapha nangesikhathi esithi "wenza kwabanye njengoba ungathanda ukuthi benze kuwe" okuhlobene nokubuyiselwa. Sizoletha induduzo kulabo. 9. Sibuza ukuthi izindlela zokwelapha noma zokubuyiselwa zibhujiswe noma zaphukile. Zimi kanjani? Sihlela indlela yokukhokha. Usizo lwezinga eliphezulu. Ukwelapha wonke umuntu ngendlela. Ukwenza ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli ngezindlela zokulandela. Ukuba nomusa kwabanye. Izikhalazo/iziphakamiso: ucingo: 032/4376007 Fax: 032.
Inhloso yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso ukuqinisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenzisa ilungelo labo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluphathwa nguhulumeni, kanye nolwazi oluphathwa abanye abantu, oludingekayo ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza noma ukuvikela ilungelo elithile. Umgomo ophambili wokwenza kube nokufinyelela kolwazi ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa ngendlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo nokuchaza izenzo zohulumeni nezizimele, kanye nokuthuthukisa umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela ulwazi ukuze bakwazi ukwenza noma ukuvikela amalungelo abo onke. Ingabe kukhona ulwazi olukhona ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezobulungiswa noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi engatholakala? Ungafinyelela wonke amadokhumenti noma amarekhodi avela kwiMnyango, kubaphathi bawo, noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano kahulumeni. Akubalulekile ukuthi ulwazi lukhona nini. Amarekhodi omuntu kwiMnyango noma enhlangano kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngamaqembu wesithathu noma amarekhodi kuphela ngokuvuma kweqembu lesithathu elithintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma amadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi oluyimfihlo noma ulwazi lomuntu siqu. Ulwazi olungavunyelwe lutholakala ngokulandela iMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso. Ukufinyelela kolwazi kuthintwa yizithiyo ezithile, ngokwesibonelo, uma irekhodi liceliwe ukuze lisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo noma uma izinqubo zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo seziqale, lapho ulwazi lungasetshenziswa khona enkantolo, ikakhulukazi uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi kungalimaza inqubo yobulungiswa. Amarekhodi wekhabhinethi noma amaqembu ayo. Amarekhodi ahlobene nokusebenza kwezinkantolo kanye nezijaji. Ulwazi olutholakala ezinkantolo ezikhethekile ezinquma izingxabano ezithile nezicelo, ezisungulwe ngokulandela umthetho. Futhi ulwazi oluphethwe ngumuntu ongumMember of Parliament noma umphakathi wesifunda. Nokho, iMthetho Wokufinyelela KwiNgcaciso idlula eminye imithetho engase ivimbe ukuthola noma yiluphi ulwazi. Cela usizo kumphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kwemnyango efanele ukuze akusize uthole ulwazi noma amadokhumenti owadingayo. Gcwalisa futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo Sokufinyelela KwiRekhodi Kahulumeni. Ungayithola ehhovisi leMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Uma ulwazi olufuna lungatholakali mahhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi ukhokhe. Ungase udinge ukukhokha imali yokusesha ukuze ufinyelele ulwazi. I-Mthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso, 2000 kanye Nezinhlinzeko ezihlobene. Umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kumele aphendule ezinsukwini eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo sakho. Uma umphathi wolwazi ekwenqaba ukufinyelela kulwazi oluceliwe, ungafaka isikhalazo kumphathiswa wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho. Uma unganelisekile ngemiphumela, ungafaka isikhalazo enkantolo. Umphathi wolwazi noma umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi uzokweseka kulolu hlelo. Uma ulwazi oluceliwe lungatholakali emnyangweni kahulumeni kodwa lukhona enhlangano kahulumeni, umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi uzothumela isicelo sakho kumphathi wolwazi waleyo nhlangano kahulumeni ezinsukwini eziyi-14. Inhlangano kahulumeni efanele kumele iphendule isicelo sakho ngesikhathi. Uzokwaziwa uma lokhu kwenzeka. Xhumana neNhlangano Yokufinyelela KwiNgcaciso yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho ngenombolo: 012 315 1715, ukuze uthole ukuthi izimali zishintshile yini. Izimali ezikhokhwayo kumarekhodi enhlangano kahulumeni zikhona njengoba kuchaziwe ezinhlinzekweni zamanje zomthetho.
Amabhayisikili Nezithuthuthu: Ukukhetha Okufanele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukufudukela kokukhula komnotho kanye nezidingo zokuhamba kwabantu kudala ukwakheka kwezindlela ezintsha zokuhamba. Amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu bahlala phambili ezinkundleni zokuhamba, kanti owokuthi yikuphi okungcono, amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu, kuhlale kuyisihloko esijuleka emiphakathini eminingi. Le ngxoxo izobheka izinzuzo nokubi kokuhamba ngethuluzi ngalunye, iqhaza lazo nezimo ezingabandakanywa ekukhetheni. Okokuqala, kudingeka sithathe umqondo wokuhamba ngethuluzi ngalinye. Amabhayisikili, njengezithuthuthu, ahlinzeka ngendlela yokuhamba engabizi kakhulu futhi ephephile. Akukhulumi nje ngentengo yokuthenga, kodwa futhi nesimo sokugcina, ngoba amabhayisikili adinga ukugcinwa okuncane uma kuqhathaniswa nezithuthuthu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili akhipha umoya opholile, okwenza kube lula ukufaka imizamo emzimbeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abahamba ngebhayisikili benza umsebenzi wokuqina, okungasiza ekunciphiseni isisindo nasekuthuthukiseni impilo jikelele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zikhangisa ngaphezu kokuhamba. Zikhawulela isikhathi sokuhamba, ziqhuba ngesivinini esikhulu, futhi zingafinyelela ezindaweni ezikude ngokushesha. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu kubantwana nabantu abadala abahamba emsebenzini, ngenxa yokuthi bakwazi ukufika endaweni yabo ngemizuzu embalwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithuthuthu zikhanga abafuna ukuzijabulisa, ngoba ukuhamba ngebhayisikili kungase kube nzima kwabaningi, kanti izithuthuthu zenza kube lula ukuhamba. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhamba ngezithuthuthu kuhilela izingozi eziningi, njengoba ubungozi bokushayisana bukhona kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga abanikazi bezithuthuthu ukuba babe neziqu eziphezulu zokuphepha, ezifana nezibuko kanye nemaski yokuphepha. Ngaphandle kokubheka izinzuzo, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo. Amabhayisikili aphumelele kakhulu ekuvikeleni imvelo. Awathathi amanzi amaningi, awakhiphi imikhaza engcolisa umoya, futhi akhuthaza umoya opholile. Lokhu kwenza amabhayisikili kube yindlela ephumelelayo yokuhamba endaweni ezinezinkinga zokungcoliswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zikhangisa ekongeni isikhathi, kodwa zikhumbula ukuthi zikhupha imikhaza eminingi emoyeni, okwenza kube nzima ukubaluleka kokuhamba kwezithuthuthu. Uma sikhuluma ngensizakalo, amabhayisikili angatholakala kalula. Abantu bangawathola kalula ezitolo noma online, futhi akudingeki ukuthi babe nemali eningi. Lokhu kuveza ithuba elikhulu lokuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-townships bangabathola kalula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zidinga ukugcinwa okuhle, okusho ukuthi abanikazi bazo kufanele babe nezezimali ezinzima ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili awadlalisi kuphela indima yokuhamba kodwa futhi ahlanganisa imiphakathi. Izindawo zokuhamba ngebhayisikili zikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlangane, bahlale bejabulile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Lokhu kuhlekelela ekukhuleni kwemiphakathi, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Izithuthuthu, zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, kodwa azikhiqizi ubudlelwano obufanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abahamba ngebhayisikili bahlala bezithokozisa ngendlela yokwenza okuthile, okubangela umoya opholile phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, ukukhetha phakathi kwamabhayisikili nezithuthuthu kuncike ezidingweni zomuntu ngamunye. Ukuthi uzofuna ukukhetha amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu kuncike kakhulu ezicini ezinjengokuthi izinto zikhona, izidingo zempilo, kanye nezinqumo zokudla. Amabhayisikili ahlanzekile, aphumelelayo, futhi akhululekile, kwazise izithuthuthu zinika amandla, isikhathi, nokugxila. Ngakho, ukuhlola lezi zindlela zokuhamba kuyisinyathelo esihle sokuthola ukuthi iyiphi indlela efanele kakhulu kuwe. Ngakho, ngabe amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu? Impendulo ingahluka kumuntu nomuntu, kodwa okubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokucabanga ngokwazisa kwethu kwempilo, umoya, nezimo. Ngaphakathi kohlanga lwezokuhamba, inhloso yethu yokuhamba ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi udinga ukukhetha okuzokwenza ube nekhono, ukhululekile, futhi ufinyelele izinjongo zakho.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwenombolo Yempesheni Kahulumeni Isingeniso Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bayakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abathola impesheni. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile ehlinzeka ngezinhlinzeko zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nezimpesheni zabo. Le mbiko igxile ekubalulekeni kokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, izinqubo ezihambisanayo, kanye nemiphumela yokungaqinisekiswa okuhle. Ukubaluleka Kokuqinisekiswa Kwenombolo Yempesheni Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo abazidingayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yezezimali iyasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abathola impesheni bathola izinzuzo zabo ngaphandle kokubambezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kunciphisa amathuba okukhwabanisa, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali kahulumeni. Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Inombolo Yempesheni Ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi unayo inombolo yempesheni efanele, etholakala ezincwadini ezisemthethweni noma kumarekhodi ezemali. Okwesibili, umsebenzisi kufanele avakashele iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-GEMS noma abize ucingo kumphakathi wezinsizakalo ukuze athole imiyalelo yokuhambisa isicelo sokuhlolela. Ngemva kokuhambisa isicelo, umsebenzisi uzothola impendulo, evamise ukuthatha izinsuku ezimbalwa. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane efakiwe iyahambisana nezincwadi ezisemthethweni, futhi uma kunokungahambelani, umsebenzisi uzocelwa ukuthi alungise imininingwane. Izinkinga Ezivamile Nokuqinisekiswa Kunamaphutha avamile ahambisana nokuhlolela inombolo yempesheni, okuhlanganisa ukungafani kwemibhalo, izinkinga zokuxhumana, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithintekayo. Lokhu kungabamba inqubo yokuhlolela, okungase kube nomthelela omubi kubathola impesheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi abheke lezi zinkinga futhi azame ukuzenza zibe lula ukuze inqubo iphumelele. Imiphumela Yokungaqinisekiswa Okuhle Uma inombolo yempesheni ingaqinisekiswa, imiphumela ingaba yimbi. Abathola impesheni bangase bahlale bezama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi banemali efanele, okungaholela ekukhathazekeni. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo, njengoba abanye bangase babe nezinselelo zokuphila uma behluleka ukuthola impesheni yabo ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaqinisekiswa kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali kahulumeni, njengoba izinsizakalo ezithile zingatholakali kubathola impesheni. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bathole izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abathola impesheni bazi izinkinga ezivamile ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale eqaphile futhi alandele izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ngokwenza lokhu, abathola impesheni bangakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo zabo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, futhi kuholele ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo.
Ukuphucwa Umhlaba Ngesikhathi Sobandlululo Kwathi ngesikhathi sobandlululo, umhlaba wethu wahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi. Abantu bahlukaniswa ngemibala, izinkolo, nezizinda zabo. Kulezi zikhathi ezinzima, kwavela abantu abaninzi abazinikele ekuphuculeni umhlaba, baphikisana nezinhlelo ezazibekwe ngempela. UThandi, intombazane encane eyayihlala edolobheni elincane, wayengomunye walabo ababengazi ukuthi umhlaba ungaba ngcono kanjani. UThandi wayenothando olukhulu lokufunda, futhi wayehlala efunda izincwadi ezazikhuluma ngamalungelo abantu. Wayazi ukuthi, noma ngabe ubani, kufanele anikezwe ithuba lokuphila impilo enokuthula. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umfana owayengaziwa edolobheni. U-Sipho wayehlupheka kakhulu, ngenxa yokuthi wayengomunye wabantu ababesebenzisa izinsiza ezincane. UThandi wamkhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba ubuhlanga bethu bungahluka, sonke siphila emhlabeni ofanayo. Bahlangana njalo, bexoxa ngezindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Bahlala behlola izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Bafunda ukuthi, uma bephikisana, kufanele bakhulume, bangavumelani, kodwa bahloniphe imizwa yomunye. UThandi noSipho baqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu, lapho abantu bekuza khona ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene beze, bejabulile ngokuhlangana. UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, uma abantu behlangana, izinkinga ziba lula. Kwakukhona izinkulumo eziningi, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa umhlaba ongcono. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, abantu baqala ukubona ukuthi, yize bephila ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlobene. UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, umhlaba ungaphucwa uma abantu behlangana, bephikisana, kodwa bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphucwa komhlaba. Kodwa, izinkinga zazingapheli. Kwakukhona abanye abantu ababesekela ubuhlanga, bephikisana nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela. UThandi noSipho bazi ukuthi, ukuze umhlaba uphucwe, kufanele bahlale bephikisana nobandlululo. Bafunda ukuthi, uma abantu behluleka ukuxhumana, umhlaba uhlala ubuthakathaka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqala ukuhlela izifundo ezincane, lapho abantu befundiswa khona ngamalungelo abantu, ubuhlanga, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ndawonye. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Kwakukhona izinselelo, kodwa uThandi noSipho babengayeki. Bahlala bephusha phambili, bephikisana nezinkinga, beqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba wabo uyaphucwa. UThandi wakhumbula umusho owawukhona encwadini yakhe: "Ukwazi ukuthi ungashintsha umhlaba, kungakuhle uma uqala ngokuqonda." Ngaleyondlela, umhlaba wabo waqala ukushintsha. Abantu baphuma ezindaweni zabo, behlangana, bexoxa, futhi befundisana. UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, noma ubani angaba nesandla ekuphuculeni umhlaba, uma kuphela ebekezela, futhi enza okuthile. Ekugcineni, umhlaba wabo waba ngcono. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila ndawonye, bexhumana. UThandi noSipho babazi ukuthi, uma abantu behlangana, baphikisana, kodwa bephila ngokuhlanganyela, umhlaba ungaba ngcono. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqonda ukuthi, ukuphucwa komhlaba akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Futhi, njengoba besebenza, babona ukuthi umhlaba ungahlala uphucwa, uma kuphela abantu bephila ndawonye, behlanganyela, futhi behloniphana. Ngale ndlela, uThandi noSipho bahlala bephusha umhlaba phambili, bejabulile, bephila impilo enokuthula. Umhlaba wabo waba yindawo yokwamukela, yokufunda, nokukhula. Ngakho, ukuphucwa komhlaba kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uThandi noSipho baba yizibonelo zabanye, bephila impilo enobuntu, beqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, umhlaba wabo waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlangana, baphikisana, kodwa behloniphana, umhlaba ungaba ngcono. Futhi, lokho kwaba yisifundo esikhulu sokuphila.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Kwavela umntwana omusha emzini omncane ogcwele imizwa. UZanele, umama wengane, wayezithwele ngothando, kodwa wayenokukhathazeka. Wafika esibhedlela, lapho abanye abesifazane bejabulisa izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lezi zinsuku zazigcwele ukuhlola nokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze uZanele akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kumntwana wakhe. Ngesikhathi efika, wathola izinsiza ezikhona, kodwa ubuhlungu bokuzalwa bukhona. UZanele wayezizwa engakhululeki, kodwa abaphathi bezokwelapha bamkhuthaza. Wathola usizo oluningi kumadokotela nabahlengikazi, ababeqonda kahle izidingo zomama nezingane. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuxoxa nokuhlanganyela. Njengoba ehamba phakathi kwezibhedlela, uZanele wafunda kakhulu. Abahlengikazi bamfundisa indlela yokunakekela umntwana, bebonisa indlela yokubamba, ukubheka, nokuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziyisisekelo. Wabona ukuthi umntwana udinga uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuphepha, okwakufanele kube khona ngaso sonke isikhathi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha empilweni yakhe. Izinsuku zokuqala zazinzima, kodwa uZanele waba nesibindi. Ngemva kokuhlinzekwa, wathola ithuba lokuhlala eduze komntwana wakhe, ebuka indlela abesebenza ngayo. USipho, umntwana wakhe, wayenobuso obuhle futhi wakhuluma kahle. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina umntwana ephilile, kodwa kubandakanya nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uZanele waqala ukubona izinguquko. USipho waqala ukujabulisa, ethokozisa abahlengikazi nabanye omama. Wawuqonda kahle umhlaba omjikelelayo, futhi uZanele wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwakhe kumntwana kwakuyinsiza enkulu. Abahlengikazi bahlala bemkhuthaza, bemfundisa indlela yokuphatha izikhathi ezinzima, futhi benza kube lula ukuba abesifazane baphile kahle. Ukwazi ukuthi uSipho uyakhula, uZanele wathola ukuthi udinga ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela. Waqopha izifundo azitholile, efunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokukhulisa umntwana. Wafunda ukuthi ukunakekela umntwana kuqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni. Waqonda ukuthi umama kufanele abe nesineke, athole usizo lapho kudingeka khona, futhi aqhubeke nokufunda. Ngesikhathi uZanele esebenza, wathola umphakathi obalulekile. Abanye omama bamthokozisa, bemxhasa ngezikhathi ezinzima. Kwakukhona izingxoxo ezijabulisayo, lapho behlanganyela izifundo zabo, izinkinga, nezixazululo. UZanele waba nesibindi sokukhuluma njengoba abanye abesifazane babebhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uZanele wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ukuxhumana. Waqonda ukuthi umama nomntwana badinga ukuxhumana ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. UZanele wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana komzimba, njengokubamba, ukuxoxa, nokuhamba, kube yindlela yokwakha uthando phakathi kwakhe noSipho. Ekugcineni, uZanele waphuma esibhedlela, esebenzisa konke akufundile. USipho wayesebenza kahle, futhi wayenobuso obujabulisayo. Waqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisifundo esiyingqayizivele sokuphila. Wafunda ukuthi uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuxhumana kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomntwana. Ngaleso sikhathi, uZanele waba umama ophumelelayo, futhi wayezithokozisa ngempilo yakhe. Waqhubeka nokufunda, nokukhulisa uSipho ngendlela efanele, futhi waba isibonelo esihle kwabanye abesifazane. UZanele wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kuhlala njalo, kuze kube phakade. Waqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane bukhula ngothando, futhi lokhu kwakuwumgomo wakhe empilweni. Ngakho, uZanele waphila impilo enothando, eqinisa imindeni, futhi eqinisa umphakathi. Uthando lwakhe noSipho lwaba yisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba izinsuku zokuqala zingaba nzima, ukuphila kungaba mnandi uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu, esashiya umphakathi unothando, unokuxhumana, futhi unokuthula. UZanele wayazi kahle ukuthi uthando lungabamba zonke izinkinga, futhi lokho kwaba yisifundo esiyigugu empilweni yakhe noSipho.
Sesifikile ekupheleni kwezinsuku ezinde zebusika, futhi kulokhu, sithole ukuhlolwa ngezimo zezulu ezibandayo zeHighveld, imvula ethule eCape Town, kanye nezinhlobo ezintsha zeflu eziphumelelayo ezidale ukuthi abantu badinge ukwelashwa emhlabeni jikelele. Kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo, i-GEMS ibenze umsebenzi wayo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo eziphezulu ezithengekayo futhi ezitholakala kalula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Amathiphu okuphila kahle: - Ukubhekana nokukhathala kwengqondo - Izindlela zokudla eziphilile - Thatha Isinyathelo! Kulobu busika, sithole futhi ugqozi ezindabeni ezithokozisayo ezivela kubalungu bethu ezweni lonke njengengxenye yokuncintisana kwe-GEMS Sisonke. Siyabonga ngalezi zindaba ezinhle eziningi enizabelane nathi. Izindaba ezithokozisayo ezivela kini ziwufakazi wokuthi i-GEMS idlala indima ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu nasempilweni yabalungu bayo. Kulungile ukwazi ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeka nokunakekela abalungu bayo lapho bedinga khona. Sizojabula ukwabelana ngalezi zindaba nani esikhathini esizayo emaphephandabeni afana ne-facets. Ubushushu buhlale buhamba nezinto ezintsha kanye nokuphila okulethwa yentwasahlobo! Phakathi kwalezi "zinto ezintsha zempilo," ngiyajabula ukulethela abalungu bethu iphephandaba lesithathu lesigaba se-facets. Ngiyethemba ukuthi nizojabulela ukwengeza kwe-facets. Usizo lwe-AIDS (AfA) yinkampani ephatha ukuxhumana kwe-HIV/AIDS esebenza ne-GEMS ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluyimfihlo oludingayo ngenkathi uphila ne-HIV. Bangakusiza futhi uma udinga olunye ulwazi ngalesi sifo. Ngokubheka kubo ukuze uthole usizo, uyazisiza ngokukhipha umthwalo we-virus ezikhumbeni zakho bese ubuyisela esandleni sakho. EUnice, uthisha, uthole ukuthi uphila ne-virus eminyakeni eyisikhombisa edlule ngesikhathi ethatha isinqumo sokuhlolwa ngemva kokushona komunye umndeni. "Kunzima kakhulu ukwazi ukuthi unale virus. Ukubhalisela uhlelo lokuphatha isifo se-HIV lwe-GEMS, oluphathwa yi-AfA, kusho ukuthi ngizoholwa futhi ngaziswa ngodokotela abaqeqeshiwe futhi ngizokwazi ukuthola ukuphumula." Naphezu kwemiphumela yesifo, kukhona indlela yokusiza. "Ngabe ngikhathazekile futhi ngikhathazekile ngengqondo ngenxa yesifo," kusho uEunice, "ngangingakwazi nokulala ebusuku ngenxa yokukhathazeka. Ngesikhathi ngibhalisela uhlelo lwe-AfA, babenobubele futhi baqonda isimo sami. Bangenza ngazi ukuthi ukuba ne-HIV nokungathathi imithi lapho kudingeka njengokushiya amasango neminyango yendlu yakho ivulekile wazi ukuthi abaphangi bayafika. Ngijabule ukwenza isinqumo sokuzibophezela, nakuba ngazi kahle ukuthi akuwona umphumela wami ukuba ne-HIV." Baphinde banginika ulwazi olubalulekile engingase ngingazi ngalesi sifo. USifiso, ilungu, uthole ukuthi i-AfA imsize ukubuyisela impilo yakhe esimweni esihle. "Bangifundisa 'Ukuphila Ngokuhle,' okungifundisa ukuthi ngiphile impilo yami entsha. Kukho ulwazi lokugcina izinto zami zihlanzekile nokudla izithelo nemifino ukuze ngingatholi ukutheleleka. Baphinde bangitshele ukuthi yiziphi izidlo ezinhle engingazidla nokuthi kufanele ngisebenze kangakanani nokuthi kufanele ngilale isikhathi esingakanani. Impela, ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu manje. Ngempela, kubonakala sengathi ngiqala impilo kabusha." Uhlelo lokuphatha isifo se-HIV lwe-GEMS, oluphathwa yi-AfA, lwenza uEunice noSifiso bazifundise ngenkathi iScheme iphatha ezinye izici. Imithi ibhekwa ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe imiphumela efanele. Odokotela nabasebenzi bezinhlaka baqinisekisa ukuthi isiguli ngasinye sithatha imithi efanele ukuze impilo yabo iqhubeke ngokujwayelekile. Isiguli ngasinye sithola izeluleko zempilo yengqondo, njengoba impilo yabo yok emotional nepsychological ibalulekile hhayi kuphela kubo kodwa nakwabanye abaseduze nabo. "Ngaphambi kokuthi ngibhalisele uhlelo lwe-AfA, ngangingasokhathazekile ngoba ngazi ukuthi ngiphila ne-HIV, futhi umndeni wami wawubona ukuthi ngikhathazekile ngengqondo. Kwakufana nenhlwathi emnyama eyayiphakeme phezu kwendlu yami, futhi ngazizwa ngathi kwaba wumthwalo wami. Manje njengoba ngise-ART, izinto seziwubuyile ejimini. Impela, kufanele ngithi ukuthi ukushintsha impilo yami kancane kancane kuyinto enhle. Ngizama ukuthatha imithi yami ngesikhathi ngisho noma ngigqoke ijersey uma kubanda, kunokuba ngizilimaze," kusho uSifiso. Bhalisela i-AfA, ngokuqinisekile, ngokuxhumana nabo ku-0860 100 646 noma ngokuthumela ifomu lesicelo ku-website www.gems.gov.za. Ukuphoxeka akukaze kusize muntu! Kunalokho, kwenza isimo sithuthuke. Ukuxhumana akucacile, okusho ukuthi izincazelo ziyalahleka, futhi izinqumo ezingalungile zenziwa. Lokhu okwenzeka ezweni lethu njengamanje nakwamanye amazwe mayelana ne-"swine flu," noma "Mexican flu," noma i-H1N1 virus, nakuba empeleni kunemizamo ethile eyenziwa ngabasebenzi bezempilo ukwazisa umphakathi ngeqiniso. Uma ubheka izinga lokufa kanye nokungaqondakali kwalo, akuyona ingozi enkulu kuneflu ejwayelekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi kubalulekile kubantu ukwazi ukuthi i-flu ejwayelekile ingadala izifo ezinzima, njenge-pneumonia. I-flu ejwayelekile ingaba nzima kakhulu, futhi ibulala abantu njalo ngonyaka. Ngokwe-NICD, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-flu virus ezivela ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene uma kuqhathaniswa ne-swine flu ezweni kuleli sikhathi. Isizathu sokuthi i-swine flu ibangele ukukhathazeka ukuthi iyivirus entsha. Abantu abavikeleki kwi-swine flu virus njengoba benza kwezinye izinhlobo ze-flu virus, abake bahlaselwa. Nokho, njengokwe-flu yesizini, i-swine flu akufanele ithathwe kalula. I-swine flu ivele njenge-flu yesizini enezimpawu eziningi ezifana ne-fever, headache, ubuhlungu bezitho zomoya, ukuhuhuma, nokuba nenhliziyo ephumayo. I-swine flu iphinde ihluke kwi-flu yesizini kwezinye izimpawu; njengezimpawu zesisu, ukuhamba, nokushaywa kwenhliziyo okukhulunywe ngakho. Abanye abagulayo baphinde babe nezimpawu ezinzima, kuyilapho abaningi bahlongoza isifo esincane. Uma unalezi zimpawu ezingenhla, vakashela udokotela wakho ngaphambi kokuphuthuma esibhedlela noma ngaphambi kokuthenga i-oseltamivir (Tamiflu), imithi ye-swine flu. Nakuba abanye odokotela beqoka i-Tamiflu kubagulayo ngaphandle kokuvuma ukuthi umuntu uthintekile, abanye bavuma ukuthi ukuthatha imithi uma ungathintekile nge-swine flu kwenza kube lula ukuyithola esikhathini esizayo - uma ujwayele ukuthatha le mithi, i-virus ingase ibe ne-resistance kuyo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uqobo uthola i-swine flu virus futhi udinga i-Tamiflu, ngeke isisebenze kahle. Ukuze isebenze kahle, ngokufanayo, udokotela onolwazi angaphakamisa ukuthi isiguli
Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi kuyigama elaziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Yini "ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni"? Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kuyisibopho somthetho sabashicileli bazo zonke izinhlobo zeziphakamiso ukufaka inani elithile lezi zikhumbuzo ezindaweni ezithile lapho lezi zikhumbuzo zibhaliswe khona ngokusemthethweni. Izincwadi kumele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekwe ngokusemthethweni ngezindleko zomshicileli, futhi lokhu kumele kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 zokushicilelwa. Inhloso yokubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokwenza kube khona ulwazi nolwazi lwamasiko ezizweni, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izincwadi ezitholakalayo. Umthetho ophathelene nalokhu wakhululwa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Okushicilela ka-1965 kanye noMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni ka-1982, kuze kube umthetho wamanje, uMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni washicilelwa ngo-1997, okukhuluma ngokufakwa kwezincwadi zedijithali nezo ezihambisana nomsindo. Iziphakamiso ziwumkhiqizo noma iyiphi impahla ehlose ukugcina noma ukudlulisa umyalezo ngombhalo, isithombe, umsindo, noma iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana enokuqukethwe okucabangekayo. Yini okufanele ifakwe? Amakhadi ezinkampani noma ama-check. Iqinisekisa ukufinyelela kuzo zonke izincwadi ezishicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Iyi-pillar eyodwa yolwazi olukhululekile. Iyi-rekhodi yezincwadi zonke ezikhiqizwe yizwe. Iqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yezisebenzi ezishicilelwe igcinwa futhi itholakala ukuze ibolekwe. Igcina umsebenzi wababhali nabashicileli ukuze usebenze ngocwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo. Isetha isisekelo sokuhlanganisa iNgqungquthela Yomlando YaseNingizimu Afrika, ethumele abasebenzisi bayo kulo lonke izwe ngama-ziphakamiso akhona, ngaleyo ndlela ithuthukisa ukusatshalaliswa kwabo kanye nokumaketha. Inombolo yokuxhumana yokusiza itholakala eMnyangweni Wezincwadi ZaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze icacise izinto eziphathelene nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni.
Ukufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziningi, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza abantu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Phakathi kwalezi zinhlangano, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) yaziwa kakhulu. Le mfundiso yempilo yadalwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. I-GEMS yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2005, ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni efuna ukwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkinga eziningi zempilo zazikhona, futhi abantu abaningi babengenayo indlela yokuthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. I-GEMS yabe isiza ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho izinsiza zezempilo zazingatholakali kalula. Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujoyina i-GEMS, bekudingeka ukuthi ahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, umgomo wokuqala wukuthi umuntu kumele abe ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abasebenzi bakahulumeni bekwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibhekelele izidingo ezithile ezihlobene nezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathola izinsiza banelisekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze ibonise izinzuzo zayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa phakathi kwabantu, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangawathola kanjani la maphakheji. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle, njengoba abantu abaningi baqala ukujoyina i-GEMS, bejabulile ngempilo yabo. Kodwa-ke, nakuba i-GEMS inezinzuzo eziningi, bekukhona nezinkinga ezazivela. Abanye abantu babengathokozile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi bekukhona izikhalazo ezivela kubantu ababephakathi kwalesi simo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni i-GEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo, ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi layo likhule, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izinsizakalo zayo zibe ngcono. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi layo likhule, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izinsizakalo zayo zibe ngcono. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha.
