Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukuhlanganyela Nokuhlangabezana Kwezakhamuzi Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlolanja 2023, umphakathi waseMbombela ubebuthene ndawonye emcimbini omkhulu obuhlanganisa abantu abaningi ezindaweni ezahlukene zedolobha. Lo mcimbi, owawubanjelwe emaphandleni eThekwini, wawuhloselwe ukuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezindawo zomphakathi, ukuxhumana kwabantu, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezahlukene ezidingekayo emphakathini. Umcimbi uqale ngekhonsathi yezenzo ezahlukene zamasiko, lapho izinkampani zomculo nezithakazelo zomdabu zedlula phambili zikhombisa ubuciko bazo. Abasolwazi bezamasiko baphinde baqhakambisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa amasiko endawo, okuhlanganisa, phakathi kokunye, imidlalo yendabuko, izinkulumo ezikhanyisayo, kanye nezifundo zezenhlalo. Abantu basemphakathini babebonakala bejabule, besebenzisa leli thuba ukuze bahlanganyele, baxoxe, futhi benze ubudlelwano. Umlingani wombiko, uNksz. Nandi Mthethwa, uthe: "Lo mcimbi ubaluleke kakhulu ngoba ubufaka bonke abantu bethu ndawonye. Sidinga ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi, futhi izenzakalo ezifana nalezi ziyasiza ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile." Ubuye wabhala ukuthi imicimbi eyanelisayo ibalulekile ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onezinhlelo ezihluke-hluke ezithuthukisayo. Ngemuva kokuphela kokuhlangana, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ethile ebanzi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzithandela, imifundaze, nezinhlelo zemfundo. Lokhu kube yithuba elihle lokuthi abantu abasha basebenze ndawonye, bajule emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa izindawo zabo. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwezemfundo lwaluhloselwe ukusiza abantwana nabantu abadala ukuba bathole amakhono abalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukukwazi ukuphila kahle. Ubhishobhi wombiko, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, uthe: "Sizokwenza imicimbi enjalo njalo ukuze siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano, ubumbene, futhi ophumelelayo. Imisebenzi eyenzekayo iyayiqhakambisa imiphakathi yethu, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile." Kuhlanganiswe futhi izinsiza ezahlukene ezitholakala emphakathini, phakathi kwazo izikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezihlinzeka ngokuqashwa. Abaholi bomphakathi bacacisile ukuthi kunemisebenzi eminingi ezayo, okuhlanganisa nokwakha izikhungo eziningi zokuphila, ezokwelapha, nezokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi nezikhungo ezizimele, kuboniswe njengomgomo obalulekile. Ngaphakathi kwemihlangano, abaholi baphinde bakhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ezitholakala emphakathini. Lokhu kuba isixhaso sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho zonke izakhamizi ziba neqhaza elibucayi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imicimbi efana nale ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni izinsiza ezithuthukisayo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu bahlale bejabule, benze ubudlelwano, futhi baqhubele phambili imisebenzi ethuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ngezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi waseMbombela uthole ithuba lokubumba ikusasa labo, baqinisekisa ukuthi imicimbi efana nale izoqhubeka nokubumbana nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezindawo zomphakathi. Imicimbi yomphakathi iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza, baqhakambise izimpilo, futhi banikeze ithuba elihle lokuhlangana. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlangana, ukufunda, nokukhula njengomphakathi, okubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngokwenza lokhu, umphakathi ubonisa ukuthi uhlala unamandla, futhi uzimisele ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihambisana nezinjongo zomphakathi. Imicimbi efana nale iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi imisebenzi yokubumbana ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma ibanjwa ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubonisa indlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobudlelwano, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo.
UNovak Djokovic: Umphakathi Wokudlala Itennis Emhlabeni UNovak Djokovic, umdlali odumile we-tennis, wazalwa ngoJulayi 22, 1987, eBelgrade, eSerbia. Uhlanga lwakhe luhlanganisa izimpande zamasiko aseYurophu, kodwa impilo yakhe ibingeyona eyomndeni kuphela, futhi ibingeyona eyomphakathi. Wakhulela ezweni elibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, kodwa lokhu akukavumi ukuvimba ekufezekiseni amaphupho akhe. Umdlalo wakhe we-tennis waqala esencane, lapho enza khona izifundo ezijabulisayo, efuna ukufunda umdlalo. UNovak wathola uthisha odumile, uMarjan Vajda, owamsiza ukuba aqonde kahle imithetho ye-tennis nokuthi angathuthukisa kanjani imidlalo yakhe. Ngemva kokuzikhandla, uNovak waqala ukujabulisa izithameli ngezindlela zakhe ezihlukile zokudlala, ezamthuthukisa ekubeni isikhumbuzo emlandweni. Ukunqoba kwakhe kokuqala kwenzeka ngo-2003, lapho enqoba umqhudelwano we-ATP e-Amersfoort, eNetherlands, okuwukuhamba kwesinyathelo sokuqala endleleni yakhe yokuba ngumdali ophumelelayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, uNovak waqhubeka nokukhula emkhakheni we-tennis, wathola iziqu eziningi ezibalulekile, kuhlanganise neGrand Slam, okuyizindlalifa ezinkulu zomhlaba. Umdlalo wakhe ubukeka unamandla, ubonisa ubuchule obuphezulu, kanye nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2011, uNovak wathola impumelelo enkulu, waba ngumdlali wokuqala ukuncintisana noRoger Federer noRafael Nadal, abanye bama-greats emlandweni we-tennis. Uqhubekile nokudlala kahle, wathola iziqu eziningi, futhi waba nguMphakathi Wokudlala Itennis. UNovak ubonisa isibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzikhandla, nokuzimisela, okwenza abanye baphuphe ngempumelelo efana neyakhe. Ngaphezu kokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, uNovak ubonisa uthando lwakhe emiphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi izingane, ngokusebenzisa imifundaze yakhe. Uhlanganisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa imfundo, impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uNovak akagcini nje ngokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, kodwa futhi ungumuntu onomoya omuhle, ofuna ukusiza abanye. UNovak Djokovic akafuni ukuba umphakathi umcabangele njengomuntu ophumelelayo kuphela, kodwa futhi njengomuntu onobuntu. Uhlonipha imindeni yakhe, abahlobo, nabalandeli, futhi ubona ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuhlonipha kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhliziyweni zabantu, futhi uNovak ubonakala engumuntu osebenzayo, onobuhlakani, futhi onobuqotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNovak uqhubeka nokukhula, efunda ezintweni ezintsha, futhi eqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umdlalo wakhe. Uhlale eqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi akavumi ukuhamba phansi. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwenza ngcono, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uNovak ungumuntu onomoya wokuphumelela. UNovak Djokovic ungumlingani omkhulu, umphakathi, nomphakathi. Ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kuphela ngamakhono, kodwa futhi ngothando, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlala unethemba. Ubonisa ukuthi noma ngabe izinkinga zikhona, kungenzeka ukufinyelela phezulu uma umuntu ezikhandla futhi enza imizamo. UNovak uhlala engumfanekiso omuhle, owaziwayo, futhi ophumelelayo, futhi umphakathi uhamba phambili, uqhubeka nokukhula, ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe kanzima. Ngokuphetha, uNovak Djokovic ungumuntu owaziwayo emhlabeni, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ungumuntu ophilayo, onothando, futhi onomoya omuhle. Uhlale efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi akavumi ukuhamba phansi. UNovak ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kuphela ngamakhono, kodwa futhi ngothando, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlala unethemba. Ngalokhu, uNovak Djokovic uyisibonelo esihle sokuphila, sokusebenza kanzima, nokuhlala unethemba, okwenza abanye baphuphe ngempumelelo efana neyakhe.
Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo Ngonyaka ka-1994, emuva kokhetho lokuqala elivulekile, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wawubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Lo nyaka wawufanekisela ukubuyiselwa kwezinto, kodwa futhi wawubeka phambili nesidingo sokuchibiyela emthethosisekelo wamaNgisi. Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kulolu shintsho kwaba yigugu elikhulu. Lokhu kwavula amathuba wokuthi abantu bangenelele ngezwi labo emibuzweni ebalulekile ebhekene nezwe. Ngemuva kokukhululwa kukaNelson Mandela, indawo yokuxhumana phakathi komphakathi neziphathimandla yaguquka kakhulu. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwemiphakathi lwasungulwa ngokuhambisana nosuku olunqamukile, lapho kwabekwa umgomo wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo nesithemiso esihle. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwazisa abantu bengabathathi, bakhulume ngezinto ezibucayi ezibalulekile empilweni yabo. Ngesikhathi sokubambisana phakathi kwezifundazwe, abaklami bezinhlelo besebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze babambe iqhaza emphakathini. Izinkulumo, imihlangano, nezibopho zokuhlanganyela zabe zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhulume ngempumelelo yezehlakalo ezithinta impilo yabo. Umsebenzi wemiphakathi owawuhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi, uthintekayo empilweni nasemphakathini, waba yisixazululo esikhaliphile sokukhulisa izwi elibushelelezi. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwathiwa "Iyasebenza" lenza izinyathelo eziyinqaba. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene ukuba basize ekuhleleni imigomo namagugu ezobulungiswa kumthetho. Empeleni, umphakathi waba ngumsebenzi ongokwayo, umbono ophakeme wokukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkanyezi zawo kokwazisa lokuthuthukiswa. Umkhosi, ogcwele imihlangano, wasungulwa ukuze kuhambisane nezinsuku ezisemqoka zenqubo yokuchibiyela komthetho. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukuxhumana ngokukhululekile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi neziphathimandla kwakhuthaza inhlonipho nemigomo emisha. Abaningi babebonisa ukuvuma izinqumo ezicomekayo, beqhakambisa izifiso zabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izinyathelo ezithile zivyathwa yizinto ezinkulu ezazisicking phakade ekwakheni imithetho yezokuphatha engaba yokuhlaleka. Uma edlula eminyakeni, abaqhamukeli abahamba phambili baveza ubuhlakani obumangalisayo ukuze babonge izimvo ezivela komphakathi, behlukana nokubukeka kwezimvo ezinhle ezihambisana nezindikimba ezahala. Lokhu kuhlangana kwavula indlela yokuhlola imithetho, ovame ukuba nempumelelo emithonjeni ebonwa komphakathi, uhambisana nezidingo zempilo ezibalulekile. Kanye nokubambisana okulindelekayo, ukuhlobana komphakathi nezinhlelo ezibucayi zaphinde zavuma izigaba ezihlukahlukene. Abesifazane, izinsizwa, ubuhlakani bezifunda, nezindlalifa zaba phakathi kwezingxenye eziyinhloko zendaba ebalulekile yezehlakalo. Lezi, zaqhubeka zikhula zodwa, zibhalela izimvo ngezindaba ezahlukahlukene ezibandakanya ubumqoka bezombusazwe, izinsiza, nezinsiza. Izinqumo ezithathiwe zabathintekayo kwavuma ukuveza izici ezintsha ezikhombisa ukuqondiswa kwemigomo eyenzekile. Lokhu kuboniswe ngokukhuluma ngokucacile, ukugqugquzela kuphakamisa udumo lokuzigcina. Ukujula kwezincazelo zemithetho ezichaza umphakathi, kuveza ubunzima bokubambisana nezindlela ezizinzile. Lokhu kuveza umkhuba osemtshali emhlabeni jikelele ukuze umphakathi uzimele ekwahlukaniseni. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelelise izinjongo zawo, uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza ludinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kudinga abadlali abaningi, abathintekayo, abasanda kuhlangana nezici zomphakathi, nasesikhathini esizayo. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe, umthetho, nobuhlakani bempilo zidinga ukuqaphela ukungqubuzana okukhona, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile. Isidingo senqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isidakamizwa esiphezulu, ngokuhlanganisa izwi ofuna ukudala igugu elisha. Futhi, lokhu kuholele emsebenzini omusha wokwakha umthetho ofanele nezindlela zokuphatha ezikhiqiza umphakathi ophilayo. Ngenxa yesi sikhathi esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza komphakathi, umkhiqizo owakhiwa kulezi zinguquko udinga ukuhlolwa, ukuze kuhlale kutshalwa umoya omusha emiphakathini nasezweni. Ngokubambisana, izimvo zikhula ngokuphumelelayo, zithinta imiphakathi ezithile, zikhuthaza ukuba umphakathi ube nomthelela omkhulu ekuchibiyelweni, kwempumelelo, nokwenziwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza elikhulu, ube neqhaza elivelayo ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuhlonipha nokwandisa ubuhlakani bazo. Kuze kube namuhla, inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo isazogcina isebenza, ifaneleka njengemodeli yolwazi lokwandisa ubuhlakani nolwazi phakathi kwabantu. Umphakathi, uma uhlanganyela, ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile, okugqugquzela isibopho somphakathi, nezokuphatha eziyisisekelo. Le ndlela ivula amathuba okwenziwa kwezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni, xa kuthiwa izikhathi zishintsha. Ngakho-ke, inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo ibalulekile, ibonisa ukuthi amandla omphakathi avulekile futhi akwazi ukuyakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, umphakathi onothando nezinto ezimangalisayo. Ubuqotho kumele kube yisiko, kanti ubumbano lwabantu luzoba yinsika eqinile yokwakha izizukulwane ezizayo.
Kwakhiwe uhlelo lokuphenya ngemuva kokushiswa kwesakhiwo eGoli ezinsukwini ezedlule, lapho umphakathi ub faced isikhumbuzo esibi somlilo. Umlilo, owenzeka phakathi nosuku, waba nemiphumela emibi, waholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo nokulahleka kwezimpahla eziningi. Uphenyo olwenziwe ngabeZithombe, iziphathimandla, kanye nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, lukhombisa ubunzima bokuphila emadolobheni amakhulu. Uphenyo luveze ukuthi umlilo uqale ngezizathu ezingaziwa, nokho kukhona izinkomba ezikhombisa ukungahleleki kwezokuphepha. Izinhlelo zokuphepha, ezifana nama-alamu nezinhlelo zokuphuma, zibonakale zingasebenzi kahle, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi kwesakhiwo ukuphuma ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izakhiwo ezinkulu eGoli zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Abaphenyi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zazingahambisani nezindinganiso ezidingekayo, okukhombisa ukuthi abathengi, abaklami, nabakhi kufanele babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izakhiwo eziphephile. Izinhlelo zokuhlola izakhiwo zidinga ukuqiniswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibucayi. Ukwengeza, umphakathi ubhekene nokungabi nolwazi olunembile ngezindlela zokuphuma uma kwenzeka umlilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono izingozi ezihambisana nomlilo. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, nezikhungo zokwakha kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokuphuma ngokushesha uma kuvela izimo ezinjalo. Uphenyo lukhombisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kufanele zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani uma kwenzeka umlilo. Ukuhlanganiswa kolwazi phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kungasiza ekwakheni uhlelo lokuphepha oluhlanganisiwe. Mayelana nezimpilo ezilahlekile, umphakathi uthole ukwesekwa okuhle, kodwa kudingeka izinhlelo eziphusile zokubhekana nezimo ezinjalo, okuhlanganisa ukuxhasa imindeni elahlekile, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokubuyisela abantu ezimpilweni zabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nabantu kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bayathola usizo. Isifundo esibalulekile kulolu phenyo sithi ukuphepha akufanele kube yinto ethile, kodwa umqondo ophilayo. Izakhiwo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuphepha, futhi umphakathi kufanele ube nolwazi oluqinile ukuze ukwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, iziphathimandla, kanye nabakhi. Ngokuqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi iziphathimandla ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuhlola izakhiwo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ezimeni ezinjalo, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nokuqonda okukhulu ngezingozi ezihlobene nomlilo. Ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo zokwakha kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izifundo ezitholakele kulolu phenyo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, leli phuzu lokuphenya lukhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi ukuphepha akuyona into okufanele sithathe kalula. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokwakha izakhiwo eziphephile, futhi iziphathimandla kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubomgomo zokuphepha ziyanakwa. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvikela izimpilo zabantu, futhi sigweme izigameko ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo. Umlilo wesakhiwo eGoli ungum reminder obalulekile wokuthi, nakuba izakhiwo zikhula, ukuphepha kufanele kube phezulu ohlwini lwezinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuphenya kufanele kube yisiqalo sokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zethu zihlala ziphephile, futhi umphakathi uhlala uphephile.
Ukubhema kuyinto enhle engiyenzayo? Ngidinga ukususa ibhokisi lami lempi. Kubuhlungu kangakanani ukuyeka ukubhema? Kungani kufanele uyeke ukubhema? Yini ekukhalisela? Ingabe ufuna ukuyeka ukubhema kodwa ungazi ukuthi uqale kuphi? Uma kunjalo, le bhukwana izokusiza. Sizokwenza ukuba uyeke ukubhema phakade - ngokuchaza ukuthi kwenzekani uma uyeka ukubhema, nokuthi kungani kwenzeka, futhi sizophinde sichaze ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezinkinga ongahlangabezana nazo. Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Kwakungokwesibili ekuseni, uNandi wayevuka ekuseni, ehlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima. Umama wakhe, uGogo, wayengaphilile kahle, enezimpawu ezinzima zokugula. U-Nandi wayezama ukuthola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, kodwa wayazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku, izibhedlela zazihlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi. U-Nandi wahamba waya esibhedlela esiseduzane, enethemba lokuthi kuzotholakala imithi edingekayo. Lapho efika, wathola umphakathi omkhulu abantu abahlala bezilindele. Abanye babebonakala bephoxekile, abanye bephuza amanzi, bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela. U-Nandi wathola umgibeli, umphakathi ubonakala ungenamandla, uthwele izinkinga ezinzima. "Ngiyaxolisa, kodwa imithi ayitholakali," kusho udokotela omncane, ebuka uNandi ngamehlo anokukhathazeka. "Sizama konke okusemandleni ethu, kodwa imithombo yethu iphelile." U-Nandi waphendula, "Kodwa kungani? Kungani umphakathi wethu ungatholi imithi edingekayo? U-Gogo udinga imithi yokwelapha." "Ngiyazi, kodwa izinkinga ezinkulu zikhona. Ukushoda kwemali, izinkinga zokuhlinzeka, konke lokhu kudala ubunzima," kuchaza udokotela. U-Nandi waphuma esibhedlela, enezinyembezi emehlweni akhe. Wayazi ukuthi uGogo wayengakwazi ukulinda. Wazi ukuthi kufanele athole indlela yokusiza, noma ngabe kunzima kangakanani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Nandi wanquma ukuhamba edolobheni elikhulu eliseduzane, lapho kuthiwa khona imithi iyatholakala. Waqala uhambo lwakhe, emoyizela izinyathelo zakhe. Wafika edolobheni, kodwa wathola ukuthi imithi ibiza kakhulu. U-Nandi wayengenamali eyanele, futhi lokhu kumshiya edidekile. Ngemva kokuhlala edolobheni, wahlangana noSizwe, umngane wakhe owayesebenza ezibhedlela. USizwe waphendula, "Nandi, ngiyazi ukuthi kudinga imithi, kodwa kufanele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Akukhona nje ukushoda kwemithi, kodwa kudinga ukuba sikhulume ngempilo yethu, nendlela yokwenza izibhedlela zisebenze kangcono." U-Nandi wathola umqondo omusha. Wavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezinkulu ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Bahlangana nabanye abantu bendawo, benza umhlangano wokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela. Baphakamisa iziphakamiso, bafuna ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emisha ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uNandi wabona ukuthi abantu bezibhedlela bakhuluma kakhulu. Bahamba besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngemithi, basebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinhlelo zokubambisana. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abantu bezwe bahlala bejolile, bephokophelela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uGogo wathola imithi edingekayo. U-Nandi waba nomuzwa wokwaneliseka, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye abantu bekuyindlela yokuthola izixazululo. Wazi ukuthi ukushoda kwemithi akukhona kuphela, kodwa kuyinselele yokwakha umphakathi onamandla. U-Nandi waphinde waphuma esibhedlela, kodwa manje wayenokholo. Wayazi ukuthi imizamo yabo yayizokwenza umehluko. Ukushoda kwemithi kwakuyinselele, kodwa ubuhlakani, ubumbano, nokusebenza ngokubambisana kwakuwumgomo omuhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi wayeqonda ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi imithi iyisixazululo, kodwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bayo yinto ebaluleke kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izibhedlela zathola ukwesekwa, zathuthukiswa, futhi zaba nezinsiza ezinhle. U-Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangathola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uGogo waphila kahle, futhi uNandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zingaba nzima, ubumbano lungavula izindlela eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba namandla, futhi izibhedlela zathola imithi eyanele. U-Nandi wayejabule, ngoba wayazi ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bayo bukhulu kakhulu. Kwakungesikhathi sokuphila, futhi uNandi wayezimisele ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze akhe umphakathi ophilayo.
Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Izimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izigameko ezidinga ukuphathwa ngokushesha ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okukhulu noma ukufa. Ukuze iziguli zithole usizo olufanele, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo zokuphatha lezi zimo. Ukuqonda Izimo Eziphuthumayo Izimo eziphuthumayo zingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izimo zokulimala, izifo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezimo ezivela emithonjeni yokuphila. Abahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo kumele bazi izimpawu ezihambisana nalezi zimo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo nezifanele. Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izimo Eziphuthumayo Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinyathelo ezicacile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphathwa kahle kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokubika izimo eziphuthumayo, okuhlanganisa ukwakha indlela yokuxhumana esheshayo phakathi kwabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nezisebenzi zokuphuthumayo. Ukuze lokhu kusebenze, izibhedlela kumele zibe nezinsiza ezanele. Okwesibili, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola iziguli ngokushesha. Abahlengikazi kumele babe neziqu eziphezulu nezifundo eziqondene nezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele. Ukusebenza Kweqembu Ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuba abantu basebenze njengeqembu. Abahlengikazi, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane, baxhumane, futhi bahloniphe imisebenzi yomunye nomunye. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi bazo mayelana nokubaluleka kokubambisana. Ukuqeqeshwa Nokuqhubeka Kwezemfundo Ukuze abasebenzi bezempilo bahlale bekwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphindaphindwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, izifundo, kanye nezifundo ezikhethekile. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezanele zokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo. Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinhlelo Izibhedlela kufanele zihlale zibuyekeza izinhlelo zazo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo, ukuthola impendulo kubasebenzi, kanye nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezisebenzayo. Isiphetho Izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile, zisebenze njengeqembu, futhi ziqhubeke ziqeqesha abasebenzi bazo. Ngale ndlela, izibhedlela zingakwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngempumelelo, zinciphise ubungozi, futhi zandise amathuba okuphila kweziguli.
Sebenzisa imephu yeNingizimu Afrika ukukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape itholakala kuphi. Isithombe 1: Iqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo emhlanganweni walo. Isithombe 2: Umongameli weqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo, uMnu. Magidela, phambi kwemifino yakhe. Le nqola yokufunda itholakala kuphi? Le nqola yokufunda itholakala endaweni yasemaphandleni lapho kungekho izindlela ezinhle nezitolo. Itholakala cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-60 ukusuka eBizana eNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Kukhona amalungu angama-100 kule nqola. Kukhona amahektare angama-100 angavunwa. Yini imbangela yokungavuni yonke imhlaba engavunwa? Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokutshala. Ukuntuleka kwezinto zokwakha izithiyo. Izimo zezulu - ekuqaleni kwesizini yokutshala ngo-2010, imvula yayinzima kakhulu, yenza kube nzima ukuthumela. Ibanga elide lokuxhumana nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsiza zokutshala, njengezithelo, imbewu, nezikhemikhali. Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kaninginingi? Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kanye ngenyanga neGrain SA, futhi lihlangana ngeviki ukuze lixoxe ngezindaba zokulima. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda? Ikakhulu, izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda zihlanganisa ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukuxoxa namanye amalungu eqembu, ukuthola izindlela ezifanele zokusebenza ezifana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukutshala, ukufaka izibulala-zinambuzane, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Iqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo lenze kahle ukuvakashela iSeshini Yokuqala Yokufundisa Ngokutshala Imifino. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweqembu lokufunda nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Okwamanje, awekho abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo! Iqembu lokufunda liphumelele kanjani ezinsizeni ezinikezwa yiGrain SA? Ngesikhathi semihlangano yabo, amalungu athola ulwazi nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela ezifanele zokutshala. Ukuhlola nokuhlola kuveze izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izikhemikhali nezithelo. Lapho amalungu ehlangana ukuze akhe iqembu lokufunda, iqembu lonke lingathenga izikhemikhali nezithelo, hhayi njengabantu ngabanye.
Izinyathelo Zokuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi: Ukuqinisekisa Impilo Yabantu Umphakathi uthole ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nezinyathelo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi, ezisemqoka ekuphumeleleni kwezinsiza zezempilo. Ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi akugcini nje ngokukwaziwa kokuthola usizo lwezokwelapha, kodwa kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni impilo yabantu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinqubo ezihlukahlukene ezihilelekile ekuthunyelweni kwama-ambulensi, ukuze siqonde kahle imithetho nemigomo ehambisana nale nqubo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kuqala ngokuqonda isimo esiphuthumayo. Uma umuntu ethola ukulimala noma ebhekene nesimo esiphuthumayo, usizo kufanele lufike ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukusondela phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, okubandakanya abezokwelapha, abezokuphepha, nezinsizakalo zama-ambulensi. Uma umuntu ebanga usizo, kufanele akhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngomyalezo onembile, okukhuluma ngesimo, indawo, nemininingwane yomuntu odinga usizo. Ngemva kokuthunyelwa komyalezo, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi ziqala ngokushesha. Ama-ambulensi anamalungelo nezinsiza ezithile ezifana nodokotela, abezokwelapha, kanye nemishini ethile. Njengoba ama-ambulensi esondela endaweni, abezokwelapha baphuthuma ukuze banakekele impilo yomuntu odinga usizo. Okwesibili, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ukuhamba kahle phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza kufanele zihlanganyele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Izinhlangano zempilo, ezokuphepha, kanye nezinsizakalo zamasipala kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphumela. Uma ama-ambulensi edlula, izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqondise imithwalo yokusebenza kwawo, kuhlanganise nokuhlela izindlela ezihle zokuhamba, ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela eziteshini zokwelashwa, kanye nokuhlonipha imithetho yokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zihlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokuqapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. Abaphathi bezinsiza kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ama-ambulensi ahlola izimo zawo njalo, aqinisekisa ukuthi abezokwelapha banazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu kubalulekile. Abantu abathintekayo, abezokuphepha, nabashayelayo ama-ambulensi kumele babe nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo ezibalulekile ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo, ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathumele izicelo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kalula, okunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlela izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukubambisana, nokuxhumana okuhle. Umphakathi kufanele uqwashiswe ngalezi zinqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka sikhumbula ukuthi impilo yomuntu ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi le mpilo iyaphepheka.
Umlando Wezinyunyana Zabasebenzi: Isingeniso Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi uhlanganisa izigameko ezibalulekile ezihlobene nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezizama ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, ukuthuthukisa izimo zabo zokusebenza, kanye nokufezekisa izinzuzo ezithile. Lezi zinyunyana zaba neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezomnotho, ezombusazwe, kanye nezokuhlalisana. Ukuze uqonde kahle umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu ezaholela ekwakhiweni kwalezi zinhlangano. Isigaba 1: Izizathu Zokwakhiwa Kwezinhlangano Zabasebenzi Ngaphambi kokuba zibe khona izinyunyana, abasebenzi babebhekene nezimo ezinzima, ezifana nokusebenza isikhathi eside, izinkokhelo eziphansi, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abasebenzi baqonde ukuthi kudingeka kube nenhlangano yokuvikela amalungelo abo. Izinyunyana zaba yindlela yokuhlanganyela, evumela abasebenzi ukuba bazwakalise izikhalazo zabo futhi bafune izinguquko ezizothuthukisa izimo zabo. Isigaba 2: Ukuqala Kwezinhlangano Zabasebenzi Ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-19, izinyunyana zabasebenzi zaqala ukuvela emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi eYurophu naseMelika. Lokhu kwavela ngesikhathi sokukhula kwemboni, lapho abanikazi bezimboni babefuna ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, kodwa bengenakukhokhela abasebenzi izinzuzo ezifanele. Abasebenzi baqala ukuhlanganisa izinyunyana ukuze bathole amandla okuphikisa, bakhe imithombo yokuxhasana, futhi babonise ubunye babo. Isigaba 3: Ukukhula Kwezinyunyana Zabasebenzi Njengoba izinyunyana zandise amaqembu, zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zomsebenzi. Izinyunyana zafaka izicelo zokuthi kube nezivumelwano ezicacile mayelana nezimo zomsebenzi, izinkokhelo, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlaka eziningi, ezifana nezinhlangano zabasebenzi ezikhethekile, ezazihlanganisa abasebenzi bezimboni ezithile. Izinyunyana zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinkulu, njengezivumelwano zokusebenza ezihlonipha amalungelo abasebenzi. Isigaba 4: Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma izinyunyana zaba namandla, zaphinde zaba nezinselelo ezinzima. Abanikazi bezimboni, kanye nohulumeni, bavame ukungavumi izicelo zezinyunyana, baphinde baqhuba izinyathelo zokuzama ukuvimba ukukhula kwazo. Lokhu kwaholela ezimeni zokuphikisana, lapho abasebenzi babebhekene nezingozi zokulahlekelwa yimisebenzi, noma ngisho nokuhlukunyezwa. Nokho, lezi zinkinga zakhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqhubeke bephikisa, befundisa abanye ngamalungelo abo. Isigaba 5: Izinselelo Zamanje Nezikhathi Zokuphumelela Namuhla, izinyunyana zabasebenzi zibuye zibe nezinselelo ezintsha, ezifana nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, ukuhamba kwemisebenzi, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Nokho, zisagcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu emisebenzini. Izinhlangano eziningi zikhuthaza ukufundiswa nokukhuthazwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zokusebenza zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokuphikisa, ukuhlela imihlangano, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwazo nezinhlaka zomphakathi. Isigaba 6: Ukubaluleka Kwezinyunyana Zabasebenzi Izinyunyana zabasebenzi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banamalungelo afanele, zikhuthaza izimo zokusebenza ezinhle, futhi ziqinisa umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphandle kwezinyunyana, izinguquko eziningi ezitholakele emhlabeni wezokusebenza zingase zingabi khona. Abasebenzi bahlala bephikisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izimo zabo zihlala zinhle, futhi lokhu kuqhubeka kuholela emiphumeleni emihle yokusebenza. Isiphetho Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi ungumfanekiso obonisa indlela abantu abavumelana ngayo ukuze bathole izinguquko ezithinta impilo yabo. Ukubambisana, ukuzinikela, kanye nomoya wokuphikisa kube yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni izinyunyana ezinamandla. Njengoba siqhubeka nezinye izinkathi zomlando, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinyunyana zabasebenzi zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, futhi zidinga ukusekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okuletha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Isimemezelo Sokunemba Kwefomu LeLungu (GEMS Member Form Accuracy Declaration) Uhlanga lwezempilo luyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zempilo ezinhle kuncike kakhulu emnothweni wezemali okwenziwa izinhlelo eziphathelene nezempilo. Ngalesi sizathu, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu omphakathi aqonde kahle isu elibhekelele ukunemba kwefomu lelungu, ikakhulukazi kulabo ababhalisela uhlelo lweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nqubo ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe ngamalungu luyiqiniso, futhi iyahambisana nezidingo eziningi ezimqoka. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuveza ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi olunembile kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsizakalo zempilo ezifanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane efanele, efana negama, ikheli, usuku lokuzalwa, nezibalo zempilo ezisemqoka. Ukungahambisani kwalolu lwazi kungaholela ekubeni izinsizakalo zinganikezwa ngendlela efanele, okuyinto engathokozisi amalungu. Ngakho-ke, uma ubhalisela leli thuba, kufanele uqaphele ukuthi wonke amafomu abhalwe kahle, ngaphandle kwamaphutha. Ukudlula emkhakheni wokunemba kwezifundo, kuyadingeka ukuthi ukufunda kahle imiyalelo ethile yeGEMS ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izidingo ezidingekayo ukuze ufake isicelo sokuba yilungu. Lokhu kuhlonipha umthetho, futhi kukhulu kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphawulekayo. Ngokuhamba phambili, uma ufaka le fomu, kubalulekile ukuthi uthathe isikhathi esanele ukuze uhlele kahle yonke imininingwane. Ukuhlola kabusha imininingwane yakho ngaphambi kokuyithumela kungasiza ekuqedeni noma yiziphi izinkinga ezingase zivele ngaphambi kokuba uqedele inqubo. Lokhu kuphinde kuqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe luhambisana neziqondiso ezisemthethweni, okuzothuthukisa ithuba lokuthi uhlelo lweGEMS lwenze kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uthola izinguquko emindenini yakho, njengokushintsha kokuhlala, izinguquko ezithintekayo ezimweni zempilo, noma ushintsho kusemsebenzini, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nesineke futhi uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinguquko zikhonjiswa okufanele efomini lakho. Lokhu kuzovikela izinkinga ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi uhlangabezana nezidingo zempilo zansuku zonke. Ngokuphathelene nokuhlola, kufanele uqaphele ukuthi ithimba leGEMS linikeza ukuhola okudingekayo kubalungu ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokufaka izimemezelo zokunemba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane ethile yokuxhumana kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uqonde kahle izidingo ezifanele. Ukuxhumana nezisebenzi zeGEMS akugcini nje ngokukusiza, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi, okubalulekile ekwakheni isikhala sokuxhumana esivulekile phakathi kwebhodi yeGEMS namalungu. Ekugcineni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukunemba kwefomu lelungu akukhona nje ukugcina imithetho, kepha kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS nabantu abawasebenzisayo. Amathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphumelelayo zempilo azothuthukiswa uma sithobela imithetho, sikhumbule ukuhlonipha, futhi sibe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke amalungu ukuthi azithathele izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane efakwe efomini lelungu ilungile. Lokhu kuzobeka isisekelo esiqinile sokuthi konke okwenziwe ngaphakathi kweGEMS kube nempumelelo, futhi amalungu akwazi ukuthola izinsiza zempilo abazidingayo. Ngokuhlonipha lezi ziqondiso, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlonipha izidingo zempilo zomphakathi, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uhlonishwa, ubhaliswe, futhi uthola izinsiza ezihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, akungabazeki ukuthi sithatha le nqubo ngokungathi sína, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi sihamba phambili ngendlela efanele ukuze sithole ikitoko elihle lokuphila.
Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Indaba Yezempilo Kwakungokwesikhathi eside, emzaneni omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaziyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola izinsiza ezitholakala kulezi zibhedlela, njengoba zaziwa ngokunikeza usizo lwezempilo olufanele, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenamali yokuhamba ezibhedlela ezizimele. UMama Thandi, umama oneminyaka engama-45, wayengomunye wabantu abavakashela izibhedlela zikahulumeni. Uhlale ethanda ukusiza abanye, kodwa wayenokukhathazeka okukhulu ngempilo yakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi esebenza emakhaya, wathola ukuthi unokukhwehlela okungajwayelekile. Wazi ukuthi kufanele aye ezibhedlela, kodwa wayesaba, ngoba wayekwazi ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinezinkinga zazo. Noma kunjalo, uMama Thandi wathola isibindi. Wavakashela esibhedlela esiseduzane, esaziwa ngokuthi iZibhedlela Zikahulumeni eMkhumbane. Lapho efika, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhona ukuze zisebenze, futhi abantu abaningi babekhuluma ngempilo yabo. Kwakukhanya ubuso babantu, bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephila kahle. Lokhu kwenza uMama Thandi azizwe ethokozile. Ngemva kokubhaliswa, wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nodokotela. UDokotela Mthembu, odokotela abahloniphekile, wamamukela ngenhlonipho. Wamtshela ukuthi akukhathalekile ukuthi ubani, bonke abantu banelungelo lokuthola usizo. UMama Thandi wathola ukuthi udokotela wayenolwazi olunzulu, futhi wayezimisele ukusiza. Wamtshela ukuthi ukukhwehlela kwakhe kungenzeka kube ngenxa yokuphefumula umoya ongcolile, futhi wanikeza izeluleko ezinhle zokuphila kahle. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uMama Thandi wathola imishanguzo, futhi udokotela wamtshela ukuthi kufanele abuyele ukuze abone ukuthi imishanguzo iyasebenza. Lokhu kwenza uMama Thandi azizwe ethokozile, ngoba wayezwa ukuthi usizo lukhona. Wabuyela emakhaya, enethemba lokuthi impilo yakhe izophila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMama Thandi waqala ukuvakashela izibhedlela zikahulumeni njalo. Waqonda ukuthi lezi zibhedlela zazingezabo bonke abantu, futhi zazinikeza ithuba lokuthola usizo lwezempilo. Waqala nokukhuthaza abanye emzaneni wakhe ukuba bavakashele izibhedlela, ngoba wayefuna wonke umuntu abe nempilo engcono. Kodwa, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zazihlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Kwakukhona ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, abanye odokotela babenganele, futhi iziguli zazilindele isikhathi eside ukuze zithole usizo. Lokhu kwenza uMama Thandi acabange ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi abantu baphile kahle uma izibhedlela zingasebenzi kahle. Waqala ukucabanga ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu bangenza umehluko. UMama Thandi wanquma ukuhlela umcimbi emzaneni wakhe, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela. Waqasha abanye abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi bonke bavuma ukusiza. Umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, abantu bejabulile, bephakela izinsiza ezahlukene, futhi bexoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela. Ngemuva komcimbi, uMama Thandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zathola ukwesekwa okukhulu. Abantu baqala ukuvakashela izibhedlela, futhi izinsiza zathuthukiswa. UDokotela Mthembu wathola ukuthi abantu bayeza, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukusiza iziguli. UMama Thandi wathola ukuthi impilo yomphakathi iyashintsha, futhi abantu baphila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMama Thandi waba yisibonelo esihle emzaneni. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile kahle, futhi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zazingezabo bonke abantu. Waqonda ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi abantu kufanele babe nethuba lokuthola usizo lwezempilo. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaba yindawo yokuphila, futhi uMama Thandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu. Uthando, ukuzinikela, nokukhuthaza kwabantu kwashintsha impilo yomphakathi, futhi izibhedlela zaba yindawo yokwelapha, yokukhuthaza, nokubambisana. Ngalesi sikhathi, uMama Thandi waba yisithombe sokuphila, futhi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaba yindawo yokuphila, yokwelapha, nokukhuthaza abantu. Lokhu kwaba yindaba ethokozisayo, futhi uMama Thandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabanye. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaba yindawo yokuphila, futhi abantu baqala ukubona ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele bahloniphe izinsiza ezikhona. Ngakho-ke, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaba yindawo yokuphila, futhi uMama Thandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabanye. Lokhu kwaba yindaba ethokozisayo, futhi uMama Thandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabanye. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaba yindawo yokuphila, futhi abantu baqala ukubona ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele bahloniphe izinsiza ezikhona.
Yini ukuhweba komphakathi? Le yindlela elula, lapho indawo eqashisayo ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane ezilula ukuzilawula ezaziwa ngokuthi ukuhweba komphakathi. Umphakathi umphathi ubekwa ukuze abheke umphakathi othile futhi ungumuntu osebenzisana ngokubambisana nezakhamuzi kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ekuvimbeleni ubugebengu obujwayelekile kulowo mphakathi. Bonke ababambiqhaza bangenela ekutholeni izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha ezithile zomphakathi wabo futhi bazame ukuthola umthombo wobugebengu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle kulowo mphakathi othile. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle emphakathini wenu. Ukubamba kwenu kuzokhiqiza imiphumela, futhi ngeke nibe nesaba sobugebengu emphakathini wenu futhi nithole izixazululo kubugebengu obujikelezayo endaweni yenu uma ninenhlangano zomphakathi zokulwa nobugebengu, ninikeza amaphoyisa ulwazi ngemicimbi yobugovu eyenzeka emphakathini wenu ukuze basebenzise izindlela ezinhle nezisuselwa emphakathini ekutholeni izixazululo zobugebengu emphakathini wenu; futhi lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwenu nomphathi wenu wombuso wezepolitiki waseNingizimu Afrika. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle emphakathini wenu.
Masixoxe ngemva kokuvuna izitshalo zakho ze-maize zonyaka ka-2010, ukuhlela okunembile kwesizini yonyaka olandelayo kuqala. Lesi yisikhathi esihle sokuhlaziya okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule nokuhlola izinto ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphathwa nokukhiqizwa kwezitshalo ezathuthukisa isimo nokukhiqizwa okutholakele ekupheleni kulezi zitshalo. Uma imibiko yomlando ingagcinwanga kuyo yonke imifula, manje yisikhathi esihle sokusebenzisa idatha yonyaka odlule ukuqala uhlelo lokugcina imibiko yomlando. Uma uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwenziwe oluhlanganisa ukuhlela lokho kuzosebenza kuyo yonke isitshalo ngonyaka olandelayo, izinga lokufaka kanye nezindleko ezitholakele kufanele ziqhathaniswe ngokucophelela nebhajethi eyabekwa ekuqaleni. Izinto ezithinta lezi zinputh ezimo zezimali kanye nezimo zezulu ezadlala indima empumelelweni noma ekwehlulekeni kwezithombo ezithile kufanele zicatshangelwe futhi zihlolwe ukuthi zishintshile noma zathuthuka. Imibiko eyisisekelo mayelana nezimo zomhlabathi kufanele igcinwe futhi ivuselelwe minyaka yonke: igama lefama, isifunda sefama, indawo ephelele, izindawo ezivunyiwe, izindawo zokulawula, izindawo ezithuthukisiwe, ukuhlinzwa, umuzi, izinqaba zefama, nezakhiwo. Iphakheji ngalinye lendawo kuyo yonke ifama ingaqhathaniswa mayelana nezinputh ezisetshenziswe lapho: indawo yomhlaba, ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, izinguquko zezulu eminyakeni eminingi. (Uma kutholakala kumphumela wokuhlola umhlabathi), ukujikeleza kwezitshalo nokuhlela ukujikeleza kwezitshalo kufanele kucatshangelwe, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokutshala, izitshalo ezihlanganisiwe, izinga lokutshala imbewu, imvula ephakathi, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kokuba isitshalo sithunyelwe, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi sokukhula kwesitshalo, ukulawula izihlahla ezisetshenzisiwe (kuhlanganise namakhemikhali nezinga lawo lokufaka), ama-pesticides asetshenzisiwe nemiphumela yawo, ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo okutholakele nesimo sawo. Izindleko ze-fertilizer zikhona phakathi kwezindleko ezinkulu ze-inputs ezisetshenziswa ngqo ohlelweni lokulima izitshalo. Ukusebenzisa kahle uhlelo lokufaka i-fertilizer njalo ngesizini kanye nesizini yokutshala ezayo kuzokhiqiza ukukhiqizwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi isimo somhlabathi wakho ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokukhiqizwa okuphezulu kwezitshalo nangemva kwemvula eningi etholelwe ezindaweni ezithile, okungase kube sekwathulile izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile ezitshalo. Ukuvela kokuphuma okuphuma ngenxa yokushoda kwe-nitrogen ne-sulfur kubonwe ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekile kule nkathi yakamuva. Uma kukhona izitshalo eziphakeme kunokujwayelekile, izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ezikhiphwe kufanele zibuye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitshalo ezilandelayo zingathola ukukhiqizwa okulindelekile. Ngokukhumbula lokhu, amasampula omhlabathi kufanele athathwe kuyo yonke imifula ye-maize ezokwenziwa futhi athunyelwe endaweni ezotholwa khona. Izinyathelo eziningana kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo yokufaka i-fertilizer nokuhlola izokwenza umsebenzi wefama yakho. Lezi zinyathelo zihlanganisa ukuqoqa nokuphatha kahle amasampula omhlabathi, izinqubo ezifanele zokulandela, imihlahlandlela efundwe kahle yokuhumusha imiphumela, ukulandela iziphakamiso ezifanele zezingqimba zezithombo, nokuhlanganisa izidingo eziphakanyisiwe zezithombo ohlelweni oluhlanganisiwe lokuphatha izakhamzimba zezithombo. Inhloso yokuhlola umhlabathi ukuhlole ikhono lomhlabathi lokuhlinzeka ngezithako ezidingekayo ezitshalo ezikhulayo nokuhlaziya noma yiziphi izinkinga zomhlabathi ezingavimbela ukukhula nokuthuthuka kwezitshalo ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo zalezi zidinga kakhulu izithako ezihlinzekwa njenge-fertilizers zomhlabathi uma amazinga wokuhlola umhlabathi enyuka. Ukuhlolwa komhlabathi okuhlola ukujula kuvumela izinga elifanele le-herbicide ukuba lifakwe ohlelweni lokulawula izihlahla. Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula kuyo yonke imifula. Isampula yomhlabathi ejulile engu-15 cm isisindo sithola cishe amakhilogremu angama-2,400 kuye ngokuthi umhlabathi uthambekela kangakanani, ukuhlanganiswa kwawo, nokujula. Isampula yokugcina ethunyelwe lab ingase isisindo sibe amakhilogremu angu-0.5, ezokwenziwa zibe ngamagramu amancane. Ngenxa yalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwemithombo enejula nezinhlobo zomhlabathi ezahlukene nezindawo ngaphakathi kwemifula, ezingeyona ingxenye yendawo yonke evunyiwe. Kusengumkhuba kubalimi ukufaka ama-fertilizers ngokuya ngezinga elabelwe ku-block yonke yomhlaba, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezindawo ezitholakala nge-satellite (GPS) nezindlela ezingaguqulwa zokufaka i-fertilizer, ezingaphrintiwe endaweni esetshenziselwa ukutshala. Akukhulunywa ukuthi lokhu kuhlola kungcono kunesampula eqoqwe kulolo mhlaba. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona umehluko omkhulu emhlabathini ezindaweni. Esikhathini esedlule, isampula eqoqwe kumahhactha ayishumi kuyo yonke i-block yomhlaba yayibhekwa njenganele. Nokho, kuyas recommended ukuthi uthenge noma uboleke ithuluzi lokumba (auger) ukuze wenze imihla ukusuka phezulu phansi kulolo mhlaba nabantu ababili, omunye ethwele ibhagi yesampula ngayinye futhi ethatha i-core yomhlabathi efika ejulile phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm kodwa ingadluli ku-20 cm. Ibhokisi lesampula kufanele libe nelayisense ecacile enombolo yefield, igama, ikheli lefama, izinombolo zokuxhumana, nosuku lokuqoqwa kwesampula, ukuze kugwenywe noma yikuphi ukudideka e-lab. Kungcono ukwenza yonke le misebenzi kahle emhlabeni ukuze kugwenywe ukungqubuzana ezisampuleni eziqoqwe. Amasampula omhlabathi akufanele aqoqwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezifana nomhlaba ophuma olwandle, imifula eyomile, izindawo ezigcina izihlahla ezindala ezindaweni, izintaba eziphansi, noma izindawo eziphukile. Manje sekukhona ithuba lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokubeka (Global Positioning System) ohlelweni lwe-grid ezindaweni ezikhethiwe eziphakathi kuka-0.5 no-4 meters, noma ukuhlela ukuqoqa amasampula ohlelweni lwe-grid. Amasampula azobe eqhathaniswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nezinguquko ezenzakalayo ezingeni lokuvuthwa komhlabathi zingatholakala kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Imiphumela yokuhlaziywa ingatholwa ngokusebenzisa i-Geographic Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholakale imephu enombala yefield ekhombisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphate, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, ama-micronutrients, nezinye izinguquko zokuhlola umhlabathi zingaboniswa ukuze zikhombise umfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuhlukahluka noma ubukhulu benkinga ethile emhlabeni. Ezindaweni eziningi, izindawo eziphakathi zikhonjwa zisebenzisa indlela ye-grid ngokusekelwe kumahhactha e-block. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha amasampula yileso lapho uzoba nethuba lokwenza umsebenzi kahle, lapho ungakwenza izinqumo ngokuhl
Izinsiza Zesayensi: Uhlolojikelele Ngezinto Ezihamba Phambili Emkhakheni Wezesayensi Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nezesayensi kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Lezi zinsiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi sithola ulwazi ngezinto ezintsha, okwenza umhlaba uqhubeke, uthuthuke, futhi uthole amandla okuphendula izinselele ezinkulu ezifana nokufuya, ezempilo, nezemvelo. Ngalesi simo, kubalulekile ukwaziwa kwezinsiza nemithelela yazo ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile. Ukwakhiwa Kwezazi: Ucwaningo Olubalulekile Njengoba sikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde izindlela ezahlukene ezitholakala kubantu abaphakanyisiwe ezemfundo. Izazi zesayensi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi olusha, oluphenywa ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kudingeka ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo emikhakheni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo eziphakeme, ikakhulukazi, ziba izikhungo zokucwaninga, lapho abathweswe iziqu benza khona izifundo ezijulile, beqala kumaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuholela emiphumeleni engcono ekwelapheni izifo, ekuthuthukiseni izinto zokusebenza, nasemikhakheni yokugcina imvelo. Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Abalingisi Abajabulisayo Ngasikhathi sinye, ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile yeziqu zezesayensi. I-automation, i-AI (Artificial Intelligence), nezinye izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe bokuqonda zishintsha indlela esisebenza ngayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha emhlabeni wethu, kusiza ukuthuthukisa imiphumela emisha emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ezinhlelweni zokulima, nezokuthutha. Ngokuthuthukiswa kwemishini, izazi zivula amathuba amasha, ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ehambisana nezicwangciso zayo ibangelwa ukucwaninga okujulile nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Izinkinga Zezemvelo: Ukubhekelela Isikhathi Esizayo Nokho, izinsiza zesayensi azigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, kodwa zibuye zihlola nezinkinga ezibhekene nomhlaba. Ukushintsha kwesimo seplanethi, imuvuzo yokungcoliswa komoya, nokwehla kwemithombo yemvelo kuzoba nemiphumela emikhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Izazi zesayensi zihlola ngendlela eqondile indlela lezi zinkinga ezingaxazululwa ngayo, zihlinzeka ngamasu nezixazululo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokuvikela imvelo, ukuphucula izinqubo zokwenza izinto, kanye nokwenziwa kwezinto zokuqwashisa umphakathi mayelana nezimo zemvelo. Ubuchwepheshe Belwazi: Ukuxhumana Komphakathi Ukuze umphakathi uthole indlela efanele yokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Ubuchwepheshe belwazi, obuhlanganisa i-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemithombo yabezindaba, bunika umphakathi ithuba lokuhlaziya, ukufunda, nokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuqonda kwezesayensi, kuvula amathuba amasha okuxoxa ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ezinye izinkampani sezisebenzise lezi zinsiza ukuze ziqhube izinkampani zazo, zikhuthaze ukuhweba, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Izeluleko Eziyinhloko: Qhubekani Nokuqonda Kubalulekile ukuthi siyazi ukuthi yonke lezi zinsizakusebenza, ezithandwa kakhulu, zidinga ukusizwa ngabantu. Ukugqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemicabango, kunceda ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Okwamanje, izazi zesayensi zikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuthi abambe iqhaza, athuthukise ulwazi lwakhe, futhi azibandakanye ezenzakalweni ezibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela kule migudu, asize ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho: Ukukhanya Kwezenzakalo Zesayensi Ngaphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinsiza, kucacile ukuthi izesayensi zinemiphumela emikhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukuze umphakathi ube nekhono lokuphendula izinselele ezenzakalweni ezinzima, kudingeka ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ngokugcwele ukufunda, ukwenza, futhi azizise izinsiza zesayensi ezintsha. Lokhu kudinga isimo sokubambisana, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene, nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuba ziqhubeke nokufunda. Izesezizukulwane ezithuthukayo zidinga ukucabangela izimo ezinzima zomhlaba, ukuze zifake emathubeni amasha okwenyusa umphakathi. Empeleni, ukuqonda ubuqotho bemikhakha ehlukene yezenzakalo zesayensi kuyafaneleka, futhi kuyasiza ukuze siqonde ukuthi sizokwazi ukuhamba nezinselele ezizayo ezihambisana nezinsiza zokugcina izwe lethu liphila ngempumelelo.
