Okhethwe yiBhodi 55 Isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwezindaba nguNgqongqoshe... x "Umkhakha" ubhekisela kunoma yimuphi umkhakha weMnyango Wezokuvikela noma iMpi eyasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezikhungo Zomphakathi 103 ka-1994, Isikhumbuzo No. a Ukusungulwa nokusetshenziswa kwemigomo yokuvikela kuncike emthethweni weHulumeni kanye neBhodi Yezwe ephethe. b Inhloso eyinhloko yeMpi ukuvikela iRiphabhulikhi, ukuhlonipha umhlaba wayo kanye nabantu bayo. c IMpi kufanele iqhube imisebenzi yayo ngokuhambisana noMthethosivivinywa kanye nemithetho yamazwe esiwamukelayo. d IMpi kufanele ikwazi ukuvikela yona uqobo futhi ibe sesimweni esifanele. e Akekho ilungu leMpi okufanele enze noma yini engalungile. f IMpi kanye nelungu layo akuvunyelwe, ngesikhathi sokwenza imisebenzi yabo, ukuphula amalungelo eqembu lezombusazwe elamukelwa nguMthethosivivinywa, noma nganoma iyiphi indlela ukukhuthaza izinhloso zepolitiki. g IMpi kufanele ihloniphe amalungelo ayisisekelo nobuntu bezilungu zayo kanye nabantu bonke. a Bonke abalingani beMpi kanye nemisebenzi yabo ehambisanayo, kanye nazo zonke izisebenzi noma ngabe zisebenza ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi; b Noma ubani, ongena ngemvume kwemvume yeziphathimandla ezithintekayo, oyingxenye yeMpi ngenkathi ephuma emaphethelweni eRiphabhulikhi. Uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalolu mthetho neminye imithetho ngaphandle koMthethosivivinywa eyayisebenza ngesikhathi lo mthetho uqala, lo mthetho uzophumelela. Ngokwezinsika 202 no-204 zoMthethosivivinywa, amandla anikezwa kuMsecretary Wezokuvikela kanye noMholi weMpi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho kufanele asebenze ngokuhambisana nezinqumo zikaNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokwemithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, aqoke abantu abaningana abadingekayo ukuze bagcwalise izikhala ezikhona kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela njengoba kudingeka. Nakuba kukhona isahluko 2, uma amalungu eMpi efisa, angabekwa ezandleni zikaMsecretary Wezokuvikela ukuze angene ezikhundleni kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Amalungu eMpi ezikhundleni kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela kufanele ahambisane nemithetho yonke efanele kubo kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye neziphathimandla eziphezulu. UPresident kufanele, ngokulandela imithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, aqoke umuntu ukuze athathe isikhundla sikaMsecretary. UMsecretary Wezokuvikela uhlala kulolo sikhundla isikhathi esifanayo nesesikhundla sabaphathi bazo zonke izigaba kanye nemithetho abaphila ngaphansi kwayo, imiholo yabo namalungelo afana nalabo babaphathi. UMsecretary Wezokuvikela kufanele abe ngum citizen futhi akuvunyelwe ukuba abe ilungu leMpi. a Kumele abhekwane njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwesahluko 1; b Qhubeka nokusebenza kulolo sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho efanele, kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulolo sikhundla siphela. Ikomidi lePhalamende libheka ukuthi izigaba zilandela lokho okukhulunywe. e Kumele anikeze uMholi weMpi imiyalelo eningiliziwe edingekayo ukuze akwazi ukuhlela amalungu emisebenzi efanele kanye namandla okwenza imisebenzi ethile eyabelwe yena nguMsecretary Wezokuvikela njengomholi kanye nomphathi wezezimali kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. f Kumele aqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho ethunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe edluliselwa kuMholi weMpi ophinde athumele umbiko ngalesi kuNgqongqoshe; g Uthwala umthwalo wokuhola izinqubo zokuziphatha nokuphathwa kwezisebenzi, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa kwazo kahle nokuqeqeshwa. Leli thuba lokudlulisa noma ukudlulisa amandla njengoba kuchazwe esahlukweni 1 alivimbele uMsecretary Wezokuvikela ekuphatheni izindaba zakhe. Noma ukuphatha noma ukwenza kube ukuphathwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho; noma d Ukwenza uphenyo olwamukelekayo futhi ngemithetho engalandelwa. ekupheleni kwezivumelwano zokuqashwa; noma iii khululwa kwezinye izindlela kwiMpi ngokuhambisana noMthetho; b Akukho siqinisekiso seMpi esingaba namalungu akhona asebenza okwesikhashana ngaphansi kwezivumelwano ngaphandle kokuthi umsebenzi wabo uphumelele emthethweni. i kunoma yisiphi umsebenzi; ii neMpi Esebenzayo noma iMpi Yesikhumbuzo noma kokubili; b UMholi weMpi angasungula umkhakha wesikhashana, iqembu, isigaba noma iyunithi njengoba kudingeka yiMpi, futhi izisekelo zesikhashana zingasungulwa njengoba kudingeka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezikhona. UMholi weMpi kufanele abe ngum citizen futhi abe ilungu leMpi Esebenzayo. a kumele abhekwane njengomsebenzi wesikhashana ngaphansi kwesahluko 1; b qhubeka nokusebenza kulolo sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho yokusebenza ayivelelayo kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulolo sikhundla siphela. Noma ubani oqashwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezikhungo Zomphakathi ka-1994, Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994, osebenza ngaphansi kweMpi; c Noma yisiphi umsebenzi uma imvume kaMsecretary Wezokuvikela itholakala. Ukudluliswa kwamandla okukhuluma esahlukweni 1 akuvimbele uMholi Wezokuvikela ekuphatheni izindaba zakhe. UNgqongqoshe angasungula umsebenzi ohlobene nokusebenza ukuze asekele iMpi uma kudingeka. Amalungu ale misebenzi asekelayo asiza kuphela ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe nguNgqongqoshe. c Ukuze kusekele noma iyiphi iMnyango kaHulumeni ngisho nokusekela okuhloswe ngokuqinisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho; d Ukuvikela wonke amaphetho akhona kuleli. Uma iPhalamende lingahlangani ezinsukwini zokuqala eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokukhethwa kweMpi njengoba kuchazwe esahlukweni 2, uMongameli noma uNgqongqoshe uzohlinzeka ngazo zonke izimfuno ezidingekayo kulesi sahluko kumkhandlu ophathelene nezokuvikela ePhalamende. Uma iMpi ikhethwa nguMongameli nganoma yisiphi isizathu esishiwo esahlukweni 2012 soMthethosivivinywa, uNgqongqoshe kufanele ahlangabezane nezidingo zesahluko 2e. c Kumele kuvele futhi kube okusha esikhundleni salokho okukhululiwe; noma d Kumele ifune ukuphelisa ukukhethwa kweMpi;. b iqiniso lokuthi noma yini eyenziwa ngenxa yokukhululwa kuze kube isikhathi sokuthi ushintsho lwenziwe, ukuvela kokusha esikhundleni sokwakhiwa noma ukusula kwemvume; noma c noma yiluphi ilungelo, ithuba, umsebenzi noma umthwalo okumele wenziwe otholakalayo, okukhulile noma kube yindleko ngenxa yokukhululwa noma ukuk
Ukuphepha Kwamalungu Emiphakathini Ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaphila, uyasebenza, futhi uyazizwa ephephile. Lokhu kuphakamisa izinga lempilo, kuthuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuqinise umphakathi. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngalesi sihloko, sizobheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphepha, izingozi ezikhona, nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuphepha emiphakathini. Izici Ezinomthelela Ekuphepheni Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta ukuphepha kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimo zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezepolitiki. Uma umphakathi unokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma umphakathi uhlangabezana nezinkinga ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezingozi, njengokweba noma udlame. Izingcuphe Nezingozi Izingozi ezithinta ukuphepha kwabantu zingahlukaniswa zibe izigameko eziphuthumayo nezimo ezijwayelekile. Izigameko eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezinhlekelele zemvelo (njengezikhukhula noma imililo), zidinga izinhlelo eziphuthumayo zokuphendula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo ezijwayelekile, ezifana nokweba, udlame, noma ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, zidinga izixazululo ezinzima ezibandakanya ubuholi bomphakathi, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuphepha Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu mayelana nezokuphepha kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izifundo zokuvikela, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Uma abantu benolwazi olufanele, bangakwazi ukuzivikela futhi baphendule kahle ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile kubalulekile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphephile, ukwandisa izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya umphakathi. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi banendawo ephephile yokuhlala, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu emiphakathini yabo. Ubudlelwano Bomphakathi Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu emiphakathini busemqoka ekwakheni ukuphepha. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye, kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imihlangano yomphakathi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bejabulela ubudlelwano obuhle, bazoba nesifiso sokuvikela umphakathi wabo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zomthetho Ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi nezikhungo zomthetho kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuphepha. Izikhungo zomthetho, ezifana namaphoyisa, zidinga ukuxhumana nabantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izikhungo zomthetho zisebenza nabo, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela umphakathi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle, ubudlelwano obuhle, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudala imiphakathi ephephile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ephephile futhi enelungelo lokuphila impilo egculisayo. Ukuphepha akuyona nje indaba yomuntu ngamunye, kodwa kuyindaba yomphakathi wonke.
Thina, njengabasebenzi boMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, sithole izinsiza ezahlukene zik government ezibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwethu ukuze sizibhekele. Ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, izinsiza zik government kumele zihlale zibhalwe; ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenzise imithetho yokuphatha futhi siqambe izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze sigweme ukulahleka okuhambisanayo. Enye yale mithetho yokuphatha wukusebenzisa imithetho yokuphepha efana nokuhlola zonke izinto zomuntu ezithwalwa ngesandla, izimoto, noma izinto ezithwalwayo. UMthetho Wokufinyelela Ezindaweni Zomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wezimoto, Inombolo 53 ka-1985, unika abasebenzi bezokuphepha amandla okwenza izenzo ezithile ngokuhambisana neSigaba 2 soMthetho Wezimoto ka-1985 (njengokwenza ukuhlola, ukuvimbela ukufika noma ukuhamba, njll.). [Ucelwa ukuthi uhlole izaziso ezikhangisiwe ezindaweni zethu]. Kuyiqiniso futhi ukuthi le ndlela yokuphepha ingaba nzima kubasebenzisi ukuba babe nesipiliyoni esihle. Ukufika kuleli phuzu kudinga ukubambisana nokuqonda kubasebenzi. Uyal encouraged ukuba uzizwe ukhululekile ukuxhumana noMnu. Van Rooyen uma kukhona okungacacile mayelana nemithetho yethu yokuphepha nezindlela.
Sebenzisa imephu yaseNingizimu Afrika ukukhombisa ukuthi kuphi iNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Isithombe 1: Iqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo emhlanganweni walo. Isithombe 2: Umongameli weqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo, uMnu. Magidela, phambi kwemifino yakhe. Le nqembu yokufunda itholakala kuphi? Le nqembu yokufunda itholakala endaweni yasemaphandleni lapho kungelamigwaqo emihle nezitolo. Itholakala cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-60 ukusuka eBizana eNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Kukhona amalungu angama-100 kule nqembu. Kukhona amahektare angama-100 angakhuliswa ukuze akhiqizwe. Yini eyenza kungakhuliswa yonke imhlaba engavunwa? Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokutshala. Ukuntuleka kwezinto zokwakha izithiyo. Izimo zezulu - ekuqaleni kwesizini yokutshala ngo-2010, imvula yayinzima kakhulu, yenza kube nzima ukutshala. Ubudlelwano obude bokuxhumana nalabo abanikeza izinsiza zokutshala, njengezithako, imbewu, nezinto zokwakha. Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kangakanani? Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kanye ngenyanga neGrain SA, futhi lihlangana njalo ngesonto ukuze lixoxe ngezindaba zokulima. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda? Ikakhulu, izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda zifaka ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukuxoxa namanye amalungu eqembu, nokuhlonza izindlela ezifanele zokusebenza ezifana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukutshala, ukufaka izithako, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Iqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo linethuba lokuh attend the First Training Session on Maize Planting. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweqembu lokufunda nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Okwamanje, akukho abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo! Iqembu lokufunda liphumelele kanjani ezinsizeni ezinikezwa yiGrain SA? Phakathi nemihlangano yabo, amalungu athola ulwazi nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela ezifanele zokutshala. Ukuhlola nokuhlola kuveze izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izinto zokwakha nezithako. Lapho amalungu ehlangana ukuze akhe iqembu lokufunda, iqembu lonke lingathenga izinto zokwakha nezithako, hhayi njengabantu ngabanye.
Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole Isingeniso Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokufundisa, zikhuthaza ukufunda, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabafundi. Le ndatshana ibheka izinqubo, izinqubomgomo, nezindlela zokuhlola ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, izidingo zemfundo, kanye nezindinganiso zokuphepha. Inhloso Inhloso yokuhlola ingqalasizinda yezikole iwukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwezikole, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zinezindawo zokufunda eziphephile, ezivikelekile, futhi ezihlangabezana nezindinganiso zokwakha. 2. Ukufinyelela: Ukuhlola ukuthi izikole zifinyeleleka kalula kubafundi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. 3. Izinsiza: Ukuhlola ukuthi izikole zinazo izinsiza ezifanele zokufundisa, ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi, nezobuchwepheshe. 4. Ukwaneliseka kwabafundi: Ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabafundi nezisebenzi ezikhona ezikoleni. Izindlela Zokuhlola Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwengqalasizinda kuyaphumelela, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zizothathwa: 1. Uphenyo Lwabafundi: Ukuqoqa imibono yabafundi mayelana nezindawo zokufunda, izinsiza, nezimo zokuphepha. 2. Uphenyo Lwezisebenzi: Ukuhlola imibono nezinkinga ezibhekene nezisebenzi ezikoleni, okuhlanganisa othisha, abaphathi, nabanye abasebenzi. 3. Ukuhlola Izakhiwo: Ukuhlola izakhiwo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zifanele izidingo zemfundo. 4. Ukuhlola Izinsiza: Ukuhlola ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona zisebenza kahle, zifanele, futhi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu. Izindinganiso Zokwakha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu, kufanele kube nezindinganiso ezithile zokwakha. Lezi zindinganiso kufanele zifake: 1. Izinga Lokuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa. 2. Izinsiza Zokufunda: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zinezinsiza ezifanele zokufundisa, ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi, nezobuchwepheshe. 3. Ukufinyelela: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zifinyeleleka kubafundi bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyathuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Imali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele yokwakha, ukugcinwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokufunda. 2. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimali zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisetshenziswa kahle. 3. Ukwabelana Ngemithombo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zabelana ngemithombo nezinsiza ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyathuthuka, kubalulekile ukubambisana nomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zisebenzisana nemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsiza. 2. Ukwamukela Imibono: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyathola ithuba lokwabelana ngemibono nezidingo zayo ezikoleni. 3. Ukwenza Imisebenzi: Ukuhlela imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda, efana nezinsuku zokusebenza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokufundisa, zikhuthaza ukufunda, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabafundi. Ngale ndlela, izikole zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, zikhuthaze abafundi, futhi zibe yizikhungo eziphumelelayo zokufunda. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, umphakathi, nezisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda iyathuthuka futhi ihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi.
Izifundo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini Kusukela kumakhono okuphila kwabantu, emalokishini aphesheya kwenyakatho ye-Afrika, ubuhle bokubambisana nomqondo wokwakha amabhizinisi siqu kude kwazise, kungaziwa. Izifundo ezenzakalayo ezitholakala phakathi kwalezi zindawo, zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abahlala emalokishini bavele banamandla, baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo, nakuba beziphila ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kuhamba phambili kube nemiphumela eminingi, higlazisa ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavela emalokishini, abafundisile uxolo, ubuhlakani, nokuqamba. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abagibeli be-Taxi nezokuthutha ezintsha babebambe izintambo zezezimali emalokishini. Phakathi neminyaka yokokubusa kwe-apartheid, abantu abaningi babezithola bedinga izinsizakusebenza eziyisisekelo, izimpahla, nezinye izidingo. Ukuze bazigcine, kwabakhona abavula amabhizinisi amancane, ngaphandle kokuxhaswa nguhulumeni, ukuze baphathe amakhasimende futhi baziqhenye ngalokho abakwenza. Izifundo zabo zakhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bangempela buvela ngaphakathi kwezimo ezinzima. UMichael “Sizwe” Ndlovu, ungomunye wabantu abavela emalokishini abezenza isibonelo sokuphumelela. U-Ndlovu waqala umsebenzi wakhe emhlabeni wezimoto, ewina ikhefi ngokuqoqa imali kancane emalini. Waqala ngokuhamba ngezinyawo nokubamba izimota ezindala, ezemoto eziyinqaba zashintsha pungwe imibono emisha yokuthi abantu bangaba nosizo lwezithuthi emalokishini. Ubuqotho nokuqamba kwakhe kuye kwaholela ekukhuleni kwenani labantu abaqala ukwenza izinkampani zabo zokuthutha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sashintsha izinkanyezi zempumelelo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavamile ukuba nemibono eqondile. Njengoba abantu baphila bejolise ezingeni lokuphila elijwayelekile, izinto baziheha ngezinhloso ezicacile. UPhindile Mthembu, kwazise uyinxusa lendawo, waba ngonoya eqhelisile obaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umnotho oyindlunkulu emalokishini. Wavula ibhizinisi elincane lokudayisa ukudla ukuze ahlinzeke abantu abahamba-mgodi. Imiqondo yezezimali nemigomo ayekungeniswe emalokishini nayo yahola ekuphuhliseni izitolo ezincane ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo yendawo. Abantu banikela isikhathi, basebenzisa amakhono amaningi anothi, ukwenza imikhiqizo efana nezithako zezindawo zomdabu. Lokhu kwaba ukuhlaziywa okukhangayo nolimi lokukhuthaza olunempumelelo. Njengoba amabhizinisi emalokishini eqhubeka nokukhula, abanikazi bangabantu abaphuma ezinkampanini ezinkulu zaphesheya. Izifundo zabo zifundisa ukuthi abantu bangakhulisa izinkampani zabo uma behlakanipha ekuxhumaneni, befunda ezicini ezihlukahlukene. umkhiqizo, ukuphatha impahla, nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu amancane. Izifundo zabasunguli bamabhizinisi babukeka zingaphezulu kwezifundo – bezibophezela emiphakathini yabo, behlinzeka ngemisebenzi, futhi begcizelela umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphezu kokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, kunemihlangano eyenzeka phakathi kwabantu abathile, eyakhayo izinkampani zamabhizinisi amaningi. Uma uDudu Khoza ethola indlela yokwenza imali, uqala ukuba nemali ngokubambisana nabanye abantu emkhakheni wezokwakha. Ubuqotho bakhe bugqugquzela abanye ukuba baphinde badlale ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokubambisana. Lokhu kudalula amandla uzinzo lwemfundo kanye nemfundo yokuphila kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwesimo sezezimali esinzima sokubhekana nakho, abanikazi bamabhizinisi emalokishini basebenzisa amandla abawathola emiphakathini yabo, baphinde bezama ukufundisa abazukulwana ngezindlela zokusebenza ezihlakaniphe. Ngezinye izikhathi, nakuba behlupheka, banemibono emisha engamaqhugwana ezinhle neziqu zokuqonda. Umanyano lwabantu oluhle luholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, owaziyo ukuthi ukwakha akusilo ukungena kuphela emabhizinisini, kodwa nokuqhubeka nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Umlando wabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini ubonisa indlela imiqondo kaNkulunkulu nayo nebhadi elingakaze lishiye izikhumbuzo zempumelelo. Umsebenzi wabo ugcina uhlanga lwezimo, umoya wempumelelo, nomcabango omuhle wokuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi banelungelo lokwakha izimfanelo zabo. Eminyakeni ezayo, izifundo zabo zizoqhubeka nokukhanya, zikhombisa amandla emphakathini, okuholela kumphakathi okhula kahle, omunyu anempela emisha yezezimali emalokishini. Okwamanje, sikhumbula ukuthi abavulandi bemabhizinisi emalokishini ababevelanga kuphela embhalweni, kodwa baphinde babhala izinkanyezi zempumelelo emlandweni wethu. Izifundo zabo zikhuthaza ukukhula kwezimali nemiphakathi emihle. Bayazama, bawina futhi basaphila ngamabomu - baziqhenya nge-legacy yabo, behlola izinjongo eziphakeme ngenxa yomlingo wekuqhubeka. Lokhu kudala umnyango futhi kubaluleke emlandweni wabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini.
Izinkinga Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Umqondo Wami Isikhathi sokubeletha sanyanga ezintathu sikhangisa umhlaba wonke. Lokhu kuyisikhathi esijabulisayo, kodwa futhi nizimo eziningi ezinzima kanye nezinkinga ezilindelekile. Ukubeletha ezibhedlela kube yinsakavukela kakhulu, kepha kumele sihlole indlela ezinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ezifana nobuhlakani benhlalakahle. Ngiyafisa ukwabelana ngombono wami, okhombisa izinselelo nezixazululo ezenzeka ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha zidinga ukuhlela kahle. Ngokusho kwezifundo eziningi, ukubeletha kahle kuthinta impilo yomama nabantwana. Abesifazane abaphethwe yizimo zokulwa kanzima, njengokukhulelwa okuphuthumayo noma ukungaphezi kahle, akufanele babhekane nezinkinga ezenzakalayo ezibhedlela. Umfazi ofuna ukuzalwa kufanele enze izinqumo ezibucayi, futhi kumele aphatheke kahle kulolu suku olukhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukunakwa kwezokwelapha okwengeziwe, lokho okufanele kuphikise izinqubomgomo ezithile ezibhedlela. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimo zempilo ezibhekene nezinqubomgomo zokubeletha ezibhedlela. Ezinye izibhedlela zinezinkqubo ezibucayi zokwelapha, kepha kuthiwe uhla lwabakhiqizi bempilo lunalungelo lokugcina izinqubo ezilula nezenzakalayo. Ukusiza abesifazane nabantwana, izibhedlela kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazi kahle izinqubo zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthuthukiswa kwezithuthukisi ezithinta izinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nezibhedlela. Okwesithathu, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukungena kwabantu abasha abahamba phambili kule mikhakha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabagibeli bezokwelapha, abezindaba, nabanye abahlala kulesi sikhala kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni okukhawulezayo. Kubalulekile ukudala isimo sokukhuluma ngokukhululekile nokuqonda izinjongo zokubeletha nganhlonhlo. Ngendlela yokuthula, umama angaba nezinketho eziningi ezifanele, okwenza kube lula ukukhuluma nalokhu. Lokhu kumele kudlule kulokhu kwezokwelapha ngendlela efanele. Okwesine, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukwamukelwa komphakathi. Ukuze kube nesishiyagalombili sokuhlakanipha esinqumo sokubeletha, umphakathi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi unakekela izidingo ezahlukene zalesi sikhathi. Ngabanye abesifazane, ukubeletha akusikho nje kuphela ukuncediswa, kepha futhi kuyifaka izenzo zokukhuthaza umndeni. Abesifazane kumele bahlonishwe futhi baphathwe kahle, beziswa ngamamethrikhi ahlukahlukene okugcina impilo yabo kanye neyomntwana. Okwesihlanu, izibhedlela zidinga ukwandisa ukuphuculwa kwezinsizakalo zabo zokubeletha. Ukubhekelela izidingo zempilo nezempilo kusemqoka, ukufaka phakathi ukugxila kumqondo ophumela endaweni yokuhlala. Ukukhethwa kokubeletha ekuhlobiseni okwenziwe amakhasi kumele kube okuphathekayo ukuze kwandiswe ubuchwepheshe bokubambisana, futhi sizame ukugcina ubungcweti kulokhu. Lokhu kufanele kumantshintshise izinqubo engagehluke ngobukhulu, okuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokubambisana. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuhlonishwa nokubhekelelwa. Umama nomntwana kumele baphathwe njengabahlonishwa, futhi ubuningi bezinsizakalo zidinga ukuthuthukiswa nsuku zonke. Sizingelwa ngokuphuculwa kwezinsizakalo, okukhulumayo kumele kuhlanganywa nokuqondiswa kwemihlangano okukhombisa ukukhuluma nokuqonda okukhulu ngalokhu. Uma sithathela phezulu izidingo zempilo, kuzokwandza kuhle ukukhulisa umphakathi nohlelo lokuhlalisana. Ngakho, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuba indawo yokuguqula – indawo yokukhazimula, hhayi ithuba lokuphoxeka. Ngaphandle kokubhalela obala izinkinga, sikhumbula ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zingaphezu kwezincwadi. Kufanele kube isikhumbuzo sokuthi indawo yokubeletha iyindawo yokukhula, nothugela umntwana ophila kahle. Siyanakiqabula! Izinqubo zokubeletha azibhalwa ngezinkanyezi, kepha zihlala zifuna inkanyezi ezimbalwa, izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili ezimpilweni zethu. Ngokwenzenjalo, ngiyakhuthaza abezempilo nababambiqhaza ukuba benze konke okusemandleni ukwenza izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlale ziphila, zikwazi ukwelapha, futhi zigqugquzele ukwelashwa komama nabantwana. Lokhu kuyokwenza kube nezinyathelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu zokwelapha, hlangana nezinhlaka ezithandekayo zokuphila okuhle.
Isithombe 1: I-header ejikayo emaphakathi ibonisa ukuthi kukhona ukujikeleza okuningi okwenzeka ekugcineni lapho amanzi ehla khona. Khumbula ukuthi ingaphandle kwe-header ihamba ibanga elide ngaphambi kokufika lapho iqala khona, ngakho amanzi amaningi aphonswa ekugcineni kwezinsika. I-sprinkler yokuqala eyayikwazi ukuhamba yona ngokwayo yatholakala ngo-1948 futhi yapatentwa ngo-1952 nguFrank Zybach e-Eastern Colorado e-United States of America. Lokhu kwaba isisekelo semishini yamanje enama-header ajikayo nalawo ahamba ngokuqonda. Zingakwazi ukujikeleza amanzi ngendlela elawulwayo. Zisebenza ngamandla azo ngaphandle kokudinga abantu abaningi ukuba zisebenze. Zijikeleza izindawo ezinkulu kahle. Zingajikeleza ngendlela eshibhile futhi zingafaka umanyolo ohlangene namanzi ukuze izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi zikhululwe. I-header ejikayo inama-framing nezinsimbi ezisekelwa njalo emametheni angu-50 ngama-framing ahamba ezinsikeni ezimbili. Lokhu kuqinisa i-header endaweni ethile ngoba zonke ezinye izingxenye ezihambayo zixhunywe kule header. I-header ikakhulukazi yakhiwe ngensimbi enkulu ethumela amanzi, i-framing esekela insimbi, kanye nemishini ehambisa konke. Ubude be-span abudingi ukuba bube yinto efanayo ngoba kuzodingeka bube bufushane noma bube bukhulu kuye ngesisindo somhlaba noma isimo somhlabathi. Le nsimbi encane inama-sprinkler aqinile axhunywe ngamakhebuli athambile ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze kukhuphuke indawo ejikelezwayo. Ama-sprinkler aphumelela kakhulu angafakwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukujikeleza kahle ngisho nasezikhoneni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula ubude obungama-1,000 metres. Izinhlobo ezithile zezinsimbi nezindawo zingatholakala ngenombolo ethile yemishini. Lokhu kuyahluka uma imishini yakhiwa ngabenzi abahlukene. Umkhiqizi we-header ethile uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphakama kwe-span kumshini othile. Ukuphakama kungahluka kusuka kumamitha angu-4 kuya kumamitha angu-0.3 kumshini othile. Umshini ongahanjiswa ungathengwa kuphela uma kukhona izindawo ezahlukene emasimini lapho i-header izobekwa khona - lokhu kungase kwenzeke uma kukhula izitshalo ezahlukene emasimini afanayo. Isimo somhlaba nesimo semfuyo - noma ngabe umswakama noma umswakama - kungavimbela kalula ukuhamba kwe-header. Kunenani elilinganiselwe lezi zindawo ezingahanjiswa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umgwaqo ongamitha angu-6 udingeka ezindaweni lapho ama-header ebekwe khona. Qaphela lapho uhamba lapho kunezithiyo nezindonga. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezi zindawo - kukhona izinhlobo ezingathuthwa. Khipha amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziqongo ezimisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuthi uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ze-14% - 30% noma phansi noma phezulu. Umshini one-header ejikayo ngaphandle kwe-header eyakhiwe ngensimbi ngaphakathi kwemfuyo nezindawo ezijikeleziweyo ungafinyelela ku-360°, kodwa ungavinjwa ezindaweni ezincane hhayi emjikelezweni wonke. Ungakcovera u-80-90% wendawo yemfuyo. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi u-75% wezithombo ukhula engxenyeni yangaphandle yomjikelezo, kanti ingxenye yangaphakathi yomjikelezo (50%) inezithombo eziyi-25% zendawo yonke. Isebenzisa amanzi, amandla (ugesi), nemali. Abakhiqizi abajikeleza amanzi abahlola njalo izinga lokumuncwa komhlaba bavame ukugcina amanzi namandla, bakhulise umkhiqizo, bavimbele ukuhuzuka komhlaba, futhi banciphise ukungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kokujikeleza amanzi kusho ukudala indawo lapho izitshalo zingakhula kahle, okusho ukuthi kubhekwa umhlabathi, akufanele kube nomswakama kakhulu noma kube nomswakama omncane kakhulu. Akekho omunye onolwazi olungaka njengokuthi wena ngamasimu akho, izitshalo zakho, kanye nokujikeleza kwakho. I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokujikeleza izitshalo, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengezinto zonke. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izici okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza ngalomshini. Lo mshini unikeza ithuba lokujikeleza ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, nezinye izifo, kanye nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezitshalo. Lo mshini ungafaka amanzi amancane njalo, kodwa lokhu kungaphindwaphindwa. Uma umlimi eqala ukujikeleza ngalomshini, kufanele ashintshe indlela yakhe yokujikeleza. Bangase babe neziqondiso zokufaka amanzi angu-30mm noma 50mm njalo, manje kufanele bafake lezo zinga kodwa hhayi konke ngesikhathi esisodwa - bangafaka amanzi ngokuphindwe kabili noma kathathu. Uma amanzi amaningi efakwa ngesikhathi esisodwa, kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwamanzi futhi kwenze izinsika zibe nzima. Futhi khumbula ukuthi umlimi uphatha inani lamanzi ezimpandeni. Uma bethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukujikeleza, kuzoba nzima ukuvimbela umonakalo ezitshalo. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga kulabo abaqalayo abajikeleza ngalendlela ngoba abazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze isandla sihambe sifikile lapho siqale khona. Ungazikhathazi ukuhamba i-header ejikayo, izokulethela inzuzo. Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokugcina amanzi uma ijikeleza kahle. Njengoba zonke izindlela zokujikeleza, lapha futhi izinga lokumuncwa komhlaba kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ujikeleze kuphela uma amanzi edingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukugcina amanzi namandla ngesikhathi izitshalo zikhula. I-header ejikayo ibiza imali eningi futhi ibekwe ngaphandle emasimini, ngakho-ke abalimisi abaningi bayakhohlwa ukuthi kunezinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa njalo nokugcinwa. Uma uhlinzeka ngomshini wakho, cabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezilandelayo. Khipha uwoyela kuzo zonke izigubhu ezisebenzayo ezinsikeni nasemashalofini e-header bese ufaka uwoyela omusha. Sebenzisa uwoyela ophakanyiswe umkhiqizi womshini. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo eminyakeni emithathu uma umshini usebenza kahle. Uma umshini usebenza ngaphezu kwamahora angu-1,000 ngonyaka, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo ngonyaka noma eminyakeni emibili. Hlola ibhodi eliqoqayo le-sand bese ulisula uma kukhona isihlabathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi umshini ume ngokuqinile emhlabeni. Khipha amanzi wonke ku-header nasemaphaketheni axhunywe ku-header. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi uma umshini uphuka ngesikhathi udingeka ukuze ujikeleze, kungadala ingozi enkulu.
Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS major member classification) Ngomhlaka 15 kuNcwaba 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wenzeka eGoli, lapho kwahlangana khona abamele izigaba ezahlukene zeGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ukuze baxoxe ngokuqhubeka kokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezinguquko ezithinta amalungu, kanye nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuhlela amalungu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yeMenenja yeGEMS, uNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, owakhuluma ngokuqonda okukhulu ngendaba yokuhlukaniswa kwelungu. Uthe, "Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungu ethu ahlukaniswa ngendlela efanele, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo." Ubuye wakhumbuza bonke ababekhona ukuthi lezi zinguquko zenzelwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu, nokuthi kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aziswe ngalezi zinguquko. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba neseshini yokuxoxa, lapho amalungu ahlukahlukene eGEMS abebamba iqhaza. Abamele izigaba ezahlukene zaphendula imibuzo ethile, futhi babelana ngemicabango yabo mayelana nezinguquko ezizayo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziqonda izinqubo ezithinta izinsizakalo zabo. Ukwengeza, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezifundo ezithile ezazihlinzekwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo, ababeveza izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuphila kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amalungu abone ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu akukhona kuphela ukwehlukaniswa kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuhilela nokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo yomuntu siqu. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lukhombisa ukuthi uma amalungu ethola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, kuthuthukiswa impilo yabo yonke. Ngemuva kokuxoxa, umcimbi waphinde waba neseshini yokubambisana, lapho amalungu akwazi ukuxhumana nabanye abamele izigaba ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwamalungu, okwakubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa futhi zisetshenziswe kahle. Uhlelo lokubambisana lwakha umoya wokubambisana, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa. Umcimbi uphothulwe ngenkulumo yokugcina kaMnu. Sipho Dlamini, owayekhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu. Uthe, "Siyazi ukuthi lezi zinguquko zidinga isikhathi, kodwa sizimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo." Ubuye wakhuthaza amalungu ukuba aqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabo. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi wokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu weGEMS wawuwumcimbi obalulekile, owahlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhulu mayelana nezinguquko ezizayo. Kwakuwumcimbi owawuhlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi wakhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu akukhona kuphela ukwehlukaniswa kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo yomuntu siqu. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi iGEMS izimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo athola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa.
Amaqembu Ebhola AseNingizimu Afrika Ezweni elinothile ngezamasiko nezemidlalo, iNingizimu Afrika iyaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yayo emkhakheni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ebholeni. Ibhola, elaziwa ngokuthi "football" emhlabeni jikelele, liyinsika yokuhlanganyela nokubumbana kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ahlukaniswe ngezinga, izifunda, kanye nezikhungo zokuqeqesha, futhi ahlale enezigigaba ezithokozisayo ezikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana. Ekuqaleni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lathuthuka kakhulu ngemva kokuphuma kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho umphakathi waqala ukubona ibhola njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokubuyisela emuva izinkinga zomphakathi. Amaqembu amaningi aqala ukuvela, futhi ngaleso sikhathi, i-PSL (Premier Soccer League) yasungulwa, yenza kube lula ukuhlela imidlalo nokwandisa ukuthandwa kwebhola. Omunye wamaqubu amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika nguKaizer Chiefs, owaziwa njenge "Amakhosi." Lo mqeqeshi ube nomlando omuhle, uqale ngo-1970, futhi ube neziqu eziningi, kuhlanganise ne-PSL titles. Amakhosi abamba umoya wempumelelo, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bekhuthazekile, bekhombisa uthando olukhulu emidlalweni. Umdlalo wabo ophakathi kweKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates, owaziwa ngokuthi "The Soweto Derby," uhlala uthokozisa izinkulungwane zabalandeli, uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-Orlando Pirates, eyasungulwa ngo-1937, iyinhlangano enomlando omude futhi ophumelelayo. Le nqola ibhizinisi elikhulu, ibonisa ubuhlakani obukhulu emidlalweni, futhi ibamba izicoco eziningi. Abalandeli bayo baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni, bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Umdlalo phakathi kwePirates neChiefs ungowokugcina izinkumbulo ezinhle, umoya ophakeme, nokuhlangana kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, iMamelodi Sundowns, eyasungulwa ngo-1970, iyinhlangano edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. I-Sundowns ithole udumo emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ngempumelelo yayo kwiCAF Champions League. Le nqola ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi inezinkanyezi eziningi ezidumile. Abalandeli bayo baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umdlalo wezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika awubandakanyi kuphela amaqembu amakhulu, kodwa futhi kunezinqola ezincane ezithokozisayo. Amaqembu afana ne-Black Leopards, i-TS Galaxy, ne-SuperSport United nawo anomlando omuhle, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Lezi zinqola zikhombisa ukuthi ibhola alikona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika liye laba yinsika yokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi. Amaqembu ahluke-hluke aphesheya kwezilwandle, ahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ibhola lihlala linomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi liwumthombo wokujabula, ukuncintisana, nokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola eNingizimu Afrika liye laba yindawo yokukhuthaza abasha. Amaqembu amaningi abamba imicimbi yokukhetha abadlali abasha, ahlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, futhi abavula amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhola lihlala likhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNingizimu Afrika ibonakale iyindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho amaqembu ebhola engumongo wempilo yomphakathi. Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns abamba izindima ezinkulu, kodwa futhi abanye abancane bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Ibhola akusikho nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokwakha umphakathi. Ekugcineni, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lihlala linethemba, futhi abalandeli bazoqhubeka nokukhuthaza amaqembu abo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, ubumbene, futhi ubambisene ukuze uthokozise umoya wobumbano. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika azokwenza izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi umoya wokuncintisana uzohlala uqhubeka.
Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izikhukhula? Izikhukhula zenzeka lapho izinga lamanzi emifuleni, ezilwandle, noma emathafeni liphakama kakhulu, kudala ukuwa kwamanzi emhlabeni. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukuna kwemvula, ukuncipha kwemvelo, noma izimo zezulu ezinzima. KwaZulu-Natal, izikhukhula zenzeka kaningi ngenxa yemvula enkulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezinyanga zokuqala zonyaka. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izizathu ezibangela izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal? Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal zidalwa yizimo eziningi. Okokuqala, imvula enkulu engapheli, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezinyanga zehlobo, ibalulekile. Okwesibili, izindawo ezinamathafa amakhulu nezintaba zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwamanzi, okungaholela ekwakhekeni kwezikhukhula. Okwesithathu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, njengokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo nezakhiwo, kunciphisa amandla emvelo okuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 3: Izikhukhula zineziphumo ezinjani? Izikhukhula zineziphumo ezinzima. Zingenza umonakalo omkhulu emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini. Abantu bangaphila engozini, futhi izimpahla zabo zingonakaliswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zingaholela ekupheleni kwemithombo yokuphila, njengamanzi nezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga ezinzima zomnotho, njengoba imisebenzi ithinteka kakhulu. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni? Ukuze kuvikwe abantu ezikhukhuleni, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlala ezikhukhuleni, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu kufanele baqeqeshelwe izindlela zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi kube nezinhlelo zokwazisa umphakathi ngezikhathi zokukhukhula. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza ekuvikelweni ezikhukhuleni? Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuvikelweni ezikhukhuleni. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu babe nolwazi ngezingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza imihlangano yokwazisa, ukwakha amaqembu okusebenza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqubomgomo zokuphila eziphephile, futhi uthumele izixwayiso uma kunemvula enkulu. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuhlale kuqinisekiswa ukuvikeleka kwabantu? Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele kubalulekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezimo zezulu, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphendula, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela umonakalo omkhulu. Umbuzo 7: Yini engakwenziwa ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula? Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinqwaba zamanzi, ukulawula ukuhamba kwamanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokulawulwa kwemvula. Ukuthuthukisa imvelo, njengokutshala izihlahla, kubalulekile, njengoba izihlahla zinciphisa ukuhamba kwamanzi. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani izikhukhula zishintsha impilo yabantu KwaZulu-Natal? Izikhukhula zishintsha impilo yabantu KwaZulu-Natal ngezindlela eziningi. Abantu abavame ukuhamba emikhakheni ethile, futhi izikhukhula zingabavimbela ekutholeni izinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, okuthinta umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zishintsha umqondo wabantu mayelana nezindawo abahlala kuzo, njengoba bezokwenza izinqumo ezinzima uma kuziwa ekukhetheni izindawo zokuhlala. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa nguhulumeni? Uhulumeni uthatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze avikele abantu ezikhukhuleni. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Umphakathi kufanele ubambisane nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal? Ngokubona kwami, ikusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal linokukhanya. Uma abantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele bamba iqhaza, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezikhukhula. Ukukhuluma, ukufundisa, nokwakha izinhlelo eziqhubekayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni ezizayo. Ubufakazi bokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nabaholi bukhombisa ukuthi singakwazi ukwakha indawo ephephile. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izikhukhula zingathinti impilo yethu ngendlela engafanele. Ngale ndlela, singenza kube lula ukuhlala kahle KwaZulu-Natal.
Ekusungulweni kwe-NER (Umphakathi Wezokuhlinzeka Ngamandla) ngoMsombuluko 1995, i-NER yazibophezela ekwenzeni izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi (ESI). Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zabe seziqokonyiswa futhi zafaneleka nguMphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki bamanzi bagcina abathengi bethola izinga elamukelekayo lezinsizakalo. Enye indima esebenza ngayo i-NER okwamanje ukuqapha iminikelo yabahlinzeki bamanzi ngokubabeka uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Umphakathi uphinde uqaphele ukuthi abathengi banendima yokudlala ohlelweni lokulawulwa. Kukholwa ukuthi uma abathengi beqonda izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhona, bazokwazi ukuvusa izinkinga kubahlinzeki bamanzi futhi babe nezwi ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngakho-ke, abathengi kufanele bazi ngezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka abazifanele. Kuze kube manje, i-NER isungule idokhumenti elula ukufundwa futhi eyamukelekayo kubathengi. Le dokhumenti isekelwe kulokho okukhona ngaphandle kokushintsha umqondo wayo. I-National Electricity Regulator (NER) isivele yaqaphela isidingo sokusungula izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi; izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zingalindelwa ngabathengi bempahla ehlukahlukene kanye nezinga okufanele lihlangabezane nalokho okukhona. Abahlinzeki bamanzi kufanele babike ku-NER ngezinga labo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bayalandela izindinganiso. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuveza kubathengi abakhokha ngogesi ngezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ezilindelekile abangazilindela kubahlinzeki bamanzi futhi ukuze inikeze abathengi ukuqonda okungcono kwekholomu ye-NRS 047 ngendlela ethinta ngayo. Ukukala ugesi okhokhelwayo kuvumela abathengi ithuba lokuthenga ugesi ngamanani abawakwazi ukukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi abangahlangabezani nezikweletu zabo zogesi ekupheleni kwenyanga bangase baphuthelwe ukukhokha. Le bhukwana iphinde ichaze izindlela ezitholakalayo kubathengi uma kwenzeka izinkinga phakathi kwabahlinzeki bamanzi nabo mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER ilindele ukuthi abathengi nabahlinzeki abathintekayo bazame ukusombulula izinkinga zabo ngaphambi kokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER. Ngokuvamile, i-NER ngeke ingenelele ngaphandle kokuthi leyo nkinga ingaxazululwa ezingeni lendawo. Ezinye izisho zisetshenziswa kakhulu embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kubalulekile kubathengi bamanzi ukuba bazi ngencazelo yalezi zisho. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi: ukuhlinzekwa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okuhlelwe phambili okwenziwa ngumbhlinzeki wogesi lapho kwenziwa umsebenzi wokugcinwa noma uxhumana nezintambo zikagesi. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okwenziwe ngokuqinile: ukuhlinzekwa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okwenzeka ngenxa yephutha elithile ezintanjeni zikagesi noma ngenxa yokungasebenzi kahle kwemishini kagesi. Izintambo zikagesi zasemaphandleni: izintambo zikagesi ezihlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezikude, njengezindawo zasemaphandleni nezifunda, ezivame ukungabi nezinsiza ezinhle ezifana nezindlela. Izintambo zikagesi zasemadolobheni: izintambo zikagesi ezihlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezihlotshiswe kahle ezivame ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwangaleso sikhathi: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kubathengi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kungase kungahambisani nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ugesi ophansi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni abathengi bezindlu noma amabhizinisi amancane. Ugesi ophakathi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekusabalaliseni ugesi nasekuhlinzekeni izimboni noma abathengi abangathengisi. I-voucher yegesi: Lokhu kuwufakazi lokukhokha (ibhilidi) elitholakala ngemva kokukhokha ugesi futhi livumela umthengi ukuthi asebenzise inani elithile legesi. Isebenza ngokuthi ilayishwe kumitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo. Umitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo: idivayisi yokukala ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izimali ezahlukene zogesi ezithengwe zifakwa kule mithathu. Isikhungo sokuhweba nokuqasha ugesi: imishini exhunywe ezindaweni zebhizinisi esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amanani kagesi athengwe ngababhalisile ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi: izinga elilindelekile lokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengezinga lamandla kagesi, ukuhoxiswa, ukwehla, nokwenyuka kwamandla, njll., njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 2 se-NRS 048. Ikhredi/Abathengi abasebenzisa ama-voucher kagesi ekhokhelwayo: laba ngabathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ngekhredi futhi umhlinzeki kagesi uza ukufunda inani legesi elisetshenzisiwe. Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezichazwe ngaphansi kwe-NRS 047 esigabeni 1 yilezo okufanele umhlinzeki kagesi azame ukuzihlangabeza, kodwa abahlinzeki bamanzi bencitshwa ukuba baphumelele izindinganiso eziphakeme ezibekwe. Ezimweni lapho umhlinzeki kagesi ehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezinga elilindelekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingaphansi kokulawula kwabo, ngeke babhekelele ukwehluleka ukusebenza ezingeni elibekwe. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izenzo zokulwa, ukuhweba, nokuvukela, izingozi zemoto, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lezi zimo ezibalwe ngenhla aziphelele kodwa ziqondwa njengezibonelo zalokho okufanele kulawule isimo. Uma kwenzeka impikiswano nomthengi mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka elikhonjisiwe, umthwalo wokuzama ukusombulula le nkinga usemuhlinzeki kagesi usebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zokubonisana. Ngale ndlela, uma isikhalazo sesifakiwe, umhlinzeki kagesi kufanele azise inkantolo, isikhathi, nendawo lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuzama ukusombulula udaba. Kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER izongena kuphela uma izingxoxo zokuxazulula zingaphumelelanga. Kubalulekile kubathengi ukuhamba ngezimo ezibekwe ngabahlinzeki bamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuqedela yonke imibhalo edingekayo, nokukhokha zonke izindleko ezibekwe. Uma kwenzeka impikiswano mayelana nezinga lezinsizakalo, ngokwesibonelo, ukunemba komitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo, kubalulekile kumthengi ukukhokha imali ebekwe ngaphambi kokuba udaba luhlolwe. Le mali izobuyiselwa uma kutholakala ukuthi ukunemba kokufunda kwemitha akulungile. Umthengi kufanele aqale ngokunikeza umhlinzeki kagesi ithuba lokuxazulula noma iyiphi inkinga. Kumele baphakamise udaba ku-NER uma kwenzeka ukuphumelela kokufinyelela esivumelwaneni. Izinsuku eziyishumi uma izintambo ezikhona zingasetshenziswa noma ikhebuli exhuma kwinethiwekhi yangaphakathi engadini. Inyanga eyodwa uma ugesi oph
Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThandiwe Ndlovu - Umqondisi WamaFilimu UThandiwe Ndlovu ungomunye wabaphumelele kakhulu emkhakheni wamafilimu eNingizimu Afrika, ethokozisa izigidi zabantu ngezindaba eziphilayo nezithokozisayo. UThandiwe wazalelwa edolobheni lasePitoli, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ojwayelekile, lapho ubumqoka bokuxhumana nemindeni buphakamisa uthando lwakhe lwezindaba nezokuxhumana. Kusukela ebuncaneni bakhe, wayenothando lokubuka amafilimu, ahlale ebuka izithombe ezihlukahlukene ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezimfundisa ngempilo, uthando, nezinselele. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezeMidlalo eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokusebenza njengomsebenzi wezokukhanyisa emafilimini amancane. Uhlale emisha, edinga ukufunda nokukhula, athola izifundo ezahlukeneyo emkhakheni wamafilimu. Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola imfundo eyenele yokuhola nokuphatha, okuholele ekutheni akhe izimiso ezinamandla zokuphatha izigcawu, izikhumbuzo, nokukhiqiza. UThandiwe waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wamafilimu ngemuva kokuphumelela kweyakhe ifilimu yokuqala, ethi "Umoya Wothando," eyakha umbono omusha mayelana nothando phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukahlukene. Le filimu yahamba phambili, yaholela ekubeni ithole imiklomelo eminingi, okuhlanganisa ne-International Film Festival, lapho yafaka khona isithombe esiqhakazile sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bezenhlalo ezihlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, kwavula iminyango yokuxhumana nabanye abaqondisi nabakhiqizi bamafilimu emhlabeni jikelele. Njengomqondisi, uThandiwe unokuhlakanipha okukhulu ekubambeni izimo ezinzima, okunikeza izithombe ezikhangayo nezikhumbulekayo. Uhlonipha izinkolo, izilimi, nemikhosi yamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Izinhloso zakhe zokwenza amafilimu zifaka ukufundisa, ukukhipha imilayezo ethile, kanye nokukhuthaza abanye ukuze bahlale bephokophele phambili. Ubumbano lwakhe nolwazi oluwusizo lwakha izindaba ezibucayi, ezihambisana nemizwa yeqhawe, ukungabaza, nobunzima obuhambisana nezimo zempilo. Ithuba elilandelayo elalikhankasela uThandiwe kwakungokwakhiwa kwefilimu ethi "Izinyembezi Zothando," ethokozisa izilaleli ngendaba yeqhawe elihamba ngebhasi lothando, elihamba ngaphakathi kwezinselelo ezivamile. Le filimu yashukumisela izincwadi zomphakathi, yanikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngamaqhawe abo, kube nezimo ezithinta ubuhlungu nothando. UThandiwe wayefuna ukwakha ikholwa phakathi kwezilaleli, eyazi ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuxhumana ngempela. Ngaphezu kokuba umqondisi, uThandiwe ungumfundisi wezobuciko, ehlanganyela ulwazi lwakhe nabafundi bezobuciko. Ubonisa ukuqonda okukhulu kwezifundo ezihlukile, ehlanganyela imibono yakhe nokuqonda kwakhe. UThandiwe ubona ukuthi ukukhiqiza amafilimu akuyona nje imisebenzi yokwenziwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokubeka impilo ebuhleni, ukudlulisa imiyalezo yemvelo, nokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungenisa umoya omusha emkhakheni wamafilimu eNingizimu Afrika, enza izifundo eziphathelene nomnotho, ubuhlobo, kanye nemikhuba yokuphila. Uhlale efuna ukuhlola izinkolelo ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganiswe nezinkinga zomphakathi, ezithinta umphakathi nezwe. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nokwakha amafilimu, ubona ukuthi umhlaba uyashintsha, futhi izindaba zidinga ukuhamba nezikhathi. I-legacy yakhe izoqhubeka nokukhula, ibalulekile emhlabeni wamafilimu, ihlale ibonisa ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuphila, yokufundisa, nokuhlanganyela. UThandiwe Ndlovu uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuciko bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, okhuthazayo, kanye nomhlaba obumbene. Ngalesi sikhathi, uThandiwe ubheka phambili, enza izinhlelo eziningi ezikhethekile zokukhuthaza abasha emhlabeni wamafilimu, eqhubeka nokukhulisa izwi lakhe, ukuze izindaba zodozane nezinye izilimi nezinkolo, zigcine zikhanya ezinkalweni zethu. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumqondisi, umfundisi, nempumelelo - ungumuntu obalulekile emhlabeni wamafilimu, ohlonishwa kakhulu, futhi ophawula indlela ezayo.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthembu, indoda esebenza ngokuzikhandla, owathola incwadi ethokozisayo. Le ncwadi, eyayivela kuhulumeni, imtshela ukuthi usuku lokuthola impesheni yakhe selufikile. U-Mthembu, oneminyaka engama-60, ubengumsebenzi emnyangweni wezokwakha iminyaka engama-35, futhi umsebenzi wakhe wakha izakhiwo eziningi ezazisiza umphakathi. Nokho, wayenokukhathazeka. Wayazi ukuthi ukuze athole impesheni, kudingeka aqinisekise inombolo yakhe yempesheni, eyaziwa njenge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nqubo yayidinga ukunaka okukhulu, futhi wayengazi kahle ukuthi angayiqedela kanjani. Ngemuva kokucabanga, uMthembu wanquma ukuya ehhovisi le-GEMS elisedolobheni, enethemba lokuthola usizo. Ehhofisini, wabona abantu abaningi bekhuluma futhi bejabule, kodwa yena wayezizwa engakhululekile. Waqonda ukuthi lezi zinsuku zokuqala zokuphila ngaphandle komsebenzi, futhi wayezama ukujwayela. Kodwa, abaphathi behhovisi bamamukela ngenhlonipho, futhi uMnu. Khumalo, umphathi, wamtshela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kudinga izincwadi ezithile. U-Mthembu wathola ukuthi udinga ubufakazi bokusebenza, isithombe, kanye nenombolo yakhe yempesheni. Ngemuva kokuhamba phambili, wathola zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo. Wabuyela ehhovisi, lapho uMnu. Khumalo emphendula izicelo zakhe. “Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane Mthembu,” kusho uMnu. Khumalo. “Sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yakho yempesheni. Lokhu kuzothatha izinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa sizokuthumelela imiphumela.” U-Mthembu wathokoziswa, kodwa waba nokukhathazeka. “Ngabe ngizokwazi ukuthola impesheni yami?” wayecabanga. U-Mnu. Khumalo wamkhumbuza ukuthi le nqubo iyajwayelekile, futhi kufanele alinde. U-Mthembu wanquma ukuba nesineke, waphuma ehhovisi enethemba. Izinsuku zedlula, uMthembu wathola incwadi ethokozisayo evela ku-GEMS. Wayezokwazi ukuthola impesheni yakhe! Wazizwa ejabule, kodwa waba nesithakazelo sokwazi ukuthi inombolo yakhe yempesheni iqinisekisiwe kanjani. Wabuyela ehhovisi, lapho uMnu. Khumalo emtshela ukuthi inombolo yakhe yempesheni ibhalwe kahle futhi iqinisekisiwe. “Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Khumalo,” kusho uMthembu, enomoya ophakeme. “Ngiyabonga ngokungisiza.” U-Mnu. Khumalo wamphendula, “Siyajabula ukusiza. Lokhu kuyinsiza kubantu abanjengawe.” U-Mthembu waphuma ehhovisi, enethemba elisha, futhi wafunda ukuthi impesheni yakhe izomnika ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono, nokuthi uzokwazi ukusiza umndeni wakhe. Waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uMthembu wathola impesheni yakhe yokuqala, wazizwa ejabule, futhi wathokozisa umndeni wakhe. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. U-Mthembu waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye, ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zempesheni. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMthembu waba umholi emphakathini, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye abantu ababephakathi. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe izincwadi zabo kahle. Wazi ukuthi impesheni iyinsiza enkulu, futhi wayefuna ukuthi wonke umuntu akwazi ukuyithola. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMthembu waba nesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi waba nesifiso sokuthi bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono. Wazi ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kwakuyisinyathelo sokuqala, kodwa impilo engcono yayidinga ukuzinikela, uthando, nokubambisana. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo esihle emphakathini, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo. Wazi ukuthi impesheni yakhe yayiyinsiza, kodwa uthando nomphakathi kwakuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuphila. U-Mthembu waphila impilo egcwele, enethemba, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Engekho Nezinsiza Ngemva kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokudla zibe yinkinga enkulu emindenini engaqondile eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu kubantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude nasemakhaya. Ukuhlaziya le nkinga kudinga ukuthi sibheke izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona ukuze sithole indlela yokuphendula lesi simo. Izimbangela Zezinkinga Zokudla Enye yezimbangela eziyinhloko zokushoda kokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali ibangelwa ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Abantu abaningi bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanelekayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla eziyisisekelo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokungabi nemali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, ezifana nokungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Futhi, izinkinga zendawo yokuhlala zibe nomthelela omkhulu. Ezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi ezisemakhaya, zidinga ukuthuthwa kwezinsiza zokudla ezifana nezitolo ezithengisayo, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kokudla Ukushoda kokudla kubangela imiphumela emibi emindenini engaphansi kwemali. Izingane ezikhulayo zidinga ukudla okunempilo ukuze zikhule kahle, kanti ukuntuleka kokudla okwakha umzimba kuholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana ne-anemia, ukungakhuli kahle, nezinkinga zokucabanga. Lokhu kubangela imiphumela emibi emphakathini, njengoba izingane ezingenamandla zingakwazi ukufunda kahle esikoleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nokudla okwanele kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwandisa izindleko zezokwelapha. Lokhu kuyalwa nezindleko ezinkulu emndenini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinye izidingo ezisemqoka. Izixazululo Ezingenzeka Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi emisha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokususwa kwezithiyo ezifaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuhamba. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kube nokwaziswa ngempilo phakathi kwemindeni, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi yikuphi ukudla okudingekayo ukuze bakhe imizimba enamandla. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ngemikhuba yokudla okunempilo zingabasiza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezinhle uma bezikhetha ukudla. Ukwakha izitolo zokudla eziseduze nezindawo ezisemaphandleni kungasiza kakhulu ekwehliseni izinkinga zokushoda kokudla, njengoba zingahlinzeka ngamakhasimende ukudla okuthengiswayo ngezindleko eziphansi. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali zidinga ukuba zibhekwane ngokubambisana ukuze zixazulwe. Ngokubambisana, uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi bangakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokudla. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe nesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze imindeni ikwazi ukuphila kahle, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.

UNgqongqoshe angawathathela emuva amandla anikezwe kumuntu esigabeni 2, uma ibandla noma inhlangano icela ukuthi ikhululwe futhi lokhu kufanele kushicilelwe kuGazethi. Zonke amandla omphakathi wokushada ngaphansi kwesigaba 4 kufanele abhalwe emqulwini futhi kufanele ahlanganise usuku lokuqala kwala mandla kanye nemikhawulo enikezwe kuyo efakiwe kulolo mqulu. Uma futhi enganeliseki, kufanele aphikise ukuhlanganiswa kobudlelwano futhi abhale phansi izizathu zalo. I-European Union: Uhlaka, Imisebenzi, Nezimpikiswano I-European Union (EU) yisixhumanisi esihlanganisa amazwe aphesheya kweselwandle eYurophu, futhi yaziwa ngemisebenzi yayo yokulawulwa kwezomnotho, isimo sezepolitiki, namalungelo abantu. Iqale ukusungulwa ngonyaka ka-1993 ngesikhathi sokubhalwa kweTreaty of Maastricht, lapho ihlanganiswe khona izici ezahlukene zempilo yaseYurophu. Le misho yalandela ukwakheka kweEuropean Economic Community (EEC) ngonyaka ka-1957, eqale ukusungulwa njengokuhlanganyela kwezomnotho phakathi kwezwe. I-European Union ihlanganisa amazwe angama-27, lawo ahlukeneyo ngemibono, ngezimo zempilo, nemigomo. Lokhu kuhlela kuvumela ukuhwebelana okukhululekile phakathi kwamazwe, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, umnotho, nokuhweba. Ukusebenza kwama-akhawunti ahlukene kuyiqiniso elibalulekile; umkhankaso wezingxoxo wekhulu elisha ukhombisa ukuzama kokuhlanganyela ezombusazwe, ukunqoba izithiyo zempilo, nobumbano lwezizwe. Ngaphandle kwezimali, i-EU iphinde yaziwa ngemithetho ethile efanele ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo, imfundo, nezinye izigaba ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-European Union igxila kakhulu kumakhasimende ayo nakuqinisekisa ukuthi kunobufakazi obuphumelelayo bokwazisa ngezinhlelo ezithile. Isizathu sokwakheka kwayo sihamba phambili ekwandiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe akuqhamukayo. Ubulungiswa bokuhlanganyela, ukunciphisa ukungabi nabulungisa, nokulondolozwa kwemvelo kuhamba phambili emibhalweni eyingqayizivele yamazwe angaphansi kwe-EU. Lokhu kudinga izinqumo ezilungiswa ngokubambisana nezwe ngalinye, kuthumele izimemo ezisemqoka ukuba zilandela izinqumo eziqhamuka kumamele. Ukubambisana kwakho i-EU kuyasiza kokuqeda gap phakathi kwemiphakathi eminingi ehlukene, nakuba iqukethe izinselelo ezihlukahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izimifications zalesi sikhungo ezivela ezimweni ezinjengokuphepha, umnotho, nezenhlalo. I-EU ibheka izinkinga ezithinta abantu, njengezinhlekelele zemvelo, ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu, nokungabi nabulungisa. Amathuba okubambisana nezizwe zangaphandle nawo akuwela emkhakheni wakamuva we-EU. Nokho, i-European Union ibhekene nezivunguvungu ezithile. Izinkinga ezikhona phakathi kwamazwe azimele ziqinisa izinkulumo ezahlukahlukene. Ukuphikiswa иkuhlelo lwe-Common Agricultural Policy, umthetho ophathelene nezolimo kanye nezinsizakusebenza, kudala ubunzima ekuphathweni kwezimali zakwa-EU. Kulokhu, izinkampani nezwe lonke kumele ziqhube izinhlelo eziphumelelayo ukuze ziphumelelayo ezicini zemvelo. I-EU ibuye ibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthokoziswa kokubambisana kwabantu. Izinselelo zomhlaba, njengezinguquko zesimo sezulu, zithinta wonke umuntu, ngakho wonke amazwe adinga ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinto ezimbi. Lokhu kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe, ukuze kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokuhlala bekhuthazwa, nokuthuthukisa umsebenzi oyinsakavukela. Ngenhloso yokwandisa indawo yokusebenza, i-European Union ibeke izijobelelo ezithile, njengezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi ezenzakalayo, ezibhekiswe ekwandiseni izinga lezempilo, imfundo, nobuchwepheshe. I-‘Digital Single Market’ iyisibonelo esihle salokhu, ibhekisa kokukwamukelwa kwezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi zokuhweba nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantu basebenzisane kalula, cushioni izithiyo ezizwakalayo, futhi kuthuthukiswe ubumba bemiphakathi. Ekugcina, i-European Union ibalulekile ngezinhloso zayo zokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, umnotho, namalungelo abantu. Ngeke nje isebenzise izimali, kodwa iphinde ihlaziye kunoma yikuphi ukuphikisana okukhona phakathi kwamazwe. Ukuzama okuhle kwabazali bayo kugxila ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi oswazini, okuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi waneliseka ngezidingo zawo. Isikhathi esizayo se-European Union sikhombisa ukusagejiswa ezinhlelweni ezivuma izidingo zami nezilwane, nokuthuthukiswe ngqa umhlaba kubantu bonke.

Imishini nokufinyelela ezingeni elithile, isikhala esingaphansi kokulawulwa kukahulumeni sekwamukelwe futhi sibambisene kahle nezinselelo zokuhlanganisa intsha yethu emnothweni. Izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi zinezibopho zokuhlinzeka ngempilo yezifo ezithile ezitholakala. I-Western Cape yonke ihlinzekwa ngosizo oluvela esikhungweni esisodwa sokubuyiselwa komzimba nokufakwa kwezitho zomzimba ezingezona ezempilo esikhundleni salokho okulahlekile ePinelands, eCape Town. Yiba nomusa, ube nezinhliziyo ezinhle, futhi ube nomusa kubo bonke, kuhlanganise nokubakhumbuza ngothando nokukhuluma nabo ngenhlonipho. Amadokhumenti omsebenzi weMizimba Yabantu, Ukubekwa ngamaqembu, igalari yeMnyuziyamu, amathambo noma imishanguzo eyashintshwa yaba yitshe, Ukuvuselelwa Kwezilwane, Amazinyo Nezitho Zezilwane Ezincane. Uhlelo lokwakha isikhungo esinjalo luzoxoxwa nawo wonke ababambiqhaza. U-Governor weBhange uNgondla Tito Mboweni kanye nabasebenzi beBhange Ngodla benze kahle kakhulu mayelana nezimali zethu. Le mthetho ikhishwa lapho kufakwa isicelo sokubeka inani eliqinile elizokwenziwa ekhokhweni komholo wombhaki. Umqashi kumele athumele lesi sicelo egameni lomsebenzi. Imiyalelo ayidluliselwa, futhi uma umsebenzi eshintsha isimo sokusebenza, kumele kufakwe isicelo esisha. Uma unamaqashi amaningi, isicelo semiyalelo kumele senziwe kumqashi ngamunye. Amakhophi wezinkontileka zomsebenzi, izivumelwano zomsebenzi, nezinye izincwadi ezihlobene ziyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe imigomo nemibandela yokusebenza. Imiyalelo yephesenti eliqinile izokwenziwa isikhathi esingama-12 months futhi kumele ivuselelwe ngemuva kwalokho. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zezimali zisesimweni esifanele uma ufaka isicelo semiyalelo yezezimali. I-SARS ngeke ikhiphe imiyalelo yezezimali uma unokwehluleka ukukhokha izintela. Ikhophi yekhontileka yomsebenzi iyincwadi echaza kahle uma ungenayo inombolo ye-ID noma inombolo yokubhaliswa kwe-PAYE. Faka isicelo sakho semiyalelo yephesenti eliqinile mathupha ehhovisi le-SARS, njengoba umsebenzi kumele athumele isitatimende seziqu zomholo nezindleko. Uma isicelo samukelwa yi-SARS, uzothola ukuqinisekiswa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa. Nokho, imiyalelo yezezimali esemthethweni ingathatha cishe amasonto amane. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.
I-Memorandum yeMthetho 136 yeMithetho Yesifunda saseGauteng. Incazelo entsha ye-"isiteshi" ifakiwe ukuze ibandakanye indawo esetshenziselwa imisebenzi ehambisana ngqo nokusebenza nokuphathwa kohlelo lwezitimela kanye nokuthuthwa kwabagibeli abafika nabahamba esiteshini. Isiteshi sizobandakanya izindawo zokupaka, ama-garage okupaka, izindawo zokulahla nokuthola abagibeli, izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi, nezinsiza ezifanayo. Kubonakale ukuthi kuvunyelwene nezinsizakusebenza zomphakathi ezifanele ngemva kokuxoxisana ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuthile endaweni yesiteshi akufanele kulawulwe yizinhlelo zokwakha ezisemadolobheni futhi akufanele kube ngaphansi koMthetho, okungavimbela izinqubo ezithatha isikhathi eside ekushintsheni izinhlelo zokwakha ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kubandakanya imisebenzi ethile yezohwebo ehambisana ngqo nokuphathwa kahle kwabagibeli, kubandakanya ukukhangisa, ukuthengiswa kokudla neziphuzo, amaphephandaba nezincwadi, imishini yokuthengisa ethengisa izinto ezithengiwe, izingcingo zomphakathi, nemishini yokubhanga (lezo ezamukela amakhadi futhi zikhokhe imali). Nokho, kubhekwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi zesiteshi, kungase kube nesidingo semisebenzi yezohwebo ezindaweni eziseduze nesiteshi. Njengoba le misebenzi yezohwebo ingase ithinte izindawo eziseduze neziteshi futhi ingase iphinde ithinte izakhiwo zomphakathi, kudingeka ukuthi amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba ahlotshaniswe nokusetshenziswa kwawo kwezomnotho kulawulwe ngohlelo olusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokwakha esisemadolobheni. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kubhekwane nomnikelo womphakathi walesi sikhala, kanye nesinqumo somasipala, ngaphambi kokuthi la malungelo anikezwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokwakha yalesi sikhala. Le misebenzi izokwenziwa esiteshini, futhi kumele yenziwe ngokuhambisana namalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba endaweni kanye nemithetho efanele yokwakha. Mayelana nokukhuluma ngendlela entsha yephakathi kanye nomgwaqo wezitimela, isigaba 4 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubuqotho Bezemisebenzi, 2000 (Umthetho No. 3 ka-2000) ubhekisisa izinqubo ezimbili ezishintshashintshayo lapho umphathi wehhovisi kumele akhiphe isinqumo esingase sithinte amalungelo omphakathi kahle noma kabi, eshilo nje ukuhlohla komphakathi noma inqubo yokuphendula. Isigaba esikhona 6 sikhetha inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi. Le nqubo ingaba nezinkinga futhi ithathe isikhathi eside futhi ingase iphinde idlulele isidingo solwazi olufanele ekwenzeni izinqumo okukhulunywe ngakho kahle ngale nqubo ehambisana nokuhlolwa kwesayithi kanye nebhuku elihlongozwayo esigabeni 6(a) soMthetho oyinhloko. Ngalesi simo, inqubo yokuhlohla nokuphendula njengoba kubonisiwe esigabeni 4 soMthetho 3 ka-2000 izosebenza futhi izosebenza kahle uma umbiko wendawo usuphothuliwe, kuyilapho inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi ingagcinwa kulezi zimo lapho izinkinga zivelayo ngqo enanini lokuhlohla futhi emibikweni emibili eminye, engase idinge ukuhlolwa nokuphendulwa okwengeziwe. Ngakho-ke, isigaba 6 sishintshwa ukuze kusetshenziswe inqubo yokuhlohla nokuphendula ukuze i-MEC yenze isinqumo, futhi kusebenze inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi kuphela ezindabeni ezihlobene nezinkinga ezithile. Ngakho-ke, ubuqotho bezemisebenzi obuphumelele buhamba phambili kunalokho okudingekayo nguMthetho 3 ka-2000 ngokuthi zombili izinqubo zilandelwa. Umthetho okhona awubheki kahle isivumelwano esidingekayo nguNgqongqoshe mayelana nokwakha, ukwakha, ukusebenza, ukuphathwa, nokubhekwa kweGautrain Rapid Rail Link ephakanyisiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-MEC ikwaziwa, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho, ukuqeda izivumelwano ezifana nesivumelwano esikhona sokwakha ngokuhambisana ne-MEC ephethe ezomnotho. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa umthengisi ophumelele noma i-MEC ngaye, okwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe amandla nokusetshenziswa kwawo ezingeni lokuzimela nokuphakeme. Ukusetshenziswa kwala mandla uma kunikezwa ukuze kuzuze umphakathi kungase kuphinde kube nezithiyo noma kuphazamise ekupheleni kwezivumelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kube nesidingo sokwakha isigaba esibhekisisa ukudluliswa kwamalungelo phezu komhlaba komunye noma amalungelo abanjwe yi-MEC adluliselwa kumthengisi ophumelele. Amalungelo phezu komhlaba komunye kanye namalungelo abantu awakwazi ukusetshenziswa ngokomthetho noma adluliselwe kumuntu wesithathu, futhi kube nesidingo sokuhleleka okukhuluma ngqo ngalokhu. Enye inhloso yeBhili ukuhlela isimo mayelana nokuhlolwa kwezindawo okwenziwayo. Ukuhlolwa kokuqala okubili kwanikezwa ngoba ngasikhathi sinye kungathatha isikhathi eside phakathi kwesigaba sokunquma izindlela nalokho kokwakhiwa kokuqala. Nokho, ukuhlolwa kwesibili akudingekile uma lezi zihlolo ezimbili zenzeka ngesikhathi esifanayo noma ngokuhambisana, njengoba kuzoba khona nokuhlolwa komgwaqo weRapid Rail Link. Ngakho-ke, iBhili ilungisa isigaba 8(b) soMthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akudingeki ukuhlolwa kwesayithi kwenziwe esigabeni sokwakha uma umphakathi onamandla okwenza umsebenzi ubona ukuthi akudingekile. Ezinye izichibiyelo ezincane ezenziwe ngalolu shintsho zenziwe kulolu sigaba. Isigaba 5 seBhili silungisa isigaba 10 soMthetho ukuze silungiselelwe ukuhambisana nesigaba esisha 6. Isigaba 7 seBhili silungisa isigaba 51 soMthetho ukuze silungise iphutha elenzeka ekubhaleni. Isigaba 8 seBhili singenisa isigaba esisha 51A kuMthetho ukuze kubhekwe izivumelwano ezingase ziphothulwe zokwakha, ukwesekwa kwezimali, ukusebenza, ukuphathwa, ukulawula, nokubhekwa kwezisekelo zomgwaqo nezitimela eziphakanyisiwe, njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, ngokuhambisana noNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezimali. Isigaba 9 seBhili sinikeza isihloko esifushane.
Imigomo Yokugoma Kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngemuva kokugoma, ngakho ngithanda ukwabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nemigomo yokugoma. Njengoba sikwazi, ukugoma kuyindlela yokuvikela impilo yethu, kodwa kukhona izinto ezithile okudingeka sizazi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda umgomo wokugoma. Imigomo yokugoma ibhekisela ezinjongweni eziyisisekelo zokuvikela abantu emithini nasezifo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvimbela ukusabalala kwezifo ezithathelwana kalula, njengezifo ezifana nokhuhlaza, i-flu, kanye ne-COVID-19. Ukugoma kusebenza ukuvikela labo abakhathazekile, njengezifo zenhliziyo, abakhulelwe, nabanye abathinteka kakhulu. Ngokubheka emuva, ukugoma akuwona umqondo omusha; isiko lokugoma lisekela emlandweni omude. Ukuqala, abantu babefuna ukuvikela umphakathi ezifo ezincane ezazihlasela. Ngesikhathi esithile, besenobuchwepheshe obuncane, kodwa benza konke okusemandleni ukuze baqonde ukuthi ukugoma kungaba indlela efanele yokuphila. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhuluma ngendima yokugoma emphakathini. Ukugoma akuyona into eyenzelwa umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana komphakathi. Uma umphakathi ugoma, uthola ukuvikeleka, okwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Futhi, uma abantu bebona imiphumela emihle yokugoma, lokho kuholela ekuqiniseni ukuthi kuyadingeka. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokugoma; abanye abantu bahlala bephikisa ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma izimangalo ezingelona iqiniso. Lokhu kudinga ukukhulumisana okuhle ukuze sabelane ngemininingwane efanele. Kumele siqonde ukuthi ukugoma kudinga ukubhekelelwa, futhi kunezindlela ezinhle zokuphendula imibuzo yabantu abangenalo ulwazi olucacile. Futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukukhetha ukuvuma ukugoma kubandakanya nemigomo ethile. Ukugoma akuphuli amalungelo abantu, kodwa kuwumkhankaso ophakathi kokunikeza ukuvikeleka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baqonde imiphumela engaba khona uma behluleka ukuvuma ukugoma. Kukhona izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezibhekene nezinkinga ezithile, futhi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukugoma kunciphisa lezi zinkinga. KwaZulu, umoya wokuhlalisana nokubambisana ungumgogodla wempilo. Ukugoma kufanele kube yisinyathelo esisodwa esihamba phambili ukuze sithole umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukunikeza ukuqonda okuthile ngezinto ezahlukene ezihambisana nokugoma. Umqondo wokugoma uhilela izinqubo ezithile, njengokubhalisela ukugoma, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyagoma ngesikhathi esifanele, nokulandela izeluleko eziphathelene nempilo. Kumele siphinde siqonde ukuthi kulandela izinyathelo ezifanele, sizokwazi ukuvikela abanye, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uhlala uphephile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalezi zinto, siphinde sabelane ngalezi zimiso ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono. Ukugoma akusiyona kuphela into esiyenza njengabantu, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo engcono, ukugcina izizukulwane ezizayo ziphephile. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizoba nesimo esihle, lapho imiphakathi ihlanganyela khona, igqugquzela impilo, futhi ibambisene ukuze ikwazi ukuvikela bonke abantu. Ngemuva kokuhlola lezi zinto, ngifisa ukuthi sithathe lesi sikhathi sikhumbule ukuthi ukugoma kungumnqamulajuqu wokuphila okuncane, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze omunye nomunye ukuze sibe nesithakazelo sokugoma. Ngalokhu, sizoba neqhaza elihle empilweni yethu nempilo yomphakathi. Hamba phambili, ugome, uvikele, futhi ube ngumhlatsi omuhle!
AmaMamelodi Sundowns: Umthelela Omkhulu emhlabeni Wezemidlalo Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle ePitoli, umoya opholile wehlobo uhamba phansi emigwaqweni. Abantu bejabulile, behamba ngezinyawo, bejolisa emakhaya abo, bezama ukujoyina umphakathi. Kodwa phakathi kwalokhu, kwakukhona okunye okwakuphakathi kwengqondo zabantu – amaMamelodi Sundowns. I-Sundowns akuwona nje umphakathi wezinkanyezi zezemidlalo, kodwa ibhizinisi elwakha izimpilo. Lezi zinkanyezi zifana nezinhliziyo zomphakathi, ziphila ngokubambisana, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. Sithanda ukukhumbula ukuthi leli qembu laqala kanjani. Eminyakeni engama-50 edlule, iSundowns yaqala njengenhlangano yezeMidlalo eThekwini, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, baqala ukuhamba phambili besuka ezindaweni ezincane baya ezinkulu. Uhlelo lwabo lwamaSundowns lwaluhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengoba ibhola lalingumsebenzi ophilayo, futhi lwaluhlobene kakhulu nezimpilo zabantu. Ngonyaka we-1990, iSundowns yabhaliswa kuPremier Soccer League, kwaba yisikhathi sokuphila okusha. Kwakuyisikhathi sokukhula, lapho umphakathi wathola ithuba lokubona izinkanyezi zedolobha zidlala. Abalandeli babejabulile, behlabelela, baphakamisa izithombe, futhi bekhumbula izikhathi ezinhle. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, iSundowns yathola iziqu eziningi, nezindondo. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi abalandeli babenokholo olukhulu. Umdlalo wabo wawuhambisana nezinkanyezi ezinkulu, njengabathandekayo abanjengoTeko Modise, Pitso Mosimane, noKhama Billiat. Lezi zinkanyezi zashintsha umqondo wabantu, zakhuthaza abasha ukuba babe nezifiso ezinkulu. Nakuba beface izinselelo, uSundowns waphendula ngokuqinile, wathola izixazululo, futhi wakhuthaza umphakathi. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho wonke umuntu, kusukela kubadlali, abaqeqeshi, nabalandeli, babephakathi kokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi kwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emqondweni. I-Sundowns yathola izifundo eziningi; umdlalo wabo wawungaphezu kokuphumelela, wawuwumoya, nokuhlanganyela. Abalandeli baziqhenya ngalesi qembu, umphakathi wawukhula, futhi iSundowns yathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi ehlukene, iyazisa imiphakathi eyayikade ingaziwa. Namuhla, amaMamelodi Sundowns akhombisa ubuhlakani obukhulu emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Akukhona nje umphakathi ophilayo, kodwa kuyisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza ekuphumeleleni. Abalandeli baziqhenya ngempela, futhi leli qembu lihlala lishaya izigigaba ezintsha, lishintsha izimpilo zabantu. Ngesikhathi sokuphumelela, iSundowns iyakha izinkanyezi ezizayo, ikhulisa abasha, futhi ibakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kubonisa ukuthi ibhola akusikho nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, umoya, nokubambisana. Ngakho, uma ubona amaMamelodi Sundowns edlala, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje umphakathi ophilayo, kodwa kuyisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emhlabeni wezemidlalo.
