Ngale ndlela, amaMamelodi Sundowns ahlale engumkhumbulo omuhle, uphiko oluqinile, nolwakhiwo oluqinile emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Umoya wabo uhlala uzwakala, izinkanyezi zabo zihlala zikhanya, zikhuthaza abalandeli, futhi zikhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza empilweni. Lokhu kuyindaba yeSundowns, futhi le ndaba izohlala ikhuluma ngezizukulwane ezizayo.
Izindlela zokonga ngokusebenzisa nokwakha izakhiwo zomdabu ezifana nezinkampani zokungcwaba nez stokvels. Ukwakha imboni yezezimali esebenzayo encane eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwezezimali ukuze kwakhiwe amandla omthetho ezinhlelweni ezibamba iqhaza kanye namakhasimende azo ukuze kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabo emisebenzini yezezimali ephumelelayo. Ukonga njalo nokuhlinzekwa kwemali kubalulekile kokubili izinhlangano kanye neziqu zezezimali ezithengiswayo (RFIs) njengendlela yokwandisa nokujulisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezezimali kubantu abampofu futhi kuthuthukise isimo sabo sezezimali ukuze baphile kahle. Ukubazi kahle ngokuqonga akusiyo ukukhethwa kokwakhiwa, kodwa ukuqala nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezisekelwe kulwazi lwezimpilo kuyakhuthazwa. Imali yokubolekwa yezezimali encane: Le nqubo ihlinzeka ngemali yokubolekwa efika ku-R10,000 kumakhaya nakwabanye abaqalayo abanguye amalungu ezinkampani ezincane ukuze bazinakekele. Iziqu zezimali ezincane zezimboni ezincane. Imali yokwehlisa amazinga obuphofu kumakhasimende avela kumakhaya athola ngaphansi kwe-R1,500. Inhlangano ebamba iqhaza izosebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola ubuphofu. Ukwakha amandla omthetho: Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso semali, kunikezwa ukwesekwa ukuze kuqiniswe isikhungo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa kwaso kwesikhathi eside. Ukonga njalo: Lokhu kusiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zezezimali nezinye izikhungo zokonga zomdabu ezifana nezinkampani zokungcwaba nez stokvels ukuze kuqoqwe ingcebo yasendaweni. I-Apex yenza umsebenzi wayo ngezinhlangano ezibhalisiwe ezibamba iqhaza, ngakho-ke ukukhetha kwazo kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kuqhubeka. Ngalesi senzo, ihlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi ezikhungweni ezibhalisiwe, ezikhungweni zebhizinisi lendawo, ezikhungweni zabazithandayo, kanye nemiphakathi efanele isebenzisa izici ezijwayelekile. Ekutholeni inani enhlangano, i-Apex ilandela imihlahlandlela ecacile engahlukaniswa ngezindawo ezilandelayo: inhlangano, umhleli, ukuphathwa, ukuphathwa, ubudlelwano bezabasebenzi, indawo yokusebenza, imisebenzi yesigaba, ukusebenza ngaphezu kokuhambisana, izinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ama-akhawunti.
Ukungena eNingizimu Afrika kuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwemvume noma ngokulandela izimo ezibekwe kwiphepha lokuvuma elinikezwe yena noma ngumuntu omnikezeleyo. Izicelo zamaphepha okuvuma ukuhambisa impahla, impahla engaphansi kokulawulwa kwezifiso kufanele zithunyelwe kufomu elibekiwe. Inhloso yalesi sevisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla esebenzisiwe ethunyelwa ingaphazamisi imboni yeSouthern African Customs Union. Le nqubo iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukulawulwa kwezempilo kwemvelo kanye nezizathu zokuphepha, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nezindinganiso, kanye nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokuhambisana nezizathu zemvelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi: International Trade Administration Commission. Amafomu ezicelo kufanele agcwaliswe futhi athunyelwe. Amafomu kufanele athunyelwe kwi-Directorate of Import and Export Control, ITAC. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala.
ISahara Desert: Ukubuyekezwa Kwendawo Enomlando Nezindawo Zokuhlola ISahara Desert, eyaziwa njengenye yezindawo ezinkulu kakhulu zomhlaba, iyasithokozisa ngabuhle bayo bemvelo kanye nomlando wayo ocebile. Le ndawo isendaweni ephakathi neNyakatho-Afrika, ibhekele izwe elikhulu elishisayo, elinomoya onamandla, nezitshalo ezincane. Ukubheka isimo sezulu, iSahara ibonwa njengetholakale elingahlala likhukhuleka ezinzile, lapho izinsuku zayo zinesimo sokushisa esingenakuchaza, kodwa ngezikhathi zonyaka zibavuma abantu ukuba bathole izimo ezithile ezithandwa abantu abaningi. Umoya weSahara ungaphezu kokuphila – uhlanganisa izindawo ezithakazelisayo ezimnandi. Iqukethe amahlathi amancane, izigodi ezimnyama, nezindawo eziluhlaza nezithakazelisayo. Iso lesimo sezulu esomile lienza kube khona ukungaboni nhlobo izinyoni. Kodwa lapho ufunwa ukuchitha isikhathi eside, uzothola izinkanyezi ezijabulisayo zaphakade, lezi zikhanya ezivela phezulu, zineziteshi ezithokozisayo zokuqhubeka komphakathi. Ukwamukela izivakashi, iSahara inezindawo zokuhlola eziningi ezivulelekileyo. Ukuhamba ngezinyawo phakathi kwezindela zezikhukhula ezivela ezintabeni, uzothola izindawo ezihamba phambili zobuhle bemvelo. Izihlahla zihlala zikhanyisa indlela, futhi ungahamba uma ubona uCape Verde, lapho ubudlelwano bezingelosi zikhanyisa kancane. Noma ngabe uhamba phansi, ujabulela ubuhle bezithombe ezimibalabala nezinhlobo zezinyoni. Ezinye izindawo ezifana neMerzouga, uBauz, kanye neChinguetti, zithokozisa izivakashi ngemibono ephawulekayo yeSahara. EMerzouga, ungazithokozisa ngama-sand dunes amakhulu, lapho ungahle uthathe isithombe esihle ngezithombe ezahlukene zenkanyezi. Pandaru lezo zici, ungavakashela ezindaweni ezithokozisayo ezikwenziwa yi-adventure, njengokugibela izinkanyezi nangokwakha ulwazi olujabulisayo ngamasiko endawo. I-Sahara isiphenduke isikhumbuzo semvelaphi yamasiko ahlukahlukene. Abantu abahlala lapha, bakha izinyathelo ezitholakalayo kwezamasiko, izindawo zokuhlola nezinhlelo zokuphila. Lokhu kumangaza kakhulu, indlela abantu abaphila ngayo kule ndawo eyinzima, usebenzisa imvelo ukuze balondoloze impilo yabo. Lokhu kuholela kubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abasebenza zesaphiwe neziza ekhaya. Ngokuphawula, abavakashi bangakwazi ukufunda ngezinkolelo, imikhuba, nezithakazelo zenhlalakahle yabantu bendawo. Uhambo lweSahara lungaba yinto esikukhumbulayo njengoba uhlangana nabantu baqhakambisa ubuhlobo, ukuphumelela kwezakhamuzi endaweni kanye nemibono yezikhumbuzo ezilula. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iSahara akukhulula kuphela, kodwa iphinde ibe ingxenye yezivakashi ezibhalwe emabhukwini wezwe lonke. Nokho, uhulumeni udinga ukuba aqinisekise ukuthi kube nokuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ukuze iSahara igcine isimo sayo esikhangayo, kudingeka izinyathelo zokuvikeleka ukuze imvelo ingagugi futhi abavakashi bahlale bejabule. Lokhu kuhlangabezana nezinselelo, kodwa kuyadingeka ukufaka izinqumo eziphusile ukuze kubaluleke ukuvikela igugu lendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlekelele ezifana nezinhlamvu zokukhukhulelwa, imibuso yokuchithwa yama-sand dunes, nezulu elimbi zingadala umthelela omubi emvelweni yeSahara. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuzigcina lezi zindawo zihlanzekile, zitholakale, futhi ziphumelele ngenxa yokubopha umhlaba wonke kwezemvelo. Ekugcineni, iSahara Desert iyindawo ebikezelayo enezimfihlo ezingenakuchazwa. Ukwahlukaniswa kwendawo kuyona kudinga ukuqonda okujulile, futhi uphendula izivakashi ngezimfashini zosuku nezinto ezithokozisayo ezibhakabhakayo. Noma ngabe uhambe ngokuhamba ngezinyawo, uhlola izindawo, noma ube sesixhumaneni nabantu bendawo, iSahara izonikeza impilo ethokozisayo, okukhumbulelayo, nokukhumbuleka. Uhambo lwakho, lunokholo lungalimala umhlaba, uthole izinto eziyingqabavu eziphathelene nemvelo. I-Sahara, ngempela, iyinsika yokuhamba emlandweni nesiko labantu.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubandakanyeka kwakho kanye nehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-pandemic influenza A (H1N1) 2009 ebhizinisini lakho nasemphakathini owusebenzela. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni leli gciwane nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa ngokuthi i-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ivela ezinkukhu. Manje sekuqondwa ukuthi imvelaphi yayo ivela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, leli gciwane alihlangene nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sekuhlonishwa ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka, leli gciwane lisabalalise ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane selithinte abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekisiwe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. eNingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 kanye nezingozi eziyisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lokuphendula Okusheshayo owawubanjwe ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lomhlaba Wezempilo (WHO) lathola ukuthi izinqubo zokumemezela leli gciwane njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezifeziwe, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni zonke ezindaweni ze-WHO futhi lenze ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi leli gciwane linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. NgoJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwale pandemic ezweni ezithintekile kanye nezwe ezintsha njengokungamukeleki nokungabambeki. Ngaphandle kwalokho, nakuba kunjalo, iphinde yathi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngaleli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngalezi zingozi ezikhona kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane liba nomthelela ikakhulukazi kubantu abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-10 kuya kwengu-29 - iningi labo lingabafundi noma ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO inikeze iseluleko ukuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wale gciwane emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lisabalala ngeziphuzo zokuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ekhala, uphonsa lezi ziphuzo ezikhiphayo noma ezingavikelwanga. Nakuba bengavikela umlomo wabo, ungase uphumelele umoya lapho bekhipha khona lezi ziphuzo. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani ongezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, esivule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesiphakamiso sikadokotela. Abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo lukamasipala akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa ezikhungweni zocwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu kwenzekela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezizimele, kodwa akukhona okudingwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala aphakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliswa kolwazi (protocol) ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela eziphethweni zokwelashwa ezingcono uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase bafe. Ulwazi olutholakala emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwale gciwane. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Sicebisa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzi ongezimpawu ezilula ahlale ekhaya. Uma kunezithombe eziningi zabafundi nabaqeqeshi abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza ngokubambisana nezikhulu zezempilo ukuhlinzeka ngamaqhaza afanele okuqhubeka. Uma ungezimpawu ezilula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kunesidingo esikhulu sesixazululo futhi ukukhiqizwa okukhulu akukwanele - isikali esingatholakali e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukubonga isikhathi osithathile sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo ngokubamba iqhaza kwakho ekusabalaliseni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni umthelela wale gciwane.
Ithuluzi lokudoba liyithuluzi elinikezelwe ukudoba, noma elinokwakhiwa kokudoba, noma lokuvuna izinhlanzi noma ukusiza emisebenzini ehlobene nokudoba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi noma iyiphi ithuluzi elisiza elinye noma ngaphezulu kwamathuluzi olwandle abamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokudoba evumelekile - lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlela izinhlanzi, ukuhamba kwazo, ukuzigcina, nokuzibeka eqandisini. Inhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika ephethe ukuphepha kolwandle, i-SAMSA, kanye nomnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha, kumele ikhiphe imvume yokuthi ithuluzi likwazi ukudoba. Akukho thuluzi elizobhaliswa ngaphandle kwesikhungo sokudoba kanye nemvume yokwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nokudoba. Hlela ukuthi ithuluzi lihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lilungele ukuhamba olwandle, emva kwalokho i-SAMSA izokhipha isitifiketi sokuphepha. Lesi sitifiketi sizohambisana nemibhalo yakho yokubhaliswa. Gcwalisa ifomu lakho ngesandla usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu futhi unikeze izizathu lapho kudingeka. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezikhungo zakho zokudoba noma isivumelwano sakho nomnikazi wethuluzi sokusebenzisa ithuluzi labo uma ungenazo izikhungo zokudoba. Isicelo sakho singathatha ezinsukwini ezintathu noma ngaphezulu kuye ngokuthi imibhalo igcwele.
Umbiko: Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS Major Member Classification) Isingeniso Ukuhlukaniswa kwezinga labalungu elikhulu, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS major member classification, kubalulekile ekuqondeni kahle izimo zomhlaba kazwelonke, ikakhulu emkhakheni wezokuphatha, wezokwakha, nezokuhlalisana. Lesi sihloko sihloselwe ukufaka isibani kulokhu kuhlukaniswa, sihlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile mayelana nezifundo, izizathu, nezindlela ezisetshenziswayo ekwakheni lezi zigaba. Izinhlobo Zezinga Labalungu Elikhulu I-GEMS major member classification ihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezibandakanya imikhakha ehlukene efana nezintaba, izindawo zasemadolobheni, nezindawo eziyinxenye ezinkulu. Umkhakha wezemvelo, ovelayo, ungomunye wezinto ezibhekwa kakhulu, njengoba uhambisana nemiphumela yokwakhiwa kanye nezinselele ezihambisana nokugcina izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukaniswa kukhombisa ukuthi imboni iyakwazi yini ukulawula izinsiza zayo ngendlela efanele. Izizathu Zokuhlukaniswa Izizathu zokuhlukaniswa kwezinga labalungu elikhulu zifaka phakathi ukunikeza umbono oyingqayizivele nosudinga ukuze uba nethezekile. Lokhu kuvumela abaphathiswa nabasebenzi bokuqonda imisebenzi ehlobene nemikhakha yabo ngendlela ecacile. Ukuhlukaniswa kusebenziseka kakhulu emzamweni wokuhlonza izindawo ezihlala inzima, ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi benze izinqumo ezifanele. Izinyathelo Zokuhlukaniswa Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu kuhlukaniswa, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka phakathi ukuqoqa idatha ethile, ukuhlaziya le datha, kanye nokwakha izigaba ezihlukene. Ukuze le nqubo ibe nekhono, kudinga ukuba kuhlolwe futhi kuqondwe izimo ezahlukene zomkhakha, kuhlanganiswe nezinselelo nezinzuzo zokubambisana. Umsebenzi wokuhlola kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izigaba ezingama-GEMS ziyahambisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile zomphakathi, ezokuphepha, kanye nemvelo. Izifundo Nokwenza Ngcono Ngokuhlanza kahle, isifundo esithathiwe kulolu hlobo lwezokuhlukaniswa sikhombisa ukuthi intuthuko yenkampani noma inhlangano ibondla kancane izigaba eziphezulu ezingama-GEMS. Ukuze kufezeke lokhu, kubalulekile ukuphatha ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu, karolo ebaluleke kakhulu empumelelweni yokuhlukaniswa. Izindlela zokusebenza ezilungile kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kudalwe isimo esihambisana nempumelelo, okuholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izifundo Ezivela Kwalolu Hlelo I-GEMS major member classification ikhuluma izaziso eziningi ezizohlonishwa. Ukuhlukanisa izigaba kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise uhlelo lwezokuphatha, kokubili emkhakheni ophakeme nasezinhlelweni eziphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa mayelana nezimo ezithile ezikhona futhi kuhlale kwenziwa izinqumo ezihambisana neemfuno zabantu. Izingcindezi ezivela kwelokuhlalisana koluntu kudinga ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuze kube khona ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile. Imiphumela Yokuhlukaniswa Imiphumela yokuhlukaniswa kwe-GEMS major member classification ibonisa ukuthi ngokwenza izigaba ezihlukanisiwe, izinkampani zingakwenza kube lula ukuhlola izindawo ezinzima, zisize ukuhlonipha imithetho yendawo, futhi zithuthukise ubumba bomphakathi. Lokhu kunciphisa izingozi nezinkinga ezingavela, futhi kuhlinzeka ngendawo ehlelekile yokwazisa ngempumelelo ngakolunye uhlangothi. Isiphetho Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-GEMS major member classification kusemqoka ezinhlelweni zakuqala nezikhandidawayo. Imiphumela yalokhu kuyavuma ukuba kucace izimo ezahlukene emkhakheni, kunciphise izinkinga ezazikhona, futhi kube nemiphumela ehlukahlukene edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinto ezithinta bonke abantu. Kodwa-ke, lo mkhiqizo wobuchwepheshe awukwazi ukwakhiwa ngaphandle kokuba nezinhlangano ezisekela. Omni wokuhlola uhambisana neqembu labantu, umphakathi, kanye nezidingo ezithile zomhlaba, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo emisha. Kulesi sikhathi esibucayi, ukuhlinzeka ngembono engcono kulapho izimo ezisemqoka zikhukhula khona, okungenza izinqumo ezintsha zibe nohlu olusha. Ngakho-ke, le theory yesigaba se-GEMS major member classification iyasiza ekwakheni izinkulumo ezignele nezisizo, ubonisa indlela eqinile yokuthola izixazululo zokuphila okukhululekile kumuntu wonke. Ngalolu hlobo, umphakathi uzuza kakhulu okuwusizo.
Ukuvikelwa Kwezempilo kwe-GEMS Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo sekubalulekile emhlabeni wonke. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezempilo, lapho ulwazi lwezempilo luthinteka kakhulu. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibhekana nezinselelo eziningi ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu. Njengamanje, ubungozi bokwephulwa kolwazi lwezempilo buye bukhula, ngenxa yokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela ziqinise imithetho nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwabantu. I-GEMS ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekwakheni izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwabantu luhlala luvalekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo, i-GEMS isebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuvikela, njengokusebenzisa ama-encryption, izinhlelo zokulandelela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukufinyelela kolwazi. Lezi zindlela zenzelwe ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo ezinsukwini zethu, lapho ubungozi bokwephulwa kolwazi buye bukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibeka phambili ukuqwashisa nokuqeqesha abasebenzi bayo mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangavikela kanjani ulwazi lwezempilo lwabanye, kuhlanganisa ukufundiswa ngezindlela zokuphatha ulwazi, izinqubo zokubika izigameko zokwephulwa kolwazi, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS iphinde ibambisane nezinhlaka ezahlukene, ezifana nohulumeni, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zokubambisana zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuvikela zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubambisana kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinqubo zokuvikela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luvalekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akuyona nje into yokugcina, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqubo zokuvikela kumele zihlale zihlaziywa futhi zithuthukiswe ukuze zikwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. I-GEMS ibheka phambili ekwakheni izinqubo ezizokwazi ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ngenkathi ibheka izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akukhona kuphela ukuvikela ulwazi, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu. Uma abantu beqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo luhlala luvalekile, bazoba nokwazisa okukhulu ngale nhlangano. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuxhumana ngokukhululekile. Ekugcineni, i-GEMS ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akuyona nje imfuneko, kodwa kuyisibopho esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho-ke, i-GEMS izoqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu luhlala luvalekile, futhi izinqubo zokuvikela zihlala ziqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izobheka izindlela ezintsha nezithuthukisiwe zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ukuze ihlale ibhekelele izidingo zabantu.
Le nsizakalo ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungabhalisela ukuba umkhiqizi ngaphansi komthetho kanye nesivumelwano somthetho se-African Growth and Opportunity Act sase-United States of America kanye neSouth African Revenue Service. Umthetho uhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezithile ezizwakalayo ezizweni zase-Afrika ukuze ziqhubeke nomzamo wazo wokuvula umnotho wazo nokwakha emakethe ezikhululekile. Thola ifomu lesicelo ku-inthanethi noma ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-SARS. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liphothulwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processing. Sicela ubheke imihlahlandlela yesicelo ukuze ukukwazi ukusiza enqubweni yokuthola ilayisensi. Bheka umkhiqizi ebhokisini le-AGOA ngaphansi kokubhaliswa. Ikhodi yomgwaqo wesigaba lapho ibhizinisi likhona. Icala lokufaka isicelo kumele liphothulwe ngum owner yebhizinisi oyedwa, umqondisi, umlingani, ilungu, umtrustee, noma umphathi webhizinisi uma ufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa komkhiqizi okhethekile kwe-AGOA ukuze uthole izinkokhelo zokungenisa nezokuphuma. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ehambisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube yilo elivela kulolu hlobo. Lapho kukhona lesi simbolo (), susa okungafanele. Izifinyezo zamagama nesibongo somuntu ofaka isicelo se-layisensi. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Phetha ifomu lesicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-South African Revenue Service Customs and Excise. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento yokuncishiswa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye ne-607.04. Inkampani - bonke abaqondisi, kuhlanganise nomqondisi ongumphathi kanye nomqondisi wezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salensizakalo. Le nsizakalo itholakala mahhala. Uhlobo lweklayenti 4 - Umkhiqizi Ngaphansi kwe-AGOA, DA185. Imininingwane yokuphepha, DA185.
Umkhiqizi uhlanganyela njalo kodwa ngeke umbone esebenzisa umhlaba. Uhlola umhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi kodwa akakaze abeke. Akafiki ekupheleni kwendawo lapho abeka khona zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ezikwi ndawo zayo emasimini. Umkhiqizi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze ukuthini ngoba uNkulunkulu umenze wabona futhi waqonda. UMdali ungumfundisi omuhle onika umkhiqizi ukuhlakanipha. U-Isaya 28:23 - 29? Ukulima kwaba umsebenzi wokuqala emhlabeni futhi kwaba umyalezo ovela kuNkulunkulu. Kubalulekile empilweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi thina njengabakhiqizi sibheke emsebenzini wethu ngamehlo ahlukene futhi sibone ukuthi kubalulekile futhi kuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu. Akukwanele ukuthi siqonde nje ukuthi sidinga ukwenza inzuzo (imali) nokwandisa ukukhiqizwa; kungcono ukucabanga ngokukhiqiza izitshalo nokudla kwekhwalithi okuzohlinzeka abanye ukudla okuzondla imizimba yabo futhi kubasize baphile impilo enhle. Umkhiqizi ungena kanjani emnothweni wezwe? Banikeza kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasebhajethi kazwelonke. Uma abakhiqizi behlangana, bahlinzeka ngemicimbi eminingi kwabantu abaningi ezweni elidinga izindawo zokusebenza ngoba kuneziningi abantu abangenamsebenzi. Abakhiqizi bakha ukudla kwekhwalithi okukhuthazayo futhi kusiza ukuqinisa ukudla kwezwe nakusasa. Ezindaweni eziningi zezwe, abakhiqizi banikeza emnothweni kulo lonke idolobha lapho behlala khona futhi badingeka ngempela empilweni yezezimali yamadolobha asondelene nabo nasemhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi bangabavikeli bomhlaba wethu; bangabasebenzi abakhuthele kakhulu ukuvikela umhlaba, umoya, amanzi, nalapho lezi zinto zihlangana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bangakhiqiza ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Umkhiqizi usebenza kanzima ukuze athole ukudla kwakhe, ukhiqiza ukudla kwabanye, usebenza yedwa ngaphandle kosizo kwabanye, usebenza ngokuzikhandla, usesimweni esiseduze nomhlaba lapho esebenza khona, futhi uhlale ethembekile. Umkhiqizi ukhula (wenza) ufulawa, amabele, noshukela esebenzisa kuphela ukukhanya kwelanga! Ngeshwa, abakhiqizi abaningi, njengamanye amabhizinisi, bazizwa bebuhlungu ngenxa yokwehla okukhulu kwemithombo yezezimali emhlabeni wethu nakwamanye amazwe. Uma sibona ukuthi okwamanje izindleko zokulima ziya zanda njalo futhi amanani okudla akhiqizwayo ekulimaleni ehla, siphinde sibone ukuthi abalimi abaningi bangase bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhokha izikweletu zabo zokulima ngesikhathi. Ngakho-ke, okwamanje kuzoba nzima ukucela imali ukuze isetshenziswe isikhathi eside - lokhu kudala ezinye izinkinga lapho umkhiqizi ezama ukuqhubeka ngebhizinisi lakhe. Kuyiqiniso elidabukisayo, kodwa abakhiqizi bacindezelwa ukuba bacele imali ukuze baqhubeke - ukukhokhela imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ukuze bangenise izitshalo emhlabeni ukuze zikhule. Ngenxa yokungazinzi kwamaholo emakethe nokuhlangana nezinkinga ezihlobene nezingozi zezulu, iqiniso lelo mali elitshalwe alinaso isiqinisekiso. Izinhlangano ezivame ukuhlinzeka abalimi ngemali manje zikhathazekile ukuhlinzeka abalimi ngemali futhi zibamba imali yabo ngokuqinile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sicele uhulumeni ukuthi asekele abakhiqizi ngemali ebolekiwe ngendlela eqinile, enhle, futhi esebenzayo lapho ukudla kukhiqizwa. Amanani emakethe emakethe ayengazinzi - ayanda futhi ehla - lapha sikhuluma ngamanani okudla nezindleko zokukhiqiza ezifana nezithako, imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo emasimini, kubeka umkhiqizi esimweni esinzima sezezimali ngoba akanawo amandla okuphatha izindleko ezibonakalayo nezifihlekile zokudla okukhiqizwayo emasimini. Uma intengo yemakethe yokudla okukhiqizwayo ngumlimi yehlile, ngeke uyibone lokhu ezitolo - lokhu kukhuphula ukungabaza ukuthi kuphela abathengi bokudla nabanye abazuza, hhayi abakhiqizi nabathengi bokudla. Lokhu kuzothinta kanjani abantu baseNingizimu Afrika? Uma abakhiqizi behluleka amabhizinisi abo nezindlu futhi abakhiqizi abasha behluleka ukungena kulomsebenzi, kuzoba nomthelela omubi kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Abakhiqizi bangumgogodla wesizwe sethu futhi bangesinyathelo sokuqala ekukhuleni kwezezimali. Uma amabhizinisi okulima ehla, amabhizinisi amakhulu nawo azohla. Lokhu kuphikisana nakho kuyasebenza - uma amabhizinisi okulima akhula, amabhizinisi amakhulu akhula, futhi izindawo ezinezamabhizinisi zikhula. Abakhiqizi ngempela bakha ingcebo, inani langempela ngokusebenzisa imbewu nokukhanya kwelanga futhi basilethela izinto ezondla imizimba yethu (ukudla) nezempilo yethu kwezezimali. Le ndlu yemindeni yokulima ibalulekile uma sifuna izwe eliqinile elikhulayo. Uma silahlekelwa ngumkhiqizi oyedwa noma senze kube nzima kulabo abasha ekulimaleni, noma singasekeli labo abasanda kuqala ukulima, sithumele imvelo yethu, ukuphepha kwezwe lethu, nezimo zethu zezezimali engcupheni.
Mnumzane Ohloniphekile, uMeya weGu District, uNgqongqoshe S. Mphathi, umnyango wami ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwekhaya nokulethwa kokuthuthukiswa ezweni. Yingakho noma kuphi sihamba khona, sikhombisa ukuthi "umuntu ungumuntu ngenxa yekhaya." Ikhaya lingachazwa njengesisekelo somuntu wonke. Ikhaya yindawo lapho izingane zikhuliswa khona ngokuphepha, zithola zonke izinto ezidingekayo ezizovumela ukuba zakhe izwe lesikhathi esizayo. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubalulekile phakathi kwekhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nezwe elinempilo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma singakheki izindlu, asizukuba nezwe. Kukho okuningi okwakha ikhaya, kodwa iphuzu lokuqala lokwakha ikhaya "yindlu." Ubuqotho bomuntu kanye nazo zonke izinto azidingayo ukuze aphumelele buphazamiseka kakhulu uma engenayo indlu yokuhlala ngaphansi. UManzankosi uhlolile izinga lokushoda kwezindlu emindenini ukuze kuncishiswe ngokushesha ubuphakathi bezindlu kule ndawo. Ngemva kokubuyekeza imiphumela, kwavela ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi okufanele wenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bethu babe nezindawo abangazibiza ngekhaya futhi baphile izimpilo ezingcono. Thina, njengohulumeni onothando, sathatha isinqumo sokusebenza kanzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izindlu, okuyilungelo labo ngokomthethosisekelo. Ngamanye amazwi, lo mnyango uzinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo enobuqotho yokuhlala, kungakhathaliseki ngesimo sabo somnotho. Leli lungelo liphakathi kwabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala emadolobheni noma ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi kule ndawo, sinezinkulungwane zabantu abahluphekayo. Kukhona inani eliphezulu labantu abangenamsebenzi kule ndawo, futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu bethu akukabhekiwe. Ukuphazamiseka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo kukhombisa kahle ukunganaki kukahulumeni we-apartheid, owangazange unake ukuphuculwa kwezimpilo zabantu bethu lapha. Akumangalisi ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinga elingu-61% labantu abangenamsebenzi. Ngisho nalabo esithi bayasebenza bathola imali encane kakhulu. R800.00 ngenyanga. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi lo mphakathi udinga usizo lukahulumeni ngezindlu nokuthuthukiswa kwezinye izinsiza, ngoba uma kungenjalo, ngeke bakwazi ukuzisiza ngenxa yesimo sabo somnotho esiphansi. Njengoba ngishilo, konke kuqala ngekhaya. Nakuba umcimbi wethu ungase ungahlangene ngqo nokwethulwa kwezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kufanele ngikhulume ngalokho okubalulekile ukwenza ikhaya libe nolwazi futhi lizinze ezimpilweni zabantu. Enye yezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi kule ndawo wamanzi. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zalokhu, kuhlanganise nezomiso ezivame ukuhlasela le ndawo. Kodwa kuze kube namuhla, uhulumeni wethu usebenza noMkhandlu weGu ukuze kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu lapha banokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile. Umnqopho wethu njengohulumeni uwukuthi wonke umuntu abe nendawo ephephile yokuhlala. Njengohulumeni, sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sakhe izindlu zabantu bethu ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuzigqaja ngokuba nezindlu ezisemqoka futhi babuyisele ubuqotho babo. Umsebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uhlanganisa nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuhambisana kahle nenhloso kahulumeni yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Inani labantu abadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kule ndawo liphansi kakhulu, liphakathi kuka-73% wezindlu zonke lapha. Njengoba ngichazile, ikhaya kumele libe nolwazi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kubeka ezimpilweni zabantu engcupheni futhi kunciphisa ubuqotho babantu bethu. Ngalesi sizathu, sithathe izinyathelo ezibanzi ukusiza wonke amakhaya ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ngokushesha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisa izindlu, amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka eziphephile. Njengoba sifeza lo msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu lapha, lo msebenzi uzophinde ube nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Siyajabula ukubona ukuthi uMkhandlu weGu usuhambe phambili ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela komphakathi ezinsizeni zokuhlanzeka ezifanele. R4.6 million ukusiza umphakathi wethu lapha eZinqoleni ukuze uthole izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. Njengomphakathi, kuyajabulisa ukubona isivinini sokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa sikhula ngoba abantu bethu baphinde balinde lezi zinto isikhathi eside. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, enye inselelo esibhekene nayo ekushiseni izindlu wukuntuleka kukagesi. Ngizokhuluma kancane ngalokhu ngoba umsebenzi usuqalile. Sineziindlu eziyi-1789 esidinga ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kulo nyaka njengengxenye yomkhankaso wethu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani wonke umuntu unogesi ngonyaka ka-2012. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, simi lapha namuhla ngenjabulo enkulu. Siyajabula ngoba imindeni eyayingenazo izindlu izothola izindlu ezakhiwe ngazo namuhla. Namuhla le miphakathi izothola izinzuzo zedemokhrasi njengoba siqala uhlelo lokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu kule ndawo. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu lapha kusho ukuthi izingane zethu zizokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wesikole endaweni ephephile nephucukile, okuzothuthukisa nezinga lokusebenza kwazo. Impela, manje singasho ngokuzethemba ukuthi impilo engcono ifikile lapha eZinqoleni. Thina, njengomnyango wezindlu, sikholwa ukuthi ukwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kufanele kusebenzele wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya noma emadolobheni. Sikholwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, nogesi. Indlu inika umuntu ubuqotho, iyindawo abizwa ngayo ngekhaya, indawo yokuphepha, futhi imnika ubunikazi. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, oNgqongqoshe, kanye noBuholi Bendabuko, ikhaya yindawo esivela kuyo, lapho sisebenza khona, futhi lapho sibuyela khona ntambama. Izindlela ezivela ezindlini zixhumanisa nathi ezindaweni eziningi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zokuthenga, lapho sisebenza khona, emithini, nakwezinye izinsiza esizidingayo. Ngibone ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinkinga zokulungiswa kwezindlela, ikakhulukazi eziholela ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko. Ohlelweni lomnyango wethu lokwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko, ngishilo ukuthi kumele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi komkhandlu nezindlu zabaholi bethu bendabuko. Abaholi bendabuko babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kubantu babo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uma lezi zindlu seziqediwe, akukho okuzosivimbela ekuletheni ukuthuthukiswa ngoba wonke umuntu uzoba yingxenye yezakhiwo zikahulumeni zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa kubantu. Njengoba ngichazile ngenkathi ngethula inkulumo yami, izikhumbuzo zethu zigcizelela ikhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nezwe. Ngichazile ukuthi indlu iyisisekelo sokwakha
I-Load Shedding Nomthelela Wayo Emnothweni I-Load shedding, noma ukuhoxiswa kukagesi, yinto esiyaziyo kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Le nqubo, eyenzeka lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokukhiqiza ugesi, ibonakala njengomphumela wokungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wayo emnothweni, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezithile zomlando ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, i-Escom, okuyinkampani eyinhloko yokusabalalisa ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, yathola ukuthi izinsiza zayo zokukhiqiza ugesi ziqhubeka zincipha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwaholela ekutheni kube nezikhathi zokuhoxiswa kukagesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umnotho wawusakhula, kodwa izinkampani eziningi zathola ukuthi zikhungathekile ngenxa yokungabi nokwaneliseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Load shedding yaba yinto evamile, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweminyaka ye-2015 kuya ku-2020. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehliseni ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, okwakuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo ezinkampanini. Izinkampani ezincane, ikakhulukazi, zathinteka kakhulu, njengoba zazingakwazi ukukhokhela izinkonzo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezinzima. Lokhu kwagcina kuholela ekwandeni kwenani labantu abangasebenzi, okwakukhathaza kakhulu uhulumeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi i-load shedding ayisiyona nje inkinga yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kodwa futhi ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima zempilo yomnotho. Izimboni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezincike kakhulu kumshini, zathola ukuthi zidinga ukwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko, njengoba izinkampani zazingakwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela we-load shedding wawungaphezu kwezomnotho kuphela. Umphakathi waba nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila, njengoba abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Izikole, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zokusebenza zaphinde zathinteka, okwakwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuhamba phambili empilweni yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka emphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni uqala ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuphendula kulolu hlobo lwesimo. Kwakukhona imizamo yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi, ngokwakha iziteshi ezintsha zokukhiqiza ugesi. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zathatha isikhathi, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka ubhekana nezinkinga zokuhoxiswa kukagesi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlakaniphile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa amandla elanga, zathuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizimele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwakusiza abantu ukuba baphile ngaphandle kokuncika kuphela kumphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esihle, kodwa umphakathi wawusadinga isikhathi ukuze ubuyisele emuva umnotho. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda ngezifundo ezitholakele. I-load shedding yakhombisa ukuthi umnotho awungaphumeleli uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baziqhenye ngezindlela zokuphila ezihlakaniphile, futhi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuba nezinhlelo ezizinzile zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokwenza izinyathelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ubhekane ne-load shedding. Kukhona ukuzimisela okukhulu phakathi kwabantu, okukhombisa ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, umphakathi unamandla okuphendula. Umnotho, nakuba ubhekene nezinkinga, uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokufuna izixazululo ezihlakaniphile. Ngakho-ke, i-load shedding ibonisa ukuthi umnotho awukwazi ukuhamba phambili uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. Kodwa futhi ibonisa amandla abantu, ukuthi bangakwazi ukuphendula ezinkingeni, futhi baphile kahle, naphezu kwezithiyo ezibhekene nabo. Lokhu kwenza umphakathi uqhubeke nokukhula, futhi ubheke phambili, ungavumeli izinkinga ziwuphazamise. I-Load shedding, nakuba iyinkinga enkulu, iyisifundo esibalulekile kumphakathi, esifundisa ukubaluleka kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, nokuthi umphakathi unamandla okuphendula ezinkingeni.
Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 mayelana nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi uhlanganise incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo wokusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo kuMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izivumelwano zomgwaqo nezokuhamba ngezitimela; ukuhlela inqubo mayelana nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umbuso ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela kumathuluzi omgwaqo asetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kumiswa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambukiswa kwawo okwethenjelwe. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okukhishwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda okukhona, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwe, ngokuhambisana nebhuku elibhalwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kuhlanganise nezincomo mayelana nomgwaqo, bese uMEC kufanele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba. Ngaphambi kokuthatha umgwaqo noma umgwaqo oguquliwe, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umbuso owaziwe ngomsebenzi esigabeni 22 se-ECA, noma umbuso obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, ungathola. kanye nokumemezela kwezinyathelo zokulawula eziqala ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 11. UMEC kufanele axhumane nayo yonke imiphakathi lapho umgwaqo uzoba khona futhi acela, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe, ukuthi bathumele imibono ebhaliwe ngombiko wokuqala womgwaqo nendawo ekhombisa umthelela umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe ozoba nawo kunoma iyiphi ifreyimu noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi oluhlelwe kahle lwezindawo ezithintekayo. a ibhekisela kumgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela; noma b ngokufaka izigaba 6 kuya ku-9, thumela udaba noma izinkinga ezivela emibikweni ethile noma imibono kwiKomishini ukuze kwenziwe ukuxoxisana komphakathi okunikeza izeluleko ngalokho okukhuluma ngqo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe nguMEC futhi, emva kokucabangela lezi zincomo, kumemeze umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela. h umuntu angaba yisikhumbuzo esinokufaneleka okufanele kube omunye walabo abakhuluma ngezikhala a kuya ku-g; futhi i isikhumbuzo kanye namalungu amane kufanele akhe i-quorum ngenjongo yokusebenza kweKomishini. e usuku nendawo yalokho kuxoxisana komphakathi; futhi f ukumemezela kwezinyathelo zokulawula eziqala ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 12. futhi b phatha ukuxoxisana ngokuhambisana nenqubo echazwe. Ngemuva kokwenza ukuxoxisana, iKomishini kufanele ihlanganise umbiko obhaliwe wokuxoxisana, ibhekisela, uma kusebenza, ezinqubweni zepolitiki ezichazwe esigabeni 3 se-Development Facilitation Act, 1995 Umthetho No. 67 ka-1995 nasezinhlelweni zokuhlela zesifunda. UMEC, ngokuxhumana nelungu leBhodi yezeMisebenzi elibhekelele ukuhlela ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ukumemezela komgwaqo ngaphansi kwesigaba 5a noma b kuhambisana kangangokuthi kungenzeka nanoma iyiphi ifreyimu noma enye uhlelo lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kwesifunda olwenziwe ngaphansi komthetho wokuhlela wesifunda. isaziso sokuthi izizathu zisenzo sikaMEC mayelana nokuthathwa komgwaqo zingacelwa ezindabeni ezithintekayo nezithintekayo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwesaziso. Ngokusho kwesigaba 82, umgwaqo noma isigaba singashintshwa kuphela nguMEC ngemva kokuhlanganisa izinqubo ezichazwe ezigabeni 81 kuya ku-8 futhi izinguquko zomgwaqo kufanele zikhishwe esigabeni 11. Isigaba 7 soMthetho oyinhloko sishintshwa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". a ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 1 noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 611". b ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 2 noma kuphi lapho amagama "isigaba 611" futhi ukufaka amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "61 kuya ku-11". a umbiko wendawo obhekiswe esigabeni 4b noma isigaba 63a, uma kusebenza; futhi f ngokufaka esigabeni 8 amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "isigaba 611." Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko sishintshwa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". f ukuhlanganiswa kohlelo lwezitimela, umgwaqo wezitimela nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo zezikhumulo zezindiza, kanye nendawo ezungezile yomphakathi nezinye izinsiza zokuhamba. UMEC unamandla, ngaphandle kokulimaza eminye imithetho, ukuhamba noma ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba, lokho akwenza egameni lezinye izinhlangothi noma eziningi zalabo abathintekayo esivumelwaneni esishiwo esigabeni 1, noma noma ilungelo lokuhamba emhlabeni womunye noma elinye ilungelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi libhalisiwe noma alibhaliswanga, kodwa ezandleni zikaMEC noma zePhondo, ngenjongo noma mayelana nanoma yisiphi isivumelwano njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 nangokuhambisana nesikhathi salo sivumelwano.
Umgwaqo ohlanganisa indlu onamathuluzi avulekile angcono kunezindonga eziphakeme ngoba umgwaqo uyabonakala. Ucingo lokusika, ucingo olunemibimbi, izinkomishi ezingenalutho noma amahhashi angaxhunywa emgwaqweni ukuze kubonakale ngokushesha uma kukhona umgibeli. Khumbula ukuthi iminyango kufanele ihlale ivaliwe. Izing doors zokuphepha emnyango ngamunye kufanele zibe nezivalo eziqinile phambi kwawo wonke umnyango kanye nasezindongeni, nezinsiza zokuvimbela ukungena. Izing doors zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. I-door yokuphepha ngaphakathi kwendlu ehlukanisa indawo yokulala nezinye izingxenye zendlu ingasiza kakhulu uma kukhona abavakashi bendlu. Kungaba kuhle futhi uma indlela yokuxhumana yokuphuthumayo ingafakwa kule ndlu. Izikhali kufanele zihlale zitholakala kalula futhi, uma kungenzeka, zigcinwe kumuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhali zihlale zigcinwa kahle futhi ukuthi umuntu ozisebenzisayo uqeqeshwe ukuze azisebenzise. Umsindo we-alamu ophakeme ophakeme phezulu kwendlu onezindawo lapho ungafaka khona ngaphakathi kwendlu ungatholakala kude uma ezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ziqhume. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinto zihlale zihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zingatholakala noma uma umuntu ekude nendlu. Izinja nezinkunzi ziwusizo kakhulu ekwaziseni uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Lezi zinyoni kufanele zigcinwe eduze kwendlu ukuze izivakashi ezingaziwa zingakwazi ukufika kalula. Abantu abangaziwa endaweni, bephuma bengenhla, kungenzeka bangabonakali kulokho abakwenzenayo. Izimoto ezingaziwa ezihamba emgwaqweni wezolimo kwesinye isikhathi zihlala endaweni. Qaphela amawheels ongawazi. Izinguquko endleleni umqashi enza izinto. Ukuthenga noma ukusebenzisa kakhulu ukudla ngasohlangothini lwabasebenzi. Izinguquko ekuziphatheni kwabasebenzi abadala ngemva kokuba beqashwe emsebenzini omusha. Ukufa kwekhaya lezinja ngendlela engacacile. Hlala uqaphele izimpawu zabantu abangaziwa abafika endaweni, njengezimbiza noma izinkomishi ezingenalutho, amaqanda, izicubu zephepha, izingubo ezikhaliphile, izinyathelo noma izicathulo, indawo esanda kuphazamiseka, izikhwama zokudla, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Ukuhlukumeza kokudla, uphethiloli, izinkomo, nezilwane. Abantu abangaziwa befika endaweni yakho bephakamisa izizathu ezivumayo kodwa kungenzeka babephakathi. Sebenzisa amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa abafika epulazini noma bevakashela abasebenzi kufanele bathole imvume yakho kuqala. Xhumana nezomthetho zendawo ukuze uthole ukuthi yini ongenza ngayo ngokomthetho nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani lokho epulazini lakho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bakho. Gcina amakhophi wezikhwama zabasebenzi bonke. Khuthaza bonke abasebenzi ukuba bahlale beqaphele ngokuphepha futhi babike noma iyiphi imisebenzi ephawulekayo. Khokha abasebenzi bakho ngazo zonke izinzuzo zabo futhi ubagcine bekwazisa. Ungavumeli muntu ukuba angene endaweni yakho noma epulazini ngaphandle kokubona kahle ukuthi bangobani, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Zonke amathuluzi angasetshenziswa njengezikhali kufanele zihlale zivalwe lapho engasetshenziswa. Uma uhambe endlini, yenza kube isiko ukusazisa umndeni wakho ukuthi uhamba kuphi, indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuyela nini. Hlala uhlole njalo ukuthi ifoni yakho iyasebenza. Beka ifoni endaweni elula ukufinyelela kuyo endlini, futhi kude nezindawo ezingashotwa kalula noma amawindi. Qaphela ngama-keys ukuze angacwengeki. Hlala unomoya eduze futhi uma uyisebenzisa, ungavezi ukuthi ungubani noma ukuthi uphi. Qaphela ukuthi uphethiloli nezimpahla zingaba nezinsongo. Ungahlali wenza izinto ngendlela efanayo nsuku zonke. Thuthukisa isiko lokungaphumuli endaweni ebonakalayo kumuntu ophumayo. Ungamile eduze kwamawindi uma uvula noma uvalela ama-curtains. Hamba ne-curtain ukuze ungabonakali kalula ngaphandle. Thatha izithombe nezinyathelo zabasebenzi bonke. Ngisho noma ungakwazi ukwenza lutho, kungaba yingozi. Ukuzijwayeza njalo izikhali zokudubula epulazini (endaweni ephephile) nakho kusiza ukuhlinzeka nokuvimbela izinsongo ezingaba khona. Fundisa izingane zakho indlela efanele yokuphendula uma zicela usizo futhi zigweme ukukhuluma nabantu abangaziwa noma ukuthola izipho kubantu abangaziwa. Cabanga - ungaphazamiseki. Ukungabonakali kahle kuyindlela yakho yokuqala yokuvikela. Hlola isimo - ingabe kukhona othile eduze? Khala phezulu? Uyalelwa ukuba ungabhekani nomgibeli ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi ungaphuma ngaleso sikhathi. Uma ubhekana ngaphandle kokucabanga, ungaboshwa. Phula umgibeli. Sebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela kuze kube yilapho ungathola usizo noma uphume. Uma ungakwazi ukubhekana, qaphela izimpawu zokuhlonza. Qaphela iminyaka yabo, ukuphakama, umbala wezinwele, izilonda, izingubo, ukukhuluma, nezindlela. Zama ukushiya ubufakazi obuningi ngangokunokwenzeka mayelana nendawo okwenzeka kuyo. Izinyathelo, izinyathelo, nezinto ezingasiza ukuhlole ukuthi ungubani kamuva. Abantu abahlukunyezwayo baphume ngempumelelo ngokuxhumana kahle nabagibeli babo (ukukhuluma ngokwakho).
Ukuhlela kabusha umthetho wezwe wezemigwaqo ukuze kuqondiswe amagama futhi kuhlelwe kabusha incazelo ethile ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi olungafakwa ezinhlinzweni ezitholakala kumgomo wezwe wezemigwaqo; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lokuhlela; ukunciphisa inani lezinqubo ezidingekayo ngumthetho; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukukhetha iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhamba eziboardini ezifanele; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezokuhamba lwezwe kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezokuhamba zamaphondo; ukususa izimo eziphathelene nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi zamanje; izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngemicabango ethile nezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe; ukwengeza izikhathi ezithile; ukuhlinzeka ngamacategori amasha ezimoto angasetshenziswa ezinsizeni zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukwengeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemvume yokusebenza, ukwengeza imisebenzi yeziphathimandla zokulawula ukusebenzisa izimvume; ukujula ezimotweni ezingasetshenziswa ohambweni olude; ukuhlinzeka ngoshintsho lwezimvume zokusebenza; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukusetha izindinganiso zamamitha ezitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha nokuvumela amaMEC ukuthola izakhiwo zokukhokha izitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha, ukudala izimo zokwabelana ngemvume yokusebenza kwezinsizakalo zabavakashi; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yesikhashana yezimoto ezithile; ukudala amacala amasha; nokwenza izinguquko kumadokhumenti; ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. "Ibhasi" lisho imoto eyakhelwe, noma eyakhelwe ngokomthetho ukuze ifanele, ngumkhiqizi obhalisiwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1989 Umthetho No. 29 ka-1989; "Umimporter" ubonisa umuntu obhalisiwe ukuze athumele ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Umkhiqizi" ubonisa umkhiqizi [umimporter noma umakhi wezimoto] obhalisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Izinsuku ezihlosiwe" zokuhlela kabusha ikilasi lezimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi. "Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithuthi nokusetshenziswa kwelizwe ngaphakathi komqondo weMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezokuhamba ka-1995 Umthetho No. 67 ka-1995 noma noma yimuphi umthetho wesifunda ofana nalokhu. "Usuku lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe zeqembu elithintekayo esigabeni 1(c) kuya (g) kumele lixhunywe kumgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda futhi kumele uvunywe ngamaMEC." Okuqukethwe kwemigomo nezinhlelo ezithintekayo esigabeni (c) kuya (g) kumele, njengoba kudingwa yile mthetho, kodwa uNgqongqoshe angase, ngokuxhumana noMEC ofanele noma amaMEC, ahambise izidingo zalezi zinhlelo, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezindawo zasemaphandleni ezindaweni ezithile. Iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezisungulwe nguMEC ukuze zenze lokhu kumele zihlomule ngezinhlelo zokuhamba ezifanele kubhodi futhi zenze iziphakamiso kulowo bhodi mayelana nokuhlela kabusha izimvume zokusebenza, njengoba kudingwa nguSigaba 9.; nokususa isigaba 6. (a) UNgqongqoshe kumele, minyaka yonke ngosuku oluzokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxhumana noMEC, azise umphakathi kuGazethi yoHulumeni, ukuze ahlele kabusha umgomo wezokuhamba komphakathi wesizwe isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu ehambisana nesikhathi semali seminyaka emihlanu soMnyango, ngokuhambisana nesigaba (b). UNgqongqoshe kumele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethuthukisiwe kumgomo wezokuhamba komphakathi wesizwe njalo eminyakeni emibili. I-MEC ngayinye kumele [minyaka yonke] ihlele kabusha umgomo wezokuhamba komphakathi wesifunda isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxhumana nazo zonke amaMEC futhi kumele kushicilelwe njengesaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni ngosuku olusethwe nguNgqongqoshe. I-MEC okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni (a) kumele, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 211(b), ihlele kabusha imininingwane kumgomo wezokuhamba komhlaba okungenani njalo eminyakeni emibili. Uma uhlela kabusha umgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda, i-MEC kumele ihambisane nomgomo wezokuhamba wesizwe."; nokufaka isigaba 3 ngemuva kwesigaba g esigabeni elandelayo: "gA ukusungula umgomo wokuphatha izidingo zokuhamba esifundeni;". ukufaka esigabeni elandelayo: "Iziphathimandla zokuhamba, zamadolobha amakhulu nezinye izindawo ezidingwa nguMEC ukuze zenze lokhu, kumele zilungise futhi zifake kumMEC minyaka yonke ngosuku olusethwe nguMEC, izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe ezihlobene nezindawo zazo isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lwemali." b izimiso nezinhlelo zesifunda mayelana nezokuhamba ngokuhlanganisa imingcele yezindawo zeziphathimandla zokuhlela, c ukuhlanganisa izifunda d nanoma iyiphi indaba esekelwe ezimweni ngaphakathi kwemithetho yesifunda efanele. Umuntu akavunyelwe ukuhambisa izinto eziyingozi ezikhulunywa esigabeni 21 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinto Eziyingozi, 1973 Umthetho No. 15 ka-1973, ngaphakathi kweziphathimandla zokuhlela, ngaphandle [kwendlela etholelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba h so sub-section 2, lapho le ndlela itholiwe futhi yakhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 291 futhi noma yimuphi umuntu owenza njalo ubopheleke] indlela evinjelwe ekhombisa kuhlelo lokuhamba oluhlanganisiwe olukhulunywa esigabeni 291, oluhambisana nomgomo noma uhlelo olujwayelekile olukhulunywa esigabeni 223l. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma engahambisani nesigaba 5 ubopheleke. Kuze kube isikhathi lapho izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi zibuyiselwa ezweni ziye kwenye ikilasi likahulumeni, umgomo nezinhlelo ezikhulunywa esigabeni 19 (b) [ku] kanye (g), ngokuhambisana, kumele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kuvunywe umgomo nezinhlelo zezithuthi zokuhamba zomphakathi, ngendlela efanele futhi ethile. Ngemuva kokuvunywa komgomo wezokuhamba komhlaba, umgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda, uhlelo lokuhamba komphakathi noma uhlelo lokuhamba oluhlanganisiwe, uNgqongqoshe noma iziphathimandla ezifanele, njengoba kudingeka, kumele kushicilelwe kuGazethi yeSifunda, noma mayelana nomgomo wezokuhamba komhlaba, kuGazethi yoHulumeni imininingwane ethile yalezi zinhlelo, okumele ifake imininingwane yezindlela zokuthola izimvume ngaphansi kwesigaba 27 (h) 27. b ukufaka esigabeni 2 so sub-section d yesigaba elandelayo: "d akukho okumele kwenziwe okuzoholela ekunciphiseni kwenani noma ukufinyeleleka kwezinsiza noma izinsizakalo
Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kumele liphathwe kahle. Ukuba nezicwangciso ezicacile kubalulekile ngoba ziyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zokuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kahle kusho ukuthi imisebenzi emine yokuphatha ibhalwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka nokukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lifinyelela ezinjongo ezifunwayo futhi lenze inzuzo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha ibandakanya: ukuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa isu, ukufaka isu emsebenzini, nokuhlola njalo ukusebenza (ukugcina ukulawula). Ukuhlela isu kuyisabelo esibalulekile kumkhiqizi ngoba kuyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zabo zokulima. Singathi ukuhlela isu kuzokhombisa indlela phambili nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni zakho zokuhlanganisa lezi zenzo. Njalo sithi asikwazi ukuhlela izicwangciso ezicacile zokulima. Izizathu zalokhu zimi kanje: kunezinto eziningi ezingalawulwa, ezifana nezimo zezulu, izifo, ukuguquguquka kwemakethe, nezinguquko ezintengo zezimali nezokukhiqiza. Lezi zingozi zingavela ekulimaleni; zikhona, futhi sibhekana nazo lapho sizama ukwakha ibhizinisi lokulima. Nokho, siphinde sisho ukuthi isu elingaphelele lingcono kunokungabi naso nhlobo. Kungcono ukuhlela izicwangciso mayelana nonyaka ojwayelekile, bese sikwazi ukuhlela lezi zicwangciso uma izimo zishintsha phakathi kwalonyaka. Yini okufanele kwenzeke? Kuphi okufanele kwenzeke? Nini okufanele kwenzeke? Malini okufanele kwenzeke? Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhalwe phansi futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho. Ungabhalela izicwangciso zakho encwadini, ebhodini, noma kukhompyutha, noma kuphi. Ngokwandisa ukubhalwa, lokhu kuzokusiza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba uzoba nedatha yomlando yokukusiza uma ubheka phambili. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlela isu kwenzeka minyaka yonke - kuzokwenzeka ini ngonyaka ozayo epulazini. Kodwa kufanele kube nesu lesikhathi eside elibheka ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini epulazini esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyisu elibanzi elikhombisa ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini esikhathini esizayo - leli thuba lingaba yiminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphezulu. Isibonelo: ukutshala izitshalo ezikhiqizayo kumahhektare angama-500, ukukhiqiza inyama emapulazini, nokukhulisa izinkukhu. Lokhu kuzokhombisa imisebenzi ejwayelekile okufanele yenziwe ngonyaka ozayo, njengokupenda indlu ethile, ukwakha ucingo oluthile, ukulungisa izakhiwo, ukuthenga imishini emisha, ukuya ezinsukwini zokuqeqesha abalimi, njll. Kuzokhiqizwa ini ngonyaka ozayo, malini kuzokhiqizwa, futhi kuzothengiswa kanjani? Tshalani amahektare angama-400 ommbila ukuze asetshenziswe epulazini, okusele kuzothengiswa ngenkontileka endaweni eseduze ekhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane. Tshalani amahektare angama-100 amabhontshisi ukuze athengiswe ngenkontileka. Khiqiza izinkomo ezingu-200 ezineminyaka engama-20 ezivela emapulazini ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza izinkukhu ezingu-40,000 zenyama ngenyanga ezizothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed. Wakha idamu endaweni enamahektare angama-9. Lungisa futhi uphathe zonke izakhiwo. Ngokusebenzisa isu lonyaka - elijwayelekile futhi elibheke ukukhiqiza - isu lwenyanga lungathuthukiswa. Ngokuvamile - penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed. Isu lokukhiqiza - ummbila: hlola zonke izinkambu; amabhontshisi: thina amahektare angama-100. Izinkomo - nikeza ukudla kwentwasahlobo kuzo zonke izilwane, nikeza izinkomo ezincane izithako, susa izinkomo ezindala, hlola isisindo sazo, uzibhalise, phatha izinkomo ezincane ngemithi, qapha isisindo sezo zonke izilwane. Izinkukhu - yenza zonke izinkonzo zansuku zonke, thengisa ezindlini ezimbili, lungisa izindlu ezintathu zezinhlobo ezintsha. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, izicwangciso zamasonto zingathuthukiswa zalesi sikhathi. Isisekelo sezicwangciso zamasonto yizicwangciso zenyanga, izicwangciso ezivamile, nezicwangciso zokukhiqiza. Isu sokugcina singaba isu lwenyanga elenziwa ekupheleni kwesonto elidlule elichaza kahle konke okufanele kwenziwe esontweni elizayo. Isibonelo: Isonto lesi-9 - Meyi 13, 2011. (Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalesi sikhathi zixubene kuTebula 1). Susa izinkomo ezingu-100 emapulazini, uzibhalise, phatha ngemithi, qapha isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi izicwangciso azikwazi ukuhlala ziqinile, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini zokulima epulazini. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezingalindelekile ezingavela, ezifana nezikhukhula ezinkambu, ukuwa kwezakhiwo, izifo ezilwaneni, njll. Ukuhlela isu kuyisabelo sokuphatha ngoba kuyisisekelo sokuphatha nokufaka emsebenzini okuzoxoxwa ngakho embhalweni olandelayo. Ngaphandle kokuhlela isu, akukwazi ukuba khona ukuphathwa okusebenzayo ngoba izicwangciso ziyi sabelo sokuqala sokuphatha; ngezicwangciso, singaphatha umsebenzi kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa, ukufaka emsebenzini, nokulawula okuqinile, umphathi kumele abe nesibindi ekwenzeni eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuhlela, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bakhe, ukubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze kahle, ukubanika amandla, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha ngokuqinile. Ukunakwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi.
Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo (GEMS health facility coordination) Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo, owaziwa njenge-GEMS health facility coordination, wabanjwa eGoli. Lo mcimbi, obuhlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo ezahlukene, uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo ebanzi mayelana nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo, ukuxhumana phakathi kwazo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo kubantu. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile kaNgqongqoshe wezempilo, uDkt. Sipho Mthembu, owakhuluma ngokuqakatheka kokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo. Uthe, "Ukuhlanganiswa kwethu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza, futhi kuzokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude." Lokhu kukhombisa umgomo omkhulu walomcimbi, okungukuthi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo oludingekayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, abahlanganyeli bahlala ezinkundleni ezihlukene ukuze baxoxe ngezihloko ezithile. Kukhona izinkulumo ezithokozisayo eziphathelene nezindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zezempilo, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokuphucula izinqubo zokusebenza. Abaholi bezikhungo zezempilo baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokwabelana ngempumelelo yabo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokwelapha, izindlela zokuphatha iziguli, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nezingxoxo ezibucayi phakathi kwabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abamele izikhungo zezempilo, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Lezi zingxoxo zakhuthaza ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwezikhungo, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Abahlanganyeli baphinde bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule ezinkingeni ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo zabo, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezingxoxo ezimnandi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwakwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlanganyela izinsiza. Abahlanganyeli baphinde banikwe ithuba lokubona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana nezinsizakalo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abahlanganyeli baphuma bejabule, bephuma nemibono emisha yokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wagcizelela ukuthi, "Umsebenzi wethu awupheli lapha. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzoba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezempilo." Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nolwazi. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi we-GEMS health facility coordination ubonise ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezempilo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zethu zisebenza ngokubambisana, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo, futhi umcimbi we-GEMS health facility coordination uzoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sibambisene, singakwazi ukufezekisa izinto ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthola usizo lwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi, ngokuhlanganyela, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nolwazi.
Izincwadi Zabasebenzi Abasha (GEMS New Employee Letters) Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha, eziyaziwa nangokuthi ama-GEMS new employee letters, zibalulekile ekwakheni umbono omuhle wokwamukela abasebenzi abasha emsebenzini. Lezi zincwadi ziwusizo ngoba zikhombisa indlela inkampani ebheka ngayo abasebenzi bayo, ikakhulukazi labo abasha, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi baqonda izinqubo, izimiso, nezidingo zomsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zincwadi zibhale ngendlela ecacile futhi enobungane ukuze abasebenzi abasha bazizwe bemukelekile futhi bejabulile ngokungena kwabo enkampanini. Izincwadi kufanele ziqale ngokubingelela okuhle, zikhombise ukwazisa nokuhlonipha umkhiqizo omusha ozojoyina ithimba. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, okwenza kube lula kubasebenzi abasha ukujwayela indawo entsha. Ngemuva kokubingelela, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsuku zokuqala zomsebenzi, izinqubo zokufika, kanye nezidingo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuzobasiza baqonde kahle lokho okulindelekile, futhi bazokwazi ukuhlela izinsuku zabo zokuqala ngokufanele. Izincwadi kufanele ziqukathe nezincomo ezicacile ngezinsuku zokuhlangana, izifundo ezizobanjwa, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kube lula kubo ukujwayela indawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zikhulume ngamasiko enkampani, izimiso, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi abasha baqonde isiko lenkampani, futhi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibekwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi, izifundo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana nabaphathi, kuzobasiza ukuhlela ikusasa labo enkampanini. Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele futhi zibe nezixhumanisi ezibalulekile, ezifana nezinsiza zokuxhumana, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze bahlale bexhumene nethimba labo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Ekugcineni, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele ziqedele ngombhalo ohehayo, ohlanganisa izifiso ezinhle zokuphumelela emsebenzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzi abasha bazizwe bejabulile futhi bephakanyisiwe, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili ngokuzethemba. Ukubhalwa kwezincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele kube yisibonelo sokuhlonipha, ukwamukela, nokukhuthaza, ukuze kube nesithombe esihle sokusebenza enkampanini. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zincwadi zibhale ngendlela efanele, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi abasha bahlala bejabulile futhi bephakanyisiwe emsebenzini.
Ezinsukwini ezindala, ngaphambi kokuthi ukulima kube yinto ethokozisayo futhi enenzuzo, abalimi babengekho kakhulu ekukaleni. Babesebenzisa umquba otholakalayo emapulazini abo - bephonsa umquba okhona ngaphambi kokuvuna. Babesebenzisa amahhashi, izinkomo, noma amajuba pulling a plow, futhi bakha umhlaba ubude obungaphathwa yilezo zinyamazane. Babefaka imbewu ngezandla - besebenzisa kuphela izandla zabo. Babekhulisa ngezandla futhi bazama ukuvimbela izifo ngezindlela ezitholakalayo futhi bavuna ngezandla - bengazi ukuthi bangaki amahektare abebefake imbewu futhi bengazi ukuthi bangakanani umkhiqizo abazovuna. Babekuhlosile kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uzokwanela ukuhlinzeka ngokudla etafuleni nasokukhulisa izinkomo unyaka ozayo. Kodwa manje izinto seziye zashintsha... Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nokukala - ukwanda kokukala nokubala kusilethele ikhono lokuqondisa nokwandisa indlela esiphatha ngayo umsebenzi wethu wokulima. Kulesi sithombe, sizohlola, sixoxe, futhi sithinte izinto esidinga ukuzikala njengezabalimi. Sidinga ukwazi usayizi wezindawo esihlosile ukuzifaka. Zonke izibalo zomquba, inani le-diesel, inani lembewu, inani lomquba, kanye nezinto zokwakha kufanele zihambisane nosayizi bezindawo ezizofakwa. Umhlaba uhluka ngezindlela eziningi: njengokujula nesimo. Kumele sazi uhlobo lomhlaba kanye nokujula kwawo endaweni ngayinye lapho sifuna ukufaka - ungacabangi ukuthi umhlaba wakho ufana kuwo wonke amakhaya! Uhlobo nokujula komhlaba kubalulekile kakhulu lapho ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo okufanele ufake - ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo azinakufakwa emhlabeni ophakathi. Uma unamahektare anomhlaba ophakathi, akusho ukuthi uphakathi kokuphila - kusho nje ukuthi kufanele uqaphele iqiniso mayelana nezithelo ongazifaka kulezo zindawo ukuze uthole inzuzo (ngamanye amazwi, uhlobo lwezinyosi ezingafakwa emhlabeni ongenamandla ukuze kudaleke izinkomo ezizokuletha inzuzo). Zonke izitshalo zithola izinto ezidingekayo emhlabeni ukuze zikwazi ukukhula. Ezinye izinto ezifana nezimvula nokunyakaza kwamanzi ngaphakathi komhlaba zingathinta ukutholakala kwezinto emhlabeni. Uma umalimi ethatha amasampula omhlaba, bazokwazi ukubona ukuthi isimo sezinto sihamba kanjani nokuthi izinga le-pH likuphi emhlabeni. Uma umhlaba unokushisa kakhulu kodwa kukhona izinto ezanele, isitshalo ngeke sikwazi ukuthola lezo zinto. Uma singazi ukuthi isimo somhlaba sikhona, asikwazi ukukala ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo nokuthi zingaki izinto ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule ukudla okuhle. Zonke izinhlobo zezithelo zinebhande lokushisa elingaphezu kwalokho okukhona, ziba nezinselelo zokukhula kahle. Sidinga ukwazi ukuthi izinga lokushisa nezinga lokubanda kuzoba kanjani unyaka wonke, nokuthi lapho kuzoqala khona ukushisa. Uma sesinayo yonke le mininingwane, singakhetha ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nesimo sezulu nobude besikhathi sokukhula endaweni esilima kuyo. (Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi sokukhula siqala ngesikhathi sokufaka imbewu futhi siqhubeke kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvuna - isikhathi lapho kuqala khona ukushisa sizokutshela ukuthi isikhathi sokukhula siphelile). Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi ukuthi imvula iyenzeka kangakanani unyaka nonyaka endaweni lapho ulima khona, nokwazi ukuthi yisiphi isikhathi esivame ukuba nomoya. Sonke siyazi ukuthi asikwazi ukusho isimo sezulu lapho kufanele kube nemvula, kodwa uma sibheka izindlela zemvula unyaka nonyaka, singacabanga ukuthi kufanele silime kanjani unyaka ozayo. Namuhla, ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu kuyaqhubeka nokuba ngokunembile futhi kusitshela ukuthi sizolindela izimo ezimanzi nezomoya ezinyangeni ezizayo - kufanele sisebenzise le mininingwane ngendlela efanele. Ukukala inani lemvula akukhathazi (izinsiza zokukala eziphathekayo zingatholakala kalula futhi kufanele zibekwe ezindaweni ezahlukene emapulazini akho). Ngemuva kokuba imvula, kufanele ukale futhi ubhale phansi inani. I-millimeter eyodwa yemvula engena emhlabeni ithambisa umhlaba kancane - kufanele ukale inani lemvula ukuze wazi ukuthi umhlaba uthambiswe kangakanani. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukufaka inani elifanele lembewu ngehektare ukuze uthole umkhiqizo ofanele. Inani elifanele lezitshalo lihlukile ezindaweni ezahlukene futhi lingahluka endaweni eyodwa ngoba kungase kube nezinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlaba. Isizathu sokubaluleka kwenani lezitshalo sithi: isitshalo esisodwa sidinga inani elithile lezinto ezidingekayo namanzi ukuze sikwazi ukukhula ngokuphelele - uma inani lezitshalo liphansi kakhulu, umkhiqizo uzoba phansi, futhi uma kukhona izitshalo eziningi kakhulu, zizokhuphukana ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo, futhi umkhiqizo uzophinde ube phansi. Umkhiqizi kumele azi kahle ukuthi ubude bokuhlukanisa phakathi kwemigqa kufanele kube kanjani nokuthi izitshalo kufanele zibe seduze kangakanani komunye nomunye emigqeni - lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni izithelo zokudla. Izitshalo zidinga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukukhula nokukhiqiza izithelo zokudla. Inani lezinto ezidingekayo lihambisana nomkhiqizo olindelekile (inani elijwayelekile umkhiqizi angalithola endaweni ethile kanye nezithelo ezithile). Umphumela wamasampula omhlaba uzokhombisa isimo sezinto ezikhona emhlabeni ngesikhathi esithile. Mayelana nalokhu, inani lezinto ezidingekayo lingakalwa. Umquba ubalulekile kakhulu uma sifuna ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle, kodwa ubiza kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukubala nokuthola inani eliqondile lomquba esizowufaka emhlabeni. Lokhu kuyindawo enye lapho ukukala kubalulekile kakhulu. Zonke lezi zinto zokwakha ziza nelebuli ekhombisa inani elifanele lokufaka. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu. Inani le-pesticide kumele libalwe ngokucophelela ukuze umkhiqizi athole umkhiqizo omuhle ngaphandle kokulimaza izitshalo zabo noma imvelo. Inani le-pesticide ngokuvamile litholakala ngokukala i-pesticide namanzi bese uxuba - isibonelo, ilitha elilodwa le-pesticide lixutshwa nezilitha eziyi-250 ukuze kuphonswe ihektare eyodwa (lokhu kukala nakho kubalulekile). Izinto zokwakha ezisetshenziswa ekulimaleni zingaba yingozi enkulu futhi zibhujiswa - ngakho-ke, kufanele zixuthelwe kahle. Ukulinganisa umshini wokuphoqa kuyinto ebalulekile kwenye indawo yokulima. Ngemuva kokwenza lo msebenzi wonke, usukalile ukuthi umkhiqizo ongawulindela ngehektare ungakanani. Kudinga umsebenzi omningi ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle, futhi ekugcineni, kufanele uqonde kahle ukuthi ube nempumelelo kangakanani. Uqala ngomhlaba - ufake futhi ukhethe uhlobo lwezithelo ofuna ukufaka, bese ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, ukhetha inani lomquba ofuna ukufaka, ukhetha izinto ozohlela ukuzisebenzisa, kanye nesikhathi salokho - konke lokhu kudinga isikhathi, amandla, kanye nemali eningi. Bese uthola ukudla ezindaweni ezidinga ukuvuna nokuthengisa - manje kufanele ubale kahle ukuthi izindleko nge-ton zikhona kanjani bese uthola ukuthi uthole inzuzo kangakanani. Ngale ndlela, kuzovela kahle ukuthi uthole imbuyiselo yomsebenzi wakho noma cha? Ohlelweni lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi, sithola abalimi abaningi abangazi ukuthi bangaki amahektare ezindawo zabo, abazi ukuthi umhlaba ujula kangakanani, abazi isimo sezinto zomhlaba, umquba abazowufaka, inani lezitshalo, njll. Zonke lezi zinto ziding
Uhlelo Lokutshala Imali ku-Just Energy Transition: Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu, ongumuntu ophakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu kwezokusebenza kagesi, ungumholi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphatha izinsiza zamandla. Njengomuntu oneminyaka engu-34, udumo lwakhe lukhanya kakhulu emkhankasweni wokuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. U-Sipho ubonakala njengomholi ohlonishwa kakhulu, egqugquzela imfundo, amandla amasha, kanye namathuba emisebenzi. Wazalwa eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika, lapho aqala khona ukufezekisa amaphupho akhe okwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uSipho wagxila ezokuphathwa kwezinsiza zezimali, eqonda ukuthi umhlaba udinga izixazululo ezinqala ukuze ubhekane nezinkinga zezimali. E-KwaZulu-Natal, ubona izinkinga ezijulile zokushoda kwamandla, okuholela ekutheni abe nesithakazelo esikhethekile kumkhankaso we-Just Energy Transition, owawuhloselwe ukuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. U-Sipho uzwa ukuthi izinguquko ezimbonini zamandla zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ngakho udinga izinyathelo ezihlakaniphile. Uhlelo lwe-Just Energy Transition lugxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa amandla ahlanzekile, ukunciphisa ukufudumala komhlaba, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. U-Sipho ufuna ukuthi lezi zinguquko zifinyeleleke kuwo wonke umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezithuthukisa amandla amasha, uSipho usebenza kanzima ekwandiseni uhlelo lokutshala imali kulolu hlelo. U-Sipho ungumholi ophokophelelayo ekwakheni imithombo ye-energising eyenza umphakathi uzitholele izinzuzo ezihlanzekile. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emikhankasweni yezoMnotho Ezemvelo, eqhubeka nokuqonda izindlela zokusebenza ezinhle. U-Sipho ukholelwa ukuthi uhlelo lokutshala imali luyisihluthulelo sokuguqula amandla, futhi u-Just Energy Transition uhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, ucwaningo lwezobuchwepheshe, nezinsiza zokwakha ibhizinisi. Uhlaka lokugcina ilungelo lokuphuma kokunciphisa izindleko zamandla lusebenza kumalungelo abantu bonke. Naphezu kokuba esencane, uSipho uhlanganyela emisebenzini yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokwakha amandla ahlanzekile. Uthanda ukuphila okukhona, ulwa nokudla kwesizinda, futhi umkhiqizo wakhe, i-Just Energy Transition, ubonisa ukuzimisela kwakhe ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho ubonisa impumelelo, ukhuthaza imikhankaso yokusebenza, futhi unakekela izinkinga zamandla. Uhlala edinga ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, abaphakathi, nezinkampani ukuze kuthuthukiswe izixazululo ezihlanzekile. U-Sipho uyisibonelo esihle, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uzokwakha ikusasa elihlanzekile nelihle. U-Sipho Mthembu, umholi emkhakheni wezinsiza zamandla, uyazikhandla futhi uhamba phambili.
Ubulunga bakho baziwa kangakanani ngezingxenye ze-planter? Funda lokho okukhuluma lapha ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho ngama-component e-planter. Zonke izingxenye zikhonjiswa futhi imisebenzi yazo ichaziwe. Le yindawo lapho ingxenye ye-planter ixhunywe khona, futhi ihluke kulapho i-planter izoxhunywa khona ku-tractor. Lezi yizinto ezibhekana nezitshalo nez fertiliser. Zenziwe ngopulasitiki oqinile noma zakhiwe ngensimbi. Lezi zingaba yizinyawo ezihamba phezu kwe-planter. Le nyawo iqhutshwa uma ixhumana nomhlaba njengoba i-planter idonswa. Le nyawo ihamba ngendlela efanayo ne-tractor. Umsebenzi wale nyawo uwukusebenzisa zonke ezinye izingxenye ze-planter - izinto ezithumele izinga lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Ukuze ukwazi ukukala isivinini sezingxenye ezithumele izitshalo nez fertiliser, kukhona uhlelo lweziqhumane nezikhala ezisebenzayo. Konke lokhu kungahlanganiswa ngendlela ehlinzeka ngenani elifanele lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Kukhona ama-plates ahlukene ahambelana nezinhlobo zezithombo nezilinganiso zazo (asikhulumi lapha ngama-planters asebenzisa umoya ukuhlinzeka ngezithombo). Lezi ngokuvamile zikhona phambili kwe-planter futhi zihlala zikhona kulawo ma-planters asetshenziswa ezimweni zokungafaki umhlabathi ngoba kunezinhlobo eziningi phezulu komhlabathi. Lezi zifaka izitshalo nez fertiliser emhlabathini. Lokhu kungaba yizinyawo ezincane ngemuva kwe-planter ezihamba emgudwini ukusiza ukuqinisa umhlabathi emgudwini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komhlaba nezitshalo. Lapha, ingcindezi ingaba phansi kakhulu noma phezulu kakhulu.
iSpaceX Ngomqolo wenqola-moya ophakamisa umoya, iSpaceX, inkampani yethu esunguliwe nguElon Musk, ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezinselelo eziphakeme emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwemikhumbi emkhathini. Le nkampani, eyasungulwa ngo-2002, inhloso yayo enkulu wukwenza ukuhamba emkhathini kube lula futhi kube nendlela yokuhlala kwabantu kwezinye izinkanyezi, ikakhulukazi iMars. Eminyakeni edlule, iSpaceX ibonile izimpumelelo ezinkulu ezifana nokukhipha izikhangibavakashi ezisindayo nezigxilile, okwakuvame ukuba yiphutha emlandweni wesayensi. Ukuphumelela kukaFalcon 1, owawukhipha umthwalo wokuqala, kwaba yinsika yokwakha ithemba elisha emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwemikhumbi emkhathini. Lesi sithombe sikhombisa ukuthi imizamo yeSpaceX ayipheli, futhi ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezingu-10, iSpaceX yathola impumelelo yokwakha iFalcon 9, inqola-moya ephumelelayo enezici eziphakeme zokuphinda isetshenziswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iSpaceX ibhekene nezinhlelo eziningi ezibangela ukukhumbula, njengokwakha iStarship, inqola-moya enezici eziphakeme zamazinga aphakeme nokuhanjiswa komthwalo omkhulu. I-Starship iyisiqalo esisha, esihlose ukwakha indlela yokuhamba emkhathini evulekile kumuntu wonke, kulandela isifiso sikaMusk sokuhamba kwezesayensi zokuqala eMars. Le mikhankaso ibonisa ukuthi iSpaceX ifuna ukukhipha umkhankaso wezokuhlala kwabantu kwezinye izinkanyezi, ngesidingo sokuhamba kwezesayensi nezokuhlala. Ithimba leSpaceX linomsebenzi ophawulekayo, ngokubambisana neNASA, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqonda okungcono kweZinkanyezi, futhi liphinde likhuthaze abantu abaningi ukuba babonise izifiso zabo zokuhamba emkhathini.
