Ngenxa yokusebenza kwazo, izikhangibavakashi ezinjengeCrew Dragon ziyaqhubeka nezinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazokwazi ukungena emkhathini ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwazisa impumelelo yokuhamba kwabantu emkhathini, futhi kuhlonishwa kabanzi emhlabeni jikelele. I-SpaceX iyinhlangano ebonisa ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezobuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bezenhlalakahle, nezinselelo ezikhona emhlabeni. Lokhu kusebenza kuholela ekuthuthukeni kwezimboni ezihlobene, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthutha, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bokuqapha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imizamo yeSpaceX yokugcina imvelo ithokozisa, ikakhulukazi ekwakhiweni kwemikhumbi engasebenzisi uphethiloli, okuyinto ebalulekile ekulawuleni ukungcoliswa kwemvelo. Ukwesekwa okukhulu okuvela kumphakathi nakumaqembu ezombusazwe, kuhlale kubalulekile emizamweni yeSpaceX. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isimo esilungele ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni, kuqhubeke nokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe. Umoya wokusebenza ngokubambisana, obalulekile emkhakheni wezokuhamba emkhathini, udinga ukugqugquzela ubuchwepheshe obusha nokwakha amathuba amasha. Ngokubheka phambili, iSpaceX ibonisa ubuqotho bayo ekwakheni ikusasa elihlanzekile, elingabhekeli nje kuphela emkhathini, kodwa futhi nakumhlaba. Le nkampani ibonisa amandla okuthi izinkanyezi zibe yikhaya labantu, futhi ibonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungathuthuka ngokwengeziwe uma abantu bejabulela ukuhamba emkhathini. Ngakho, iSpaceX iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi uma sishintsha umqondo wethu, sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni elikhulu lokuphila emhlabeni nakumkhathini. Ngale ndlela, iSpaceX iyingxenye enkulu yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuphumelela okukhulu, futhi izophinde ibonise ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo uma bephikelela. Njengoba sibheke phambili, sizobona izimanga ezenzakalayo emkhathini, futhi iSpaceX izoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imizamo yezenhloso ezinhle iyasivumela ukuba sithuthuke siqhubeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kulindeleke ukuthi iSpaceX izokwenza izinqumo ezibalulekile, ezizothuthukisa amandla okuphila emkhathini, ikakhulukazi uma sikhumbula ukuthi lokhu akukhona kuphela okuhlangene nomhlaba, kodwa futhi ngokuvumelana nezimo ezithile ezizovuleka. Ijolise ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi izosiza ukwakha amaphupho ezizukulwane ezizayo. ISpaceX, ngalesi sikhathi, ibonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayipheli, futhi kufanele ube nesibindi sokuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinzima ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, iSpaceX ayigcini nje ngokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu besebenza ndawonye, bayakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu, bahlanganyele impumelelo emkhakheni wezokuhamba emkhathini. Lokhu kuqhuba ibhizinisi elisha, elikhuthaza abanye, futhi linika ithemba lokuthi impilo yethu izoshintsha ngendlela emangalisayo.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Izinyathelo Zokuthola Nokugcina Ukuhlanzeka Kwamamzi Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esikhulu empilweni yethu. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukulandela izinyathelo ezithile. Lezi zinyathelo zizosiza ekugcineni impilo yethu iphila kahle, futhi zivikela nezilwane kanye nemvelo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlonza Umthombo Wamanzi Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde umthombo wamanzi ethu. Uma usebenzisa amanzi avela emthonjeni, ichibi, noma emtapweni, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi lezi zindawo zihlanzekile. Ukuze uhlonze umthombo, ungenza lokhu: - Bheka ukuthi umthombo ubonakala kanjani. Ingabe amanzi acwebile, noma kukhona okukhathazayo njengokungcola, izinsalela, noma umbala ongajwayelekile? - Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola amanzi endaweni engaphansi kwezindawo ezitholakala khona izinkuni, izinhlamvu, nezinye izinto ezingadala ukungcola. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlanzeka Kwamamzi Uma umthombo wamanzi wakho ubonakala uhlanzekile, lesi sikhathi sokuhlanza amanzi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi akunayo imiphumela emibi empilweni yakho. Ungakwenza lokhu ngezindlela ezilandelayo: - Ukusebenzisa amabhodlela apholile: Qinisekisa ukuthi ubhidliza amabhodlela angcolile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa. - Ukuhlanza ngemuva kokuphosa: Uma udinga amanzi ahlanzekile, ungawaphosa ngentambo yokuhlanza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubulukhuni bamanzi abuphazamiseki. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izinga Lokuhlanzeka Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amanzi akho ahlanzekile, kufanele uhlale uhlole izinga lokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezindlela ezilandelayo: - Ukusebenzisa izivivinyo: Thola izivivinyo zamakhemikhali ezitholakalayo ezizokwazi ukukwazisa ngokuqondile ngezinga lokuhlanzeka kwamamzi akho. Lezi zivivinyo zingatholakala ezitolo zamakhemikhali noma kumasipala wakho. - Ukukhuluma nochwepheshe: Uma ungazi kahle ukuthi ungazithola kanjani izivivinyo, xhumana nochwepheshe bendawo abanolwazi ngendaba yokuhlanzeka kwamamzi. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuvikela Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ukuba namanzi ahlanzekile akupheli lapho udinga ukuwathola. Kubalulekile futhi ukuvikela lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo: - Ungaphumeli amanzi emithonjeni engcolile: Qinisekisa ukuthi awuphumi amanzi emithonjeni engcolile, ngenxa yokuthi lokhu kuzothinta amanzi owatholayo. - Gcina imithombo yethu: Ungakusebenzisa amanzi alinganiselwe ukuze uvikele imithombo yethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukusebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayatholakala isikhathi eside. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqhubeka Nokufunda Ukugcina amanzi ahlanzekile akupheli kuphela ekutholeni amanzi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile: - Ukwazi izitayela ezintsha: Funda ngezindlela ezintsha zokuhlanza amanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlanzekile. Bheka izincwadi, izifundo, nemithombo ethokozisayo. - Yabelana ngolwazi: Qinisekisa ukuthi uthumele ulwazi lwezokuhlanzeka kwamamzi kubangani, emndenini, nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela abanye. Isiphetho Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathola amanzi ahlanzekile futhi uvikele imithombo yakho. Amanzi ahlanzekile akubalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi ukwenza imizamo yokukwenza kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuvikelekeni komphakathi nasemvelo. Yiba nomthombo omuhle, uvikele, futhi ube nomthelela omuhle. Amanzi ahlanzekile akho uyafaneleka!
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Ukubheka Phambili Nokuqonda Izinkinga Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ikakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngempilo yabesifazane nabantwana. Ukubeletha kwehlelwa kakhulu ezibhedlela ngenxa yokuphepha nokuthola usizo lwezempilo olukhona. Nokho, lezi zinsizakalo zikhona nezinkinga zazo, ezidinga ukuba zicatshangelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Okokuqala, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zinikeza ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Izibhedlela zinezinsiza ezithuthukile, njengemishini yokuhlola impilo, ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, kanye nezitho zomzimba eziphathelene nokubeletha. Lokhu kusiza ukunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokubeletha, njengoba kudinga ukuthi kube nezikhungo ezifanele ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezingaba khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, odokotela nabahlengikazi abanemfundo eyanele bahlala bekulungele ukusiza, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ziwumqondo omuhle. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko zokubeletha ezibhedlela zingashaya amaphesenti aphezulu. Ukuze umama akwazi ukuthola lezi zinsizakalo, udinga ukukhokha, okungaba mkhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izinsiza zempilo zingekho ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuphakamisa umbuzo othi: ingabe izindleko zikhona ukuze zikhokhelwe? Lokhu kubeka abesifazane abaningi engcupheni yokungakwazi ukuhlela ukubeletha kwabo ezibhedlela, okusho ukuthi bangase bahlupheke kakhulu uma bephila ezindaweni ezithile, lapho izinsizakalo zokubeletha zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela azivamile ukufaka izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nezidingo zabesifazane. Abesifazane banokuhlukahluka okukhulu ezidingweni zabo, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezindlela zokubeletha. Kweminye imiphakathi, ukubeletha ngokwemvelo kubalulekile, futhi abesifazane bangase bazizwe begciniwe uma behlinzekwa kuphela ngezindlela ezisemthethweni ezibhedlela. Lokhu kudinga ukuxoxwa okujulile phakathi kwabazali, odokotela, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kube nezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, kunezinto eziningi ezingathuthukiswa. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zinsizakalo, izibhedlela kufanele zisebenzise izindlela zokuxhumana ezihlakaniphile. Umama ophumile ezibhedlela kufanele akwazi ukuthola ulwazi olucacile nolusebenzayo, oluzomnika ithuba lokwenza izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nezinsizakalo azitholayo. Lokhu kuzoba nempumelelo enkulu ekunqandeni izinkinga ezihlobene nokubeletha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abesifazane kufanele banikezwe ithuba lokuzwakalisa izifiso zabo nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabazali nabahlengikazi, okuzoholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abahlinzekayo nezidingo zeziguli. Odokotela badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukubeletha akuyona kuphela inqubo yokwelapha, kodwa kuyisigameko esibalulekile empilweni yomama, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuhunyushwa ngokuhlonipha. Okokugcina, izibhedlela kufanele zifake izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhambisa ezikahle, ukuze abesifazane bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuhlinzeka ngendlela yokuhamba efanele kungasiza ukusiza abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezibhedlela kalula. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinto, singakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ziba ngcono. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abesifazane bakwazi ukuzizwa bephumule futhi bezinakekela kahle ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ngamafuphi, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuba zicatshangelwe ngokujulile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zikhuthaze impilo yabesifazane nabantwana. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi jikelele.
Thola ukudla okunempilo nezidingo zempilo. Izidingo zokuphepha nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekela abasebenzi bezempilo. Ulwazi ngempilo nokunakekelwa ngendlela umntwana angayiqonda kalula uma kufanelekile. Ukuhlonipha ubuntu, ubumfihlo, ukuthembeka, isithunzi, ukuphila ngokomoya, nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ngemvume yomguli, thola ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokwelashwa komguli kusuka kuzihlobo zabo. Ukwelapha lokhu ngokuhlonipha nangokuthobeka ngokucabangela izidingo zomoya nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ukukhombisa ukukhathazeka nokuthola izincazelo ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuqonda ngezehlakalo ezingajwayelekile ezenzeka ngenkathi umguli elashwa, njengokwehla embhedeni nokunye. Ilungelo lokungena ukuze ubone umguli ngezikhathi ezingekho ezokuvakasha uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sikhulu. Ukusekelwa ngokomoya, nolwazi uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sikhulu. Ukusekelwa ngokomoya, nolwazi lokuthi ungathola kanjani usizo ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwesibhedlela. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele mayelana nempilo nokwelashwa komguli ngaleso sikhathi uma kudingeka. Ngemuva kokukhishwa komguli esibhedlela, umndeni ubandakanyeka, uqinisekisa ukuthi bathatha imithi, futhi babuyele ngendlela efanele ukuze baqhubeke nohlelo lokwelashwa njengoba kuzobe kuhlelwe. Ukuhlonipha abanye abaguli, izivakashi, nabasebenzi besibhedlela. Ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zabanye abaguli nemindeni zingase zibe ziphuthumayo kunalezo zabo. Ukuqonda nokuhlonipha izinsiza, imishini, nokuhambisana nemithetho. Ukuqonda isibhedlela ngezinguquko kulwazi lomguli njengokuhamba, inombolo yocingo, nezinye. Ukuhlinzeka ngezimali zokwelashwa komguli njengoba kulindelekile.
A. Hey, Umshayeli weTaxi! B. Bheka amawheels akho! b. Bangane, amaTaxi anikeza usizo olubalulekile kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Sithembele kini ukuze nithumele ngokuphepha ezindaweni zethu. Nokho, amaTaxi enu aphephile kangakanani? Bheka amawheels akho! Amawheels akho abalulekile kakhulu. Khumbula ukuthi yibo kuphela abaxhumanisi phakathi komgwaqo, itaxi, kanye nabagibeli. Amawheels akho angakwenza umehluko phakathi kokuphila nokufa. Uyalungile. Ngiyabonga ngokusikhumbuza. Esikhathini esedlule, sithukile ukuphepha. Kodwa sizimisele ukuphakamisa izinga embonini yethu! Ukuphepha kwabagibeli bethu kuphezulu ohlwini lwethu. Ngemuva kokukhuluma nawe, siyazi kahle ukuthi sizoqala kuphi - ngokugcina amawheels! Yebo! Njengabagibeli, ukuphila kwethu kusezandleni zenu! Khumbula lokho - imindeni yethu iyasidinga! Imindeni yenu iyasidinga, siyasidinga, nezwe lenu liyasidinga. Asikwazi ukuhlupheka ukulahlekelwa ngempela ngempela ngenxa yokunganaki nokungakhathaleli. Abagibeli kumele bathuthwe ngokuphepha! Amawheels afanele + abashayeli abafanele = ukuphepha emigwaqweni. Ngiyabonga ngokuthatha le ndaba ngokungathi sína! a. Ingabe nguwe? b. Woza, woza! Sinehambo ende phambili. Cha, Mama, ungakhathazeki! Ngithemba ukuthi ubheke amawheels akho. Wonke amawheels akho - owokuqala, wesibili, wesithathu, nowesine. Yebo! Ingabe amawheels akulungile? Unayo i-spare? Yini ehamba! Uplaying ngokufa! Lo mshayeli ubukeka engazi lutho ngama-wheels aphephile! Uyalungile! Noma ubani ophuthelwa amawheels akhe udlala ngokufa. Ngisho, amawheels angaphephile angabangela izingozi! Izikhathi eziningi amawheels afakwe ngendlela engafanele, noma anobquality ophansi! Kufana nokuba nama-wheels ahlanzekile! Amawheels angaphephile angabiza ukuphila kwethu! Uma kuphela bonke abashayeli bengafunda ngokuqinisa nokugcina amawheels. Uyalungile. Emasontweni edlule ngashaywa yitayi, ngiyabonga, akekho owalimala, kodwa ama-tires amasha abiza imali eningi. Ngakho! Uthole inhlanhla. Abantu bafa njalo ngesonto ngoba abashayeli nab owners beTaxi abafaki amawheels ngendlela efanele futhi abathathi isikhathi sokuwagcina. Ingabe ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awuyona imbangela yezingozi - ngisho nokufa? Ingabe ufuna ukusindisa imali? Uma ufuna ukuhlola amawheels akho! Funda ukugcina amawheels akho? Kufanele sazi amawheels ethu, sithole ukujwayela ukuwabheka, silungise lokho okungahambi kahle ngokushesha, futhi sigcine kahle, esimeme, esidala, nasezindaweni ezingazinzile amawheels angabangela izingozi! Amawheels akho afana nezinyawo zezimoto zakho. Uma izinyawo zakho zihlanzekile, zihlala, ungaziphonsa phansi futhi uzilimaze. Amawheels awakwazi ukukhuluma. Ngakho, kuncike kithi, abanikazi beTaxi, nabashayeli ukuba sihlolisise ukulimala futhi silungise ngaphambi kokuthi kubangele izinkinga! Amawheels ezimoto asetshenzisiwe ahluke kuma-wheels ajwayelekile. Amawheels ajwayelekile awaqinile ngokwanele ukuthwala abagibeli beTaxi. I-wheel ye-vehicle inencwadi C emva kwenombolo yesisindo. Uma i-wheel incane kakhulu noma inkulu kakhulu, ingaphuma emgibeni we-wheel. Kumele ibe nosayizi ofanele. Buza umthengisi wakho we-tire ngosayizi ofanele we-vehicle yakho, noma ufunde incwadi yakho. Uma i-wheel incane kakhulu, ingaphuma emgibeni we-wheel. Ungazifaki engcupheni yokuphuma okungaba yingozi. Njalo uma ufaka itayi elisha, futhi ufake ne-air valve entsha. Ama-air valves awabizi kakhulu, ayabiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi umgibeli we-wheel uphila kahle. Uma umgibeli we-wheel ulimele, ungabangela itayi ukuthi ilahleke umoya ngokushesha noma iphume emgibeni. Hlola ama-wheel rims e-vehicle yakho njalo. Uma kukhona ukulimala, shintsha noma buza othile onolwazi ukuthi alungise. Umoya ongafanele ubangela itayi yakho ukuthi igqoke ngokungafanele futhi ingagqoka ngokushesha. Ukuhlola umoya njalo uma ugcwalisa uphethiloli nokufaka umoya ofanele kukunika ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi itayi yakho izohlala isikhathi esifanele - okwenza ukusindisa imali! Itayi yakho ingagqoka ngokushesha esontweni lokuqala uma ingafakwe kahle noma uma i-valve igxuma umoya. Hlola umoya kuma-tires akho nsuku zonke esontweni lokuqala ngemuva kokufaka ama-tires amasha. Ngemuva kwalokho, hlola umoya kuma-tires akho njalo. Njalo umshayeli kufanele abe ne-air pressure gauge yakhe. Ama-air gauges atholakala ezigaraji angase angasebenzi. Umoya ongafanele we-tire ungumthombo wezingozi eziningi zeTaxi. Faka umkhuba wokuhlola umoya kuma-tires akho. Qinisa ama-bolts kuma-wheels akho. Izingxenye eziningi zezingozini zenzeka ngoba umshayeli ucabanga ukuthi bazodlula noma ama-bolts aphukile. Ungazami ukuhamba ngemoto enama-bolts aphukile noma alahlekile. Ingabe lokhu akukhona nje ukugcinwa kwe-tire okuyisisekelo? Ungafaka ama-tires abiza kancane futhi ungawagcini - kodwa lokhu kungakubiza ukuphila kwakho. Lokhu kubiza kakhulu kunezithayi ezinhle ezigcinwe kahle. Ungacabangi ukuthi okuncane kungcono! Ama-tires abiza kancane - njengezithayi eziphindwe kabili, noma eziphindwe kabili noma ezibuyisiwe - angakubiza ukuphila kwakho kanye nabagibeli bakho. Ungazami ukufaka ama-tires aphindwe kabili noma abuyisiwe. Ama-tires abiza kancane ekugcineni - ngoba adinga ukugcinwa okuningi futhi awahlali isikhathi eside njengama-tires amasha. Ama-tires anekhwalithi ephezulu angabiza kakhulu kodwa abiza kancane ekugcineni ngoba kulula ukuwagcina futhi ahlala isikhathi eside. Ukulayisha ngokweqile kwe-vehicle kubangela ukugqoka kwe-tire futhi kungabangela ukuphuma, okuholela ezingozi nasekufeni. Ungacabangi ngentengo ye-tire. Uma itayi yakho inobubanzi be-tread obungaphansi kuka-1.6mm noma kuphi. Ukulayisha ngokweqile kwe-vehicle kuyingozi! I-taxi ngayinye ivunyelwe ukuthwala inani elithile labagibeli. Uma uthwala abagibeli abaphezulu kwenani elivunyelwe, ulimele umgwaqo kanye ne-vehicle. Uphula umthetho futhi ubeka ukuphila kwakho engozini! Ngizokwehlisa isijeziso sokulayisha ngokweqile i-vehicle! Ungangikhombisa yini ilayisense yakho yokushayela? Uthole yini utshwala? Ungaphuma kwi-vehicle yakho ukuze ngihlolisise ukuthi iyasebenza emgwaqweni? Cishe konke kudinga ukugcinwa uma ufuna ukuthi kuhlale isikhathi eside noma kuhamba isikhathi eside. Akusizi ukuba nemoto enhle nezithayi ezinhle uma ungazigcini. Futhi ufuna ukuthutha abagibeli bakho ngokuphepha. Ukugcinwa kusindisa imali. Ukunganaki ama-vehicles kuyimbangela enkulu yezingozi emgwaqweni. Ungavumeli ukuba ube wena
Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezimali kumasipala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlolwa kwamabhuku kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho nezinhlinzeko zokuphatha izimali ziyalandelwa, futhi kuhloswe ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemali. U-Nkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uMenenja wezeMali, uvule umcimbi ngekhulumo echaza izinjongo zokuhlolwa, wathi: “Sihlose ukwakha ukwethembeka nokuphumelela ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuhlola amabhuku kumasipala akusizi kuphela ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni.” Ngemva kwalokho, kwaba nezigaba zokuhlola, lapho abahloli benza iziphakamiso ezithile. Ukuhlolwa kuhilela ukubuyekezwa kwamarekhodi, izincwadi zezimali, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Abahloli bahlola izindleko, izinzuzo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala kumasipala, ukuze baqonde kahle indlela izinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa ibonise ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ekuphathweni kwemali, kumasipala amaningi kube nezinqumo ezinhle ezithathwe. Kukhona amaphuzu abahloli abawafakazile, njengokungabi khona kokubhaliswa kwezimali ezithile, okukhombisa izinkinga ekuphathweni kwemali, okudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwemithetho. Ubulungiswa bokuphathwa kwemali bukhombisa ukuthi kumasipala amakhulu, ukuphathwa kwezimali kusebenza kahle, kodwa kunezikhala ezidinga ukunakwa. Abahloli bagcizelela ukubaluleka kwemfundo nokwakhiwa kwamakhono ukuze kufezwe izinjongo ezinhle zokuphathwa kwemali. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, kwaba nezingxoxo phakathi kwabahloli nabaphathi bamabhuku, ezazifaka iziphakamiso zokuthi masipala bahlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwezinhlelo. Uhlelo lokuhlola luzoba yinsika yokwakha ukwethembana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni, futhi luzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwemali. Abahloli baphinde baphakamise ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubika ezicacile, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oluhlobene nezimali zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani, futhi kuzokwandisa ukwakhiwa kokwethembana. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoshintsha indlela amabhuku aphathwa ngayo kumasipala. Ukuhlolwa kuzoholela ezifundweni ezithile ezizothathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala uzoba isibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuphathwa kwezimali kungathuthukiswa kanjani. Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezinzima, ezizokwenza ukuthi umphakathi uthole izinsiza ezingcono. Ekupheleni komcimbi, uNkk. Mkhize wakhumbuza bonke abathintekayo ukuthi imiphumela yokuhlolwa iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uthe: “Siyavuma ukuthi kunezinkinga, kodwa sizimisele ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwemali kumasipala. Sifuna ukwakha isiko lokubambisana, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.” Umcimbi ugcine uhlelwe kahle, futhi abavakashi bahlonipha imizamo yokuphatha izimali kumasipala. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoba yisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqinile, lapho umphakathi uzokwazi ukuthemba ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwane phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuthola izinsiza abazidingayo.
Kubhalwe njalo kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle ukuthi ingabe kukhona inkinga ethile yokukhula kwezihlahla emapulazini akho. Izindlela zokulima, izindlela zokulawula izihlahla ngezikhemikhali, kanye nokuphindaphinda izitshalo kuyahluka ezindaweni ezithile nasemapulazini athile. Kungenzeka ukuthi inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla epulazini lakho ihluke ngokuphelele kunenkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla emapulazini asendaweni. Hlola njalo ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona epulazini lakho bese uhlanganisa izikhemikhali ezifanele zokusebenzisa. Sicela ubheke ithebula elingezansi ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-herbicides ezitholakalayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika ezilawula izihlahla emakhanda. Izikhemikhali ezitholakalayo kanye nohlu lwezikhemikhali zinezingxenye ezisebenzayo ezibulala izihlahla ezifana nezitshalo zonyaka noma izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Ingxenye esebenzayo iyisikhemikhali esilawula izihlahla ngokuvimba ukufinyelela kwazo elangeni, okwenza izihlahla zingakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhula. Lezi zikhemikhali zihlanganiswa lapho izinkambu zomkhiqizi zinezingqinamba ngezihlahla nezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi. Ezinye izindawo, ungaba nenhlanhla ngoba usebenzise uhlelo oluhle lokuphindaphinda izitshalo noma ulawule izihlahla kahle, futhi kuzoba nenkinga kuphela ngezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi emakhanda. Kulokhu, uzophosa imali uma uphonsa izitshalo. Ukuhlola ngqo inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla kuzokusiza ngezindleko zakho uma ulawula izihlahla. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi i-pH yomhlabathi ikuphi kuyo yonke imikhakha epulazini lakho. Izinga lokusebenzisa izikhemikhali lihambisana ne-pH yomhlabathi - lapho i-pH ikhula, inani lezikhemikhali lenyuka. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-pH ithola ingxenye ye-ingxenye esebenzayo, futhi isitshalo sezihlahla asitholi i-herbicide eyanele yokubulala. Kuyiphutha ukufaka inani elinganele le-herbicide ngehektare ngoba ufuna ukunciphisa izindleko zamanje ngehektare. I-herbicide engasebenzi kahle izoholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kokukhiqiza kulo nyaka. Uma i-herbicide enganele ifakwa, ezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla zingaphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zihlahlana zizodinga i-herbicide/ingxenye esebenzayo ezobe x 100 ukuze zibulale. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindlu zokulima (zonke izifunda) zizothola inzuzo uma umyalezo wokufaka i-herbicides ngendlela efanele ulandelwa. Kubiza imali eningi (nangesikhathi) ukuthola ama-herbicides amasha nezikhemikhali uma i-herbicide ethile ingasebenzi kahle. Isibonelo esilandelayo sikhombisa ukuthi inani le-herbicide lishintsha kanjani uma i-pH yomhlabathi ishintsha. Lapha sikhuluma nge-'acetochlor', i-herbicide elawula izitshalo ezifana nezitshalo. 'Acetochlor' ivamise ukusetshenziswa lapho ihlanganiswa ne-'safener'. Uma le nhlanganisela ne-'acetochlor' ifakwa, 'acetochlor' ingase ingabulali izitshalo zomkhiwane - khumbula: umkhiwane uyisitshalo esifana nezitshalo. Ukuze uqale, kusho ukufaka izikhemikhali emhlabathini noma lapho ungekhulumi kakhulu ngemuva kokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini. Uma kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhula minyaka yonke emikhakheni ethile, izikhemikhali eziningi zizofakwa. Izindleko zezikhemikhali ngehektare zingaqala ku-R97.50 emhlabathini (lapho i-pH ingu-0% - 10%) kuya ku-R150 emhlabathini one-pH ephezulu (41% - 55%). Umkhiqizo womkhiwane ongu-4.5 tons ngehektare ungakha ingcebo engafika ku-R7,200 ngehektare. Ngakho-ke, kungaba yiphutha ukufuna ukusindisa u-R60 ngehektare uma ucabangela ezinye izinkinga nezingozi ezingase zivele. Siphinda sithi: hlola kahle inkinga nawe nomphathi wezikhali ukuze uphathe konke kahle. Kubalulekile futhi ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-herbicides ozosebenzisa ukuze ukwazi ukuhlela umshini wokuphonsa kusenesikhathi kulonyaka. Ama-herbicides angafakwa ngemuva kokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele, futhi ungafaka ama-herbicides ngemuva kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini noma ngemuva kokutshala uma umhlabathi ulungiswe kahle. Umhlabathi olungisiwe kahle ubonisa umhlabathi omuhle onokwakhiwa okungathathi izikhemikhali. Uma ama-herbicides ephonswa ngesikhathi sokutshala noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokutshala, umkhiqizi angakhetha ukufaka i-herbicide kabanzi kuyo yonke imikhakha lapho zikhona noma endaweni encane ngaphezulu komugqa owodwa. Enye indlela yile: umshini ophonsa ungafakwa emkhakheni ngokushesha ngemuva kokutshala. Ngale ndlela, kuzoba nesikhathi esanele sokwenza umsebenzi wokuphonsa ngemuva kokuthi izihlahla zivele. Indlela yokusebenza izoncika kakhulu kumatshina kanye nezinye izinto umkhiqizi anazo noma azithengile. Uma uthuthukisa izinqubo zomsebenzi, kufanele kubhekwe izinto eziningi, njengokuthi kube nesikhathi esifushane sokuphothula ukuphonsa ngoba imvula enzima ilindelwe. Izibonelo zezinhlanganisela zezikhemikhali ezitholakalayo emakethe zikhonjiswa ngezansi. Uma ungumkhiqizi noma umphathi wepulazi, thola ulwazi mayelana nezikhemikhali ezibalulekile. Emakethe, kukhona ama-herbicides ahlukahlukene anamagama amahle amaningi, kodwa wonke anohlu olufanayo lwezingxenye ezisebenzayo. Uma uqhathanisa amanani ezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-herbicides, cabangela futhi ukusebenza kahle kwalawa mahlanganisela bese uthola intengo emakethe ukuze uqhathanise nayo ingxenye esebenzayo ukuze unqume izindleko ngehektare. Ikakhulukazi ngezihlahla zonyaka. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke kanye nezinye izinhlobo ezifana nezitshalo. Acetochlor/atrazine terbuthylazine (nange noma ngaphandle 'kwesafener'). Kukhona izixazululo eziningi. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Awukwazi ukulinda ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili. Izinhlobo eziningi zezihlahla zikhula minyaka yonke. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Awukwazi ukufaka emhlabathini one-pH engaphansi kuka-16%. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngemuva kokuphuma. Kuphela eKwaZulu-Natal. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Faka ezihlahleni eziphelele. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Ngaphambi kokuphuma noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokuphuma. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Faka lapho izihlahla ziphelele. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. F
Isithombe 1: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa engakaze iphuzwe nge-herbicide, ngakho-ke izitshalo eziphukile. Isithombe 2: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa ephuzwe nge-herbicide ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala. Isithombe 3: Zama ukuthola isitshalo se-maize kulesi sithombe! Isithombe 4: I-filter ye-nozzle yokuphuzisa igcwele. Isithombe 5: Izikhala zomshini ophuzisa zivalekile. Isithombe 6: Ukuvaleka kwezi zikhala kungenzeka uma umshini ungcolile futhi ungagcinwanga kahle. Izithombe 1 no-2 zithathwe ensimini efanayo eMpumalanga Kapa - isithombe 1 sikhombisa lapho i-herbicide ingafakwanga - isithombe 2 sikhombisa lapho iphuziswe khona ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala - umehluko ubonakala kahle! Singasho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafuneki khona ziwukuhlanya. Ukuhlanya kuyinkinga uma kukhuliswa izitshalo zokudla ngoba zikh competition nezinye izitshalo zokudla ngamanzi nezakhi, okwenza kube nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, z contaminating izitshalo zokudla, imbewu yazo ingafaka ama-toxins ekudleni, futhi zingagcina izilokazane nezifo ezibeka ubungozi. Ukuhlanya kukhula ngokushesha futhi kuqina kalula. Zivame ukuba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zikhula kahle ezimeni zezulu ezahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuzisusa; ziqinile futhi zikh competition ngokuqinile nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi nezakhi. Ukuhlanya kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuphindaphinda, ngakho kufanele siqaphele ngalokhu uma sizama ukuzisusa. Ukuhlanya kungakhiqiza imbewu (ngokuvamile ngokushesha nangokulula), ezinye izinhlobo zine-rhizomes phansi, ezinye zine-stolons phezulu, ezinye zine-tubers, kanti ezinye zineziphuzo ezinkulu. Omunye umhlobo, njenge "nut grass," unazo zonke lezi - ukhiqiza imbewu, unama-tubers, futhi unama-rhizomes phansi - lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuzisusa. Imbewu yokuhlanya ivame ukuhlala iphila futhi ingaphila emhlabathini isikhathi eside kuze kube izimo zifanele ukuvuthwa. Imbewu yokuhlanya nayo ayivuthi ngasikhathi sinye - ezinye zizovutha ngokushesha, kanti ezinye zizolinda. Ngokuvamile, ziqala ukuvutha uma umhlabathi uphazamisekile. Izimpande zokuhlanya zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zidlula izimpande zezithako zokudla, zivumela ukuhlanya ukuba kukhule ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ukuhlanya okukhula unyaka nonyaka kugcina izakhi ezimpandeni zazo ngaphansi komhlabathi - ngesikhathi sokukhula okunzima, zingaphumelela. Ukuhlanya kungaba yonyaka (kukhiqiza unyaka owodwa), ezinye izinhlobo ziyi-biennial (kukhiqiza iminyaka emibili), kanti ezinye ziyi-perennial (kukhiqiza iminyaka eminingi). Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula ukuhlanya ezitshalo zokudla? Ukuhlanya kukh competition nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi emhlabathini, ngezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, nendawo yokukhula, nangokukhanya (ilanga). Le competition ibangela ukuthi izitshalo zingakhuli kahle, futhi umkhiqizo wehla. Kungase futhi ku contaminating imbewu futhi kwehlise izinga lezi zimbewu. Le competition iyahluka - ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlanya azibeki ubungozi obukhulu kwezinye izitshalo - ubungozi bungaba buphansi, njenge 10%, kodwa bungakhuphuka bube ngu 98%. Ukuhlanya kuqala ukukh competition nezinye izitshalo uma seziqinisekisile izimpande eziqinile - ngemva kokuvuthwa. Ukulawula ukuhlanya kusho ukuvimbela le competition, nokuvimbela ukuhlanya ekukhiqizeni imbewu ezovutha futhi zikh competition nezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka ozayo. Bonke abalimi abafuna ukuphumelela ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zokudla kumele balwe nezinye izitshalo ngaso sonke isikhathi - ukuhlanya kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlanya kulawulwa kusetshenziswa imishini ngokuhlanza noma ngamakhemikhali - kuvame ukuthi zombili lezi zindlela zisetshenziswe. Uma umalimi elawula kahle ukuhlanya, insimu izoveza kuphela izitshalo ezitshalwe - akukho ukuhlanya! Kodwa kuvame ukuthi lokhu kungahambi kalula, futhi ukuhlanya kuqhubeka. Kungani ukuhlanya kungase kulawulwe kahle? Kukhona izinto ezintathu ezingaholela ekulawulweni okungasebenzi kahle - eyokuqala ingaba indlela yokuhlanza kanye nomshini osetshenziswayo, eyesibili ingaba i-herbicide efakwe, futhi yokugcina ingaba izimo zezulu. Izilungiselelo zomshini zingase zingabi seduze, futhi kungase kube nezikhala, okuvumela umhlabathi phakathi kwezithako ukuthi ungahlanzi kahle (uma ziqinile, azizokwazi ukusebenza kahle). Ubude bokuhlanza bungase bungefiki kahle - izimpande zokuhlanya eziphakeme zihlala ziqinile emhlabathini, futhi ukuhlanya kungase kuqale kabusha. Isivinini somshini singase sibe siphansi kakhulu - kufanele run ngokushesha ukuze uphazamise umhlabathi kahle. Umhlabathi ungase ube manzi kakhulu - izitshalo ezihlanziwe zihlala zisebenza nomhlabathi ongenamanzi futhi zingase ziqale kabusha. Ukulungiswa komshini kungase kube okungafanele. Isikhathi sokuphuzisa ukuhlanya singase singabi sesimweni esifanele. I-herbicide esetshenziswayo ingase ingasebenzi kahle ngokumelene nohlobo oluthile lokuhlanya. I-filter ye-nozzle yokuphuzisa igcwele (isithombe 4). Izikhala zomshini ophuzisa zivalekile (isithombe 5). Izinsiza ezingafanele zisetshenziswa (khumbula ukusebenzisa i-nozzle enobumba uma uphuzisa phezu kwezithako, futhi i-nozzle ye-fan elula uma uphuzisa phezu komhlabathi). Umshini ungase ungakahlanzwa kahle ngonyaka odlule - izinto eziningi zingavala, futhi ngeke usebenze kahle uma kukhona okushiywe okungahlanzwanga. Ingxenye yekhemikhali idinga imvula emva kokuphuzisa ukuze isebenze kahle - uma kunganaki, i-herbicide ayikwazi ukuqala ukusebenza. Izimo zezulu ezishisayo kakhulu nezomile zingase futhi zivimbe i-herbicide ekusebenzeni kahle. Imvula eningi ngemva kokuhlanza ingabangela ukuhlanya 'ukuqala kabusha.' Ukuphatha nokulawula ukuhlanya kubaluleke kakhulu - uma singakwenzi kahle, asizukuzuza umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokungaphathi ukuhlanya kahle esikhulume ngazo ngenhla - kodwa ekugcineni, kubonakala ukuthi ukuphatha yonke imisebenzi yakho yokulima ngaphambi kokuba kube khona izinkinga kubalulekile. Lo nyaka ububhalwe kakhulu ekulungiseni lezi zinkinga, kodwa lokho esikufundile kungasisiza siqhubeke ngonyaka ozayo. Iziphakamiso ezindala esizenzile esikhathini esedlule kufanele zifundise ukuthi singaziphindi emhlabeni; kungcono ukwenza amaphutha amasha!
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eMphakathini waseMzimkhulu. Umoya wawupholile, futhi abantu bejabulile, bekhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ezenzakalayo emsebenzini. UThandi, umphakathi wezokwakha, wayephakathi kwalezi zinsuku ezijabulisayo. Waziwa njengomsebenzi oncomekayo, onobuchule obukhulu, futhi engakaze aphuthelwe ithuba lokwenza kahle. Njengoba uThandi ehamba emsebenzini, wayecabanga ngempumelelo yakhe. Wazi kahle ukuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze uthole imali, kodwa futhi ukuze uqashelwe ngempela. UThandi wayenombono wokuthi abantu kufanele bahlonishwe ngemisebenzi yabo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisizathu sokuthi azame njalo ukwenza kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-30 zokusebenza kanzima, umphakathi wathi uzokwenza umcimbi wokuhlonipha abasebenzi abavelele. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayeziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Umphakathi wawuhlela imiklomelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise neziqu ezihloniphekile, izitifiketi, kanye nemali yokwengeza. Umcimbi wenzeka endaweni enkulu, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bajabulele. UThandi wayebona abanye abasebenzi bejabulile, bejolisa emiklomelweni yabo. Kwakukhona uNandi, owayengumsebenzi wezokupheka, noMusa, owayengumsebenzi wezokwakha. Bobabili babevele bahlonishwa ngempumelelo yabo, futhi uThandi wayejabula ngokubona abanye behlonishwa. Lapho umcimbi uqala, umphakathi wakhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ezenzakalayo. Umholi wendawo, uMnumzane Khumalo, wakhuluma ngokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Wathi: “Abasebenzi bethu bayisibopho sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphandle kwabo, asizukwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. Namuhla, sizobabonga ngempela.” UThandi wayezwa umoya wokuhlonishwa, futhi lokhu kumjabulisa. Wazi ukuthi imiklomelo ayitholi kuphela, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya omuhle emsebenzini. UThandi wayefisa ukuba yisibonelo kwabanye, ukuze bonke bazi ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma. Lapho kufika isikhathi sokwethula imiklomelo, uThandi waphakanyiswa. Umholi wendawo wathi: “Ngiyajabula ukumemezela ukuthi uThandi ungumsebenzi ophakeme kakhulu kulo nyaka. Ubonise ukuzinikela, ubuchule, nokusebenza kanzima. Ngiyamhlonipha, futhi ngiyamnika le miklomelo.” UThandi waphakamisa izandla zakhe, ejabule kakhulu. Wazi ukuthi le miklomelo ibalulekile, kodwa okwakubaluleke kakhulu wukuhlonishwa. Wabonga umphakathi, wathi: “Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Lokhu akukhona kuphela okwenziwe ngami, kodwa nakwabanye. Sisebenza sonke, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi sizoqhubeka sikhula.” Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwemiklomelo, umcimbi waqhubeka. Abantu bajabula, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, futhi bejabulela impumelelo yabo. UThandi wathola ithuba lokukhuluma noMusa noNandi, abanye abasebenzi abavelele. Bahlanganyela izifundo zabo, baphinde baxoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezenzakalayo emsebenzini. UThandi wathola ukuthi imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokuhlonishwa, kodwa futhi iyakhuthaza. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabule, futhi umoya wokusebenza kahle wawukhula. UThandi waba nesifiso sokwenza kahle njalo, ukuze aqhubeke nokuhlonishwa. Njengoba umcimbi uphela, uThandi waphuma ethokozile. Wazi ukuthi imiklomelo iyisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu wukuhlonishwa. Waqonda ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi bonke kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waphuma emcimbini, enomoya ophakeme. Wazi ukuthi imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi akukhona nje okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile, kodwa kuyisiko elibalulekile elidinga ukuqhubeka. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, enethemba lokuthi uzobona abanye behlonishwa, futhi umphakathi uqhubeke ukhula. Ngakho-ke, uThandi waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi akukhona nje okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile, kodwa kuyisiko elidinga ukuqhubeka, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ebalulekile.
Ukuze ibhizinisi lezolimo libe nenzuzo, kumele likwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo efunwa ngabathengi. Ngemuva kwalokho, le nenzuzo kufanele iqhubeke ibe khona esikhathini esizayo, ngakho ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lezolimo kufanele kukhule futhi kuthuthuke ngokuqhubekayo esikhathini esizayo. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zomuntu, umuntu wayedinga izinto ezizomsiza ukuze aphile. Ukudla kwakubalulekile, bese edinga nezingubo nezindawo zokuhlala. Ekuqaleni, abantu bathola izinto ezidingekayo ngok hunting, ukuqoqa ukudla ezitshalweni zemvelo, ukuhwebela izingubo zabo, nokuzivikela ezimeni. Njengoba umuntu eqhubeka phambili, izidingo zawo ziqhubeka zishintsha zibe sezingeni eliphezulu kunezamanje. Umuntu uphinde udlule ekuzimeleni ukuya endaweni lapho konke okudingekayo kuthengwa. Singasho ukuthi empilweni yezenhlalo yanamuhla, amabhizinisi ahlinzeka ngazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo, kodwa zikhokha imali. Ngakho, namuhla sidinga imali ukuze sithenge izinto ezibalulekile zokuphila. Njengoba singabantu abafuna ukuthenga lezi zinto, singathola imali kuphela ngokusebenza kuyo. Ungasebenza ngokwakho noma usebenze komunye umuntu ukuze uthole umholo. Uma ukhetha ukusebenza ngokwakho ngokuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, leli bhizinisi kufanele likulethe inenzuzo - kumele uphumelele kwezezimali. Ekulimaleni, kungaba nempumelelo kuphela uma ibhizinisi lakho lihlinzeka abantu ngezinto abazidingayo - ngaleyo ndlela umnikazi wale bhizinisi uzokwenza inenzuzo. Uma ibhizinisi lenza inenzuzo, umnikazi uzokwazi ukukhipha umholo. Uma ibhizinisi lingakwenzi inenzuzo, umnikazi uthola lutho. Izinto ezidingekayo zikhona ezinkampanini, futhi abathengi bazithenga. Imali engenayo evela ekuthengiseni izinto ezidingekayo iyinenzuzo yebhizinisi. Uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza noma lihambisa izinto ezidingekayo, libhekana nezindleko ezithile. Izindleko zokukhiqiza - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali ezifo, imithi, ukuvuna, nezindleko zokumaketha. Izindleko eziphezulu - izimali zebhange, izindleko zendawo yokusebenza, izindleko zokubhaliswa kwezimali, nezindleko zemoto nezithuthi. Izindleko eziyisisekelo - amalayisense ezimoto, amaholo çalışan abaqashiwe, ukuncipha kwezithuthi nezakhiwo, nezindleko ze-inshurensi. Izindleko zangaphandle - intshontsho yemali ebolekiwe, amaholo abaphathi, nokurenta izindlu noma umhlaba. Zonke izindleko zizofana nalokho okukhuluma ngenhla (uma sizihlanganisa zonke). Inenzuzo ifana nalokho okusele ngemuva kokukhipha zonke izindleko. Uma kukhiqizwa, abakhiqizi bangaba abathengi bezintengo (imali engenayo) nezindleko. Kokubili, amanani nezindleko, akhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa ezingeni elihlukile. Isibonelo: ngoMashi 26, 2010, uJ Willemse wabhala kuLandbouweekblad ukuthi ngonyaka ka-2009, inenzuzo yamabhizinisi ezolimo emhlabeni jikelele yakhula ngo-2.6% kulonyaka, kodwa izindleko zakhula ngo-8%. Lezi zilinganiso zihluka minyaka yonke kodwa zakha okuthiwa "ukucindezela kwezindleko-nani." Uma sibheka iminyaka neminyaka, lokhu kungaboniswa njengokuhlelwa okulandelayo (Isithombe 1) (Uhlu lwezinsiza: Willemse, J. 2010, Ukwehla kwezimali kudlulela ezolimo. Landbouweekblad: Mashi 26, 2010). Uma umsebenzi epulazini uqhubeka ngendlela efanayo unyaka nonyaka, umgapho phakathi kwemali engenayo nezindleko zokuhlinzeka izindleko uzovalwa, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukufinyelela inenzuzo. Uma sibheka umsebenzi wethu sigxile ezindabeni zezimali, kubonakala ukuthi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo kufanele kuthuthuke futhi kuqhubeke kukhula ngokuqhubekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ibhizinisi lakho ngeke likwazi ukuqhubeka liphumelele esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma siqhubeka nokunaka le ndaba ukuze ukuphathwa kwemikhakha yebhizinisi kuqhubeke kukhula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Inhloso kufanele kube ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali engenayo ihlale iphakeme kunezindleko (izindleko) ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kuboniswa ku-Isithombe 2 ngezansi. Lokhu akusiyo umsebenzi olula ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingaphandle kokulawula komphathi wepulazi ezingashintsha umkhondo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuyinselelo enkulu kumnikazi/umphathi webhizinisi lezolimo. Ngokwazi umsebenzi, kufanele uhlale ucabanga ngezindaba zezimali eziphathelene nemali engenayo nezindleko (izindleko) lapho wenza noma yini ebhizinisini lakho. Ekuphetheni, singasho ukuthi ukuze ibhizinisi lezolimo libe nenzuzo, kumele lihlinzeke abathengi ngezimpahla/imikhiqizo abayidingayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, abaphathi bamabhizinisi ezolimo kufanele baqinise imizamo yabo ukuze baqhubeke benza inenzuzo esikhathini esizayo, ukuze umsebenzi wabo uhlale uthuthuka.
Izinkinga Zamanzi: Ukubaluleka Kokubhekisisa Nokuxazulula Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, izinkinga zamanzi ziba yinkinga enkulu ethinta abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, kudala izinselele ezinkulu empilweni yethu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi awawona nje umkhiqizo, kodwa ayisisekelo sempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngentengo yokuntuleka kwamanzi. Emazweni amaningi, abantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile bahlupheka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Izingane zikhathazekile, zikhula zinganempilo, futhi imindeni ibhekana nezinkinga ezinzima zokuphila. Ngakho, izinkinga zamanzi zikhombisa ukuthi ziningi izinselelo ezihambisana nezomnotho, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kuyinkinga enkulu. Imifula nezilwandle zikhathazekile ngenxa yokukhishwa kwemfucumfucu, amakhemikhali, nezinsalela zezimboni. Lokhu akuthinti kuphela impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuthinta izilwane nezitshalo ezisebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kudinga izinyathelo zokuqinisa imithetho yokuvikela imithombo yamanzi, ukuze sigweme ukulimala okukhulu. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela emanzini. Ukushisa okwandayo, imvula engapheli, kanye nezimo ezimbi zomoya, kudala ukungabikhona kwamanzi emithonjeni ethile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho imithombo yamanzi ingatholakali kalula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinguquko zesimo sezulu zikhombisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Kumele sikhulume ngamasu okuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kudingeka ukuthi sisebenzisane, sihlanganise imizamo yethu. Imibono yokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, njengokulima okungcono, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, iyadingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi kuthuthukise izinga lempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka kwamanzi nokusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza, kuyadingeka. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi amanzi awawona umkhiqizo ongatholakala kalula, kodwa kufanele aqashelwe njengento ebalulekile empilweni. Izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangawagcina kanjani amanzi. Ekuphetheni, izinkinga zamanzi zidinga izinyathelo ezinzima. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, kudinga ukuhlolwa kwezindlela zokuxazulula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi ayisisekelo sempilo, futhi kufanele siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, kanye nokusebenza ngokubambisana, kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Sifuna ikusasa elingcono, futhi lokho kudinga izinyathelo namuhla. Amanzi awawona nje umkhiqizo, kodwa empeleni, ayimpilo yethu.
Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kumele liphathwe kahle. Ukuba nezicwangciso ezicacile kubalulekile ngoba ziyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zokuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kahle kusho ukuthi imisebenzi emine yokuphatha ibalanced ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka nokuphumelela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lifinyelela ezinhlelweni zalo ezifunwayo futhi lenze inzuzo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha ibandakanya: ukuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa isu, ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo, nokuhlola ukusebenza okuqhubekayo (ukugcina ukulawula). Ukuhlela isu kuyinto ebalulekile kumkhiqizi ngoba kuyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zabo zokulima. Singathi ukuhlela isu kuzokhombisa indlela eya phambili nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni zakho zokuhlanganisa lezi zenzo. Njalo sithi asikwazi ukuhlela izicwangciso ezicacile ekulimaleni. Izizathu zalokhu zimi kanje: kunezinto eziningi ezingalawulwa, ezifana nezimo zezulu, izifo, ukuguquguquka kwemakethe, nezinguquko ezintengo zokufaka nezokukhipha. Lezi zingozi zingavela ekulimaleni; zikhona, futhi sibhekana nazo lapho sizama ukwakha ibhizinisi lokulima. Nokho, siphinda sithi isu eliphukile lingcono kunokungabi naso nhlobo. Kungcono ukuhlela izicwangciso mayelana nonyaka ojwayelekile, bese singakwazi ukuhlela lezi zicwangciso uma izimo zishintsha phakathi kwalonyaka. Yini okufanele kwenzeke? Kuphi okufanele kwenzeke? Nini okufanele kwenzeke? Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhaliwe futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho. Ungabhala izicwangciso zakho kwidiyari, ebhodini, noma kukhompyutha, noma kuphi. Ngokwandisa imibhalo, lokhu kuzokusiza esikhathini eside ngoba uzoba nedatha yomlando ezokusiza uma ubheka phambili. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlela isu kwenzeka minyaka yonke - kuzokwenzekani ngonyaka ozayo emasimini. Kodwa kufanele kube nesu lesikhathi eside elibheka ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini emasimini esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyisu elibanzi elikhombisa ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini esikhathini esizayo - leso sikhathi singaba yiminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphezulu. Isibonelo: ukutshala izitshalo ezithengiswayo kumahhektare angu-500, ukukhiqiza inyama emasimini, nokukhulisa amaqanda. Lokhu kuzokhombisa imisebenzi ejwayelekile okufanele yenziwe ngonyaka ozayo, njengokupenda indlu ethile, ukwakha udonga oluthile, ukulungisa izakhiwo, ukuthenga imishini emisha, ukuya ezinsukwini zokuqeqesha abalimi, njll. Kuzokhiqizwa ini ngonyaka ozayo, kuzokhiqizwa kangakanani, futhi kuzothengiswa kanjani? Tshalani amahektare angu-400 ommbila ukuze asetshenziswe emasimini, okusele kuzothengiswa ngenkontileka endaweni eseduze ukukhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane. Tshalani amahektare angu-100 wezinhlanzi ukuze athengiswe ngenkontileka. Khiqiza ama-calves angu-200 aneminyaka engu-20 ezivandeni ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza amaqanda angu-40,000 ngenyanga azothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda umgwaqo wokusebenza kanye nesikhala se-traktor. Yakha idamu emaplotini angu-9. Lungisa futhi uphathe zonke izakhiwo. Ngokusebenzisa isu lonyaka - elijwayelekile nelikhiqizayo - isu lenyanga lingathuthukiswa. Ngokuvamile - penda umgwaqo wokusebenza kanye nesikhala se-traktor. Isu lokukhiqiza - ummbila: hlola zonke izinkambu; amahlamvu: thina amahektare angu-100. Izinkomo - nikeza ukudla kwehlobo kuzo zonke izilwane, nikeza ama-calves izithako, susa izinkomo ezindala, hlola isisindo sazo, zibhalise, treat ama-calves ngomedicine, bheka isisindo sezo zonke izilwane. Amaqanda - phatha zonke izinsuku, thengisa ezindlini ezimbili, lungisa izindlu ezintathu zezikukhu ezintsha. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, izicwangciso zamasonto zingathuthukiswa zaleyo nyanga. Isisekelo sezicwangciso zamasonto yizicwangciso zenyanga, izicwangciso ezivamile, nezicwangciso zokukhiqiza. Isu sokugcina singaba isu lwenyanga elenziwa ekupheleni kwesonto elidlule elichaza kahle konke okudingeka kwenziwe esontweni elizayo. Isibonelo: Isonto 9 - Meyi 13, 2011. (Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalolo suku zixubene etafuleni 1). Susa ama-calves angu-100 ezivandeni, ubabhalise, ubaphathe ngomedicine, bheka isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi izicwangciso azinakuma, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini zokulima emasimini. Kunezinto eziningi ezingalindelekile ezingavela, ezifana nezikhukhula ezinkampanini, ukuwa kwezakhiwo, izifo ezilwaneni, njll. Ukuhlela isu kuyinto yokuphatha ngoba kuyisisekelo sokuphatha nokuhlinzeka okuzoxoxwa ngakho emibhalweni ezayo. Ngaphandle kokuhlela isu, ngeke kube nokuphathwa kahle ngoba izicwangciso ziyiwo umsebenzi ophambili wokuphatha; ngezicwangciso, singaphatha umsebenzi kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa, ukuhlinzeka, nokulawula okuqinile, umphathi kumele abe nezenzo eziphumelelayo ekwenzeni eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuhlela, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bakhe, ukubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze kahle, ukuwasekela, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha ngokuqinile. Ukunakwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi.
uThabo Mbeki - Umholi Ohloniphekayo UThabo Mbeki ungumholi ophawulekayo kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, owabamba isikhundla sikaMengameli phakathi kweminyaka ka-1999 no-2008. Wazalelwa eMbizana, edolobheni eliseMpumalanga Kapa, ngomhla ziyi-18 kuMfumfu ngowe-1942. Uthando lwakhe kwezombusazwe lwaqala ngesikhathi esenhlangano eNyuvesi yaseTshwane, lapho athola khona ukuqonda okujulile ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokwehlukaniswa kwabantu. Lokhu kwehlukaniswa kwaba umthombo wezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwezakhamuzi ezahlukene. Njengomholi we-ANC (iAfrican National Congress), uThabo Mbeki wathatha izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane, edlala indima ebalulekile ekuphishekeni nasekukhululekeni. Umsebenzi wakhe wahlanganisa nokusekela uNelson Mandela, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo esinamandla ekuphikisaneni nobandlululo. Ukwaziswa kukaMbeki kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, njengoba waba nobudlelwano obuhle nezinye izizwe. Uhlanga lwakhe lokubambisana lwaholela ekwakheni izivumelwano ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, umnotho, nezokuhlalisana. Ngalesi sikhathi, uMbeki wahola izifundo eziningi zamazwe ase-Afrika, ethuthukisa umbono wokwakha umnotho oqinile nokuxhumanisa amazwe. Ngemva kokuphothulwa kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili njengomengameli, uThabo Mbeki wabhekana nezihe ezinzima. Iziphikiso ezivela emiphakathini mayelana nezinqumo zakhe, ikakhulukazi ezimayelana nezindaba zokusebenza kazwelonke, zakhumbuza abanye ukuthi uMbeki ungumholi ongenamahloni, ophikisana nezimvo zomphakathi. Nokho, akumelanga kulahlekelwe umbono omuhle owawuhambisana noMbeki. Waziwa nangokusebenzisa izindlela eziphusile zokuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima, okuholele emthethweni omkhulu empilweni yabantu. UThabo Mbeki ubalulekile emlandweni wombuso waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi umbono wakhe wokwakha i-Afrika eqinile usaqhubeka nokuphila. Njengomholi, wayenobuhlakani obumangalisayo, ezama ukuhlanganisa abantu bezizinda ezihlukene ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Ubuye abe yisibonelo sokuthi ubuholi obuhle busekelwe ekuthandeni abantu, ukuhlonipha izidingo zabo, kanye nokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Izimvo zikaMbeki mayelana nezindaba ezinjengobandlululo, umnotho, nezokuphepha zihlala zikhona emqondweni wabantu. Akumangalisi ukuthi, izithombe ezibhalwe uMbeki zikhumbuza izizukulwane ezizayo mayelana nemithwalo ethwala ubuholi. UThabo Mbeki, njengomholi, ukhumbuleka ngokukhuthaza izakhamuzi ukuba zithathe izinyathelo ezizothuthukisa isimo sabo, nokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Kulo mhlaba wezezimali eziguqukayo, uMbeki ubalulekile ekuphakamiseni umqondo wokubambisana kanye nokwakha izixazululo ezizinzile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ugxile ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwe-Afrika nezinye izifunda zomhlaba, edinga ukuqaphela ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile, futhi uphakamisa umqondo wokuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufaka isandla ekwakheni izwe elingcono. Noma kunini lapho uThabo Mbeki edlula, uthinta abantu ngezwi lakhe elinamandla, elikhuthaza. Umsebenzi wakhe usaqhubeka nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezintsha, ubafundisa ukuthi ubuholi buhamba nezinhlelo ezithile, futhi kufanele kube nokuzimisela okukhulu ukuze uphumelele. UThabo Mbeki ungumholi obekwe emlandweni, futhi izenzo zakhe zikhumbula izifundo ezibalulekile ezizothinta umhlaba ngezizukulwane ezizayo. Ngaphandle komqondo wakhe, izinto eziningi ezikhona namuhla zingase zingabikhona. Ngokubhala lokhu, sikhumbula uThabo Mbeki, umholi owayenobuhlakani, ubuholi obuqotho, nothando lwempilo yomphakathi. Uhambo lwakhe luhlala lukhumbuleka, njengoba ethinta abantu abaningi ngeqhaza lakhe emlandweni wobumbano, ekwakheni umphakathi onokuthula, nolwazi oluqinile. UThabo Mbeki uyisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani, ubuholi, nokuzimisela zingaholela ekuthuthukiseni izwe.
Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amathayi akho efemini ngendlela efanele luzokusiza ukuthi usebenze ngokuphepha futhi unciphise izindleko kanye nok damage kumasimu nasemhlabathini. Ukushayela efemini kusho ukusebenza ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene - ukulima emasimini nokuhambisa ithreyi emgwaqweni ophukile. Lokhu kuyahluka, kodwa kukhona umlayezo obalulekile okufanele ulandelwe njalo. Lapho sikhuluma ngamatayi, kunezinto ezibalulekile: hlanganisa uhlobo lwamathayi nohlobo lomsebenzi (ukusebenza emanzini, isihlabathi esithambile, njll.), landela imihlahlandlela yomkhiqizi mayelana nosayizi nolwazi lwamathayi, ikakhulukazi hlanganisa ingcindezi yomoya nesisindo somthwalo nendawo lapho kusetshenziswa khona. Umoya kuphela ngaphakathi kwethayi ophatha umthwalo othile, futhi abakhiqizi bamathayi abafana neGoodyear bakhombisa umthwalo wethayi ethile, ingcindezi, kanye nezinga lesivinini. Uma uthwala okuthile okukhulu kakhulu kodwa ungakhuphuli ingcindezi yomoya, kuzokwenza amathayi aguge futhi aphume ngokushesha, okuzokwenza imishini ingasebenzi kahle futhi amathayi azoguga ngokushesha. Uma umthwalo unheavy futhi amathayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele, ithayi izophenduka ohlangothini futhi imiphetho yethayi ingaguga futhi ithayi izophuka njengoba ihamba. Amathayi e-bias noma e-crossply ajwayele ukuphenduka ohlangothini uma umthwalo unheavy kakhulu futhi ingcindezi iphansi uma amavhili edonswa kanzima, umzimba wonke wethayi uzonakaliswa. Ithayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele ingaphuma emgqonyeni futhi i-bead ingaphuka, futhi lapho ithayi ibamba khona emgqonyeni kuzonakaliswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi: uma ithayi inengcindezi eningi kakhulu, iba qinile kakhulu, okwenza ithayi lithinte kuphela umgwaqo ngaphakathi futhi liguge lapho. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi ithayi lonke alithinti umhlaba, futhi alikwazi ukubamba kahle, lizophuma futhi lihlasele umhlabathi. Uma kudingeka ukusebenza ngamathayi ezimo lapho kudingeka khona, amathayi azohamba kalula. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulungisa ingcindezi ngokuya ngezimo zokusebenza, njengokuhambisa ithreyi noma emshinini, noma ukushayela emgwaqweni ophukile. Inani lengcindezi yamathayi libalulekile, kodwa ukusebenzisa ithayi enengcindezi ehlukile kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni kwamavhili nasecingweni sayo emhlabeni. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona izitshalo nezimpande ngaphansi komhlaba, kungaba kuhle ukusebenza ngethayi elibanzi elinengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela imishini ukuthi ithwale umthwalo ofanayo njengethayi elincane ngobubanzi kodwa eliqinile emoyeni - leli thayi lizojwayela ukunyakaza kalula emhlabeni futhi liqinise umhlabathi. Ngokufanayo, esihlabathini, ithayi elibanzi elingaqinile kakhulu lizobamba kangcono ngoba linendawo enkulu yokubamba - lihamba phezu kwesihlabathi, lingadli. Kungcono ukusebenzisa ukudlula kwemoto ezimeni lapho umhlaba ungaphatheki kahle, kodwa ungasebenzisa lokhu emgwaqweni ophukile noma emgwaqweni eqinile ngoba kudala ukuguga okungalingani kumathayi aphambili, okwenza ukushayela kube nzima nokusebenzisa ezinye izingxenye ngendlela elahlekile amandla.
Incazelo Yomcimbi: Umcimbi Wezokuthengisa – "Imisebenzi Nezinhlelo Zokuthengisa Ezintsha" Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wezokuthengisa uzobanjwa umcimbi omkhulu ozoqa umgudu wokuhlanganisa abathengisi, abacwaningi, nezimboni ezahlukahlukene ukuze baxoxe ngezindlela ezintsha, imikhuba, nezinsizakusebenza ezithinta ezokuthengisa. Lo mcimbi, ozoqala ngosuku lwesi-15 kuJanuwari 2024, uzoba seHhotela Lezokuphila eGoli, uhlanganisa abaholi abavela ezinkampanini ezinkulu, abathuthukisi bezobuchwepheshe, kanye nabathengisi abakha izixazululo ezisheshayo nezisemqoka ukuze bathole impumelelo. Umcimbi uzokwenza isikhala sokuxhumana phakathi kwababukeli nabakhangisi, uvula amathuba okudala ubudlelwane obusendabuko nolwakhiwo lwezinhlelo zokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo ezihlukahlukene zizoqhutshwa ngochwepheshe abanolwazi, behlola izindaba ezithinta izokuthengisa, njengokuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, indlela yokwakha umkhiqizo, nokubaluleka kokuxhumana nabathengi. Izingxenye zomcimbi zifaka izingxoxo, izifundo ezibukhoma, kanye nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abaphambili emhlabeni wezokuthengisa. Izingxoxo ezizokwenziwa zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimbonini ezahlukene bazokwazi ukuthola imibono emisha, befa iziqondisi nezindlela zokuphumelela ezinobuhlakani. NgoMgqibelo, lo mcimbi uzodlulisa ikhethini lokugcina lapho abathengisi bazoba nekhono lokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta imikhiqizo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izimpendulo ezicacile nemibono emisha ukuze kuxhunywe nemikhiqizo yezinkampani ezihlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amathuba okuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nezinkampani azokwakha ibhizinisi eligqugquzelayo emhlabeni okukhuluma ngempumelelo. Ngaphakathi kokuhlangana, umcimbi uzolalela izihloniphekile ezikhuluma ngezinto ezibucayi ezithinta izokuthengisa, ukujula kokuqonda okuhlobene nokuthengisa, nezindlela zokuhamba phambili kwakamuva. Uhlelo luzokwakhiwa ukuze lunikeze abahlanganyeli izinzuzo ezisheshwayo, ezingafaka izindlela ezingabo, izibonelo ezihamba phambili, nezindlela zokwengamela emhlabeni obunjwe ngabathengi abashintsha. Abalaleli bazoba nethuba lokukhetha izifundo ezithile ezifunekayo ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zabathengi futhi bakhe amasu aqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bazoba nokuheha ezimakethe zabo, okukhuthaza ukuhamba phambili komkhiqizo kanye nokusebenza kohlelo lokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kokuphumelela komcimbi, kuzophinde kube nezinhlelo zokwazisa ezithinta abathengisi abasha, kube yithuba lokubakhuthaza ukuba babe ngabathengisi abaqavile esizweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsizwa ezintsha kanye nomoya wokuthuthukisa. Umcimbi uzokwazisa abathengisi mayelana nezinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze benze ukuthengisa kwabo kube nokusebenza okuhle kakhulu, bobuqu nemikhawulo abayithola emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ekwandiseni ibhizinisi, kudale umbono wokwakha okwamanje. Umgomo wethu ukwakha indawo yokuxhumana ezokuthengisa, ukuxhumanisa ulwazi nemibhikisho, okugqugquzela ukusebenzisana nokuqonda okukhulayo. Sinethemba lokuthi lo mcimbi uzoba nempumela ejabulisayo, okuhloswe ngayo ukwakha izimpendulo ezinemisebenzi emisha nokwenza ngcono amasu okuthengisa. Ababamba iqhaza bayamenywa, kanye nalabo abakhathazekile ngokuthengisa, ukuze basebenzise ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye abathengisi ezingakabalungeli. Ukuze uqophele imicimbi, sikhuthaza bonke ukuthumela izicelo zabo zokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuzokwakha isikhala sokukhuluma ezimeni ezithinta intuthuko yezokuthengisa, kanti ukuthola izixazululo ezinqala kuzoba yindlela eyodwa yokukhweza izinyathelo zokuthengisa ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Umcimbi uzobe ubukeka njengethuba lokubambisana okukhuthazayo, sibambisene ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wezezimali nezokuthengisa. Thina, kulindeleke ukuba sibe maphakathi nokuhlangenwe nakho kwemisebenzi emisha, bekhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obutsha nezinkulumo eziphumelela ngemibono ehluke ngokuphelele nezindlela ezithinta izokuthengisa. Sibheke phambili ekuthokoziseni abaphumelelayo futhi sizobona impumelelo aleli thuba. Kuhle kakhulu ukuba khona. Hamba nathi ukuze sikhule, sithuthuke, futhi sikhulume ngezinto ezithinta ubuhlakani bezokuthengisa ezikhanya. Izinhlelo, izixazululo, kanye nosizo olukhulu kufanele kuhlangane okukhuthazayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha ikusasa elihle, eliphumelelayo ekuthengiseni.
Sikhumbulile ukuthi ibhola lizongena kanjani enethini? Kunemali eningi ekhokhwa yiMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe, iMnyango Wezolimo, ama-trusts ahlukene ezitshalo, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezithengisa izinto zokwakha, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene ezizama ukuthuthukisa ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Kodwa singabuza futhi: yisiphi isiphumo? Ukuthuthukisa nokukhulisa abalimi kuhambisana nokuthuthukisa abantu emhlabeni. Abantu, ikakhulukazi labo abafanele, kumele baphumelele, bakhule, bafunde, futhi bathole ulwazi. Lapho sibheka ukuthuthukisa abalimi, asibheki kuphela ukuthi ubani okhiqiza ukudla okuningi kunezinye; sigxila ekusizeni abanye abalimi ukuba bathole ulwazi oluzobasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokulima ngendlela esekela ukuphila kwabo futhi kulethe inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Uma sifuna ukwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu, kubalulekile ukubheka umuntu oyedwa ozama. Futhi kumele sibheke labo abasemaphandleni, umphakathi, futhi siqonde ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza zemvelo ezizobasiza - kumele sithuthukise lokhu. Kulula nje ukungena endaweni ethile bese ukhombisa izinto ezingadingekile, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi uzobasiza ukwenza konke abakuthandayo. Kuzokwenzeka ukuthini uma ungaphumeleli ukubasiza? Kumele sithathe izandla zabantu lapho bekhona manje futhi sibakhombise indlela phambili ngokucophelela, kancane, ukuze bajwayele ukuthi imithetho nokuphila kuyashintsha. Kumele sibathumele endaweni abazophila khona ngokuthula, endaweni abakhululekile kuyo (hhayi lapho sithanda khona ukuthi bame)? Inhloso yabantu abaningi ivame ukuba: "okuningi kungcono." Iqiniso, nokho, ukuthi umuntu othile kumele aqale endaweni ethile, noma ngabe kuwumsebenzi omncane. Kunabalimi abaningi abaqonda kuphela ezolimo njengendlela yokuphila - abanandaba nokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ukuze kuthengiswe - futhi lokhu kulungile. Bese kuba nabanye abalimi abakhuluma kahle futhi bafisa ukuba abalimi abakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Bese kuba abalimi abakhulu abaqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele (kodwa nabo baqala ezingeni eliphansi futhi baqhubeka nokukhula). Uma imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa abantu izoba namandla futhi ibe nezinzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kumele sithole labo bantu ezindaweni abakhona futhi siqale lapho - akukhathazi kakhulu (anginankathazo ngalokhu) ukubona abaqashi abakhulu abangena emhlabeni kodwa balima, babheke izitshalo, baphumelele, futhi baphinde baphawule ukuthi benza umsebenzi "wokuthuthukiswa kwabalamli" - cha! Lokhu akukhulisi; bangangena kuphela kulezo zindawo. Eqinisweni, abalimi bangase bahlale kulezo zindawo ngoba izindleko zamanje ziphezulu - bese abaqashi bethatha ingxenye yenhlalakahle (badla kabili kanti umalimi udla lutho). Ake sibuyisele ezibalulekile futhi siqonde ukuthi singawathuthukisa kanjani abantu. Uma izinkundla zakho zilimwa umqashi omkhulu, cabanga kahle ukuthi ufuna ukufika kuphi ekugcineni - ufuna ukuba umalimi noma ufuna ukuba umqashi wezolimo?
Ithenisi: Umlando, Izimiso, Nezindlela Zokudlala Ithenisi, umdlalo owenziwa phakathi kwabantu ababili (singles) noma phakathi kwezixuku ezimbili (doubles), unomlando omude futhi uthokozisa abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Umdlalo uqala emakhulwini ambalwa edlule eFransi, lapho abathandi bokuqala bezama ukujabulisa abantu ngokudlala umdlalo ophakathi kokuphonsa ibhola nokuqhubeka nokulibamba. Ngemuva kwalokho, ithenisi lathuthuka laba umdlalo owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi namuhla, luhlala lunomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abaningi. Umdlalo we-ithenisi udlalwa emkhakheni obizwa nge-court, ophakathi kwama-rectangle amabili ahlukaniswe ngentambo. Abadlali baphonsa ibhola phezu kwentambo, bejolise ekutholeni amaphuzu. Zikhona izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-court, njenge-grass court, i-clay court, kanye ne-hard court, ngayinye inezinhloso zayo ezithile nezindlela zokudlala ezihlukile. Izimiso zethenisi ziqala ngokuthi umphakathi kufanele uqonde kahle imithetho eyisisekelo. Umdlalo uqala ngokuphosa ibhola, umphosa kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lidlula entanjeni, uma engaphumelelanga, umphakathi uthola iphuzu. Umdlalo uqhubeka ngalendlela, futhi umphakathi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi ubamba ibhola ngaphambi kokuba lihambe phansi kabili. Lokhu kuhilela ubuchwepheshe, ukuzithiba, kanye nesineke. Ithenisi idinga amakhono ahlukahlukene, okufaka phakathi ukushaya, ukujolisa, nokuhamba. Abadlali badinga ukukwazi ukujolisa kahle ibhola ukuze baphumelele. Ukushaya ibhola ngendlela efanele kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezobuchwepheshe, njengokubamba ibhola ngendlela efanele, ukuhamba kahle emkhakheni, nokusebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla nokuziphatha kahle, njengoba umphakathi kufanele uhlale ungena emkhakheni futhi ube nesineke ukuze uzuze impumelelo. Ithenisi iyinsiza yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali bahlangana emncintiswaneni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa imijaho yeGrand Slam efana ne-Wimbledon, i-US Open, i-French Open, kanye ne-Australian Open. Lezi zinkanyezi zenza umphakathi ubonakale emhlabeni jikelele, futhi zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele empumelelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ithenisi ithuthukisa impilo yomzimba, ibalulekile ekwakheni amandla, ukujula, nokuphila kahle. Umdlalo we-ithenisi unethonya elikhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi ezizukulwaneni ezincane. Abantwana abavame ukudlala ithenisi bathola amathuba amaningi okukhula, ukuthola ubungane, nokufunda amakhono amasha. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokukhulisa ukuzethemba, njengoba abantwana befunda ukubhekana nezinselelo, ukuphumelela, nokwehluleka, okuyinto ebalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esiqinile nesinokuzimisela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ithenisi iyinsiza yokwakha umphakathi. Imicimbi ye-ithenisi ivame ukuheha abantu abaningi, kubandakanya abathandi bomdlalo, osaziwayo, nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kudala amathuba okuxhumana, okuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Umdlalo ungumthombo wokuthokozisa, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ekugcineni, ithenisi akugcini nje ngokuba umdlalo, kodwa kuyinsiza yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuthuthukisa impilo, nokukhuthaza umphakathi. Umphakathi we-ithenisi uqhubeka nokukhula, uthokozisa abantu ngezizathu eziningi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abanye ukuba badlale ithenisi, ukuze sibe nomphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Ithenisi, ngempela, iyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sithokozise ngokujabula.
