uToyota: Ummbila Wokuhamba Esimeni Esisha U- Toyota, leli gama elaziwa kabanzi emhlabeni jikelele, akukhona nje ukuthi uveza imodeli yezimoto eziphezulu, kodwa ungumfanekiso ohloniphekile wombono wokuhamba ophumelelayo. U- Toyota akakhethi kahle kuphela, kodwa uveza umbono wezinto ezinhle ezihambayo. Ngenhlonipho enkulu, ngifuna ukwabelana ngombono wami ngomlando, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemiphumela yokuphila kule mikhakha, okwenza u- Toyota abe yinsika enkulu emhlabeni wezokuhamba. Umlando KaToyota Umlando kaToyota uqala eminyakeni engama-80 edlule, lapho uqala khona njengomkhiqizi wezicabha ezishisayo. Ubuchwepheshe babo buye baba yisisekelo sokuphumelela kwenkampani, behlanganisa amasu okwakha imoto angcono, aphumelelayo futhi ahlekisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iToyota ithole impumelelo enkulu ngokwakha izimoto ezijabulisayo futhi ezontanga. Izimoto ezidumile, ezifana neToyota Corolla neCamry, zibonisa ukuthi uToyota akakhethi umkhakha; usebenza ezimfashini ezahlukene ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ubuchwepheshe Obuhluke Kakhulu U- Toyota ungumholi ngabanye emkhakheni wabathuthukisi bezimoto. Lawa maphakathi ngenxa yokuzinikela kwabo ezinhlelweni, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha. U- Toyota waziwa ngokwakhiwa kwezimoto ze-hybrid, okuyinto eyenziwe ukuze ilondoloze amandla futhi inciphise imikhawulo. Lokhu kuhambisana nemizamo yokuvikela imvelo, okuvusa umuzwa wokunakekela ihlathi lethu. Ukusebenza kwabo kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili kulethe izimoto ezikhumbulekayo ezibanjwe ngamakhasimende emazwe amaningi, ngenxa yokonga ugesi nokunciphisa ama-sustainability. Imiphumela Yempilo Elokhu iToyota isiza ekwakhiweni komphakathi. Izenzo zayo zikhuthaza umbono wokuhamba onobulungiswa, okubandakanya izinqubo zokuphepha ezithuthukile. Ukuze uToyota ahlangabezane nezidingo zamakhasimende, bakwazile ukuthuthukisa amamodeli anokwakhiwa okukhulu, izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima, nezithuthi ezihlangabezana nezidingo zezwe lesimanjemanje. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola imoto efanelekile kumuntu ngamunye, okwenza umphakathi ubambe iqhaza elibanzi kulezi zinhlelo. Ubuqotho Bekhwalithi U- Toyota uthanda ukuhamba phambili nezinga elikhulu lokwakhiwa, okwenza kube lula ukuba nempilo ende ngemoto yabo. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa yizibuyekezo ezinhle ezivela kumakhasimende, okusho ukuthi ikhasimende lithembekile futhi lizitholele ividiyo eyodwa, yaMrs. Ndelu, ogcine imoto yakhe yaqala Mhlobo 1999 iyasebenza kahle. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, uma usukele imoto yeToyota, ungakwenzi kuphela ukuze uhambise, kodwa ungakwenza futhi njengengxenye yempilo yakho yansuku zonke. Izindleko and Umnotho Uma sizama ukuthola imoto, uToyota ungowokuhlola, ngenxa yokuba nezindleko ezilinganiselwe. U- Toyota uhlale engcono umkhiqizo uma kuziwa enhliziyweni yokuhamba. Lokhu kudala umnotho okhukhulayo, njengoba imoto yeToyota izoba yinketho eqhelelekile ezithuthweni ezithile. Ukuze utholakale isikhathi eside, ezinhlobonhlobo zenzile ukwakha imoto yeToyota, kanti lokhu kudalula indlela yokwabelana nomphakathi wabo. Kuthokozisa Uthando Lwangempela Ngaphandle kokuba uToyota ungumkhiqizo, ungumndeni. U- Toyota ushintshe umbono wami wokuhamba, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo esiyihambayo iyathokozisa. Ngoba kube yinzima ku-prodigy, ingase idalule umuzwa wokuhamba, kodwa iToyota iphethe noxolo kabani enhliziyweni. Ukuze uthole isipiliyoni esihambisanayo namabhizinisi, u- Toyota uvuma ukuthanda, ukuxhumana nangesipho samadoda nabesifazane ngobuqotho. Isiphetho Ngokubuka kwakho, uToyota akuphathe kahle umqondo wokuhamba. U- Toyota ungumkhiqizi wezimoto osiza abantu ngezindlela eziphusile, ezikhuthazayo futhi ezihlala zihlanzekile. Ukuthokoza kwabo ekwakheni imoto efanelekile, okwakhetha umphakathi ophelele, kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngakho, usuku lonke, uma uhamba neToyota, uyawuhlonipha umnyama wezimoto, uhlezi uhamba phambili. Kaningi sithola umbono ophumile wekhono eliyinhloko, uToyota ungumgibeli ophumelelayo, thina bonke rero sithimele izinkinga ezisiza ukuhamba kahle.
Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye (GEMS dependent member classification) Ngaphakathi komphakathi wethu, izinsiza zempilo zibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono, futhi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Kule ndaba, sizobheka indlela ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS dependent member classification, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kufanele siqale ngemuva, sibuye sithathe isinyathelo esibheke phambili. I-GEMS, okuyi-Government Employees Medical Scheme, yasungulwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakukhona umqondo wokuthi abasebenzi bangathola izinzuzo ezihlukahlukene, hhayi kuphela bona, kodwa nakwabanye abantu abaxhumene nabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwesigaba sokuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukiswa ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zezikhathi. Izinqubomgomo zayo zashintsha, zafaka phakathi ukuhlela kahle amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izigaba ezahlukene zamalungu, okuhlanganisa abashadile, abantwana, kanye nabanye abaxhumene nabo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abangenamali eyanele yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinguquko azizange zibe lula. Abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo. Abanye babengazi kahle ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani lezi zinsizakalo, kanti abanye babengazi ukuthi bangakwazi yini ukufaka amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibuzo eminingi, futhi kwavula ithuba lokuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Njengoba i-GEMS iqhubeka nokukhula, kwavela izidingo ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Ukuze abantu bazi kahle izigaba zabo, kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezikhangiso, ama-workshops, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhethekile. Ngale ndlela, abantu baqala ukuqonda kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kwavula amathuba okwenza izinqumo ezibalulekile. Abantu bangaqonda kahle ukuthi bangakhetha kanjani izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekwandeni kwemfundo nokwazi. Ukuhlukaniswa kwaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe kahle izinsiza zabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba izinsizakalo zempilo zanda, kubonakala ukuthi kukhona abantu abathola izinzuzo ezincane, noma abanye abangalitholi lutho. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezinkinga ezithile, futhi kwavula ithuba lokuxoxisana ngalezi zinkinga. Abantu baqala ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokubheka le ndaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo. Kukhona nezifundo ezibalulekile esizitholayo, ezifana nokuthi kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ku-GEMS kube yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Kule ndaba, sithole izifundo eziningi, futhi sikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zibalulekile, kodwa ukufundisa abantu nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile kubalulekile kakhulu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi onempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuxhumana, sifundise, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphathe kahle izinsizakalo zabo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono.
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Isidingo Esibalulekile Somphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubonakala ukuthi impilo yempilo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu. Izikhungo zezempilo ziyingxenye ebalulekile yalesi simo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho kutholakala izinsiza ezinzima. Kwaze kwaba nezikhungo eziyi-72 ezisemthethweni ezweni lethu, futhi ngempela lezi zindawo zenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi. Uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha, kodwa futhi kuyingxenye yesithunzi somphakathi. Izindawo ezinjalo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngomsabalalisi wezinsizakalo, ziqinisa imiphakathi yokuvikela, futhi zisebenza njengemithombo eyisisekelo yokufundisa abantu ngempilo yabo. Ngokuvamile, izikhungo zezempilo zinekhamphani yokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlangana kuholela ekubeni kwenziwe izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezinzuzo ezithinta izifundo eziphathelene nezempilo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza ekwakheni imibono ethokozisayo mayelana nezigameko zezempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwavela izinselelo eziningi. Imishini yokusebenza ibalulekile, kodwa izinsiza ezingama-72 azikaze zibe nenkinga yokufinyelela. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zisebenze ngokubambisana nezimboni zendawo ukuze ziqinise ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Lokhu kungenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini nasezindaweni ezithintekayo ngezindawo ezingama-72. Ngaphandle kokuthi izikhungo zezempilo zisetshenziswe kanjani, abasebenzi bezempilo nabo banendima ephawulekayo. Abasebenzi bahlala bephakeme, behola inqubomgomo yokwelapha nokuqeqesha umphakathi. Lo msebenzi ungabhekwa njengomsebenzi onzima, kodwa uma abasebenzi beba nekhono lokukhuluma kahle, lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuthola ukuxhaswa yilabo abakwaziyo. Ukuze lezi zikhungo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda imiphakathi ezungezile. Ndawonye, sizokwazi ukuzama ukwakha izixazululo ezenzakalelayo ezisemqoka, futhi siphendule izidingo ezihlukahlukene zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukumemezela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezihloniphekile, njengoba lokhu kuzoholela ekuthandeni nasekuphathweni okuhle. Ngokukhalipha, imithombo yokuxhumana ibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwezikhungo ezingama-72, sikhuluma ngebhizinisi lokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, olukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezindabeni ezithinta impilo. Lapho abantu benolwazi, bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, futhi basebenzisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze baqinisekise impilo yabo. Esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukugcina imisebenzi yethu ibambisene. Izikhungo zezempilo zingaba yizikhangiso ezinkulu zokuhlanganisa imiphakathi, futhi zinhle kakhulu uma zigijima ngokubambisana. Ukusebenza ngasikhathi sinye kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa futhi ubalulekile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Ngendlela, izindawo zezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zithinta impilo yethu, ngempela. Zithanda ukweluleka abantu, zibhale izindlela zokuphila eziphusile, futhi zedlulisela ulwazi olubalulekile kumphakathi. Njengoba sizama ukwengeza lezi zikhungo, sinesibindi sokulahla izithiyo ezivaleleka, sigqugquzela ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Konke lokho kuncike kuphela kumphakathi wethu. Ngamanye amazwi, umehluko ubalulekile ngenxa yokusebenza kwethu ngabanye. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zidinga usizo lwethu, futhi uma sihamba phambili, lapho izinkinga zempilo zingaba neqhaza elincane empilweni yethu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze ukuhlinzeka ngokuphila okubushelelezi nokukhula kwemiphakathi yethu. Ngakho, khumbula, izikhungo zezempilo zingama-72 akusikho kuphela ngaphandle kwempilo, kepha zinhle zikhona ngempela. Izindawo ezinjalo zidinga ukusekelwa, zidinga ukukhuthazwa, futhi zidinga ubumbano lwethu. Njengabantu, ngeke sizame ukufunda nokuhlola izindlela ezingama-72 ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyavuma. Ukuba kudinga ukuba tenga nathi, sizogcina sithokozile ekuphileni, kuba nethuba lokwakha umphakathi ozinzile nohlanganyele.
Umculo: Izindlela Zokuwuqonda Nokuwudlala Umculo ungumthombo obalulekile wokwazisa, ukujabulela, kanye nokuxhumana. Ukuze umqondo wakho umculo ube sobala, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizinda zawo, izindlela zokuwudlala, nezimpande zawo. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izinyathelo ezahlukene zokufunda, ukuwudlala, nokuwuqonda ngempela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Uhlanga Lomculo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo unohlanga olunhlobonhlobo. Uhlanga lomculo lungahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi, njengegitar, ibhendi, noma emkhakheni wombhoshongo wezokuziqhenya. Qonda ukuthi ubani umculi, yiziphi izinsimbi ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nesiko elihambisana nomculo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle umculo. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsimbi Nezindlela Zokudlala Izinsimbi zomculo zihluke kakhulu. Zifaka phakathi izinsimbi ezinjengepiyano, igitar, nezinsimbi zomoya ezifana nama-trumpets nama-flutes. Qala ngezinsimbi ezilula ukufunda, njengegitar. Thola izincwadi zokufunda noma sebenzisa izifundo ze-inthanethi ezikufundisa izisekelo zokudlala. Uma usulungele, phambili ufunde ukudlala izigqi ezinzima. Isinyathelo 3: Ukucula Noma Ukuqamba Umdlalo Uma ungumculi, ungakhetha ukuhamba phambili ngokucula. Ukucula kudinga umoya, uthando, kanye nezindlela zokucacisa imicabango yakho. Cabanga ngendaba ofuna ukuyicacisa; ungabhalela izinkondlo noma umyalezo othile, bese uzama ukukhipha imizwa yakho ngolimi lomculo. Umculo ungumthombo omuhle wokukhombisa imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuxhumana Ngezinga Lomculo Umculo unethonya elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Khetha umculo okukhombisa umoya wesiko lakho. Ungabambisana nabanye, udale amaphrojekthi omculo, noma udlale emikhosini. Lokhu kuzokwenza ufinyelele ezindleleni eziningi zokuxhumana nezinye izinkolo nezinkanyezi. Isinyathelo 5: Phumelela Ngezifundo Zomculo Ukufunda umculo akupheli. Bheka izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono akho. Ungafunda ngezincwadi ezahlukene, ubhalisele izinhlelo, noma uhlale uthola umculo ongena mahhala kwi-inthanethi. Hamba nemicimbi, hlola izikhala ezitholakalayo, nomphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ufunde izitayela ezahlukene, imiphakathi, nezinkanyezi zomculo. Isinyathelo 6: Yabelana Ngomculo Njengoba uqhubeka nokuqonda umculo, ungakhuthaza abaculi abasha. Yabelana ngolwazi lwakho, uqhubeke nokuqinisa izindlela zokudlala, futhi ukhuthaze abanye ukuba baziqhenye ngemicabango yabo. Umculo unika ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwane, futhi ngokubambisana ungadala imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 7: Jabulela Umculo Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Umculo ungumnikazi wezinto ezinhle; ungama-banda, izinhlelo zokwakha, noma izigcawu ezinkulu zemicimbi. Gcina uhlanganisa okuthandayo, ujabulele izinsuku ezihlukile zokwakha umoya. Ujule ekuthuthukiseni ukuzijabulisa ngamaqhawe nezinkanyezi ezivelele emculweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza uhambisane nesiko nomculo. Isiphetho: Ukuqhubeka Nokufunda Umculo Emhlabeni wamanje, umculo ungendlela ebalulekile yokuxhumana; ungasiza empilweni yethu. Sizoqhubeka sifundisa abantu ukuthi baphile umculo, bawuqonde, bawuqhube, futhi baphume umculo baphishekela izinjongo zabo. Ngakho-ke, thatha isinyathelo, thola umculo, bese ujabulela ukuhamba kwezwe lomculo. Ukuze umculo uphile, kudinga umsebenzi, uthando, nomoya wokubambisana. Zizwe ukhululekile njalo emculweni wakho, futhi phumeza izinto ezinkulu.
Ihhovisi likaMeya lenza umkhankaso wokhetho lwezimeya ophokophele ukuthola ukwesekwa kwemiphakathi nokuphendula ezidingweni zayo njengoba kuboniswe ku-IDP. Sihlangene namuhla ukuze sibhiyozela ukusungulwa kwenhlangano engabandakanyi ubuhlanga iSANEF. Banciphisa ukuphepha nemisebenzi eSmithfield Road. Thina sathola izindlela zokwelapha ezingamukeleki ezineziphetho ezimbi ezingadingekile kubantu abamnyama baseNingizimu Afrika. Ingxoxo phakathi kokuhlangana kwabo yayigxile kakhulu kumasu kanye nomkhankaso wokulwa nobugebengu. Uzobambisana nezinkampani ezizimele ngenxa yezinqubomgomo zezimali ezihlobene nezwe. Emaphutheni amaningi ahlolwe yiBhange Lezohwebo, uhulumeni uyaphulwa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzinikela kweSweden nokwesekwa okwakhiwe mayelana nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, izigidi zikhumbula nsuku zonke zisahlupheka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zindawo zinezimfuneko zokungena ezisagcina abanye behlukanisiwe futhi zikhuthaza ukucwaswa, kuyilapho abanye bekudingeka ukuba baphinde baphilisiwe nganoma iyiphi indlela engaba khona. Izifundo zokubhukuda nezindawo zokuhlala zabangenamakhaya azizovalwa izikhala zomsebenzi. Abathuthukisi bewebhu kumele balandele imihlahlandlela eqinile ekwakheni amawebhusayithi nokuqukethwe. Lezi zinto kumele zidluliselwe kuSAPS ngesikhathi sokuhlola. Injabulo esiyithola kulokhu kanye nezindaba ezivela ezithintanweni zethu nabantu zisishiya sinesithunzi sokungathembeki esiqhubeka sikhona. Ukuze sikhulume ngesibonelo esisodwa, ikhaya lomakhelwane kaChris Hani eLesotho lachithwa laba izingcezu. Manje sesiqonda kahle isimo sokungalingani futhi sesiqalile ukuvala umgomo phakathi kwabacebile nabampofu mayelana nezempilo. Akukho njabulo ngaphandle kwezithombe ezimbi ezihambisana nayo futhi eziletha ukukhanya. Kodwa ngesikhathi sokuphila emhlabeni wanamuhla ezikhungweni zobufakazi, kunezinye izimo ngaphandle kwalabo abavela esiteji. Abanye abasolwa baboshiwe mayelana nokwamukela nokuba nezimpahla ezikholakala ukuthi zisetshenziswe emaphoyiseni. Azikho izidingo ezikhona ezikhungweni zikahulumeni zokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha imvelo (EMS), ukuze ziqaphe imiphumela, zifunde, noma zenze ukuhlolwa kwemiphumela yemvelo. Izinsiza zizosebenza ukuthuthukisa amakhono ukuze amazwe akwazi ukuhambisana kangcono nezinyathelo ezivumelwene ngazo ngokubambisana. Ngendlela eyamukelekayo, ukusebenza ngeSonto kumele kube ngabantu abakhethwe ngokwabo. Sifuna ukukucacisela ukuthi asizange sibe nengxenye emicimbini yobudlova ngokumelene nalabo abahluphekayo. Isizathu - ulwazi mayelana nezifo ezithile nezokuhlukunyezwa ikakhulukazi eziphathelene nezingane nabesifazane sizoqoqwa futhi sishicilelwe kabanzi. Ukukhuluma nokukhankasela ababhali kwenza okuqukethwe kube neqiniso njengoba kungaqinisekiswa. Ngomgomo wokurekhoda, uyasebenza noDiligence nayo? Kunalokho, kwenziwe umzamo omkhulu wokubika ngokuqinile ngezindaba nokuzifaka emphakathini omhlophe. Lezi zinto zikhuthaza imiphakathi engahleleki ukuba iphikise ukuhamba okuhlinzekwayo. Kithi, kukhona ubufakazi besibhedlela obukhombisa ukwelashwa mayelana nengane eyakhala. Lokhu kube nomthelela ekunciphiseni inani eliphezulu lokungena ezikoleni. Izinguquko zenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile ezimweni zezulu ezihlobene nezikhathi, ngokwesibonelo, ubusika obunemvula kanye nesikhathi esomile. Kubhalwe isibuyekezo mayelana nokubaluleka kokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo kwezolimo. Izindlela manje sezisunguliwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokho okuqondwa kuboniswa kumadokhumenti. Angicabangi ukuthi yindlela abakhangisi abenza ngayo. Namuhla, njengoba sikhumbula leli suku, akukho okunye esingakugxila kukho ngaphandle kukaMahatma Gandhi. Amakamelo ezihotela nawo abikwe kuwo wonke umuzi nakuma-estado asondelene njengeVirginia neMaryland. Uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngazo zonke izinhlobo zezinsiza ezifana nezindlu ezincane, ama-trailer, izigezayo, izinsiza zamanzi, njll. Ukuhamba phezulu kungabalwa, kodwa ukuhamba phansi akukwazi ukubalwa. Isizathu sikhathazekile kakhulu ngoxolo nokuphepha ezingeni lomhlaba wonke nguM.E kanye nendawo yePheresiya. Le moto ihlinzekwe ngezici ezikhethwayo phakathi kwakho, ukudluliswa kweziteshi zedijithali ezisezingeni eliphezulu zohlobo lweTetra, amakompyutha anama-imeyili, i-inthanethi, kanye ne-fax. Kungagcina futhi kugcine amarekhodi ngendlela eyisimanga. Imishini idlala indima ebalulekile ekudluliseni lokhu ngehlelo elifanele kulabo abathakazelelayo. Futhi kulolo suku olubalulekile, ezindaba zaseNingizimu Afrika zaziphazamiseka futhi zaphazamiseka nguhulumeni ngesikhathi semisebenzi yazo. Usizo oluvela kubantu ngqo emphakathini noma, ngaphandle kwalokho, kulabo abavela ezimweni ezingajwayelekile, kubafundi bezimali, noma ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lokwakha nokusebenza. Ingabe lezi kungenzeka izinto ezisetshenziswa umgibeli we-cricket mayelana nenani lamabhola abholayo? Eziklasi zothisha, bazokwazi ukuphatha, ukusetshenziswa kwabo kokwesekwa kwezimfundiso, izinsiza zabo, nokufundisa kwabo kuzothintwa ngochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe. Omunye wabo ukuthuthukiswa kwamazwe ethu njengoba sizama ukuthola uxolo, ubud democracy, kanye nokungabandakanyi ubuhlanga okuphumelelayo. Umsulwa wacindezelwa ngamandla futhi wabekwa endaweni yokugijima lapho wahlukunyezwa. Amaphoyisa afinyelela endaweni yobugebengu ababona umsolwa eduze kwesitolo. Ngakho-ke, sithuthukise ikhono elithile lokuqapha nokuphepha ezingeni lendawo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwalabo abazuza ngaphambili nalabo abangazange baphumelele kanye nesici sokugcina sokuthuthukiswa kwezimali. Idizayini ehleliwe ngempela isetshenziswe ngandlela thile, incike enanini lemali elitholakalayo ebhizinisini. Abasebenzi abaqokwe muva baveza ukuzinikela kwabo ukusiza imiphakathi yabo. Ngemuva kokuxoxa nabalingani, ngicela imvume yokuhamba phambili ngalolo daba. I-Transitional Authority nayo yenze isitatimende sokuthi iSomaliland iyingxenye ebalulekile yeSomalia. Amaphoyisa abambe izibhamu ezimbili, okukholelwa ukuthi zisetshenziswe ekubhuleni. Uma isikhathi sokwabelana ngemininingwane sithatha kuze kube yisikhathi sokugcina, kuzohambisana nokudla neziphuzo. Umphakathi wamaJuda eThekwini uhlala lapho kungekho ukuphikiswa kokucwaswa. Basiphazamisela, basiphakamisa, bese besiphonsa phansi. Abantu bethu kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba baziphekelele ukuze bazivikele kuphela. Kulungile, nganoma yisiphi isimo, izandla ezintathu eziphakeme zikhombisa ikhono elikhulu. Izinselelo ezixoxwe kuToolkit zatholakala ngezinkundla zokubuza imibuzo nokuphatha konke okukhona okuhlobene nokuhamba. Omsebenzi labanye, isb, mayelana nokulawulwa kwe-malaria nezinye izifo ezithathelwana, ukulawulwa kwezifo, nezinye izinyoni
Ibhukuda Liyanda eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Uma ubheka eNingizimu Afrika, uyakwazi ukubona ubuhle bemvelo obuhambisana namanzi, kusukela ogwini lwezindawo ezithokozisayo ezifana ne-Kwazulu-Natal, kuya ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni ezifana nemifula nemithombo. Kulokhu, ukubhukuda sekubuye kwaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu, kungokwezempilo, ukuhlanganyela, noma ukujabulisa. Lokhu kubonakala ngempela emicimbini emisha yokubhukuda yeNingizimu Afrika, njengoba abantu abaningi bejabulela ubuchwepheshe obusha bokubhukuda. Ukukhula Kwezokubhukuda Ukubhukuda akusona nje umkhuba wokuzivocavoca, kodwa futhi kuyindawo yokuphumula, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona. Izikhungo ezahlukene zikhuthaza imicimbi yokwakha ubuqotho kanye neqhaza elibalulekile lokuthuthukisa impilo enempilo. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zendlela yokuphila ehloniphekile, imiphakathi iyazama ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubhukuda ezisebenza kahle ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umphakathi wase-Ethekwini ugxile ekwakheni izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zokubhukuda, kulandela umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe ngaphambilini. Othisha basebenza ngokubambisana nezinsiza zomphakathi ukuze kufundiswe izingane, futhi baqale imicimbi emisha yokubhukuda, okwanika ithuba lokuthakasela izipho zempilo. Izinzuzo Zokubhukuda Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi ukubhukuda kunenzuzo enkulu empilweni. Abahlali baveza ukuthi ukuhamba emanzini kubasiza ukuphumuza ingqondo, kwenze bazise ukuthi baphila kahle, ngokwenyama nangokwengqondo. Lo mkhuba ukhuthaza abasebenzisi ukuba babe nomoya opholile, bajabulele ubuchwepheshe obutholakala ezikhungweni zokubhukuda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNingizimu Afrika iyazisa kakhulu kokubhukuda, njengoba ithola izindondo eziningi emiqhudelwaneni yamazwe omhlaba. Lokhu kudala umoya wezinga eliphezulu phakathi kwezingane nabantu abadala, kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemikhankaso efana ne-‘Swimming for All’, eyenzelwe ukwenza izifundo zokubhukuda zifinyelele kubo bonke, kungakhathaliseki isimo sempilo, ukudlala, noma ukuphuza amanzi. Imicimbi Yokubhukuda ehlukene Imicimbi yokubhukuda iqhubeka ivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kwemijaho yendabuko, kunezinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezihlanganisa imidlalo yokubhukuda, okuqukethe ukukhetha izigaba ezahlukene, ukusuka ebhukuweni elijabulisayo lokuziqeqesha, kuya ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ibhukuda labesifazane libonise ukukhula okukhulu, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi abesifazane balandela izifundo zokubhukuda, beshaya amamaki amasha emiqhudelwaneni. Lokhu kudala isikhala sokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuze zisebenzisane futhi zihambisane nemithetho yokuphila. Izinselelo Zokubhukuda Nokho, nakuba sikhula, kunezithiyo ezibhekene nababhukudi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ubungozi obuhlangene nemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokungabi khona kwemifula ephephile, kusewuya kumkhankaso wokubukuda eNingizimu Afrika. I-‘Water Safety Initiative’ iqhubeka ibhekana nezingozi ezahlukene, iqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, bazi ukuthi amanzi kufanele ahlale ephephile. Isifinyezo Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika ibheja phambili, ukubhukuda akukhona nje umkhuba wokuzivocavoca, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Ukuze sithole impilo enempilo, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka senza imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukubaluleka kokubhukuda. Lokhu kuzokuvula indlela yokuba amazwe afunde kahle, emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe, noma ubani angaba yibhukudi abazi kahle izinto ezinjengalezi. Ibhukuda, njengoba sesikubonile, liyingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlonipha impilo, impilo emphakathini, kanye nempumelelo yephupho lokubona zonke izigaba zomphakathi zenza kahle.
Emhlabeni Wokumbiwa Phansi, endaweni eshaya khona izinkanyezi, kwakukhona umuzi omncane owawubizwa ngokuthi uMahlabathini. Lo muzi wawaziwa kakhulu ngempahla eyahlukene eyatholakala phansi, ikakhulukazi igolide, insimbi, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Abantu bakwaMahlabathini babejwayele ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze baphile impilo engcono, kodwa bazi kahle ukuthi lokhu kudinga umsebenzi onzima. Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkampani ezinkulu zokumbiwa phansi, abahlali baseMahlabathini babephila ngokuthengisa imikhiqizo yemfuyo, izitshalo, nezinsiza ezitholakala emhlabeni. Kodwa njengoba izinsiza ziqhubeka zincipha, kwavela umcabango wokuthi umhlaba ungangena kalula kuwo ukuze uthole izinto ezinkulu. Abantwana babejabulisa ngendaba yokuthi emhlabeni kunamathafa okukhona izimanga. Nokho, uMnumzane Mthethwa, umholi wendawo, waphakamisa, “Asizame ukujula, sithole lokho okukhona phansi. Kungase kube nento emangalisayo, mhlawumbe igolide elincane elizothuthukisa impilo yethu.” Ngakho, kwaba nesimemezelo sokuthi bonke abakhokheli baphume bajule emhlabeni. UThandiwe, intombazane encane enezifiso ezinkulu, wayebona izinsiza ezinjengokhuni nezinsimbi. Wayethemba ukuthi uma umhlaba uthola igolide, kuzothuthukisa umuzi wabo. UThandiwe wakhuluma noSipho, umngani wakhe, “Ngabe uyavuma? Uma sithola igolide, sizokwazi ukusiza abazali bethu!” USipho waphendula, “Yebo, uThandiwe! Lokhu kuzoba yithuba elihle! Kodwa kufanele siqaphele ukuthi umhlaba ungasinika noma ungasidela.” Kwathi ngosuku olukhulu, bonke abathanda ukuthola izinsiza bahlangana edwaleni elikhulu. Umoya opholile wawukhona, futhi abantu babejabulile. UThandiwe noSipho banquma ukujoyina leli qembu. Bafaka izigqoko zabo zokuvikela, behlola izindawo ezahlukene, bagxila ezindaweni ezinje nezibhekene nezinsizwa ezikhanya. Njengoba bejula, baqala ukuthola izinto ezimangalisayo. Babona amatshe amakhulu, izinsimbi ezizwakalayo, nezinto eziningi ezazingaziwa. Kodwa ngesikhathi bejula kakhulu, baqala ukuzizwa bephazamisekile ngenxa yezwi elijulile elibuhlungu elalibabiza. “Hamba! Hamba! Ungekho umhlaba okhonjisiwe,” lasizwa. UThandiwe noSipho babephazamisekile, kepha bahamba phambili, becabanga ngempilo engcono. Kwathi lapho befika endaweni ethile, baqala ukubona umgudu omkhulu, ophakathi kwendawo engaziwa. “Kukhona okuthile lapha, Sipho,” kusho uThandiwe, enza izinyathelo zokuqala. Kodwa njengoba bejula, umhlaba waba mnyama, wabavulela umgudu omkhulu, owawuthokozisa impilo yabo. Bahlaselwa yizimo ezinzima, kodwa uThandiwe wathi, “Asizoyeka! Sizobona ukuthi umhlaba ungenza kube lula.” Ngemva kwezinsuku ezithile, uThandiwe noSipho bathola igolide elikhulu nelikhazimulayo. Babegcwele injabulo, becabanga ngemiphumela yalo mgudu. Nokho, ngesikhathi besathokozisa impumelelo yabo, baqala ukuzizwa bejulelwe yizinto ezimbi. Umhlaba wawusiphendulela, ubabulela izinkinga ezinzima. Babona ukuthi ukujula phansi kwenza kube nzima, futhi umhlaba waba izingxaki ezinkulu. UThandiwe wagcizelela, “Sipho, kufanele sibuyele emuva! Umhlaba akusona isikhala sokuhlala, kodwa kusetshenziswa kahle! Kulula ukujula, kodwa kunzima ukuphuma.” Baphuma bejule, bejabulisa umuzwa wokuthi umhlaba wawungathanda, kodwa kufanele bazi kahle izinzuzo nezingozi. Ekugcineni, uMnumzane Mthethwa waba nezinkumbulo ezinzima. “Umhlaba ufundisa ukuthi izinsiza zidinga ukuhlonishwa. Akukona konke okukhanyayo okuhle. Sizobe sithuthukisa imiphakathi yethu ngokuhlonipha umhlaba, kanye nezinsiza zawo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile,” waphika. Ngemuva kwalokho, abahlali baseMahlabathini baqhubeka nokuhlala, bejabuliswa yimpilo yabo, behlonipha imvelo nokuqonda kahle izinzuzo nezingozi zokumbiwa phansi. UThandiwe noSipho bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela umhlaba wabo, beqonda ukuthi umhlaba ungumngane uma uhamba naye, kepha ungumshoshaphansi uma ufisa kuphela ukuthola izinto ezikhanyayo. Umhlaba udinga ukuhlonishwa, futhi abahlali bazi kahle lokho ukuze baqhubeke nokuphila kahle, banganaki izimanga ezikhanyayo kuphela, kodwa futhi bahloniphe leso sikhala esibalulekile.
Inyanga kaMashi yisikhathi esingabizi kakhulu uma kuziwa ekutholeni umumbu, kodwa yisikhathi sokulungiselela umkhiqizi ophumelelayo. Kubalimi bomumbu, isikhathi sehlobo sokuvuna sesidlulile, futhi manje sekuyisikhathi sokuphumula emumbini. Nokho, abaningi abalimi bomumbu banokukhiqiza izinkomo ezidlala indima ekusetshenzisweni okuphelele kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo emvelweni futhi kunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokuvuna. Kukhona amaphuzu ambalwa abalulekile ahlobene nokuba ngumlimi wezinkomo zenyama, okuyindlela evamile yokufuya izilwane ezisetshenziswa abalimi bezitshalo. Lawa maphuzu ahlobene kakhulu nesimo nempilo yezinkomo. Ukukhulisa izinkomo ukuze kwandiswe inani lezinkomo esikhathini esizayo kubiza kakhulu, njengoba kuze kube yilapho inkomo inezinkomo zayo zokuqala, ayikhiqizi imali. Abakhiqizi abavumelani ngempela ngesimo esifanele sokukhulelwa kwezinkomo zokuqala, kodwa kulungile ukusho ukuthi kufanele kwenzeke phakathi kweminyaka emibili kuya kwemithathu. Uma inhlanzi ingadli kahle, izoba ncane kakhulu (izoba neqholo) futhi lokhu kuzokwehlisa usuku lokukhulelwa kwayo kokuqala. Empilweni yenkukhu, inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngenkukhu njalo ezinsukwini eziyi-365 (kwesinye isikhathi ngonyaka enyangeni efanayo). Uma iminyaka yenkukhu idlule lapho ikhulelwa okokuqala, kusho ukuthi izoba nezinkomo eziningi kuyo yonke impilo yayo. Inkomo ingabhekwa njengefektri yokukhiqiza izinkomo. Isikhathi sokukhulelwa kwenkukhu sithatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye futhi isuswa emadodeni ezinyanga ezimbili ezilandelayo ukuze umzimba wayo uphumule ngenkathi ikhiqiza ubisi lwezinkomo (izinkomo ziphila ngobusisi kuphela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuphila kwazo). Ngokwenkolo esikhona, kuzoba kuhle ukuba inkomo ikhulule futhi phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu ngemuva kokukhulelwa ukuze ikwazi ukuba nezinkomo enyangeni efanayo unyaka nonyaka. Lokhu kuyisimo esifisayo, sinikeza ithuba lokukhiqiza okuphelele kokukhula kwenkukhu unyaka nonyaka, ngaphandle kokuphazamisa impilo yenkukhu. Uma inkomo ingadli kahle, ngeke ikwazi ukukhulelwa futhi iphathe inhlanzi njalo ngonyaka. Njengoba inani lokukhulelwa kwezinkomo likhula, njalo izinkomo ezitholakalayo zokuthengisa ekupheleni kwalonyaka. Ngobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka ukuthi inkomo ikhulule inhlanzi njalo ngonyaka. Nokho, kunezimo eziningi ezithinta iphesenti lokukhulelwa kwezinkomo, kodwa isimo senkomo uqobo siyinto ebalulekile (eminye imingcele ingabandakanya impilo yeqembu, inani lezinkomo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkomo, ikhono lokufuya izinkomo, njll.). Izinkomo ezingakhuleli njalo ngonyaka akufanele zigcinwe eqenjini - ziyizivakashi kuphela futhi azinikele emalini yokufuya. Inhlanzi eshayiwe, esanda kuzalwa iyisiqalo esihle, kodwa ukuze le nhlanzi ikhiqize imali, kufanele ikhuliswe ibe semnyakeni lapho ingathengiswa khona. Inhlanzi kufanele ikhululwe ikhululekile futhi iqinile ukuze ikwazi ukuzimela ngokushesha emama wayo futhi iqale ukukhula. Isimo sokudla kw mama sibalulekile kakhulu. Uma inkomo isesimweni esihle futhi idliwa kahle, izoba nesimo esihle sokuphatha nokukhulisa inhlanzi enempilo. Izinkomo ezifa ngaphambi kokukhululwa zimele ukulahlekelwa kumlimi. Kufanele kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuze kukhululwe u-100% wezinkomo ezizalwayo. Izinkomo eziningi ezikhululiwe zithengiswa ngesisindo, ngakho uma isisindo somzimba sikhulu, intengo ezotholakala nayo izoba phezulu. Usayizi wezinkomo uvame ukuhlobana nesimo sokudla senkomo kanye naleyo nhlanzi ngonyaka kanye nohlobo lwenkukhu. Uma inhlanzi ekhulelwe ivela kuyo yonke inkomo ikhululekile, njalo izokwenza imali ethile ethuthukise le msebenzi. Njengoba kushiwo, abalimi abaningi abakhiqiza izitshalo baphinde babe nezingxenye zokufuya ezisebenzayo - izinkomo (noma ezinye izilwane) zisebenzisa amapulazi emvelo, izinkundla (ezibhalwe ezindaweni ezinezinga eliphansi lokufuya), nezindawo ezinezimfucuza zomumbu. Ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo wezilwane kuhlobene kakhulu nekhono lokuhlinzeka ukudla okwanele, okuphakeme ngonyaka. Phakathi nezinyanga zehlobo, abakhiqizi abaningi bangathembela kumapulazi nezinkundla ukuze badle izilwane zabo, kodwa abakhiqizi abahle balungiselela izilwane zabo ezinyangeni ezibandayo nezomile. Njengoba ukuphela kwehlobo kuza, abalimi abaningi baphonsa ukudla okuluhlaza (ngokuvamile bekuwumumbu wokudla (ama-oats) phakathi kwemigqa yomumbu). Ngemuva kokuvuna umumbu, izinkomo nezimvu zivunyelwe ukugaya ezinkundleni lapho zidla izimfucuza zomumbu, amahlamvu omumbu adilika, nokudla okuluhlaza. Abanye abalimi baphonsa i-seradella phakathi komumbu. I-seradella iyisitshalo esinothile ngemifino esinokudla okuhle, okungahlinzeki kuphela ukudla okuhle kodwa futhi kwakha i-nitrogen emhlabathini ukuze isetshenziswe emvuthwandaba elandelayo. Inyanga kaMashi ingemuva kwesikhathi sokuphonsa umumbu wokudla (ama-oats) kanye ne-seradella, kodwa kusasele isikhathi sokuphonsa uhlobo lwe-rye. Nokho, khumbula ukuthi le ndlela ye-rye akufanele iphonseke yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa ngoba ikhula ngokushesha kakhulu futhi endaweni ethile, uzoba nokudla kwezilwane okweqile, okuzolandela isikhathi sokuhlupheka lapho kungasatholakali ukudla okwanele kwezilwane. Le ndlela ye-rye ayinambitheki uma inezithelo njengoba imicu yayo iklwebha umlomo, izindlebe, nezinyembezi zezinyoni. Uma unamapulazi aphonswe nge-eragrostis, inyanga kaMashi yisikhathi esihle sokuwagawula okokugcina. Isimo sebhande ngeke sibe kuhle kulolu suku, ngaphandle kokuba ubenze kahle, kodwa okungenani uzoba nokudla okuhle okungasetshenziswa ezinyangeni ezibandayo. Khumbula ukuthi ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nokwengeza ukudla okuhle ukuze izinkomo zikwazi ukukusebenzisa kahle njengokudla okungesihle. Nokho, uma ungenakho ukudla okuhle, ngeke ukwazi ukunakekela kahle izilwane zakho ukuze zibe sesimweni esihle ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngokugawula utshani ngokuhambisana nemigqa, uzokwazi uku fertilize umhlabathi entwasahlobo futhi uthole izitshalo ezinhle zotshani esizeni esilandelayo. Uma kungenzeka, vikela imigqa yotshani ezimeni zezulu ngokuyigcina ngaphansi kwempahla, noma okungenani, kufanele uyifake ngendlela enciphisa ukuvezwa kwayo emvula. Ezinyangeni zebusika, ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi udla kuphela izilwane zakho. Awufuni izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ukuba zigeze eqenjini lakho. Lokhu kuyisikhathi esihle sokwelapha izilwane zakho ngokususa amagciwane angaphakathi nezilwane eziphilayo (ama-ticks). Uma udinga iseluleko ngalokhu, ukhuthazwa ukuba uxhumane nebhizinisi lakho lendawo lezolimo, i-cooperative yabalimi bendawo, noma udokotela wezilwane bendawo (bazoba nezindawo zokuhlola nezokwelapha ezitholakalayo). Uma usebenzisa amapulazi omphakathi, kuzoba kuhle kubo bonke abasebenzisi uma abanikazi bezilwane bel
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezenzo Zesisebenzi Sikahulumeni: I-GEMS Isixazululo Esibalulekile Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ngeshesha, izinqubo ezivamile zidinga ukuhamba nalesi sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kuyinto ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nhlangano idlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni kube lula ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathole izinsizakalo zezempilo eziphakeme, kodwa lokho kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kwempumelelo nasemsebenzini. Ukuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile kakhulu, hhayi kuphela ukuze kugcinwe ubufakazi bokusebenza, kodwa futhi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bayakwazi ukujabulela izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwesitoreji, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nomqondo ophusile wokuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ziqinisekisa ukukhula nokuphila kahle kwalezi zisebenzi. Ukusiza abasebenzi ukwazi ukuthi bahlala bexhaswa, kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Ngokwe-GEMS, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi kukhombisa ubulungiswa bokusiza abasebenzi, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela labo abasebenza emsebenzini kahulumeni abangathola lezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kudala isimo sokwethembana phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi, ngoba abasebenzi bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo abasithandayo zikhona futhi zikhona ngezinqubomgomo ezicacile. Lokhu akugcini nje ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, kodwa futhi kusekela umqondo wokusebenza ngempumelelo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinhlinzeko azibheki kuphela izidingo zabasebenzi; zihlola futhi izidingo zempumelelo kahulumeni. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi izinsizakalo abazitholayo ziqinisekisiwe futhi zisebenza kahle, bazoba nethemba lokuthi imizamo yabo izogqamisa izinzuzo emsebenzini. Lokhu kudala umoya wokugqugquzela, okuthuthukisa umkhiqizo kanye nenhlonipho emsebenzini. Noma kunjalo, kunobunzima obuthile obungavela lapho sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwesimo. Izinkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zazo zisebenza kahle, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile, ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, kanye nezinsiza ezanele zokubheka izimo. Uma lezi zinto zingaqinisekisiwe, kungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini nasempilweni yabasebenzi. Okokugcina, kuhle ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni akukhona nje uhlelo lokuphatha. Kunomqondo omkhulu wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho bonke abasebenzi bekhululekile futhi bejabulile. I-GEMS iyisixazululo esibalulekile, kodwa kudinga ukujula kokuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo kumele zisebenze ngendlela eguquguqukayo, ukuze zihlale zithuthukisa isimo sabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngakho, uma sicabanga nge-GEMS kanye nokuhlolwa kwesimo sesisebenzi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kuyinto ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa elihle, hhayi kuphela kubasebenzi, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. I-GEMS akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi ibiza ukwakha ithemba, ukugcwalisa izifiso, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izisebenzi kanye nohulumeni, ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle, obumbene, nonempilo. Ngalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kufanele kube yinto esiyibheka ngeso elibukhali, ukuze sigcine izinsizakalo zezempilo zisebenza ngokufanele, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulezi zikhathi ezishintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuba siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinqubo zethu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke, futhi sibe nempilo engcono.
IPhalamende likazwelonke lisebenze umphakathi wesikhashana ukuze lihlole imizamo yokubambisana ekulandeleni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi "Sisebenza ndawonye ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezisezingeni eliphezulu emiphakathini." Inqubomgomo yale komidi iwukubuza ngentuthuko uma kubhekwa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi nokuhlola ukuthi yiziphi izinselelo ezikhona lapho kube nezimemezelo ukuze kuvezwe umbiko kuPhalamende likazwelonke ozofaka iziphakamiso ezicacile nezindlela ezisebenzisekayo. Kuze kube manje, le komidi ivakashele ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasemadolobheni, futhi ibambe imihlangano ePhalamende nasemaphandleni. Imihlangano yephalamende yenzeka kusukela ngomhlaka 2 kuya ku-4 kuFebhuwari 2010. Ngenkathi le komidi ivakashela emaphandleni, izohlola lezi zindawo futhi ihlangane namalungu omphakathi, osomabhizinisi bendawo, abaphathi bezifunda, abaphathi bezinsiza zomphakathi, amakomidi ezindawo, nezinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nezithunywa zomkhakha wezebhizinisi. Le mihlangano izobanjwa kusukela ngomhlaka 17 kuya ku-21 kuMeyi 2010, ezifundazweni ezintathu.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Kwakukhanya kahle emini, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, zikhuluma ngothando nosuku olusha. Ekhaya, uNandi wayethokozisa umndeni wakhe, ethokozisa umama wakhe, uGogo, ngenkanyezi encane ezobe izalwa. Kwakungesikhathi sokukhumbula nokulindela, njengoba uNandi wayezokhuluma nezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, ezithinta impilo yakhe kanye nezingane ezizayo. Ngemva kokuhamba, uNandi wathola ukuthi isibhedlela esisedolobheni sakubo sitholakala emuva kweminyaka eminingi, sinesipiliyoni esikhulu sokubeletha. Kwakukhona odokotela abaqeqeshiwe, ababejolise ekunakekeleni abesifazane abakhulelwe, beqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zabo zihlala ziphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukuqondiswa kokukhulelwa, kanye nezinsiza ezithile ezifana nezokwelapha nezokwelashwa. Njengoba uNandi ehlola izinsizakalo, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukukhulelwa akukona ukuhamba komjaho kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umndeni. U-Nandi wakhumbula izikhathi lapho abesifazane bejabulisa izinsiza ezithile, njengezikhumbuzo zokubeletha, izifundo zokukhulisa izingane, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zabazali. Lokhu kwenza uNandi wacabanga ukuthi akufanele kube nezinselelo, kodwa kufanele kube nesikhathi sokujabula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha azigcini nje ngokubeletha kuphela, kodwa zifaka phakathi ukwelashwa kokuphila kwengane. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhumbula ukuthi ingane iyisibusiso, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane izalwa iphilile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Ngesikhathi esebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuhlinzwa uma kudingeka. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bangathola izinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphumula, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezingane. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zomama. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Njengoba uNandi ehlola izinsizakalo, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe badinga ukuxhumana, ngakho-ke izibhedlela ziqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokukhulisa izingane, izifundo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlala bejabulile, futhi lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Ngesikhathi esebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuhlinzwa uma kudingeka. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bangathola izinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphumula, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezingane. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Ekugcineni, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwezingane kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Ngalesi sikhathi, uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwezingane kubalulekile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlala bejabulile, futhi lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Ngale ndlela, uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwezingane kubalulekile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Ngiyakwemukela, mngani! Namuhla sizokhuluma ngendawo ezibalulekile kakhulu empilweni yethu — izikhungo zezempilo. Kukhona izikhungo ezingama-72 ezahlukene, futhi ngizokutshela ngazo ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi zisebenza kanjani, zikhona kuphi, futhi ziwusizo kanjani emphakathini. Ukuqala, akukhona nje izikhungo zezempilo ezidumile, kodwa zikhona ezincane ezikahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zihlala zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zempilo zomphakathi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi impilo yabo ibaluleke kangakanani. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikhungo ezinjalo zihlala zikhona ezindaweni eziningi? Zivame ukutholakala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu bengenakho ukufinyelela kalula ezikhungweni ezinkulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu basendaweni ezisemakhaya badinga usizo lwezempilo, futhi lezi zikhungo zikhona ukuze zibasize. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo zezempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zikhona ezihlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo, ezokwelapha, nezokunakekela. Izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo zibalulekile, njengoba zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphume ezinkingeni zabo. Abantu abaningi bahlupheka ngezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, futhi lezi zikhungo zikhona ukuze zibe usizo. Zihlinzeka ngokuqondisa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Izikhungo zezempilo zihlala ziqhuba izinhlelo zokuvikela, njengokuhlolwa kwezifo ezithathelwana, izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha izifo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu badinga ukuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nezifo ezithile, futhi izikhungo zempilo zikhona ukuze ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi futhi bayakwazi ukuzivikela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezempilo zisebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba imfundo iyisisekelo sempilo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imfundo iyasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Izikhungo zezempilo zikhuthaza ukufunda, zifundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nezikhungo zezempilo. Ngokuvamile, izinsiza zihlala zincishisiwe, futhi lokhu kuhluphe abantu abaningi. Izikhungo ezincane zihlala zidinga usizo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izikhungo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, abantu bahlupheka. Ngakho, abantu badinga ukuxhasa izikhungo zezempilo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendima yomphakathi. Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni izikhungo zezempilo. Uma abantu bephumelela ekuxhaseni izikhungo, izikhungo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma umphakathi ubambisene, impilo iyathuthuka. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani izikhungo zezempilo. Kukhona futhi izinhlelo ezihlinzekwa izikhungo zezempilo ezithile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlola impilo, ezokwelapha izifo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Lezi zinhlelo zibalulekile, ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zihlala ziqhuba izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokudla okunempilo, ezokuzivocavoca, nokunye okuningi. Ngokuphetha, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Zihlinzeka ngempilo, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zempilo zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, zikhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nazo, futhi umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni izikhungo. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza izikhungo zezempilo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, mngani! Ngiyethemba ukuthi uthole ulwazi oluningi ngalezi zikhungo ezibalulekile. Impilo iyinsika, futhi kumele sithi "yebo" ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu kanye neyezizukulwane ezizayo. Hamba kahle!
Izikhala zomsebenzi emaphandleni nasemaphandleni zifakwe ngokufuna abasebenzi ngokumema abantu ukuthi bafake izicelo, kulabo abangasebenzi kuhulumeni. Izikhala zomsebenzi ezindaweni eziphezulu, emkhakheni wokuphathwa okuphezulu, kumele zikhangiswe ngokwezifunda kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweSevisi yoMphakathi. Izikhala zikhangiswa kwiSikhangiso seMisebenzi yoMphakathi, esihlanganiswa masonto onke nguMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nokuphathwa. Ngesikhathi sokufuna abantu abangasebenzi kuhulumeni, lowo mnyango kazwelonke noma wesifunda uzokhangisa lezi zikhala zomsebenzi ezimidiya. Iwebhusayithi ebizwa ngokuthi: Isikhangiso seMisebenzi yoMphakathi ibika abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngama-position atholakalayo ngaphakathi kweSevisi yokusebenza kukahulumeni. Abantu abangasebenzi kuhulumeni kodwa abanentshisekelo ezikhala ezikhangisiwe kufanele baphendule kuMnyango okhangisayo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Imininingwane yokuxhumana noMnyango okhangisayo inikezwa kwiSikhangiso. Ezinye izikhungo ezifana noMnyango Wezokuvikela zingase zidinge ukuthi udlule ekuhlolweni kwezempilo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho sithathwe sibe sithathelwe phezulu. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela iwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nokuphathwa. Ungathola incwadi eqinisekisa ukufaka kwakho isicelo, kodwa lokhu kuncike kumnyango. Inqubo yokufuna abasebenzi nokukhetha iyahluka phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni futhi ingaqedwa ngesikhathi esifushane. Ifomu lesicelo alikhokhiswa.

Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Kwakukhanya emini, izinsuku ezikanye, lapho izwe lethu, iNingizimu Afrika, lathola khona ukudabuka okuningi. Emini yamaJulayi ngonyaka wezi-2021, abantu bahlala em street corners, emizileni nasemakhaya bejabulile futhi bejabulisa omunye nomunye. Kodwa emhlabeni ka 2021, lapho konke kubukeka kuhle, wafika umoya wezinhlekelele, ubhubhisa ithunzi lemphilo yamaZulu. Kwathi uma izinsuku zidlula, umkhiqizo wezokungcebeleka oqhakazile, uthathelwa phezulu ngezingxabano ezivame ukuhlupha abantu. Kukhumbuleka ukuthi lezi zibhulu zokuqala zazihambisana nemijikelezo yokulwa nokwephula umthetho, okwakuthuthukisa ukungavumi kwezinhlelo zamanje. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga zomnotho ezazithinta amadola yonke, nezimo zalabo ababephila emizileni, nezimo zalabo ababeziqhubeka nayo. Izinsuku zokuqala zomhla zingakaphumi phakathi kwezinsuku ezinkulu. Abantu bejoyina imizamo yokukhombisa ukuzwakala kwabo, ngokuzibophezela empilweni yomqondo wokwakha izinyathelo zamakhaya. Kwaba nezingxabano phakathi kokukhangwa, lapho abanye bekhangwa ukwemukela imithethonqubo ehlukile. Izinhloso zazidlondlobala, nokukhathazeka ngabantu bemizamo yempilo yabo kwavela. Abaxhasi bakhuluma ngezinhlelo zokuthuthuka umnotho ezalotshwe yizo ezikhumbulayo – izinga lokukhula komnotho belikwazile, kodwa kwaba nezahlulelo ezinzima ezazithinta imisebenzi. Kodwa ka sekwenzekile, izinhlelo zamaphathiswa azithintekanga kahle. Kwathathwa imizamo yokwandisa ukuhweba, kodwa ivumelwano elingaqedi kangako lwenze abantu bavele babe nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kwadala ukucasuka nokungaqondi kahle okwabulala ithemba labantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlekelele zindawo zikaMphakathi zatholakala ngendlela ezibuhlungu. Lezi zinkinga bebebavimbela ekuhwebeni nasemsebenzini, kanti abadluli bezishoshovu bazama ukuthola izixazululo. Ukuhlaziywa kukhombisa ukuthi umnotho walokhu kwamahlekelele uyaqhamuka ezingeni eliphakeme, kodwa nakho lokho ngenxa yokufuna ukwehlisa okwenziwa ngabadlula ngaphandle. Lokhu kuyadabukisa, kubanga imiphumela eminingi empilweni yabo. Kwakungezinkanyezi ezidlagitha ezingajazi, ezichaza izifundo ezihlukaniselayo. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezama ukuthola izinzuzo zokuhweba, nokhulumela izinjongo zomphakathi, kodwa izinto zathola imiphumela emibi. Ukungabi naluthando lwezinsongo ezithwala izinkanyezi ezinhle, kwakhuthaza impilo engapheli. Abantu bahlala behluleka ukufunda ukuze baphinde bangene ezinhlelweni eziphuthumayo, ukuze baphinde bazitholele izikhala ezinkulu. Esikhathini esidelwe ubungozi, imizamo yokukhuluma ibikwenza kube nokwakha okungakafiki. Abanye babeyizinyanga abathintekayo ekwakheni umnotho, belindele ukuba nempumelelo eMphakathini. Lokhu kube yikushoda kobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezivela kumasu omnotho. Kodwa umhlaba wawuchophisa – kodwa owawa waqhubeka nokwenza ubuhlobo, kuze kube sekwitchini eziphakamisa izikhalo. Isimo sezinhlekelele sahlala sibhubha, kanti nabafuna ukuhamba bayavuma ukuvala izinkanyezi ezihlukile kanti nabashoshovi abayinyango bezama ukwakha ubuhlobo. Lokhu kuboniselayo ukuthi abantu bayakuthanda ukuphiwa inhlonipho, bese bakhuluma futhi bezwe umbuso wabo. Ithuba lokulahlekelwa, akujwayelekile; umnotho wafelwa uklekeliswa. Ababamba iqhaza bezama ukujabulisa kanye nezinhlangano ezikhethiwe. Kubuhlungu ukulindela, kodwa kanti isimo samanje sikhumbuza izinyathelo ezivumayo. Abantu bejabula kakhulu emadodeni kanti imiphumela ibingekho. Bese kuthiwa “phuma” kanjena, kwavela uhulumeni wamaZulu, kanti lokhu kube yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umnotho ofanele ukuvumpa. Umphakathi wawa ungenegozi, kanti kubizwa ukuhlonipha. Lezi zibhulu zangoJulayi 2021, zigxile emkhakheni wezokuhweba. Zonke lezi zinxushunxushu zaku luthando ezeqisa ukwehluka, kanti uMphakathi uthola ithuba lokuphikisa imiphumela emisha. Umnotho ugxile ekuthuthukiseni inhlalakahle, okuhlanganisa ukubambisana kukamasipala. Ngakho ke ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, ikhanda laphakanyiswa ngezimpande zokuvikela. Ekuhlonzeni kobuchwepheshe, lokhu kungenza kube nezinsizakalo ezinkulu, kanti umphakathi uthola umsebenzi omningi. Ngokuphetha, izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zitshengisa ukuthi umnotho awubheki abanjani, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba babe nabantu abavumayo. Uthando lomphakathi lubalulekile, futhi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezakhelwe ukuvikela umnotho. Ukungaboni ngaso linye akuthandi, kodwana umhlaba uthanda, kanti umaphepha ahlanganiswe imizamo, olumkumbulo nempumelelo ehlangene. Izigigaba zithakazelelwa, kanti izifundo ziphakamisa umnotho, okwenza kube yinsakavukela enhle, emnothweni.
Ama-Social Media - Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Kwethu Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, umhlaba wethu usushintshe kakhulu. Emhlabeni wamanje, ukuxhumana akusashadiwe kuphela ezikhathini, i-imeyili noma esontweni. Izingqapheli zesimanje zifaka phakathi ama-social media, okuyizinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abantu ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwane. Lo mcimbi uzogqugquzela ingxoxo ebalulekile mayelana nomthelela wezokuxhumana ezimpilweni zethu, okuholela ekwenzeni umhlaba ube indawo ethokozisayo, kepha engazwakali. Umqondo Wokuqala: Ukuqonda ama-Social Media Ama-social media akha isakhiwo esisha sokuxhumana phakathi kwababukeli, ababhali, nabathandi bezindaba. Noma ngabe uthanda ukukhangisa, ukuyekethisa izithombe, noma ukwabelana ngemicabango, lezi zinkundla ziza nemininingwane ebanzi, ezihambelana namagugu nezifiso zethu. Imithombo efana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram kanye ne-YouTube ibalulekile kakhulu, njengoba ithuthukisa indlela esibuka ngayo izindaba, sigcina ubudlelwane, futhi sabelane ngaphezulu kwemizwa yethu. Ukusebenza Kwama-Social Media: Ekuqaleni Nokuthuthuka Ithuna lokuqala lama-social media laqala lapho abantu beqala ukuhwebelana ngobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholele ekuveleleni kwama-platforms anjengokuthi MySpace, aphawulekayo ngalo lonke ubukhulu bawo. Nokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-social media asithandwa kakhulu, afika ezikhathini eziningi, abangela ushintsho olukhulu. Umsebenzisi owodwa angaba nezithameli eziningi, kanti amathuba okuthi umyalezo ufinyelele abantu abaningi kakhulu, akhula kakhulu. Ukwazisa Nokuqwashisa: Izinzuzo Nezingozi Zokuxhumana Ukuze sihloniphe futhi siqonde kahle ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuthi siwazise izinzuzo nezingcuphe ezihambisana nawo. Njengoba abantu bexhumana, bathola ulwazi olusemqoka, babambisane, futhi benze izinqumo ezibalulekile. Noma kunjalo, izingozi ezifana nokuphepha kokuphila kwabantu, ama-bots, nezihloko ezingezinhle zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuziqonda kahle. Ukuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Amathuba nemiphumela Ama-social media awagcini nje ngokusiza abantu ukuba baxhumane, kodwa anikela ngamathuba amahle nempumelelo emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Amabhizinisi nezinkampani zisebenzisa ama-social media ukuze zikhulise imikhiqizo, zithole abathengi, futhi zindlebe izifiso zabavakashi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba abantu babe nengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, nokuphuma kwabo komunitini kube ukwakha umnotho onempumelelo. Ubuhlakani Nempilo: Ukuziphatha Kwethu Kwi-Online Njengoba siqhubeka nokusebenzisa ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izenzo zethu zikwazi ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukuziphatha kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile, futhi ukuvikela abanye kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sispirela isikhala esihle sokuxhumana. Ukudala indaba yangempela, ehloniphekile, nokuqwashisa nabanye, kuyinto ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukubhekana Nezinguquko: Okuhlangenwe Nakho Kwethu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sebe saba nomqondo wokuthola indlela yokuxhumana, izidingo zethu ziye zashintsha. Ukuhlanganyela kulezi zinkundla kuholela ekwenzeni abantu babe witayithi elibalulekile, futhi impilo yabo isiphenduka ibe nobukhulu obukhulu. Umcimbi wethu uzokhuluma ngezindlela ezihlukene abantu abathola ngazo ulwazi, abashukumiseleka, futhi babe nomoya wokubambisana. Isiphetho: I-Impact Yama-Social Media Emiphakathini yethu, ama-social media akha “umjikelezo” wezinto ezahlukene. Lokhu kuveza amandla okuxhumana, ukuqonda, kanye namathuba amasha. Njengabantu, kumele sizigcine sishesha, sihlaziye, futhi sifunde ukusebenzisa lawa mathuluzi ngendlela efanele. Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhala sokuxhumana, sikhaza umthetho ophumelelayo, sithola ithuba lokukhuluma, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ama-social media akhulisa umuzwa wokubambisana, uduku, nokuqonda ukuphila kwabanye. Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, amandla ethu akhulu. Ngakho-ke, masithathe ithuba lokuxhumana ngokugqugquzela, siqonde, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophumile, ophumelelayo nokuhambisana nezinga eliphezulu lokuphila. Lo mcimbi uzobalulekile ekuvezeni lezi zinto njengomkhiqizo wempilo yesimanje, futhi sizodinga sonke sikwazi ukuziqonda nezidingo zethu, ukuze sidonse phambili kulezi zinkundla ezisemqoka.
Inqubekela phambili ye-Operation Vulindlela Operation Vulindlela, ehlanganisa izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ibonisa inqubekela phambili ebalulekile emizamweni yokukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Le msebenzi, eqale ngonyaka ka-2020, ibheke ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula komnotho, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokuhlupheka okubangelwe yiCOVID-19. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise izimpumelelo eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokwakha izinsiza ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, amanzi, kanye nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokusebenza ezizokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekwakheni umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuphatha. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, uhulumeni usebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukufaka izicelo zezinsiza ezithile. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokwaziswa nokwaziswa kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokufunda. Idokhumenti elivela enyangeni edlule laphawula ngokuhlelwa kokufafaza nokuthi kusebenze kanjani. Lapha, sizobhekisisa ngokukhethekile ukuthi leyo sprayer ingahlelwa kanjani. Yini ukuhlela? Inhloso yokuhlela i-sprayer ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ifafaza inani elifanele leli liquid (amanzi ne-chemical) endaweni ethile. Amanzi amaningi akhishwa. Umfutho we-sprayer uzokhombisa ukusebenza komshini. Lungisa inani le-chemical emanzini. Khulisa inani lamanzi afafazwayo. Gcwalisa ithangi le-sprayer. Linomthamo ongu-4 liters kanye nomfutho ongu-2,500 rpm. Linganisa ubude obungu-100 m. I-sprayer ihamba ibanga elilinganayo no-100 m (isibonelo: imizuzwana engu-21). Bheka ukuthi mangaki amafutha aphuma phansi. Setha umfutho ofunwa (isibonelo: 3 bar). Ukuze ufafaze, linganisa inani lamanzi aphuma kumphakamo owodwa (isibonelo: 1,200 ml / 1.2 liters). Sebenzisa inani lamanzi aphuma kumphakamo owodwa, isibonelo, phinda lokhu ngenani lezi zimpakamo. Linganisa ububanzi bokufafaza (4.7 m). Lokhu kububanzi bungakanani endaweni engu-100 m? Indawo efafazwe ngaphezu kuka-100 m: 100 m x 4.7 m = 470 square meters. Sebenzisa ama-14.4 liters kule ndawo. Indawo engu-1 hectare = 10,000 square meters (100 m x 100 m). Futhi inani lelitre le-chemical elidingekayo nge-hectare. Noma usayizi wezimpakamo. Lokhu kuzongena ethangini. Isibonelo, ithangi ligcina ama-500 liters. Ama-4 liters nge-hectare. Phindaphinda ngo-4 (amalitre e-chemical nge-hectare). Kufanele ungeze ama-6.5 liters e-chemical ethangini elingu-500-liter.
Ukusebenza Ekhaya: Izinqubo, Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Isingeniso Ukusebenza ekhaya, okwaziwa futhi njenge-remote work, kube yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni wethu, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokwanda kwe-COVID-19. Le ndlela yokusebenza ibonisa ushintsho olukhulu emikhakheni eminingi, njengoba abantu abaningi sebesebenza ezindlini zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlolwa okujulile ukuze kuqondwe izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lokusebenza. Izici Zokusebenza Ekhaya Ukusebenza ekhaya kuhlanganisa izinto eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kukhona ukwanda kokufinyelela kumathuluzi nezinsiza ezithuthukile, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene kalula nabanye futhi benze imisebenzi yabo ngaphandle kokuphuma ekhaya. Okwesibili, le ndlela yokusebenza ivumela abantu ukuba baphathe izikhathi zabo, benza kube lula ukuhlela izinsuku zabo ukuze bafeze izidingo zomsebenzi nezomndeni. Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Ekhaya Izinzuzo zokusebenza ekhaya ziningi. Okokuqala, abantu abaningi bahlala bejabule kakhulu uma besebenza ekhaya, njengoba bekwazi ukugcina isikhathi sokuphila komndeni. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, njengoba abantu bezizwa bekhululekile futhi benokuthula. Okwesibili, ukusebenza ekhaya kunciphisa izindleko ezihambisana nokuhamba, njengezindleko zokuhamba, zokudla nezokugqoka, okubalulekile ezimweni lapho abantu behlupheka ngenxa yokuncipha kwemali engenayo. Izinkinga Zokusebenza Ekhaya Nokho, ukusebenza ekhaya akukhululekile kuphela. Kukhona nezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lokusebenza. Okokuqala, abantu abaningi babhekana nezithiyo zokuxhumana, njengoba ukungabi khona komphakathi kungaholela ekudambiseni umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abasebenzi bazizwe bedabukile futhi bephuma emsebenzini. Okwesibili, ukusebenza ekhaya kungaholela ekunciphiseni umkhuba wokuziphatha kahle, njengoba abantu bengase bahlale bephuza noma bengenzi imisebenzi efanele, okungaholela ekwehliseni ukusebenza kahle. Ukubaluleka Kokuphathwa Kwezikhathi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusebenza ekhaya kuyimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuphatha kahle izikhathi. Abasebenzi kufanele babeke imigomo ethile yokusebenza, balungiselele izikhathi zokuphumula, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bexhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bagweme ukucindezeleka nokukhathala, okungaholela ekwehliseni umkhiqizo. Ukwakha umkhuba wokusebenza ofanele, okukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kokusebenza ekhaya. Isiphetho Ukusebenza ekhaya kuyindlela ethokozisayo nekhuthazayo yokwenza umsebenzi, kodwa kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuzuze bonke. Izinzuzo zikhona, kodwa izinkinga nazo zidinga ukunakwa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphela, behlola izindlela zokuphila zabo, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bayakwazi ukuphatha kahle izikhathi zabo ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukusebenza ekhaya kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile emsebenzini wanamuhla.
Ubulalayo obuqondiswe kubantu bangaphandle buwumbango! Uhulumeni ngeke avumele noma iyiphi indlela yobudlova eqondiswe kwabanye abantu! Masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sakhe impilo engcono kubantu bonke abahlala eNingizimu Afrika. Masibambisane ukuze sithuthukise amakhono ethu futhi sakhe amathuba emisebenzi. Uma unemininingwane mayelana nokuhlaselwa okukhulunywa ngakho kwabantu bangaphandle abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, sicela ubize isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze noma uma kuyiphuthumayo, sicela ubize le nombolo ku-10111. Ukuhlasela abantu bangaphandle abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ngeke kuzuze muntu. Kuvame ukuba abantu abangenacala ababa yizisulu zalokhu - abasolwa bayabalekela. Uma unemininingwane mayelana nomsebenzi wobugebengu - bika kumaphoyisa. Ungathathi umthetho ezandleni zakho. Uhulumeni ukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuba ihlale ibheke phansi futhi ibike izigameko ezihlobene nobudlova nempilo enobugagu eqondiswe kubantu bangaphandle. Ukuphumelela kokusingathwa kweFIFA World Cup 2010 kube nomthelela omuhle eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Kukhule kakhulu inani labavakashi abavakashela leli zwe, okuthuthukisile amathuba okutshala imali, futhi lokho kuzovula amathuba emisebenzi. Noma iyiphi indlela yobudlova ezweni lethu izophula konke esikufezile ngesikhathi sokuqhuba iWorld Cup. Manje umhlaba usibheka ngenhlonipho enkulu kunangaphambili.
Abameli bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zaleli zwe eziboshwe kwamanye amazwe ziphathwa ngendlela efanele ngesikhathi zisejele. Noma yiziphi izenzo ezihlobene nokuhlukunyezwa noma ukuphathwa okungahlonishwa noma ukuphathwa kabi kufanele kubikwe eziphathimandla zalelo ndawo. Imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ephathelene nokuphathwa kweziboshwa iyasetshenziswa kulezi zimo. Yisiphi usizo olunikezwa abameli ezakhamuzini zaseNingizimu Afrika eziboshwe kwamanye amazwe? Banika iziboshwa ulwazi ngemicimbi yaleso sikhungo, okungase kufake phakathi imikhawulo yezomthetho yaleso sikhungo, indlela yokufinyelela ohlwini lwabameli uma sebuya ejele, izimo zokukhululwa, nendlela yokuphakamisa icala ukuze iziboshwa zazi amalungelo azo. Bagcina uxhumano olujwayelekile neziboshwa zaseNingizimu Afrika kulowo mhlaba ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bayahambisana nemithetho yaleso sikhungo. Uxhumano nomndeni nabangane luvunyelwe uma luceliwe yiziboshwa. Akukho xhumano noma ulwazi oluzokwabelwana ngaphandle kwemvume yesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esiboshwe kwamanye amazwe. Baqinisekisa ukuthi uma udinga usizo lwezempilo, ubika eziphathimandla ejele. Iphondo lezeMisebenzi Yangaphandle kanye nabameli baseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali, imibhalo nezinto zokufunda, kanye nemithi zifika eziboshweni ngokushesha. Nokho, imisebenzi ebalulekile ye-ofisi ye-embassy ibekwe phambili. Isimo salelo zwe singavimbela ukufika kwezinto eziboshwe. Ukugxila kubekwa ekuthuthukiseni izinkantolo zamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kutholwe ummeli noma ukunikeza izeluleko zomthetho ukuze kube lula ukukhululwa, noma imali yokukhululwa ezindaweni eziphephile noma ejele ukuze kuhlolwe icala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zokuphila ejele z better compared to others ngaphandle kokulandela imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ephathelene nokuboshwa kweziboshwa. Abantu abakhuluma izilimi ezimbili bahlala ejele ezweni lesibili lapho futhi bengabakhulumi khona futhi abakwazi ukusizwa ngabameli baseNingizimu Afrika. Uma abantu abakhuluma izilimi ezimbili bahlala ejele kwamanye amazwe lapho bengabakhulumi khona, futhi bahambe ngepasipoti evela ezweni lesibili, kufanele baxhumane ne-embassy yalelo zwe abahambile ngale pasipoti. Izinga lokusebenza liyahluka ukusuka ezweni ukuya ezweni futhi lincike esimweni sezwe eliboshwe umuntu.
Njengoba siphakathi kwephondo leKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile emizamweni yokubuyisela isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko kanye nokubamba kwabo iqhaza kuzo zonke izici zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezakhamuzi. Umphathi wohlelo, ovela emphakathini waseMalangeni, ubonisa ukuthi ukuba lapha kusinika injabulo enkulu ngoba indawo yaseMalangeni inenhlonipho enkulu emlandweni. Le ndawo iyindawo yokuzalwa kweNkosi uShaka kaSenzangakhona. Sazi futhi ukuthi amaqhawe amaningi avela eMalangeni. Futhi le ndawo yindawo lapho imindeni eminingi ibhujiswa emhlabeni wabo ocebile. Nakuba kunezihloko ezingezinhle emlandweni wale ndawo, ilanga liqhubeka likhanya eMalangeni. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi yethu lapha kwenzeka ngaphansi komlando omkhulu futhi ngesikhathi esibalulekile lapho ubuholi bendabuko bushintsha, buhamba phambili kunangaphambili. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi ukubuyiselwa kobuholi bendabuko kanye nokuphatha kwabo ezimpandeni zabo, ngokwezifiso zendabuko. Siphakathi lapha namuhla siqonda kahle ukuthi nakuba ukujabuliswa kwenkosi yethu kuyisigameko esibalulekile esihlobene nenjabulo nokuqhakambisa isiko, kuhlanganisa nomthetho, ukuphatha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokubaluleka kokugcina isiko. Isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sikhishwe kakhulu yimithetho ehlukene kahulumeni eyayikhona ngaphambili. Kodwa manje lesi simo sishintsha. Uhulumeni wesifunda omusha uhlose ukuhlinzeka abaholi bendabuko ngamathuba okwakha uhlelo lokukhulula umthelela wemigomo yokucindezela nokwahlukanisa esakhiweni sobuholi bendabuko. Sisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze sifinyelele lapho sikhona namuhla. Okwamanje, siphakathi kwenqubo yokwakha umthetho ozophonswa ezingeni lesifunda mayelana nabaholi bendabuko nokuphatha, futhi uzobhekana nezinkinga ezithinta thina ngqo njengephondo. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kube ukuphambuka kuMthethosisekelo weSizwe. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume kahle. Ngivumele ukusebenzisa leli thuba ukuqala ngokugqamisa amaphuzu abalulekile esiko mayelana nesigameko sokugcotshwa kwenkosi. Nakuba kuzobe kusekhona umthetho esifundazweni ozohlinzeka ngemininingwane ngalokhu. Kodwa ngokufingqa, ngingasho lapha ukuthi umndeni wesigodlo usuphumelele indima yawo ngokukhetha uNkosi uNgcobo njengenkosi yesizwe saseMalangeni. Okuzolandela ukuthi indlela yendabuko izophelelwa nguIsilo SamaBandla, lapho kuzobe kukhona nendlela yethu endala yokuthola amanzi. Le mikhuba ibalulekile kakhulu ngoba inkosi iyona ethulisa amakhosi, futhi amakhosi aphinde asebenze nenkosi. Le mikhuba sifisa ukuthi ihlonishwe, futhi sikhuthaza wonke amakhosi ukuba agcotshwe ukuthi alandele le mikhuba. Angazi ukuthi bangaki bethu abazi noma basakhumbula lezi zifiso, njengoba ingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu lendabuko ilahlekile eminyakeni edlule yohulumeni. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile ekubuyiseni isithunzi samakhosi. Ngibhalile izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye esizithathile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi isakhiwo sethu sobuholi bendabuko sithola indawo yaso efanele. Le mizamoyo ifaka phakathi ukuthi ekugcineni indima yamakhosi ekuletheni intuthuko ihlonishwe. Siyazi ukuthi uNkosi uNgcobo kanye nekhansela lakhe, kanye namanye amakhosi, njengengxenye yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko, sevele baqale imizamo yokuthuthukisa, ngakho manje iOndabezitha iyamenywa ukuphatha ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukuhlela nokubambisana nezakhiwo zezakhamuzi ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwentuthuko ezindaweni zokuhlala zamakhosi. Uhulumeni ukholelwa ukuthi intuthuko nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kungasheshiswa ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yamakhosi kanye nezikhulu ezikhethwe. Imizamo kaNkosi uNgcobo ekuletheni intuthuko kule ndawo, ngiyakholelwa nonke niyazi. Akukho shwa ngokuqinisekile ngokuqhubeka kukaNkosi ekuthuthukiseni. I-IDP, sibona izoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu ngokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Bonke sibona ukuthi nakuba inkosi izama, isikhundla senkosi, njengabanye abaningi, sishiywe ngemuva uma kuziwa ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza zentuthuko. Lesi simo asivumelekile. Njengohulumeni, sikholwa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uthuthuke ngokulinganayo; akufanele kube nezilwandle zempumelelo phakathi kobumpofu nokuhlupheka. Futhi akufanele kube nabantu abaphila kahle kakhulu kanti abanye bahlupheka kakhulu. Lesi simo umasipala kufanele sihlole futhi silungise ngokubambisana namakhosi kanye nekhansela labo. Ngibhalile indima yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko ekuletheni intuthuko; kufanele sihlole futhi indima yabo emlandweni eyasilethela lapho sikhona namuhla. Umlando usitshela ukuthi ekuvikeleni abantu babo, amasiko, nezwe labo, amakhosi amaningi, kuhlanganise nalawo avela kulezi zintaba nezilwandle, athatha izikhali ukuze alwe nokucindezelwa nokwahlukaniswa. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, asikwazi ukukhohlwa ubuhlakani bukaBhambatha kaMancinza, owahlulwa yizikhali zesimanje zabahlaseli, waphonsa isisekelo senkululeko nodemokhrasi esijabulela namuhla. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa okusemthethweni kukaNkosi uNgcobo namuhla kuqinisa ukuqhubeka kwesikhumbuzo sobuhlakani obuhlale buyingxenye yamakhosi amaningi kulesi sifunda kanye nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Umphathi Wohlelo, uhulumeni wethu ubaluleka kakhulu kumakhosi, hhayi ngoba bangabaphethe bezamasiko nezindlela zendabuko, kodwa futhi ngoba bamele ingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwethu kokhetho olusemthethweni olususelwa kumthethosisekelo. Kuye kwaba njalo kubalulekile kuhulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko ziqiniswa. Uhulumeni weKwaZulu-Natal ukholelwa ukuthi kudingeka ukuvikelwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuthuthukiswa kokuba khona kwabaphathi bendabuko kanye nezikhulumi ezikhethwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu bethu. Iqiniso ukuthi njengelizwe kanye nephondo, sithwele izinguquko ezinkulu kwezomnotho nasemphakathini. Siphila eNingizimu Afrika lapho idemokhrasi nentuthuko seziqhubeka phambili. Noma ungumholi bendabuko, umphakathi, noma ilungu lePhalamende, unendima ebalulekile futhi edingekayo ekufezeni umgomo wethu wokuphula bezokuphepha, ukungabi namsebenzi, nendlala. Ukugcotshwa kwamaOndabezitha uMapholoba namuhla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni egxile kakhulu ekubuyiseleni ithemba kubantu bethu ezikhungweni zezakhamuzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kweziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zezakhamuzi nezakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko. Akukho shwa ukuthi ukusungulwa ngempumelelo kweziteshi zokubambisana phakathi kwezinga lempilo yomphakathi kuzoholela ekuhlinzekweni kwezidingo ezibalulekile futhi kuzosheshisa ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokuphila kwabantu basemakhaya.
