Izinhlelo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Izimo eziphuthumayo ziwumthwalo omkhulu empilweni yomuntu, zidinga ukuzinikela okuqondile, okusheshayo, nolwazi olunembile ukuze kugwenywe imiphumela engafuneki. Ezibhedlela, ukunakekelwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo kubaluleke kakhulu, futhi kuthinta iziguli eziningi. Lo mbiko uhlose ukuhlela izinqubo ezisemqoka ezimisiwe endaweni yokwelashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izimo eziphuthumayo ziqhutshelwa phambili ngendlela efanele. I. Ukuthola Izimo Eziphuthumayo Ukuqonda ukufaneleka kokubiza usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Uma isiguli sifika ezibhedlela, kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe ukuhlola isimo saso. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqonda izimpawu, imvelaphi yokulimala, nezimo zempilo ezikhona. Izisebenzi zezempilo zibhala imibiko enembile, ukuze ukuthola ulwazi olucacile kube lula, futhi kube khona izinqumo ezihloniphekile. II. Izindlela Zokuhlela Ngemuva kokuqinisekiswa kwesimo seziguli, izinqubo zokuhlela ziyaqala. Izibhedlela zinezinqubo ezithile ezisunguliwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli eziphuthumayo zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukulawula izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezokwelapha zokushesha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwelashwa okufanele. III. Ukubika Nokuqapha Ukubika izimo eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Izinqubo zebhodi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokubika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhunyushwa kolwazi olutholakele. Ukulandela izinqubo ezilandelanayo zokubika kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kahle kwenqubo. IV. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Abasebenzi bezempilo badinga ukuqeqeshwa njalo. Ukuze bagcine izinga eliphezulu lemfundo, kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale befunda ngezinguquko ezintsha emkhakheni wezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amathuba okuthola ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. V. Uxhaso Lwempilo Esikhathini sokuzenzakalelayo, uxhaso lwezimo eziphuthumayo luyadingeka. Ukuqonda izimo eziphuthumayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwesikhala sokwelapha esikhulu. Uxhaso luhlanganisa izinsiza zomphakathi nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhona. VI. Ukufaka Izobuchwepheshe Ukufaka izobuchwepheshe kwezokwelapha kuqinisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Izibhedlela zingathuthukisa izinqubo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. VII. Ukuxhumana Neziguli Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi neziguli kubalulekile. Abasebenzi bezempilo badinga ukuxhumana kahle neziguli ukuze baqonde kahle izimo zempilo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukubonisana phakathi kwabo, kunciphise izinkinga, futhi kudale umuzwa oyiqiniso wokuphila. VIII. Ukuhlola Izimo Nemiphumela Ukuhlola izimo zomsebenzi wezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola imiphumela esigulini, ukusebenza kwezinqubo ezisetshenzisiwe, nokuqonda izinkinga ezivela. IX. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile ekunakekelweni kwesiguli. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ziyahambisana nemithetho, futhi zikhuthaza impilo engcono. Ngokuhlonipha lezi zinyathelo ezisemqoka, izibhedlela zingathola impumelelo embonini yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, zigcine izinsizakusebenza zihlanzekile futhi ziphendule izidingo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa izinga eliphezulu lempilo nezenzo ezithobekile.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini: Isidingo Sokubheka Ngezindlela Ezihlukahlukene Emiphakathini yethu, izinkinga zamanzi zibe yinkinga enkulu, ethinta impilo, ezemvelo, kanye nezomnotho. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi eziphukile, konke lokhu kudala izinselelo ezinzima. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izimbangela zazo, izimpawu, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amanzi ayisisekelo sempilo. Ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile, impilo yomphakathi ibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Izifo ezithathelwanayo, ezifana ne-cholera ne-typhoid, zikhula lapho abantu bengenayo imithombo yamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kubangela ukwanda kwezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okwenza kube nzima kumiphakathi ethwele kanzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantwana, ikakhulukazi, bahlaselwa kakhulu, njengoba izifo ezihlobene namanzi zingathinta ukukhula kwabo nokufunda. Ngokuphathelene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi, lokhu kuyinkinga ebonakalayo emiphakathini eminingi. Imithombo yamanzi iyahlaselwa ngukukhipha imfucumfucu, imfucuza yezimboni, kanye nezinsiza zokulima. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi emvelweni, kuholele ekunciphiseni kwezinto eziphilayo, futhi kuphazamise izinhlelo zokuphila zabantu. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi akukhona nje kuphela okuthinta impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuthinta nezilwane nezitshalo, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imithombo yethu yamanzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Emiphakathini eminingi, izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi zikhona, kodwa azisebenzi kahle. Ukuphazamiseka kwemithombo, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo ezingasebenzi kahle, konke lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Ngokubheka izixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi abantu basebenze ndawonye, bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imikhankaso yokufundisa abantu ngokuqwashisa ngamanzi, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka, kanye nokwakha imithombo emisha yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele kungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuhlanza amanzi, njengezinhlelo zokuhlunga, zingasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokungcoliswa. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi, kungasiza ekuphatheni kahle imithombo yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlola izinsiza zamanzi. Ngokuphetha, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi eziphukile, konke lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane, ithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, futhi isebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha imiphakathi enempilo, enokuthula, futhi eqinile. Izinkinga zamanzi akusona isimo esingashintsha kalula, kodwa ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuzenza zibe yinto yempilo engcono.
Izinkulumo zomthetho eziphathelene nokuthathwa komhlaba Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseMkhumbane uhlela umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nezinkulumo zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lo mcimbi, obubanjelwe emnyangweni wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, wawuhloselwe ukudala ithuba lokuxoxa, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngemicabango phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, izikhulu zikamasipala, kanye nezazi zomthetho. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo kaMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wesifunda, owakhumbuza bonke abebekhona ngobaluleka kokuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezindabeni zokuthathwa komhlaba. Uthe, “Ukuthathwa komhlaba akuyona into elula; kudinga ukucabangela izimpilo zabantu, izinsiza, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi.” Ngemuva kwalokho, izazi zomthetho zabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsiza zomthetho ezikhona eziphathelene nokuthathwa komhlaba. UProf. Zanele Khumalo, ongumlawuli wezifundo eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, waphawula ngokuqonda okubalulekile kokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba. Uthe, “Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba awuwona umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa ungumthombo wezimpilo zethu.” Umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu abathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abanikazi bomhlaba, izinkampani ezithintekayo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. UMsizi Mkhize, ongumholi weqembu labanikazi bomhlaba, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho umhlaba wabo uthathwa. Uthe, “Siyazama ukuvikela amalungelo ethu, kodwa imithetho ibonakala ingasithathi kahle. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi singazithola kanjani izixazululo eziphumelelayo.” Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, kwaba nesikhathi sokuxoxa, lapho abantu bekhuthazwa ukuba babelane ngemibono yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezimpikiswano ezinzima, kodwa eziphumelelayo, mayelana nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imithetho yokuthathwa komhlaba. Abanye babebonisa ukukhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabantu abathintekayo, kanti abanye baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubuyisela umhlaba kubanikazi bawo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokwazisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abo. Izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana ne-Advocacy Group for Land Rights, zabelana ngemininingwane yokuthi abantu bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zomthetho uma bephikisana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabathola kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonakale uphumelele ekwakheni indawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, okuhlanganisa iziphathimandla, izazi, kanye nomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuxoxa lwaluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwabelana ngemicabango, futhi lwenze kube lula ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinqubo zomthetho ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, ubonisa ukuthi izinkulumo zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuxoxwa ngokujulile, futhi zidinga ukubandakanya wonke umuntu. Umphakathi ubonise isifiso sokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi ezithuthukisa izimo zokuphila zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, umphakathi unamandla okwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenzeka ngendlela efanele. Umcimbi ubonisa ukuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elihlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi elithuthukisa umphakathi wonke. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umhlaba, njengomthombo wezimpilo, uhlonishwa futhi uvikelwe.
Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, njengoba zithinta impilo yabantu abadinga usizo lwezokwelapha. E-Gauteng, okuyisifunda esinabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi zihlala zihlolwe futhi ziqhathaniswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. 1. Ukubaluleka kwezikhathi zokuphendula Izikhathi zokuphendula zisho isikhathi esithathwa yi-ambulensi ukusondela endaweni yokuphuthuma. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izimo eziphuthumayo, njengezingozi zomgwaqo, ukuwa, noma izifo ezinzima, zidinga ukusabela okusheshayo ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okwengeziwe noma ukufa. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula ezisheshayo zingakhuphula amathuba okuphila kwabantu abadinga usizo. 2. Izici ezithinta izikhathi zokuphendula Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng zithonywa yizici eziningi, okuhlanganisa: - Ubukhulu besifunda: EGauteng, izindawo ezinamakhaya amaningi nezindawo eziphithizelayo zenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhathi zokuphendula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. - Izimo zomgwaqo: Izimo zomgwaqo, njengezikhala, izithiyo, noma izimo zezulu, zingathinta isikhathi sokuhamba kwama-ambulensi. Izimo ezimbi zomgwaqo zingaholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuphendula. - Inani lama-ambulensi: Inani lama-ambulensi atholakalayo endaweni ethile lingenza umehluko omkhulu. Uma kunezimo eziningi eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi esifanayo, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphendula. - Izinsiza ezitholakalayo: Ukuze ama-ambulensi aphendule ngokushesha, kudingeka izinsiza ezifanele, njengabashayeli abaqeqeshiwe, izimoto ezisebenza kahle, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. 3. Izinga lokuphendula e-Gauteng Ngokwezinqubomgomo zempilo, izikhathi zokuphendula ezinhle zidinga ukuba ama-ambulensi aphendule ezimeni eziphuthumayo phakathi kwemizuzu emithathu kuya kwemihlanu. Nokho, e-Gauteng, izikhathi zokuphendula zingahluka kakhulu. Kwezinye izindawo, ama-ambulensi angaphendula ngaphakathi kwemizuzu emibili, kanti kwezinye izindawo, kungathatha isikhathi eside, ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo ngenhla. 4. Ukuhlola izikhathi zokuphendula Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula zihlala ziphansi, iziphathimandla zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Uphenyo lwabantu: Ukuqonda izimo ezithinta izikhathi zokuphendula, iziphathimandla zenza uphenyo kubantu abathole usizo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba baqonde izinkinga ezikhona. - Ukuhlola izibalo: Izibalo zokuphendula zihlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-ambulensi aphendula ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izikhathi ezithathwa ama-ambulensi ukusondela ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. - Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa: Uma izikhathi zokuphendula zingahambisani nezidingo, iziphathimandla zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphendula. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwandisa inani lama-ambulensi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, noma ukuhlela izindlela ezihamba kahle. 5. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa izikhathi zokuphendula Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa: - Ukukhulisa inani lama-ambulensi: Ukwanda kwenani lama-ambulensi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukuqeqesha abashayeli: Ukuqeqesha abashayeli ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo kungasiza ekwandiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana: Izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo zingasiza ekutholeni ama-ambulensi ngokushesha, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukubambisana nezindawo zomphakathi: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa umphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kungasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi bangabiza kanjani ama-ambulensi ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Isiphetho Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta lezi zikhathi, ukuhlola izibalo, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yabantu ibhekwa ngeso elibukhali, futhi izinsiza zempilo zisebenza kahle ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha: Umhlahlandlela Oqondile Nothando Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuwumkhiqizo wesigameko esibalulekile esithinta impilo yomuntu. Le nqubo, ebandakanya ukuqala kokukhula komntwana, ivame ukubhekwa njengomphumela ophawulekayo wokuthokozisa kokuhlobana, kodwa futhi iphethe imiphumela eminingi edinga ukuqashelwa. Noma ngabe abantu abaningi bazi kahle ukuthi umntwana uhamba kanjani, kubalulekile ukuba sihlolisise kahle zonke izici ezithinta ukukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ebuhleni nasebuhlungwini obuhambisana nakho. Isizathu Sokukhulelwa Ukukhulelwa kuqala lapho ukuhlanganiswa kwamangqamuzana amabili, elinye elivela kumama nelinye elivela kubaba, kwenzeka. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokuvamile ngesikhathi sokuhlobana. Ngemuva kokuhlanganiswa, umhlonyane ulandela indlela yawo oya emathunjini, lapho uqala khona khona ukwakheka komntwana. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi intsha iqonde kahle lokhu, ukuze baqonde ukuthi ukuhlobana akusihlalo sokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuziphatha kahle nokucatshangelwa. Imiphumela Yokukhulelwa Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akukona okujabulisayo kuphela, ngoba kubandakanya izici eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ubulili, izimo zomphakathi, imvelo, kanye nezidingo zomuntu siqu, konke lokhu kwenza izindlela zokuphila nezinkambiso zabalulekile. Intsha ikwenza kube nesibopho sokwenza izinqumo ezifanele ukuze kugwenywe izimo ezingezinhle, ezinjengezithiyo, ukuswela, noma izinkinga zempilo. Kudala, umphakathi ubona ukukhulelwa kwentsha njengento enezithako eziningi. Ngenkathi abanye bebheka ukuthi ikhuluma ngothando, abanye bathi ukuthola ubandlululo. Lokhu kuthinta izimvelo zomndeni nomphakathi, okwenza uzive bekhuthalele ukuthola izixazululo ezinokwenzeka. Umonakalo omkhulu ungavela uma umntwana ekhulela ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, okwandisa amathuba okuba nezingqinamba eziningi empilweni yakhe. Izinyathelo Zokuxhasa Intsha Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uhlinzeke ngesiqondiso esifanele nokuqondiswa kwabantu abasha. Izikhungo zabantu, njengezikole nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, zidinga ukwesekwa ukuze ziwuphathe lo mzila ukuze zikwazi ukuxhasa intsha. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezemfundo, ukuvikelwa kwezempilo, kanye nesibindi sokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zempilo, kuyinto efanele ukuba yenzeke, ivuselele umqondo wokukhula kwentsha enempilo. Ukukhuluma nezinsiza, izikhungo zokwelapha zingabahlinzeka ngolwazi lolwazi lokuphumelela kwezindawo ezibalulekile. Izinkulumo ezinhle, okuhloswe ngazo abachwepheshe, kufanele ziqhutshelwe phambili, ukuze abantu abasha baqonde kangcono ukuthi yini okudingeka bazilungiselele, nangendlela yokukhuluma. Ukubamba Isandla Eunhlalweni Ngenxa yomthelela emiphakathini, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uphathe umoya ohloniphekile phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana kwamalungu omphakathi, abahlengikazi, nezikhungo zemfundo. Njengoba intsha ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa, kumqoka ukuthi kekukhiqizwe ukugqugquzela ukusekelwa kwabantu abasha, ukuze bakhule bezazi futhi benza izinqumo ezinhle. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kusemqoka futhi kudinga ukucabangela okujulile. Kungaba ukuphila okuhle, okugcwele ezinjabulo, uma kuphela umphakathi usiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. Ukukhuluma ngalezi zindaba kufanele kube yinto evulekile, ukuze ingane weza ikhulile, ibe nekhono lokubhekana nezithiyo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yethu ibambisene futhi ikhululekile, iphila kahle empilweni. Ukukhulelwa akusilutho olunye, kodwa kuyindlela esizokwakha ngayo ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi Kwakhanya ilanga, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela kubantu abahlala emadolobheni amakhulu. Phakathi kwezinkanyezi, kukhona umhlaba owawungaziwa – umhlaba weshashalazi. Imidlalo yeshashalazi, noma i-theatre, iyinsika yamasiko, ibhuloho phakathi kwezizukulwane, futhi ibonisa ubuciko bokuphila kwabantu. Ekuqaleni, imidlalo yeshashalazi yayiyindlela yokukhumbula izenzakalo ezibalulekile, izinganekwane, nemfundo ethile. Abantu babebuthana emithonjeni, ezindaweni ezikhethekile, ukuze babone abalingisi bephila izindaba ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwakungelula, ngoba abalingisi babephila izinkanyezi, bephila izimpilo ezahlukene, futhi bezama ukudlulisa imizwa yabo kubabukeli. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yayiyindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso zabantu. Ngonyaka owodwa, umqondisi ophumelelayo, uMnumzane Mthembu, waphakamisa umbono omusha. Wathi, “Ngifuna ukudala umhlaba lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuzwakalisa imizwa yabo, bahlabe umxhwele, futhi bakhumbule ukuthi baphila kanjani.” Waqala ukuhlela imidlalo ehlobene nezinkinga zomphakathi, efaka izindaba zothando, ubuhlungu, nempilo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha, lapho abalingisi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo, behlola izimo ezinzima, futhi bezama ukuthola izixazululo. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abantu baphenduka bezobona imidlalo, bejabulile, bezwa ukuthi imidlalo ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho abalingisi, abaqondisi, nababukeli behlangana ukuze bakhe umhlaba ophilayo. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yabe isiyindawo yokuxoxa, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso, futhi yathola indawo ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu. Njengoba imidlalo yeshashalazi iqhubeka, kwavela abalingisi abasha, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. UThandiwe, intombazane eyayiphuma emakhaya, waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imidlalo ingashintsha impilo yomuntu. Waqala ukudlala indima encane, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba yinkanyezi enkulu. UThandiwe wayenenhloso yokudlala, futhi wayefuna ukwabelana ngempilo yakhe nabanye. Waqhubeka nokukhula, waba yisithombe sokuphumelela, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Kwakukhona uSipho, owayengumculi, noNandi, owayengumqondisi. Bobabili babebambisene, behlanganisa umculo, ukudansa, nezinkanyezi eziphilayo. Imidlalo yabo yabe ibonisa ubuhle bokuphila, ubudlelwano, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Ababukeli babebonisa uthando, behlabelela, bejabulile, futhi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Kodwa, njengazo zonke izinto, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibhekana nezinselelo. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abantu bebengakuthandi, noma imidlalo ingatholi ukwesekwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokubuyisela emuva, nokucabanga ngempilo. UMthembu, noThandiwe, noSipho, babebonisa ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ayigcini nje ngokuba yindawo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, yokubhekana nezinkinga, nokwakha umphakathi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinzima, imidlalo yeshashalazi yaphinde yaphumelela. Ababukeli babebuyela, bejabulile, futhi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo. UThandiwe, uSipho, noNandi baphinde bakha imidlalo emisha, ethokozisayo, futhi eyakhayo. Imidlalo yabo yabe ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yeshashalazi yahlala iyinsika yamasiko, ibhuloho phakathi kwezizukulwane. Yaba yindawo yokuxoxa, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo, futhi bejabulisa abanye. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yahlala ibalulekile, futhi izinkanyezi zayo zihlala zikhanya, zikhombisa indlela kubantu abahlala emadolobheni amakhulu. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsika, ibhuloho, futhi iyindlela yokuphila. Ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile, esifanele ukuba sikhumbule njalo.
Umnikazi wempahla ebhalisiwe kumele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethinta leyo mpahla, izinqumo zenkantolo zokuvimbela ezinye izenzo mayelana nempahla, inani lemali emakethe lempahla, imigomo ye-title deed eyingxenye yempahla, ikhophi yesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi kwe-deed, ilungelo lokudlulisela impahla komunye umuntu, inani lesikweletu sokuthenga impahla, kanye neminye imibhalo efanele. Ikhophi ye-title plan eyingxenye yempahla, noma imigomo yokuphathwa kwe-Title Scheme eyingxenye yempahla, kodwa ikhophi yokuhloswe yokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokwakhiwa kwesigaba sokuhlala sabantu abaxhumene nempahla noma itayitile. Amagama aphelele noma inombolo yokukhomba yomnikazi wempahla, noma okungenani usuku lwabo lokuzalwa. Inombolo ye-erf kanye nenombolo ye-towship, noma igama lefamu nenombolo, kodwa hhayi ikheli lomgwaqo. Hamba kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lemidlalelo, uye ehhovisi lolwazi, lapho umphakathi ozosiza ekugcwaliseni ifomu elibekiwe futhi echaza inqubo. Cela umtapo wolwazi we-data ukuthi useshe ulwazi ngempahla, noma ukhokhe imali efanele ehhovisi lezezimali bese uthatha umphumela emuva kumphakathi ehhovisi lolwazi. Inombolo yomphumela izobanjwa nekhophi yakho ye-title. Ukusesha ulwazi kungathatha imizuzu engama-30 kuya kwengama-60. Ezinye ehhovisi ezinkulu, ikhophi ye-title ingathunyelwa ngeposi, noma kufanele iqoqwe ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile. Umphakathi ehhovisi leMidlalelo uzokunikeza ifomu okufanele ugcwalise.
Inyama Yenkomo: Ukubuyekezwa Kwekhwalithi Nempilo Inyama yenkomo, eyaziwa ngesiNgisi ngokuthi "beef," iyinsika ebalulekile emndenini wethu, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Iphakathi kwezithako ezisemqoka ezithokozisa izibiliboco zethu, futhi ibalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zenyama yenkomo, kuhlanganise nekhwalithi yayo, izinzuzo zempilo, nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuyipheka. Ikhwalithi Yenkomo Ukukhetha inyama yenkomo ehamba phambili kubalulekile. Inyama enempilo ibonakala ibomvu, inamafutha alinganiselwe, futhi inamathambo aqinile. Ukuze uthole inyama engcono, kubalulekile ukukhetha izinkomo ezikhuliswa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa kwemithi yokukhulisa. Izinkomo ezikhuliswa emapulazini anokunakekelwa kahle, ezithola ukudla okuphumelelayo, zikhulisa inyama enempilo, enezinga eliphezulu lezinhlayiya ezidingekayo emzimbeni. Izinzuzo Zempilo Inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu yokudla okunempilo. Iqukethe amaprotheni aphezulu, avumela ukukhula kwemisipha kanye nokwakhiwa kwezicubu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iqukethe amavithamini ahlukahlukene, njenge-B12, ebalulekile ekusebenzeni kahle kwezinzwa. Iphinde ibe nezinhlayiya ezibalulekile, ezifana ne-iron, ezisiza ekwakheni igazi elinempilo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuyidla ngokulinganisela, ngoba amafutha amaningi angaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Izindlela Zokupheka Inyama yenkomo ingaphekwa ngezindlela eziningi, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuyihlanganisa nezitsha ezahlukene. Ukupheka inyama yenkomo kuhlanganisa izindlela ezinjenge-grilling, roasting, frying, noma slow cooking. Ukupheka ku-grill kuveza ukunambitheka okuhle, kanti i-roasting iyindlela ethokozisayo yokuthola inyama ethambile. I-slow cooking, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ivumela izithako ukuba zixube kahle, ikhiqiza isobho elinothile nelinambitheka. Izithako Ezihambisanayo Inyama yenkomo ihambisana kahle nezinye izithako, njengezithombo, imifino, kanye nezinkwa. Ukusebenzisa imifino efana ne-broccoli, carrots, noma izaqathe kuhlobisa ukudla, futhi kuqinisa inani lempilo. Izithako ezinjenge-garlic, rosemary, noma thyme zingathuthukisa ukunambitheka kwenyama, zenza kube mnandi kakhulu. Ukugcina Inyama Yenkomo Ukugcina inyama yenkomo ngendlela efanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ihlale iphilile. Kubalulekile ukuyigcina endaweni epholile, futhi uma ungayisebenzisi ngokushesha, kufanele uyifake efrijini. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi inyama iyagcinwa kahle, qiniseka ukuthi ibhalwe kahle ukuze ungabi nekhanda lokuthi iyashintsha ukunambitheka. Isiphetho Inyama yenkomo iyinsika ebalulekile ekudleni kwethu, inikeza izinzuzo eziningi zempilo, futhi iyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa izitsha ezahlukene. Ukukhetha inyama enempilo, ukuyipheka ngendlela efanele, nokuyigcina kahle, kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi uthola okunambitheka okuhle nokunempilo. Ngakho-ke, uma uthanda ukudla okuhle, ungaphuthelwa yithuba lokujabulela inyama yenkomo, eyenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane.
Ukwelashwa Kwezifo Zengqondo: Umqondo Ohloniphekile noMsebenzi Oqondile Izifo zengqondo, njengokukhathazeka, umoya ophansi, kanye nezinye izimo ezithinta imizwa, zibe yizinkinga ezinkulu emphakathini wethu. Lezi zifo azithinti kuphela abantu ngabanye, kodwa zinezimpempe ezibanzi ezithinta imindeni, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zifo, siqonde ukuthi zikhona, futhi sithole izindlela zokwelapha ezisebenzayo. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuqonda okujulile. Abantu abaningi basaba ukuvuma ukuthi banesifo sengqondo ngenxa yokwesaba ukujabulisa, ukucwaswa, noma ukungaqondi kahle. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlale bezama ukubhekana nezinkinga zabo bodwa, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo. Ukuze sikwazi ukusiza, kudingeka sishintshe indlela esibheka ngayo lezi zifo. Akukhona okungajabulisi, kodwa kuyinqubo efanele, futhi kufanele siqonde ukuthi sikhuluma ngezimpilo zabantu. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlobonhlobo zezindlela. Abanye abantu bangase bacabangele ukwelashwa ngokomzimba, njengokwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanti abanye bangathanda ukwelashwa ngokomoya, njengokukhuluma nodokotela bezengqondo. Ukuxhumana nomuntu onolwazi, ofana nodokotela noma umeluleki, kungaba yisinyathelo sokuqala esibalulekile. Lokhu akuhlanganisi nje ukwelashwa okujwayelekile, kodwa futhi kudinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komuntu odinga usizo nomeluleki. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi udinga ukuba neqhaza elikhulu ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo. Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kudingeka sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphule ukungabaza nokwesaba. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezinhlelo zokufundisa, ezokwelapha, kanye nemikhankaso yokwakha ukuqonda. Umphakathi ungalwela ukwakha izindawo ezivulekile zokuxoxa ngezifo zengqondo, ukunciphisa ukucwaswa, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele ekwelashweni. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sithuthukise izinsiza ezikhona. Izibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nemitholampilo kumele zibe nezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudingeka abeluleki abaningi, odokotela, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze abantu bathole usizo oludingekayo. Ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele, abantu abaningi bazoba sengozini yokuhlala bezwa bephansi, bezama ukubhekana nezinkinga zabo bodwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukusiza abanye. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bathole usizo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta imizwa. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo akuyona into eyodwa kuphela, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukwelashwa akupheli, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube yinto eqhubekayo empilweni yabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumana nodokotela, baphinde bahlale bephokophele phambili, beqonda ukuthi izinkinga zingavela futhi zidinga ukwelashwa ngokuqhubekayo. Ekugcineni, ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuba kube yinto ejwayelekile, hhayi into ethusayo. Umphakathi kumele ube nesithakazelo ekwakheni indawo evulekile, lapho abantu bezwa bekhululekile ukuveza izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta imizwa. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe umphakathi onempilo, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, futhi wonke umuntu ehlonishwa. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi kuyinqubo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ohloniphekile, nolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kube lula ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokukhuluma, masiqhubeke nokufundisa, futhi masiqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail Isingeniso Ukwakhiwa kwezimoto zokuhamba kwezimpahla ezisebenza ngaphansi kwe-Transnet Freight Rail kudinga ukuhlaziywa okujulile kwezinsiza, izinqubo, nezimo ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo. Le dokhumenti ibheka izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ukugcinwa, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsiza zomsebenzi. 1. Ukuphepha Ukuphepha kusebenza njengesisekelo sokusebenza kwezitimela. Izinselelo ezinkulu zifaka phakathi: - Izingozi Zokuphepha: Kunezingozi eziningi ezihlobene nezitimela, okuhlanganisa nokuphahlazeka, ukuhamba okungafanele, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo eziqinile zokuhlola nokugcina. - Ukuphazamiseka Kwezimoto: Ukuhluleka kokusebenza kwezitimela kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni okukhulu. Ukubhekelela izinhlelo zokugcina ezisebenzayo nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zingozi. 2. Ukugcinwa Kwezinsiza Ukugcinwa kwezinsiza zokuhamba kwezimpahla kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezinsiza: Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezanele zokugcinwa, njengemishini yokulungisa, kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zihlala zisebenza kahle. - Ukwanda Kwezindleko: Izindleko zokugcinwa ziya zanda, lokhu kungenxa yokukhula kwezindleko zokusebenza, izinsiza, nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zindleko, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle izinsiza nezinhlelo zokusebenza. 3. Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengezinga elibalulekile lokusebenza kwezitimela. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezobuchwepheshe: Ukuze kube nokusebenza okuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi izitimela zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukuntuleka kwezobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. - Ukuphazamiseka Kwamathuluzi: Ukuphazamiseka kwamathuluzi obuchwepheshe kungathinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola nokugcina ubuchwepheshe. 4. Izinsiza Zomsebenzi Izinsiza zomsebenzi zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezisebenzi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinselelo zokusebenza ezanele. Ukuntuleka kwezimali ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. - Izinhlelo Zokuqeqesha: Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bejwayele izinqubo ezisemqoka. Ukuqeqeshwa okunganele kungaholela emaphutheni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. 5. Ukubambisana Nezinye Izinhlaka Ukubambisana nezinye izinhlaka kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukungabikhona Kwezokuxhumana: Ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Transnet Freight Rail nezinye izinhlaka. Ukungabikhona kwezokuxhumana kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. - Izinkinga Zomthetho: Izinkinga zomthetho zingathinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Isiphetho Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuqonda lezi zinselelo nokuhlinzeka ngamasu okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-Transnet Freight Rail ibambisane nezinye izinhlaka, ihlaziye izinqubo zayo, futhi ithuthukise izinsiza zayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle, ziphephile, futhi zisebenza ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwezimpahla, kuqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabathengi zikhuthele, futhi kuthuthukiswe umnotho wezwe.
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano Ngesikhathi ilanga likhanya kakhulu eGoli, umphakathi wahlangana emkhakheni omkhulu wezokungcebeleka. Kwakukhona umncintiswano omkhulu we-basketball obizwa ngokuthi "Ibhola Lethu." Abantu babejabulile, bejolise emkhakheni, bekhuluma ngabadlali abavelele, abanye bezijabulisa ngeziphuzo, kanti abanye bejolise ezindaweni ezikhethekile ukuze babone kahle. UThabo, umgibeli ophumelele emidlalweni edlule, wayezimisele ukujabulisa abalandeli bakhe. Yize uThabo engumfana ophuma emndenini ophakathi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano babubanga umdlandla. Wazi ukuthi umphakathi ubheke kuye, futhi wayefuna ukukhombisa ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Ngesikhathi umncintiswano uqala, izinkanyezi ziqala ukuvela. UThabo noSipho, umngani wakhe, babejabulile, bejolise emkhakheni. UThabo wayezama ukugcina ukugxila, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana wawumkhumbuza ukuthi akufanele aphumele ngaphandle. Umphakathi wawumkhumbula, futhi uyafuna ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Umdlalo uqala, umoya wawugcwele. UThabo wathola ibhola, wakhuphuka, waphosa, waphosa ibhola elibhalwe kahle. Kwakungathi ibhola lalingena emoyeni, laphuma phansi, umphakathi wawujabule, uThabo waba yinkanyezi emkhakheni. Kodwa umphakathi wawungazi ukuthi uThabo wayenobuhlungu obukhulu. Ngemuva kokuphosa ibhola, wathola ukuthi umgibeli ophikisanayo, uMandla, wayemkhumbuza ngezinkumbulo ezinzima. UThabo wayekade edlala ibhola, kodwa kwenzeka ingozi eminyakeni edlule, wathola ukulimala okukhulu. Lokhu kwashiya umoya wakhe uphansi, kodwa wayezimisele ukulwa. Umdlalo uqhubeka, futhi uThabo wayezama ukugcina umoya wakhe uphansi. Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, kodwa uMandla wayephikisana naye, efuna ukumnqanda. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, umphakathi wawujabule, kodwa uThabo wayezwa ubuhlungu. Wazi ukuthi kufanele akhumbule ukuthi umphakathi ubheke kuye, futhi wayefuna ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wawujabule, uThabo waba yinkanyezi emkhakheni. UThabo noSipho baphuma emkhakheni, bejabulile, umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uThabo wayezimisele ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo.
I-Crime Stop inezikhungo eziningi zokubiza ezikhethekile ekuqoqeni ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezono kanye nemisebenzi yabo yokwenza izono. Amalungu omphakathi athola usizo kubasebenzi bezikhungo zokubiza abaqeqeshiwe ekuphatheni izingcingo nasekutholeni ulwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuvumela abantu ukuba baziwe iSikhungo Sezokuphepha SaseNingizimu Afrika ngemicimbi yokwenza izono ngendlela ephephile engabafaki engozini. Uma uthanda, ungakhetha ukuhlala ungaziwa. Abameli baphawula futhi banikeza ulwazi ngesikhathi izingcingo, futhi labo abashaya izingcingo akufuneki bakhombise ubunikazi babo kuCrime Stop, okuvumela abashaya izingcingo ukuba bahlale bengaziwa uma befisa. Ulwazi olunikeziwe luthunyelwa eziphathimandla. Qaphela: lokhu kwenziwa kuphela ngenhloso yakho. Umuntu oxhumana naye ezikhungweni zokubiza uzokubuza imibuzo, futhi uma ulwazi olunikezwayo lungasetshenziswa, bazokunikeza inombolo yakho eyingqayizivele. Uma ulwazi lungasetshenziswa, umuntu oxhumana naye uzokuchazela ukuthi kungani lungasetshenziswa futhi anikeze izeluleko zokuthi ungathola kanjani olunye ulwazi. Ulwazi olusetshenziswayo luhlotshaniswa nenombolo yekhodi oyitholile. Uzocelwa ukuthi ushaye iCrime Stop ngenombolo: 08600 10 111 ngesikhathi esithile ukuze uthole ukuthi ulwazi lwasetshenziswa yini futhi uthole umvuzo uma ufanelekela. Umuntu oxhumana naye ngefoni uzophuma uma engakholwa ukuthi ungumuntu ofanayo owashaya kuqala. Lokhu kuyisinyathelo sokuphepha esikhona futhi ngeke kuxoxwe ngakho. I-Crime Stop izothumela ulwazi olunikeziwe kwi-unit ethile yokuhlola ukuze ilandele leli cala futhi iphinde icela ukuthi babuyisele umbiko phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-24 mayelana nomphumela wokuhlola ngokushesha okukhulu. Uma ushaya ucingo ukuze ubike icala okufanele uthole umvuzo, umphakathi ophenyayo nguye okumele abhekane nendaba yomvuzo nokuthi ungawuthola kanjani, ngokulandela inqubo yomvuzo ye-NI2/2001. Akukho sidingo sokugcwalisa amafomu ngoba izono zibikwa ngefoni. Nokho, uma ubika icala usebenzisa iwebhusayithi ye-SAPS, gcwalisa ifomu lokubuyekezwa ngogesi.
Othisha: Abaholi Bezemfundo Othisha bahlala beneqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba beqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zikhula zibe nefuture ecacile. Ngenkathi befundisa, bahlomisa abafundi ngolwazi, amakhono, nemigomo ebalulekile yokuphila. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekufundiseni izifundo ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi ubandakanya ukufundisa izimiso zokuziphatha, ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Indima Yabo Emphakathini Othisha bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemfundo. Ngaphandle kokuba yizifundiswa, baphinde babe ngabathuthukisi bomphakathi. Bafundisa abafundi ukuthi bahloniphe abanye, basebenzisane, futhi babe nezinhloso eziphakeme. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga abantu abakhululekile, abahlakaniphile, nabazimisele ukufunda. Ubuchwepheshe Bokufundisa Othisha basebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokufundisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bayakuqonda kahle lokho abakufundisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nezincwadi, amavidiyo, nemidlalo yokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha bahlala bejolise ekwakheni imvelo yokufunda ethokomele, lapho abafundi bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imibono yabo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhloso Zokufunda Othisha bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele bayifinyelele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuzibophezela emsebenzini wabo. Othisha bahlala bephakamisa izinjongo ezicacile, ezithuthukisa ukuzimisela kwabafundi, ukuze bakwazi ukugxila futhi bafinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ukwesekwa Kwabafundi Othisha bahlala beqonda ukuthi abafundi bahlukile, futhi banemibono ehlukene. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bahlale bejolise ekusekeleni abafundi abahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nabafundi, ukubasiza uma behlangabezana nezinselelo, kanye nokubakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. Othisha bahlala bephakamisa umoya wokubambisana, ukuze abafundi bazizwe beyingxenye yeqembu. Ukubaluleka Kokuxhumana Ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile emsebenzini wothisha. Othisha bahlala bexhumana nabafundi, abazali, kanye nabanye othisha ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bonke bayahlanganyela ekwakheni imvelo efanele yokufunda. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukuxhumana okuhle kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, obusiza ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokufunda. Izifundo Zokuphila Ngaphezu kokufundisa izifundo ezisemqoka, othisha bahlala befundisa abafundi ngezifundo zokuphila. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abafundi indlela yokuphatha izinkinga, ukuxazulula izingxabano, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lezi zifundo zibalulekile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi bakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ezihlukahlukene empilweni yabo. Ukwamukela Izinguquko Emhlabeni oshintsha ngokushesha, othisha bahlala bejolise ekwamukeleni izinguquko. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezithuthukile zokufundisa. Othisha bahlala beqonda ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi bahlala bephokophela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kubafundi babo. Isiphetho Othisha bahlala benomsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yabafundi, emphakathini, nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ngaphezu kokufundisa izifundo ezisemqoka, bahlala bephakamisa izimiso zokuziphatha, ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekwakheni abantu abahlakaniphile, kodwa futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe othisha bethu, sibabonge ngomsebenzi wabo oncomekayo, futhi siqonde ukuthi bahlala bephila impilo yokufundisa, yokuhola, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukuba nomqondo ophumelelayo, ukusebenza kahle, nokugxila ekuthuthukisweni ngokukhula kungaba umphumela wezinyathelo zabantu abadala uqobo, ngokukhula kwenani labo kanye nomthelela wabo. Ulwazi oluhlanganisiwe mayelana nokuguga, njengomqondo wokuhlanganisa emphakathini, lungaba yinto enhle (Uhlelo Lomhlaba Lokusebenza Ngokuqhubekela Phambili 1/para. 32). Inani elandayo lemindeni ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS libangela umthelela ezimpilweni zabantu abadala. Imiphumela yeHIV/AIDS iphula imindeni. Inani elikhulayo lezingane ezingenabazali ngenxa yokufa kwabazali ngenxa yezifo ezihlobene neHIV/AIDS kusho ukuthi abantu abadala kuphela abashiyekile ukuze banakekele lezingane. Abantu abadala emindenini ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS bathola ukuthi baphakathi komthwalo omkhulu wokunakekela ilunga lomndeni elinokugula noma elisondela ekufeni, kanye nokunakekela abazukulu babo ababe sebezingeni. Kuvame ukucabanga ukuthi imindeni ethinteke yalesi simo inganakekela amalunga ayo agulayo. Abantu abaneHIV/AIDS badinga impilo, amandla, izinsiza zezimali, kanye nezibopho eziqinile zokuzama ngokwengeziwe ukuthola lezi zinto. Amadokhumenti okuzalwa ezizukulwaneni zabo. (Lokhu kuyinkinga evamile kubantu abadala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi kulabo abantwana babo bahlala emadolobheni noma ezweni elizungezile). I-stigma ehambisana neHIV/AIDS ibangela abantu abadala ukuba babe nezinselelo ezinkulu njengoba bezama ukubhekana nokufa kwamalunga omndeni. Njengoba abantu abadala kufanele babhekane nokusiza izingane zifunde ukujwayela indawo entsha ngaphandle kwabazali bazo. Abantu abadala bangaba abanikeli bemvelo futhi kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okuyisisekelo abakudingayo ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo owengeziwe wokunakekela amalunga omndeni agulayo kanye nezizukulwane zabo ezingenabazali, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Kubalulekile ukubona abantu abadala ngendima yabo emnothweni wezwe ngezandla zabo futhi banakekele izizukulwane zabo lapho abazali babo besebenza noma befileyo ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Izinsizakalo zokwelulekwa kwezempilo yengqondo zemindeni ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS. Lokhu kwenziwa futhi ngamaqembu omphakathi asiza, ebhekana nezinkinga zengqondo nezomzwelo zamalunga omndeni athintekile. Ulwazi olusabalalisiwe ngama-brochure anolwazi mayelana nokuthi ungafinyelela kanjani usizo lomphakathi nokwazi amalungelo akho njengomthwalo kubalulekile. Umkhakha wezebhizinisi, izwe, izinhlangano zenkolo, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni ziye zasiza ngokunikeza usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bayawuthola.
Ukufuduka Kwezakhamuzi Zangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi usuku luhamba. UThandi, intombazane encane enomoya opholile, wayehamba edolobheni, ebuka abantu abahlukene abahamba phambili. Leli dolobha lalihlukile, linabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. UThandi wayehlala eThekwini, kodwa uGoli wawumhlaba omusha, owawumthokozisa. Wazithola esebhoda phakathi kwabantu abavela eZimbabwe, eMozambique, naseNigeria. Abanye babebonakala bejabulile, bejabulela ithuba lokwakha impilo entsha, kanti abanye babebonakala benokukhathazeka, bejolisa amehlo abo emigwaqweni, befuna ithuba lokuphila. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umfana ophuma eZimbabwe. U-Sipho wayenokukhanya emehlweni akhe, kodwa ubuhlungu bempilo yakhe babubhalwe ebusweni bakhe. Wakhuluma ngoMthetho, umphakathi wakhe owawunokuhlukumezeka, nokuthi uhambe eNingizimu Afrika efuna amathuba. "Ngifuna ukufunda, ngifuna umsebenzi," kusho uSipho, "ngifuna ukuphila impilo engcono." UThandi wathola ukuthi uSipho wayengumfana onamaphupho, kodwa ubunzima bokufuduka bukhona. Abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe babebhekana nezithiyo eziningi, ezinjengokungamukelwa, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala. UThandi wacabanga ngalesi simo, wathi, "Kungani abantu bengenakuthola ithuba lokuphila kahle? Kungani kufanele bahlupheke?" Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka noSipho, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo yabafuduki. Wathola ukuthi abanye babezama ukuhamba bengenamali, bengenamakhaya, kodwa bephupha ngempilo engcono. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu abavela emazweni ahlukene bahlala bejolisa emaphusheni abo, bephupha ngempilo engcono, kodwa bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola umngane omusha, uSipho, futhi baqala ukuhamba ndawonye. Bafunda kakhulu komunye nomunye, futhi uThandi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo entsha. U-Sipho wakhombisa uThandi izindawo ezinhle eGoli, izimakethe ezimnandi, nezindawo zokudlela ezihlukahlukene. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela ubuhlobo obusha, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Ngesikhathi uThandi noSipho behamba, bahlangana nabanye abafuduki, ababeveza izindaba zabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi uNandi, owesifazane ophuma eMozambique, wayephila impilo enzima, kodwa wayenamaphupho amakhulu. "Ngifuna ukuvula ibhizinisi," kusho uNandi, "ngifuna ukusiza umphakathi wami." UThandi wathola ukuthi uNandi wayengumuntu onamandla, futhi wayefuna ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. UThandi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abafuduki bahlala bephila impilo enobunzima, kodwa bahlala bejolisa emaphusheni abo. U-Sipho, uNandi, noThandi babebonisa ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo engcono. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela ubuhlobo obusha, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Njengoba usuku luhamba, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje kuphela izinkinga, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokwakha ubuhlobo obusha, ukufunda, nokwakha impilo engcono. UThandi waphuma eGoli, kodwa wathola ukuthi ubuhlobo abawakhile noSipho, noNandi, nabanye abafuduki, bahlala bukhona. Wazi ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo engcono, ubuhlobo obusha, nokuphila impilo enothile. UThandi wathola ukuthi izifundo azitholile zihlala zikhona, futhi zizoqhubeka zikhanya empilweni yakhe.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zokunakekelwa Kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekunikezeni abantu ulwazi olufanele nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezempilo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, ukufakwa kwezikhungo ezinjalo kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umehluko phakathi kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezindaweni ezahlukene, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo kubantu bonke. Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokucwaninga, kanye nezikhungo zokufundisa. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezifo, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ulwazi olufanele lungasiza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo yabo. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga ukuxhaswa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinhlaka zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile nolufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifake ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi sebekhuluma nge-inthanethi, futhi ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo nge-inthanethi kungasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zisebenza ekwakheni imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi. Lezi mikhankaso zihlala ziqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuvikelwa kwezifo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinqumo zabo zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Kodwa-ke, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ububha, obuvimbela abantu abaningi ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezisemaphandleni zidinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza efanele. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izikhungo eziningi ezisemaphandleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ulwazi lwezempilo olufanele, oluthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuxhaswa, kanye nokuzinikela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ulwazi olufanele nolwakhiwe kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu bethu bazi kahle ngezempilo zabo, futhi benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile.
Izimpawu ezintsha zalesi sizwe ziwuhlonzo oluphakeme, olunikezwa nguMongameli kubantu, kanye nakwabanye abantu abahlonishwa kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe. UMongameli ungumthombo (umgibeli, isibambiso, nomthombo omkhulu) wokuhlonipha ezweni, yingakho uMongameli engumuntu ophakamisayo imiklomelo futhi enikeza izimpawu zokuhlonipha. INingizimu Afrika idlulelwe uhambo olude lokuhlukanisa nesikhumbuzo sokukoloni esisekelwe ebudlelwaneni, umbala, nenkolo. Izwe lethu liya phambili ngokuzinzile endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu nobuqotho kubantu bonke. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bonke, kukhona isiko elisha lemidlalelo yamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonishwa kobuqotho bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Imithombo yezimpawu zokuhlukanisa nesikhathi esedlule ibonakaliswe ngokuphakanyiswa kweflegi entsha ngo-1994. Leso sikhathi saqinisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobuqotho besizwe esijabulela ukuhlonishwa kwabantu bonke. Enye indlela yokuphumelela kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwe-emblem yesizwe entsha, ehlanganisa umlando wabantu bonke besizwe, ngoMgqibelo 27, 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuhlinzeka ngobuhle bonke base-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuka nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Le emblem yesizwe entsha isekelwe emoyeni walolu vuselelo lwesizwe. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanezakhono eziphakeme zobuciko nezokwakha, futhi abafeze amazinga aphezulu empumelelo ngendlela engajwayelekile. IMapungubwe - Ubukhosi beMapungubwe babutholakala engxenyeni enyakatho yezwe lethu eminyakeni eyinkulungwane edlule. Le nkosi yayinokuphathwa okuhle kakhulu, futhi yayithuthuke kakhulu kwezolimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nkosi yayina nezimayini nezimboni zensimbi. Le nkosi yathengiselana namazwe akude afana neChina. Ngesikhathi salo bukhosi, babe nezinga eliphezulu lokwazi ekucabangeni okujulile nasekuthuthukiseni. IMapungubwe artifact - Singumgogodla kanye neqholo, i-artifact iyingxenye yendawo eyakhiwe ngamatshana agcwele umhlaba, endaweni eyomile nephakathini, engatholi imvula eningi yehlobo, njengoba kuboniswe ngesikhathi sokuhlola okukhombisa ubuciko obukhulu obutholakala endaweni yemvelo kodwa enezimo ezinzima. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi leMapungubwe - lenziwe futhi labonwa emathunjini egolide ohlangothini lwezimbobo - okuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezenziwe futhi zatholakala emathunjini abacwaningi abawahlola kule ndawo (indawo yokuhlola). Ibhodwe elihlotshisiwe lokungcwaba igolide - isimo sebhodwe esibonakala ebhodweni lokungcwaba igolide sikhombisa ubuciko obunothile, isayensi, kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa, okuyisibonakaliso sempumelelo yasendulo ekukhiqizeni insimbi. Ilanga eliphakamisayo - limele ukukhanya okusha e-Afrika. Isikhungo sokungcwaba insimbi - ukujabulisa nokuthuthukisa impilo ngokuqhuma, okusetshenziswe kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, kanye nempumelelo eqhubekayo nobuciko kuzo zonke izindawo. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngomsebenzi wabo ophakeme. Lezi zisebenzi akufanele zibe imisebenzi ejwayelekile kuphela kodwa zidlule ezijwayelekile, futhi zenzelwe abantu hhayi kuphela ukuze bakhokhelwe kodwa ukuze badlule kulokho okujwayelekile nokulindelekile. Ukukhuthazwa kwezobuchwepheshe, nokukhonza imiphakathi. Singomuthi obalulekile kwezolimo. Sihlinzeka ngama-fibers ezindwangu nezintambo, izithelo, nomlilo, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisebenzisekayo. IBaobab (Baobab noma i-Adansonia Digitata) - iyaziwa ngamagatsha ayo nezimpande zayo ezinde. Sihlinzeka ngensimu nokuhlalisana, futhi siphinde sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni imiphakathi lapho sitholakala khona. Isimo sezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalolunye - isimo se-geometry sezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalolunye limele imikhakha eminingi ehlukene lapho imisebenzi ehlukahlukene ingaqhutshelwa ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esizinzile nesithuthuke. Le simbala iphinde imele izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye zezwe lethu. Le emblem inikezwa kubabusi bamazwe angaphandle (Amakhosi Wamazwe Nezikhungo, nabanye abantu abahlonishwa kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe) ukuze kubonakale ubudlelwano neNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho siba yisibonakaliso sokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesibonakaliso sokuhlanganyela nokuxhasana. Le emblem iyisibonakaliso esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Imiklomelo emibili yokuqala ihlanganisa izigaba ezine: iphendenti, ibhajethi yentamo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel rosette. I-emblem yokugcina inezigaba ezintathu: ibhajethi yentamo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel pin. Umjola (uthuli olutholakala ebusheni) - Uthuli oluvakashela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Alulimazi ingane noma amalungu omndeni, futhi indlela yokukhipha uthuli ukuthi umama wengane aphuze. Lolu thuli luvakashela ingane ukuze luyilungiselele ikusasa eliqhakazile neliphephile ebusheni bayo. Lufika njengesihlobo nomvikeli. Ubudlelwano obumele, obusekelwe emnqopheni omuhle, busekelwe emoyeni wokukhombisa ukweseka kanye nenhloso yokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo yentsha kanye namalungu omphakathi akhulayo. Lolu thuli luhlale luwumlando wabantu ngenxa yesaga esidumile esibhaliwe kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umbono wokuthi uthuli luyisidalwa esiyingozi futhi esilimazayo, kodwa ibonisa umbono ocebile we-Afrika, iqonda uthuli njengomngane nolwazi oludingekayo lokuhlala ndawonye. Umjola - indwangu eyakhelwe, eyenziwe ngama-fibers amnyama, ivela emthini wase-Afrika, iyisibonakaliso sobungane ekusekeleni nasekubambisaneni okuboniswayo ngabangane, futhi iphinde imele ukuzibophezela kokweseka nokuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Iqembu libizwa ngokuthi Uphuzane. Le ndawo yePhuzane itholakala enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal uma uhamba amakhilomitha angama-25 usuka ePaulpietersburg, eduze komfula obizwa ngeBivane River. Lapha ngempela kusemaphandleni futhi akukho okukhuluma ngakho ngesiNgisi njengezinsiza (amathuluzi okutshala nokulima, ukuthutha, ukuthenga nokuthengisa, noma yini). Abalimi nabo abanamakhono nolwazi lokulima bodwa. Kuleli qembu lokufunda, kukhona abakhiqizi besilisa nabesifazane abakhuthalele ukufunda nokwandisa inzuzo yabo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabo futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ezinsizeni zemvelo ezikhona. Okwamanje, abakhiqizi basebenzisa amahektare angama-70 angalimiwa, kodwa kusekhona izindawo eziningi ezingalimiwe ezingenza umkhiqizo. Kungani kukhona izinkundla ezingalimiwe? Izizathu zokungaklami kulezo zindawo zihlala zikhona ezomnotho, ngoba izinkundla eziningi zikhona ezwenikazi, futhi amabhange nabanye abanikazi bezikweletu bayazithoba ukunikela le mali ngoba abanakuqinisekisa ukuthi bazoyithola le mali emuva kokuphuma. Enye inkinga imishini; abalimi abanamatractor nezinye izinto. Iqembu lihlangana nini? Iqembu lihlangana kanye ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngezinkinga zamalungu nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza zawo ezincane. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leli qembu lokufunda? Ngithole ukumangala okukhulu lapho ngiya ukubona lokho abakwenza; ngathola ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima zesimanje ukuze bakhiqize (ukulima ngaphandle kokulima) ngempumelelo ngo-2009/2010. Lo nyaka baqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokulima besebenzisa indlela yokulima ngaphandle kokulima futhi bathola umkhiqizo ophakeme kunowonyaka odlule. Ukuzimisela kwabo nokufuna ukushintsha, ukushiya izindlela zokutshala zendabuko, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha kukhombisa ukuthi abashiyi emuva ekushintsheni futhi babona ukuthi ukufunda kwabo nentuthuko kubanika impumelelo enkulu. Bayazi lokho okukhuluma abadala: 'Ulala uhlezi emuva' - labo abangahambi phambili bazoshiywa emuva. Abakhiqizi bathola ukuthi bathola ulwazi oluningi uma beyiwo amalungu eqembu lokufunda futhi behambele izinsuku zabakhiqizi lapho kukhona izifundo. Enye indlela yokuthola ulwazi ukusebenzisa izindawo zokubonisa, ezikhombisa abalimi indlela entsha eqondile yokutshala ufulawa. Ingabe kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwale qembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eqembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho abaseduzane, kodwa abanye bahlala kude futhi abakwazi ukuhlangana nabo kalula - lokhu kuyinkinga. Iqembu lihamba kahle neMnyango Wezolimo kaHulumeni nabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo.
Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye (GEMS dependent member classification) Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS dependent member classification, kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo. Lezi zinsiza zihlala zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amalungu anikezwa usizo olufanele, ikakhulukazi uma engakwazi ukuziphatha ngokwakhe. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole ukuthi amalungu ancike kwabanye ahlukaniswa kanjani, izinzuzo ezihambisana nalokhu, kanye nezidingo ezithile ezibhekelelwa. Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Amalungu ancike kwabanye ahlukaniswa ngokwemigomo ethile, okungukuthi, ubudlelwano bawo nomuntu ophakamisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene, njengezingane, abakhubazekile, noma abanye abadinga usizo, bangathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukuze umuntu abe ngumuntu ohlanganyela, kufanele kube khona ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komuntu ophakamisayo nomuntu ohlanganyela. Izinhlobo Zamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ngokwesiko, amalungu ancike kwabanye ahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene. Lezi zigaba zifaka phakathi: 1. Izingane: Lezi zihlukaniswa njengamalungu ancike kwabanye uma zineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-21, noma uma zifunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle. 2. Abantu Abakhubazekile: Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuziphatha ngenxa yokukhubazeka, angabhaliswa njengomuntu ohlanganyela. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zakhe. 3. Abantu Abadala: Abantu abaphezulu kweminyaka ethile, ikakhulukazi abakhubazekile noma abadinga usizo, bangabhaliswa njengamalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bathola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Izinzuzo Zokuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bahlala benakekelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene badinga izinsiza ezihlukahlukene. Okwesibili, lokhu kuhlukaniswa kusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Izidingo Zokubhaliswa Ukuze umuntu abhaliswe njengomuntu ohlanganyela, kunezidingo ezithile okufanele zifezekiswe. Okokuqala, kufanele kube khona ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komuntu ophakamisayo nomuntu ohlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umuntu ohlanganyela uthola usizo olufanele. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube neziqinisekiso ezithile ezikhombisa ukuthi umuntu ohlanganyela udinga usizo. Lokhu kungaba yizincwadi ezivela kumhlinzeki wezempilo noma ezinye izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalesi siza. Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kubalulekile kakhulu emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene bahlala benakekelwa, futhi bahlala bethola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuhlukaniswa kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye (GEMS dependent member classification) kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo. Umbiko Ngemisebenzi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimakethe Zomsebenzi Isingeniso Ezimweni zezimali eziguquguqukayo, imisebenzi ithinta impilo yabantu abaningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle izimo zokuqashwa, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta imakethe yemisebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya izinga lokungasebenzi, izidingo zabasebenzi, kanye nezinguquko ezibangelwa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ngalesi sihloko, sizobheka indlela imakethe yemisebenzi eshintsha ngayo, izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisebenze. Isimo Semisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika ENingizimu Afrika, isimo semisebenzi sikhathaza. Izibalo zakamuva zikhombisa ukuthi izinga lokungasebenzi liphakeme kakhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabasha. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi ekukhuleni komnotho. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abasha abaningi bahlala bengaqashwa, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, okubalwa kuzo ukungafani kwezimfuno zemisebenzi nezifundo ezikhonjwa kubafundi. Izifundo Nezidingo Zabasebenzi Njengoba imakethe yemisebenzi ishintsha, izidingo zabasebenzi nazo ziguquka. Izikhungo zemfundo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bazifundisa amakhono afanele ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zifunde izidingo zemboni ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango efanele. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemfundo nezidingo zemboni kuzokwakha isixazululo esinzima kulokhu. Ubuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Ubuchwepheshe buye babalulekile emsebenzini wanamuhla, nokuthi imisebenzi ethile iyashintsha noma iyadlalwa yizinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudala ukuncintisana okukhulu. Abantu badinga ukufunda amakhono amasha ukuze bahlale bephumelela. Ngokuvamile, izinkampani zifuna abasebenzi abaneziqu eziphezulu, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abangenayo imfundo ephakeme. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko Emsebenzini Kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nabantu abafuna imisebenzi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwamathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni ezithile kuholela ekubeni abantu baphinde baphahlazeke. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zithathe indawo yemisebenzi ethile, okwenza abantu babe nokungafuni kokuqashwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu babe nekhono lokushintsha, ukuze bakwazi ukufanisa izidingo ezintsha. Izixazululo Nezaziso Ukuze sithuthukise imisebenzi, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Ukuze imfundo ihambisane nezidingo zomsebenzi, izikhungo zemfundo kumele zibambisane nezinkampani ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ulwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngababekhona emsebenzini abanezinga eliphakeme. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops nabantu abasha, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola amakhono afanele. Isiphetho Imakethe yemisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa kunezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukwenza ngcono isimo. Ngokuhlanganisa imfundo nezidingo zomsebenzi, kanye nokudala amathuba amasha, sizokwazi ukwakha imakethe yemisebenzi ezinzile. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi, sithuthukise umnotho, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokwenza izinguquko luzodingeka, futhi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izinhlelo zidinga isikhathi, impumelelo izofika uma sisebenza ndawonye. Ukwazisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, okwaziyo ukubhekana nezinselelo zamanje.
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungelona lutho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, kukhona nezifo ezivela endleleni esiphila ngayo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, singathola lezi zifo. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela yethu yokuphila. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, unakekele. Kumele sithathe ukunakekela thina. Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lidla utshwala obungaphezu kwabantu kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Abantu abaningi baphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye baphuza kakhulu kanti abanye baphuza njalo. Lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi. Abanye abantu bayakhishwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokuzibophezela kwabo kutshwala. Abanye bathi bangaba nodlame uma bephuzile futhi balwe namalungu omndeni, abangane, nabangane. Kwabanye, utshwala bungaba yingozi, futhi ukuqhubeka nokuphuza kungaholela ekufeni. Kungcono ukungaphuzi utshwala nhlobo ngoba contains ama-toxins ayingozi angaphazamisa impilo yakho. Ukuphuza utshwala kungaba nemiphumela emibi emndenini wakho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile uma ungumuntu ophuzayo, uphuze ngokuziphatha kahle. Funda le bhukwana ukuze ufunde ukuthi ungaphuza kanjani ngokuziphatha kahle. Bheka uDudu, laba bantu sebesesaba utshwala obusele emshadweni wokuqala. Pic.
