Sizokhuluma ngokuphuza utshwala. Ukuze sikusize wenze isinqumo sokuthi utshwala luhle noma lubi, masikhulume ngemiphumela yalo kumuntu. Utshwala lungaphazamisa impilo yakho kakhulu. Ukuphuza ngokweqile isikhathi eside kungalimaza umzimba wakho futhi ungase ungabuyeli esimweni sokuqala. Ukudla okungaphansi: Kukhona okuncane okukhona kutshwala. Ngakho-ke, ukuphuza utshwala kakhulu kungakwenza ungakudli. Lokhu kudala ukuthi ugule futhi uzizwe ungenamandla. Ukuphazamiseka kwengqondo: Utshwala lwenza ubuchopho buphazamiseke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, utshwala lungaphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo yakho. Isifo senhliziyo: Ukuphuza kungase kwenze inhliziyo yakho isebenze kanzima futhi ungase ube nesifo senhliziyo. Umhlola: Utshwala lungadala umhlola womlomo. Ukulimala kwesibindi: Uma uphuza njalo, kungadala ukulimala kwesibindi. Utshwala lungalimaza ne-pancreas futhi uma unegciwane. Ukungasebenzi kahle kokuphuma: I-organ yesilisa ayisebenzi kahle futhi ubhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela ekuphuzweni. Izenzakalo eziningi zokudlame nokuhlukumeza zenzeka ngoba abantu baphuza ngokweqile. Abantu abakwazi ukuzilawula uma bephuza. Ezinhlungwini eziningi zomgwaqo eziholela ekufeni, kuvame ukutholakala ukuthi abashayeli abaningi baphuze ngaphezu komkhawulo ofanele. Iningi labagibeli abafa ezinhlelweni baphuze. Ukufa nezifo ezidalwe utshwala kubiza uhulumeni imali eningi unyaka nonyaka. Le mali ingasetshenziswa kangcono emfundweni, empilweni, nasemakhaya. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo ezahlukene zineziphuzo ezihlukene. Ungakhetha ukuthi iyiphi ofuna ukuyiphuza phakathi kwalezi ziphuzo. Akufanele uphuze lutho ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi utshwala bungakanani obukhona. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kakhulu! Ukuphuza nje ukuze ujabule nokweqa umkhawulo wezinyanga ezimbili zoshukela nsuku zonke, ngenye indlela, akufanele kube yisiko lakho ukuphuza ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa iziphuzo zakho. Phuza uhlobo olulodwa lutshwala ngasikhathi sinye futhi ungaphuzi ngaphambi kokushayela noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyodwa kuya kwezimbili: Uxoxa kakhulu futhi awumisi, isivinini senhliziyo yakho sikhuphuka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu: Ukushayela kwakho kuba kubi kakhulu, awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase uzizwe unokukhathazeka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu: Ungase ungaboni kahle; uma ukhuluma, uyaphazamiseka; awukwazi ukwenza izinto ngokushesha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili: Awukwazi ukuhamba ngqo futhi kubonakala sengathi uyawela; ubona izinto kabili. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-20: Uyaqandwa kakhulu futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase uphume. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi akufanele uphuze ngokweqile ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili. Izinyanga ezintathu zidalela ushintsho em behavior yakho futhi awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. Ungakuphuzanga utshwala uma... Ungavumeli abantu bagcwalise iglasi yakho ngaphambi kokuyiqeda. Uzophela ungazi ukuthi uphuze kangakanani. Ungahlanganisi utshwala obuphuza. Phuza kancane. Ngaphambi kokuphuza iglasi elandelayo yotshwala, phuza iglasi yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa izinga lakho lokuphuza. Qinisekisa ukuthi udle ngaphambi kokuphuza. Ungaphuzi utshwala uma ungakudlanga lutho. Ungashayi noma uhamba. Zama ukuthola indlela yokubuyela ekhaya. Ungavumeli muntu ukuba akuphoqe ukuphuza uma ungafuni. Impilo yabantu abasha ingashintsha futhi ibe nezinkinga ngenxa yokuphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye bangase bathole abazali abane-alkoholi. Abantu abasha bangase bathole ukuthi abanye babo baphuza. Lokhu akudala umndeni ojabulayo. Kumele sivikele
Ezolimi Umbuzo 1: Yini ezolimi? Impendulo: Ezolimi yisigaba esibanzi esihlanganisa zonke izindlela zokukhuluma, ukubhala, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Izilimi zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu, zisetshenziswa ukuze sabelane ngemicabango, imizwa, nolwazi. Ziyingxenye ebalulekile yesiko, zikhombisa ubunikazi bethu, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkolelo nemikhuba yethu zidluliselwa ezizukulwaneni. Umbuzo 2: Zingaki izilimi ezikhona emhlabeni? Impendulo: Kukholelwa ukuthi kunezilimi ezingaphezu kwe-7,000 emhlabeni. Lezi zilimi zihlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengezilimi ezisemthethweni, ezikhuluma kakhulu, nezilimi ezincane. Izilimi ezinkulu, ezifana nesiNgisi, isiSpanish, nesiMandarin, zikhuluma abantu abaningi, kuyilapho ezinye izilimi zikhuluma abantu abambalwa, kodwa zibalulekile ukuze kugcinwe ubuciko bazo. Umbuzo 3: Kungani kubalulekile ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene? Impendulo: Ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene kukhulu kakhulu. Okokuqala, kusivulela amathuba okuxhumana nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba, ukusebenza, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Okwesibili, ukufunda izilimi kusiza ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda kwethu ngezamasiko ahlukene, okwenza sibe nekhono lokubona izinto ngamehlo ahlukile. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlonipha nokwamukela. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo zokufunda izilimi? Impendulo: Noma ukufunda izilimi kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi, kunezinselelo ezithile. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokukhumbula amagama, ukwakha izisho, noma ukusebenzisa kahle izimiso zolimi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilimi ezihlukene zinezindlela ezihlukene zokukhuluma, okungaholela ekudidekeni. Nokho, lezi zinselelo zingaxazululwa ngokuzikhandla, ukuzijwayeza, nokufunda ngendlela ejabulisayo. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenza izilimi zihluke? Impendulo: Izilimi zihluke ngezindlela eziningi, okuhlanganisa izakhiwo zazo, izwi, nezincazelo. Isibonelo, isiZulu sinesakhiwo esihlukile kunesiNgisi, futhi sinesizinda esicebile samagama nezisho ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezindlela ezihlukene zokucabanga nokukhuluma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilimi zikhula futhi zishintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zithinteka kakhulu yizimo zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezamasiko. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza isiZulu sibe yisiZulu? Impendulo: IsiZulu sinesizinda esijulile, sikhuluma abantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Iqukethe izici ezihlukile, njengezimpawu zamasiko, izinkolelo, nezindlela zokuphila. IsiZulu sinesichasiso esiqinile sokuhlonipha, futhi sikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Izaga, izisho, nezinkolelo zesiZulu zikhombisa ubuhlakani bamasiko, futhi zibalulekile ekudluliseni ulwazi phakathi kwezizukulwane. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokufunda isiZulu? Impendulo: Ukuze ufunde isiZulu, ungasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene. Ungabhalisela izifundo ezisemthethweni, ufunde ngezincwadi, noma usebenzise izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Ukuxhumana nabantu abakhuluma isiZulu, nokuzijwayeza ukukhuluma, kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuthuthukisa amakhono akho. Ukubuka amafilimu, ukulalela umculo, nokufunda izincwadi zesiZulu nakho kuyasiza. Umbuzo 8: Yini engakwenza ube ngcono ekukhulumeni isiZulu? Impendulo: Ukuze ube ngcono ekukhulumeni isiZulu, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza njalo. Zama ukukhuluma nabantu abakhuluma isiZulu, futhi ungazithokozisa ngezincwadi, izinkulumo, noma ama-podcast. Futhi, ungazama ukufunda izaga nezisho, ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ukhulume kahle futhi uqonde kangcono umongo wezinkulumo. Ukuzimisela nokuzikhandla kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu. Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenza izilimi zibe yinsiza ebalulekile? Impendulo: Izilimi ziwusizo olukhulu empilweni yethu. Zisiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ekuxhumaneni, nasekudluliseni ulwazi. Ngaphandle kwezilimi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bungeke buphumelele. Izilimi zikhombisa ubuciko bethu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkolelo nemikhuba yethu zihlala zikhona. Ngakho-ke, ukufunda nokukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana emhlabeni wanamuhla. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele siyenze ukuze sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko? Impendulo: Ukuze sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko, kubalulekile ukuzigcina zikhuluma, zifundiswa, futhi zisetshenziswe ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Lokhu kungafaka ukufundisa izingane zethu izilimi zethu, ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuluma, nokubhala izincwadi ezikhuluma ngamasiko ethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokufunda izilimi zendabuko ezikoleni nakwezokuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izilimi zethu zihlala zikhona. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zihloko, sithola ukuthi izilimi zibalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhumbula. Ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene akusizi kuphela ekuxhumaneni, kodwa futhi kusivulela umhlaba omusha wezinto esingazithola. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sifunde, sikhulume, futhi sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko.
Ukuthenga Online: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezizathu, Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Ukuthenga online, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukuthenga kwe-inthanethi, sekuphenduke umkhuba obalulekile emnothweni wezokuthengisa. Le ndlela yokuthenga ivumela abathengi ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo kusuka ezindaweni ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokuba baphume endlini yabo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kuningi okukhuluma ngale ndlela yokuthenga, okuhlanganisa nezizathu zayo, izinzuzo, nezinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Okwokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu zokuthi kungani abantu benza ukuthenga online. Enye yezizathu eziphambili wukutholakala kalula kwemikhiqizo. Abathengi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezitolo eziningi ze-inthanethi ezihlinzeka ngezinto ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo yokuhamba noma izinsuku zokusebenza. Lokhu kuphinde kuvumele abantu ukuba baqhathanise amanani nemikhiqizo kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuthola okungcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, njengoba bekwazi ukufunda izibuyekezo zemikhiqizo nezincomo zabanye abathengi. Izinzuzo zokuthenga online zikhulu. Okokuqala, kunezindleko eziphansi. Ukuze abathengi bathenge online, akudingekile ukuthi bakhokhe izindleko zokuqasha izitolo, izisebenzi, noma izindleko zokugcina impahla. Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni eziphansi zemikhiqizo, okwenza kube lula kubathengi ukuthola imikhiqizo ngamanani aphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuthi bathenge noma nini, okuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abanokusebenza okuningi. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini enomsebenzi ongapheli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kulula futhi kusebenza kahle. Abathengi bangakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba wonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ethile engatholakali ezindaweni zabo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho, njengoba kudala amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi nabathengisi. Izinjini zokusesha zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezinketho ezahlukene, futhi amapulatifomu amaningi anikeza izinhlelo zokuhamba ezizwakalayo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo efanele. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezihambisana nokuthenga online. Enye yeziqhamuka ezinkulu yokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Abathengi bavame ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali nemininingwane yabo siqu. Ukuphulwa kwemithetho yokuphepha ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwemali noma ekubeni abathengi babhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abathengi babe nekhono lokuhlola izimakethe ezahlukeneyo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bazithola ezitolo ezithembekile. Enye inkinga ethinta ukuthenga online ukufana nokwakhiwa komkhiqizo. Abathengi abakwazi ukubona, ukuthinta noma ukuhlole umkhiqizo ngaphambi kokuwuthenga, okungaholela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo engahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukwakha ukholo phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, njengoba abathengi bezithola besebenzisa izithombe ezithile neziqubulo ezingase zingakhombisi kahle imikhiqizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kwenza kube nzima ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, njengoba abathengi bengenakho ukubona umkhiqizo ngokwakhe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukujabulisa abathengi, ikakhulukazi uma imikhiqizo ingafiki ngesikhathi noma ingahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Ukuze kuphumelele ukuthenga online, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ukufunda izibuyekezo, ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nokubheka izitolo eziyaziwayo kuyasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abathengi benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Ekugcineni, ukuthenga online sekuphenduke indlela ebalulekile yokuthenga emhlabeni wanamuhla. Noma kungezona zonke izinzuzo ezithathwayo, izinselelo zikhona, futhi abathengi kufanele babe nekhono lokuhamba phakathi kwemithombo ehlukene ukuze benze izinqumo eziphusile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukuthenga online kuzoba nethonya elikhulu emnothweni, futhi sizobona izinguquko eziningi ezizayo kulolu hlelo lokuthenga.
Umculo we-Jazz: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezizukulwane Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-jazz usuphenduke uphawu lokuhlangana kwezizukulwane ezahlukene, uhlanganisa izindlela zomculo, izinkolelo zamasiko, nezifiso zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene. Lokhu kuvele kakhulu emcimbini wokuhlanganyela umculo we-jazz, ogujwa eGoli, lapho izithameli zifika zikhathele, kodwa zinejabuliso ezikhanyayo. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa abaculi abahamba phambili abavela kuzo zonke izindawo zalesi siko, behlanganyela emculweni owaziwa ngokuba nezinhlobonhlobo ezintsha nezikhumbuzo zomlando. Umsindo we-jazz uqala ukudala umoya wezinhlobonhlobo, lapho izigubhu, i-saxophone, ne-piano ziqala ukudlala. Njengoba abaculi behlangana, imisindo ibonisa ubuciko, isithombe somoya wobudlelwano, nempilo ebonakala. Umdlalisi we-saxophone uthola ithuba lokudlala solo, okwenza izithameli zizwe zixhumene nezinhliziyo zabo, zikhumbula izikhathi ezinhle nezimfihlo zempilo. Umculo we-jazz uveza imizwa ehlukahlukene, kusukela ekujabuleni kuya ekudabukeni, futhi zonke lezi zimo zikhombisa ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi komculi nomlistener. Emcimbini we-jazz, abaculi baphinde babe nabaxhumanisi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umculi usuka eNew Orleans, eChicago, noma eCape Town, bonke bazihlanganisa ukuze benze umculo ophilayo, okhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kungenza umoya wokubambisana, futhi ukufakwa kwezinqubo ezahlukene kungaholela ekuphumeleleni okukhulu. Njengoba umculo uhamba phambili, izithameli zikhuthazwa ukuba ziveze izimvo zabo, zibe yingxenye yezenzakalo ezithokozisayo. Umgubho we-jazz ulethe umoya wokukhumbula abaculi abaphumelele, njengama-legends afana noLouis Armstrong noElla Fitzgerald. Ukuhlonishwa kwemisebenzi yabo kudalula indlela umculo we-jazz uthinteka ngayo empilweni yansuku zonke. Abaculi baphinde bahloniphe lezi zinsakavukela ngezindlela zabo, bejolisa emculweni nasemikhulumweni, benza umoya oncomekayo obamba wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, izethameli zibe nezinye izigcawu ezihlukile, ezifana ne-Jam Sessions, lapho abaculi behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngemicabango nemigubho. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuhlobene kakhulu nokuxhumana okukhululekile, okwakha imizwelo eqinile phakathi kwabaculi nabalaleli. Ukuze umculo uqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube khona ukubambisana, futhi umcimbi we-jazz ubona lokhu kuphila, kwenza kube yindawo yokwakha ubungane obuqinile. I-Jazz iyindlela yokuziveza, futhi umcimbi lo ubonisa kahle ukuthi umculo ungakha kanjani ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubonakala ezintweni ezincane, njengokuhlangana kwasemakhaya, lapho umndeni uphumeza izigcwalisiso ezihlukahlukene zomculi. Umdlalisi we-piano udlula emuva, amehlo akhe ezilungile ethinta umoya, kanye nezwi elinothile le-saxophone, kudala umoya ophilayo. Umcimbi we-jazz awugcini nje ngokubamba abaculi, kodwa ukhuthaza futhi izethameli ukuthi zibe yingxenye yokwakha umculo. Umoya wokubambisana uvula indlela yokudluliselwa kwemizwa, lapho wonke umuntu edlala indima ebalulekile. Lokhu kuveza indlela umculo we-jazz ungafinyelela ngayo ezimpilweni zethu, uhlanganise abantu abahlukene, ubavuselele, futhi ube umthombo wokuphishekela izifiso eziphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ugcina ubude bayo ngokubhaliswa kwezingoma ezidumile, futhi ubukhona bayo buphinde bukhumbule abaculi abasha. Lokhu kudala amathuba kubantu abasha ukuthi bathole izifundo, bazifundise, futhi baphumelele emculweni we-jazz. Abaculi abasha bazama ukwenza izinguquko, bejolisa emasikweni omculo, benza kube lula ukuba umculo we-jazz ube yinto ephilayo, ethokozisayo, nengashintshi. Umgubho we-jazz ungumcimbi obalulekile wokuhlanganisa abantu abanokuthanda umculo, futhi uhlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle. Njengoba umcimbi uphothulwa, izithameli zishiya zikhumbula umoya ophilayo, zihamba nezinhliziyo ezijabulile futhi zibalela izinkumbulo eziveza ubungani obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Umculo we-jazz ungumsebenzi ohloniphekile, futhi umcimbi lo ubonisa kahle ukuthi umculo ungaletha kanjani abantu ndawonye, uhlanganise izizukulwane, futhi ube umthombo wokujabulela izimpilo zethu.
Hamba emgwaqweni. Uma kungekho umgwaqo, sebenzisa uhlangothi olufanele lomgwaqo kude nomgwaqo. Uma uhamba emgwaqweni, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ohlangothini olufanele kude nomgwaqo, ngamagama amanye, ubheke ezimotweni ezisondela. Izimoto eziningi zihamba ngezikhathi ezahlukene emigwaqweni ehlukene, ngakho kubi kakhulu ukuba izingane zidlale emgwaqweni/ohlwini lomgwaqo. Uma ingane idlala emgwaqweni, umshayeli osondela angase angakwazi ukuhamba noma ukumisa ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Hamba njalo ubheke ezimotweni ozihlangabezana nazo ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezisondela ngesikhathi. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 azinakho ukukala ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze imoto ifike kuzo. Konlya cross emgwaqweni uma kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Ungagijimi. Ungacross emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezifihlekile ezifana nezikwele nezintaba ngoba kunzima kubashayeli ukubona ngesikhathi. Abahambi ngezinyawo abavunyelwe EMIGWQWENI ENGAMAKHANDA. Linda ibhasi/taxi ukuba ime ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuphuma. Linda ibhasi/taxi ukuba ihambe ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezivela kokubili ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Le bhasi/taxi ophumayo ingakushaya. Ungashaywa/ushaywe imoto edlula lapho ibhasi/taxi ophumayo likhona. Konlya cross uma uphakamisa isignali yomphakathi eluhlaza futhi kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Uma isignali yomphakathi ishintsha ivela eluhlaza iye kubomvu ngesikhathi uhamba, qhubeka ubheke emuva nasemaphakathini ukuze ubone izimoto ezisondela. Uma isibani somgwaqo esibomvu sishintsha sibe luhlaza, izimoto ezivela phambili nasezandleni nazo zinegunya lokuhamba manje. Qiniseka ukuthi abashayeli bakubona futhi bame ngaphambi kokuthi udlule. Umgwaqo uhlinzekwa ukuze usebenze wonke umuntu; ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhamba ngokushesha ukuze abashayeli baqhubeke. Ukuhamba emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezingekho ezibekwe kahle kuyingozi futhi kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Abashayeli balindele ukukubona ezindaweni ezibekwe kahle zokudlula: njengokudlula kwabantu okuhlinzekwe ngama-block, lapho kukhona izimpawu zokumisa noma izibani zomgwaqo, nokho, kufanele uhamba ngokushesha ukuze abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baqhubeke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokwabelana ngomgwaqo nokuhlonipha abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Gwema ukusebenzisa umgwaqo ngemuva kokuphuza utshwala/nokwelapha ngoba kuthinta ukubona kwakho nokulinganisa, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, cross umgwaqo ngokushesha. Ukuhamba uphuzile kuyingozi njengokushayela uphuzile. Yini ukugcwalisa? Ukugcwalisa kuwukwenza komuntu onebhizinisi lokuhamba usebenzisa umgwaqo, umshayeli noma umgibeli, ukudlula umkhawulo wezimpahla ezisemthethweni zemoto, kungaba ngenhloso noma ngengozi. Ukugcwalisa nezimpahla ezingalungile kuholela ekufeni nasekukhathazekeni emigwaqweni yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo ofika kumamili ama-rand emigwaqweni nasezimotweni ezigcwele. Imoto egcwele ithatha isikhathi eside ukumisa uma kwenzeka ukuphuthuma. Uma ufuna ukuhamba ukuze ugweme ingozi, isikhathi sokwenza lokho sandele ngenxa yokugcwalisa. Kunzima ukulawula imoto egcwele futhi ngeke ukwazi ukwandisa kalula njengoba ungakwenza emoto ejwayelekile, okwenza kube yingozi ukudlula ezinye izimoto. Amathayi emoto egcwele afudumala futhi abe bushelelezi - lokhu kungabangela ukuthi amathayi aphuke. Ukugcwalisa kubangela ukuthi imoto yakho ibhujiswe, okwenza kube nzima kuwe ukubona izimbobo noma ezinye izithiyo emgwaqweni. Ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo emgwaqweni ngakho ungase ujeziswe kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bathuthwa emsebenzini noma ezindaweni ezahlukene behlezi ngemuva kwezithuthi nezivharo ezivulekile nsuku zonke - behlezi phezu kwezimpahla. Abanakho izikhwama zokuhlala, abanakho izihlalo nhlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lokhu kuthinta kakhulu inani eliphezulu lempilo nezingozi emigwaqweni yethu. Umthetho 247 uthi abantu bangathuthwa kuphela ngemuva kwemoto yezimpahla uma le ndawo abahamba kuyo ivikelwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ivimbele ukuwa kwabo. Abashayeli bezinhlaka nezithuthi bavame ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Sivame ukuzwa ezindabeni "I-taxi noma ibhasi elalilodwa eligcwele libe nengxabano". Kumele kube nesaziso ebhasini/taxi esikhombisa inani labagibeli abavunyelwe ukuhlala nokuma emotweni. Umshayeli othuthwa abantu nezimpahla kufanele ahlolwe ngalolo msebenzi futhi kufanele afundiswe ukuthi angashayela kanjani. Abashayeli kufanele basebenzise lesi saziso ukuze balahle imoto zabo. Ungayibona kanjani imoto egcwele? Ihamba kancane uma ihamba phezulu. Yini enye ongayibona ukuthi igcwele emotweni? Isimo sayo esiyisisekelo. Londoloza isikhathi: Akukho ukulibaziseka, ngokwesibonelo, uma ulayisha noma udayisa impahla. Izinkinga ze-inshurensi uma ubandakanyeka engxabanweni futhi kutholakala ukuthi imoto igcwele. Ukuhamba ngebhayisikili sekuphenduke umkhuba ophumelelayo nendlela yokuhamba eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abaningi bayajabulela ukuphumula okuvela ekugibeleni ezimpilweni zabo zansuku zonke. Kubantu abaningi, ibhayisikili iyindlela ehlukile yokuhamba kunemoto yokuhamba nsuku zonke. Ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba njengemoto. Nokho, ibhayisikili ayifani nezinye izinhlobo zezimoto, ibhayisikili iphakathi kwamandla abantu. Unamalungelo, imithwalo, nemisebenzi efanayo nabanye abashayeli. Khumbula, abagibeli abavunyelwe emigwaqweni engamakhanda. Izinguquko Zomthetho: Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezibalulekile zomthetho ezihloswe ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo, ezomnotho, kanye nokuphila kwabantu. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi izinqubomgomo ezithinta amalungelo abantu, ukulwa nobugebengu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emthethweni. Umcimbi omkhulu walesi sikhathi wenzeka eGoli, lapho izikhulu zikamasipala, abamele izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinguquko. Uhlelo lwezinkulumo luqukethe izethulo ezivela kubachwepheshe bezomthetho, abameli, kanye nabamele izakhamizi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemibono emisha yokuthuthukisa umthetho ukuze uhambisane nezidingo zamanje. Ukwaziswa ngalezi zinguquko kwaba yinto ebalulekile, njengoba umphakathi udinga ukuqonda indlela lezi zinguquko ezizothinta ngayo impilo yabo nsuku zonke. Izinkulumo zakhuluma ngama-akhawunti amasha ezomthetho, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezithinta imithetho yokuhlala, imithetho yokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela abantwana. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Abamele izinkampani baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi izinguquko zomthetho zingasiza kanjani ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, kanti abamele izakhamizi bagcizelela ukuthi imithetho kufanele ibheke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uqonda kahle ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azihambisani kuphela nezinqubomgomo, kodwa zidinga ukubandakanya wonke umuntu. Ukwengeza, umcimbi ubuyekeza izinhlelo ezikhona zokuphatha. Abaholi bephakamisa ukuthi izinqubo zokuphatha kufanele zibe lula, ziqinise ukwethembeka, futhi zikhuthaze ubumbano phakathi komphakathi nezikhungo zomthetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula emthethweni, bazi ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma bephula umthetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko zomthetho zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta ubuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nezimo zokuhlala. Abaholi baphakamisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumalungelo abantu, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokuvikela abesifazane nezingane. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu bonke, futhi akekho ozoshiywa ngaphandle. Umcimbi ugcizelela ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azifanele kube yinto eyenziwa nguhulumeni kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube neqhaza labantu. Abantu baphakanyiswa ukuba baphathe izinkulumo, baveze imibono yabo, futhi babambe iqhaza ekwakheni umthetho. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinqubweni zomthetho, futhi kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nesibopho sokuziphatha kahle. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonisile ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho zidinga ukusebenzisana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukuze lezi zinguquko zibe nempumelelo, umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukwakha umthetho ophumelelayo, ovumelanayo, futhi ohloniphekayo. Izinguquko zomthetho zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, futhi ubuchwepheshe obusha bungasiza ekwenzeni lezi zinguquko zibe ngempumelelo. Umcimbi ubonisile ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, izinguquko zomthetho zingaba yinsika yempumelelo. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wezinguquko zomthetho awuqedi nje kuphela izinkulumo, kodwa uveza umbono omusha wokuthi umphakathi ungakwazi kanjani ukuhamba phambili. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ithemba, zikhuthaza ubumbano, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana, futhi izinguquko zomthetho zidinga ukugqugquzela abantu ukuba baphathe izinkulumo ezibalulekile ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Uma umholo ophelele womsebenzi noma inani elifanayo ngonyaka lingaphansi kwe-R2,000, aludluli inani okumele lukhishwe ukuze kube nezinye izinkokhelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomu le-IT3 kufanele likhishwe, kusekelwe enanini eliphelele elikhokhiwe lapho izinkokhelo zentela zingakhishwanga. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe kumuntu wokuhlinzeka ngesevisi ethile, noma okumele yenziwe, lapho izinkokhelo zentela zingakhishwanga. Izinkokhelo zezinye izinsizakalo zivame ukutholakala emsebenzini wobungcweti, njengodokotela, abameli, abavakashi, ababhali bezincwadi, nabahloli bezimali. Umholo noma inani elifanayo elingadluli kwe-R2,000 emnyakeni wentela. Inkokhelo eyenziwe ngelungelo lokusebenzisa impahla, izinkokhelo zezinye izinto ezakhiwe esikhathini esedlule ezifana nokubhaliswa kwezimali nezinye, noma izinkokhelo zokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani, ukwakhiwa, amalungelo emikhiqizo, amalungelo okwakha imibhalo noma ulwazi, noma yokudlulisela ulwazi oluhambisana nokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani bezinto ezithile ezakhiwe. Incazelo ye-uniti noma impahla yezezimali ingumkhiqizo wezinto noma impahla edliwayo, inani liyisilinganiso seziqu ezidliwayo, inani eliphelele elitholwe kulezi zimpahla ezidliwayo yinzuzo ngemuva kokukhishwa kwezindleko ezifanele noma ukulahleka okuhambisana nalezi zimpahla ezidliwayo. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile ezitholwe ngawe ngokuthenga noma ukushintshanisa ngezimpahla. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile zithengiswa ngawe njengomthengisi wombhali. Zonke izitshalo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, noma imayini, zethulwa ngawe njengomthengisi ophatha izimpahla zomkhiqizi ziye kubathengi ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe. Le nsizakalo iyatholakala mahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.
Ulimi lwabantu ngandlela-thile luyisiqinisekiso "sesibili," lumele okuthile okungokwemvelo kwabantu, lapho sikhuluma khona ngezithemba nezifiso, sibhala imicabango yethu nemigomo, sihlola ulwazi lwethu namasiko, futhi sakhe imiphakathi yethu nemithetho yokubusa. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni ohlanganyela njalo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liqinisekiswe yiBill of Rights kanye neSisekelo sethu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele zisetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, sikwazi ekugcineni ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo senqubomgomo yolimi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwukuphetha komsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngithumele khona iLanguage Planning Working Group (LANGTAG) ukuba inikeze izeluleko ngesakhiwo esihambisanayo senqubomgomo yolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ngokombono wokungabi khona kokuphikiswa ekuhlukahlukaneni kwezilimi kanye nemiphumela yokuthi "ukusebenza kwezilimi eziningi kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. I-National Language Policy Framework isekelwe emiphumeleni yokubambisana ngokubonisana, isebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG nezinsiza zeMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neLanguage Policy Advisory Group. Lesi sikhungo senqubomgomo sibalulekile ekuphatheni izinsiza zethu ezihlukahlukene zolimi nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kukahulumeni ezinjongo zokukhuthaza ubud democracy, ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nobunye bezwe. Kulesi simo esihle, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zelizwe lethu, njengoba kuvezwe yiSisekelo, kube nendawo ebalulekile kule nqubomgomo. Le Nqubomgomo futhi igcizelela ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kubonakala kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwazo kwezomnotho, kwezokuxhumana, nasezombusazwe. Lapho ulimi lungalahlekelwa ukubaluleka kulezi zimo, isimo sawo siyancipha. I-nqubomgomo iphinde ibonise ukuthi sibhekene nezinselelo zokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukuthi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye yeziqubu ezishintshashintshayo zobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kuzobhekelelwa ukusimama kwesimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngithemba ngenhlonipho ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi njengabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi le nqubomgomo iba yimpumelelo ezimpilweni zethu, futhi isenze siqhenye ngempilo yethu ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika. SAQA Ibhodi leziqu laseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona cishe izilimi eziyi-25 ezahlukene ezikhuluma eNingizimu Afrika, kanti eziyi-11 zikhishwa isimo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seSisekelo sika-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996), ngokusekelwe esidingweni sokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufanele kube ngu-98% wabantu bonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni yizona isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, kanye ne-siSwati (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeNguni); isiSesotho, isiSepedi, kanye neSetswana (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeSotho); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi, kanye ne-Afrikaans. ENingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinokukhuluma izilimi eziningi. Isici esivelele sokukhuluma izilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi eziningi zomdabu zidlula imingcele yezifunda, zikhuluma phakathi kwemiphakathi yaleso silimi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphikisiwe ngaphambili futhi kukhuthaze ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi, uma kuphela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bekhululekile ukweseka izilimi ezingezona ezomdabu njengokubalulekile, okuyizilimi ezisemthethweni zalesi sikhungo. Ukuphathwa kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika bekukhona izinkinga emlandweni ngenxa yokungabi khona kwenqubomgomo yolimi echazwe kahle, okuholele ekusetshenzisweni kwe-English kanye ne-Afrikaans njengamazwi aphakeme athonya izici zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe zomphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuhulumeni wenkululeko, eNingizimu Afrika ifike endaweni ebalulekile emlandweni wayo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baphendule ekuhlukahlukaneni kwabo kolimi namasiko kanye nezinselelo zokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, yingakho le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi ithuthukiswa. Le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe ayiqali nje indlela entsha yokubhekana nokukhuluma izilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika kodwa futhi ikhulisa kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ukuze kukhuthazwe futhi kuthuthukiswe ubunye bezwe. Iphakela ukuqashelwa okubanzi kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi, ubulungiswa bezokuxhumana, ukufinyelela okufanele ezinhlelweni nasemithonjeni yomphakathi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Leli documet linikeza isikhungo esingasetshenziswa yibhodi yokukhuluma izilimi eziningi ehlanganisiwe ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeSisekelo. Kusukela ekusungulweni kokuqala kwabantu baseDashi eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1652, ngezikhathi ezilandelanayo zokubusa kweNgilandi, i-Union of South Africa, kanye nohulumeni we-apartheid, kuze kube sekupheleni kokwakhiwa kukahulumeni wenkululeko ngo-1994 nokuhlanganiswa kokukhuluma izilimi eziningi emthethweni, inqubomgomo yolimi kahulumeni nezikhungo zokuqondisa azikaze ziqaphele ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela walolu simo kube ukungalingani, lapho ubuholi be-English kanye ne-Afrikaans kudala ubudlelwano obungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zabo zomdabu nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke, inqubomgomo yolimi yeziqhingi kanye ne-apartheid, ezihlanganiswe nezinhlelo zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe, zaveza ubuholi bezilimi, ukungalingani okukhonjiswe ezakhiweni zobuhlanga nezamakhono ezakha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa isimo sezilimi zomdabu kanye nezinhlobo zezizilimi zabantu bomdabu nezinye izigaba ezaziphikisiwe, kuhlanganisa neKhoi kanye neSan - okuqhubeka nokwakha umbono omubi wezilimi ezimnyama, okungabangelwa kuphela ngababhalisi be-Afrikaans kanye ne-English, kodwa futhi nabanye abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu uqobo. Isimo siba sibi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngenxa yezizathu ezingacacile nezimpi zamandla eziphikisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi, uhulumeni nezikhungo ezizimele zine ndlela ethile yokwenza izinqumo zolimi eziphikisana nezingxenye zeSisekelo kanye nezidingo ezihambisana nezilimi. Isigaba 6 seSisekelo sinikeza isikhungo esiphezulu esisemthethweni sokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa nokubekezela kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika. I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission: Ukubuyisana Nokuqonda I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) iyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu, iNingizimu Afrika. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngemuva kokuphela kokubusa kobandlululo, ngenhloso yokubuyisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, nokwakha isizwe esisha esihlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuma izigameko ezinzima ezedlule, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngokubona kwami, i-TRC ibalulekile ngoba yayingumzamo wokubuyisana, hhayi kuphela phakathi kwabantu, kodwa futhi phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi izigameko ezedlule zishiya izilonda ezinzima. Ukuxoxa ngalezi zinto, nokuvuma ukuthi zenzeka, kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo. I-TRC yabe iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba sikhuluma ngempilo, kudingeka sikhumbule izinkumbulo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-TRC yaphenduka indawo yokuxoxisana, lapho abantu bephuma phambili ukuze babelane ngezindaba zabo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu baziqonde, bahloniphe, futhi bakhumbule abanye. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zindaba zazingezinzima, kodwa zazingaphezu kokukhumbula ubuhlungu; zazikhombisa amandla okuphila, nokuthi abantu bangakha kabusha izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi, ukuze sibe nesizwe esiqinile, kudingeka sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. I-TRC ibhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Abanye abantu babengafuni ukuvuma izigameko ezithile, noma babengafuni ukuphendula imibuzo ethile. Lokhu kwadala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabantu, futhi kwavusa izinkinga ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu babengathokozile ngempumelelo ye-TRC, bethi ayizange ibuyise kahle izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba i-TRC ibalulekile, akusikho konke okwakhiwe kahle. Ngokubona kwami, i-TRC ibalulekile, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi siqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze sithole ubulungiswa. Ukubuyisana akupheli lapho sikhuluma ngezinto ezedlule; kudinga ukuba siqhubeke nokwakha izindlela zokuxhumana, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isizwe esiqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, kufanele sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-TRC ibonisa ukuthi, ukuze sibe nesizwe esiqinile, kudingeka sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, kufanele sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-TRC ibonisa ukuthi, ukuze sibe nesizwe esiqinile, kudingeka sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze sithole ubulungiswa, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi, nakuba sikhuluma ngempilo, kudingeka sikhumbule izinkumbulo ezinzima. Ekugcineni, i-Truth and Reconciliation Commission iyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokuthi, ukuze sibe nesizwe esiqinile, kudingeka sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze sithole ubulungiswa, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi, nakuba sikhuluma ngempilo, kudingeka sikhumbule izinkumbulo ezinzima. I-TRC iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ukuze sibe nesizwe esiqinile, kudingeka sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile.
UMphathiswa Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo usungule lezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ngemuva kokuxoxisana noMphathiswa Wezezimali, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 30 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvimbela Ukucwaswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). "UMthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvimbela Ukucwaswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). 2.(1) Isicelo sokunikezwa isikhundla sokuba umregistrar obhekiswe kuso esigabeni 17 soMthetho kumele sibe sibhaliwe kufomu efana neFomu 1 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure futhi sithunyelwe kuMphathi-Jikelele, kanye namagama, amakheli, nezinombolo zocingo zabantu ababili abangaxoxwa ngcharacter yakhe. Umuntu anganikezwa isikhundla nguMphathi-Jikelele ukuba abe umregistrar uma ehambisana nezidingo ezibekwe kuMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994 (Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994) futhi ahambisane nenqubomgomo yokunikezwa leso sikhundla sokuba umregistrar kule Ndawo. Ukunikezwa kwabaregistrars kuncike ekuphothulweni kwezifundo ezithile ezivunyelwe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele anganikezela umuntu ukuba abe umregistrar isikhathi esivumelwene nguMphathi-Jikelele nomfaki-sicelo; umfaki-sicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola umholo ophelele ofana nenani eliphelele elitholwe ngabaregistrars kule Ndawo. Izimo zokunikezwa umuntu isikhundla sokuba umregistrar njengoba kuqondiswe ngalesi sigaba (1) ngenhla zifana nezimo zokemployment ezisetshenziswa kumuntu onikezwa isikhundla sokuba umregistrar enkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994 (Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994). Benza imisebenzi yomregistrar enkantolo ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe lokho okukhulunywe ngakho nguMthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikhomishini ebhekiswe esigabeni 20 salo Mthetho, efuna ukulethela udaba enkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ingakwenza lokhu ngokwazisa umregistrar wenkantolo ngentshisekelo yabo yokwenza lokhu besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 2 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bacela umphenduli ukuba banikeze ulwazi olubhaliwe olukhulunywe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 kusukela ngosuku lokwamukela leso sikhumbuzo. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela impendulo evela kumphenduli obhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma isithombe salo mpendulo kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu olethe udaba. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nalolo daba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzophakanyiswa enkantolo noma luthunyelwe kwenye iforamu. Uma umphathi ophakanyisiwe ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kufanele luphakanyiswe enkantolo, kumele athumele udaba kumregistrar, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokwamukela lolo daba, abeke usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba. Umregistrar kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba, wazise umfaki-sicelo nomphenduli ngaleso sikhathi sokulalelwa besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 4 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Bangase benze iziphakamiso noma imibono ebhaliwe abacabanga ukuthi ifanele ukuba icatshangelwe yile nkantolo besebenzisa ifomu efana nesigaba 2 seSigaba A seFomu 5 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bazise zonke izigaba ezithintekayo kulolu daba ngamadokhumenti athunyelwe kule nkantolo abhekiswe esigabeni (a). Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokulalela udaba itholile amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8)(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe esazisa zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba nomregistrar wenkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa kokwamukelwa kwalolu daba. I nkantolo ethunyelwe udaba kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokwamukela amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8), ithumele umbiko kumregistrar wenkantolo, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolu daba. Uma udaba luphothuliwe yile nkantolo, le nkantolo kumele ngokushesha ibike umregistrar wenkantolo ngempumelelo yalolu daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo yalo daba kumele ibe sibhaliwe kufomu efana nalokhu kuSigaba B seFomu 5 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure, inikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba luphindiselwa. I nkantolo kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kusukela ngosuku lokuthi udaba luphindiselwe emuva enkantolo, iqondise ukuthi udaba luzoxoxwa kanjani. Umregistrar kumele ngokushesha wazise labo abathintekayo kulolu daba ngosuku lokulalela ngemihlahlandlela ezolandela ngendlela ebhekiswe esigabeni (6). Ngemuva kokwenza isicelo esibhaliwe kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, uma udaba luphuthumayo, umphathi ophakanyisiwe angaqondisa ukuthi isikhathi esibekiwe ezinqubweni sikhululwe. Ngokuthumela nge-imeyili, uma ubufakazi bokuthi bathole i-imeyili ethunyelwe kubo bungaboniswa nguthumeli, ubufakazi bokuthumela kumele bugcina, futhi ifomu eliyinhloko kumele lithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo ngokushesha ngeposi elibhalisiwe. Kumele lithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo noma lifakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela elawulwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Ngokuthumela nge-imeyili noma ngeposi, ubufakazi balokhu kumele bugcina, futhi ifomu eliyinhloko kumele lithunyelwe ngaphandle kokulibala kumfaki-sicelo ngeposi elibhalisiwe. Isikhumbuzo esibhekiswe esigabeni 6(6) kumele sinikezwe kumphakathi wenkantolo noma kumregistrar kuzo zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba mathupha. 8.(1)(a) Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi ukuze bavele phambi kwenkantolo kumele, okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela udaba, acela umregistrar wenkantolo ukuba akhiphe futhi asebenze isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi ngokushesha. Isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi esikhiphwe kumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Ngubani omunye ongathunyelwa umregistrar ngokuphakamisa komphathi ophakanyisiwe? Umuntu othumela isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi kumele aqedele ingxenye B yesigaba sesibili seFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. (a) Ukubakhona kobufakazi phambi kwenkantolo ngomyalo wenkantolo kwenziwa ngokuthumela leso sikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi, esikhishwe ngumregistrar, okumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure.
