Kunemibandela eminingi echaza intshisekelo evukile yokuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika, isibonelo: umhlaba ophumelelayo utholakala, amanani okudla akhuphukile kakhulu, futhi kukhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngavailability yokudla ezweni lethu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Udaba lokushoda kokudla luhlala lukhuluma emhlabeni jikelele, mayelana nokugcina ukudla emhlabeni, ilungelo lokuba nokudla nendawo yokuhlala, ekugcineni lokhu kudla kukhiqizwa umuntu othile endaweni ethile - kukhona umuntu osebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lowo muntu. Kunomneed yokuthuthukisa lowo muntu nokumnika amandla okuba umkhiqizi wezomnotho ozohlinzeka ukudla kwethu ezweni lapho kudingeka khona. Kungani abantu befuna ukwazi ukuthi abalimi abasha benza ini? Umkhakha wezolimo udinga ukuba nevoce eyodwa ekhulumela bona. Imikhiqizo yezolimo iyimpahla ethola ukudla emhlabeni jikelele futhi iyisisekelo somnotho wamazwe emhlabeni. Imikhiqizo yezolimo inikeza umsebenzi obalulekile kubantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukukhula komnotho wezindawo zasemakhaya kwenza ingcebo yasemadolobheni ingabi namandla. Lapho u-1-30% womhlaba usendleleni yabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokuba ngabapropathi, sizobheka ukuthi u-30% wokukhiqiza kwezolimo uzovela kulabo bantu. Ngakho-ke, sicabanga ukuthi u-30% wezinto ezidingekayo kwezolimo uzothengwa ngabalimi labo. Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abasha? Ukuphuma okuphansi kwemali yokuthola izitshalo uma kukhula kuphela ezimweni zokunisela, kanye nezinga lokwaziswa elikhuphukayo. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo etholakalayo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo ibinokwehliswa. Izindleko zokuqala zikhuphuka njalo, kodwa intengo yemakethe ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abangakwazi ukuqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokubolekwa imali. Lapho izinzuzo ziqinile futhi izinga lokwaziswa lemali ebolekiwe liphansi, kuba nguyena obalulekile ukuboleka izimali ezinkulu ukuze ukwazi ukutshala imbewu emhlabeni. Abakhiqizi eNingizimu Afrika balwela emakethe yomhlaba, kodwa imithetho yokubambisana ayifani. Kukhona ukungabi nalwazi olufanele namakhono. Abakhiqizi abasha bangaba abafundi; badinga ukwesekwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nemfundo. Ngokuvamile, abantu abasebenza emaphakathini abhandling le misebenzi bangenalwazi olufanele. Abaningi abake basebenze epulazini, abanye bayavuma ukusiza, abanye bafundile kodwa abakwazi "ukubeka imbewu emhlabeni." Izinhlangano ezinikeza izinto zokulima zisebenza kahle, kodwa izindleko zazo ziphakeme. Abakhiqizi abasha abaningi babhekana nezinselelo lapho befuna uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhasa ifuna ukuzibophezela epulazini ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka uxhaso. Abalimi abaqashile amapulazi noma abakhiqiza emhlabeni wombuso abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo zibopho, ngaleyo ndlela behluleka ukuthola uxhaso. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhasa ehlinzeka ngoxhaso lokukhiqiza ifuna ukuqinisekiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe leyo mali. Nokho, ukuqinisekiswa kokukhiqiza kusebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula, lapho konke okukhona sekuvele kwenzekile. Ezinye izindawo ziyawuphika ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso ngaphambi kokuthola ukuqinisekiswa, okushiya umphakathi ungenalo uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Enye inkinga ukuthi: ukuqinisekiswa kuvikela kuphela u-65% wezindleko - u-35% osele usengcupheni. Ukulima kunzima; ngaphandle kolwazi, uzobhekana nezinkinga. Lapho izinzuzo zincipha, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Abakhiqizi abasha basafunda, ngakho-ke ingozi yokubaphelezela ngoxhaso iphakeme kakhulu. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abanethuba lokuthola umhlaba noma izinkundla, kodwa abambalwa banemishini yokulima lelohlaba. Imishini emisha ibiza kakhulu, futhi abalimi abakwazi ukuyifinyelela, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ibhizinisi elizohlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuthenga imishini endala. Lapho kukhona imishini yokulima, ivamise ukuba ingasebenzi kahle. Ukuphuma okuphansi kokukhiqiza izitshalo kusho ukuthi abalimi abanemali yokulungisa imishini yabo. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bangenalwazi lokulungisa nokugcina imishini yabo. Ngokuvamile, ukuhweba komhlaba kufaka zonke izinto ezikhona epulazini, futhi sithola ukuthi imishini ibhujiswa futhi iphukile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umphakathi omusha uqala endaweni engathandeki. Izigaba zinikezwa imishini esetshenziswa ngamalungu wonke, kodwa akekho obheka impilo yemishini. Uhlelo lokulungisa umhlaba lweMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube yinkinga kubantu abaningi. Ngokuvamile, ukusebenza kwalo kuhamba kancane; manje abalimi abasha abaningi bayalahlekelwa amathuba okuqhubeka, futhi abalimi abamhlophe bayakhathele futhi bathengisa amapulazi abo kubangane abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango wehlulekile ukuqedela ukuhweba. Futhi akukho zinkomba ezicacile ezikhombisa ukuthi ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu shintsho lomhlaba. Ukubuyisela ibhalansi ye-PH emhlabathini kungaba yindleko enkulu ngoba kunezindawo ezidinga kuze kube yizinkulungwane eziyi-14 ze-lime nge-hectare. Ngokuvamile, abalimi abakwazi ukukhokha lezo zindleko, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zindlela zomthetho ezikhombisa ukuthi abakhiqizi abasha bangafuna usizo kuhulumeni. Kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa akukho uhlelo olufanayo. Izindlela ezingafanele zokulima eminyakeni edlule zibe nomthelela ekwehliseni izinsiza ze-phosphate kwezinye izindawo. Njengokufaka i-lime, ukubuyisela lokhu kubiza imali eningi, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zikhwama. Ngokuvamile, amapulazi lapho abakhiqizi abasha bekulima awasebenziswanga kahle ngoba awekho ama-contours nezinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unohlelo lokunakekela umhlaba, isabelomali saso sincane, futhi awakwazi ukubhekana nale nkinga enkulu futhi ahlangabezane nale mfuneko enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ukonakaliswa komhlaba ngenxa yomoya namanzi sekwenziwe kwaze kwaba sezingeni lokuthi akukwazi ukulungiswa. Abakhiqizi badinga ithuba lokuba ngabapropathi futhi babe nemishini ukuze bakhule babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Kwezinye izifunda, kukhona ukungabi khona kwezinsiza zezolimo ezifana nezindlela, ama-silos, izindawo zokomisa ukudla, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Abalimi badinga ukuqeqeshwa, ukwesekwa, kanye nezinsiza ezabelana ngolwazi. Abantu badinga ukwakhiwa ukuze baziqhenye. Kumele bafunde ukusebenza ngokwabo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni abangakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo benza abantu bahlale bebuphofu (isibonelo, uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba wehlulekile ukuthuthukisa umsebenzi wabo kanye noMnyango Wezolimo ongasekeli abantu ngendlela efanele). Kulula ukuhlinzeka abantu abaphansi (bakhishwa). Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza ukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abasha basebenze ngokwethembeka nangokuhlonipha. Imithetho efanele nezimiso zokuhweba eziqondile ukuvikela amabhizinisi ezolimo ezweni. Nikeza usizo ngezindleko zokufaka i-lime. Nikeza
### Ama-Smartphone: Uhlanga Lokuxhumana Lwezobuchwepheshe Isingeniso Kulezi zinsuku, ama-smartphone sezidume kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi kube uthando lokuthi abantu basebenzise lezi zinsiza zokuxhumana. Uma sihamba ezindaweni zomphakathi, sithola abantu abaningi besebenzisa ama-smartphone, okuhleli phakathi kwezandla zabo. Kule ncwadi, sizobheka imvelaphi, izici, kanye nokubaluleka kwe-smartphone empilweni yansuku zonke. Imvelaphi Ye-Smartphone Ama-smartphone awaqalanga njengokujwayelekile. Qala umqondo owayevame ukuba yifoni yendabuko, eyayikwazi kuphela ukuxhumana nokuqhubeka nezinkampani. Khona-ke, eminyakeni engamashumi amabili edlule, yima inhlanganisela enkulu ye-intelligent technology, okuholele ekwakhiweni ama-smartphone. Lawa ma-smartphone anikela ngezici ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ikhamera, i-inthanethi, nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene. Enye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wama-smartphone wukuthi awanemiko emincane, njengama-Blackberry ne-Nokia, okwakuyizifanekiso ezazida futhi zazidumile ngesikhathi sazo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buchuma, ama-smartphone aqala ukuvela, futhi kuze kube namuhla, anikezela ngezici ezinzima, ezibandakanya amandla okuxhumana, ukudlala imidlalo, nezinye izilungiselelo eziningi zomsebenzi. Izici Ze-Smartphone Ama-smartphone akhiwe ngezici eziningi ezizenza zihluke kwi-foni yendabuko. Okokuqala, kukhona isikhombimsebenzisi esihambisana ne-touchscreen esivumela abasebenzisi ukuthi baphathe izinhlelo zokusebenza ngokuthinta kuphela. I-touchscreen ibhekwa njengomsebenzi ophawuleka kakhulu wama-smartphone, phakathi nezizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani zaziwa kakhulu. Okwesibili, ama-smartphone anama-processor akhuphukayo, okwenza kube lula ukuphatha imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukusebenza, baphule imidlalo, kanye nokuxhumana nabangani baphinde bazithokozise. Ikhamera yama-smartphone nayo ibalulekile. I-smartphone yanamuhla ibikhiqiza izithombe eziphakeme kakhulu, ezivumela abantu ukuba bathathe izithombe ezizwakalayo nezibukwayo. Njengoba imithombo yezokuxhumana isiphenduke indawo yokwabelana ngezithombe, isikhathi sokuthatha isithombe sibe lukhuni, bakeshe imithombo yokuxhumana ingasekho, ihlaba umxhwele. Ukubaluleka Kwe-Smartphone Ama-smartphone awasiyena kuphela amathuluzi okuxhumana, kodwa asebenza futhi njengama-hub ahlakaniphile empilweni yethu. Ngaphezulu kokuzenzakalelayo, ama-smartphone ahlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda, yokusebenza, kanye nezokungcebeleka. Abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela emakhasi e-inthanethi, baxhumane nabangani, futhi bathuthukise izifundo zabo ngale ndlela. Ukwengeza, ama-smartphone asiza ekuxhumaneni kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlela izibopho, balandele impilo yabo, noma baphathe imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eyahlukeneyo. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubekele phambili kabili futhi baphendule emaso. Ngokwengxenye, ama-smartphone abe nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Abantu bakwazi ukuxhumana kalula, kungakhathaliseki ukuba baphila kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kuxhumana kwesiteshi esisodwa kubavumela ukuba babelane ngemicabango, izincwadi, nezithombe, okwenza kube lula ukuthi baze baphinde bahlale bedlalisa. Izingozi Nezingqinamba Zama-Smartphone Kodwa-ke, nakuba ama-smartphone enezinzuzo eziningi, akulula kodwa futhi eza nezingozi. Ukuxhumana okungafunwa kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwezinsuku zethu, kungase kuphumele izinkinga zokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ukubamba ngaphandle kokuhlala sibukeka, sithathele izithombe, kungaba yingozi, kungenzeka campa emiphakathini yangempela. Okunye okukhathazayo wukuthi ama-smartphone azama ukufaka umthelela ekukhuleni kwengqondo. Abanye abantu baqala ukuthola ukuphazamiseka kokucabanga ngenxa yokusebenzisa ama-smartphone kakhulu, okukhomba ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sihlale sikhumbula ukujula kubona. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ama-smartphone awavulekile nje amathuluzi okuxhumana, kodwa akhiwe ngezici ezividlaysisayo empilweni yethu. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukubheka izinzuzo nemikhawulo yama-smartphone njengengxenye yemvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza, singathuthukisa impilo yethu, sisize abanye, futhi sigcine isikhalazo esithokozisayo ngaphansi kwenguquko ye-intelligent technology. Amasimu amasha aphuma emfundweni yethu yomhlaba phakathzail lezi zinto, kuyiphuzu elikhalipha emhlabeni ukuze sibe abaphuma phambili emhlabeni wezamabhizinisi. Ngakho, masikubheke njengemithombo yokufunda nokuqhakambisa ukuphila kwethu, siqonde indlela yokuxhumana ngendlela eyakhayo futhi ethokozisayo. Kumbe kungenzeka sibeke izijobelelo ezintsha ukuze sithole oyena masimi oyiqatha sinnye-noqhubekiswayo.
Ukulima: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezolimo Kuvulekile umcimbi ongcwele, ogqugquzelwe yizifiso zabaqalayo nabakhokhela umhlaba wezolimo, owaziwa ngokuthi iNkundla Yezolimo. Ucwaningo lwezindlela zokulima, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi, kube yizinto eziphawulekayo kulo mcimbi obungcono obubanjwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi uqale ngokubamba umoya, lapho abezindaba bejabulisa izivakashi ngezinkanyezi ezivelele emhlabeni wezolimo. Izimakethe zomkhiqizo wezolimo, ezinjengezithako, izitshalo, nezilwane, zaba yinsika ezintsha zabakwazi ukufinyelela kumakhasimende abasha. Abalimi bavula amavolontiya namaqonga amasha okugcina nokuhlonipha imisebenzi yamanje yokulima, okwakuhlanganisa ukukhuthaza umgwaqo wokukhiqiza ompofu. Ngenkathi emaphethelweni emcimbini, izivakashi zabeziqhelisa ngempilo emhlabeni wezolimo. Ukuze kufudukele emhlabeni wempilo yolwazi, futhi uhlanganyele ngobuchwepheshe, phakathi kokukhulelwa kwezimoto, izinsiza zezimali zafakwa phakathi kwalokhu ukubhekana nobunzima bokuhlala phansi kwesikhumba seplanethi. Abasebenzi bezolimo baphinde badele ukuzwakala kokuthengisa cosekucwaningo nokukhuthaza umnyango owedlula umphakathi, okwakuhloswe ukuyolisiphakela imifino, izithelo, nemifino emisha. Abalimi bakhuluma ngempumelelo nemithwalo ethile yokulima. Izifundo ezenzakalayo, ezifana nezibalo zezimali, ukwenza kahle kwezinsiza, nakho konke okubhalwe phansi, kuxhumene nendlela yokubambisana yokugcina imiphumela. Ubulili buphawulekayo phakathi kokufunda kwezimpawu, ukwakha izindlela ezikahle zokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokulima. Umphakathi ubheke ukuze ube neqhaza elikhethiwe elikulandelayo, ukuze uzame ukucubungula nezixhumanisi zempilo eziqinile. Ngesikhathi somcimbi, imifino eyanele yalethwa ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, ibhizinisi lokuphuma kwamasiko azihambisani namatekhnoloji amasha. Lokhu kuhlangenwe nakho kwezivakashi kukhombisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende, osomabhizinisi, nabalimi, ukuveza impilo efanele nezikhungo ezivulekile. Abalimi baphinde bamba iqhaza emihlanganweni ebusuku, bexoxa ngokushintshwa kwemikhuba, izimidlalwana, nezinguquko ezethulwayo emhlabeni wezolimo. Uphenyo lokugcina lwaholela ekutheni bahlanganyele imicabango, bahlola izinkinga zokulima impilo okuthinta abaninimzi, nezehlakalo ezicebile. Izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zafaka ezokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nabalimi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulima, nokwakha amathuba okusebenza. Ngemva kwalokhu, umbono omusha uphumelele, uhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithokozisayo zemvelo yokulima. Ukwenziwa kokugcina kumqoka kakhulu ukwazisa imikhiqizo ezishayabala ubuso bomhlaba, ukuqinisekisa ukuzenzela nokukhula kwezokuhlala. Ubusuku bahlale bebambisene, besebenzisa izinsiza eziphansi, abafuna ukuba babonise izifundo ezihamba phambili ezinjengokwakhiwa komphakathi ukuze benze ibhizinisi elihle. Ngalesi sikhathi, abaholi bezolimo baphinde balandela imikhuba emisha yokulima, bazali, behlola izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa umhlaba, befuna umsebenzi ophumelelayo. Umcimbi ugcine ngokukhumbuza bonke ababebekhona ukuba badalele amaphuzu abawathathayo, futhi bajabulele umphakathi ofuna ukuphila kahle. Impumelelo yeNkundla Yezolimo ibonisa ukuthi umhlaba wezolimo awudingi ukuthosizwe; udinga ukusubulawa ukuze uphinde ube buhle. Ngemva kosuku olunomsebenzi, ubudlelwano obubumelene ekwenzeni umhlaba ube nobungane bukhumbuza ukuthi ukusebenzisa umhlaba wokuqala futhi uqhakazile kuyizinto ezibalulekile zokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Uthando namandla abathokozisayo ababebekhona kuze kube sekugcineni kwela mcimbi, lapho uhlelo lukasizo lwakhasimende lukhombisa ngendlela eqinile yokuphakela umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wezinhlaka ezikhiphayo unikeze ithuba elihle lokulima, ukhuthaza ukuzibophezela okwengeziwe ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi nabalimi abahlanganyela umqondo ofanayo wokukhulisa impilo yezolimo. Noma kanjani, izigaba zomcimbi weNkundla Yezolimo ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukulima kube yingxenye ebalulekile yezenhlalakahle. Ubulili obunamandla, imfundo, nokuxhumana phakathi kwemindeni nakweminye imiphakathi kuzohlinzeka ngomphumela ophumelelayo nokuqhubekayo kwalowo mcimbi.
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukugxila kulezi zinhlelo. Le ndawo, enezinsiza zemvelo eziningi, ibonisa izidingo zethu zokwakha ikusasa elihlanzekile nelinobulungiswa. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo angaba yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, njengezinhlelo zamandla elanga, amanzi, kanye namandla omoya, ezihlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu akwandisi amathuba emisebenzi kuphela, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basendaweni bayakwazi ukuziphilisa. ENyakatho Kapa, lapho umnotho ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo angase abe yisixazululo esihle sokukhuthaza ukukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, la mandla ahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokunciphisa imithelela emibi yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo awakhulisi umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa futhi anciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ebamba ukushisa, okuqinisekisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zinezinsiza ezihlanzekile. Ngokubheka izinhlelo ezithile, sinesibonelo esihle sephrojekthi ye-‘Solar Water Heater’ ehlanganisa izindlu eziningi, esize abantu banciphise izindleko zokushisa amanzi. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekongeni imali, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza umqondo wokuzimela. Uma abantu bekwazi ukwenza izinto zabo, bayakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ozimele. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene namaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo, njengezindleko zokuqala eziphakeme, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabaxhasi benze izinhlelo zokuxhasa ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nalwazi olufanele kubantu abaningi eNyakatho Kapa kungaba yinkinga. Abantu badinga ukuqonda kabanzi ngalezi zinhlelo ukuze bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi, okuzobasiza ukuba babe yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi amaphrojekthi ahlangane nezidingo zomphakathi, okukhombisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo, abahlinzeki, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze amaphrojekthi aphumelele, kudingeka ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze bonke abathintekayo bazi ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa. Ngibona ikusasa elikhanyayo eNyakatho Kapa, lapho amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo azoba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni komnotho, ekunciphiseni umthelela emvelweni, nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Umphakathi onamandla ungakha izixazululo ezinzima ezibhekene nezinkinga zethu. Ngakho-ke, ngiyabiza bonke abathintekayo, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nabantu bendawo, ukuba baphokophele ekwakheni amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinobulungiswa. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa akuyona nje indlela yokuthola amandla, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Masiphokophele lezi zinhlelo ukuze sibe neNyakatho Kapa engcono.
Isingeniso Inkolo nomoya kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yabantu, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umqondo, izimiso, nemikhuba yokuphila. Lezi zinto zihlala zixhumene, zikhombisa indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo, abaphila ngayo, futhi abahlanganyela ngayo emiphakathini yabo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolo nomoya, izindlela ezihlukene zokukholelwa, kanye nomthelela wazo empilweni yomuntu. Inkolo: Umqondo Nokubaluleka Kwayo Inkolo ingachazwa njengokholo oluqinile olwakhiwe ezimisweni, izinkolelo, nemikhuba ethile. Iqukethe izinkolelo eziphakeme, ezivame ukuhamba nezincwadi ezibhalwe phansi, izinkulumo, nemikhuba yokukhulekela. Izinkolo ezahlukene zikhona emhlabeni, njengeKristu, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, kanye nezinye eziningi. Ngamunye wazo unomlando, izinkolelo, nemikhuba ehlukile, kodwa zonke zihlala zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, bahloniphe abanye, futhi bakhuthaze umphakathi. Inkolo ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu ngoba inikeza umqondo wokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Abantu abaningi bathola comfort, ithemba, nokuholwa ezinkolweni zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izimo ezinzima, njengokulahlekelwa, ukugula, noma izinselelo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inkolo ibamba umphakathi ndawonye, ibasiza ukuba bahlanganyele ezinkolweni zabo, benze imikhuba ethile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo. Umoya: Ukukholelwa Nokuhlangenwe Nakho Umoya, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ungumqondo ongenakubalwa, ophathelene nokuhlangenwe nakho komuntu, izinzwa, nemizwa. Umoya ungabhekwa njengokuxhumana komuntu nomhlaba, nemvelo, kanye nezinto ezingaphezu kwemvelo. Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ekutheni umoya unethonya elikhulu empilweni yabo, futhi lokhu kuthonywa kungaba kuhle noma kubi, kuye ngokuthi umuntu ubhekana nani. Umoya ungatholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengemvelo, ezindaweni zokukhulekela, noma ngisho nasezindaweni ezijwayelekile. Abantu bahlala befuna ukuxhumana nomoya, bephendukela ezikhathini zokuzindla, imikhuba yokukhuleka, noma izifundo ezithile ezithinta umoya. Lokhu kuhlanganyela nomoya kuholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe behlangene, bephila impilo enenjongo, futhi bejabule. Ubudlelwano Phakathi Kwenkolo Nomoya Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolo nomoya bukhombisa ukuthi lezi zinto azihlukanisiwe, kodwa zixhumene kakhulu. Inkolo ivame ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukholelwa komoya, kanti umoya unikeza impilo enembile ezinkolweni. Lokhu kubonakala ezinkolweni eziningi, lapho izinkolelo zomoya zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo ethokozisayo, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Isibonelo, ezinkolweni eziningi, umoya uthathwa njengomthombo wamandla, futhi abantu bahlala befuna ukuwuhlonipha. Lokhu kubonakala ezimisweni zokukhulekela, lapho abantu bencenga umoya ukuze ubasize, ubakhanyisele, noma ubavikele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umoya ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana nezinkolelo, lapho abantu bezama ukuqonda izimfundiso ezinzima, futhi bahlola izindlela zokuphila ezihambisana nezinkolelo zabo. Umthelela Wenkolo Nomoya Empilweni Yabantu Umthelela wenkolo nomoya empilweni yabantu ungumqondo obanzi, ophathelene nezici eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici zomuntu siqu, ezomphakathi, nezomnotho. Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi inkolo nomoya kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wabo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ezindaweni eziningi, inkolo nomoya zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zokuxhaswa, lapho abantu behlanganyela ukuze basize abanye, noma ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi kubasiza ukuba bahlale bexhumene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umoya unomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu. Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nomoya kubasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile impilo enenjongo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nabantu namuhla. Isiphetho Inkolo nomoya kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yabantu, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umqondo, izimiso, nemikhuba yokuphila. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolo nomoya bukhombisa ukuthi lezi zinto azihlukanisiwe, kodwa zixhumene kakhulu. Umthelela wazo empilweni yomuntu ungumqondo obanzi, ophathelene nezici eziningi, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inkolo nomoya zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, bahloniphe abanye, futhi bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sifunda, sihlola, futhi sikhuthaze lezi zinto empilweni yethu.
Namuhla sikhona eNseleni ukuze sithintane nani ngezindlela esingazisebenzisa ukuvimbela izifo ezingasithinta lapho kungekho isidingo. Le mkhankaso esiyingxenye yayo namuhla ibonisa kahle ukuthi abaholi baleli zwe bayakhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokwanda kwe-TB kuleli. Le mkhankaso, esayiyinayo ngaphambili endaweni yaseMsinga ekuqaleni konyaka, iyalandelwa nathi emzini ophakathi kweDolobha laseThekwini, futhi iphelile ezindaweni zemidlalo zedolobha laseMpumalanga eHammarsdale ekuqaleni kukaAugust. Masicacise ukuthi abahlali balendawo banjengama-130,000, futhi okwamanje, kuphela abangu-700 kubo abavakashele ezikhungweni zethu zokuhlolwa kwe-TB. Njengomnyango, sinezinkinga ezincane zokwelapha bonke laba bantu abathintekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abakhona lapha bazi futhi bakhumbuze labo abangaphumelelanga ukuthi ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwe-TB kwenziwa mahhala. Ukwelapha lowo muntu kusiphatha ngaphezu kuka-R24,000, futhi umuntu ophakathi kwalolu suku angase athole ukuthi uchitha isikhathi eside esibhedlela, kude namalungu omndeni wakhe. Lezi zimpawu zidinga ukuthi uphuthume uye esikhungweni sezempilo ngoba ungakwazi ukusiza empini yokulwa ne-TB. Labo abahlala nomuntu onayo, labo abangakwazi ukunakekela izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu, abantu abahlala ne-HIV, abantu abaphuza utshwala, abantu abasebenzisa imishanguzo, abantu abakhathazekile, kanye nalabo abahlala ezindaweni ezingaventilated kahle baphakathi kwezingozi eziphezulu. Labo abathatha ama-ARVs kufanele bazi ukuthi imishanguzo ye-TB ayithinti amaphilisi abo. Ukuhluka ukuthi ukwelashwa kwe-TB kuhlala izinyanga eziyisithupha kanti ama-ARVs athathwa impilo yakho yonke. Khumbula, ungathola ne-TB uma uhlala nomuntu onayo, futhi ungakwazi ukunakekela. Njengomnyango wezempilo, siyazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi udle ukudla okunempilo ukuze uhlale unempilo. Sazi futhi ukuthi awukwazi ukumelana nemishanguzo ngaphandle kokudla okuthile esiswini sakho, yingakho sabelana ngezikhwama zokudla kulabo abathintekayo. Umphakathi usisekela ngokuphelele njengoba siphinde siye emhlabeni; yingakho nginazo lezi zinsiza zokulima. Impilo kufanele isetshenziswe.
Ubuhle Bemvelo: Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Ndlovu UThandiwe Ndlovu, ophuma emphakathini waseMpumalanga, ungumfazi ophilela imvelo, onothando, futhi ohlonipha konke okukhona emhlabeni. Uthandiwe, odabuka emndenini ophilayo ngokuhlonipha imvelo, ukhombisa uthando olujulile ngezinto eziphilayo. Uthanda ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinhle, lapho athola khona ukuthula nokubona ubuhle bendalo. Uthando lukaThandiwe lwemvelo luqala ngesikhathi esencane, lapho akhumbula khona izinsuku ezishisayo emaphandleni, ebuka izinyoni ezibhalela izinkanyezi emoyeni. Imvelo yaba yikhaya lakhe, futhi uThandiwe wayejabulela amaqabunga ahlaza, izimbali ezizimele, nezinyoni ezihamba phansi. Lezi zinto zaziyizikhumbuzo ezinhle, zikhumbuza ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi kanye nezinguquko zemvelo. Njengoba eminyakeni edlule, uThandiwe waqhubeka nokuhlola imvelo, efunda ngayo ngendlela ehlukile. Uthanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezindaweni ezihlanzekile, efuna ukuzwa izwi lemvelo. Izinyoni ezihamba phansi, umoya opholile, nezihlahla ezinkulu zihlala zikhumbuza uThandiwe ukuthi imvelo iyisisekelo sokuphila. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuvikela imvelo, eqhuba imikhankaso yokufundisa abantu ngokuqonda nokuhlonipha imvelo. UThandiwe ungumfundi onothando lokuthuthukisa ulwazi lwakhe ngemvelo. Uthanda ukufunda izincwadi eziphathelene nemvelo, ezimfundisa ngempilo yezinyoni, izitshalo, nezilwane. Ubuye abe neqhaza ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokuhlola imvelo, ezihlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze bazihlanganise nemvelo. Uhlanga lwezinyoni, izitshalo, nezilwane zikhombisa ubuhle obungapheli, futhi uThandiwe uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yalokho. UThandiwe ubonisa indlela yokuphila ehlonipha imvelo. Ubuye abe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini, efundisa abantu ukuthi imvelo iyinsika yokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe uqhubeka nokufundisa abanye ngothando nemvelo, ethokozisa abanye ngezikhathi ezinhle. Ubuhle bemvelo buhlale bukhanya emhlabeni wakhe, futhi uThandiwe uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yemvelo.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ingxoxo NoMnu. Zulu, Umphakathi Wokuphendula Eziphuthumayo Umhleli: Sanibonani, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha ukuze sixoxe ngendaba ebalulekile yokuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ungabelana ngombono wakho ngalolu daba? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, umhleli. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile kakhulu. Izimo eziphuthumayo, njengezinhlekelele zemvelo, izifo ezibulalayo, noma izimo zokuphila, zidinga izinhlelo ezibambekayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela kahle, ukuqeqesha abantu, kanye nokuxhumana ngendlela efanele. Umhleli: Lokhu kuhle, kodwa ungakuchaza kabanzi ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe lesi sikhathi sokuphendula? Mnu. Zulu: Impela. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, nezokuphepha kumele zisebenzisane. Ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha, kudinga ukuhlolwa kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuxhumana, kanye nokuba nezinhlelo ezicacile. Umhleli: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo ezithile zendlela lezi zinyathelo ezisebenza ngayo? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ngithanda ukufaka isibonelo seMphakathi Wokuphendula Eziphuthumayo eGoli. Lapha, sithuthukise uhlelo lokuxhumana olusebenzayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Sihlele imihlangano yokubambisana evamile, lapho abaholi bezikhungo bahlola khona izinhlelo zabo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo, wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uzothatha isinyathelo esithile. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyindlela ephumelelayo. Kodwa, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele. Ucabanga ukuthi imithombo yokuxhasa ibalulekile? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, imithombo yokuxhasa ibalulekile. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele, kungaba ngezinsiza zezimali, abantu abaqeqeshiwe, noma izinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi eziphusile. Umhleli: Ngabe ukhona umbono wakho mayelana nokuthi abantu bangakwazi kanjani ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinhlelo? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu. Ukuze sibe nezinhlaka eziphumelelayo, abantu kufanele baqeqeshwe futhi bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphendula. Kubalulekile futhi ukubandakanya umphakathi, ukuze abantu bazi izinhlelo zokuzivikela, bahlale beqaphele izingozi, futhi bazi ukuthi kumele benze kanjani uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo. Umhleli: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu. Ngabe unayo imiphumela ethile yokuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, imiphumela ibonakala ngokushesha. Uma sithuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula, izinga lokuphila komphakathi liphucukile. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezingozi, ukunciphisa ukulimala, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Futhi, uma umphakathi uzwa ukuthi uhlinzekwa kahle, kuba nokwethenjelwa okukhulu ezikhungweni ezithintekayo. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinzuzo enkulu. Ngabe unayo imiyalelo ethile kubaphathi bezikhungo eziphuthumayo? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ngincoma abaphathi ukuthi bahlale beqaphile futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zihlala zisesikhathini. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo, ukuhlela imihlangano, nokuxhumana nabantu. Futhi, kufanele bahlale beqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi benzeni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngalezi zinkulumo ezibalulekile. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubafundi bethu? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphele, bazi ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuxhumana. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe necebo eliqinile lokuphendula ukuze sikwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kuyisihloko esibalulekile, futhi izeluleko zakho zizoba usizo olukhulu. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, umhleli. Ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zifundo ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu.
Ama-Amapiano: Uhambo Lwezinguquko Nezintuthuko Emculweni. Ama-Amapiano abhalisela umlando ophawulekayo, adumile emhlabeni, futhi aqhubeka nokukhula. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko zomculo, kufanele sibuyele emuva ezinsukwini lapho la magama aqala khona. I-Amapiano, igama elihlanganisa izitayela eziningi, yaziwa njengenhlobo yomculo ophuma eNingizimu Afrika. Izimpande zayo ziqala ezikhathini zokuqala zekhulu leminyaka, lapho umculo we-house uqala ukuthandwa. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene, ama-Amapiano ahlukaniswa njengohlobo oluhlukile, olunezici ezinzima ze-bass, izigubhu ezimnandi, kanye nezimvumi ezikhangayo. Ukuqala kwama-Amapiano kwenzeka eminyakeni yama-2010, lapho abaculi abanjengo DJ Maphorisa, Kabza De Small, no-Vinny beqala ukukhipha imisebenzi ethokozisayo, behlola izihloko ezifana nempilo, uthando, nezinsuku zansuku. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ophilayo, owenze abantu bajabule. Lokhu kwaba yinsika yokwazisa abathandi bomculo ngalesi sikhathi esisha. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, ama-Amapiano aqhubekile nokukhula, abe yinsika ebalulekile emakhaya ama-Afrika. Ukuhamba phambili kwawo kuholele ekuxhumaneni nezinye izinhlobo zomculo, njengemizwelo ye-gospel, i-jazz, ne-kwaito, okwakha imisebenzi emisha ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ogcwele injabulo, okwazi ukudansa abantu ezikhathini eziningi. Njengoba ama-Amapiano ekhula, abantu basemakhaya nabafudukela emadolobheni baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zindlela zokuphila ukuze baphile izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholele emicimbini emikhulu, lapho abantu behlangana, behudulela izinyathelo, behlanganyela imizwa futhi bejabulela ubudlelwane. Lokhu kwenza ama-Amapiano abe ngumculo odumile, kanti izinkanyezi ezivela kulo mkhuba zandisa umphakathi, zikhombisa izindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Ukwanda kwama-Amapiano akuphezu komculo kuphela, kodwa kukhombisa nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Abaculi abavela kwezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi eZimbabwe, eZambia, naseBotswana, baqala ukuvuselela ama-Amapiano, behlanganisa izitayela zabo zomculo ukuze bakhe umculo ophathekayo, ohambisana nezimo zabo. Lokhu kwenza ama-Amapiano abe yinkanyezi yokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamazwe. Eminyakeni edlule, ama-Amapiano aqhubeke nokukhula emhlabeni jikelele, futhi abaculi abasha baqala ukuveza imisebenzi emisha, behlanganisa ama-Amapiano nezitayela ezahlukene, okwenza umculo uthokozise abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokujabula, lapho abantu bekwazi ukujabulela iziphuzo, ukudla, nokuhlanganyela ngezindlela ezihlukene. Njengoba ama-Amapiano eqhubeka nokukhula, aqhubeka nokubamba abalandeli abaningi, abathanda umculo, nezizukulwane ezintsha. Lokhu kusikhumbuza ukuthi umculo uhlanganisa abantu, ubasukela ezimpilweni zabo, ubakhiphe emithini yobuhlungu, futhi ubathokozise. Ama-Amapiano akhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokuzijabulisa, yokukhumbula, kanye nendlela yokuthokozisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-Amapiano azogcina engumkhiqizo oholayo, usetshenziswa emicimbini emikhulu, ezinkundleni, nakwezinye izindawo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzovumela umculo ukugcina ubukhona bawo, nokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-Amapiano, sikhuluma ngempilo, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umculo ungaphezulu kwekhono lokudansa; ungumkhiqizo wezifiso, izifundo, kanye nemizwa esishukumisayo. Ama-Amapiano akhuthaza umculo, avusa umoya wokubambisana, nokuhlanganyela, futhi azoba yingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko nezenzakalo ezizayo, aqhubeke nokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu, futhi agcine engumthombo wokujabula nempilo.
Uma uqala ukulima, kusho ukuthi usenkampanini, ngakho kufanele uqoqe ulwazi mayelana nezinto ezichaza isimo sakho. Kuzofika isikhathi lapho uzodinga imali, bese uya ebhange noma kwenye indawo ukuyoboleka imali. Lezi zindawo zidinga ulwazi oluningi mayelana nesimo sakho kanye nesimo sebhizinisi lakho. Ngezansi kukhona amatafula anemininingwane yezinto ezizodingeka (kufanele kube nekhophi ye I.D. yakho kanye nekhophi ye I.D. yomkakho). Lokhu kubalulekile. Ngaso sonke isikhathi nikeza ulwazi mayelana nalezi zinto: lapho wazalwa khona, nini, lapho ukhulele khona, ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi uqale ukufisa ukulima. Lokhu kungasiza lapho uya ezifundweni ngoba bazokwazi ukukhuluma ulimi oluhambisana nawe. Khumbula ukuthi ukulima kudinga ukunakwa kwakho nsuku zonke nangasikhathi sonke. Uma unomfuno oqinile wokulima, kufanele ube khona epulazini lakho ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kuthiwa "amehlo omqashi akhuthaza isilwane," futhi "ukufaka okungcono kakhulu yizinyathelo zomkhiqizi emhlabeni." Ukulima kuhlobene nezinto eziphilayo, izitshalo - zidinga ukunakwa okuqhubekayo. Ingabe uhlala epulazini lapho ulima khona?
Kukhona ingxenye yale ncwadi engakwazi ukukhishwa noma ukudluliselwa nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngabe yisiphi isizathu ngaphandle kokuthola imvume edingekayo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe. Umthetho - 3: Umngane noma abalingani, kanye nezizukulwane.. Ngemuva kokungabi khona kwesivumelwano sokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, umthetho we-Intestate Succession Act No. 81, owawusungulwa ngoMashi 18, 1988, ulawula ukusabalalisa impahla (ngokugcwele noma ngengxenye) ngalolo suku noma ngemuva kosuku oluhambelanayo. a Uma umufi engakakhombisi ukuthi impahla yakhe kufanele ihlukaniswe kanjani ngesiqinisekiso noma ngesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi komshado; noma b Lapho kungenzeka ukufezekisa izifiso zomufi ngoba abaphumelelayo, ngokwesibonelo, bahluleka ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala noma abakhombisi isifiso sokuhlala noma bafa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kungenzeka ukuthi umuntu afe ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye engafunwa. Isibonelo salokhu yileso lapho umtshali wezimali ethula ingxenye ethile yephahla esivumelwaneni esiqinisekisiwe kodwa engakhulumi ngempahla esele. Kulokhu, ingxenye enikezwe isivumelwano izohlukanisa impahla ngokuhambisana nokucabangela noma yiziphi izimo ezitholakala esivumelwaneni, kanti impahla esele izohlukaniswa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-Intestate Succession Act. Ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwesinqumo ku-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, I-Case No. 49/03, eyethulwe kwiNkantolo yeZomthetho ngo-Okthoba 15, 2004, izinhlinzeko ze-Intestate Succession Act zazingenakufaneleka kubantu abamnyama abafa ngaphandle kwesivumelwano futhi bashadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Isinqumo ku-Bhe saguqula lokhu; manje impahla yabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma isiko, abafa ngaphandle kwesivumelwano, izophathwa yi-Intestate Succession Act njengoba kuhlelwe ku-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngezinhlinzeko ze-Intestate Succession Act, kubalulekile ukuchaza ezinye izimiso ezibalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izinhlinzeko. Ngokuqondene nezincazelo ezilandelayo, "stirpes" kusho ingane ephilayo yomufi noma ingane eyafela phambilini emelelwa yizizukulwane. Ingane eyafela phambilini yomufi enezizukulwane eziphilayo eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ibonisa kuphela i-stirpes eyodwa. Ukumeleka kwenzeka uma umphakathi ofanele engakwazi noma engafuni ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala, kuthathwa ngelinye noma ngaphezulu kwezizukulwane. Esibonelweni esingenhla, u-D no-F bazomela ingane eyafela phambilini yomufi. Ngemuva kwesigaba (f) se-Intestate Succession Act ka-1987 njengoba kuguqulwe ngesinqumo ku-Bhe, ingxenye yengane ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani eliphelele lempahla ngenani le-stirpes zomufi (okukhuluma ngenani lezingane eziphilayo zomufi noma lezo ezafela ngaphambi kwakhe ezisaphila ezizukulwaneni) kanye nenani labashadikazi abaphilayo bomufi. Ake sithi inani eliphelele lempahla yomufi ngu-R500,000 futhi unezingane ezimbili eziphilayo nezifuba ezimbili zomthetho. R100,000. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye yengane izoba ngu-R100,000. Ngokwesigaba 1(d) se-Intestate Succession Act, izinga lobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bomndeni bomufi kanye nomufi lingahlukaniswa laba ngamaphuzu amabili, okungukuthi izinga lobudlelwano ekwehlukaneni okuqondile kanye nezinga lobudlelwano ekwehlukaneni okungaqondile. Ekwehlukaneni okuqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lilingana nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kwabazali nomufi noma isizukulwane nomufi (njengoba kumile). Ekwehlukaneni okungaqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lilingana nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kobudlelwano bobulili kanye nezizukulwane eziseduze ezihlobene nazo zonke, kanye nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kwabazali bomufi. Ukwabiwa kwempahla ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987 kungafingqwa emigomeni eyisishiyagalolunye. Uma umufi eshiya umngane noma abalingani, kodwa engenazizukulwane - umngane noma abalingani bangabaphumelelayo kuphela. Endabeni lapho umufi engumfazi emshadweni wesiko onabafazi abaningi, abalingani abaphilayo bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Umngane ophilayo ungumphumelelayo kuphela ngaphansi kwe-Intestate Succession Act, kungakhathaliseki inani lempahla. Uma abalingani bashadile emphakathini wezimpahla, umngane ophilayo uzothola ingxenye eyodwa ngokuhambisana nomshado wabo emphakathini wezimpahla kanye nenye ingxenye ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Uma abalingani bashadile ngaphandle kwemiphakathi yezimpahla, umngane ophilayo uzothola yonke impahla ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. A & B = abazali bomufi; E = umufi; C no-D = abalingani emshadweni wesiko womufi. Ngokwesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987, njengoba kaguqulwa yiNkantolo yeZomthetho esinqumweni se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, abalingani ababili bomufi (C no-D) bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo, ngaphandle kokubandakanya omunye umndeni. Uma umufi ethokoziswa ngababazi abangaphezu kwababili ngaphansi komthetho wesiko futhi engashiyi izizukulwane, khona-ke bonke abashadikazi bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Uma umufi engashiyi umngane kodwa eshiya izizukulwane - izizukulwane zifaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla njenge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuyavunyelwa. Izingane zomufi, u-D, E, no-F bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Njengoba u-E efa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, izizukulwane zakhe, u-J no-K bazomela yena futhi bafake isicelo sokuhlala impahla yakhe ngokulinganayo. Zonke izingane zomufi zinegunya lokuhlala. Akukhathalekile ukuthi zikhule emshadweni wezimali, wesiko, noma ukuthi zikhule ngaphandle komshado. Ngokwesigaba 1 se-Intestate Succession Act, abaphumelelayo be-intestate abalahlekelwa amalungelo abo okuhlala empahleni yomufi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esivela ebudlelwaneni bobulili. Uma umufi eshiya umngane noma abalingani nezizukulwane - umngane noma abalingani bazothola ingxenye enkulu ka-R125,000 ngayinye noma ingxenye yezingane, kanti izizukulwane zizothola impahla esele, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi noma yiziphi izizukulwane zikhona. Uma inani eliphelele lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, umngane ophilayo, esibonelweni esingenhla, (S) uzothola yonke impahla, kuhlanganise nezingane nabanye abomndeni. Uma umufi engumfazi oshadile nabafazi abaningi futhi kukhona abanye abafazi abaphilayo, futhi inani lempahla lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, khona-ke abalingani abaphilayo bazokwabiwa inani elisele ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezingane nabanye abomndeni. Uma inani elisele lempahla lidlula u-R125,000, umngane uzothola u-R125
Noma nini uma umsebenzi ubandakanyeka engozini ephathelene nomsebenzi wabo engaziwa, le ngozi ingaholela ekulimazweni noma ekufeni. Noma nini uma umsebenzi ebika ukulimala kwabo kumqashi wabo, uma ngesikhathi sokubika bephawula ukuthi le ngozi yenzeka ngenxa yomsebenzi ongaziwa. Uma le ngozi iholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokuzizwa, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba futhi lapho umuntu olimele ebhekwa njengongenakusebenza okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14, umphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza kufanele futhi aziswe ngokuphuthumayo ngefeksi noma ngefoni. Qedela "Ingxenye A" yekhasi lokuqala le fomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele, ubhale igama, futhi ufake usuku lapho kukhonjiswa khona. Susa "Ingxenye B" efana kakhulu ne "Ingxenye A" ekhasini 1 ngokuyikweleta lapho kunezikhala, nikeza umsebenzi "Ingxenye B" bese umcela ukuthi ayinikeze kudokotela noma esibhedlela lapho baphathwa khona. Ezigamekweni ezinzima, "Ingxenye B" kufanele ithunyelwe kudokotela noma esibhedlela ngokushesha. Qedela "Ingxenye A" ekhasini lesibili le fomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele lapho. Thumela umbiko ophelele we-engozi kanye neMbiko Yezokwelapha Yokuqala W.CI. Qedela ifomu elisha mayelana nomsebenzi olimele. Le fomu akufanele ibambezeleke ngoba kulindeleke ukuthi umsebenzi uqale ukusebenza noma imibiko evela kudokotela ilindelwe. Umqashi ongaphenduli ngengozi kwiKomidi Lokukhokha usebenzisa le fomu ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 uzobhekwa njengonobungozi ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokukhokha Wezingozi Zomsebenzi Nezifo zika-1933, futhi angase abhekane nezindleko eziphelele zokukhokha eziphathelene nale ngozi. Umqashi ongaphenduli kumphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza ngefoni noma ngefeksi ngengozi eyaholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokuzizwa, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba noma isimo lapho umsebenzi engakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo izinsuku eziyi-14 uzotholwa njengonobungozi ngaphansi kweMthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha ka-1993. Kufanele usebenzise ifomu elifanele ukuveza izifo ezitholakele ngenxa yomsebenzi owenziwayo W.CL.1. Uma umsebenzi olimele eyeka ukusebenza, gcina irekhodi le-adresi lapho angatholakala khona ukuze usize ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali evela kwiFundo Yokukhokha okufanele ikhokhwe ibanjwe kuye. Qedela ifomu elibhalwe ngamagama amakhulu futhi uphakamise (X) ezindaweni ezifanele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mbiko yokulimala ethi yenzeke emsebenzini, ngokwazi kwami, iyiqiniso.
