Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-podcast aseNingizimu Afrika abe yinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokuzijabulisa. Lezi zinhlelo zokulalelwayo, ezivame ukwenziwa ngabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, zikhombisa ukukhula okukhulu, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayazithokozela futhi bayazifuna lezi zinhlelo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izizathu eziholela ekukhuleni kwama-podcast, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nezifundo ezitholakala kulokhu kuthuthuka. Okokuqala, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubona ama-podcast njengendlela yokuxhumana ngezinto ezibalulekile. Njengoba abantu bethola ithuba lokukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta impilo yabo, izinkinga zomphakathi, nezindaba zomnotho, ama-podcast akha indawo yokuxoxa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu babelane ngemicabango nemibono yabo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baxoxe ngezindaba ezibucayi. Okwesibili, ukwanda kwezobuchwepheshe nezinsiza zokulalela ama-podcast kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni kwama-podcast. Njengoba abantu bethola ukufinyelela kalula kumadivayisi afana namafoni, ama-tablet, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, kulula kakhulu ukuwathola ama-podcast. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila nezindaba ezintsha, bephendula ezimweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukusabalalisa ama-podcast, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba babelane ngama-podcast abawathandayo nabanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izihloko ezithinta ubuciko, ezemidlalo, ezempilo, nezokwakha. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bejolise ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yabo, futhi ama-podcast anikeza izixazululo, izeluleko, kanye nezifundo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza ama-podcast abe yinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi nolwazi. Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika akukhona kuphela ngenxa yokutholakala kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu. Abantu abaningi baveza izindaba zabo, izifundo, kanye nemicabango yabo kumama-podcast, okwenza kube lula kubanye ukuba bafunde futhi bakhule. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast akhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ezimweni ezinzima. Njengoba abantu bephila emhlabeni ogcwele izinselelo, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa ngezinto ezinzima, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu babone ukuthi abakhulumi bodwa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda ngezinto ezintsha, izindlela zokuphila, nezindlela zokwenza izinto ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezivela kubantu abanolwazi, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhule futhi bathole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuhlobene nendlela ama-podcast akhuthaza ngayo ukufunda okuqhubekayo, okubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kodwa-ke, ukukhula kwama-podcast akukhona ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Njengoba abantu bephendula ezindleleni ezahlukene, kunezinto ezithile ezidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinselelo zokuhlonza ama-podcast aphumelelayo, njengoba kunezinketho eziningi ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga abantu ukuba bahlale bephendula futhi bahlolisise ama-podcast ukuze bathole lezo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuhweba zikhona. Njengoba ama-podcast eqhubeka nokukhula, abenzi bama-podcast badinga ukuthola izindlela zokwenza imali. Lokhu kudinga ukucabanga ngendlela yokuhlanganisa izikhangiso, izixazululo zokubambisana, noma ezinye izindlela zokuthola imali. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze ama-podcast akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ekugcineni, ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayafuna izindlela zokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana. Njengoba ama-podcast eqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi abenzi bama-podcast bahlale bephendula ezindleleni ezahlukene, ukuze baqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngama-podcast anekhwalithi ephezulu. Ngakho-ke, uma ubheka ukuhamba phambili kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhona ukuze zixhumane, zifundise, futhi zikhuthaze abantu. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-podcast awukuphela kwezindlela zokuxhumana, kodwa ziwusizo olukhulu empilweni yethu. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokulalela, ukufunda, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile.
Isithombe 1: Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma ushaya ummbila ngamakhemikhali ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Isithombe 2: Qiniseka ukuthi ushaya amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele. Amakhemikhali asetshenziselwa ezolimo angalimaza kakhulu izitshalo zakho uma engafakwa ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nangokucophelela. Ukulandela izinyathelo ezifanele uma uthenga futhi ufaka amakhemikhali kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukulimala kwezitshalo zakho. Ingabe kukhona ikhemikhali ethile ebhaliswe ukuze ifakwe emasimini athile (lapha eNingizimu Afrika) futhi ukuze ibulale izitshalo ezithile noma izifo ezithile? Ingabe ufake inani elifanele lekhemikhali ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo? Ingabe isimo sezulu ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuphuma kuhambisana nemiyalelo? Ingabe isikhathi sokufaka ikhemikhali sihamba kahle nemiyalelo, ngokwesibonelo: ekuseni noma ntambama? Ingabe isimo sehlathi lapho ifakwe sifeza izidingo zekhemikhali, ngokwesibonelo: umswakama nohlobo lomhlabathi? Ingabe ikhemikhali efakiwe ihambisana nemiyalelo mayelana nosayizi wezitshalo ofuna ukuzibulala? Imiphumela - ikhemikhali oyifakile akufanele ilimele ezinye izitshalo uma ushintsha izitshalo minyaka yonke - ingabe ngeke ibulale izitshalo zokudla ozohlela ukuzitshala unyaka ozayo? Ikhemikhali oyisebenzisayo ingahlanganiswa namanye amakhemikhali noma cha - ngokwesibonelo: ukuhlanganisa i-herbicide ethile namanye amakhemikhali abulala izinsongo nezifo? Imiyalelo yokufaka ikhemikhali kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi isayinwe ngumfaki. Abalimi kufanele babe nenhlonipho uma beshaya amakhemikhali ngoba amakhemikhali angahamba. Kungaba nesixwayiso esikhulu ezitshalo eziseduze ezingalimala ngamakhimikali. Kubalulekile ukuthi amakhemikhali angathinti ukudla. Ukufaka amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele nokugcina amarekhodi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudla kuhlala kuphephile.
Isaziso sikhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c), (e), (h) kanye (i) soMthetho Wezobuchwepheshe Bezempilo (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004) ("okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho"), sisho ukuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uyamenywa abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abazobekwa njengezithunywa zeBhodi Yesikhashana Yezempilo (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "iBhodi"). Isigaba 7 soMthetho sisho ukuthi iBhodi izokwakhiwa ngamalungu angama-22 abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. Isigaba h sesigaba 7 soMthetho sisho ukuthi abantu abathathu abamele umphakathi kumele babekwe njengezithunywa zeBhodi; kanti isigaba i sesigaba 7 sisho ukuthi ummember owodwa kumele abekwe emkhakheni wezempilo ngamunye, okungukuthi: umthandazi, umphakathi wezokwelapha ngempahla yemvelo, kanye nodokotela. Umuntu obekwe njengezithunywa zeBhodi ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(c) kanye (i) zoMthetho kumele ube sebenza njengochwepheshe bezempilo okungenani iminyaka engu-5 emkhakheni wezempilo ofanele. Iziphakamiso zabantu abazobekwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c) zoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma ilungu leBhodi elibhekelele ezempilo esifundeni lapho umphakathi usebenza khona, ngokukhethekile. Iziphakamiso zabantu abazobekwa ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(e), (h) kanye (i) zoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Iziphakamiso kumele zithunyelwe ngendlela echazwe emqulwini ofakwe ohlobene nokubekwa kwamalungu eBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho.
Omphefumulo wesifazane ophakathi kwezobulungiswa uthole imali ephelele eyasuswa emalini yakhe yokuthola umhlalaphansi njengengxenye yokuhlanganiswa kwezikweletu zomnyango. Umprotector womphakathi uLawrence Mushwana uncome ukuthi ummangali abuyiselwe le mali kanye nenzalo, ebaliwe kusukela ngosuku lokuthi kwenziwa ukususa. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemuva kokuhlolwa kweHhovisi leMphakathi Protector kwatholakala ukuthi inqubo echazwe kuMqulu Womhlalaphansi Wabasebenzi Bakahulumeni (GEPF) yokuhlanganisa izikweletu zomnyango ngokweSahluko 21 soMthetho Womhlalaphansi Wabasebenzi Bakahulumeni ka-1996 (GEPF Act) ayilandeliwe. Kutholakala futhi ukuthi isinqumo sokubuyisela izimali zomnyango emalini yokuthola umhlalaphansi yommangali asihambisani nezidingo zeSahluko 3 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukuhlela Kwezokuphatha ka-2000 futhi ngakho "kwenziwe ngokuphambene nenqubo." Umkhulumeli weNdlu YezamaPhalamende wacelwa ukuba athathe izinyathelo ngokumelene noNgqongqoshe Osenhliziyweni Yezangaphakathi, uMalusi Gigaba, ngokungahambisani nezibopho zakhe zomthethosisekelo zokubambisana neHhovisi leMphakathi Protector. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemuva kokuthi uMnu. Gigaba ehluleka ukubambisana ne-OPP ekuhloleni izinsolo zokuthi uthumele izimbali kumkakhe ngezindleko zendawo futhi akhokhe amathikithi nezokuthutha kwabanye abantu ngezikhathi eziningi. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uMprotector womphakathi uLawrence Mushwana uncome ukuthi umkhulumeli athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwehluleka kukaMnu. Gigaba kulungiswa. Nakuba ukuhlola kuthole ukuthi izindleko ezithathwe ihhovisi likaMnu. Gigaba mayelana nezimbali ezithunyelwe kumkakhe zazingafaneleki, zange zibe nomphumela omuhle, futhi zaziphuma emalini, kutholakala futhi ukuthi izinsolo eziphathelene nezindleko zokuhamba ezithathwe ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe zazingekho. U-Advocate Mushwana uphinde wancome ukuthi uMphakathi-Jikelele woMnyango, uMavuso Msimang, athuthukise izindlela zokuphatha ezimali ehhovisi likaMnu. Gigaba. IKomidi Lezabasebenzi lePhalamende elibhekelela amandla kufanele lilandele futhi libike njalo futhi libuyisele ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphakanyisiwe yiNhlangano Yezamandla YaseNingizimu Afrika (NERSA) ngoMeyi 2008 ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwezinkinga zokushoda kukagesi. Uhlelo lokuphakamisa ukuthi kungabikho izinguquko ezenziwayo ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwangaphambilini okuqale iHhovisi mayelana nezimo zokushoda kukagesi nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ugesi ngumnikazi wombuso, u-Eskom, umprotector womphakathi wacela uMphakathi weNdlu YezamaPhalamende ukuba athathe izinyathelo mayelana nalokhu. Ingxenye enkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekane nokushoda kukagesi nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ngenxa yokukhishwa kwezinsiza kusukela ngoJanuwari 2007 kuze kube nguFebhuwari 2008. "Imiphumela nezinsizakalo eziphakanyisiwe zalesi sihlolo zikhombisa ukuthi kube nokulibaziseka ngakolunye uhlangothi kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni amandla okukhiqiza ugesi kwe-Eskom ngenkathi futhi kunikezwa izixolelo zomphakathi mayelana nezinkinga ezidalwe ukukhishwa kwezinsiza," kusho u-Advocate Mushwana. Uthe i-NERSA, njengomphakathi ophathisa imithetho eqinile ethuthukiswe nguMthetho Wokulawula ugesi ka-2006, inamandla namandla okuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe embikweni wayo zifezekiswa futhi ukuthi i-Eskom ihambisana nezimo zelayisensi yayo nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho.
Ekhaya elincane eliseNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, kwakukhona isikole esincane sika "Isizotha Primary School." Lesi sikole sasingaphansi kwezintaba ezimhlophe, sikhula phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene, lapho isiZulu nesiNgisi kwakungamakhaya ezilimi eziningi. Abafundi be-Isizotha babenhlobonhlobo, behlanganyela izilimi ezahlukene ezikhuluma ezindlini zabo. UThandi, umfundi ophumelelayo, wayekhuluma isiZulu ekhaya, kodwa esikoleni, wayefunda isiNgisi. Lokhu kumjabulisa, ngoba wayeziqhenya ngamasiko akhe, kodwa wayefuna ukufunda isiNgisi kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni. Ngelinye ilanga, uthisha uMsizi, owayenothando lokufundisa, wanquma ukuthi kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwezilimi. Wafuna ukwenza umcimbi wokuhlanganyela, lapho abafundi bengahlanganyela khona izinhlelo zabo zokufunda, bezokhuluma ngezindlela ezahlukene zokufunda isiNgisi nesiZulu. Umcimbi wawuhlelwe kahle, futhi wonke umfundi wathokozisa. UThandi wathola ithuba lokukhuluma phambi kwezigidi zabafundi, wabelana ngendaba yakhe yokufunda isiNgisi. Wathi: "Ngesikhathi ngiqala ukufunda isiNgisi, ngazizwa ngingekho. Kodwa ngafunda ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje ukwazi ukukhuluma, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabanye abantu." Umfundi omncane, uSipho, waphakamisa isandla, wathi: "Ngiyavuma, Thandi! Ngithanda isiZulu, kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngifunda isiNgisi, ngizokwazi ukubona umhlaba omkhulu." Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla phakathi kwabafundi, njengoba bonke bejabulela ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene. Uthisha uMsizi waphinde wanikeza abafundi ithuba lokubhala izinkanyezi ezincane ngesiZulu nesiNgisi, ukuze baveze imicabango yabo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwazisa izilimi zabo, futhi kwavula iminyango emisha yokufunda. Abafundi babebhalela izinkanyezi ezimnandi, bejabulisa izilimi zabo, futhi bezwakalisa izifiso zabo. Ngemuva kwemicimbi eminingi, abafundi baqala ukujabulisa ukufunda isiNgisi. UThandi, uSipho, noMaya, bonke baphumelela emaphoyiseni abawafundile. UThandi waphumelela emqhudelwaneni wokubhala, lapho abhalela izinkanyezi ezinhle ngesiNgisi. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje ukuphumelela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uthisha uMsizi waba nesifiso sokwenza isikole sibe yindawo yokufunda izilimi eziningi. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo ezikhethekile, lapho abafundi bengafunda izilimi ezahlukene, bahlola izincwadi, futhi baxhumana nabantu abakhuluma lezi zilimi. Lokhu kwakhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nezinhloso eziphakeme, futhi baphokophele ukufunda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqala ukuhamba emiphakathini, befundisa abanye abantu isiNgisi. Bafunda ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje ukufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Abafundi bahlala bejabulile, behlanganyela emicimbini yokufunda, futhi bezwakalisa izilimi zabo. Ekugcineni, uMsizi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona, bezokhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Uthisha waphinde wathola umklomelo wokuba uthisha ophumelelayo, futhi bonke abafundi baphakamisela uMsizi izandla, bebonga umsebenzi wakhe omuhle. UThandi, uSipho, noMaya bahlala bejabulile, bazi ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi kwavula iminyango emisha. Bafunda ukuthi izilimi azikhulumi nje, kodwa zihlala zixhumanisa abantu, zenza umhlaba ube yindawo engcono. Ngale ndlela, isikole se-Isizotha sahlala sikhula, sithokozisa izilimi eziningi, futhi sakhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphokophele phambili, bejabulisa izilimi zabo. Uthando lokufunda lwalukhona, futhi abafundi babefunda ukuthi izilimi eziningi zikhona ukuze zixhumanise abantu, zikhuthaze ubuhlobo, futhi zikhulise umphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqonda ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Futhi, le ndaba yaphenduka isifundo esikhulu sokuthi izilimi eziningi zingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS (GEMS medical information protection) Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe bukhula khona ngezinga elikhulu, ukwazi ukuvikela kolwazi lwethu lwezempilo kuba wumsebenzi obalulekile. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ziza nezidingo ezinkulu zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu lwezempilo. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kweziqubu zempilo, ngithanda ukukhipha umbono mayelana nezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kwi-GEMS. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lungumkhiqizo wokuthula owenza ukuthi sikwazi ukuphila kahle. Lokhu ulwazi lubalulekile, ngoba kudinga ukuvikelwa okubhekiswe ekukhanyeni kwezinto ezimbi ezingase zenzeke uma kudingeka. I-GEMS, njengomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zempilo, ineqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ukuqonda nezinyathelo zokuvikela ulwazi lwabantu. Ukubona ukuthi ulwazi lwazempilo lungagcinwa kanjani, kulindeleke ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siluvikele. Ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngonyaka owedlule, kuboniswe ukuthi abantu abaningi abakuvumeleli ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo luphume ngaphandle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzwelana nokuvikela okungekuhle. I-GEMS, njengephrojekthi ephethwe nguhulumeni, kufanele iqinise amasu ayo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwabathengi luhlala lukhona kuphela ezandleni eziphephile. Lokhu kumele kuhlanganise ukwenza kahle izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha ubuhlobo obusondele phakathi kwabathengi nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Enye yezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kungenzeka ukuthi kube nomsebenzi ophumelelayo wezobuchwepheshe. I-GEMS kufanele igxile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iwufanele futhi ivikelekile. Lokhu kudinga umgomo ophakeme wokuphepha okuhlanganisa ukuqapha okuhlanganyelwe nokuphathwa kwesimo sephepho. Uhlelo lokuphepha kumele lube nezinqubomgomo ezihambisanayo ezinikeza indlela yokuhlonza, ukugwema, nokuphendula ezimweni zengozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukufaka ubuchwepheshe bokuvikela obuhlasela amabutho. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokuphepha kwedatha ezisebenzisana ne-GEMS zingathuthukiswa ukuze kuqhutshekwe phambili imisebenzi yokuvikeleka. Kulolu hlobo, ukusetshenziswa kwemiyalo yokugcina izimfihlo, izinhlelo zokubika, nemisebenzi yokuhlola ingadlala indima enkulu. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwephula umthetho akusona isimo esijwayelekile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu baqonde izinqubo zokuvikela. Lokhu kufanele kube yinsiza elula yokufinyelela, okuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuqonda indlela ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo olunakekelwa ngayo. Ngokusho kohlelo olukhalipha ubuchwepheshe, kungasetshenziswa izinhlelo zokuphendula ezihloniphekile, zibe nomthelela omuhle emizamweni yokuvikela ulwazi lwempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kufanele kube ingxenye ebalulekile yokugcina iso kulwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS kufanele ibe nezinsuku zokuhlola eziningi, ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuvikela ziyasebenza yini. Lokhu kusebenza njengesithunywa ukuze kutholakale iziphakamiso ezithile ezingathuthukisa amasu athile. Ngalokhu, umphakathi ungavuma ukuphatheka ngempela emabangeni okuvikeleka kwempilo yabo. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo akukona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngedatha ephephile, kodwa kube nezimo ezinhle zomkhiqizo ochumi. Uma i-GEMS ikwazi ukugcina ulwazi lwezempilo luyimfihlo, izothola imvume enkulu kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesithombe sokuthi i-GEMS iyinhloko yezeMpilo ezinokuhlala okuphephile. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kudinga ukusebenza okuqinile, okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, imihlahlandlela efanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Sizofakaza kahle ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ukuze umahluko uhlale uphila, kuyilapho singabheki phezulu ukuvikeleka kwempilo yethu. Ngakho, asikhumbule ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo yinsiza ebalulekile, kufanele lukhululeke, kodwa kuphela uma lutholakala ezandleni eziphephile. Siphakamisa i-GEMS nezinye izinhlelo ezizobheka izinqubomgomo eziqondile nezisezingeni eliphezulu zokuvikela ulwazi lwemiphakathi. Ukwakha umuzwa wezimiso ezizothuthukisa ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kusemqoka, futhi kufanele kube ngumphumela wethu sonke. Asiwuqhakambiseni umphakathi wethu, kodwa sigcizelele ekufundiseni ababambiqhaza mayelana nezidingo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS iyindawo eqala imizamo yokwakha ikusasa elinokuphepha nolwazi oluqinisekile lokwenza ngcono impilo yethu somphakathi. Lokhu kuncike kithi, futhi kungenzeka kuphela uma siqaphela izinselelo nokubambisana ekwakheni izinhlelo ezenza umthelela omuhle. Ngakho sizobe siye phambili, siqhubeke nokusela izinyathelo zethu, kuya emhlabeni osembili, lapho suntu sithola ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, siphumelela ngokweqiniso. Ukusiza omunye nomunye empilweni, ukuhlonipha ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezempilo, kuyindlela yokubuyisela. Lokhu kufanele kube yinsizakalo yethu esiyenzayo, ukuze siqhubeke nokukhulisa umphakathi ophephile.
Isithombe 1: Umkhiqizo endaweni ephakathi (evamile) ngo-2008 nango-2009. Abalimi banikeza izizathu ezahlukene zokungasebenzisi ama-hybrids: imbewu ibiza kakhulu, ukuntuleka kwemali ngesikhathi sokutshala, ukungakwazi ukuthola imbewu ye-hybrid, ukuthenga umanyolo, umkhiqizo ophansi, ukungaphumeleli ukukhula ezindaweni zonke, ukufakwa kabi, ukuntuleka kwekhwalithi efanele. Lokhu okukhulunywe ngenhla kuphakamisa umbuzo wokuthi ama-hybrids angcono kunezinhlobo ezivulekile zokupollinate (OPV) kubalimi abaphumelelayo - lapho imbewu ingatholakali kalula, lapho izindleko zokufaka ziphansi, nalapho umkhiqizo uvame ukuba phansi. Umbuzo oqondile uzokhetha uhlobo lwemibewu: ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs yizinkanyezi ezizokwazi ukweseka umlimi ukuba abe nokudla kwesikhathi esizayo futhi axhaswe ngenzuzo eqhubekayo. Imbewu enhle iyisihluthulelo sokutshala nokukhiqiza yonke imikhiqizo yokudla. Zivula umnyango wokukhiqiza yonke imikhiqizo yokudla. Zonke izenzo zokulima ziqondiswe ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo ezisemibewwini etshaliwe. Akukho zenzo zokulima (njengokulima kahle, ukulawula izihlahla, ukufaka umanyolo, nokuphatha izifo) ezingakhuphula umkhiqizo ngaphezu kwekhwalithi yemibewu. Ngakho-ke, yonke imisebenzi yokulima ezoba nomphumela omuhle noma ophansi ihlotshaniswa nemibewu etshaliwe. Ukuze ufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle, kufanele utshale imbewu yekhwalithi enhle. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola imbewu yekhwalithi enhle, kufanele uthenge imbewu eqinisekisiwe - noma ngabe ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs. Imbewu eqinisekisiwe inezinga lokukhula elingafika ku-98% (akukho okungahambi kahle) futhi umkhiqizo wayo ungafinyelela ku-90%. Izindleko zemibewu eqinisekisiwe akufanele zibe yinkinga ekugcineni ngoba uzothola umkhiqizo ophakeme. Abalimi abakhiqiza ezindaweni ezincane noma abalimi bokuphila bahlushwa izinselelo zezimali, bavame ukutshala ummbila osele unyaka owedlule. Uma benza lokhu ngemibewu eseleyo lapho ama-hybrids abekwe khona, umkhiqizo ungashintsha kakhulu (uphakeme kuze kube ngu-50% uma kuqhathaniswa nemibewu emisha). Nokho, uma betshala imbewu eseleyo lapho ama-OPVs abekwe khona, abalahlekelwa umkhiqizo omningi. Yini i-hybrid? I-hybrid ivela lapho izinto ezimbili ezihlukile ngokuphelele (njengabazali abahlukene), enye yowesifazane nenye yowesilisa, zixubana. Ukuvuleka kokupollinate kusho ukuthi isitshalo esisodwa sithatha ipholeni sithole imbewu yaso. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuzalanisa." Lapho ummbila uqhubeka usebenzisa ipholeni yawo, izitshalo nemibewu ekhiqizwayo - izizukulwane - iyalahlekelwa amandla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi - lokhu kubizwa ngama-line aphindwe kabili. Izitshalo ezivela kulezi zixhumanisi eziphindwe kabili zincane, zineziqu ezincane, futhi umkhiqizo wazo uphansi. Nokho, uma umgqa ophindwe kabili uxubana nomgqa ophindwe kabili, amandla abuyiselwa emibewwini ezokhula, futhi umkhiqizo waleyo mitshalo uzokhula. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuphila kwe-hybrid." Kwenzeka lapho ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kwezi line kuhlanganiswa futhi kuhlanganyela. I-hybrid ethile ingakhethwa ngoba inokuqina ezifo, kanti enye ingaba nekhono lokubekezelela ukushoda kwamanzi. Ngokuvamile, ama-hybrids anemikhiqizo edlula leyo ye-OPVs. Ama-hybrids ayafana ngemibala, ukufinyelela, nezinye izici, avumela umlimi ukuthi enze imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye (njengokufaka umanyolo, ukuwasha, nokuvuna). Ukuvumelana kwemigqomo evunyiwe kungaba usizo uma ummbila uthengiswa noma uthengiswa kubathengi abanezimfuneko ezithile zokuhlola. Ama-hybrids ngokuvamile akhiqiza umkhiqizo ophakeme ngama-18% uma kuqhathaniswa nama-OPVs. Umlimi kufanele avune ngaphezu kwamathani amabili ngehektare ukuze akwazi ukuthenga lezi zibhamu ezibizayo. Imbewu emisha kufanele ithengwe minyaka yonke. Imigqomo evunyiwe yonyaka odlule ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengemibewu yonyaka olandelayo. Kungenzeka ukuthi umlimi angatholi imbewu lapho kusasele isikhathi. Ama-hybrids avame ukuhamba kancane uma izimo zezulu nezinye izinto ziba nzima (ukuphuma kwe-tassel). Lapho ukukhiqiza nokulima kuphathwa kahle futhi izimo zezulu zibi, ama-hybrids awakhiqizi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nama-OPVs. Yini i-variety evulekile yokupollinate (OPV) efana? I-OPV ikhiqiza imbewu ngokuvuleka kokupollinate kuzo zonke izindawo, futhi izinhlobo zixubana (okukhuluma ukuthi ukuvuleka kokupollinate akuphathwa nganoma iyiphi indlela). Ipholeni yezitshalo endaweni ethile ayiphathwa, ngakho umkhiqizo / izitshalo azikwazi ukuba yizifanekiso; isibonelo: ukuphakama kwezitshalo akuzukuba yizifanekiso, umbala wecobho awuzukuba yizifanekiso, usayizi wezindlebe awuzukuba yizifanekiso, nezitshalo azizukufinyelela ngesikhathi esifanayo. Imbewu ibiza kancane noma ayidingi ukuthengwa. Umlimi angasebenzisa ezinye zezimveliso ezivunyiwe ukuze atshale unyaka olandelayo. Izindleko zokuthenga imbewu zingaba phansi kakhulu kunezindleko zokuthenga ama-hybrids. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi uzoba nemali yokukhokha umanyolo nokulawula izilokazane. Imbewu ingaphindwa. Imigqomo yonyaka wamanje ingatshalwa unyaka olandelayo. Akukho sidingo sokutshala ama-hybrids ezindaweni ezingenamandla. Ama-OPVs angaba nezakhi zofuzo ezihlukile, ngakho izikhathi zokutshala azihambisani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzoba nesikhathi sokutshala eside okuzokwenza ama-OPVs avuleke kokupollinate ngesikhathi esifushane uma kunezinto ezibangela izinkinga (amanzi amaningi, ukushisa okuningi, njll.). Lokhu kuhluka kungaholela kumkhiqizo ofanayo uma kuqhathaniswa nawo wonke ama-hybrids atshalwe ngasikhathi sinye. Kubalulekile ukuthenga imbewu eqinisekisiwe njalo eminyakeni emithathu ukuze kuvinjelwe ukulahleka kwamandla kwemvelo emibewwini. Umkhiqizo ungase ube phansi ngo-10 - 25%. Ezindaweni ezinomfertility ephezulu (umhlabathi), ama-OPVs azokwehlisa inzuzo. Izitshalo azizukuba yizifanekiso ngemibala, ukufinyelela, nezinye izici zezithombo. Lokhu kungathinta ukuthengiswa (ikhwalithi). Lapho kunezinto eziningi ezihlukene, kungaba nzima ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngasikhathi sinye, njengokuwasha izilokazane nokuvuna (ikakhulukazi uma usebenzisa umshini wokuvuna). Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-OPV ihlala inamandla, kufanele itshalwe okungenani emamitha angu-300 kude nezinye izinhlobo. Imbewu enekhwalithi ephansi (imibewu ehlelelwe ukutshala unyaka olandelayo kodwa ibekwe ezimeni ezimbi lapho kushisa kakhulu futhi lapho kunezilokazane nezifo) ingaholela ekukhuleni okuphansi futhi izitshalo zihl
Imincintiswano Yezemidlalo: Ukuhlola Izici Nezinzuzo Imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi emhlabeni. Lezi zenzakalo zihlala zikhanga izixuku ezinkulu, zikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Kubalulekile, nokho, ukuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nemincintiswano ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wayo emphakathini. Okokuqala, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ikhulisa umoya wokubambisana. Lapho abantu behlangana ngenhloso yokuwina, bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinikele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano ivula amathuba okukhuluma ngezinkinga zomphakathi, ezifana nokuhlukumezeka, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zezemidlalo ezihlobene nezomnotho. Lokhu kwenza imincintiswano ibe yindawo yokuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile, okuhlinzeka ngethonya elihle emphakathini. Nokho, imincintiswano ingaholela ekucindezelweni kwabathandi bezemidlalo. Abantu abaningi bazimisele kakhulu ukuze baphumelele, okungaholela ekucindezelweni okukhulu. Abadlali bangazizwa bedinga ukwenza kahle ukuze bagcine izithameli zabo zijabule, okungaholela ekuphathweni kabi. Lokhu kucindezelwa kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo, kuhlanganise nokukhathala, ukucindezeleka, noma ukuhlukumezeka. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bemincintiswano baqaphele lezi zingozi futhi banikeze ukwesekwa kwabathandi bezemidlalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano ingaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni. Izinkampani ezinkulu zikhuthazwa ukuba zixhase imincintiswano, lokhu kuholela ekutheni izindawo zithole imali eningi. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni, lapho imincintiswano ibanjwa khona. Futhi, imincintiswano ingakhuthaza ukuvakasha, njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni zabo ukuze babone imicimbi ethokozisayo, okwandisa imali engenayo emiphakathini. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imincintiswano ingaholela ezinkingeni. Ukuncintisana okweqile kungaholela ekutheni abathandi bezemidlalo bazizwe bephatheke kabi uma bephumelela noma behluleka, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuziphatha, njengezokukhwabanisa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi imincintiswano ibanjwe ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwamukela futhi uyahlonishwa. Ekugcineni, imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Izinzuzo zayo ziningi, kuhlanganise nokukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana, ukuvuselela umnotho, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Nokho, kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nayo, njengokucindezelwa kwabathandi bezemidlalo. Ukuze imincintiswano ibe nempumelelo, kumele ibanjwe ngendlela efanele, ihloniphe wonke umuntu, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi izinzuzo zayo zifinyelelwa ngaphandle kokulimaza abanye. Ngale ndlela, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ingaba yinsika eqinile yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Uphuthu: Izimfihlo Zomkhiqizo Wendabuko Isingeniso Uphuthu, umkhiqizo obalulekile ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke, uthathwa njengemfihlo yokuphila kahle. Lezi zinkanyezi eziphilayo zinezinsiza eziningi, ezifaka phakathi impilo enhle, ubuchwepheshe bokudla, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukisa impilo. Kulesi sikhathi, sizohlola imvelaphi yephuthu, ukusebenza kwalo, nezindlela ezahlukene zokuwakha. Imvelaphi yePuthu Uphuthu, okwakwaqanjwa ngezizathu eziningi, kuphila ngokwakha izimo ezintathu noma ezine. Izinceku zitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, zikhula njalo, futhi ziwusizo ezindaweni zokudla. Kancane kancane, uphuthu ufake izimpande ezinzulu emiphakathini yethu, ukuze uthakasele amathuba amaningi. E-Afrika, uphuthu uthathwa njengophuhliso lwemvelo, lapho abantu bezama ukusimama. Ukuze sisebenzise izinzuzo zalo, abantu baqala ukujwayela ukuphuza uphuthu, okubengabantu abahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuveza umqondo wokuthi uphuthu akusikho nje ukudla, kodwa kungenza umzimba uqine futhi ukhule kahle. Izindlela Zokwakha Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu, uma ikhuluma ngezindlela zokwakha, kudingeka ulwazi olunembile. Kubalulekile ukuhlonza amahlamvu afanele ukuze umkhiqizo uqine. Ukuze uphuthu lungathola usawoti, udinga ukudla kahle, uhlole izakhiwo, uqinisekise ukuthi uyathanda, bese uxhumanisa nemishanguzo emisha. Abakhiqizi basebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokwenza uhlanga lwephuthu, kubandakanya ukukhetha amahlamvu ahlanzekile, ukuwaqinisekisa ngokuhlanza kahle. Ngemuva kwalokho, badlula ezinyathelweni ezahlukene, kusuka ekuvuthweni, ukuze uhlanga lube nophethiloli, kube neqhaza elikhulu emandleni engqondo nasempilweni yomzimba. Izinzuzo zePuthu Emzimbini Nasempilweni Uphuthu ubonakaliswa ngokukwazi ukudala impilo engcono. Njengoba usetshenziswa kwezithako ezifanele, uthuthukisa ukukhula kwezakhi zofuzo, uqinisa isikhumba, futhi unciphisa izinhlungu ezinzima. Thina njengabantu, singancoma ikhono lephuthu lokusiza emithini, okwenze kube umkhiqizo ongakhalipha nezinhliziyo zethu. Ngokwemvelo, uphuthu uhlanganisa izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze izicubu zibe namandla. Abantu abahamba phambili ngezokwelapha baveza imiphumela emihle lezi zihloko zinikezwa ngalesi sikhathi sokudla. Kukhona izeluleko eziningi ezivela kumalungu omphakathi ezikhuthaza ukuthokozela uphuthu njengesixazululo sezikhalazo ezithile. Izindlela Zokusebenzisa Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu lungasetshenziswa ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene emakhishini. Abaningi bazi ukudla uphuthu bezikhandla nezithako ezithile, bakha izithako eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi uthokozise ukusinda. Kodwa-ke, kufanele bafake ingqondo endaweni lapho kudalwa khona izimo ezihle. E-West Africa, ukudla uphuthu okuhamba phambili kuxhaswa izithembiso, okuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Khumbula, ukuphila kwesimanje kudinga ukwenziwa okuncane, kuquiwe ekudleni ukuze siphepheke. Ukuze uphuthu lungalethi imiphumela emibi, kubalulekile ukujwayela izindlela eziphumelelayo zokulawula ukwenzeka. Ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza, okumele kubalulelwe ukuhloza izimpawu zephuthu ezikhankanyisiwe. Ukubheka Izenzo Zokuthinta Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu uwumkhiqizo ophephile, kodwa umphakathi unokufaneleka ekusizeni uhambile. Amazingnazo uma kwenzeka kudlalwa ngamaqhinga akudala, akusizi. Umuntu noma imiphakathi kumele ibone ukuthi izinsiza ezithile ziyasebenza kanjani. Uhlanga lwephuthu luhlobene kakhulu nomphakathi, kulandela izinkolelo, kuthinta ubudlelwane bezimpilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uphuthu uyibhalansi ebaluleke kakhulu. Abantu base-Afrika bahlala benalo lonke ulwazi olunembile nolwakudala lokugcina uqondiso eceleni kwezinsuku zanamuhla. Ukuxhumana, ukwenziwa, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwezinhlanga zempilo kube nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Isiphetho Uphuthu, obalulekile emiphakathini yethu, uhlanganisa imfihlo ekahle yokuphila kahle. Ngamafuphi, izinzuzo zawo zikhula phansi kwezinsiza ezahlukene. Ukuwa nogwadule lwezinkanyezi kuzoletha ukujabuliswa nokwenziwa kwezinto eziyinqaba. Ukuhlola izindlela zokwakha uhlanga lwephuthu, nokuqonda izinzuzo ezihambisana nalo, kubalulekile ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophilayo. Ngakho-ke, abavakashi kufanele baqonde indlela ezithinta ngayo izinqubo zempilo, ukuze uphuthu luthuthukise impilo ezinkulu. Ngale ndlela, uphuthu ulindeleke ukuba ube yisibonelo esihle sokuphila, ukubonisa emhlanganweni wezokudla, nesiko lakhe. Abantu bahlala bengahamba phambili, kwehlisa isithombe sokukhiqiza, ukuze uphuthu luthokozise kumphakathi.
Abesifazane abangafuni ukuba baphathwe kabi noma abakhala bangakhushulwa ezikhundleni eziphakeme. I-ICRC ikakhulukazi ikhathele ngokuphathwa kabi kwamalungu omphakathi ngabantu abaphethe izikhali, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, kusho uPatrick Walder, ophatha i-sub-delegation ye-ICRC eBukavu. Imikhankaso nemisebenzi yokukhuthaza nokuhlanganyela komphakathi, kanye nezinsiza, zizosisiza ukuqhubeka nalezi zinhlelo. Amakhono atholakala kulabo abanepotfoliyo, ukuphazamiseka kwemizwa emzimbeni wabo, ukufa ngakolunye uhlangothi, nokuphazamiseka kwemisipha (ukuphazamiseka kokuhamba kwemisipha). Uhulumeni wesifunda uqale ukubhekana nezinsolo zokuthi izinkampani ezimhlophe zisebenzisa abantu abamnyama njengabanikazi noma njengabantu abaphakathi kwezikhundla eziphakeme ezinkampanini zabo. Ezinye izinto zibekwe ebhakedeni elibonisa ubufakazi obungakaze buvulwe ukuze kuhlolwe ehhovisi lendawo elithola impahla. Uma umuntu ethola imali ethintwa yintela kodwa engakhishwa kuyo intela ye-SITE noma ye-PAYE, kufanele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kulowo msebenzi. Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela ngokwenza ukukhokha kusenesikhathi kunokukhokha imali enkulu ekupheleni konyaka lapho kubalwa khona inani lentela elikhokhwayo. Intela yesikhashana izokwenyusa inani elikhokhwayo uma kuqhathaniswa nemali yonke umuntu okufanele akhokhe intela kuyo kulonyaka wezezimali ofanele. Umuntu okumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kufanele, ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngemuva kokuba esebenzela, athumele isicelo esibhalwe phansi sokubhaliswa ehhovisi le-South African Revenue Service. Ukwehluleka ukwenza lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezintshisekelo nezijeziso zokukhokha sekwedlule, kanye nentela eyengeziwe ehlobene nezinkokhelo eziphuthumayo. Usuku lokukhokha intela yesikhashana esikhathini sokuqala lukhona ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezisuka ekupheleni konyaka wentela. Intela yokuqala yesikhashana kufanele imele ingxenye yesibili yentela ephelele ekhokhwayo sonke unyaka, emva kokukhipha intela yabasebenzi ekhishwe ngaleso sikhathi kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimali ezivunyelwe ngaphandle ngaleso sikhathi. Khipha le mali usebenzisa ifomu lokukhokha lentela elingu-IRP6, ngaphambi kosuku lokukhokha. I-SARS izothumela abakhokhi bentela yesikhashana ababhalisiwe amafomu afanele. Intela yesikhashana ingakhokhwa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela esiseduze kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu phakathi kwe-8:00 AM no-3:00 PM, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma abantu bekhokha ngeposi noma beyifaka ebhange, kufanele bavumele isikhathi sokulethwa kweposi noma sokucubungula izinkokhelo zebhange. Uma ukukhokha kuthunyelwa ngocingo, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ibhange linomkhawulo wesikhathi salolo suku futhi kudingeka isikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthumeli unama-funds anele, okungathatha izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. Inombolo yentela kufanele ibe nezinombolo eziyishumi, kanti inombolo lapho imali izokwenziwa khona ibhekisela ku-akhawunti ezothola imali. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe engahambisani nalokho okubhalwe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana nenombolo yentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti ethola, ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha luhlangana nosuku lokuphumula noma iMgqibelo, abantu kufanele bakhokhe ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kosuku lokuphumula noma iMgqibelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile, vakashela ku-website ye-SARS ku-www.sars.gov. Amafomu e-IRP 6 esikhathini sokuqala kufanele athunyelwe, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi akukho ntela yesikhashana okufanele ikhokhwe. Uma ukukhokha kwentela yesikhashana kwenziwa ngokusekelwe emalini ehleliwe engaphansi kwenani lokuqala, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo nencazelo. Ifomu lesicelo sentela le-IRP 6 lesikhathini sokuqala liqukethe incazelo yalelo sicelo. Uma i-SARS inganelisekile, kungacelwa ukuthunyelwa kabusha. Ukuze ugweme izijeziso nezintshisekelo, qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu e-IRP 6 athunyelwa ehhovisi le-SARS elihambelana ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina lokukhokha. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe futhi sithunyelwe kusenesikhathi. Manje ingxenye ye-akhawunti yokukhokha ifomu le-IRP 6 itholakala kwelinye ikhasi elikhaleni. Ifomu lakho lokukhokha lingathunyelwa lodwa ngaphandle kwenani lokukhokha. Isigaba sentela siqinisekisile izinga lesikhungo sokusebenza ezinyangeni ezizayo ezimbili. Uma ucela omunye umuntu ukuthi akusize ukuthumela isaziso sentela, kubalulekile ukwazisa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo bakho futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isigaba sentela asikhulumi ngemininingwane yakho yomuntu. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni (GEMS salary deduction procedures) Ezweni elikhulayo, izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali ziba yisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni, ezinjenge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinyathelo ezithathwayo, izinzuzo, kanye nezimo ezihambisana nazo. Ukuqala, i-GEMS iyinhlangano eyakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni ziqala lapho umsebenzisi ebhalisela le nhlangano. Lokhu kubhaliswa kudinga ukuthi umsebenzisi anikeze imininingwane ethile, efana negama, isibongo, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, umsebenzisi uzothola incwadi yokwamukela, eqinisekisa ukuthi ubhaliswe ngempumelelo. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali ziqala. I-GEMS idonsa imali ethile emholweni wabasebenzi ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Le mali idonswa ngenyanga, futhi ibalwa ngokususelwa kumholo wabasebenzi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bangathola izinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokukhokha izindleko zazo ngasikhathi sinye. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zindleko zikhokhwa ngokuqhubekayo, futhi umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubona izinguquko emholweni wakhe. Uma umholo ushintsha, i-GEMS izobuyekeza inani elidonswayo ukuze lihambisane nezinguquko ezenzekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benokuthola okulinganiselwe kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga zokukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezithuthukile. Abasebenzi bangakhetha phakathi kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zokwelashwa, okuvumela ukuthi bakhethe okuthandayo ngokwezidingo zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izidingo zezempilo zihluke kakhulu phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, kunezimo ezithile ezidinga ukunakwa. Uma umsebenzisi engathandi ukuqhubeka nokudonswa kwemali, kufanele abike lokhu kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kungenziwa kalula, futhi umsebenzisi uzothola iziqondiso ezicacile zokuthi angakwenza kanjani. Kubalulekile ukuthi abhalise izinguquko ngesikhathi, ukuze kungabi nezinkinga zokukhokha ezizovela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza ithuba lokubuyisela imali uma umsebenzisi engasebenzisi izinsizakalo ezithile. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abasebenzi ukuthi bahlale benokuthula, bazi ukuthi uma bengasebenzisi izinsizakalo, bangathola imali yabo emuva. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithile, futhi umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo ukuze athole leli thuba. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS inikeza indlela elula yokukhokha izindleko zezempilo, iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benempilo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baqonde lezi zinqubo, ukuze bakwazi ukuzenza kahle. Ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa lezi zinqubo, i-GEMS izoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi, iqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala benempilo futhi bejabule emsebenzini wabo. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumsebenzi kahulumeni, qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle lezi zinqubo, ukuze uthole okungcono kakhulu kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze uphile impilo enempilo.
Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kungamanga ukuthi ukungasebenzi kwentsha kube yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ithinta izigidi zabantu abasha futhi ithinta kwazulu danosube, ikakhulukazi emzamweni wabo wokufuna imisebenzi. Ukuze sihlonze izizathu ezisemqoka eziholela kulokhu, umcabango ophucukile udinga ukubhekwa. Okokuqala, ukukhula kwezinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha kuhlobene nokuqhamuka kwezinhlelo zokufunda eziphezulu. Abantu abaningi baqeda izifundo eziningi, kodwa uma befika emhlabeni wokusebenza, behlangabezana nenkinga yokungatholi izikhala eziyimfanelo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziguqule ukuhlakulela amakhono ahambelana nezidingo zemakethe. Umthetho wobuchwepheshe uphinde uveze ukuthi imfundo kufanele ikhulise amakhono awusizo okungasebenzi, ukuze khona ukufika okungapheli emsebenzini. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zezomnotho ezinzima zibeka umthwalo omkhulu kulesi sikhala. Ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, izinkinga zokukhula komnotho, kanye nezinhlekelele ezinjengezimo ze-Covid-19 zibe nomthelela omkhulu. Lokhu kufaka umfutho omubi kwezobuhlakani, ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezikhundla ezintsha. Umphakathi kufanele uhlaziye lokhu ukuze uhlonze izixazululo ezinhle zalesi simo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuphila zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ububha, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nemithetho eqinile yokusiza, nazo zibalulekile. Inani elikhulu labantu abasha abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-township alahlekelwe yithuba lokuthi baphumelele emsebenzini. Lezi zimo ziqhubeka ziqinisa ukungasebenzi kwentsha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okukhulu kogesi kwabazwelonke nezifunda ezibalulekile. Umphakathi wezepolitiki unendima enkulu ekukhiqizeni izixazululo. Imibono yesikhumbuzo nemfundo kukhombisa ukuthi njengoba izinhlelo zomphakathi nezezimali ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuyekethisa izinqubomgomo ezikhethekile ezigxile ekufundeni nasekuqeqesheni. Lokhu kuzokwenyusa amathuba okusebenza सहज. Ukuze kubaluleke, kufanele kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zamasiko nezomnotho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfundo iyahambisana nezidingo zempilo. Ngaphezu kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiz resources, ukuhweba nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu basendaweni basize bazakhele amakhono. Ukuze lokho kudluliselwe empilweni yabo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngeziqu nezinhlelo ezihlinzekwa ngamathuba angcono okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe impi yokungasebenzi. Imali ethile kufanele ihlinzeke izifunda ezinomthelela omkhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana nabantu abasha bahlala bejolise emgibeni wokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuphatha, ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngezinyathelo zokuqapha, kudinga ukuthi zibukwiswe ngokukhalipha. Umphakathi wezomnotho uzoba nesandla ekwakheni umsebenzi, uma kubhekwa izindlela ezizokwazi ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abasha futhi baphinde bakwazi ukuxhuma nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwenza abatekenya. Ekuhlaziyeni kwesimo sokutholakala kwentsha, kudinga ukubhekiselwa ezinhlelweni ezenzakalelayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhuthaza uhlelo lokubjobiya ezikhundleni ezintsha, ukujikijela izifundo ezimfushane zokusebenza, nezinye izinhlelo ezikwenziwayo zokwakha indawo yokusebenza engcono nesikhala. Lokhu kuzokwenza umuntu ngamunye akwazi ukubona intuthuko, okuzenzakalelayo kunciphisa indlela yokusebenza eziningi. Ukufingqa, ukuhlola izimo ezizwakalayo nezokungasebenzi kwentsha kumele kube ugqozi oluqinile emphakathini nabaphathiswa. Iphalamende, izinkampani, nezinkampani zomphakathi kudinga ukuba baxhumane futhi bakhe izinkambiso ezizokhulisa iscripe sesikhathi esizayo. Uma siphuma kulesi simo, sizoba neziphumo ezihlangene, nezinhlelo ezenzakalelayo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwentsha. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho olusemthethweni, oluqinile nolwanelisayo, ukuze kwenzeke ukuguqulwa okudingekayo empilweni yabantu abasha. Ngalokhu, sizodinga ukuqhubeka nokuxoxisana, noma ngabe kuhlelwe imihlangano erhubhulayo nezinhlelo eziphambili, ukuze sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinethuba lokusebenza, noluthokozisayo. Iphalamende kudinga ukuba ibonisane ukuze zenzeke izinxephezelo, ukuze izinkampani, uhulumeni, nemiphakathi ibonakale ixhumene ndawonye ekwandiseni izikhala ezikhona. Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezinhle zemisebenzi, ezihlonza umsebenzi nenhlalakahle, kuzohlala kusemqoka. Ngakho-ke, ngazo zonke lezi zinkinga, sinesidingo sokuhleleka, ukuphikelela, nokuhlonza izixazululo, ukuze sithumele umyalezo wokuthi intsha yethu ingamaheliwe. Izinqubomgomo ezimfanele nezisizayo kungama-tools, ukuze sithumele izisho ezizokwenza isimo sibe ngcono. Lokhu kuyacaca – sizodinga ukwakha izinkonzo ezinobuhlakani nesizinda esiqinile, ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuwina empilweni, ithola amathuba okwenza kube ngcono futhi yakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi, kwakukhona idolobha elikhulu elibizwa ngokuthi uMzimkhulu. Leli dolobha laliphezulu ngezinto eziningi, kodwa lalinokuhlupheka okukhulu okubhekene nezakhamuzi zakhona. Abantu bahlala impilo enezinkinga ngenxa yokungabi nempilo, izinsiza ezincane, kanye nezinhlelo eziphukile. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yezenzo ezimbi zabaholi ababephatheka kahle, kodwa besebenzisa amandla abo ngendlela engafanele. UThandi, intombazane encane enomoya ophakeme, wayehlala eMzimkhulu. Wayenothando lokuphila futhi efuna ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Nokho, wayebona ukuthi izinto zazingahambi kahle. Umama wakhe, uNandi, wayephindaphinda ukuthi inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga enkulu. "UThandi, uma ungakwenzi kahle, ubuhlungu bethu buzokhula," wayekhuluma njalo. UThandi wayeziqhenya ngempilo yakhe, kodwa wayefuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani abantu abaningi behlupheka. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noMnumzane Dlamini, umphakathi ophatha izinsiza zomphakathi. Wafunda ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ubengumuntu onamandla, kodwa wayephinde abe nezinhloso ezingalungile. Wayehlela izinhlelo ezazibonakala ziwusizo, kodwa empeleni, wayefuna kuphela ukuzuza imali. UThandi, onobuhlakani, wabona ukuthi kufanele enze okuthile. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabanye abantwana bendawo, ebakhuthaza ukuba baphakamise izwi labo. "Asikwazi ukuhlala sithule, kufanele sikhulume," kusho yena. Abanye baphendula, "Kodwa singenza kanjani? Ubugebengu bukhona!" UThandi wabakhumbuza ukuthi ubuhlakani bethu buhle kakhulu kunobubi, futhi uma besebenzisana, bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko. Ngemva kokuhlangana, uThandi nozakwabo baqala ukuhamba emigwaqweni, bephakamisa izikhumbuzo ezibhalwe ngamagama afana noMnumzane Dlamini. Bafuna abantu bazi ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe. Umphakathi waqala ukubona ukuthi lezi zinsolo zazingekho ezingeni eliphakeme, kodwa zazingezokukhuluma. Abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi kunokukhathazeka, futhi baphakamisa izwi labo. Ubugebengu bukaMnumzane Dlamini baphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba phambili. UThandi nozakwabo baqhubeka nokukhuthaza umphakathi, behlela imihlangano ukuze baphinde baphakamise izwi labo. UThandi waba umholi walesi sikhumbuzo, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi kufanele baphumelele. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uMnumzane Dlamini wathola ukuthi izinsolo zikhona, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu ababephila ngaphansi kwayo babezokhuluma. Waqala ukucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kube nendlela yokuphuma. Wathola ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zazingekho ezandleni zikaMnumzane Dlamini, kodwa zazingokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokukhuluma, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo kumphakathi. Ubugebengu bukaMnumzane Dlamini baphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe. UThandi waba umholi, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba phambili. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi nozakwabo baqeda ukujula kwezinkinga zomphakathi, umphakathi wawuthola amandla, futhi abantu baqala ukuvula amehlo abo. Ubugebengu buphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe.
Imiphumela Yezivivinyo: Ukuhlola, Ukuhlaziya, Nokuhlola Ukuphumelela Ngonyaka wesikole, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibalulekile kakhulu ezimpilweni zabafundi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Lokhu kuhlola akugcini nje ngokubona ukuthi abafundi baphumelele noma baphumelele kanjani, kodwa futhi kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi imizamo, ukuzikhandla, nokuzinikela kwabo kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Ukuhlola Imiphumela Lapho imiphumela yezivivinyo ikhishwa, izigaba ezahlukene zikhombisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Abafundi abaphumelelayo bahlonishwa, futhi imiphumela yabo ibonisa ukuthi imizamo yabo ibiyaphumelela. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sikhohlwe nabasebenzi abahlinzeka ngalezi zifundo, abahola abafundi babo ezindleleni ezinzima zokufunda. Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi izifundo zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze bonke abafundi. Izifundo Ezitholakele Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo ayikhombisi kuphela ukuphumelela, kodwa futhi ibonisa izifundo ezitholakele. Abafundi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona kuphela ekutholeni amamaki aphezulu, kodwa futhi ekutholeni ulwazi oluqinile nolwaziyo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuthi bangabheki nje kumamaki, kodwa baphinde baqonde kahle izifundo abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokufunda okwandayo. Ukusebenza Kwezemfundo Imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa ukuthi izikole zidinga ukucabanga ngempela ngempumelelo yokufundisa. Izikole ezithola imiphumela emihle zihlala zikhuthaza abafundi, zifaka izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, kanye nabazali. Ukuze imiphumela ibe ngempumelelo, izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zabafundi. Izinkinga Ezikhona Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa izinkinga ezithile ezikhona emfundweni. Abafundi abaningana baphinde baveze ukuthi bahluleka, futhi lokhu kudinga ukunakwa. Izizathu zokuhluleka zingahluka, kanti zifaka phakathi ukungabi nakho ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifanele, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, kanye nokungabikho kokwesekwa okuqinile. Ukuze sithuthukise imiphumela, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhasa abafundi abahlangabezana nezinselelo. Ukubuyekeza Nokuthuthukisa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza imiphumela yezivivinyo ukuze kuqondwe kahle izidingo zabafundi. Lokhu kubuyekeza kufanele kube nenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zemfundo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi. Ukubuyekeza akufanele kube yinto eyodwa kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yinqubo eqhubekayo, ethuthukisa indlela yokufunda. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imiphumela yezivivinyo iyisithombe esikhombisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi, izikole, kanye nomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphumela ibhekwane ngokucophelela, futhi izinyathelo zidinga ukuthathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokufunda. Umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukusiza abafundi baphumelele, baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngale ndlela, imiphumela yezivivinyo izoba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ozinikele, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sikhuthaza abafundi bethu, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo iyinsiza yokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Isihloko 2: Neels Ferreira (GrainSA), Johan Kriel (umqondisi wesifunda), Labious Manoto, noTonie Loots (abaphathi besifunda). Umkhiqizi wezinkuni ophumelelayo konyaka, owenze kahle emncintiswaneni we-Grain SA Developing Producer of the Year, wakhethwa emcimbini omkhulu e-Theatre on the Track eKyalami ngomhla ka-17 kuMfumfu 2008. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-Grain SA ifuna ukuveza ukubonga okukhulu kwezolimo lwe-maize, ikakhulukazi kulabo abakhiqizi abasha abenze kahle kulo msebenzi wokukhiqiza ukudla. Bakhombisa indlela phambili kulabo abasanda kuqala kulesi sikhala. Abantu abayisithupha bakhethwe ukuba baphikise umklomelo we-2008 Developing Producer of the Year. Phakathi kwabo bekukhona u-Isaac Khuto ovela eFicksburg eFree State. Uphumelele lo mncintiswano we-Developing Grain Producer uLabious Manoto ovela eMooifontein esifundazweni saseNorth West. Sifuna ukusho 'Hooray!' kuLabious nakwabanye abanye abaphakanyisiwe ngomsebenzi wabo omuhle. Okulandelayo kuyisifinyezo esivela kubahloli ngemva kokubuyekeza umsebenzi kaLabious. Amandla - Usebenza ngokuzikhandla. Ungumsebenzi onobuchule. Unolwazi olufanele ngeshishini lakhe. Iziphakamiso - Sekuyisikhathi sokuba abe umkhiqizi wezohwebo. Amandla - Unemishini yokulima eyanele nemishini yokulima. Uyiqonda kahle, izitshalo zakhe zinhle, futhi imishini yakhe isesimweni esihle. Unemishayo emihle kanye ne-workshop. Amandla - Unendawo (amasimu), unemishini, unabasebenzi ababili, futhi unolwazi lweminyaka eminingi kwezolimo. Amandla - Ulimi ngezitshalo ezihlanganisiwe ezahlukene: maize, soybeans, izinkomo, nezinkomo. Ungumkhiqizi ozinikele onolwazi oluneminyaka eminingi. Unemishini yokulima eyanele, futhi unemisindo emihle kanye ne-workshop esebenza kahle. Unolwazi ngolimo futhi uyazi ukuthi wenza ini futhi uyakuqonda ukuthi kungani enza imisebenzi ethile. Usebenzisa ulwazi lwabo abahlinzeka ngempahla zokulima - imbewu, amafutha, nezinto zokwakha. Ubuthakathaka - Lo muntu usuwaphulile wonke ubuthakathaka, ulima ngendlela elethe inzuzo manje nangesikhathi esizayo. Iziphakamiso - Lo mkhiqizi wenza konke kahle futhi ufika lapho abakhiqizi bezomnotho bekhona. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngolimo nolwazi oluhle ngolimo. Unamasimu amahle (umhlaba) asetshenziswa kahle futhi unemishini eyanele nemishini. Iziphakamiso - Qhubeka nalo msebenzi omuhle! Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle, umhlabathi onokuthola, imvula enhle, nemishini eyanele nemishini enempilo. Ubuthakathaka - Ukuphathwa kwezitshalo kufanele kuqashelwe - ikakhulukazi kweekgras. Ukumaketha kwakhe kungaba ngcono. Iziphakamiso - Qhubeka nokwandisa amandla emishini njengoba amasimu ekhula. Phenya ukuze uthole amasimu okuphonsa. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngomsebenzi wakhe. Iziphakamiso - Kumele abambe iqhaza ezinsukwini zomkhiqizi nasemahhovisi ukuze athole ulwazi ngezindlela ezintsha ezinhle. Amandla - ungumuntu omkhulu - unamaqhawe amakhulu - izinyathelo ezilandelwayo. Ungumthombo wokuqwashisa ongakhuthaza abanye ukuba bamlandele - ikakhulukazi abafana bakhe. Uthumele iqiniso lokuthi ikusasa lezolimo ezandleni ezifana nezakhe lizokhanya futhi liqhubeke. Ubephumelela ngaphandle kokuhlupheka iminyaka eminingi ngaphandle kokuba nethuba lokuthuthuka. Ngiyamhlonipha, ungumuntu onobungcweti. Phambili nabantu. Usakhula ukuba abe umkhiqizi wezohwebo, kodwa akesabi ukubona izindawo lapho engakhululekile khona nokucela usizo - futhi uzimisele ukuthola lokho kusizo. Iziphakamiso - Umkhiqizi Wonyaka 2008!
Ukuntuleka Kwemisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya eNingizimu Afrika, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi sekuphenduke inkinga enkulu, ezwakalisa izinselelo eziningi kumphakathi. Izinsuku zethu zikhombisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyisisekelo sokuphila kahle, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwayo, abantu baningi abakhubazekile ukudla okwaneleyo, izindlu ezifanele, kanye nemfundo ezayo. Kuqala, kudingeka kuqondwe ukuthi le nkinga igqamile emiphakathini eminingi. Izizathu eziningi zenza ukuthi le miphakathi ibhekane nezithiyo ezinkulu ekutholeni imisebenzi. Ukuntuleka kwezimali zokutshala, ukwehla kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, kanye nezinselele ezinkulu kwezokuthutha, ziza phambili njengemithombo yalesi simo. Iziphathimandla zikhuluma ngale miphakathi, zikhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, kodwa imiphumela ivele ibonakale kancane. NgokweZibalo, inani labantu abavela emiphakathini yasemakhaya abangu-60% baphila ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuphila emaphakathini aanhlamvu omnotho, okwenza ukuba kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu abaningi bakhuluma ngempilo elindeleke kabi, okukhombisa ukuthi bahlushwa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi nemisebenzi, nokwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka emindenini, lapho kukhula khona umuzwa wokwehluleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imfundo eyanele ikhalipha abantu ekutholeni imisebenzi, kodwa emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuqeqeshwa kwemicabango namakhono akabikhona. Izikhungo zemfundo azitholi ukweseka okuningi, futhi abantwana balahleka ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusilela kwezinto ezifanele ezidingekayo ezikoleni, okubangela ukuba abafundi bahlale behluleka emikhakheni ethile. Iziphathimandla ziqhamuka nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa izimo zemisebenzi, njengokwakha izikhungo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Nokho, imiphumela yazo zihlala ziphansi, ngenxa yokuthi imithombo ethile ibonakala iyisitshalo esithile esithola ukufinyelela. Kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezakhamizi neziteshi zezimali, ukuze kube nokuqonda okukhululekile phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo ezithuthukisa umnotho wahulumeni zithinteka futhi zandiswa, kodwa akukhona okwanele. Umnotho omncane wezifunda ezisemakhaya uhlale ungapheli, nezinselele ezivela kumazinga aphakeme zihlala zibonakala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwehluka kwezifunda nemicabango, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuphila, eziklanyelwe ukwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuhlala kwezokuthuthukiswa kumele ziqinise imiphakathi yasemakhaya. Lokhu kumele kufake phakathi ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi, ukuphakanyiswa kwezinga lemfundo, nokukhuthazwa kokusebenza komphakathi. Umugqa wokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nosomabhizinisi kumele uqhubeke, ukuze kwandiswe amathuba okwakha imisebenzi. Ezinye izixazululo ezisematheni zifaka phakathi ukusungula imiphakathi emisha, ukuhlomisa izinsizakalo kulo mkhakha, kanye nokunikezela ngezinsizakalo ezinjengezohwebo ezineqhaza emiphakathini. Ukuze lezi zixazululo zisetshenziswe ngendlela ephumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuguqula indlela musha yokubona imisebenzi, kuze kube sekupheleni. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kumele kube umqondo okhangayo, okubangela ukuqwashisa emphakathini. Ukuze siphumelele, kumele sifunde ukwakha izixazululo ezithinta izidingo zomphakathi, sinike izinsizakalo ezimqoka, futhi senze konke okusemandleni ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo nemisebenzi. Uhlanga lwezinto olunqamulelayo lukhona, kodwa sizokwazi ukuyedwa uma sithola isixazululo esifanele sokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Kulesi sikhathi sokuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya, kudinga ukuqwashisa okukhulu, ukusekelwa kukaHulumeni, kanye nokuqonda okunembile kwezinselelo ezikhona. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kumele sibe nesibindi sokuhlanganisa izindlela zokuxazulula nokuthuthukisa izimo, ukuze sikhulise amathuba okuphila kahle komphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela isithombe esitholakalayo emiphakathini yasemakhaya, sithuthukise izinga lempilo, nokugcina isithunzi somphakathi sibuye sibe ngaphezulu.
UXolile Dasheka wazalwa efemini endaweni yasePetrusburg. Ubaba wakhe wayesebenza efemini kanti umama wakhe wayengumsebenzi wasekhaya. UXolile unedigri kuMphakathi kanye nezeMali kanye neDiploma kuMphakathi Wobudlelwano. Wathenga ifemu yakhe, iLemoenkloof, endaweni yaseJagersfontein ngo-2006 ngenkampani yeLand Bank. Ifemu yakhe inobukhulu obuyi-1,134 hectares, lapho u-145 hectares kuyindawo yokulima kanti u-989 hectares isetshenziselwa ukugaya izinkomo. UXolile uhlala ekhula ummbila, uphisa izinkomo zenyama, izinkukhu, nezinkuni, futhi uphinde akhule imifino. Uthola kanjani imali yokuphatha izitshalo zakho? Eminyakeni emibili edlule, angikathengisi izitshalo. Ngizisebenzisile ukudla izinkomo zami. Ngisebenzise enye ingxenye yokwenzayo ukuphatha umkhiqizo wonyaka ozayo. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko, ngizozama ukuthola imali ukuze ngisize ngempela kwiLand Bank. Yini imibono yakho ngezimo zezimali kwezolimo? Umkhiqizi kufanele abe yizinto eziningi; isibonelo, kufanele abe uchwepheshe kwezimali, umnotho, umthengisi, nokuningi. Izingxenye zenzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zincane kakhulu. Sidinga umphakathi ukusiza abakhiqizi baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuthenga imikhiqizo yasendaweni. Sidinga ukuba kube nentela ezimpahleni ezithengiswa ezweni. Izindleko zokufaka njenge-diesel nezinsiza zokulima ziyasibulala. Ezolimo akuyona insimu ethokozisa intsha yabantu abamnyama; abawuboni umbono wesikhathi esizayo kuyo. Uma izindleko nezimpahla ezingenayo zingalawulwa, ukuncintisana okukhona ezimpahleni ezixhaswayo kuzobhubhisa umkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthola kuphi izinsiza zakho? Ngithenga kulabo abamele abahlinzeki bezinkampani ezinikeza lezo zinsiza, ngemuva kokuthola nokuhlonza amanani aphakanyisiwe nokucabangela ukwesekwa abakunikeza ukusiza ngezinkinga ezivela ngemuva kokuthenga kubo. Yini indima kahulumeni kwezolimo futhi ubani uyiqedela kanjani? Uhulumeni kufanele anakekele abakhiqizi. Abakhiqizi benza amathuba emisebenzi nokuzinza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Kumele babheke umhlaba onikezwa abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nokwesekwa okunikezwa ukuze babasize baphumelele kwezimali nasemathulini okusebenza. Kumele kube nokukhuthazwa kulabo abakhuluma ngokwenza imali. Kumele kukhokhwe amanani afanelekile, futhi usizo kufanele lucelwe lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni uyazama, kodwa okwamanje akaphumelelanga. Yini obona njengokuthinta impumelelo yakho? Ikhono lami lokuphatha izinto eziningi lingenzele kahle. Izinkomo zikunikeza ukuzinza futhi zikusiza ngemali edingekayo. Ukuphisa izinkukhu nezinkomo zenyama kungisizile ukuhlangabezana nezindleko zami zenyanga. Nginephuzu elincane lomhlaba lokulima elingu-3 hectares engazi ukuthi ngingalima. Ngikhula imifino ukuze ngithole imali ngokushesha. Futhi, iqiniso lokuthi angigxile ngokuphelele kwezolimo, nginokunye umsebenzi ozinzile, kuyasiza. Uma ezolimo zingaba nezindleko ezinkulu, ngizoba umkhiqizi wesikhathi esigcwele. Yini obona njengengozi empumelelweni yakho? Ngikhathazekile ukuthi ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezinzile, ukukopela, kanye nezindaba ezithokozisayo zingaphazamisa amathuba ami empumelelo. Ukuthola inzuzo kuyinto ebalulekile. Yiziphi izingxenye zokuhweba kwezolimo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa? Ngifuna ukuba nolwazi oluningi lwezobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuphathwa komhlaba, ukonga amanzi, nokunakekela izinkomo. Ngifuna futhi ukuthi abasebenzi bami bathole ukuqeqeshwa. Yisiphi isu ozophila ngaso kulo nyaka? Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwami lokwesekwa lukhona. I-Grain SA neqembu lami locwaningo kubalulekile ekunikezeni usizo. Ngifuna futhi ukwandisa ukulima izinkomo zami, okuyizinkomo zenyama. Uma ukukopela kungasuswa, ngifuna ukuqala ukuphisa izimvu.
IKOMISHINI YOKWENZA KUPHUMELELA KWESIKHATHI SOKUFIKELA KULWAZI NENDAWO YEKOMISHINI YOKWENZA KUPHUMELELA KWESIKHATHI SOKUFIKELA KULWAZI. Ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokuphakanyiswa Kwefayela Lokufinyelela Kulwazi, uMthetho No. IKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esisunguliwe ngokweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inenhloso yokuhlola, ukubheka, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphatha imisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mthethosisekelo ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ngaphezu kwamandla akhuluma ngenhla, i-PSC inenhloso yokuphakanyiswa kwezindlela zokwenza imisebenzi yeHulumeni ibe nekhono nelungelo, nokuphakanyiswa kwemigomo nemigomo yokuphatha umphakathi njengoba ibhalwe kwiMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi kahulumeni. IKomishini ithola amandla ayo ezigabeni 195 no-196 zeMthethosisekelo ka-1996. Isigaba 195 sichaza izimiso nemigomo ephethe ukuphathwa komphakathi okumele iKomishini iphakamise. Izinga eliphakeme lezemfundo. Ukusetshenziswa kahle, okungabizi, nokusebenza kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuphathwa komphakathi okuhloswe ukuthuthukiswa. Izinsizakalo kumele zinikezwe ngendlela engakhethi, ngendlela efanele, ngendlela efanele, futhi ngaphandle kokwehluleka. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kumele ukhuthazwe ukuba ube nengxenye ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kube nekhono. Ukuveza kufanele kuphakanyiswe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi kumele kukhuthazwe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokusebenza futhi uphatha abasebenzi ngokwekhono, ukucabanga okuzimele, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ububi obudlule. Ukuphakanyiswa kwemigomo nemigomo yokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 95 soMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yeHulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukubheka, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphatha, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ukulandela izimiso nemigomo echazwe esigabeni 195, kanye nasekusebenzeni kukahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke nelasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela nezincazelo okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZigaba Zikazwelonke noma kwiZigaba Zasezindaweni njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nomsebenzi kumaphoyisa afanele abhekelele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza iziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukwenza umsebenzi nokuqinisekisa izinga. Lezi zingxenye zihlelwe zibe yizinhlelo ezimbili, okungukuthi: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Okuxhumene Nabasebenzi; kanye Nokubheka Nokuhlola Umsebenzi Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Ezinye zezincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC zifaka phakathi, phakathi kokunye, Isimo Sezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, Ucwaningo Lokwaneliseka Kwabantu, Ukulinganisa Ukusebenza Kwe-National Anti-Corruption Hotline, kanye Nokuhlaziywa KweMikhankaso Yokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS ne-TB Ezinsizakalweni Zomphakathi. Uhlu oluhlanganisa zonke lezi zincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC lutholakala esigabeni 15 se-PSC/OPSC futhi lutholakala futhi kwi-website ye-PSC, www.psc.gov.za. IKomishini isunguliwe ngokweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. IMthethosisekelo ifuna iKomishini eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu awo athunyelwe nguMongameli ngokuhlonishwa kweZigaba Zikazwelonke, kanti ilungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye lithunyelwa nguMphakathi wesifunda. IKomishini ibophelelwe kwiZigaba Zikazwelonke okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo ezindaweni kumazinga asezindaweni. Ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amaKomishina amahlanu avela ePretoria kanye nelungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye. I-PSC ixhaswa yiHhovisi leKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, elikhokhelwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele (ongumsebenzi ophethe). Njengoba kudingeka, uMongameli uthumela amalungu alishumi nane. Isakhiwo sokuphatha se-PSC sihlela ukulandela izinhloso zayo ezicacile nezindawo zayo zokusebenza. Umsebenzi weKomishini uhlelwe ube yizigaba zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwenqaku 1 ngenhla. Ibhange: Izinsizakalo Zomphakathi Nokuxhumana linikeza ukuphathwa okuphelele kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali; ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu nezinsizakalo zokuxhasa, ukuxhumana, kanye nobuchwepheshe bolwazi kwi-O/PSC. Ibhange: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Kwezinsizakalo Zabasebenzi kuvumela iKomishini ukuba ithuthukise ukuphathwa kobudlelwano babasebenzi, yenze ukuhlolwa kwamahhovisi, futhi ihlole futhi iphakamise ukulwa nobugebengu; kanye nokubuyekeza ukwenzeka kwemigomo yabasebenzi ezisebenzelana nohulumeni. Ibhange: Ukuhlola Nokubheka kusekela izinga eliphakeme lokuhola emisebenzini yeHulumeni, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhishwa ngendlela efaka phakathi ukubandakanywa komphakathi. Inhloso yewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zik 정부 yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyodwa mayelana nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso wukuxhumanisa phakathi kwabantu abanamandla nabangenamandla, phakathi komnotho wokuqala nowesibili. Le webhusayithi iyisimanga esibalulekile sokubandakanya nokusiza ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi bonke abantu bangaxhumana nohulumeni. Abasebenzisi abaqondile ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe, amabhizinisi akhona kanye namabhizinisi azayo eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezikhungo nezakhamuzi noma izikhungo zangaphandle ezidinga izinsizakalo kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzisi ababalulekile bahlanganisa izikhungo zokuxhumanisa umphakathi ezifana nezikhungo zomphakathi eziningi, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa emiphakathini, nezikhungo zokuxhumana zikahulumeni ezifana nezikhungo zokushayela zeBatho Pele Gateway, ezizosisiza abantu ekusebenziseni le webhusayithi kulabo abangakwazi ukufinyelela i-inthanethi ngqo. Le webhusayithi innehla ngemininingwane mayelana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa uhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke. Izinsizakalo zabantu bangaphandle: imininingwane efanele abantu bangaphandle abadinga izinsizakalo ezithile kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Izigaba ngasinye kulolu hlelo nazo zihlelwe ngendlela ehambisana nezikhathi empilweni yomuntu noma ibhizinisi. Izikhathi zokuphila zihlelwa ngokulandela izigaba zokuphila. Imininingwane ngezinsizakalo nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ihlelwe ngokwezindawo eziyisixhenxe ezibalulekile, ezihlanganisa: incazelo, izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okulethwa kwezinsizakalo nezikhathi zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo, izindleko, amafomu okufanele agcwaliswe, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Le ngxenye yewebhusayithi, ekhombisa isandla esikhaleni sokudla esiqondisa indlela okufanele uhambise ngayo, ixhumanisa nawe kwezinye amawebhusayithi ahlobene, mayelana nalokho okwenzekayo empilweni. Le webhusayithi ilungiselelwe ngolimi olukhuluma ngolimi olukhulu: isiNgisi, isiAfrikaans, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, isiPedi, isiSotho, isiTsonga, isiVenda, isiSwati, kanye nesiTswana. Ngoba imininingwane ibhalwe kuqala ngesiNgisi bese ihunyushwa kwezinye izilimi. Imininingwane ngezinsizakalo kwezinye izilimi ifakwa kwiwebhusayithi ngemuva kokuhunyushwa. Sebenzisa ikhasi lokuxhumana nathi ukuze uphawule noma ubuze ngale webhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Ikheli lewebhusayithi yokuxhumana nohulumeni ngu: www.gov.za elikuvumela ukuthi ufike futhi uxhumane nekhasi lokuthi ungene kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokungena, kanye newebhusayithi yolwazi lukahulumeni. Imame yewebhusayithi ihlinzeka ngezithombe nezithombe zendlela yewebhusayithi. Ihlelwe ukusuka phansi ukuya phezulu, ibeka imininingwane kwiwebhusayithi ngamasango nezihloko ezithile. Lokhu kukusiza ukuthi ubone kahle futhi uqonde ukuhleleka nokwenzeka okukhonjiswa yiwebhusayithi. Ikhasi lekhaya lihlanganisa izinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula. Lezi zindawo zokungena zikusiza ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezinhlanu ezivakashelwe kakhulu ngabasebenzisi. Uhlu luhlelwe futhi luhlelwe ngokuhlinzeka ngama-visit counts. Ibhokisi lokusesha litholakala kuwo wonke amakhasi ewebhusayithi. Uma ufaka igama lokusesha, izosesha yonke iwebhusayithi ngalezi zisho, ikhetha izixhumanisi lapho kukhona iPrimary Search. Umsebenzi wokusesha uwukusesha imininingwane kwezinye amawebhusayithi kahulumeni. Izixhumanisi kwezinye amawebhusayithi angaphandle nazo zikhonjiswa ngamagama athi 'external link - opens in a new window' ezovela ebhokisini uma ikhursi yakho ibhampa phezu kwaleyo nxazonke. Le webhusayithi izovuleka efasiteleni elisha ukuze uhambise kwezinye amawebhusayithi. Le webhusayithi izoqhubeka ibuyekezwa ngemininingwane emisha. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane noma nini lapho itholakala. Nokho, abaklami nabathuthukisi bewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane evela kwezinye amawebhusayithi esixhumanisa nazo ezishicilelwe lapha izoba neqiniso ngaleso sikhathi. Bheka Izimo Nezimo, isigaba 4.3. Iminyango kahulumeni iyabamba imininingwane yabo kwiwebhusayithi. Le nsizakalo ihlinzekwa kubasebenzi bokuxhumana bamanzi, abawuthintayo imininingwane eshicilelwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzi bokuxhumana kukahulumeni bangabantu abaphethe ukuphathwa kokuqukethwe nokuhlanganisa umqondo wokwenzeka okuqukethwe kwiwebhusayithi. Imininingwane ikakhulukazi ihlelwe kule webhusayithi ngefomethi ye-HTML. Nokho, ezinye izincwadi zitholakala ngefomethi ye-PDF, ezihlinzekwe ngendlela yokuthi zigcine uhlobo okumele zibe nalo ukuze zihlale zihlala. Ukuze uvule izincwadi ze-PDF udinga i-Adob Acrobat Reader 4, noma inguqulo ephezulu kukhompyutha yakho. Lokhu kuzokuvumela ukuthi uvule izincwadi ngqo kwi-browser yakho. Ngezinye izikhathi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuvula izincwadi ze-PDF. Kulokhu, siphakamisa ukuthi ulandele izincwadi kukhompyutha yakho bese uzivula lapho. Sebenzisa umouse wakho, chofoza kwesokudla kudokhumenti ofuna ukuyilanda. Ku-menu yokwehla, khetha 'Save target as'. Ku-'Save as' iwindi, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kudokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile. Vula i-Acrobat Reader, bese uvula izincwadi ofuna ukuzilanda kukhompyutha yakho. Sebenzisa umouse wakho, gcina shift bese uchofoza ku-link yedokhumenti ofuna ukuyigcina. Ku-'Save as' iwindi, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kudokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile. Vula i-Acrobat Reader, bese uvula izincwadi ofuna ukuzilanda kukhompyutha yakho. Uthanda usizo ngezinkinga obhekana nazo kule webhusayithi? Sicela uxhumane nathi nge-imeyili: uma unenkinga ngewebhusayithi.
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi: Isingeniso Kulezi zinsuku, abasebenzi banomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini ezahlukene. Ukuwazisa, ukuhlinzeka ngosizo, nokubakhuthaza kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi impumelelo. Ngakho, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kuyisici esibalulekile sokwakha indawo yokusebenza ephumelelayo nefaka umoya omuhle. Umqondo Wokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Ukuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kubonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokubahlonipha, ukunikela ngemibono, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezikhumbuzo kumuntu noma eqenjini. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bazi imizamo, ubuhlakani, nezimpumelelo zabasebenzi. Ukuqashelwa kudala umoya omuhle, okwandisa ukuzinikela, futhi kukhuphule impumelelo ezinkampanini. Izindlela Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Izindlela zokuhlonipha zihluke kakhulu. Zingaba zifushane, njengezincwadi zokuhlonipha ezivela kubaphathi, noma zibe zinde, njengezinhlelo ezihlanganisa imiklomelo emikhulu. Izinkampani ezithuthukile zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene, njengemiklomelo yokusebenza kahle, izinhlelo zokwazisa, noma imikhankaso yokubika izimpumelelo. Imiklomelo Yokusebenza Kahle Imiklomelo yokusebenza kahle iyindlela ethandwa kakhulu yokuhlonipha abasebenzi. Lokhu kungaba ukuhlinzeka ngohambo, imali, noma izikhumbuzo ezikhethekile, okwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile futhi kukhuthaze abanye ukuba bakhuphule izinga labo lokusebenza. Izinhlelo Zokuhlonipha Izinhlelo zokuhlonipha zihlala zinezinzuzo eziningi. Izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlelwe kahle ukuze ziqashele abasebenzi, okuhlanganisa imiklomelo yokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuhlonipha ezibhalwe phansi, kanye nemikhosi yokwazisa. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baphumelele futhi zibhala izinqumo ezinhle. Ukwaziswa Nokuqashelwa Kwezimpumelelo Ukwaziswa nokuhlonishwa kwezimpumelelo kwabasebenzi kudinga ukuba kube nokuqonda okujulile, kucace futhi kube nokuhlonipha. Abaphathi kufanele baqonde izimpumelelo ezithile zabasebenzi futhi baveze lokhu emphakathini, okwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile. Izinzuzo Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kuholela ezinzuzweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukukhulisa ukuzinikela, ukwandisa umkhiqizo, nokwakha isimo esihle emsebenzini. Abasebenzi abazizwa behloniphekile bazama ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo, okwakha ithimba elikhuthazayo. Ukubaluleka Kokuziphatha Okuhle Ukuziphatha okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi kubalulekile ekukhuthazeni imiklomelo nokuqashelwa. Uma abasebenzi bebonisa ukuziphatha okuhle, baveza ukuzimisela ukufinyelela izinhloso, okudingeka ukuqashelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe umoya omuhle. Izinselelo Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Nokho, zikhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Abanye abaphathi bangase bangakwenzi lokhu ngendlela efanele, noma babe nezinkinga zokwahlulela, okungaholela ekungahambisani. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi baqonde izidingo zabasebenzi ukuze imiklomelo ihambisane nezinjongo zebhizinisi. Isiphetho Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza ephumelelayo. Ukuqonda izimpumelelo, ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango, nokuhlonipha abasebenzi kudala umoya wokuzinikela, kukhuphule umkhiqizo, futhi kugqugquzele ukuthuthukiswa. Izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuhlonipha abasebenzi bazo ukuze bonke baziswe futhi bakwazi ukukhula emikhakheni abawuthandayo, okuholela ekuzuzeni okukhulu kubo nakwizinhlangano.
